Gen/1.lcc_original: 起初上帝創造天地。
notes: 神(UNV, H0430/Elohim) → 上帝(LCC): standard systematic substitution, same Hebrew referent
Both {<WH0853>} (את direct-object markers) remain implicit in LCC — no explicit particle appears before 天 or 地, so braces are kept per rule 4

Gen/1.lcc_original: 地還沒有定形、混混沌沌；黑暗在深淵上面；上帝的靈覆煦在水面上。
notes: LCC '還沒有定形' collapses two Hebrew words into one phrase — H1961 (הָיְתָה, was) + H8414 (תֹהוּ, formless); both tags appended at end of phrase with morphology <WTH8804> kept adjacent to H1961.
UNV's implicit {<WAH05921>} (עַל) becomes explicit 在 in LCC due to word order inversion (UNV: 淵面黑暗 vs. LCC: 黑暗在深淵上面); braces dropped per Rule 3.
In '在深淵上面': 在 = H5921 (עַל, upon), 深淵 = H8415 (תְהֹום, deep), 上面 = H6440 (פְּנֵי, face/surface).
LCC 上帝 = UNV 神 = H430 (אֱלֹהִים); LCC 覆煦 = UNV 運行 = H7363 (מְרַחֶפֶת, hovering/brooding).

Gen/1.lcc_original: 上帝說：『要有光』；就有了光。
notes: 神 (UNV, WH0430) maps to 上帝 (LCC) — same referent, different term; SN attaches to 上帝 as a normal (non-implicit) tag
Punctuation differences (「」→『』, ，→；) are preserved per LCC original; only tags inserted

Gen/1.lcc_original: 上帝看光很好；上帝就把光暗分開了。
notes: Second God (H430): UNV uses implicit {<WH0430>} (God is elided), but LCC explicitly restates 上帝 — braces dropped per rule 3 and SN attached directly.
是好的 (UNV) → 很好 (LCC): both express H2896 טוֹב; SN attached to 很好.
UNV comma (，) → LCC semicolon (；): punctuation preserved exactly as LCC has it.
Direct object marker {<WH0853>} and conjunction {<WH03588>} remain implicit (braces kept) as LCC has no explicit words for either.

Gen/1.lcc_original: 上帝稱光爲晝，稱暗爲夜。有晚上有早晨：是一日。
notes: UNV 神 and LCC 上帝 both represent H0430 (אֱלֹהִים); tag attaches to 上帝
UNV 頭一<WH0259> → LCC 一<WH0259>: LCC omits 頭 (ordinal prefix) but 一 still carries H0259 (אֶחָד)
LCC omits the demonstrative 這 present in UNV before 是; no SN was assigned to 這 so no tag is lost
UNV quotation marks 「晝」「夜」are absent in LCC; SNs attach directly to 晝 and 夜 after 爲 in both cases

Gen/1.lcc_original: 上帝說：『衆水之間要有穹蒼，將水和水分開。』
notes: 上帝 (LCC) vs 神 (UNV) — both render אֱלֹהִים (H0430); systematic LCC/UNV difference
穹蒼 (LCC) vs 空氣 (UNV) — both render רָקִיעַ (H07549, firmament/expanse); LCC uses more astronomically precise term
LCC's second explicit 水 (in 和水) corresponds to UNV's implicit {<WAH09001>}{<WH04325>} (לָמָיִם) — applied Rule 3, dropped braces
LCC 分開 (two-char compound) carries the SN and morphology of UNV 分 (<WH0914><WTH8688>)
{<WAH01961>}{<WTH8799>} (וִיהִי, 'and let it be') remains implicit in LCC — no explicit Chinese word corresponds to it in the 將…分開 structure

Gen/1.lcc_original: 上帝造了穹蒼，將穹蒼以下的水和穹蒼以上的水分開：就這樣成了。
notes: UNV 空氣 → LCC 穹蒼: different translation of H7549 (raqia); both mean firmament/expanse
UNV 分開了 → LCC 分開: LCC omits aspect particle 了; H0914+WTH8686 attach to 分開
UNV 事就這樣 → LCC 就這樣: LCC drops 事; H3651 attaches to 就這樣
LCC 和 (between the two water clauses) left unannotated — replaces UNV enumeration comma 、; the waw conjunction is absorbed into the WAH prefix of the second H0996 (beyn)
{<WAH0853>} and {<WH0834>} remain implicit — LCC also has no explicit words for the direct object marker or the second relative pronoun

Gen/1.lcc_original: 上帝稱穹蒼爲天：有晚上有早晨，是第二日。
notes: 上帝 (LCC) ↔ 神 (UNV): both = אֱלֹהִים WH0430; systematic lexical difference between versions
穹蒼 (LCC) ↔ 空氣 (UNV): both = רָקִיעַ WH07549 (firmament/expanse); WAH09001 definite article prefix attached to 穹蒼 as in UNV
爲 left unannotated — connective particle with no Hebrew counterpart (Hebrew uses direct apposition: וַיִּקְרָא...שָׁמַיִם)
LCC omits comma between 晚上 and 有早晨 (vs UNV 有晚上，有); punctuation preserved exactly as in LCC original

Gen/1.lcc_original: 上帝說：『天下的水要積聚在一處，讓旱地露出來。』就這樣成了。
notes: 神 (UNV) → 上帝 (LCC) for H0430; both render אֱלֹהִים (Elohim)
聚 (UNV) → 積聚 (LCC) for H6960 קָוָה; LCC uses a two-character compound — SN tags attached to 積聚 as a unit
使 (UNV) → 讓 (LCC) — both are causative particles with no SN annotation in UNV; left unannotated in LCC
UNV has 事 before 就這樣 (unannotated, added for readability); LCC omits it entirely — WAH03651 attaches directly to 就這樣
LCC uses 『』 vs UNV 「」 — quotation marks preserved as-is per rule 7

Gen/1.lcc_original: 上帝稱旱地爲地，稱水之積聚爲海：上帝看這很好。
notes: 上帝 (LCC) vs 神 (UNV) both = H0430 Elohim — straightforward lexical variant
之 before 積聚 is a Chinese genitive particle with no Hebrew counterpart — left unannotated; 積聚 carries WAH09001+WH04723 (מִקְוֵה miqveh)
{<WAH03588>} is implicit כִּי in UNV but LCC renders it explicitly as 這 ('this/that') — dropped braces per Rule 3
很好 annotated as a phrase with WH02896 (טוֹב); 很 is a Chinese intensifier with no Hebrew equivalent but inseparable from the headword 好 in LCC's rendering

Gen/1.lcc_original: 上帝說：『地要發生青草、和結種子的菜蔬、跟結果子的樹在地上，各從其類，果子裏有種子：』就這樣成了。
notes: LCC explicitly renders '在地上' (on the earth) for UNV's implicit {<WAH05921>}{<WH0776>}; braces dropped per Rule 3
LCC '裏' (inside) explicitly renders UNV's implicit {<WAH09002>} (Heb. בוֹ 'in it'); braces dropped per Rule 3
LCC '有' (to have/exist) in '果子裏有種子' has no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated per Rule 5
LCC uses '樹' vs UNV '樹木'; same SNs (H6529+H6086) transferred to the shorter form

Gen/1.lcc_original: 於是地生出了青草，和結種子的菜蔬，各從其類，跟結果子的樹，各從其類，果子裏有種子。上帝看這很好。
notes: UNV 神 → LCC 上帝 (standard variant for Elohim)
UNV 發生了 → LCC 生出了 (synonymous verb, same H3318)
UNV 樹木 → LCC 樹 (abbreviated form, same H6086)

UNV {<WAH03588>} implicit 'that/כִּי' → LCC 這 serves as complementizer introducing the clause, braces dropped per Rule 3
UNV {<WAH0834>} 'which/אֲשֶׁר' kept implicit — LCC has no explicit relative pronoun; the relationship is expressed structurally via 裏
LCC 有 (have) has no Hebrew equivalent (Hebrew uses nominal clause אֲשֶׁר זַרְעוֹ־בוֹ), left unannotated per Rule 5
LCC 很 (very) is a Chinese intensifier with no separate Hebrew source, grouped with 好 for H2896

Gen/1.lcc_original: 有晚上有早晨，是第三日。
notes: UNV and LCC text are identical for this verse — direct 1:1 tag transfer with no ambiguity.

Gen/1.lcc_original: 上帝說：『天穹要有發光之體來分晝夜；它們要做天象，定節令、日子、年歲；
notes: LCC 天穹 (vault of heaven) absorbs both H07549 (raqia/firmament) and H08064 (shamayim/heavens) since LCC combines the two Hebrew nouns into a single compound
UNV implicit {<WAH01961>}{<WTH8804>} (והיו, 'and they shall be') becomes explicit in LCC as 它們要做 — braces dropped per Rule 3, tags attached after 做 (the verb corresponding to היה)
LCC 天象 (celestial signs) maps to H0226 (oth/sign); UNV uses 記號 — different Chinese word but same semantic referent

Gen/1.lcc_original: 要做發光之體在天穹裏，來照在地上；』就這樣成了。
notes: LCC 要做 corresponds to UNV 並要 — 做 captures the verbal sense of H1961 (הָיָה, to be/become)
LCC 發光之體 (luminous bodies) expands UNV 發光 but maps to the same H3974 (מָאוֹר, luminary)
LCC 天穹 (celestial dome) is a single compound covering both H8064 (שָׁמַיִם, heavens) and H7549 (רָקִיעַ, firmament); all three SNs attached to the compound
裏 is a Chinese locative particle with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated
LCC 來照 (come to illuminate) replaces UNV 普照 (illuminate everywhere) but maps to same H0215 (אוֹר, to give light)

Gen/1.lcc_original: 於是上帝造了兩個大的發光體：一個較大的發光體來管白晝，一個較小的發光體來管黑夜；又造星辰。
notes: UNV has implicit {<WH03974>} (luminary) for both the 'greater' and 'lesser' clauses, but LCC explicitly says 發光體 in all three instances — braces dropped per Rule 3
來 (purpose particle) left unannotated; Hebrew prefix ל (H9001) kept attached to 管 following UNV convention
一個 (classifier) and 較 (comparative marker) are Chinese grammatical words with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated per Rule 5
又造 carries no separate SN (Hebrew repeats וְאֵת but not the verb עָשָׂה); follows UNV which also leaves 又造 untagged

Gen/1.lcc_original: 上帝把這些發光之體佈置在天穹，讓它們照在地上，
notes: UNV {<WAH0430>} is implicit (no explicit '神' subject), but LCC has explicit '上帝' → dropped braces per rule 3
LCC '天穹' (sky-vault) maps to UNV '天空' (sky-expanse): split SNs character-by-character as 天<WH08064>穹<WAH09002><WH07549>, paralleling UNV's 天<WH08064>空<WAH09002><WH07549>
LCC '讓它們照' rephrases UNV '普照' (Hiphil infinitive לְהָאִיר → causative 'let them shine'); all three tags <WAH09001><WH0215><WTH8687> attached to 照 as the semantic verb
'讓它們' (let them) has no direct Hebrew counterpart — left unannotated per rule 5

Gen/1.lcc_original: 來管晝夜，分別光暗：上帝看這很好。
notes: 來 left unannotated — Chinese purposive particle with no independent Hebrew equivalent; lamed prefix (09001) attached to 管 as part of the verb unit
UNV 明 (bright) → LCC 光 (light): different Chinese words, same Hebrew referent H0216 (אוֹר)
UNV 神 → LCC 上帝: systematic terminological difference for H0430 (אֱלֹהִים)
UNV implicit {<WAH03588>} (כִּי/that) → LCC has explicit 這 (this/that), so braces dropped per Rule 3
很 left unannotated — Chinese degree adverb with no Hebrew counterpart; H2896 (טוֹב) attached to 好 only

Gen/1.lcc_original: 有晚上有早晨，是第四日。

Gen/1.lcc_original: 上帝說：『水要滋生無數的活物，要有飛鳥飛在地上，天穹之中。』
notes: 活物 receives three SNs (H5315 nephesh + H2416 chayyah + H8318 sherets) — LCC combines what UNV splits across 有生命的物 into a single compound
無數的 left unannotated — LCC's own rendering of the abundance/swarming concept; no separate Hebrew word maps to it
天穹 treated as compound receiving H8064 (shamayim) + H7549 (raqia), parallel to UNV's 天空
飛鳥 is a compound noun (bird, H5775); the following 飛 is the verb (fly, H5774+WTH8787)

Gen/1.lcc_original: 上帝就創造大魚、和滋生在水中各樣能行動的活物，各從其類；又創造各樣有翅膀的鳥兒，各從其類：上帝看這很好。
notes: WAH0834 (אֲשֶׁר, relative particle) attached to 在: LCC restructures UNV's relative clause 水中所 into locative 在水中; 在 is the closest functional equivalent for the relativizer
Rule 3 applied: UNV implicit {<WAH03588>} (כִּי = that) is rendered as explicit 這 in LCC — braces dropped, tag attached directly as 這<WAH03588>
LCC 很好 vs UNV 是好的: 很 (intensifier) has no Hebrew root; H2896 (טוֹב = good) attached after 很好 as the trailing phrase tag
LCC 有翅膀的鳥兒 expands UNV 飛鳥: H3671 (כָּנָף = wing) → attached after 有翅膀; H5775 (עוֹף = bird) → attached after 鳥兒
Second 又創造 carries no SN: Hebrew has only one verb בָּרָא; the repeated Chinese verb is a translation addition with no Hebrew counterpart

Gen/1.lcc_original: 上帝就給它們祝福說：『要繁殖增多，充滿海中的水；飛鳥也要增多在地上。』

就賜福給(UNV)→就給祝福(LCC): LCC reorders the verbal construction; H1288+TH8762 attach to 祝福 which carries the bless semantics
{<WAH0853>}(accusative marker H853) kept implicit after 它們: 它們 translates the pronoun 'them' (=UNV 這一切) but H853 itself is a grammatical direct-object particle with no explicit LCC word
滋生(UNV)→繁殖(LCC) for H6509 (פָּרָה, be fruitful); 繁多/多生(UNV)→增多(LCC) for H7235 (רָבָה, multiply) — both are synonym substitutions with clear one-to-one correspondence
雀鳥(UNV)→飛鳥(LCC) for H5775 (עוֹף, flying creature/bird): different Chinese synonyms, same referent

Gen/1.lcc_original: 有晚上有早晨，是第五日。
notes: LCC omits the comma after 晚上 (UNV: 有…晚上，有…早晨) — punctuation preserved as-is per rules; word-level alignment is direct and unambiguous throughout.
是 carries no SN tag in UNV and is left unannotated in LCC (Chinese copula with no independent Hebrew lexeme).

Gen/1.lcc_original: 上帝說：『地要生出各種活物：牲口、昆蟲、和地上各種走獸：』就這樣成了。
notes: claude CLI error:

Gen/1.lcc_original: 於是上帝造了地上各種走獸，各種牲口，和地上各種各樣的昆蟲：上帝看這很好。
notes: LCC restructures the first beast clause from UNV's 野獸<WH02416><WH0776> into 地上+走獸; WH0776 (הָאָרֶץ) is assigned to LCC's first 地上 and WH02416 to 走獸.

In the third clause LCC's 各種各樣的 is a single compound phrase rendering both כָּל (WAH03605, 'all') and לְמִינֵהוּ (WAH09001+WH04327, 'according to its kind'); all three tags are attached to this phrase.

Gen/1.lcc_original: 上帝說：『我們要造人，按着我們的形像，照我們的樣式來造；讓他們管理海裏的魚、空中的飛鳥，也管理牲口、以及全地、和爬在地上的各樣爬行動物。』
notes: 神(UNV)→上帝(LCC): both explicit renderings of WH0430, SN attached normally (no braces dropped/added).

LCC restructures the image/likeness clause: UNV places 造 AFTER 形像/樣式, while LCC places it BEFORE (我們要造人) and then adds a resumptive 來造 at the clause end. WH06213+WTH8799 placed on the first (syntactically primary) 造; the resumptive 來造 left unannotated.
LCC repeats 管理 as 也管理 to introduce the second list of dominion objects (牲口/全地/爬行動物). Hebrew has one verb WH07287; SN placed on first occurrence only.
昆蟲(UNV)→爬行動物(LCC): different lexical choices for Hebrew רֶמֶשׂ (WH07431, creeping things). WH07431 attached to the full word 爬行動物.
The participial verb הרֹמֵשׂ (creeps, WH07430+WTH8802) is rendered in LCC as 爬在…地上; SN placed directly on 爬, and 地上 tagged with WAH05921+WH0776 for עַל הָאָרֶץ.
一切(UNV)→各樣(LCC): both render Hebrew כֹּל (all/every kind); WAH09002+WAH03605 transferred to 各樣.
牲畜(UNV)→牲口(LCC) and 鳥(UNV)→飛鳥(LCC): lexical substitutions, SN transferred to the LCC synonym.
以及 (connector between 牲口 and 全地) has no Hebrew equivalent and is left unannotated.

Gen/1.lcc_original: 上帝就按自己的形像創造人：按上帝的形像創造他：創造他們有男有女。
notes: UNV '他<WH0430>' in clause 2 refers to God (אֱלֹהִים) — LCC makes this explicit as '上帝<WH0430>'
UNV clause 2 ends with implicit '{<WAH0853>}' (Hebrew אֹתוֹ, 'him') — LCC makes the pronoun explicit as '他'; braces dropped per rule 3, giving '他<WAH0853>'

Clause 1 '{<WAH0853>}' kept implicit: Hebrew אֶת is the object marker before הָאָדָם with no Chinese equivalent in either UNV or LCC

Gen/1.lcc_original: 上帝就給他們祝福說：『要繁殖增多，充滿全地，去征服它；也要管理海裏的魚、空中的飛鳥、和在地上行動的各樣活物。』
notes: LCC condenses UNV's two distinct clauses (וַיְבָרֶךְ / וַיֹּאמֶר) into one: 給他們祝福說 — WAH0853 (accusative 'them') attaches to 給他們, WH01288+WTH8762 (bless) attaches to 祝福, WAH09001+WH0559+WTH8799 (said-to-them) attaches to 說

LCC 去 (directional auxiliary before 征服) and 在 (locative particle in 在地上) are Chinese grammatical particles with no Hebrew equivalent — both left unannotated
LCC uses 飛鳥 (flying birds) where UNV has 鳥 — both map to WH05775 (עוֹף); LCC uses 上帝 where UNV has 神 — both map to WH0430 (אֱלֹהִים)

Gen/1.lcc_original: 上帝說：『看哪，我將全地上結種子的各樣菜蔬、和各樣的樹、樹上有果實結種子的、都賜給你們做食物。
notes: 神(UNV)→上帝(LCC): both = H0430 (Elohim); straightforward substitution

有核(UNV)→種子(LCC): both render Hebrew זָרַע (H02233); UNV 有核 = 'has kernel', LCC 種子 = 'seed', same referent
Second 樹 in 樹上 not annotated: following UNV precedent where עֵץ in פְרִי עֵץ was also not separately tagged
都(LCC) unannotated; corresponds stylistically to UNV全 in 全賜, but <WH05414><WTH8804> placed on main verb 賜 (נָתַתִּי)
{<WAH0834>} retained as implicit in same position as UNV (between accusative marker and first כָּל), matching FHL annotation convention

Gen/1.lcc_original: 至於地上各樣走獸、空中各樣飛鳥、和爬在地上的各樣活物、裏面有生命的、我卻將菜蔬所有的青葉子給他們做食物：』就這樣成了。
notes: First two creature groups: lamed prefix {<WAH09001>} stays implicit (no explicit word in LCC); 各樣 is explicit for כָּל so braces dropped → 各樣<WAH03605>.
Third creature group: LCC reorders to 爬在地上的各樣活物 — tags follow LCC word order, so 各樣<WAH09001><WAH03605> lands after 地上 instead of before 爬.
Hebrew נֶפֶשׁ חַיָּה (WH05315 + WH02416) is split across two LCC clauses: 活物 takes WH05315 (the creature/noun), 生命 in 裏面有生命的 takes WH02416 (the living/life qualifier).
LCC 裏面 is an explicit rendering of Hebrew בּוֹ ({<WAH09002>}), so braces dropped: 裏面<WAH09002>. The relative pronoun אֲשֶׁר {<WAH0834>} remains implicit — no explicit word in LCC.

Food clause: LCC expands 青草 (green herb) into 菜蔬所有的青葉子. 菜蔬 takes WH06212 (עֵשֶׂב), 所有 takes WAH03605 (כָּל, explicit in LCC so braces dropped), 青 takes WH03418 (יֶרֶק); 葉子 is a Chinese expansion with no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated.
我卻將<WAH0853>: WAH0853 (אֵת, direct object marker) attaches to 將, parallel to UNV's 我將<WAH0853>.

Gen/1.lcc_original: 上帝看看他一切所造的都很好。有晚上有早晨，是第六日。
notes: UNV 神→LCC 上帝: systematic Elohim rendering difference (WH0430 attaches to 上帝)
UNV 看著→LCC 看看: LCC uses verb reduplication for the same Hebrew רָאָה; WH07200+WTH8799 attach to 看看
LCC adds pronoun 他 before 一切 with no Hebrew counterpart; direct object marker {WAH0853} kept implicit and placed after verb cluster
{WAH02009} (הִנֵּה, behold) has no explicit LCC equivalent; kept implicit after 的
UNV 甚→LCC 很: both render מְאֹד (exceedingly); WH03966 attaches to 很

Gen/2.lcc_original: 天地與其萬彙【1】都造齊了。
notes: 與其 ('and their') has no dedicated SN in UNV — left unannotated; these correspond to Hebrew prefixed conjunctions and the pronominal suffix on צְבָאָם
LCC 萬彙 corresponds to UNV 萬物, both translating H6635 (צָבָא 'host')
Footnote marker 【1】 preserved in its original position after the SN tag on 萬彙

Gen/2.lcc_original: 第七日上帝完畢了他所作的工，就在第七日歇了他所作的一切工而休息。
notes: LCC 上帝 vs UNV 神 — both = H430 (אֱלֹהִים); tag transfers without issue

H7673/WTH8799 (וַיִּשְׁבֹּת) placed on 歇了: UNV split the verb across 歇了…安息了<WH07673>, but in LCC 歇了 is the governing main verb; 而休息 is an appositional expansion with no independent Hebrew word and is left unannotated
Chinese relative particle 所 is the explicit reflex of אֲשֶׁר (WAH0834) in both clauses; UNV marked both as implicit {<WAH0834>} so braces are dropped and tag attaches directly to 所
UNV opens with 到 (untagged preposition) absent in LCC; the ב prefix WAH09002 attaches to 日 in both versions
Pronoun 他 (possessive suffix on מְלַאכְתּוֹ) left untagged in both clauses, following UNV convention

Gen/2.lcc_original: 上帝賜福與第七日，分別爲聖，因爲在這一日、上帝歇了他在創造中所作的一切工而休息。
notes: 神→上帝: Both render H430 (Elohim); LCC systematically uses 上帝 throughout.
定為聖→分別爲聖: Both render H6942 (qadash, Piel = to sanctify/set apart as holy); WH06942+WTH8762 attach after 聖.
{<WAH0853>} remains implicit after 分別爲聖: LCC has no repeated 日 or explicit pronoun as object of the sanctification verb, so the object marker stays braced.

Major clause restructuring in second half: UNV's 他一切<WAH04480><WAH03605>{<WAH0834>}創<WH01254><WTH8804>造<WAH09001><WH06213><WTH8800>的工<WH04399> becomes LCC's 他在創造<WH01254><WTH8804>中所<WAH0834>作<WAH09001><WH06213><WTH8800>的一切<WAH04480><WAH03605>工<WH04399>. 創造 absorbs H1254 (bara=created); 所 absorbs WAH0834 (relative אֲשֶׁר, explicit in LCC so braces dropped); 作 absorbs WAH09001 (ל prefix) + H6213 (asah=make) + WTH8800; 一切 absorbs both WAH04480 (מִן prefix) and WAH03605 (כָּל=all).
歇了 in both UNV and LCC has no SN tag (free Chinese addition); H7673 (shabath=rested) and WTH8804 attach to 而休息, paralleling UNV's 安息了<WH07673><WTH8804>.
WAH09002 (ב prefix, 'in/on this [day]') attaches to the final 日 of 在這一日, matching UNV's 在這日<WAH09002>.

Gen/2.lcc_original: 天地之被創造，其來歷是這樣：當永恆主上帝造地造天的日子，
notes: 永恆主 tagged as a single unit for <WH03068> (YHWH); LCC's explanatory expansion 永恆 has no separate SN counterpart
LCC 造地造天 follows Hebrew word order (אֶרֶץ וְשָׁמַיִם, earth then heaven), the reverse of UNV 天地; the repeated 造 before 天 is a LCC stylistic device with no Hebrew counterpart and is left unannotated
當 renders the temporal ב function of בְּיוֹם but is left unannotated; <WAH09002> kept paired with <WH03117> after 日子, following the UNV convention of attaching prefix tags to the root word
之 (classical Chinese nominalization/possessive particle before 被創造) and 其 (possessive pronoun in 其來歷) are Chinese grammatical additions without Hebrew equivalents; both unannotated

Gen/2.lcc_original: 地上還沒有草木【2】，田野的菜蔬還沒有長起來，因爲永恆主上帝還沒有降雨在地上，也沒有人耕種土地；
notes: First-clause H07704 (שָׂדֶה, UNV 野地 'of the field') has no LCC correspondent: LCC restructures the clause as 地上 ('on the earth') without a 'field' qualifier for shrubs. H07704 for the herbs clause maps normally to 田野.

{<WH0776>} was implicit in UNV (בָאָרֶץ) but LCC makes it explicit as 地上 at clause-initial position → braces dropped per rule 3. {<WAH09002>} (waw conjunction, וְכֹל) remains implicit at clause start.

First 還沒有 split as 還沒<WH02962>有<WAH01961><WTH8799> following UNV split (טֶרֶם + הָיָה); second 還沒有<WH02962> stays together (טֶרֶם only, no הָיָה); third 還沒有<WH03808> maps to לֹא (different Hebrew word).
耶和華+神 (UNV) → 永恆主<WH03068>上帝<WH0430> (standard LCC rendering for YHWH + Elohim).
耕種 (LCC, two-char) covers UNV's 耕 (single char); all three tags WAH09001+WH05647+WTH8800 attached to 耕種. 土地 (LCC) covers UNV's 地, H0127 attached to 土地.
Missing SNs: 07704

Gen/2.lcc_original: 不過有泉源【3】從地裏上來，灌溉【4】地面。
notes: H108 (אֵד): UNV renders as 霧氣 (mist/vapor), LCC renders as 泉源 (spring/fountain) — known exegetical difference for this word (stream vs. mist); both translate H108
H6440 (פָּנִים, face/surface): implicit in UNV as {<WH06440>} but LCC has explicit 面 in 地面; braces dropped per Rule 3 and attached to 面
H3605 (כֹּל, all): UNV expresses as 遍, but LCC has no explicit 'all/entire' equivalent in 地面; kept as implicit {<WAH03605>}
H853 (אֵת, direct object marker): untranslatable particle, no LCC word; kept implicit {<WAH0853>}

Gen/2.lcc_original: 永恆主上帝用地上的塵土塑造了人【5】，將生氣吹進他的鼻孔裏，那人就成了一個有生命的活人。
notes: 永恆主 (Lü's rendering of YHWH) mapped to WH03068; 上帝 (Lü's 'God') mapped to WH0430.
WH04480 (מִן 'from') maps to 用 in both UNV and LCC, following UNV's precedent for this preposition in this phrase.
LCC 塑造了 (sculpted/formed) for יָצַר — SNs attached to the whole verb + aspect particle 了 as a unit.
吹進: SNs attach after 吹 (נָפַח root); directional complement 進 is a Chinese addition with no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated.
UNV's 名叫亞當<WH0120> is a translator's gloss for the second הָאָדָם (subject of וַיְהִי). LCC uses 那人 in this role, so the second WH0120 maps to 那人.
一個 (Chinese numeral classifier 'a/one') has no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated.
他的 (pronominal 'his') is the suffix implicit in WH0639 (אַפָּיו); left unannotated.
就 (Chinese sequential particle) and 將 (Classical Chinese pre-object marker) have no Hebrew equivalents; left unannotated.
Footnote marker 【5】 preserved in its original post-人 position.

Gen/2.lcc_original: 永恆主上帝在東方栽種了一個園子在伊甸，將所塑造的人放在那裏。
notes: 永恆主 ← 耶和華<WH03068>: LCC renders יְהוָה as 永恆主 rather than 耶和華; SN attached to end of 永恆主
上帝 ← 神<WH0430>: LCC renders אֱלֹהִים as 上帝 rather than 神; straightforward substitution

Clause order differs: UNV places 在東方的伊甸 before 立了; LCC places 在東方 before the verb and 在伊甸 after 一個園子, matching the Hebrew גַּן בְּעֵדֶן מִקֶּדֶם more literally — SNs follow each phrase to their new positions
在伊甸<WAH09002><WH05731>: the 在 in LCC expresses the בְּ prefix (WAH09002); tags placed after 伊甸 per insertion-after-word convention
栽種了 ← 立了<WH05193><WTH8799>: both render נָטַע (Qal impf.); aspect particle 了 within 栽種了 left unannotated
塑造 ← 造<WH03335><WTH8804>: LCC uses 塑造 for יָצַר; tags attached after 塑造
放 ← 安置<WH07760><WTH8799>: LCC uses 放 for שִׂים
將 ← 把<WH0853>: both render the direct-object marker אֵת

Gen/2.lcc_original: 永恆主上帝使各樣的樹從土地裏長起來：看了可喜愛，做食品好喫。園子當中又有生命樹和知識樹，能使人分別善惡【6】。
notes: 永恆主 is LCC's rendering of יהוה (WH03068); 上帝 is LCC's rendering of אֱלֹהִים (WH0430) vs UNV 耶和華/神
使…長起來 is the Hiphil of צָמַח: 使 receives WH06779+WH00 (causative + null particle) and 長起來 receives WH06779+WTH8686 (verb + Hiphil morphology), mirroring UNV's split-causative tagging
LCC restructures 可以悅人的眼目 (נֶחְמָד לְמַרְאֶה) into 看了可喜愛: 看了 maps to לְמַרְאֶה (WAH09001+WH04758), 可喜愛 maps to נֶחְמָד Niphal ptcp (WH02530+WTH8737)
LCC omits 其上的果子 (no SN in UNV either); 做食品好喫 maps טוֹב לְמַאֲכָל: 做食品 = לְמַאֲכָל (WAH09001+WH03978), 好 = טוֹב (WH02896); 喫 is unannotated (LCC addition)
LCC adds the explanatory relative clause 能使人分別 for the tree of knowledge; 分別 in this clause is left untagged as LCC's expansion; 知識 receives WH01847 (דַּעַת)
WH02896 (טוֹב) correctly appears twice: 好 in the food clause and 善 in the good-evil pair

Gen/2.lcc_original: 有河從伊甸流出來、灌漑那園子，從那裏分支、成了四道。
notes: UNV 滋潤 → LCC 灌漑: both translate H08248 (שׁקה, to water/irrigate); all three tags (<WAH09001><WH08248><WTH8687>) transferred to 灌漑
LCC 分支 covers UNV 分 (H06504=פָּרַד, to divide/separate); 支 is LCC's added nuance for 'branching' — no separate SN, treated as one translation unit
UNV 為 → LCC 成了: both translate H01961 (הָיָה, to become); Chinese aspect particle 了 left unannotated per rule 5
{<WAH0853>} (implicit direct object marker) retained as braces since LCC has no explicit equivalent word

Gen/2.lcc_original: 第一道名叫比遜，就是環繞哈腓拉全地的；那裏有金子；
notes: WH0834 (אֲשֶׁר, relative pronoun) kept implicit {<WH0834>}: LCC omits the relative clause entirely and shifts directly to '那裏', as UNV also treats it as implicit.
UNV '在那裡<WAH08033>' → LCC '那裏<WAH08033>': LCC drops the preposition 在, but 那裏 still corresponds to שָׁם (WH08033 = there); tag attached to 那裏.
LCC uses ；(semicolons) where UNV uses 。and ，; LCC's original punctuation preserved exactly.
WAH0853 (direct object marker את) kept implicit {<WAH0853>}: LCC likewise has no explicit word for it.

Gen/2.lcc_original: 那地的金子很好：那裏有紅玉和水蒼玉【7】。
Gen/2.unv_sn_reference: 並且那<WH01931>地<WH0776>的金子<WH02091>是好的<WH02896>；在那裡<WAH08033>又有珍珠<WH0916>和紅瑪瑙<WH07718><WH068>。
notes: 並且 (UNV opening conjunction) is absent in LCC; it carried no SN in UNV so no loss.
LCC 很好 (predicate adjective) maps to UNV 是好的 for WH02896 (טוֹב, good) — straightforward.

Gem alignment by word order: LCC 紅玉 ← UNV 珍珠 (WH0916, בְּדֹלַח bdellium); LCC 水蒼玉 ← UNV 紅瑪瑙 (WH07718 שֹׁהַם + WH068 אֶבֶן). Both versions diverge in gem identification but the positional order is preserved, so the mapping is reliable.
Footnote marker 【7】 kept after the SN tags on 水蒼玉, preserving its original attachment to that word.

Gen/2.lcc_original: 第二道河名叫基訓，就是環繞古實全地的。
notes: LCC text is lexically identical to UNV for this verse — every token maps directly with no reordering or rephrasing.
Implicit direct-object marker {<WAH0853>} (את) retained with braces; neither UNV nor LCC has an explicit word for it.
Morphology code <WTH8802> (Qal participle) kept attached immediately after its verb 環繞<WH05437>.

Gen/2.lcc_original: 第三道河名叫希底結【8】，就是流在亞述東邊的。第四道河就是伯拉河【9】。
notes: 就是 in both clauses explicitly renders what was implicit {<WAH01931>} in UNV (Hebrew הוּא), so braces dropped and tag attached as normal
LCC 希底結 = UNV 底格里斯 (both = Hiddekel/Tigris, different transcription conventions); similarly LCC 伯拉河 = UNV 幼發拉底河 (Euphrates)
Footnote markers 【8】 and 【9】 kept in place; SN inserted before them after the river name
LCC preposition 在 has no Hebrew counterpart (implied by construct chain קִדְמַת אַשּׁוּר); left unannotated
LCC structural particle 的 at end of first clause has no Hebrew counterpart; left unannotated

Gen/2.lcc_original: 永恆主上帝將那人安置在伊甸園裏，去耕種，去看守。
notes: 耶和華→永恆主 (LCC's rendering of יהוה/YHWH)
神→上帝 (LCC consistently uses 上帝 for אֱלֹהִים; UNV uses 神)
{<WAH0853>} kept with braces — LCC has no explicit word for the direct-object marker אֶת
使他修理→去耕種: LCC rephrases the ל+infinitive construct; WAH09001 (ל prefix) attached to 去 as the infinitive marker; WH05647+WTH8800 attached to 耕種
在…園裏: LCC adds 裏 for locative; SN tags applied to 伊甸 and 園 as in UNV, 裏 left unannotated

Gen/2.lcc_original: 永恆主上帝吩咐那人說：『園中各樣樹的果子、你都可以喫：
notes: LCC renders יְהוָה as 永恆主 (Eternal Lord) rather than UNV's phonetic 耶和華; SN H03068 attached to 永恆主
LCC renders אָדָם as 那人 (that person) rather than UNV's pronoun 他; SN H0120 attached to 那人
{<WAH05921>} (implicit עַל) retained as braced implicit — LCC also has no explicit word for this preposition

Hebrew infinitive absolute אָכֹל (H0398/WTH8800) mapped to 都, which carries the emphatic/completive force in LCC's construction 都可以喫, paralleling UNV's 隨意吃; finite verb תֹּאכֵל (H0398/WTH8799) mapped to 喫

Gen/2.lcc_original: 只是那能使人分別善惡【6】的知識樹的果子，你卻不可喫；因爲你喫的日子、你一定死。』
notes: H01847 (דַּעַת/knowledge) attached to 知識 rather than 分別: LCC expands the Hebrew construct עֵץ הַדַּעַת into '知識樹' plus an explanatory relative clause '能使人分別善惡'; 知識 is the direct rendering of H01847 while 分別 is part of the added gloss and receives no SN.
善 (H02896) and 惡 (H07451) appear before 知識 in LCC's paraphrase word order; SNs placed immediately after each word at their natural positions.
Both {<WAH04480>} implicit markers (מִמֶּנּוּ = from it) retained as implicit: LCC has no explicit pronoun or particle corresponding to either instance.
UNV 必定 → LCC 一定: H04191+WTH8800 (infinitive absolute מוֹת, the 'surely' intensifier) transferred to 一定; 死 retains H04191+WTH8799 (main verb תָּמוּת).

Gen/2.lcc_original: 永恆主上帝說：『那人獨居不好；我要爲他造個幫助者做他的配偶。』
notes: 耶和華 (YHWH, H03068) → 永恆主: LCC's distinctive rendering of the Tetragrammaton; SN attaches to 永恆主 as a unit
神 (H0430, Elohim) → 上帝: LCC's standard rendering of Elohim
{<WH01961>}{<WTH8800>} kept implicit: LCC also omits the copula between 那人 and 獨居, so no explicit word to attach to

LCC inverts the Hebrew word order of עֵזֶר כְּנֶגְדּוֹ: UNV renders it as 配偶幫助他 (helper-mate first), LCC as 幫助者做他的配偶 (helper first, then counterpart phrase); split accordingly — WH05828 (עֵזֶר) to 幫助者, WAH09003+WAH05048 (כְּנֶגְדּוֹ) to 配偶
UNV's 一個 and LCC's 個 are both bare Chinese measure words with no Hebrew equivalent; neither takes an SN tag

Gen/2.lcc_original: 永恆主上帝用地上的塵土塑造了野地各樣走獸、和空中各樣飛鳥，帶到那人面前，看他給叫甚麼；那人怎樣叫各樣有生命的活物，那就是那活物的名字。
notes: LCC 永恆主 renders UNV 耶和華 (WH03068); LCC 上帝 renders UNV 神 (WH0430) — standard Lü systematic substitutions.
LCC expands UNV 土 (WH0127) to 地上的塵土 ('dust of the ground'); WH0127 attached to the full noun phrase since it is a single Hebrew lexeme (אֲדָמָה).

LCC 給 (before 叫 in first clause) is treated as an explicit rendering of the implicit {<WAH09001>} (לוֹ = 'to it/him'); braces dropped per Rule 3, giving 給<WAH09001>叫<WH07121><WTH8799>. This is the main uncertainty: 給 could alternatively be a Chinese valency/aspect particle with no direct Hebrew equivalent.
LCC 有生命的活物 expands UNV 活<WH02416>物<WH05315> (נֶפֶשׁ חַיָּה). Both SNs are attached to the phrase end per Rule 6.
Second {<WAH09001>} (לוֹ in the second relative clause) remains implicit — LCC has no explicit word for it there, unlike the first clause.
LCC 那活物的名字 renders UNV 牠的名字; WH08034 (שְׁמוֹ = 'his name') attached to 名字 as the head noun.

Gen/2.lcc_original: 那人便給各樣牲口和空中飛鳥跟野地各樣走獸起了名；只是那人【10】自己卻沒有遇見一個幫助者可以做他的配偶。
notes: LCC uses 各樣 (every kind) twice where UNV uses 一切…都; first 各樣 → UNV 一切 <WAH09001><WAH03605>, second 各樣 (before 走獸) → UNV 都 <WAH09001><WAH03605>

LCC word order for 野地各樣走獸 inverts Hebrew חַיַּת הַשָּׂדֶה ('beasts of the field') to 'field every-kind beasts'; <WH07704> placed after 野地, second <WAH09001><WAH03605> after second 各樣, <WH02416> after 走獸

UNV 配偶幫助他<WH05828><WAH09003><WAH05048> (עֵזֶר כְּנֶגְדּוֹ) maps to LCC's 幫助者<WH05828>可以做他的配偶<WAH09003><WAH05048>; LCC rephrases the noun phrase into a relative clause but the two Hebrew roots align cleanly to 幫助者 and 配偶
LCC adds 自己, 卻, 一個 with no Hebrew equivalents; left unannotated
Footnote marker 【10】 preserved in situ after 那人 in the second clause

Gen/2.lcc_sn: 永恆主<WH03068>上帝<WH0430>就使<WH05307><WTH8686>{<WAH05921>}那人<WH0120>瞇瞇沉睡<WH08639>；當那人睡覺<WH03462><WTH8799>的時候，永恆主上帝就取下了<WH03947><WTH8799>他的一<WH0259>條肋骨<WAH04480><WH06763>，又用肉<WH01320>去補而合起來<WH05462><WTH8799>{<WAH08478>}。
Gen/2.lcc_original: 永恆主上帝就使那人瞇瞇沉睡；當那人睡覺的時候，永恆主上帝就取下了他的一條肋骨，又用肉去補而合起來。
notes: LCC repeats 永恆主上帝 in the temporal clause (當那人睡覺的時候，永恆主上帝就取下了) as a stylistic expansion; the second occurrence has no Hebrew counterpart and is left unannotated.
瞇瞇 is LCC's descriptive elaboration of the deep sleep and has no Hebrew equivalent; WH08639 (תרדמה) attaches to 沉睡 only.
{<WAH05921>} (עַל, 'upon') kept implicit — LCC renders no explicit word for it, matching UNV's implicit treatment.
LCC restructures the second clause into a temporal subordinate clause (當那人睡覺的時候); WH03462/WTH8799 attach to 睡覺 in that clause.
去補 is LCC's addition describing the patching/filling action; WH05462/WTH8799 (סגר, close up) attach to 合起來 only.
{<WAH08478>} (תחתנה, 'in its place') kept implicit — no explicit LCC equivalent.

Gen/2.lcc_original: 於是永恆主上帝用那人身上取下來的肋骨建造一個女人，帶她到那人跟前。
notes: 耶和華神 (two words) → 永恆主上帝 (two words): 永恆主 carries WH03068 (YHWH), 上帝 carries WH0430 (Elohim); LCC systematically uses 上帝 where UNV uses 神
WAH0834 (relative particle אשר, on UNV 所) mapped to LCC 的, which serves the same post-verbal relativizer function in the 取下來的 construction
{<WAH0853>} retained as implicit: LCC has no explicit direct-object marker word, placed before 肋骨 to match its Hebrew position (את before the noun)
造成 → 建造 (synonym, same WH01129+WTH8799)
領她 → 帶她 (both mean 'bring/lead', same WH0935+WTH8686)
於是 left unannotated — Chinese discourse connective with no Hebrew lexical equivalent

Gen/3.lcc_original: 於是女人見那棵樹的果子做食品似乎好喫，又悅人眼目，而且可喜愛、能使人有智慧，就摘取那果子來喫了；又給她丈夫一齊喫，她丈夫也喫了。

Gen/3.lcc_original: 二人的眼睛就開朗了，纔知道自己是赤身裸體，便縫了無花果樹的葉子，爲自己作圍裙。

Hebrew לְפִצְעִי (for/of my wound, WAH09001+WH06482) rendered as UNV 傷我 and LCC 傷了我; tags placed after 我 in both

Gen/4.lcc_original: 亞當又和妻子同房，妻子就生了一個兒子，並給他起名叫塞特，意思是說：『上帝給我立了另一個後裔來代替亞伯，因爲該隱殺了他。』

LCC repeats 妻子 as explicit subject of 生了 (UNV uses pronoun 她); no SN for this second 妻子 — the subject is embedded in the Hebrew verb form, not a separate lexical item

來 before 代替 in LCC is a Chinese aspect/purpose particle with no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated

Gen/4.lcc_original: 塞特也生了一個兒子，他就給兒子起名叫以挪士【5】：【6】這人是最先【6】呼求永恆主之名的。

LCC introduces 這人是 as an explicit grammatical subject for the Hophal passive—no SN attaches here, as the Hebrew has no explicit nominal subject at this point.
之名 receives WAH09002+WH08034 (בְּשֵׁם 'in/with the name') intact; UNV's 的名 maps cleanly to LCC's 之名 (both are genitive constructions).
The 【5】【6】 footnote markers are preserved in their original positions without modification.

Gen/5.lcc_original: 以下是亞當後代的記錄。當上帝創造人【1】的日子，他是按着自己的樣式造他的：

Gen/5.lcc_original: 上帝創造他們、有男有女。當他們被創造的日子，上帝賜福與他們，給他們起名叫「人」【1】。
notes: UNV 造 → LCC 創造 for bara H01254; SNs attached to 創造 and 被創造 respectively for both occurrences
UNV has {<WH08034>} implicit (no explicit 名 in 稱他們為) but LCC has explicit 名 in 起名 — braces dropped per rule 3: 起名<WH08034>
起名叫 split between two Hebrew roots: 起名<WH08034> for shem, 叫<WH07121><WTH8799> for qara

WAH0853 appears twice: explicitly on 與他們<WAH0853> (blessing them) matching UNV 給他們<WAH0853>; implicitly {<WAH0853>} placed after 叫 (the accusative marker on שְׁמָם has no explicit Chinese equivalent in LCC's 起名叫 construction)
LCC 上帝 substitutes for UNV 神 (Elohim); neither is SN-tagged in source UNV so none added

Gen/5.lcc_original: 亞當一百三十歲的時候，生了一個兒子，生來就有自己的樣式、自己的形像；亞當給他起名叫塞特。
notes: 活到 (WH02421+WTH8799, 'lived') has no explicit lexical equivalent in LCC's age construction '一百三十歲的時候'; marked implicit with braces since the verb is structurally absent in LCC.
LCC reverses the Hebrew/UNV word order: 樣式 (WH01823, dəmût) precedes 形像 (WH06754, ṣelem) in LCC, whereas UNV has 形像 before 樣式. SNs attached to the corresponding words in LCC's order.
The second 亞當 in LCC's name-giving clause ('亞當給他起名叫塞特') is a Chinese explicit subject restatement; Hebrew implies the subject pronominally here, so left untagged.
生來就有自己的 is LCC's restructuring of the pronominal suffixes on 樣式/形像 plus UNV's explanatory '和自己相似'; left untagged as it has no direct SN correspondence.
叫 in '起名叫塞特' is a Chinese verb-complement introducing the name with no Hebrew lexeme; left untagged. WH08352 attaches to 塞特 (the proper name שֵׁת) only.

Gen/5.lcc_original: 亞當生了塞特之後，在世的日子還有八百年；這期間他還生兒養女。
notes: 生了: tags attach to 生 only; 了 is a Chinese aspect particle with no Hebrew equivalent (Rule 5)
{<WAH0853>} remains implicit — the Hebrew object marker אֶת has no explicit word in LCC just as in UNV (Rule 4)

UNV's 又在<WAH01961><WTH8799>世<WH03117> restructured in LCC as 在世的日子<WH03117>還有<WAH01961><WTH8799>: LCC fronts the subject phrase 日子 and places the copular verb 還有 after it, inverting UNV's word order; <WH03117> (יְמֵי, days) maps to LCC's 日子 rather than 世
LCC's 這期間他還 is an explanatory expansion (no Hebrew lexeme behind it) → left unannotated

Gen/5.lcc_original: 亞當活在世上的日子共有九百三十年，然後死。
notes: 在世上 ('in the world') is LCC's contextual expansion of חַי with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated
的 maps to implicit אֲשֶׁר {<WAH0834>}; LCC uses structural relative particle 的 where Hebrew uses explicit relative pronoun — braces dropped per Rule 3 since 的 is an explicit word
日子 provides explicit rendering of implicit יְמֵי {<WH03117>} — braces dropped per Rule 3
有 in 共有 provides explicit rendering of implicit וַיִּהְיוּ {<WAH01961>}{<WTH8799>} — braces dropped per Rule 3; 共 carries H03605, 有 carries H01961 with morphology
Single 年 covers two Hebrew שָׁנָה occurrences (H08141 appears twice in UNV: once after 百, once after 歲); both tags attached to the single 年 in LCC

Gen/5.lcc_original: 塞特活到一百零五歲，生了以挪士。

The direct object marker {<WAH0853>} (אֵת) remains implicit in LCC just as in UNV — neither version has an explicit Chinese word for it.

{<WAH0853>} kept implicit — LCC has no explicit direct-object particle corresponding to Hebrew את.
Double <WH08141> (שָׁנָה) preserved as in UNV: Hebrew attaches 'year' to both the hundreds and the units numeral in the source text.

Gen/5.lcc_original: 給他起名叫挪亞，說：『永恆主曾咒詛這土地，以致我們操作勞苦；這兒子必【2】將我們安頓好了【2】，來減輕我們的操作、和我們手中的勞苦。』

Gen/5.lcc_original: 拉麥生挪亞之後，又活了五百九十五年，這期間還生兒養女。

Gen/5.lcc_original: 拉麥在世的日子、共有七百七十七年，然後死。

Gen/6.lcc_original: 人類開始在地上增多起來，又生着女兒。

Gen/6.lcc_original: 神子【1】們看見人類的女子俊美，就隨意揀選娶爲妻子。

Implicit markers {<WAH03588>}{<WH02007>} (כִּי הֵנָּה) remain implicit — LCC absorbs the copular clause into the bare adjective '俊美' with no explicit pronoun or conjunction

Gen/6.lcc_original: 永恆主說：『人類旣是屬肉體的，我的靈就不永遠住在人類裏面：他在世的日子可以活到一百二十歲。』
notes: 永恆主 is LCC's rendering of YHWH (WH03068); maps cleanly to UNV's 耶和華
WAH01931 (הוּא, pronoun 'he') placed on 人類 — LCC expands the pronoun reference explicitly to 人類 (human kind), parallel to UNV's 人

Gen/6.lcc_original: 當那些日子，以及以後的日子，地上有巨人；神子【1】們進去找人類的女子們，生了兒子：那就是上古英武有名的人。
notes: LCC restructures the temporal clause: UNV splits into '那時候…後來…' (two separate time markers), while LCC merges both into one phrase '當那些日子，以及以後的日子'. WAH01992 (הָהֵם those) is placed on 那些, and WAH09002+WH03117 (בַּיָּמִים in-the-days) on 日子.

{<WH03651>} (כֵן) and {<WH0834>} (אֲשֶׁר) remain implicit; placed at the close of the temporal clause before the semicolon, matching their function as connectors between the time-setting and the main clause.

Chinese aspect particle 了 in '生了兒子' has no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated per Rule 5.

Gen/6.lcc_original: 永恆主見人類在地上壞透了，人類心思終日所計謀的、沒有別的、只是壞事；

WAH03588 (כִּי, 'that') remains implicit {<WAH03588>} because LCC, like UNV, uses direct object construction without an explicit complementizer
WAH03605 for וְכָל ('and every', modifying יֵצֶר) has no explicit LCC correlate and is marked implicit; the second WAH03605 (כָּל before הַיּוֹם) attaches to 終
心思 covers WH04284 (מַחְשְׁבֹת, thoughts) and WH03820 (לִבּוֹ, heart); 所計謀 carries WH03336 (יֵצֶר, inclination/impulse)
Second 人類 is LCC's subject-repeat for literary clarity with no Hebrew counterpart at that position — left unannotated
沒有別的 renders WH07535 (רַק, only); 只是 is LCC elaboration without a separate Hebrew word; 壞事 carries the second WH07451 (רַע, evil)

Gen/6.lcc_original: 永恆主就後悔造了人在地上，心中憂傷。
notes: 耶和華→永恆主: LCC's distinctive rendering of יהוה (WH03068), attached normally as explicit word
了 is a Chinese perfective aspect particle with no Hebrew correspondent — left unannotated between 造 and {<WAH0853>}人
Both implicit markers {<WAH03588>} (כִּי) and {<WAH0853>} (אֵת) remain implicit — LCC has no explicit words for them either

Gen/6.lcc_original: 永恆主說：『我要將我所創造的人類、都從地上擦滅：無論人類獸類或爬行動物，以及空中的飛鳥，都要擦滅，因爲我後悔造了他們。』
notes: LCC uses 人類 twice (main clause + enumeration) where UNV has a single 人 carrying all SNs for both Hebrew occurrences (הָאָדָם and מֵהָאָדָם). Split: first 人類 receives <WH0120> for the main-clause object; second 人類 receives <WAH04480><WH0120> for the enumeration head מֵהָאָדָם. The UNV implicit {<WH0120>} after 除滅 is resolved to the explicit first 人類 per Rule 3 (LCC has an explicit word).

LCC repeats 擦滅 at the close of the enumeration (都要擦滅) as a stylistic device with no Hebrew counterpart; left unannotated.

LCC's reason clause 因爲我後悔造了他們 follows Hebrew word order (נִחַמְתִּי then עֲשִׂיתִם), the inverse of UNV's 我造他們後悔了. The implicit {<WAH03588>} for the second כִּי ('that') is placed between 後悔 and 造了他們 where the subordinating conjunction would naturally sit.
LCC inserts an explicit 我 in 我所創造 (absent in UNV's 所造的); left unannotated as a Chinese syntactic addition.

Gen/6.lcc_original: 不過還有挪亞在永恆主面前蒙恩。

眼前<WAH09002><WH05869> → 面前: LCC uses 面前 (face/front) rather than 眼前 (eyes) for the Hebrew לְעֵינֵי; both SNs attach to 面前 as it covers the full prepositional phrase

Gen/6.lcc_sn: 以下這些人<WAH0428>是挪亞的後代<WH08435>。挪亞<WH05146>是<WAH01961><WTH8804>個義<WH06662>人<WH0376>：在當時的世代<WAH09002><WH01755>、他純全無疵<WH08549>：挪亞<WH05146>跟<WAH0854>上帝<WH0430>往來<WH01980><WTH8694>。

Gen/6.lcc_original: 挪亞生了三個兒子：閃、含、雅弗。

LCC 都 (adverb 'all') has no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated

Gen/6.lcc_original: 上帝看全地都敗壞了：凡有血肉的在地上所行的全都敗壞。

Gen/6.lcc_original: 上帝就對挪亞說：『凡有血肉的，我決定要結束他們的生命了，因爲全地都因了他們而滿有強暴；看吧，我要把他們、連全地、都毀滅【2】。

{<WAH02009>} implicit in UNV (הִנְנִי); LCC makes it explicit as 看吧 — braces dropped per Rule 3
מִפְּנֵיהֶם (WAH04480+WH06440 = 'from before them / because of them') maps to LCC's 因了他們而; tags placed after 而

Gen/6.lcc_original: 你要用松柏木造一隻樓船：你造那樓船、要有許多艙窩，船內外要糊上松香【3】。

Gen/6.lcc_original: 你造樓船要這樣造：樓船要長三百肘【4】，寬五十肘，高三十肘。
notes: LCC restructures the opening clause significantly: UNV nominalizes the Hebrew verb תַּעֲשֶׂה as 造法 (manner of making), while LCC uses a topic-comment structure with 造 appearing twice. The first 造 (in 你造樓船) receives <WH06213><WTH8799> as the primary verb translation; the second 造 in 要…造 is a stylistic resumptive repetition with no new Hebrew equivalent.

Gen/6.lcc_original: 你要給樓船造透光處，向上作到高一肘，也要把樓船的門設在旁邊，把船作成了一【5】二三三層。
notes: WAH09001 (ל 'for') detached from WH08392 and attached to 給 instead, because LCC renders the dative preposition explicitly as 給 before 樓船, whereas UNV fused both tags onto 方舟

UNV's implicit {<WAH0413>} (אֶל 'to/toward') is rendered explicitly as 到 in LCC's 作到; UNV's implicit {<WH03615>}{<WTH8762>} (תְּכַלֶּנָּה 'finish/complete it') is rendered explicitly as 作 — both implicit markers become explicit words in LCC, so braces are dropped

Gen/6.lcc_original: 我呢，你看罷，我要使洪流大水臨到地上，來毀滅天下凡有血肉的，就是有生氣的活物：凡在地上的都必溺死。
notes: LCC inverts the UNV opening order: UNV '看哪<WH02009>，我<WH0589>' → LCC '我<WH0589>呢，你看罷<WH02009>'. H589 attaches to the first 我 (discourse subject 我呢); 呢 is a Chinese particle with no Hebrew equivalent. H2009 attaches to 你看罷 (the hinneh exclamation).

LCC has two 凡 corresponding to Hebrew's two כֹּל. UNV provides only one WAH03605, placed on 凡地上 = כֹּל אֲשֶׁר-בָּאָרֶץ (all that is on the earth). LCC '溺死' (drown and die) paraphrases UNV '死' as the rendering of H01478 (גָּוַע, expire/perish); WH01478 + WTH8799 attach to 溺死.

Gen/6.lcc_original: 但是我要同你立約。你要進樓船；你和你兒子，妻子跟兒媳婦，都要同你進去。
notes: LCC restructures the single Hebrew clause (enter-ark + compound subject list) into two sub-clauses: 你要進樓船 and 你和你兒子…都要同你進去; all SNs distributed across both sub-clauses accordingly
WH0413 (אֶל, into/to) has no explicit counterpart in LCC's 進樓船; attached to 樓船 since the directional preposition is absorbed into the verb-noun compound
WH0859 (emphatic אַתָּה) placed on the 你 that heads the family list, not on the introductory subject 你要進樓船, matching Hebrew's appositive structure
LCC lists family in order sons→wife→daughters-in-law, matching Hebrew word order (בָנֶיךָ / אִשְׁתְּךָ / נְשֵׁי-בָנֶיךָ); UNV lists wife first—SN assignment follows LCC's own sequence
Second 進 in 都要同你進去 left unannotated; it is LCC's structural repetition of the entry verb, not a second Hebrew occurrence of H935

Gen/6.lcc_original: 凡有血肉的衆生，每樣兩個，你要帶進樓船，好和你一同保全性命：有公有母。
notes: LCC repositions 公/母 to end (有公有母) vs. UNV mid-sentence (一公一母); SNs 02145 and 05347 moved to match LCC word order accordingly.

LCC uses explicit 有 in 有公有母 where UNV kept יִהְיוּ (01961) implicit {<WAH01961>}{<WTH8799>}; per rule 3, braces dropped and 01961+8799 attached to the first 有 as explicit copula. The second 有 is a Chinese rhetorical parallel with no separate Hebrew correspondent.
LCC 和 ('with') is the explicit rendering of אֵת (0854) where UNV used 在...那裡 with the SN trailing; 0854 attached directly to 和.
Second and third occurrences of min-kol (04480+03605) remain implicit in LCC as in UNV — no explicit Chinese word bridges them.
LCC 衆生 ('all living beings') maps directly to UNV 活物 (02416); LCC 樓船 maps to UNV 方舟 (08392) — both are clearly equivalent terms.

Gen/6.lcc_original: 飛鳥各從其類，牲畜各從其類，地上一切爬行動物、各從其類，每樣兩個：都要來找你保全性命。
notes: UNV 昆蟲<WAH04480><WAH03605><WH07431> is split across LCC structure: 一切<WAH03605> receives כֹּל since LCC renders it explicitly as a separate word, while 爬行動物<WAH04480><WH07431> carries the remaining prefix + head-noun tags.

UNV 要到<WH0935><WTH8799>你那裡<WAH0413> mapped to LCC 來<WH0935><WTH8799>找你<WAH0413>; 找 has no independent SN and functions as a directional complement to 來; WAH0413 (אֶל) attaches to 找你 as the closest equivalent of 'to you'.
LCC 都 is a cohesive/universal particle with no direct Hebrew counterpart and is left unannotated.
LCC 性命 vs UNV 生命 are near-synonyms; both map cleanly to <WH02421><WTH8687> (חיה, Hiphil infinitive).

Gen/6.lcc_original: 你呢、你要拿所喫的各樣食品，積聚起來，這就要做你和牠們的食物。』
notes: LCC's emphatic 你呢、你... renders Hebrew אַתָּה; WAH0859 tags the first 你 (the emphatic subject), the second 你 is Chinese-style repetition and left unannotated
LCC 所喫的 explicitly renders the three UNV implicit tags {<WAH0834>}{<WH0398>}{<WTH8735>}; braces dropped per Rule 3 since 所 (relativizer = אֲשֶׁר) and 喫 (= יֵאָכֵל) are both explicit in LCC
LCC's connective 這 in 這就要做 has no direct Hebrew counterpart and is left unannotated
食物 (UNV) → 食品 (LCC) synonym substitution; WH03978 placed on 食品

Gen/6.lcc_original: 挪亞就這樣行；凡上帝所吩咐他的、他都照樣行了。
notes: UNV 神<WH0430> → LCC 上帝<WH0430>: different Chinese terms for the same Hebrew אֱלֹהִים, SN transfer is unambiguous.
UNV has implicit {<WAH0853>} (direct object marker את) with no explicit Chinese word; LCC has explicit 他 filling that role, so braces dropped per Rule 3: 他<WAH0853>.
UNV places SN after 吩咐的 as a unit; LCC inserts 他 before 的, so tags split accordingly: 吩咐<WH06680><WTH8765>他<WAH0853>的.

Gen/7.lcc_original: 永恆主對挪亞說：『你和你全家都要進樓船，因爲在這世代我看只有你在我面前是個義人。
notes: 永恆主 is LCC's rendering of יהוה (UNV: 耶和華); SN03068 attached to the full phrase as a single lexical unit
UNV 進入 (two words) → LCC 進 (one word): merged <WH0935><WTH8798> (verb בּוֹא) and <WAH0413> (preposition אֶל) onto 進, per rule 6
方舟 (UNV) → 樓船 (LCC): different Chinese terms for Noah's ark; SN08392 transferred to 樓船
世代中 (UNV) → 世代 (LCC): locative 中 omitted in LCC; <WAH09002><WH01755> attached to 世代
只有 is LCC's interpretive addition (emphasizes exclusivity, 'only you'); has no Hebrew equivalent and is left unannotated; object marker <WAH0853> attached to 你 following 只有
是個義人 (LCC) adds classifier 個 vs. UNV 是義人; SN06662 (צַדִּיק) attached to 義人 only, 個 left unannotated

Gen/7.lcc_original: 凡潔淨的畜類、你要七隻七隻地帶着：公的和牠的匹配；畜類不潔淨的要帶兩隻：一隻公的和牠的匹配；
notes: UNV '七公七母' (seven male, seven female) is restructured in LCC as '七隻七隻地帶着：公的和牠的匹配' (take in sevens: male and its mate). Both instances of 七 receive H7651; 公的 receives H376; 匹配 receives H802 (LCC uses 匹配 for אִשְׁתּוֹ where UNV uses 母).

{<WAH09001>} (vav conjunction on אִשְׁתּוֹ) is explicit in LCC first clause as 和 — braces dropped per Rule 3, yielding 和<WAH09001>. The 和 in the second clause receives no annotation because UNV's second clause also lacks {<WAH09001>}.

{<WAH0834>}{<WH01931>} (אֲשֶׁר/הִוא relative clause markers) remain implicit — LCC handles the relative clause with the particle 的 (畜類不潔淨的), with no explicit words corresponding to these Hebrew pronouns.
LCC inverts word order in the second clause: UNV '不潔淨的畜類' → LCC '畜類不潔淨的'. SN assignments follow LCC word order (畜類<WAH04480><WH0929>不<WAH03808>潔淨的<WH02889>).

UNV '一<WH08147>公...一母' (H8147 = pair/two, distributed as one each) → LCC '兩隻<WH08147>'. H8147 anchors to 兩隻. The 一隻 in '一隻公的' is LCC's distributive expansion with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated.

Gen/7.lcc_original: 空中的飛鳥也要七隻七隻地帶；公的和母的，使種存活於全地上；
notes: LCC restructures UNV 七公七母 (seven male / seven female) into 七隻七隻地帶…公的和母的: both H7651 tags land on the two 七隻, while H2145 (male) and H5347 (female) move to the later 公的/母的 clause.
UNV 可以留種(H2233)…活(H2421+T8763) is collapsed by LCC into 使種存活: 種 carries H2233 and 存活 carries the verbal complex WAH09001+WH02421+WTH8763.
LCC 於 replaces UNV 在 as the equivalent of H5921 (עַל); tagged accordingly.
The adverbial 地 in 七隻七隻地帶 is a Chinese grammatical particle (地₂), distinct from 地(H776) in 全地上, and is left unannotated.
H3605 (כָּל) attaches to 全 as WAH03605 following the UNV annotation pattern.

Gen/7.lcc_original: 因爲再過七天，我要下雨在地上，四十晝又四十夜，將我所造的衆生都從地上擦滅。』
notes: LCC 下雨 corresponds to UNV 降雨 (WH04305 = מָטָר, rain); same verb, different compound in Chinese.

UNV has implicit {<WH0705>} for the second '四十' (forty) before 夜, because UNV writes '四十晝夜' without repeating 四十. LCC explicitly writes '四十晝又四十夜', so Rule 3 applies: drop braces and attach <WH0705> to the explicit 四十 before 夜.
LCC 衆生 ('all living beings') covers both UNV 各種<WH03605> (כֹּל = all) and 活物<WH03351> (יְקוּם = living substance); both SNs co-attached to 衆生.
LCC 將 corresponds to UNV 把 — both serve as object-marker particles translating אֵת (WAH0853).
LCC 擦滅 corresponds to UNV 除滅 (WH04229 = מָחָה, to wipe/blot out); WTH8804 (Qal perfect) attaches to 擦滅 as in UNV.

Gen/7.lcc_original: 挪亞就都照永恆主所吩咐的去行了。
notes: UNV '就遵著' carries both prefix tags (כְּכֹל, according to all); LCC splits this into '都' (כֹּל, all → <WAH03605>) + '照' (כְּ, according to → <WAH09003>), so the two tags are distributed across separate characters in reversed order relative to UNV attachment
LCC '永恆主' is its rendering of יהוה (UNV '耶和華'); <WH03068> attached normally
LCC adds directional complement '去' before '行了' with no Hebrew counterpart — left unannotated

Gen/7.lcc_original: 當洪流大水氾濫在地上的時候，挪亞正六百歲。
notes: UNV 洪<WH03999>水<WH04325> → LCC 洪流大水: split as 洪流<WH03999> (mabbul=flood) and 大水<WH04325> (mayim=waters); LCC expands with 流 but the semantic split holds cleanly.
UNV 整六<WH08337> → LCC 正六<WH08337>: 整 and 正 are both adverbs meaning 'exactly/just'; H8337 (שֵׁשׁ=six) attaches after 六 in both.
{<WAH01961>}{<WTH8804>} remain braced implicit: LCC has no explicit verb for הָיָה here, parallel to UNV.

Gen/7.lcc_original: 挪亞就進樓船，也帶他的兒子、妻子、和兒媳婦、一同進去，要躱避洪流的水。
notes: WAH0413 (אֶל, into) absorbed onto 進 — LCC has no separate directional particle before 樓船; 進 in LCC already carries the full 'enter into' sense
WAH0854 (אִתּוֹ, with him) attached to 帶 as the primary expression of the comitative; 一同進去 is LCC's stylistic expansion clause with no direct Hebrew counterpart and receives no additional SN
洪流<WH03999>的水<WH04325> reverses UNV tag order to match LCC's genitive structure: 洪流 = flood/mabbul (H3999), 水 = waters (H4325)
兒子<WH01121>、妻子<WH0802> word order is reversed from UNV (妻 before 兒子) but SNs follow LCC's own word order

Gen/7.lcc_original: 潔淨的畜類、和不潔淨的畜類、飛鳥和爬在地上的各樣昆蟲，
notes: LCC splits UNV's single word 昆蟲 into verbal 爬 + nominal 昆蟲. The Hebrew for this clause is וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר-רֹמֵשׂ עַל-הָאֲדָמָה ('all that creep upon the ground') — there is no separate noun for 'insects'; H7430 is purely the Qal participle verb. WH07430+WTH8802 are therefore assigned to 爬 (the verbal/participial form), leaving 昆蟲 unannotated as a Chinese gloss with no direct Hebrew lexeme.

LCC restructures the final clause as 爬在地上的各樣昆蟲 (relative clause before noun) vs. UNV's 地上一切的昆蟲 (place-phrase before noun). WAH05921 maps to 在 (= עַל, upon) and WH0127 maps to 地上 (= הָאֲדָמָה, ground).

Both {<WAH0834>} occurrences remain implicit: (1) in 和{<WAH0834>}不潔淨的 the relative function is absorbed into the adjective structure; (2) in 的{<WAH0834>}各樣 the 的 particle carries the relative link but is a structural particle rather than an explicit lexical word, so braces are retained per Rule 4.

Gen/7.lcc_original: 都兩隻兩隻地來到挪亞那裏，進樓船；有公有母，照上帝【1】所吩咐挪亞的。
notes: 兩隻兩隻 (distributive reduplication) maps to שְׁנַיִם שְׁנַיִם (WH08147×2); each 兩隻 gets one tag to preserve the one-to-one distributive pairing.

Hebrew has one verb בָּאוּ (WH0935/8804) but LCC expands to two motion words 來…進. Following UNV's tagging logic where the verb attaches to the entry/motion word (UNV: 進<WH0935>), I attach WH0935+WTH8804 to 來 (the primary motion initiator) and the second WAH0413 (אֶל before תֵּבָה) to 進, mirroring UNV's 入<WAH0413> pattern.
照 covers both WAH09003 (כַּ prefix) and WH0834 (אֲשֶׁר), since LCC condenses כַּאֲשֶׁר into single character 照.
上帝【1】 is LCC's term for אֱלֹהִים (WH0430); the footnote marker 【1】 is preserved in place, SN appended after.
{<WAH0853>} retained as implicit: LCC omits the Hebrew direct object marker אֵת, so no explicit word to attach it to.

Gen/7.lcc_original: 過了那七天，洪流的水就氾濫在地上了。
notes: LCC rephrases UNV's 洪水 as 洪流的水 — H03999 (מַבּוּל, flood) attached to 洪流, H04325 (מַיִם, waters) attached to 水, reflecting the Hebrew construct chain מֵי הַמַּבּוּל.
就 (emphasis/sequential adverb) has no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated.
了 (sentence-final aspectual particle) has no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated.
Both {<WAH01961>} markers remain implicit: 過了 is a temporal idiom for וַיְהִי ('and it came to pass'), not a literal rendering of H01961; the second occurrence likewise has no explicit copula in LCC.

Gen/7.lcc_original: 當挪亞活了六百歲那一年，二月十七日這一天，大深淵的泉源都裂開了，天上的罅隙也敞開了。
notes: UNV {<WAH09001>}{<WH02416>} (implicit חַיֵּי, 'life of') is rendered explicitly in LCC as 活了; per Rule 3, braces dropped and tags attached as normal after the phrase.
LCC's 那一年 is a structural gloss: the two WH08141 instances (construct בִּשְׁנַת + absolute שָׁנָה) are already accounted for by 當 and 歲 respectively; 那一年 left unannotated.
UNV 那<WH02088> (הַזֶּה) maps to LCC 這 — both render the same demonstrative; tag transferred to 這.
LCC 深淵 covers UNV 淵 (WH08415 = תְּהֹום); 深 is LCC's own intensifier, treated as a single lexical unit.
LCC 罅隙 (WH0699) corresponds to UNV 窗戶 (אֲרֻבֹּת, 'sluices/windows'); different Chinese terms, same Hebrew referent.

Gen/7.lcc_original: 隨有傾盆大雨降在地上、四十晝又四十夜。
notes: LCC reorders clauses relative to UNV (rain+earth first, then time); SN tags placed according to LCC word order, not UNV order
{<WAH01961>}{<WTH8799>} are implicit in UNV but LCC explicitly renders with 隨有 — braces dropped per Rule 3, both tags attached to 隨有
Second {<WH0705>} is implicit in UNV but LCC explicitly writes 四十 again — braces dropped per Rule 3
LCC's 降 in 降在地上 is a Chinese verbal expansion with no independent Hebrew SN; left unannotated
又 is a Chinese connective with no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated

Gen/7.lcc_original: 就在這一天、挪亞就進了樓船；挪亞的兒子，閃、含、雅弗、和挪亞的妻子、跟他的三個兒媳婦也和他一同進去。
notes: LCC restructures into two clauses with a repeated verb: WH0935/WTH8804 tagged on first 進了 (Noah's entry); the second 進去 is LCC's structural addition for the remaining subjects (sons, wife, DIL) and is left unannotated since the Hebrew בָּא occurs only once.
{WH05146} (pronominal suffix -ו 'his' on בָּנָיו 'his sons') dropped from braces and attached to the explicit LCC 挪亞 in ；挪亞的兒子 per Rule 3 — LCC writes Noah's name where UNV uses an implicit pronoun.

WAH0854 (אִתָּם 'with them', H0854 + 3mp suffix) placed on 和他 in 也和他一同進去, where LCC explicitly expresses accompaniment; in UNV the annotator fronted it to the head of the accompanying-persons list (和他三個兒子), creating an apparent position mismatch.

Gen/7.lcc_original: 他們和一切走獸、各從其類、一切牲口、各從其類，爬在地上的一切爬行動物、各從其類，一切禽鳥、各從其類：各種羽族各樣鳥兒：
notes: UNV 百獸<WH02416> → LCC 走獸<WH02416>: different compound but same Hebrew חַיָּה (living creature/beast)
UNV 牲畜<WH0929> → LCC 牲口<WH0929>: synonymous Chinese terms for livestock (H929 בְּהֵמָה)
UNV 昆蟲<WH07431> → LCC 爬行動物<WH07431>: LCC uses more accurate rendering for רֶמֶשׂ (creeping things)
UNV 禽<WH05775>...鳥<WH06833> → LCC 禽鳥<WH05775><WH06833>: LCC merges into compound; the implicit {<WAH03605>} between UNV 禽 and 鳥 is absorbed into the leading 一切<WAH03605>
UNV {<WAH03605>}{<WH03671>} (both implicit) → LCC 各種羽族: both became explicit in LCC so braces dropped; 各種<WAH03605> and 羽族<WH03671>
LCC 各樣鳥兒 is elaborative Chinese gloss with no direct Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated
Missing SNs: 03605

Gen/7.lcc_sn: 都進<WH0935><WTH8799>到<WAH0413>挪亞<WH05146>那裏，入<WAH0413>了樓船<WH08392>。凡<WAH04480><WAH03605>有血肉<WH01320>的，就是<WH0834>裏面<WAH09002>有生氣<WH07307>的活物<WH02416>，都兩隻<WH08147>兩隻地<WH08147>進去，
Gen/7.lcc_original: 都進到挪亞那裏，入了樓船。凡有血肉的，就是裏面有生氣的活物，都兩隻兩隻地進去，
notes: LCC restructures the sentence: the action clause (都進到挪亞那裏，入了樓船) front-loads the main verb, while the descriptive subject (凡有血肉的...活物) follows with a repeated motion verb 進去. SNs are distributed across both clauses accordingly.

H935 (בּוֹא 'come/enter') attached to 進 in 進到; 進去 at the end of LCC's descriptive clause left unannotated — it is LCC's structural addition for the rearranged subject clause, not a second Hebrew verb occurrence.
H834 (אֲשֶׁר, implicit in UNV via {}) made explicit in LCC as 就是 ('that is/namely'); braces dropped, attached as 就是<WH0834>.
H09002 (בּ prefix in בּוֹ 'in it', implicit in UNV via {}) made explicit in LCC as 裏面 ('inside/within'); braces dropped, attached as 裏面<WAH09002>.
入 in 入了樓船 tagged as WAH0413 (second אֶל, 'into the ark'), matching UNV's split of 進<WH0935>入<WAH0413>方舟 — 入 functions as directional complement 'into' while 進 carries the main verb semantics.
LCC 樓船 ('multi-storey vessel') = UNV 方舟, both H8392 (תֵּבָה). LCC 生氣 = UNV 氣息, both H7307 (רוּחַ).

Gen/7.lcc_sn: 那些進去<WH0935><WTH8802>的、是凡<WAH04480><WAH03605>有血肉<WH01320>、有公<WH02145>有母<WH05347>進去<WH0935><WTH8804>的，正如<WAH09003><WAH0834>上帝<WH0430>所吩咐<WH06680><WTH8765>挪亞{<WAH0853>}的。永恆主<WH03068>就把他們關在<WH05462>船裏頭<WAH01157>。
Gen/7.lcc_original: 那些進去的、是凡有血肉、有公有母進去的，正如上帝所吩咐挪亞的。永恆主就把他們關在船裏頭。
notes: LCC restructures the opening clause: UNV leads with 凡<WAH04480><WAH03605>有血肉進入方舟的 (all flesh that entered the ark), while LCC opens with 那些進去的、是凡有血肉 (those who entered, being all flesh). SNs are distributed accordingly: <WH0935><WTH8802> goes on the first 進去 (那些進去的), and <WAH04480><WAH03605> goes on 凡 embedded in 是凡.

UNV's implicit {<WH0935>}{<WTH8804>} (implicit second occurrence of 'entered') is made explicit in LCC as the second 進去 (有公有母進去的). Per Rule 3, braces dropped and SN attached directly: 進去<WH0935><WTH8804>.
{<WAH0853>} (Hebrew direct object marker אֵת) kept in braces: LCC also has no explicit Chinese word for the accusative particle, so the implicit marker notation is preserved on 挪亞.
LCC uses 上帝 (vs UNV 神) for H0430, 永恆主 (vs UNV 耶和華) for H03068, and 船 (vs UNV 方舟) — SNs assigned to corresponding LCC terms without issue.
<WAH01157> (H01157 בַּעַד, 'within/behind') attaches to 裏頭 in LCC matching UNV's 裡頭<WAH01157> pattern; 船 is left unannotated as it is the LCC rendering of 方舟 which carried no SN in UNV.

Gen/7.lcc_original: 洪水氾濫在地上四十天。水越往上長，越把樓船漂起，使它離地上升。
notes: 越...越... parallel adverb structure (appearing twice) is LCC's stylistic addition with no Hebrew counterpart; both 越 left unannotated
方舟 (UNV) → 樓船 (LCC): different lexical choices for the ark (H08392 mapped to 樓船)
LCC restructures UNV '從地上漂起' as '漂起，使它離地上升': H05375→漂 and H07311→起 (preserving same character-to-SN correspondence as UNV); H04480+H05921→離; H0776→地上; 使它 and 升 are unannotated Chinese additions
{<WAH01961>}{<WTH8799>} retained as implicit — LCC has no explicit word for the Hebrew narrative copula וַיְהִי, just as UNV does not

Gen/7.lcc_original: 水勢浩大，在地上大大地往上長，樓船在水面上漂來漂去。
notes: 方舟 (UNV) → 樓船 (LCC): both render תֵּבָה (H08392, ark/chest); SN attaches to 樓船 without ambiguity. All other lexical choices and word order are identical between UNV and LCC.

Gen/7.lcc_original: 水勢在地上極其浩大，普天下的高山都被淹沒了。
notes: UNV has {<WAH03605>} implicit before 天下, but LCC renders it explicitly as 普 (universal/all); per Rule 3, braces dropped and tag attached directly: 普<WAH03605>
LCC adds 被 as a passive voice marker corresponding to the pual stem (WTH8792); 被 has no independent Hebrew lexeme so it is left unannotated, with the SN tags following 淹沒了 as in UNV
H8478(under)/H8064(heavens) positional tagging on 天/下 follows UNV convention, preserving FHL's Hebrew-word-order-mapped assignment even though it appears semantically inverted in Chinese

Gen/7.lcc_original: 水勢比山漲高二十二尺半，山嶺都被淹沒了。
notes: UNV clusters verb (WH01396+WTH8804) and noun (WH04325) together on 水勢; LCC grammatically separates them so WH04325 attaches to 水勢 (noun) and WH01396+WTH8804 attach to 漲高 (verb).
מִלְמַעְלָה (WAH04480+WAH09001+WH04605 = upward/above) is embedded in the 比山漲高 phrase; all three attached to 漲高 as the verb phrase captures the upward direction.
LCC converts 十五肘 (15 cubits, WH02568+WH06240+WH0520) to 二十二尺半 (22.5 chi); per rule 6 all three SNs attach to the equivalent converted phrase as a unit.

Gen/7.lcc_original: 凡有血肉、而在地上行動的，飛鳥、牲口、走獸、和在地上滋生的各樣昆蟲、以及所有的人、都溺死；
notes: LCC reverses UNV word order in opening clause: UNV '在地上有血肉的動物' → LCC '有血肉、而在地上行動的'; SNs follow LCC word order: 有血肉<WH01320> then 在<WAH05921>地上<WH0776>行動的<WH07430>.
UNV implicit {<WAH09002>} (waw conjunction before 爬) is realized explicitly as LCC 和; braces dropped → 和<WAH09002>.
UNV implicit {<WAH03605>} (כֹּל before שֶׁרֶץ) is realized explicitly as LCC 各樣; braces dropped → 各樣<WAH03605>.
LCC 滋生 (H8317, 'swarm/teem') = UNV 爬 — same Hebrew root, different Chinese rendering; morphology <WTH8802> attached to 滋生.
LCC 牲口 = UNV 牲畜 (both H929 בְּהֵמָה); LCC 溺死 renders H1478 גָּוַע with drowning-specific nuance not present in UNV 死了 — SN still attaches directly.

Gen/7.lcc_original: 凡在旱地上、鼻孔有氣息的生靈都死了；
notes: LCC is lexically identical to UNV for this verse; the only difference is terminal punctuation (。→；), so all SN tags transfer in the same positions with full confidence.
{<WAH0834>} remains implicit — LCC has no explicit word for אֲשֶׁר between 凡 and 在, matching UNV's bracketed treatment.

Gen/7.lcc_original: 水把地上的衆生、從人類到獸類、到爬行動物、以及空中的飛鳥、都擦滅了；他們都從地上被擦滅。只有挪亞和那些同他在樓船裏的、得存活，
notes: LCC adds 水 (water) as the explicit subject for the active Qal verb וַיִּמַח; no Hebrew SN exists for 水 in this verse so it is left unannotated.

LCC splits the verse's 'wiping out' concept into two clauses: active '都擦滅了' (unannotated—corresponds to the Qal form, which has no separate SN in UNV) and passive '被擦滅' (annotated WH04229+WTH8735, corresponding to the Niphal וַיִּמָּחוּ whose morphology H8735 = Niphal matches the passive voice).

{<WAH0853>} implicit braces dropped because LCC has explicit 把 as object marker (= Hebrew אֵת); similarly {<WAH05704>} braces dropped for explicit 到 in the creeping-things clause and 以及 in the birds clause.
衆生 absorbs both WAH03605 (כֹּל = all) and WH03351 (יְקוּם = living things) since LCC collapses UNV's 各類的活物 into one word.
LCC's 得存活 at the end corresponds to UNV's 留下 (WH07604 שָׁאַר + WTH8735 Niphal = remained/survived); the survival is implied in UNV's sentence structure but made explicit in LCC.

Gen/7.lcc_original: 水勢浩大在地上，共有一百五十天。
notes: LCC inserts 有 after 共 (共有 = 'altogether there were') — existential verb with no Hebrew equivalent in H3967 context; left unannotated
共 likewise has no direct Hebrew counterpart; unannotated
All seven SN/morphology tokens map cleanly to identical lexical items in LCC

Gen/8.lcc_original: 上帝記起挪亞來，也記起那些同挪亞在樓船裏的一切走獸、一切牲口；上帝叫風吹過地上，水就漸漸消退。
notes: LCC restructures the single Hebrew verb זָכַר (WH02142) into a parallel construction 記起…也記起 for literary effect; only the first 記起 is tagged since Hebrew has one verb with multiple objects; 也記起 left unannotated.
LCC 那些 is a demonstrative pronoun added for fluency with no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated.
UNV 挪亞<WAH0854> represents the Hebrew pronoun אִתּוֹ (with him); LCC expresses this as 同挪亞, with WAH0854 attached to 挪亞 following UNV convention of tagging the content noun.
Hebrew בַּתֵּבָה is split in LCC into two words: 在 takes WAH09002 (inseparable preposition בְּ) and 樓船 takes WH08392 (noun תֵּבָה), since LCC makes the preposition explicit.
UNV has {<WH05921>} implicit for Hebrew עַל (over/upon); LCC makes it explicit as 上 in 地上, so tag is applied directly per Rule 3: 地<WH0776>上<WH05921>.
UNV {<WAH03605>} before 牲畜 is implicit; LCC has explicit 一切 before 牲口, so braces dropped per Rule 3.
First {<WAH0853>} (before 挪亞) and second {<WAH0853>} (וְאֵת conjunction+object-marker before cattle group) both remain implicit—LCC has no explicit content word for either.
WH00 on 叫 preserved as-is from UNV (FHL causative-construction marker for the Hiphil; meaning opaque but duplication of WH05674 across 叫 and 吹過 is the FHL convention for Chinese causative split).
LCC 來 (after 挪亞) and 就 (before 消退) are Chinese aspect/conjunctive particles with no Hebrew equivalents; left unannotated.
Missing SNs: 0853

Gen/8.lcc_sn: 深淵<WH08415>的泉源<WH04599>和天上的<WH08064>罅隙<WH0699>都閉塞了<WH05534><WTH8735>，傾盆大雨<WH01653>也從<WAH04480>天上<WH08064>止住了<WH03607><WTH8735>。
Gen/8.lcc_original: 深淵的泉源和天上的罅隙都閉塞了，傾盆大雨也從天上止住了。
notes: UNV 淵<WH08415>源<WH04599> splits across two characters; LCC 深淵的泉源 distributes them as 深淵<WH08415> (H8415 = תְּהוֹם, deep/abyss) and 泉源<WH04599> (H4599 = מַעְיָן, spring)
UNV 窗戶<WH0699> → LCC 罅隙<WH0699> — different Chinese terms for the same Hebrew H0699 (אֲרֻבָּה, lattice/window)
LCC second clause inverts word order: UNV 天上的大雨 → LCC 傾盆大雨...從天上; WAH04480 (מִן, from) attaches to 從 as the semantic preposition, WH08064 attaches to 天上 as the noun
LCC 傾盆 (pouring/torrential) is an elaborative addition with no direct Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated

Gen/8.lcc_original: 水從地上不斷地退去；過了一百五十天，水就消減。
notes: Hebrew inf-abs idiom הלוך ושוב (halak+shuv = 'going and returning', expressing continuous action) is rendered in UNV as 漸 with both inf-abs tags <WH01980><WTH8800><WH07725><WTH8800>; in LCC this idiom becomes the adverb 不斷地 ('unceasingly'), so both inf-abs tags attach there, while the main verb tag <WH07725><WTH8799> attaches to 退去.
UNV 漸消 → LCC 消減 (both gloss H02637 חָסֵר 'to decrease/abate'); tag attaches to 消減, leaving 就 unannotated as a Chinese connective particle.
LCC uses semicolon ；between the two clauses where UNV uses 。— LCC punctuation preserved exactly.

Gen/8.lcc_original: 七月十七日、樓船停在亞拉臘【1】山間。
notes: LCC uses 樓船 (lit. 'tower-boat') where UNV uses 方舟 for the ark; H8392 assigned to 樓船
LCC uses 山間 ('among the mountains') where UNV uses 山上 ('atop the mountain'); H2022 attaches to 山, the locative particle 間 is LCC's own phrasing and left unannotated
{<WAH09001>}{<WH02320>} (the closing 'of the month' phrase, לַחֹ֖דֶשׁ) kept implicit since LCC does not repeat 月
Footnote marker 【1】 preserved in its original position between 亞拉臘<WH0780> and 山<WH02022>間

Gen/8.lcc_original: 水又不斷地消減、直到十月；十月初一日、山頂都現出來了。
notes: H2320+H6224 were implicit {braces} in UNV (first 'tenth month' unmarked in UNV's collapsing of עַד הַחֹדֶשׁ הָעֲשִׂירִי), but LCC explicitly writes 十月 for that first occurrence — Rule 3 applied: braces dropped and SNs attached directly to 十月.
H1961 (הָיוּ = were) remains implicit after 又 — LCC also has no explicit copula, same as UNV.

H1980 (הָלוֹךְ = going/walking, expressing the progressive-continuous aspect of the verbal hendiadys הָלוֹךְ וְחָסוֹר) mapped to LCC 不斷地 (continually/without stopping), while H2637 (חָסוֹר = diminish) maps to 消減.

Gen/8.lcc_original: 過了四十天，挪亞打開他所造的樓船的窗戶；
notes: LCC uses 打開 for פָּתַח (H6605) instead of UNV's 開了; H6605+WTH8799 attached after 打開
LCC uses 樓船 for תֵּבָה (H8392) instead of UNV's 方舟; H8392 attached to 樓船

UNV implicit {<WAH0834>}{<WH06213>}{<WTH8804>} are explicit in LCC as 他所造的: H0834 (אֲשֶׁר relative pronoun) attached to 他 as the relative clause introducer; H6213+WTH8804 (עָשָׂה 'made') attached to 造
H01961 (וַיְהִי) remains implicit — LCC begins with 過了 (covering מִקֵּץ) without rendering the existential/temporal frame verb
H0853 (אֵת direct object marker) remains implicit — no explicit Chinese word corresponds to it
The 的 after 所造 is a Chinese relativizing particle with no Hebrew correspondent; left unannotated

Gen/8.lcc_original: 放了一隻烏鴉出去。烏鴉出去，飛來飛去，直到水在地上都乾了。
notes: 放了...出去: SN <WH07971><WTH8762> attaches to 放了 (the main sending verb); the directional complement 出去 has no separate Hebrew equivalent (it is absorbed into שָׁלַח).
Second clause 烏鴉出去: LCC uses 出去 where UNV uses 飛來 for the main וַיֵּצֵא (H03318, Qal impf); both express the raven's departure.

Hebrew idiom יָצוֹא וָשׁוֹב (going out and returning) → LCC 飛來飛去: 飛來 carries the cognate inf abs <WH03318><WTH8800>; 飛去 carries the שׁוּב <WH07725><WTH8800>. Since LCC has an explicit 飛去 for the implicit {<WH07725>}, braces dropped per Rule 3.
Word order inversion: UNV 地上的水 → LCC 水在地上; tags redistributed so 水<WH04325> precedes 在地<WH0776>上<WAH04480><WAH05921>.

Gen/8.lcc_original: 他又放了一隻鴿子出去，要看看水從地上退了沒有。
notes: LCC '放了…出去' rephrases UNV '放出…去' — both render שָׁלַח (WH07971); WH07971/WTH8762 attached after 放了 as the main verb; directional complement 出去 carries no SN
{<WAH04480>}{<WAH0854>} kept implicit after 出去 — LCC has no explicit words for מֵאִתּוֹ (from with him), matching UNV's implicit treatment
All other alignments (鴿子, 看看, 水, 從, 地, 上, 退了) are 1-to-1 with UNV and structurally identical in LCC

Gen/8.lcc_original: 但那鴿子卻找不着腳掌停息的地方，就回到樓船挪亞那裏，因爲遍地上還都是水；於是挪亞伸手拿鴿子，接進樓船。
notes: LCC reorders clauses: UNV opens with the 'water' clause (但…都是水), while LCC moves it to the middle as a causal subordinate (因爲…都是水). <WAH03588> (כִּי 'because/for') is therefore transferred to 因爲, not to LCC's initial 但, which functions as a Chinese discourse connector with no direct Hebrew equivalent.
腳掌 covers all three SNs for לְכַף רֶגֶל: the inseparable ל prefix <WAH09001>, כַּף 'sole' <WH03709>, and רֶגֶל 'foot' <WH07272>. LCC 停息的地方 covers מָנוֹחַ 'resting place' <WH04494>.
LCC uses 拿 for לָקַח 'take' (<WH03947><WTH8799>) and 接進 for הֵבִיא hiphil 'bring in' (<WH0935><WTH8686>), paralleling UNV's 接/進 split.
Both implicit {<WAH0413>} markers (אֵלָיו 'to him') are retained as implicit; LCC's 接進樓船 also lacks an explicit pronoun referent.
LCC 還 ('still/also') is a Chinese adverbial filler with no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated.

Gen/8.lcc_original: 他又等了七天，再把鴿子從樓船放出去。
notes: LCC 樓船 (boat/ship) replaces UNV 方舟 (ark) but both translate H08392 (תֵּבָה); SN attached to 樓船 without issue. All other tokens are lexically identical to UNV, so alignment is unambiguous.

Gen/8.lcc_original: 到了晚上時候，那鴿子飛進挪亞那裏；嘴裏竟叼着新擰下的橄欖葉呢！挪亞這纔知道水從地上都退完了。
notes: First 挪亞 in '飛進挪亞那裏' left untagged — it corresponds to UNV's implicit referent '他'; only <WAH0413> (אֵלָיו) attaches to 那裏
{<WAH02009>} (הִנֵּה/behold) kept implicit: LCC expresses the exclamatory force via '竟...呢！' rather than a single directly mappable word
{<WAH03588>} (כִּי/that) kept implicit: LCC uses a direct object clause construction with no explicit connective
從地上 receives all three SNs (<WAH04480> מִן, <WAH05921> עַל, <WH0776> אֶרֶץ) as a unified prepositional phrase representing מֵעַל הָאָרֶץ

Gen/8.lcc_original: 挪亞又等了七天，又把鴿子放出去，鴿子就永不再回來了。
notes: Rule 3 applied to {<WH05750>}: UNV's implicit עוֹד (anymore) is explicitly rendered as 永 in LCC, so braces dropped → 永<WH05750>
LCC's second 又 (又把鴿子放出去) is a waw-consecutive stylistic connector with no dedicated SN in the UNV tagging scheme; left unannotated
{<WAH0853>} kept implicit: LCC's 把 is a Chinese BA-construction particle, not a semantic translation of the Hebrew direct-object marker אֵת
挪亞 unannotated: LCC names Noah explicitly where UNV uses pronoun 他; subject pronoun carries no SN in UNV

Gen/8.lcc_original: 當挪亞六百零一歲的時候，正月初一日，水在地上都乾了；挪亞撤去樓船的蓋兒一觀看，阿，地面都乾了。
notes: 當 absorbs WAH01961+WTH8799 (וַיְהִי); LCC uses 當…的時候 temporal frame vs UNV's 到
Water clause word order reversed: LCC has 水在地上 vs UNV 地上的水; WAH04480+WAH05921 (מֵעַל) attached to 在, WH0776 (אֶרֶץ) to 地
LCC 阿 maps to UNV 便見 for וְהִנֵּה (WAH02009)
LCC 地面 split: 地→WH0127 (הָאֲדָמָה), 面→WH06440 (פְּנֵי), vs UNV's 地…面上
{WAH0853} kept implicit — אֶת has no Chinese equivalent in either version

Gen/8.lcc_original: 二月十七日，地就都乾了。
notes: Textual variant: UNV reads 二十七日 (27th day) with WH06242 (עֶשְׂרִים, twenty) + WH07651 (שֶׁבַע, seven); LCC reads 十七日 (17th day), following a different manuscript tradition (likely Samaritan Pentateuch). WH06242 has no LCC equivalent and is omitted; WAH09002+WH07651 are attached to 十七 for the 七 component.
Implicit {<WAH09001>}{<WH02320>} (לַחֹדֶשׁ, 'of the month' — second Hebrew occurrence) retained in braces: LCC likewise has no explicit word for this second 月.
UNV 到了 carries no SN and is absent in LCC; no adjustment needed.
Missing SNs: 06242

Gen/8.lcc_original: 那時上帝告訴挪亞說：
notes: 那時 has no Hebrew equivalent — it is a LCC contextual addition; left unannotated per Rule 5
LCC 上帝 = UNV 神 for H0430 (systematic UNV/LCC lexical difference)
H413 (אֶל, preposition 'to') has no standalone word in LCC; attached to 挪亞 since it governs that noun in Hebrew (אֶל-נֹחַ)
לֵאמֹר (H0559+WTH8800+WAH09001) was fully implicit in UNV ({braces}), but LCC has explicit 說 → dropped braces and attached all three tags to 說 per Rule 3

Gen/8.lcc_original: 『你要出樓船，你和你妻子，兒子、和兒媳婦都要同你出來。
notes: LCC restructures into two clauses: '你要出樓船' (summary imperative) + full subject list with '都要同你出來'; Hebrew/UNV is a single clause. This required splitting placement decisions.

<WH03318><WTH8798> attached to 要出 in the first clause as direct correspondence to the Hebrew imperative צֵא; the second 出來 in the final clause is LCC's stylistic expansion for the restated subject list and is left untagged.
{<WAH04480>} (implicit מִן 'from') placed between 要出 and 樓船 — LCC has no explicit preposition (出樓船 implies 'go out from the ark'), matching UNV's same implicit usage pattern.
<WAH0854> (H854 אִתָּךְ 'with you') attached to 同你 in the second clause, where LCC makes the Hebrew prepositional phrase explicit.

兒媳婦 carries both <WH01121> (sons/בָּנִים) and <WH0802> (wives/נָשִׁים) since LCC merges the two Hebrew components of 'sons' wives' into a single compound noun, paralleling UNV's split 兒⟨H1121⟩婦⟨H802⟩.

First 你 tagged with <WAH0859> (H859 אַתָּה); the 你 before 妻子 is a possessive (your wife) with no separate Hebrew token. The first 你 is preferred since LCC moved the subject to clause-initial position.

Gen/8.lcc_original: 和你在一起凡有血肉的各樣活物，飛鳥、獸類、和爬在地上的各樣爬行動物，你都要帶出來，牠們好在地上滋生，在地上生殖而繁多。』
notes: H834 {<WAH0834>} kept implicit after 一起 — LCC has no explicit relative pronoun corresponding to UNV 那裡
UNV tags H7235(רָבָה multiply) on 大大 and H6509(פָּרָה fruitful) on 興旺 — reversed from Hebrew canonical order (פרה then רבה); LCC 生殖→H6509 and 繁多→H7235 re-aligns with canonical Hebrew order
{<WAH0854>} after 帶出來 kept implicit — LCC has no explicit 'with them' in that clause

H3605 appears three times: (1) explicit in 凡<WAH04480><WAH03605>, (2) upgraded from implicit {<WAH03605>} to explicit 各樣<WAH03605>活物, (3) from UNV 一切<WAH03605> mapped to 各樣<WAH03605>爬行動物 — LCC's two 各樣 each cover a distinct כֹּל
LCC 獸類 maps to UNV 牲畜 (H929 בְּהֵמָה); LCC 爬行動物 maps to UNV 昆蟲 (H7431 רֶמֶשׂ, creeping things)
{<WAH05921>}{<WH0776>} upgraded from implicit to explicit — LCC has a second overt 在地上 for the final clause (在地上生殖而繁多)

Gen/8.lcc_sn: 於是挪亞<WH05146>就出來，他兒子<WH01121>、妻子<WH0802>、和兒媳婦<WH01121><WH0802>、都同他<WAH0854>出來<WH03318><WTH8799>：
Gen/8.lcc_original: 於是挪亞就出來，他兒子、妻子、和兒媳婦、都同他出來：
notes: LCC restructures the clause into two predicates: 挪亞就出來 (Noah came out) + 都同他出來 (all came out with him). Hebrew has a single verb וַיֵּצֵא (H3318); the SN is attached to the final 出來 since it governs the full subject list (都). The first 出來 is a stylistic forward mention with no separate Hebrew counterpart.

兒媳婦 is a single compound in LCC rendering Hebrew נְשֵׁי בָנָיו ('wives of his sons'); both H1121 (sons/בָּנִים) and H0802 (wives/נָשִׁים) are attached to it, following the same dual-SN pattern as UNV 兒＜H1121＞婦＜H0802＞.
<WAH0854> (אִתּוֹ, 'with him') maps to LCC 同他 rather than UNV 和他; the prefix marker WAH is retained since אִתּוֹ is a prepositional suffix, not a standalone word.

Gen/8.lcc_original: 各樣走獸、各樣動物、各樣飛禽、和地上各樣昆蟲、各從其族類，都出了樓船。
notes: LCC reorders the four animal categories vs. UNV/Hebrew: UNV has 走獸→昆蟲→飛鳥→(地上)動物; LCC has 走獸→動物→飛禽→(地上)昆蟲. SNs assigned to semantically matching LCC words regardless of position.
In Hebrew/UNV, 地上 (H05921+H0776) modifies the participle רוֹמֵשׂ H07430 (LCC 動物). In LCC, 地上 is structurally paired with 昆蟲 instead. SNs for 地上 placed where they appear in LCC text, before 各樣昆蟲.
UNV's {<WAH03605>} before 飛鳥 and 昆蟲 were implicit; LCC has explicit 各樣 in all four positions — braces dropped per rule 3, tagged as WAH03605.
各樣 before 動物 maps to UNV's explicit 所有的<WH03605> (standalone כֹּל, not prefixed), tagged as WH03605 not WAH03605.
{<WAH04480>} kept implicit before 樓船 — LCC has no explicit word for Hebrew מִן ('from').

Gen/8.lcc_original: 挪亞給永恆主築了一座祭壇，取了各樣潔淨的牲畜、各樣潔淨的飛禽、獻在壇上做燔祭。
notes: LCC renders יהוה as 永恆主 (Eternal Lord) instead of 耶和華; the לְ prefix <WAH09001> is distributed to 給 (the preposition) while <WH03068> attaches to 永恆主.

UNV uses implicit markers {<WAH04480>}{<WAH03605>}{<WAH02889>} before 飛鳥 (Hebrew repeats 'all clean' for birds but UNV omits explicit text); LCC explicitly writes 各樣潔淨的飛禽, so braces are dropped per Rule 3.
LCC 飛禽 (fowl/flying birds) maps directly to UNV 飛鳥 <WH05775>.

Gen/8.lcc_original: 永恆主聞了那怡神的香氣，就心裏說：『我必不再因人的緣故而咒詛土地，雖然人從年幼時心裏所計劃的就是壞事；我也不再照我所剛行的來擊滅衆生了。
notes: 永恆主 (Eternal Lord) translates יְהוָה (WH03068); single tag applied to the compound name as one unit.
{<WAH03588>} (כִּי, implicit in UNV) is rendered as explicit 雖然 (although/concessive) in LCC — braces dropped per Rule 3.
UNV 惡<WH07451>念<WH03336> (evil/inclination in that order) is reversed in LCC: 計劃 (H3336, inclination/imagination) precedes 壞事 (H7451, evil); tags follow LCC word order.
衆生 collapses UNV 各種的<WAH03605> + 活物<WH02416> into one compound word; both tags attached to 衆生 at the end.
LCC connective 而 (before 咒詛) left unannotated — Chinese grammatical particle with no Hebrew equivalent.

Gen/9.lcc_sn: 這<WAH0428>三<WH07969>個人是挪亞<WH05146>的兒子<WH01121>；全<WAH03605>地<WH0776>的人口是從<WAH04480>這三人<WAH0428>散布<WH05310><WTH8804>出來的。

<WAH0428> (H428, אֵלֶּה) appears legitimately twice: once in each Hebrew clause, matching both LCC occurrences of the referent.

Gen/9.lcc_original: 種地人挪亞是最先栽了葡萄園的。

Word order rearrangement: UNV 就到外邊…告訴 → LCC 就告訴在外邊的; בַּחוּץ (WAH09002+WH02351) relocated from verb-phrase to nominal modifier of 兄弟, but both SNs preserved

Gen/9.lcc_original: 於是閃和雅弗拿件方塊外披，搭在自己的肩膀上，倒退着走，去把他們父親的下體蓋上；他們的臉向外，沒有看見他們父親的下體。

Gen/9.lcc_original: 挪亞醒了酒，知道他小兒子向他所作的事，

Gen/9.lcc_original: 就說：『迦南該受咒詛；他必給他的弟兄做奴僕的奴僕。』

Gen/9.lcc_original: 又說：『願永恆主給閃的帳棚祝福【1】；願迦南做閃的奴僕。

Gen/9.lcc_original: 願上帝使雅弗擴展【2】；使雅弗在閃的帳棚裏居住；願迦南做他的奴僕。』
