notes: The toledot formula is restructured: UNV '他拉的後代記在下面' (SNs: 08646→08435→0428) becomes LCC '以下這些人是他拉的後代'. <WAH0428> (אֵלֶּה, 'these') is placed after '以下這些人' as the closest lexical equivalent; '是' is a LCC copula addition with no Hebrew referent and is left unannotated.
All {<WAH0853>} accusative markers (את, 'et) remain implicit braced form — the Hebrew direct-object particle has no Chinese lexical equivalent in LCC any more than in UNV.
第一句中 <WAH0428> 的 WAH 前綴包含 ו (and/and-these)；LCC 省略了連詞，但 '以下這些人' 仍是最貼切的對應詞。

Gen/11.lcc_original: 哈蘭死在他親族之地、迦勒底的吾珥，比他父親先死【1】。
notes: LCC omits 他拉 (Terah, WH08646) from the closing clause — rendered as implicit {<WH08646>} since LCC has no explicit word for it (the 【1】 footnote may supply the name).
LCC rephrases 在他父親之先 as 比他父親先死, adding a second 死 for grammatical completeness. The second 死 has no Hebrew equivalent (Hebrew has only one verb) and is left unannotated.
LCC uses 親族 for מוֹלֶדֶת (WH04138) where UNV uses 本 — same Hebrew lexeme, different Chinese rendering; WH04138 attaches to 親族.
WAH09002+WH06440 (先) covers the Hebrew עַל-פְּנֵי idiom; 比 is an unannotated Chinese preposition LCC uses to frame the comparison.

Gen/11.lcc_original: 亞伯蘭和拿鶴各娶了妻：亞伯蘭的妻子名叫撒萊；拿鶴的妻子名叫密迦，是哈蘭的女兒；哈蘭是密迦和亦迦的父親。
notes: UNV has 亞伯蘭、拿鶴 (with Chinese enumeration comma 、) while LCC has 亞伯蘭和拿鶴 (using explicit 和 conjunction); WAH09001 prefix on 各 is retained as-is since 各 is present in LCC.
All proper names (撒萊, 密迦, 哈蘭, 亦迦) and relational nouns (妻, 名, 女兒, 父親) align one-to-one between UNV and LCC with no rephrasing.
LCC uses identical vocabulary throughout; no implicit markers needed.

Gen/11.lcc_original: 撒萊不能生育，沒有孩子。
notes: LCC 不能生育 expands UNV 不生育 by adding 能 (can/able to), but both represent H6135 (עֲקָרָה, barren); SN attaches cleanly to the full phrase
{<WAH01961>} (הָיְתָה, to be) and {<WTH8799>} (Qal imperfect morphology) remain implicit—LCC uses no explicit copula, matching UNV's implicit treatment
{<WAH09001>} (וְ prefix on וָלָד) remains implicit—LCC has no explicit conjunction before 孩子

Gen/11.lcc_original: 他拉帶着他的兒子亞伯蘭、和他的孫子、哈蘭的兒子羅得、跟他的兒媳婦亞伯蘭的妻子撒萊，領他們出了迦勒底人的吾珥，要往迦南地去；他們走到喀蘭，就住在那裏。
notes: {<WAH0854>} (אִתָּם, 'with them') is implicit in UNV; LCC rephrases as 領他們出了 ('led them out'), so WAH0854 attaches to the explicit 他們 with braces dropped per Rule 3
LCC adds 人 to form 迦勒底人 vs UNV 迦勒底; WH03778 maps naturally to 迦勒底人
LCC 喀蘭 = UNV 哈蘭 = Hebrew חָרָן (H02771); LCC consistently distinguishes the city (喀蘭) from the person Haran (哈蘭) within this same verse
LCC 領 ('led/took') is an interpretive addition with no direct Hebrew correspondent and is left unannotated; the main verb is 出了<WH03318><WTH8799>

Gen/11.lcc_original: 他拉在世的日子共有二百零五年；他拉死在喀蘭。
notes: H1961 (היה, 'were') was implicit {braces} in UNV — LCC has explicit '共有' (in total were/had), so braces dropped per Rule 3
UNV maps '共活了' to H3117 (יְמֵי, days-of); LCC's '日子' is a more literal rendering of the same Hebrew word
LCC repeats '他拉' as subject of the second clause (before 死) for clarity; this second occurrence has no corresponding tag in UNV+SN and is left unannotated
Two H8141 instances (שָׁנִים/שָׁנָה) follow UNV's split: first H8141 attaches to '二百' (for מָאתַיִם שָׁנָה), second to '年' (for חָמֵשׁ שָׁנִים)
H9002 (ב preposition prefix) split from H2771 (חָרָן) across '在'/'喀蘭' since LCC uses two distinct characters; UNV had both on '哈蘭' as a unit

Gen/12.lcc_original: 永恆主對亞伯蘭說：『你要離開你本地、你親族、你父親的家，往我所要指示你的地去。
notes: 耶和華 → 永恆主: LCC's distinctive rendering of YHWH; H03068 attached to 永恆主
本族 → 親族: both translate H04138 (מוֹלֶדֶת, kindred); SNs attached after 親族
LCC adds explicit 你 possessive before each noun phrase (你本地, 你親族, 你父親) for the Hebrew pronominal suffixes; SNs attach to the noun, not the preceding 你
父 → 父親: LCC expands to full form 父親 for H01; SN attached after 父親
First 你<WAH09001>: carries the לְ dative/directional prefix (H09001) as in UNV, aligned to the first 你 of the imperative clause

Gen/12.lcc_original: 我必使你成爲大國；我必給你祝福，使你的名尊大；成爲祝福的口頭語：
notes: LCC 給你祝福 restructures UNV 賜福給你 (verb → verb+noun phrase); WH01288+WTH8762 attached to 祝福 as the primary semantic bearer of ברך, since 給 is a function word here

LCC's final clause 成爲祝福的口頭語 substantially paraphrases UNV 你也要叫別人得福; WAH01961 mapped to 成爲 (hayah = become) and WH01293 mapped to 祝福 (berakah = blessing); 口頭語 ('byword/formula') is LCC's interpretive expansion with no UNV counterpart and is left unannotated
WH00 preserved as-is after 使, mirroring UNV's 叫<WH01431><WH00> pattern; its exact referent in the source annotation is unclear (possibly marks the Hebrew direct-object suffix -ךָ)

Gen/12.lcc_sn: 給你祝福的<WH01288><WTH8764>，我也必給他祝福<WH01288><WTH8762>；咒詛你的<WH07043><WTH8764>，我也必咒詛<WH0779><WTH8799>他：地上<WH0127>萬<WAH03605>宗族<WH04940>都必用你的名<WAH09002>而給自己祝福<WH01288><WTH8738>。』
Gen/12.lcc_original: 給你祝福的，我也必給他祝福；咒詛你的，我也必咒詛他：地上萬宗族都必用你的名而給自己祝福。』
Gen/12.unv_sn_reference: 為你祝福的<WH01288><WTH8764>，我必賜福<WH01288><WTH8762>與他；那咒詛你的<WH07043><WTH8764>，我必咒詛<WH0779><WTH8799>他。地上<WH0127>的萬<WAH03605>族<WH04940>都要因你<WAH09002>得福<WH01288><WTH8738>。」
notes: UNV 我必賜福與他 → LCC 我也必給他祝福: verb 祝福 is postposed in LCC; tags placed after final 祝福 before semicolon

Two distinct Hebrew roots for 'curse' (WH07043 qalal = light; WH0779 arar = strong) both rendered 咒詛 in LCC — distinguished only by position (first occurrence = participle WH07043, second = imperfect WH0779)
UNV 因你 (WAH09002, ב preposition on pronoun) → LCC 用你的名 (fuller prepositional phrase); tag placed after 名 as the whole phrase represents ב+כָּ
UNV 得福 (WTH8738 Niphal passive 'be blessed') → LCC 給自己祝福 (reflexive construction); WH01288+WTH8738 placed after 祝福 as the verbal anchor
UNV 的萬族 → LCC 萬宗族: 的 is absorbed; WAH03605 placed after 萬 and WH04940 after 宗族 to preserve the all/families distinction

Gen/12.lcc_original: 亞伯蘭就照永恆主所吩咐他的去了；羅得也和他一同去。亞伯蘭出喀蘭的時候，正七十五歲。
notes: LCC uses 永恆主 for Yahweh (H3068) instead of UNV's 耶和華 — same SN attached to LCC's form
UNV {<WAH0413>} is implicit; LCC explicitly has 他 ('him') for the indirect object of 吩咐, so braces dropped per rule 3: 他<WAH0413>
LCC drops 著 from UNV's 就照著 but retains the same semantic function; WAH09003+WAH0834 attach to 就照

Age expression: H1121 (ben, 'son of') has no explicit word in LCC's 七十五歲 construction, so kept implicit as {<WH01121>} before the numeral; the two H8141 (shanah) instances distributed as 七十<WH07657><WH08141> and 歲<WH08141>
LCC's 喀蘭 is an alternate transliteration of UNV's 哈蘭 (Haran, H2771) — same place name

Gen/12.lcc_original: 亞伯蘭帶着他的妻子撒萊、和他兄弟的兒子羅得、連他們在喀蘭所積蓄的一切財物，所得的奴婢，出了喀蘭，要往迦南地去。他們就來到迦南地。
notes: UNV splits the Hebrew לקח across 將<WAH0853> (DO marker, sentence-initial bā-construction) and 帶<WH03947><WTH8799> (verb, sentence-final); LCC places 帶着 immediately after 亞伯蘭 in SVO order — all three tags consolidated onto 帶着
UNV 姪兒<WH01121><WH0251> renders 'nephew' as a single word with both SNs; LCC expands to 兄弟<WH0251>的兒子<WH01121>, so WH0251 (brother) goes on 兄弟 and WH01121 (son) goes on 兒子
UNV 的{<WAH03605>}財物 treats כָּל (all) as implicit; LCC has explicit 一切, so braces dropped: 一切<WAH03605>
UNV 和{<WAH0853>} and 連{<WAH0853>} both have implicit braces; LCC 和 and 連 are explicit, so braces dropped per Rule 3
Second {<WAH0853>} (Hebrew וְאֵת before הַנֶּפֶשׁ) remains implicit in LCC — the comma between 財物 and 所得 carries no explicit conjunction word
UNV 人口<WH05315> (נֶּפֶשׁ = persons/souls acquired) → LCC renders as 奴婢 (servants/slaves); SN transferred as 奴婢<WH05315> — legitimate LCC interpretive choice for this context

LCC 出了喀蘭 adds a second explicit mention of Haran for clarity (Hebrew וַיֵּצְאוּ does not repeat it); 出了<WH03318><WTH8799> for יָצָא, but the second 喀蘭 receives no SN as it is LCC's own addition with no independent Hebrew token

Gen/12.lcc_original: 亞伯蘭經過那地，到了示劍地、神諭篤耨香樹【1】那裏。當時迦南人在那地。
notes: LCC translates מוֹרֶה (WH04176) as 神諭 (divine oracle/teacher) rather than transcribing it as 摩利; WH04176 assigned to 神諭
LCC shortens 地方 (WH04725) to just 地 for Shechem's 'place'; tag follows 地 immediately after 示劍<WH07927>
Second עַד (WAH05704) kept implicit {<WAH05704>}: LCC has no explicit 到/至 before 神諭篤耨香樹, unlike UNV's structural repetition
LCC drops 住 from 住在那地; SNs WAH09002+WH0776 still attach after 那地 following the same positional pattern as the first occurrence

Gen/12.lcc_original: 永恆主向亞伯蘭顯現，說：『我要把這地賜給你的後裔。』亞伯蘭就在那裏給向他顯現的永恆主築了一座壇。
notes: LCC uses 永恆主 systematically for YHWH where UNV has 耶和華; WH03068 and WAH09001+WH03068 are attached to 永恆主 in both occurrences accordingly.

In the second clause, LCC uses 給 where UNV uses 為 ('for the LORD who appeared to him'); 給 is left unannotated just as 為 is in UNV, since neither word has a direct Hebrew lexeme — the לְ prefix is already captured by WAH09001 on 永恆主.
WAH08033 (שָׁם, 'there') attaches to 那裏 in LCC (variant 裏 vs UNV 裡, same word).

Gen/12.lcc_original: 從那裏他又往前進，到伯特利東邊的山搭帳棚。西邊是伯特利，東邊是艾，在那裏他又給永恆主築了一座壇，呼求永恆主的名。
notes: LCC '往前進' renders UNV '遷' (Hebrew עָתַק Hiphil — to journey on/move forward); SNs attached after the full phrase
LCC renders יְהוָה as '永恆主' throughout (vs UNV '耶和華'); both occurrences tagged with <WH03068> as normal
LCC uses '給' (for/to) where UNV uses '為', both corresponding to Hebrew ל prefix <WAH09001>; tags follow '永恆主' per UNV's pattern of attaching prefix SN + main SN after the main noun
LCC '呼求' = UNV '求告' = Hebrew קָרָא (Qal, <WH07121><WTH8799>); clear lexical correspondence
LCC '搭' = UNV '支搭' for Hebrew נָטָה (to pitch/stretch, <WH05186><WTH8799>); LCC drops the aspectual '支' but the verbal SN attaches cleanly to '搭'

Gen/12.lcc_sn: 後來亞伯蘭<WH087>又一站一站地<WH05265><WTH8800><WH05265><WTH8799>向南地<WH05045>往前行<WH01980><WTH8800>。
Gen/12.lcc_original: 後來亞伯蘭又一站一站地向南地往前行。
notes: 一站一站地 compresses both the נסע infinitive absolute (5265/8800) and the נסע finite verb (5265/8799) into one adverbial phrase — both tags attach to it in canonical order
LCC reorders the Hebrew sequence: הַנֶּגְבָּה (Negev/南地) appears before the הָלוֹךְ form (往前行) rather than after; SNs placed at the semantically closest LCC words regardless of this reordering
向 is an untranslated directional particle with no own SN; the SN for נֶגֶב (05045) attaches after 南地 as the lexical head

Gen/12.lcc_original: 當時在那地鬧了饑荒，因爲饑荒在那地很嚴重，亞伯蘭就下埃及去，要寄居在那裏。
notes: '當時' is LCC's narrative opener for the waw-consecutive structure — no direct Hebrew SN equivalent; left unannotated.
Second '在那地' is explicit in LCC where UNV has implicit {<WAH09002>}{<WH0776>} — dropped braces per Rule 3 since LCC renders the phrase explicitly.
LCC reverses the word order of the final clause: UNV '在那裡暫居' → LCC '寄居在那裏'; SNs placed on each word accordingly (H1481+morphology on '寄居', H8033 on '在那裏').
'了' is a Chinese aspect particle with no Hebrew equivalent; absorbed into '鬧了' as the verb phrase bearing H1961.

Gen/12.lcc_original: 將近進埃及的時候，亞伯蘭對他妻子撒萊說：『喂，我知道你是個容貌美麗的婦人。
notes: LCC has explicit 進 for implicit {<WH0935>} (לָבוֹא); braces dropped per Rule 3, all three tokens (WAH09001, WH0935, WTH8800) attached to 進.
LCC 的時候 is an explicit rendering of כַּאֲשֶׁר ({<WAH09003>}{<WH0834>}); tagged on 時候 per Rule 3 with braces dropped.
וַיְהִי ({<WAH01961>}{<WTH8799>}) has no corresponding explicit word in LCC; kept implicit at verse start.
LCC 喂 is an explicit equivalent of הִנֵּה ({<WH02009>}); braces dropped. נָא ({<WH04994>}) has no explicit counterpart and stays implicit.
LCC adds 亞伯蘭 as the explicit subject of וַיֹּאמֶר (subject inferred in Hebrew context); left unannotated.
是 (Chinese copula) and 個 (classifier) are grammatical additions in LCC with no Hebrew counterparts; left unannotated.
WH0802 (אִשָּׁה) appears twice: first for אִשְׁתּוֹ (妻子 = his wife), second for אִשָּׁה (婦人 = woman) in the predicate clause.

Gen/12.lcc_original: 埃及人看見你一定會說：「這是他的妻子」；他們就會殺我，而讓你存活。
notes: Three implicit markers {WAH01961}{WTH8804}{WAH03588} (וְהָיָה כִּי = 'and it will come to pass that') kept implicit — LCC likewise omits them and opens directly with 埃及人.
UNV 必說 → LCC 一定會說: same modal force; WH0559+WTH8804 attached after 說.
UNV 卻叫你<WAH0853> → LCC 而讓你<WAH0853>: LCC rephrases with 而讓 instead of 卻叫; WAH0853 (אֹתָךְ object marker) attaches to 你.
UNV 就要殺 → LCC 就會殺: aspectual difference only; WH02026+WTH8804 attach after 殺.

Gen/12.lcc_sn: 你務要<WH04994>說<WH0559><WTH8798>你是<WAH0859>我的妹妹<WH0269>，使<WAH09001><WH04616>我<WAH09001>因你<WAH09002><WAH05668>而平安無事<WH03190><WTH8799>，我的性命<WH05315>也可以因你的緣故<WAH09002><WH01558>而得存活<WH02421><WTH8804>。』
Gen/12.lcc_original: 你務要說你是我的妹妹，使我因你而平安無事，我的性命也可以因你的緣故而得存活。』
notes: WH04994 (נָא, particle of entreaty) placed after 務要: LCC renders the imperative urgency with 務要 where UNV uses 求你 for the same Hebrew particle
LCC 妹妹 = UNV 妹子 = WH0269 (אָחוֹת, sister) — straightforward synonym

Two distinct Hebrew prepositions both surface as 因你 in UNV: first 因你 = בַּעֲבוּרֵךְ (WAH09002+WAH05668), second 因你的緣故 = בִּגְלָלֵךְ (WAH09002+WH01558); LCC disambiguates the second with 緣故 (sake/reason), matching גָּלַל semantically — tags placed after 緣故
LCC 平安無事 expands UNV 得平安 for WH03190 (יָטַב) + WTH8799; tags placed at end of full phrase
LCC 可以 (modal 'may') and two 而 (connective particles) have no Hebrew equivalents — left unannotated

Gen/12.lcc_original: 亞伯蘭進埃及的時候，埃及人眞地看見那婦人極其美麗。
notes: UNV 到了<WAH09003><WH0935><WTH8800> → LCC 進: LCC uses a single character 進 (enter/go into) where UNV uses 到了 (arrived); all three tags (lamed prefix + בּוֹא root + morphology) attach to 進.
{<WAH01961>}{<WTH8799>} (וַיְהִי) remains implicit at sentence start — LCC restructures the temporal clause into 進...的時候 with no explicit existential verb, so the braces are retained.
LCC 的時候 (temporal clause marker) has no Hebrew equivalent and is left unannotated — it is a structural addition to make the Chinese relative clause grammatical.
LCC 眞地 (truly/indeed) is a translator's interpretive addition with no UNV/Hebrew counterpart — left unannotated.
UNV 美貌<WH03303> → LCC 美麗: different Chinese words for יָפֶה (beautiful); WH03303 attaches to LCC's equivalent 美麗.
{<WAH03588>}{<WAH01931>} (כִּי הִיא) remain implicit — LCC omits the relative pronoun/conjunction entirely.

Gen/12.lcc_original: 法老的大臣看見了她，就在法老面前讚美她；那婦人就被帶進法老宮裏去。
notes: 臣宰 (UNV, H08269 שָׂרִים) → 大臣 (LCC): same referent, different Chinese rendering; SN attached to 大臣
誇獎 (UNV, H01984 הָלַל) → 讚美 (LCC): synonymous praise verbs; SN + morphology attached to 讚美
UNV 的宮<WH01004> → LCC 宮裏: possessive 的 dropped and locative 裏 added; H01004 (בַּיִת, palace) attaches to 宮 as the head noun, 裏 left unannotated as a Chinese locative suffix

Gen/12.lcc_original: 法老因這婦人的緣故就好待亞伯蘭；亞伯蘭得了羊羣、牛羣、公驢、僕婢、母驢、駱駝。
notes: UNV 因<WAH09002><WAH05668>這婦人 → LCC 因這婦人的緣故<WAH09002><WAH05668>: LCC expands the Hebrew preposition בַּעֲבוּר into the periphrastic 因…的緣故; SNs attached at end of the full prepositional phrase since 緣故 carries the semantic weight of עֲבוּר (05668) and 因 alone is not a full equivalent.
{<WAH01961>}{<WTH8799>} was implicit in UNV (Hebrew וַיְהִי = 'and there was to Abram' = possession); LCC renders this explicitly as 得了, so braces dropped per rule 3: 得了<WAH01961><WTH8799>.
亞伯蘭{<WAH09001>} (second occurrence): the waw conjunction ו (09001) is expressed in LCC only via the semicolon ；, which is punctuation not a word, so braces retained.
UNV 僕<WH05650> and 婢<WH08198> are separate annotated words; LCC combines them as 僕婢, so both SNs attach to the combined word per rule 6.
Livestock order differs between UNV and LCC (UNV: 牛羊駱駝公驢母驢僕婢; LCC: 羊羣牛羣公驢僕婢母驢駱駝); each SN was matched to its semantic equivalent regardless of order.

Gen/12.lcc_original: 永恆主因了亞伯蘭妻子撒萊的緣故，就以大災病擊打法老和他全家。
notes: 耶和華→永恆主: Lü's distinctive rendering of YHWH; WH03068 attached to full divine title 永恆主.
因了: 了 is a Chinese aspect particle with no Hebrew equivalent; WAH05921 attached to 因 only.
降→擊打: UNV uses 降 (bring down) while Lü uses 擊打 (strike/smite) for H05060 נָגַע; WH05060+WTH8762 both attached to 擊打.
災→災病: Lü expands H05061 נֶגַע to 災病 (plague-disease compound); WH05061 attached to the full compound 災病.
就以: Chinese structural causative/instrumental words with no direct Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated.
First WAH0853 (與 in UNV, object marker for 法老): LCC has no explicit equivalent; kept as implicit {<WAH0853>} placed before 法老.
Second WAH0853 (和 in UNV context, object marker for 全家): LCC's 和 carries the conjunction aspect of waw+את; WAH0853 attached to 和.
他的全家→他全家: Lü drops possessive particle 的 but referent is identical; WH01004 attached to 他全家.

Gen/12.lcc_original: 於是法老就召了亞伯蘭來，說：『你這向我作的是甚麼事？你爲甚麼沒有告訴我她是你的妻子呢？
notes: LCC opens with 於是 (thereupon), a Chinese connective with no direct Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated
LCC uses 作 vs UNV 做 for H6213 — same verb, different character variant, aligned without issue

Gen/13.lcc_sn: 亞伯蘭<WH087>從<WAH04480>埃及<WH04714>上<WH05927><WTH8799>南地<WH05045>去，他<WAH01931>和他妻子<WH0802>、跟他一切<WAH03605>所有的<WAH0834><WAH09001>、以及羅得<WH03876>、都和他同行<WAH05973>。

Gen/13.lcc_original: 他從南地按着路站走，直到伯特利，到了伯特利和艾的中間，他起先支搭帳棚的地方，
notes: LCC '按着路站' explicitly renders the implicit {<WAH09001>}{<WH04550>} (לְמַסָּעָיו, 'by his journeys/stages') — braces dropped, both SNs attached to 路站 since the concept is overtly expressed.

H834 (אֲשֶׁר, relative pronoun) is attached to 的, the Chinese relative-clause particle. LCC '永恆主' (Eternal Lord) is a paraphrase of יְהוָה where UNV has '耶和華'; H3068 is attached to 永恆主 as a single lexical unit.

Gen/13.lcc_original: 跟亞伯蘭同行的羅得也有羊羣牛羣和帳棚。

UNV 與 → LCC 跟 (both mean 'with/together with'); WH0854 attaches to 跟
LCC 和 (conjunction before 帳棚) is a Chinese addition with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated

Gen/13.lcc_original: 那地容不下他們住在一起；因他們的活財物很多，他們便不能住在一起。
notes: UNV implicit markers {<WH03162>}{<WAH09001>}{<WH03427>}{<WTH8800>} (together + dwell infinitive) become explicit in LCC as 住在一起; per Rule 3, braces dropped and all four tags appended after the phrase per Rule 6 (one LCC phrase covers multiple Hebrew roots)

{<WAH01961>}{<WTH8804>} (הָיָה, was/became) remains implicit — LCC 因他們的活財物很多 also has no explicit copula
LCC 因 vs UNV 因為: both render כִּי (WAH03588), shorter form in LCC only

Gen/13.lcc_original: 牧養亞伯蘭牲畜的人和牧養羅得牲畜的人就起了分爭。當時迦南人和比利洗人住在那地。
notes: LCC reverses sentence order relative to Hebrew/UNV: the strife clause appears first, then the Canaanite/Perizzite residence clause.

WAH01961 (וַיְהִי = 'there arose') split from WH07379 (רִיב = strife): WAH01961 attaches to 起了 (the verb 'arose') and WH07379 attaches to 分爭 (the noun 'contention'), whereas UNV combined both onto 相爭.

First {<WAH0996>} (בֵּין = 'between', first occurrence) kept as implicit tag inserted before 牧養亞伯蘭 since LCC has no explicit corresponding word; the 和 connecting the two groups carries the second WAH0996 (וּבֵין).
Both {<WH04735>} occurrences (מִקְנֵה = livestock) are explicit as 牲畜 in LCC — braces dropped and tag attached directly.
LCC uses the verbal phrase 牧養…的人 ('those who tend') rather than UNV's nominal 牧人 ('herdsman'); WH07462 (רֹעֵי, Qal active participle) attaches to 牧養 in each occurrence, preserving WTH8802 morphology.

Gen/13.lcc_original: 亞伯蘭就對羅得說：『你我之間、不可分爭；你牧人和我牧人之間、也不可分爭，因爲我們是族弟兄。
notes: WAH0996 (בֵּין, between) moved from 你我 in UNV to 之間 in LCC — 之間 is the explicit Chinese word for 'between', which UNV did not use; the SN naturally attaches there instead.

Double WAH0996 on 之間 in clause 2: LCC's single 之間 compresses both Hebrew occurrences of וּבֵין ('and between your shepherds and between my shepherds') — the formerly-implicit {WAH0996} before 你牧人 drops its braces since 之間 is explicit in LCC.

族弟兄 carries both WH0582 (אֲנָשִׁים, men/kinsmen) and WH0251 (אַחִים, brothers) — LCC renders the Hebrew compound 'kinsmen-brothers' as a single compound word 族弟兄 rather than UNV's 骨肉 + parenthetical note.
{<WAH04994>} (נָא, please) and {<WH01961>}{<WTH8799>} (תְהִי, let there be) kept implicit — LCC has no explicit words corresponding to them, same as UNV.

Gen/13.lcc_original: 所有的地不都在你面前麼？請離開我！你左，我就向右；你右，我就向左。』
notes: UNV 遍<WAH03605>地<WH0776> → LCC 所有的<WAH03605>地<WH0776>: '所有的' is the all/every morpheme (כֹּל H3605), '地' is the land morpheme (אֶרֶץ H776) — split preserved across the two-word LCC rendering.
UNV 眼前 → LCC 面前: both render Hebrew לִפְנֵי (lamed prefix WAH09001 + פָּנִים WH06440); tags attached after 面前.
UNV 請你離開我 → LCC 請離開我!: LCC elides the explicit subject 你; 請 receives WAH04994, 離開 receives WH06504+WTH8734, 我 receives WAH04480+WAH05921.

Both {<WAH0518>} implicit conditional markers retained as braced — LCC also omits an explicit conditional word in both clauses.

Gen/13.lcc_original: 羅得舉目，看見約但河那一片平原，沿到瑣珥的路向，各處水源充足，在永恆主還沒有毀滅所多瑪蛾摩拉以前，就像永恆主的園子，就像埃及地一樣。
notes: LCC renders יְהוָה (WH03068) as 永恆主 instead of UNV's 耶和華 — both occurrences annotated consistently.

Gen/13.lcc_original: 我要使你的後裔像地上的塵沙那麼多；若有人能數得清地上的塵沙，你的後裔也就能數得清。

LCC 永恆主 (Eternal Lord) = UNV 耶和華 = YHWH; WAH09001+WH03068 attached to 永恆主, with 給 functioning as the preposition corresponding to the lamed prefix encoded in WAH09001

Gen/14.lcc_original: 當暗拉非做示拿王，亞畧做以拉撒王，基大老瑪做以攔王，提達做戈印王的日子，

LCC 亞畧 vs UNV 亞略 and LCC 做 vs UNV 作 are orthographic/lexical variants with no effect on SN alignment.

All four king-name/kingdom/王 triplets map 1-to-1 with no ambiguity.

Gen/14.lcc_original: 他們向所多瑪王比銳，蛾摩拉王比沙，押瑪王示納，洗扁王善以別，和比拉王，就是瑣珥王──作戰。

UNV's implicit {<WH0854>} (אֵת, object/preposition marker) maps to LCC's explicit 向 (against/toward); braces dropped per rule 3: 向<WH0854>.
LCC's 比銳 is a different transliteration of UNV's 比拉 (H01298, Bera, king of Sodom); same person, different character choice — <WH01298> assigned to 比銳.
{<WAH0854>} retained as implicit after the first comma (before 蛾摩拉), as LCC uses only a comma for the conjunction and has no explicit word for it.
LCC adds 王 after 瑣珥 (就是瑣珥王) with no Hebrew equivalent in UNV tagging; left unannotated.

Gen/14.lcc_original: 這些王在西訂山谷會合；那就是鹽海。
