WH01931 (הוּא, 'that/it is'): UNV anchors to 就是; LCC uses 那就是 where 那 is the pronoun הוּא — placed on 那 as the closer lexical match.
LCC 山谷 vs UNV 谷: both render H06010 (עֵמֶק, valley); the fuller LCC form absorbs the tag without issue.
UNV 五王 ('five kings') has no SN tag and reflects contextual bridging from v.2; LCC likewise has 王 unannotated — consistent.

Gen/14.lcc_original: 他們服事了基大老瑪十二年，到十三年就背叛了。
notes: UNV 事奉 / LCC 服事 are synonymous verbs for the same Hebrew root <WH05647>; alignment is unambiguous.
<WH0853> is the direct object marker (אֵת) with no explicit LCC word; kept as {<WH0853>} per implicit-marker rule.
SN tags placed immediately after the content word (服事, 背叛) and before the trailing aspect particle 了, consistent with rule 1.
他們 carries no SN in UNV (subject encoded in the Hebrew verb conjugation); left unannotated in LCC as well.
十二/十三 number compounds (two-SN each) assigned directly to the corresponding LCC numerals with no rephrasing.

Gen/14.lcc_original: 十四年基大老瑪和同盟的王都來，在亞特律加寧擊敗了利乏音人，在哈麥擊敗了蘇西人，在沙微基列亭擊敗了以米人，
notes: {<WAH0834>}{<WAH0854>} kept as implicit: LCC's 同盟 is a semantic paraphrase of Hebrew אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ ('who were with him'), not a direct lexical match for either particle individually; neither 和 nor 同盟 corresponds cleanly to a single one of these grammatical particles
UNV 殺敗了 → LCC 擊敗了: synonymous verbs (both = 'to strike/defeat'); SN tags <WH05221><WTH8686> transferred to 擊敗了 in all three instances
{<WAH0853>} (object marker אֵת) kept implicit throughout — LCC has no explicit particle corresponding to it, just as UNV does not
LCC omits middle dots in place names (亞特律加寧, 沙微基列亭 vs UNV 亞特律‧加寧, 沙微‧基列亭); treated as same proper nouns receiving the same SNs

Gen/14.lcc_sn: 在何利人<WH02752>的西珥<WH08165>山<WAH09002><WH02042>擊敗了{<WAH0853>}何利人，一直<WAH05704>追擊到靠近<WH05921>曠野<WH04057>的<WAH0834>伊勒巴蘭<WH0364>。
Gen/14.lcc_original: 在何利人的西珥山擊敗了何利人，一直追擊到靠近曠野的伊勒巴蘭。
Gen/14.unv_sn_reference: 在何利人<WH02752>的西珥<WH08165>山<WAH09002><WH02042>殺敗了{<WAH0853>}何利人，一直<WAH05704>殺到靠近<WH05921>曠野<WH04057>的<WAH0834>伊勒‧巴蘭<WH0364>。
notes: 殺到 (UNV) → 追擊到 (LCC): LCC adds 追擊 ('pursued') where UNV has 殺 ('struck'); neither carries a SN in the source, so no annotation is inserted.
{<WAH0853>} kept implicit: H853 is the Hebrew direct-object marker (את); LCC likewise absorbs it grammatically with no explicit word.
伊勒巴蘭: LCC omits the interpunct (‧) present in UNV's 伊勒‧巴蘭; <WH0364> attaches to the full proper name as a unit.

Gen/14.lcc_original: 然後轉到安密巴，就是加低斯，擊毀了亞瑪力人的各鄉間，又擊敗了住在哈洗遜他瑪的亞摩利人。
notes: 然後 is LCC's own transitional connective with no Hebrew SN counterpart; WH07725+WTH8799 attaches to 轉 (returned/turned back).
LCC splits UNV's single verb 殺敗了 (WH05221+WTH8686) into two verbs: 擊毀了 (tagged) and 擊敗了 (untagged, LCC stylistic expansion for the second object); WH05221+WTH8686 assigned to first verb only.
LCC 各鄉間 maps to UNV 全地的人 (all the people of the land): 各=WAH03605 (כֹּל all), 鄉間=WH07704 (שָׂדֶה field/countryside).
LCC 又 maps to UNV 以及 (WAH01931=גַּם, and also).
WAH09002 (ב preposition prefix) and WH02688 (Hazezon-tamar root) both placed after 哈洗遜他瑪, following UNV's compound-token grouping convention.

Gen/14.lcc_original: 於是所多瑪王、蛾摩拉王、押瑪王、洗扁王、和比拉王、就是瑣珥王、都出來，在西訂山谷擺陣，和他們交戰；
notes: LCC restructures the parenthetical '（比拉就是瑣珥）' as '、就是瑣珥王、' integrated into the king list without brackets; <WAH01931> placed on 就是 and <WH06820> on 瑣珥 accordingly; the extra 王 after 瑣珥 is LCC's own stylistic addition (no distinct Hebrew source word) and is left unannotated.
LCC writes 山谷 (valley) where UNV writes 谷; both <WAH09002> (prefix particle) and <WH06010> (עֵמֶק, valley) are attached to 山谷 as a single unit representing the same Hebrew phrase.
UNV uses 與 (with) while LCC uses 和 as conjunction; <WAH0854> (אֵת with pronominal suffix = with-them) follows UNV positioning and is placed after 他們 rather than on 和.

Gen/14.lcc_original: 就是和以攔王基大老瑪、戈印王提達、示拿王暗拉非、以拉撒王亞畧、交戰：四個王和五個王交戰。
notes: 與→和: WAH0854 attached to 和 in both occurrences (LCC consistently uses 和 instead of 與 for the preposition 'with')
亞略→亞畧: LCC uses the variant character 畧; same name Arioch, WH0746 aligns clearly
四個/五個: LCC adds the measure word 個 after the numeral; SN attached after the full numeral phrase (四個, 五個) since the whole phrase represents the Hebrew word
UNV 乃是 (transitional phrase before 四王) carries no SN, so its omission from LCC causes no annotation loss

Gen/14.lcc_original: 西訂山谷有許多石漆坑；所多瑪王和蛾摩拉王逃跑，有掉在坑裏的，其餘的人都往山上逃跑。
notes: LCC has '山谷' (mountain valley) where UNV has bare '谷': H07708 (שִׂדִּים, Siddim) → 西訂, H06010 (עֵמֶק, valley) → 山谷, attaching each SN to its respective component.
{<WAH08033>} (שָׁם, 'there') kept implicit — LCC has no explicit locative adverb corresponding to it, just as UNV does not.
LCC semicolon (；) after first clause preserved exactly as written; UNV period (。) not substituted.

Gen/14.lcc_sn: 四個王就把<WAH0853>所多瑪<WH05467>和蛾摩拉<WH06017>所有的<WAH03605>財物<WH07399>跟<WAH0853>一切<WAH03605>糧食<WH0400>都拿<WH03947><WTH8799>了走<WH03212><WTH8799>，
Gen/14.lcc_original: 四個王就把所多瑪和蛾摩拉所有的財物跟一切糧食都拿了走，
Gen/14.unv_sn_reference: 四王就把<WAH0853>所多瑪<WH05467>和蛾摩拉<WH06017>所有的<WAH03605>財物<WH07399>，並<WAH0853>一切的<WAH03605>糧食<WH0400>都擄掠<WH03947><WTH8799>去<WH03212><WTH8799>了；
notes: 擄掠(H03947)+去(H03212) → 拿(H03947)+走(H03212): LCC uses the serial verb 拿…走 where UNV uses 擄掠…去; semantic correspondence is sound (לָקַח = take, הָלַךְ = go/depart). The aspect particle 了 between them has no Hebrew equivalent and is left unannotated per Rule 5.
Second <WAH0853> (את direct-object marker) placed after the conjunction 跟 and before 一切, mirroring the UNV positional pattern (並<WAH0853>一切的).
LCC omits the structural particle 的 after 一切 compared to UNV 一切的; the <WAH03605> tag attaches to 一切 directly.
LCC 四個王 adds measure word 個 vs UNV 四王; no SN tags assigned to these words as none appear in the UNV source for this phrase.

Gen/14.lcc_sn: 也把<WAH0853>亞伯蘭<WH087>弟兄<WH0251>的兒子<WH01121>羅得和<WAH0853>羅得<WH03876>的財物<WH07399>都拿<WH03947><WTH8799>了走<WH03212><WTH8799>。當時羅得<WAH01931>正住<WH03427><WTH8802>在所多瑪<WAH09002><WH05467>。
Gen/14.lcc_original: 也把亞伯蘭弟兄的兒子羅得和羅得的財物都拿了走。當時羅得正住在所多瑪。
notes: LCC 弟兄的兒子 is a literal rendering of the Hebrew (אֲחִי + בֶּן), while UNV uses the idiomatic 姪兒 (nephew); H251 → 弟兄, H1121 → 兒子.
The second <WAH0853> (second Hebrew אֵת accusative marker) is placed after 和, since LCC has only one 把 covering both objects; this preserves the marker before the second direct object phrase.
LCC 拿了走 replaces UNV 擄掠去了: 拿<WH03947> = H3947 (לָקַח, take), 走<WH03212> = H3212 (יָלַךְ, go); 了 is a Chinese aspect particle with no Hebrew equivalent.
LCC 都 (all/entirely) has no Hebrew correspondent and is left unannotated.

Gen/14.lcc_sn: 有一個逃<WH06412>出來<WH0935><WTH8799>的人告訴<WH05046><WTH8686>希伯來人<WH05680>亞伯蘭<WAH09001><WH087>。亞伯蘭<WAH01931>正在亞摩利人<WH0567>幔利<WH04471>的聖篤耨香樹<WAH09002><WH0436>【1】那裏居住<WH07931><WTH8802>。幔利是以實各<WH0812>的族弟兄<WH0251>，也是亞乃<WH06063>的族弟兄；這些人<WAH01992>都是和亞伯蘭<WH087>結約<WH01285>的盟友<WH01167>。
Gen/14.lcc_original: 有一個逃出來的人告訴希伯來人亞伯蘭。亞伯蘭正在亞摩利人幔利的聖篤耨香樹【1】那裏居住。幔利是以實各的族弟兄，也是亞乃的族弟兄；這些人都是和亞伯蘭結約的盟友。
Gen/14.unv_sn_reference: 有一個逃<WH06412>出來<WH0935><WTH8799>的人告訴<WH05046><WTH8686>希伯來人<WH05680>亞伯蘭<WAH09001><WH087>；亞伯蘭<WAH01931>正住<WH07931><WTH8802>在亞摩利人<WH0567>幔利<WH04471>的橡樹<WAH09002><WH0436>那裡。幔利和以實各<WH0812>並亞乃<WH06063>都是弟兄<WH0251>，曾與<WAH01992>亞伯蘭<WH087>聯盟<WH01167><WH01285>。
notes: LCC renders UNV 橡樹 as 聖篤耨香樹【1】 (different tree identification with footnote marker); SNs WAH09002+WH0436 inserted immediately after the word and before 【1】 to preserve the footnote reference in place
UNV summarises brotherhood as 弟兄<WH0251> once; LCC expands to two occurrences of 族弟兄 (once per sibling pair). WH0251 tagged only on the first occurrence (Eshcol relationship) since UNV uses it once
Hebrew הֵם (WAH01992 = 'and they') surfaces as 曾與 in UNV but is rendered explicitly as 這些人 in LCC; WAH01992 tagged on 這些人
LCC 結約的盟友 expands UNV 聯盟<WH01167><WH01285>: 結約 receives WH01285 (בְּרִית, covenant) and 盟友 receives WH01167 (בַּעַל, lord/partner)
LCC places verb 居住 at end of clause rather than mid-clause (UNV 正住); WH07931+WTH8802 attached to 居住 in LCC accordingly

Gen/14.lcc_original: 亞伯蘭聽見他的姪兒被擄了去，就抽出他家裏生養的精練壯丁三百一十八人，直追到但。
notes: UNV 率領 → LCC 抽出 for <WH07324> (וַיָּרֶק, lit. 'to draw/pour out'); LCC's 抽出 is actually closer to the Hebrew meaning than UNV's 率領 (lead/command)
UNV editorial note 【原文是弟兄<WH0251>】 is a translator's note; LCC directly uses 姪兒 without comment, so <WH0251> attaches to 姪兒 as a normal (non-braced) tag since LCC has an explicit word
{<WAH03588>} (כִּי, 'that') retained as implicit — LCC also omits an explicit conjunction here
{<WAH0853>} (direct object marker אֵת) retained as implicit — no Chinese equivalent in LCC
LCC aspect particle 了 (before 去) left unannotated; LCC adds 的 (他的姪兒) also left unannotated — both are Chinese grammatical additions with no Hebrew counterpart

Gen/14.lcc_original: 他和他的奴僕趁夜分隊，攻擊敵人，擊敗了他們，又追到大馬色北邊的何把；
notes: LCC expands the Hebrew 分隊 + עֲלֵיהֶם (he divided against them) into two clauses: 分隊 (WH02505+WTH8735) and 攻擊敵人 (where WAH05921=עֲלֵיהֶם attaches to 敵人, mirroring UNV's pattern of anchoring WAH05921 to the noun object rather than the Chinese verb).

The single Hebrew verb וַיַּכֵּם (he smote them, WH05221+WTH8686) is rendered in LCC as 擊敗了他們; tags attach to 擊敗 as the closest verbal match. 攻擊 before it is an LCC expansion with no direct Hebrew word and is left unannotated.
LCC renders Damascus as 大馬色 vs UNV 大馬士革; both receive WH01834.
了 (perfective aspect particle after 擊敗) and 他的 (possessive before 奴僕) are left unannotated as Chinese grammatical additions with no direct Hebrew counterparts.

Gen/14.lcc_sn: 將<WAH0853>一切<WAH03605>財物<WH07399>奪回來<WH07725><WTH8686>，也<WAH01571>將<WAH0853>他的姪兒<WH0251>羅得<WH03876>、和羅得的財物<WH07399>、以及<WAH01571><WAH0853>婦女<WH0802>{<WAH0853>}人口<WH05971>、都奪回來。
Gen/14.lcc_original: 將一切財物奪回來，也將他的姪兒羅得、和羅得的財物、以及婦女人口、都奪回來。
Gen/14.unv_sn_reference: 將<WAH0853>被擄掠的一切<WAH03605>財物<WH07399>奪回來<WH07725><WTH8686>，連<WAH01571>{<WAH0853>}他姪兒<WH0251>羅得<WH03876>和他的財物<WH07399>，以及<WAH01571><WAH0853>婦女<WH0802>、{<WAH0853>}人民<WH05971>也都奪回來。
notes: UNV 連<WAH01571>{<WAH0853>} → LCC has explicit 也將, so distributed as 也<WAH01571>將<WAH0853>: 也 carries גַּם and 將 carries the now-explicit accusative את (dropping braces per rule 3).
UNV {<WAH0853>}人民<WH05971>: LCC combines 婦女人口 without separator, so the implicit accusative between them is retained as {<WAH0853>}人口<WH05971>.
LCC uses 人口 (population) where UNV has 人民 — semantically equivalent, mapped to <WH05971> (עָם).
LCC omits UNV's 被擄掠的 (the captured/taken-captive participial modifier); no SNs were attached to that phrase so no impact.
LCC says 羅得的財物 where UNV says 他的財物 — a clarifying paraphrase; still mapped to <WH07399>.

Gen/14.lcc_original: 亞伯蘭擊敗了基大老瑪和跟他同盟的王回來的時候，所多瑪王出來，在沙微山谷，就是王之山谷，迎接亞伯蘭。
notes: WH0310 (אַחַר 'after') kept implicit — LCC expresses the temporal clause via 的時候 with no explicit 'after' word.
SNs for 擊敗 placed before aspect particle 了, which has no Hebrew equivalent and is left unannotated.
Second WAH0853 (direct object marker for the allied kings) was unwrapped in UNV but treated as implicit {<WAH0853>} in LCC since Chinese has no direct object marker particle.
LCC restructures the parenthetical gloss to precede 迎接亞伯蘭 (vs. UNV's end-of-verse placement); SNs distributed to match LCC word order.
LCC writes 山谷 where UNV has 谷; both mapped to WH06010 (עֵמֶק = valley) — 山 is a LCC stylistic addition with no Hebrew equivalent.
迎接他 (UNV) → 迎接亞伯蘭 (LCC explicit referent); WAH09001/WH07125/WTH8800 attached after 亞伯蘭 as the phrase end.

Gen/14.lcc_original: 又有撒冷王麥基洗德、帶着餅和酒也出來：他是至高者上帝的祭司。
notes: LCC uses 至高者 vs UNV's 至高 — both map to H5945 (עֶלְיוֹן, Most High); tag attaches after 至高者
LCC uses 上帝 vs UNV's 神 — both map to H410 (אֵל); WAH09001+WH0410 attach after 上帝的 following the same possessive-particle pattern as UNV's 神的
LCC inserts 也 before 出來 as a stylistic particle — no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated
UNV's 迎接 (to meet) had no SN in UNV either; LCC omits it entirely — no SN loss
WTH8689 (Hiphil morphology) kept paired with WH03318 on 帶着, matching UNV pattern

Gen/14.lcc_original: 他給亞伯蘭祝福說：『願天地的製作主，至高者上帝，賜福與亞伯蘭！
notes: UNV 祝福 and 說 are annotated separately; LCC writes 祝福說 as a run-on phrase, so tags are attached after each respective character to preserve individual alignment.
UNV 主<WH07069><WTH8802> (Heb. qānāh = possessor/maker, Qal ptcp) is rendered by LCC as 製作主; tag attaches after 製作主 as the whole compound is the translation of that one Hebrew participial form.
UNV 至高<WH05945>的　神<WAH09001><WH0410> maps cleanly to LCC 至高者<WH05945> 上帝<WAH09001><WH0410>; 至高者 absorbs the adjective and the nominalizing 者, while 上帝 is LCC's standard rendering of אֵל (WH0410).

Gen/14.lcc_sn: 至高者<WH05945>上帝<WH0410>{<WAH0834>}把你的敵人<WH06862>交<WH04042><WTH8765>在你手裏<WAH09002><WH03027>，他是應當受祝頌<WH01288><WTH8803>的！』亞伯蘭就把他一切所有的<WAH04480><WAH03605>、拿出十分之一<WH04643>來，給<WH05414><WTH8799>麥基洗德<WAH09001>。
Gen/14.lcc_original: 至高者上帝把你的敵人交在你手裏，他是應當受祝頌的！』亞伯蘭就把他一切所有的、拿出十分之一來，給麥基洗德。
Gen/14.unv_sn_reference: 至高<WH05945>的　神<WH0410>{<WAH0834>}把敵人<WH06862>交<WH04042><WTH8765>在你手裡<WAH09002><WH03027>，是應當稱頌<WH01288><WTH8803>的！」亞伯蘭就把所得的<WAH04480><WAH03605>拿出十分之一<WH04643>來，給<WH05414><WTH8799>麥基洗德<WAH09001>。
notes: WH05945 (עֶלְיוֹן, Most High) attaches to 至高者 — the 者 suffix in LCC is a title nominalizer, not the relative pronoun, so WAH0834 remains implicit: LCC restructures the relative clause 'who delivered' into a new clause beginning with 他, leaving no explicit Chinese word for אֲשֶׁר.
UNV 所得的 (WAH04480 מִן + WAH03605 כֹּל) maps to LCC 一切所有的 — both express 'all that he had'; tags attach after 一切所有的.
UNV 稱頌 → LCC 受祝頌 for WH01288 (בָּרַךְ); morphology WTH8803 (Qal passive participle) follows immediately after.
LCC adds 你的 (before 敵人) and 他 (before 是應當) as natural Chinese pronominal expansions — left unannotated as they have no Hebrew equivalents.

Gen/14.lcc_original: 所多瑪王對亞伯蘭說：『你把人口給我；財物你拿走。』
notes: UNV '你自己<WAH09001>' becomes LCC '你<WAH09001>' — LCC omits the emphatic 自己, so the WAH09001 prefix marker attaches directly to 你
UNV '拿去吧' becomes LCC '拿走' — the directional complement 走 is LCC's own addition with no Hebrew equivalent and is left unannotated; <WH03947><WTH8798> attach to 拿 only
Punctuation differences (「」vs『』, ，vs；, ！vs。) preserved as-is from LCC original
Missing SNs: 07399

Gen/14.lcc_original: 亞伯蘭對所多瑪王說：『我已經向天地的製作主，至高者上帝永恆主舉手起誓；
notes: LCC expands H7069 (qanah = creator/possessor) as 製作主 vs UNV's 主; tags follow 製作主 as the full rendering of that root.
LCC uses 上帝 for H410 (El) where UNV uses 神; straightforward substitution.
LCC renders H3068 (Yahweh) as 永恆主 ('Eternal Lord') rather than 耶和華; tag follows 永恆主.

Hebrew oath idiom 'lift up the hand' (H7311+H3027) is compressed to 起誓 in UNV but made explicit in LCC as 舉手起誓; H7311 (rûm, lift) + WTH8689 + H3027 (yad, hand) all attach to 舉手, while 起誓 is left unannotated as LCC's explicating expansion.

Gen/14.lcc_original: 凡是你的東西就是一根線、一條鞋帶，我也不拿，免得你說：「我使亞伯蘭發財」。
notes: LCC 發財 renders UNV 富足 (<WH06238>+<WTH8689> = הֶעֱשַׁרְתִּי, Hiphil perfect); semantically equivalent.
{<WAH05704>} kept implicit — LCC omits an explicit word for Hebrew וְעַד ('even to/until'); the 、 is punctuation only.
LCC 也 (corresponding to UNV 都) left unannotated — both are Chinese emphasis particles with no direct Hebrew correspondent; negation anchors to 不<WH0518>.
LCC classifier 根→條 for 鞋帶 is a natural Chinese variation; 鞋<WH05275>帶<WH08288> alignment unchanged.
使 tagged <WAH0853> following UNV's convention of mapping the Hebrew direct object marker אֶת onto the causative 使.

Gen/14.lcc_original: 別給我甚麼！只有僮僕們所喫了的，以及和我同行的人、亞乃、以實各、幔利、所應得的分兒、讓他們拿走就是了。』
notes: LCC renders the implicit {<WH01107>} (H1107 בִּלְעָדַי = 'nothing for me/apart from me') explicitly as 別給我甚麼！— braces dropped, SN attached before exclamation mark.
LCC renders the implicit {<WAH07535>} (H7535 רַק = 'only') explicitly as 只有 — braces dropped.
LCC renders the implicit {<WH0582>} (H582 אֱנוֹשׁ = 'men') explicitly as 人 — braces dropped, SN attached after 人.
LCC uses 喫 (traditional character for eating) vs UNV 吃; aspect particle 了 left unannotated per rule 5.
LCC compounds 拿走 ('take away') where UNV has 拿去; <WH03947><WTH8804> attach after 拿 with 走 left unannotated.
Final {<WH02506>} kept implicit: LCC's 就是了 has no explicit word corresponding to the second occurrence of חֶלְקָם (their portion).
LCC connectives 以及 and 讓 carry no Hebrew equivalents and are left unannotated.

Gen/15.lcc_original: 這些事以後、永恆主的話在異象中傳與亞伯蘭，說：『亞伯蘭，你不要怕！我是你的盾牌；你的報賞極大呀。』
notes: 永恆主 (Eternal Lord) assigned WH03068 as LCC's rendering of 耶和華/YHWH (יְהוָה).
UNV's 有<WH01961><WTH8804> (הָיָה, 'came to be') maps to LCC's 傳 ('was transmitted'); the preposition 對<WAH0413> (אֶל, 'to') maps to LCC's 與.

LCC restructures the closing clause from verbal (UNV: 必大大地賞賜你 = 'will greatly reward you') to nominal (LCC: 你的報賞極大呀 = 'your reward is exceedingly great'). SNs redistributed: 你的報賞<WH07939> = שְׂכָרְךָ; 極<WH03966> = מְאֹד; 大<WH07235><WTH8687> = הַרְבֵּה (Hiph. inf.abs. of רָבָה); 呀 is a Chinese exclamatory particle with no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated.
LCC 這些 ('these things') corresponds to UNV 這<WAH0428>; 這些 receives WAH0428 (אֵלֶּה) and the following 事 separately receives WH01697 (דָּבָר), matching the Hebrew הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה.

Gen/15.lcc_original: 亞伯蘭說：『主阿，我，我快要去世了還沒有兒子，你還賜給我甚麼呢？那麼承受我家業的、就將要是大馬色以利以謝了！』
notes: LCC '主阿' condenses UNV '主耶和華啊' (H136+H3069); both SNs attached to 主 since LCC omits the explicit Yahweh name.

LCC's emphatic '我，我快要去世了' renders Hebrew אֲנֹכִי הֹלֵךְ עֲרִירִי; H0595 goes on the first 我 (subject pronoun), H1980+WTH8802 on 去世 (the participial verb of going/departing), H6185 on 沒有兒子 (the adjectival 'childless' sense).
Double annotation of H1121+H4943 preserved on both 承受 and 業 following UNV's pattern for the Hebrew construct chain בֶּן-מֶשֶׁק (ben-mesheq).
LCC '大馬色' is a shorter transliteration of Damascus vs. UNV '大馬士革人' (which adds 人/person); H1834 attaches directly to 大馬色 with no 人 needed.
LCC '了' (aspect particle) at verse end has no Hebrew equivalent and is left unannotated.

Gen/15.lcc_original: 亞伯蘭說：『你看，你沒有給我後裔；看吧，我家中的男兒就要做我的後嗣了。』
notes: UNV 又說→LCC 說: 又 has no separate SN; H0559+WTH8799 attaches to 說 alone
{<WAH02005>} (הֵן) and {<WAH02009>} (הִנֵּה) are implicit in UNV but explicit in LCC as 你看 and 看吧 respectively — braces dropped per Rule 3
UNV 兒子→LCC 後裔: both render H02233 זֶרַע (seed/offspring); lexical difference only
UNV 就是我的<WAH0853>→LCC 我的<WAH0853>: object marker אֹתִי (H0853) attaches to the pronoun 我的 which directly represents it; 後嗣<WH03423><WTH8802> follows
LCC aspect particle 了 left unannotated (no Hebrew equivalent)

Gen/15.lcc_original: 永恆主的話又傳與亞伯蘭說：『這個人必不會做你的後嗣；由你親腹出的，纔要做你的後嗣。』
notes: הִנֵּה (WAH02009) has no explicit LCC counterpart; kept as implicit {<WAH02009>} at sentence start.
LCC renders יְהוָה (WH03068) as 永恆主 vs UNV 耶和華; attached accordingly.
LCC's 又傳 is a translation-level addition (implicit 'came') with no corresponding SN in the UNV annotation; left unannotated.

WAH0413 (אֵל 'to/unto') placed immediately after 與 (the preposition), not after the whole phrase 與亞伯蘭, to be precise about which word carries the SN; LCC makes 亞伯蘭 explicit where UNV uses the pronoun 他.
אֲשֶׁר (WAH0834, relative pronoun) attached to 的 (the clause-closing relative marker in LCC's pre-nominal relative construction), since LCC has no 所-equivalent.
הוּא (WAH01931) attached to 做 following UNV's pattern of attaching the resumptive pronoun to the copulative verb (UNV: 成為<WAH01931>); WH03423+WTH8799 then attach to 後嗣 for the verbal root יָרַשׁ.

Gen/15.lcc_original: 就領他出去到外邊，說：『你望着天，數數衆星，看能數得過來不能。』又對他說：『你的後裔就要這樣。』
notes: LCC '看' treated as explicit rendering of {<WAH0518>} (H518 אִם = if/whether), dropping braces; '看能…不能' expresses the same conditional/interrogative function as Hebrew אִם, so rule 3 applies and braces are dropped

LCC '數數' (reduplicated verb) treated as single unit corresponding to UNV '數算<WH05608><WTH8798>'; the second occurrence of '數' in '數得過來' separately maps to the infinitive construct with WAH09001 prefix + H05608<WTH8800>
LCC '望着天' reverses UNV word order '向天觀看': 望着 = H05027 (Hiphil imperative, look/gaze) and 天 = H08064 (heaven/sky)
{<WAH04994>} (H4994 נָא, entreaty particle) kept implicit — LCC has no explicit particle at this position
{<WAH0853>} at end of question kept implicit — LCC '不能' replaces UNV '嗎' as the question/negation marker but H853 (direct-object marker אֵת) has no explicit LCC rendering

Gen/15.lcc_sn: 亞伯蘭信<WH0539><WTH8689>永恆主<WAH09002><WH03068>，永恆主就給他<WAH09001>算爲<WH02803><WTH8799>義<WH06666>了。
Gen/15.lcc_original: 亞伯蘭信永恆主，永恆主就給他算爲義了。
Gen/15.unv_sn_reference: 亞伯蘭信<WH0539><WTH8689>耶和華<WAH09002><WH03068>，耶和華就以此為<WH02803><WTH8799>他的<WAH09001>義<WH06666>。
notes: 耶和華 → 永恆主: LCC's consistent rendering of the Tetragrammaton YHWH
就以此為 → 就給他算爲: H2803 (חָשַׁב, reckon/count) maps to 算爲; the preposition 給 has no direct Hebrew equivalent and is left unannotated

他的 (UNV possessive) → 他 (LCC indirect object): <WAH09001> marks the 3ms pronominal suffix on צְדָקָה; LCC restructures possessive 'his righteousness' into an indirect object construction, so <WAH09001> attaches to 他
了 is a Chinese perfective aspect particle with no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated

Gen/15.lcc_sn: 永恆主又對亞伯蘭<WAH0413>說<WH0559><WTH8799>：『我是<WAH0589>永恆主<WH03068>，{<WAH0834>}曾領你<WH03318><WTH8689>出了迦勒底<WH03778>的吾珥<WAH04480><WH0218>，爲的是要將<WAH0853>這地<WH0776>賜給<WAH09001><WH05414><WTH8800>你<WAH09001>，使你取得它<WAH09001><WH03423><WTH8800>爲基業。』
Gen/15.lcc_original: 永恆主又對亞伯蘭說：『我是永恆主，曾領你出了迦勒底的吾珥，爲的是要將這地賜給你，使你取得它爲基業。』
notes: 耶和華 → 永恆主 (LCC's rendering of YHWH); <WH03068> transferred to second occurrence 永恆主 as the predicate nominal, matching UNV structure
他 → 亞伯蘭 (LCC makes the pronoun explicit as a proper name); <WAH0413> attaches after 亞伯蘭, the same prepositional el (אֵל) relationship
{<WAH0834>} retained as implicit marker; LCC has no explicit relative pronoun before 曾領你, so braces kept

LCC restructures the possession clause: UNV 賜...你為業 → LCC 賜給你，使你取得它爲基業; <WAH09001><WH05414><WTH8800> attached to 賜給 (compound verb = give), <WAH09001><WH03423><WTH8800> attached to 取得它 (obtain-it, capturing both the Hebrew verb יָרַשׁ and its pronominal suffix -הּ represented by 它)
LCC 爲的是 elaborates the purpose clause but adds no new Hebrew roots; <WAH0853> (direct object marker אֵת) placed after 將, consistent with UNV positioning immediately before the object 這地

Gen/15.lcc_original: 亞伯蘭說：『主阿，我憑甚麼能知道我要取得這地爲基業呢？』
notes: LCC omits 耶和華 entirely; both WH0136 (主/Adonai) and WH03069 (耶和華/YHWH) are attached to the single 主, since LCC collapses the divine address to one word.
LCC 憑甚麼 corresponds to UNV 怎能 for Hebrew בַּמָּה (by what) = WAH09002 (ב‐prefix) + WH04100 (מה); tags placed after 能 which closes the idiomatic phrase.

WAH03588 (כִּי = 'that', the complementizer introducing the possession clause) has no explicit lexical match in LCC. UNV renders it as 必 (certainty modal); LCC uses 要 as the closest functional equivalent introducing the dependent clause, so WAH03588 is attached to 要.
LCC 取得 covers UNV 得 (WH03423 + WTH8799); the added 取 is an LCC enrichment with no separate Hebrew root.

Gen/15.lcc_sn: 永恆主說<WH0559><WTH8799>{<WAH0413>}：『你給我<WAH09001>取<WH03947><WTH8798>一隻三年未生犢的<WH08027><WTH8794>母牛<WH05697>，一隻三年的<WH08027><WTH8794>母山羊<WH05795>，一隻三年的<WH08027><WTH8794>公綿羊<WH0352>，一隻斑鳩<WH08449>，一隻雛鴿<WH01469>。』
Gen/15.lcc_original: 永恆主說：『你給我取一隻三年未生犢的母牛，一隻三年的母山羊，一隻三年的公綿羊，一隻斑鳩，一隻雛鴿。』
notes: UNV 他 (pronoun) → LCC 永恆主 (Eternal Lord, full title); no SN on the subject itself since UNV has none on 他 either — <WH0559><WTH8799> attaches to 說 in both
{<WAH0413>} (implicit 'to him') remains braced — LCC also has no explicit word for this preposition
UNV 為我<WAH09001> → LCC 給我<WAH09001>: both express the prepositional 'for me' (Hebrew לִי); <WAH09001> attaches after 給我
For the heifer: UNV 三年的 → LCC 三年未生犢的 (interpretive expansion 'three years without having calved'); <WH08027><WTH8794> attaches after the full expanded phrase, before 母牛<WH05697>

Gen/15.lcc_original: 亞伯蘭就把這些祭牲取來，每樣都從當中劈開，一半對着一半地排着；鳥卻沒有劈開。
notes: The implicit {<WAH0853>} (אֵת, direct-object marker) from UNV was assigned to LCC 把, which is LCC's explicit functional object marker for the same construction; braces dropped per Rule 3.

Hebrew בַּתָּוֶךְ (H09002 ב-prefix + H8432 תָּוֶךְ, 'in the midst') corresponds to LCC 從當中; tags are attached to 當中 as the head noun. LCC's 從 (prepositional particle expressing the same relationship) is left unannotated as it has no independent SN.
LCC 祭牲 ('sacrificial animals') is an interpretive addition by Lü with no explicit Hebrew counterpart in this verse; left unannotated.
LCC inverts the verb phrase: UNV 就取了[H3947]...這些...來 → LCC 把...這些...取來; H3947+WTH8799 placed after 取來 to follow LCC word order.

Two instances of 一半 in LCC map to distinct Hebrew roots: first 一半 = אִישׁ (H376, 'each') + בֶּתֶר (H1335, 'piece'), annotated as 一<WH0376>半<WH01335>; second 一半 = רֵעַ (H7453, 'companion/fellow'), annotated as 一半<WH07453>.
LCC 排着 (arrange/lay out) corresponds to UNV 擺列 for H5414 (נָתַן, 'to place/set'); semantic fit is adequate, slight verb nuance difference.
Extra SNs: 09001

Gen/15.lcc_sn: 有鷙鳥<WH05861>直下來<WH03381><WTH8799>，落在<WAH05921>祭牲尸體<WH06297>之上，亞伯蘭<WH087>直把它們<WAH0853>嚇走<WH05380><WTH8686>。
Gen/15.lcc_original: 有鷙鳥直下來，落在祭牲尸體之上，亞伯蘭直把它們嚇走。
Gen/15.unv_sn_reference: 有鷙鳥<WH05861>下來<WH03381><WTH8799>，落在<WAH05921>那死畜<WH06297>的肉上，亞伯蘭<WH087>就把牠<WAH0853>嚇飛<WH05380><WTH8686>了。
notes: LCC adds 直 twice as a stylistic adverb (no Hebrew equivalent); left unannotated in both positions
UNV 死畜 (WH06297, 'carcass') → LCC 祭牲尸體; SN attached to 尸體 as the word most directly meaning 'carcass/body', with 祭牲 as LCC's contextual gloss
UNV 嚇飛 → LCC 嚇走 (both = 'drive/scare away'); WH05380+WTH8686 attached to 嚇走 without ambiguity

Gen/15.lcc_original: 日頭正落的時候，亞伯蘭瞇瞇地沉睡着，忽有一種恐怖、一種大黑暗落在他身上。
notes: LCC 瞇瞇地沉睡着 contains no explicit word for naphal (H5307/WTH8804); the 'fell into' sense is absorbed into the manner adverb 瞇瞇地 — kept {<WH05307>}{<WTH8804>} implicit before the phrase

LCC splits Hebrew 'eimah gedolah chashekah' into two coordinate nouns (恐怖、大黑暗) rather than UNV's merged compound 驚人的大黑暗; H0367 attached to 恐怖, H01419+H02825 to 大黑暗 — this is more faithful to the Hebrew three-word structure
忽然 (UNV) compresses to 忽 in LCC (as part of 忽有); WAH02009 attached to 忽
{<WAH05921>} before 亞伯蘭 kept implicit — no explicit preposition 'upon' before Abram's name in LCC

Gen/15.lcc_original: 永恆主對亞伯蘭說：『你要確實知道：你的後裔必寄居在一個不是自己之地的所在，必服事那地的人，那地的人必苦害他們四百年。
notes: 耶和華→永恆主: LCC uses a circumlocutory divine name; WAH09001+WH087 both attach to 永恆主 as a unit.
的確知道→確實知道: both render the Hebrew infinitive-absolute construction יָדֹעַ תֵּדַע; WH03045/WTH8800 on 確實 and WH03045/WTH8799 on 知道.

別人的地→不是自己之地的所在: LCC expands the Hebrew לֹא לָהֶם אֶרֶץ significantly; WAH03808 (לֹא) attaches to negation 不, while the prefix particles WAH09001/WAH09002 and WH0776 (ארץ) cluster on 地 before the added LCC phrase 的所在.
{<WAH03588>} (כִּי) remains implicit: LCC uses a colon structurally rather than an explicit connective, so braces are kept.
苦待→苦害: different renderings of עָנָה (Piel = afflict/humble); SNs transferred normally to 苦害.
WAH01961 (יִהְיֶה 'will be') with implicit morphology {WTH8799} placed on 必, matching UNV's 必<WAH01961>{WTH8799} grouping.

Gen/15.lcc_original: 他們所要服事的那國、我也要懲罰；後來他們要帶着大量財物、從那裏出來。
notes: UNV opens with 並且<WAH01571> (גַּם, 'also/even'), which LCC renders as 也 in the middle of the clause (我也要懲罰). H01571 is attached to 也 rather than a clause-initial word.
UNV 我要<WAH0595> is split in LCC: H0595 (אָנֹכִי, 'I') attaches to 我, with 也 intervening before 要懲罰. Order: 我<WAH0595>也<WAH01571>要懲罰<WH01777><WTH8802>.
UNV 許多<WH01419> → LCC 大量<WH01419>: semantically equivalent terms for 'great/large quantity' (גָּדוֹל, H01419).
LCC 他們要帶着 carries no SN, consistent with UNV 他們必帶著 which also has no tag.

Gen/15.lcc_sn: 至於你<WAH0859>呢，你卻要安安然然地<WAH09002><WH07965>歸回<WH0935><WTH8799><WAH0413>你列祖<WH01>那裏，得享長壽<WH02896><WAH09002><WH07872>，受人埋葬<WH06912><WTH8735>。
Gen/15.lcc_original: 至於你呢，你卻要安安然然地歸回你列祖那裏，得享長壽，受人埋葬。
Gen/15.unv_sn_reference: 但你<WAH0859>要享大<WH02896>壽數<WAH09002><WH07872>，平平安安地<WAH09002><WH07965>歸<WH0935><WTH8799>到<WAH0413>你列祖<WH01>那裡，被人埋葬<WH06912><WTH8735>。
notes: WAH0859 (אַתָּה) attached to the first 你 in 至於你, which is the topicalized pronoun corresponding to Hebrew וְאַתָּה; the second 你 is a resumptive subject and not separately annotated.
LCC 安安然然地 corresponds to UNV 平平安安地 for H7965 (שָׁלוֹם); WAH09002 prefix retained.
LCC compresses UNV 大壽數 (H2896 טוֹב + H7872 שֵׂיבָה = 'good old age') into the single compound 長壽; both SNs plus the WAH09002 prefix are attached together after 長壽.

H413 (אֶל 'to/toward') has no explicit lexical counterpart in LCC — the directional meaning is absorbed into 歸回; WAH0413 attached immediately after the verb complex 歸回 to preserve the preposition–destination relationship.
LCC 受人埋葬 aligns cleanly with UNV 被人埋葬 for H6912+WTH8735 (Niphal participle of קָבַר).

Gen/15.lcc_original: 到了第四代，他們必回到此地來，因爲亞摩利人的罪孽還沒有貫滿。』
notes: LCC 貫滿 corresponds to UNV 滿盈 — both render H08003 (שָׁלֵם, complete/full); straightforward lexical substitution.
LCC adds directional complement 來 after 此地 — purely a Chinese grammatical addition with no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated.
因爲 (LCC traditional form) vs 因為 (UNV simplified form) is a character variant only; alignment is unambiguous.

Gen/15.lcc_original: 日落時、天黑壓壓，忽有冒煙的手提爐子、和燒着的火把、從那些肉塊中經過。
notes: 天黑壓壓 treated as a single phrase covering both עֲלָטָה (H5939) and הָיָה (H1961+WTH8804) per Rule 6; both SNs placed after 壓壓 as the final word of the compound
壓壓 is LCC's intensifier with no direct Hebrew equivalent; H1961+WTH8804 attached to it as the closest semantic host for the stative verb הָיָה
{<WAH01961>}{<WTH8799>} remains implicit — LCC uses a temporal clause structure 日落時 rather than expressing וַיְהִי explicitly, identical to UNV's treatment
LCC 手提爐子 (portable stove) expands UNV 爐; both = תַּנּוּר (H8574); 手提 is LCC's descriptive elaboration with no separate SN
忽 chosen over 有 as host for H2009 (הִנֵּה = behold) since 忽 directly captures the exclamatory attention-drawing force of הִנֵּה; 有 is existential filler

Gen/15.lcc_original: 就在那一天，永恆主就同亞伯蘭立了約說：『這地我已經給了你的後裔了：就是從埃及河直到大河、就是伯拉河、那一帶：
notes: LCC topicalizes 這地 (=הָאָרֶץ הַזֹּאת) before the verb 給; WAH02063 attaches to 這 and WH0776 to 地, matching Hebrew demonstrative+noun order
{<WAH0853>} (אֶת direct object marker) kept implicit and placed after 地 — Chinese has no structural equivalent for the Hebrew object marker
WAH04480 (מִן prefix = 'from') attached to 從 since 從 is the Chinese preposition expressing the same Hebrew מִן; WH05104 (נָהָר) separately attached to 河
{<WH05104>} in UNV represents the construct 'river of Euphrates' where river is implicit; LCC 伯拉河 has an explicit 河, so braces dropped per rule 3 and WH05104 attached to 河
那一帶 at end has no direct Hebrew correspondent and is left unannotated — appears to be LCC's summarizing geographic phrase with no Hebrew lexical basis
就是 phrases (before 從 and before 伯拉) are LCC clarification connectives with no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated

Gen/15.lcc_original: 就是基尼人、基尼洗人、甲摩尼人、
notes: LCC text is character-for-character identical to UNV; all three people-group names align directly. The first <WAH0853> (את) attaches to 就是 as in UNV; subsequent object markers remain implicit {<WAH0853>} for the coordinated list items.

Gen/15.lcc_original: 赫人、比利洗人、高身漢種的人、
notes: H853 (direct object marker את) has no explicit Chinese equivalent in either version — kept as implicit {<WAH0853>} for all three peoples
LCC renders H7497 (רְפָאִים, Rephaim) descriptively as 高身漢種的人 (tall/giant race people) rather than transliterating — SN attached to the whole phrase

Gen/15.lcc_original: 亞摩利人、迦南人、革迦撒人、耶布斯人、之地。』
notes: All four people-group names (亞摩利人, 迦南人, 革迦撒人, 耶布斯人) map directly 1-to-1 between UNV and LCC with identical characters, so SN placement is unambiguous.
{<WAH0853>} (direct object marker אֵת) has no explicit Chinese equivalent in LCC — braces retained per Rule 4.
LCC inserts a comma before 之地 that UNV lacks; LCC punctuation preserved exactly, no SN for 之地 since none appears in the UNV+SN source.

Gen/16.lcc_sn: 亞伯蘭<WH087>的妻子<WH0802>撒萊<WH08297>沒有<WH03808>給他<WAH09001>生兒女<WH03205><WTH8804>；可是撒萊有一個婢女<WH08198>，是埃及人<WH04713>，她名<WH08034>叫夏甲<WH01904>。
Gen/16.lcc_original: 亞伯蘭的妻子撒萊沒有給他生兒女；可是撒萊有一個婢女，是埃及人，她名叫夏甲。
Gen/16.unv_sn_reference: 亞伯蘭<WH087>的妻子<WH0802>撒萊<WH08297>不<WH03808>給他<WAH09001>生兒女<WH03205><WTH8804>。撒萊有一個使女<WH08198>，名<WH08034>叫夏甲<WH01904>，是埃及人<WH04713>。
notes: 不(WH03808) mapped to 沒有 — different Chinese word but same Hebrew negation לֹא
使女(WH08198) mapped to 婢女 — LCC uses a different synonym for שִׁפְחָה (handmaid/maidservant)
LCC inverts the final two clauses: UNV has 名叫夏甲…是埃及人, LCC has 是埃及人…名叫夏甲; SNs inserted at correct LCC positions accordingly
可是 and 她 are LCC connective/clarifying additions with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated

Gen/16.lcc_original: 撒萊對亞伯蘭說：『你看，永恆主抑制我、使我不能生育；求你進去找我婢女，或者我的後裔得以樹立起來。』亞伯蘭聽從了撒萊的話。
notes: 你看 in LCC is an explicit rendering of UNV's implicit {<WAH02009>} (הִנֵּה, 'behold') — braces dropped per Rule 3; the trailing {<WAH04994>} (נָא, entreaty particle) has no LCC equivalent in this clause so remains implicit
H06113 (עָצַר, 'restrain/close up') maps to LCC's 抑制 rather than UNV's paraphrastic 使我不能 structure; H03205+H04480 (מִלֶּדֶת, 'from bearing') attaches to 生育
H0413 (אֶל, preposition 'unto') mapped to 找 — LCC recasts 'go in unto my maidservant' as 'go in, find my maidservant', so 找 is the closest lexical bridge
Second H04480 (מִמֶּנָּה, 'from/through her') is entirely absent from LCC's rephrasing of the H01129 niphal clause; retained as implicit {<WAH04480>}

H01129 niphal ('I will be built up through her', i.e. obtain children) is rendered in LCC as a different-subject clause '我的後裔得以樹立起來' (my offspring will be established) — same root sense, lower alignment confidence for this clause

Gen/16.lcc_original: 這樣，亞伯蘭在迦南地住了十年之後，亞伯蘭的妻子撒萊纔取了她的婢女埃及人夏甲給自己的丈夫亞伯蘭爲妾。
notes: LCC inverts clause order vs UNV: the time phrase (住了十年之後) precedes the main clause. This actually mirrors Hebrew syntax more closely — MT begins with מִקֵּץ עֶשֶׂר שָׁנִים לְשֶׁבֶת before the main verb.
UNV compresses בְּאֶרֶץ into 在<WAH09002><WH0776> (single word). LCC makes 地 (אֶרֶץ, WH0776) explicit as a separate character, so WAH09002 attaches to 在 and WH0776 attaches to 地.
LCC's 之後 renders מִקֵּץ (WH07093 + WAH04480 = 'at the end of / after'); in UNV these same tags were placed on 已經.
Third occurrence of 亞伯蘭 in LCC (inside 丈夫亞伯蘭) is left untagged — consistent with UNV, which also does not apply WH087 to the 亞伯蘭 in that position.
纔 (temporal adverb 'then / only then') left unannotated; it has no direct Hebrew lexeme equivalent (the waw-consecutive is absorbed into the verbal form).

Gen/16.lcc_original: 亞伯蘭和夏甲同牀，夏甲就懷了孕。夏甲見自己有了孕，就輕看她的主母。
notes: UNV 與→LCC 和: both serve as the preposition 'with'; WAH0413 attached after 和
UNV 同房→LCC 同牀: synonymous expressions for cohabitation; WH0935+WTH8799 transferred
UNV uses semicolon ；splitting clauses; LCC uses full stop 。splitting into two sentences — LCC punctuation preserved exactly
UNV 她見→LCC 夏甲見: LCC restates the full subject; SN attached after 見 as normal
UNV 小看→LCC 輕看: synonyms for 'despise/belittle' (H7043 קָלַל); transfer straightforward
{<WAH09002>}{<WH05869>} (Heb. בְּעֵינֶיהָ 'in her eyes') remains implicit — LCC omits this phrase just as UNV does

Gen/16.lcc_original: 撒萊對亞伯蘭說：『我之受屈都歸在你身上；我將我的婢女放在你懷中，她見自己有了孕，就輕看我。願永恆主在你我之間行判斷。』
notes: LCC rephrases 我因你受屈 as 我之受屈都歸在你身上 — WH02555 (חָמָס, wrong/violence) attaches to 受屈; WAH05921 (עַל, upon) attaches to 身上 as the closest semantic anchor for 'upon you', despite reversed clause order vs UNV
LCC uses 婢女 where UNV has 使女 — both render שִׁפְחָה (WH08198), straightforward lexical variant
LCC uses 輕看 where UNV has 小看 for קָלַל (WH07043) — synonymous despise/make-light-of verbs
LCC uses 永恆主 for יְהוָה (WH03068) — Lü's circumlocution for the divine name instead of 耶和華
LCC has 行判斷 vs UNV's 判斷 for שָׁפַט (WH08199/WTH8799) — 行 is an auxiliary verb; tags attach to 判斷 as the semantic head
{<WAH03588>} (כִּי, 'that') and {<WAH09002>}{<WH05869>} (בְּעֵינֶיהָ, 'in her eyes') remain implicit — LCC has no explicit words for these

Gen/16.lcc_original: 亞伯蘭對撒萊說：『看哪，你的婢女全在你手中，你看怎麼好，就怎麼樣待她吧。』於是撒萊苦待夏甲，夏甲就從撒萊面前逃走了。
notes: UNV {<WAH02009>} (implicit הִנֵּה) is explicit in LCC as 看哪; braces dropped per Rule 3 and tag attached after 看哪.
UNV 使女<WH08198> → LCC 婢女<WH08198>: direct synonym (שִׁפְחָה, maidservant), straightforward substitution.
UNV 隨意<WH02896><WAH09002><WH05869> is rephrased in LCC as 你看怎麼好; SNs distributed: WAH09002+WH05869 (בְּעֵינַיִךְ, in-your-eyes) → 你看, WH02896 (טוֹב, good) → 好.
LCC uses Hagar's name 夏甲 where UNV uses pronoun 她 in the second half — no additional SN tags required since UNV also lacks an explicit SN for the pronoun there.
LCC adds 全 (entirely/all) before 在你手中 with no Hebrew counterpart; left unannotated per Rule 5.
WAH09002 (ב prefix) appears twice: once on 手 (בְּיָדֵךְ, in-your-hand) and once on 你看 (בְּעֵינַיִךְ, in-your-eyes) — two distinct Hebrew occurrences, both preserved.

Gen/16.lcc_original: 永恆主的使者在曠野的水泉邊，在往書珥路上的泉旁遇見了她。
notes: UNV's {<WH05869>} (first עַיִן, implicit spring) is explicit in LCC as 泉 in 水泉邊 — braces dropped per Rule 3, tag attached to 泉
LCC expands into two parallel clauses (在曠野的水泉邊 / 在往書珥路上的泉旁), allowing both עַיִן occurrences to be tagged explicitly — one per clause
LCC's 往 (directional 'toward') is LCC's expansion of בְּדֶרֶךְ שׁוּר and carries no direct SN
了 (aspect particle) and 她 (pronominal suffix on Hebrew verb) left untagged per Rule 5

Gen/16.lcc_original: 就說：『撒萊的婢女夏甲，你從哪裏來？要往哪裏去？』夏甲說：『我從我主母撒萊面前逃出來。』
notes: LCC uses 就說 vs UNV 對她說; the verb SNs (H0559 + WTH8799) attach after 說 in both cases — the 對她 directional phrase has no separate SN in UNV so nothing is lost
LCC uses 婢女 (bondwoman) where UNV uses 使女 (maidservant), both rendering H08198 (שִׁפְחָה); SN attaches after 婢女
LCC omits the possessive 的 in 從我主母 (vs UNV 從我的主母); H01404 attaches to 主母 regardless
哪裏/哪裡 is a purely orthographic difference; SNs transfer straightforwardly to both occurrences

Gen/16.lcc_original: 永恆主的使者對夏甲說：『回到你主母那裏，屈服在她手下。』
notes: 耶和華→永恆主: LCC's standard rendering of YHWH; <WH03068> attaches to 永恆主 as a unit
她→夏甲: LCC supplies the explicit name Hagar where UNV uses the pronoun 她; <WAH09001> (prefix ל, 'to') attaches to 夏甲 as the object
服→屈服: LCC uses the two-character compound 屈服 for הִתְעַנִּי; both <WH06031> and morphology <WTH8690> attach after the full compound

Gen/16.lcc_original: 永恆主的使者又對她說：『我必定使你的後裔大大增多，多到數不過來。』
notes: WH03068 (יְהוָה) and WH04397 (מַלְאַךְ) were both implicit {braces} in UNV but are explicit in LCC as 永恆主 and 使者 respectively — braces dropped, tags attach in LCC word order (reversed from Hebrew/UNV order because Chinese genitive is possessor-的-possessed).
WAH09001 (לָהּ, 'to her') was implicit in UNV; LCC makes it explicit with 對她, so braces dropped and tag placed after 她.
WAH0853 (direct object marker אֵת) has no explicit Chinese equivalent in LCC; retained as {<WAH0853>} between 使 and 你的後裔.

Hebrew inf-abs + hiphil imperfect construction (הַרְבָּה אַרְבֶּה, 'greatly multiply') appears in UNV split across 極其 (WH07235+WTH8687) and 繁多 (WH07235+WTH8686); LCC's 大大增多 parallels this split — 大大 takes WH07235+WTH8687 (emphatic/inf-abs role) and 增多 takes WH07235+WTH8686 (finite verb role).

LCC renders לֹא יִסָּפֵר מֵרֹב as 多到數不過來 (a resultative-complement construction); 多到 maps to מֵרֹב (WAH04480+WH07230, 'from/for multitude'), 數 maps to יִסָּפֵר (WH05608+WTH8735), 不 maps to לֹא (WAH03808); resultative complement 過來 ('be able to finish') has no Hebrew equivalent and is left unannotated.

Gen/16.lcc_original: 永恆主的使者又對她說：『看哪，你如今懷了孕，必生個兒子；你要給他起名叫以實瑪利，因爲你受的苦難永恆主聽見了。
notes: UNV opens with {<WH04397>}{<WH03068>} both implicit (subject re-introduced implicitly); LCC renders both explicitly as 永恆主的使者 in reversed possessive order (LORD's messenger rather than messenger-of-LORD). Braces dropped per Rule 3, SNs placed on their respective words: 永恆主<WH03068>的使者<WH04397>.
{<WAH09001>} (ל prefix 'to her') is implicit in UNV; LCC renders it explicitly as 對她, so braces dropped: 對她<WAH09001>.
{<WH02009>} (הִנֵּה 'behold') implicit in UNV; LCC has explicit 看哪, so braces dropped: 看哪<WH02009>.
{<WAH0413>} (אֶל 'to/unto') kept implicit — LCC reorders the final clause into topic-comment structure (苦難...永恆主聽見了) with no explicit preposition word for it.
LCC inserts aspect particles 了 in 懷了孕 and 聽見了 — these are Chinese grammatical additions with no Hebrew equivalent and are left unannotated.

LCC rephrases the final clause as topic-comment: 你受的苦難永恆主聽見了 (as for your suffering, the Eternal Lord heard) vs UNV's verb-object order 耶和華聽見了你的苦情. SNs distributed accordingly across the reordered words.
UNV's parenthetical (就是神聽見的意思) carries no SN tags and has no counterpart in LCC — correctly omitted.

Gen/16.lcc_sn: 你兒子<WAH01931>必像<WAH01961>人類<WH0120>中的野驢<WH06501>：他的手<WH03027>必攻打人<WAH09002><WAH03605>；人<WAH03605>的手<WH03027>也必攻打他<WAH09002>；他必居<WH07931><WTH8799>於<WAH05921>和衆<WAH03605>邦親<WH0251>相對<WH06440>的地位。』
Gen/16.lcc_original: 你兒子必像人類中的野驢：他的手必攻打人；人的手也必攻打他；他必居於和衆邦親相對的地位。』
notes: H1931 (הוּא = he/pronoun) tagged to '你兒子' — LCC makes the referent explicit as 'your son' rather than a bare pronoun.
H1961 (יִהְיֶה = will be) tagged to '必像' — LCC merges 'will be' and the comparative into a single verbal phrase.

H120 (אָדָם) and H6501 (פֶּרֶא) relationship inverted in LCC: Hebrew פֶּרֶא אָדָם = 'wild-donkey of a man' → UNV '為人...野驢' → LCC '人類中的野驢' (wild donkey among humanity); H120 tagged to '人類', H6501 to '中的野驢'.

H6440 (פְּנֵי = face/front) tagged to '相對' — LCC renders 'upon the face of all his brothers' as 'a position facing all his kinsfolk'; '相對' (face-to-face/opposite) correctly derives from פָּנִים, whereas UNV uses '東邊' (east side).
'的地位' (position/place) at end of last clause is LCC's elaboration with no direct Hebrew lexeme; left unannotated.

Gen/16.lcc_sn: 於是夏甲稱<WH07121><WTH8799>{<WH08034>}那對她<WAH0413>說話<WH01696><WTH8802>的永恆主<WH03068>叫「你<WAH0859>是看見<WH07210>萬事的上帝<WH0410>」，因爲<WAH03588>她說<WH0559><WTH8804>：『連在這裏<WH01988>我也<WAH01571>居然看見<WH07200><WTH8804>那看着<WH07200><WTH8802>我<WH0310>的麼？』
Gen/16.lcc_original: 於是夏甲稱那對她說話的永恆主叫「你是看見萬事的上帝」，因爲她說：『連在這裏我也居然看見那看着我的麼？』
notes: LCC '永恆主' (Eternal Lord) maps to UNV '耶和華' (Yahweh) → WH03068
UNV implicit {<WAH0859>} (אַתָּה, 'you') becomes explicit '你' in LCC → braces dropped per Rule 3
LCC '叫' (named/called it) is a grammatical connective parallel to UNV '為'; no SN assigned
LCC '看見萬事的上帝' expands the divine name El-Roi: '看見' → WH07210 (רֳאִי, seeing), '上帝' → WH0410 (אֵל, God); '萬事' is LCC's rhetorical elaboration with no SN
LCC '連在這裏我也' renders גַּם (WAH01571) via a 連…也 construction; WAH01571 placed after '也' matching UNV '我也<WAH01571>' pattern; '連' left unannotated as the secondary element of the pair
LCC '居然' (surprisingly/indeed) is a rhetorical intensifier added by LCC; no SN
LCC '她' before '說' is an explicit subject pronoun not in UNV Hebrew; no SN

WH0310 (אַחֲרֵי, after/behind) attached to '我' per UNV pattern in '那看着我<WH0310>的'; the difficult phrase אַחֲרֵי רֹאִי is rendered by LCC as '那看着我的' with '我' absorbing both the suffix and the preposition

Gen/16.lcc_original: 因此這井名叫庇耳拉海萊：看哪，就在加低斯與巴列之間呢。
notes: UNV {<WAH02009>} was implicit, but LCC has explicit 看哪, so braces dropped per Rule 3 → 看哪<WAH02009>

Hebrew has two בֵּין (H0996) tokens: first before Kadesh, second before Bered. LCC's 之間 captures the main 'between' → 之間<WAH0996>. LCC's 與 means 'and' not 'between', so the second H0996 stays implicit → 與{<WAH0996>}巴列
因此 (LCC) maps to 所以 (UNV) → carries <WAH05921><WAH03651>
庇耳拉海萊 in LCC omits the interpunct dots used in UNV (庇耳‧拉海‧萊); LCC's original punctuation preserved as-is

Gen/16.lcc_original: 夏甲給亞伯蘭生了一個兒子，亞伯蘭給他的兒子、就是夏甲所生的、起名叫以實瑪利。
notes: UNV opens with 後來 (temporal adverb) which carries no SN tag and is absent from LCC — no action needed.
UNV's 給他<WH01121> (Hebrew בְּנוֹ 'his son') is expanded in LCC to 給他的兒子; WH01121 attaches to 兒子 as the explicit nominal head. The possessive 他的 is implied by the Hebrew suffix and left unannotated.

The four implicit markers {<WAH0834>}{<WH01904>}{<WH03205>}{<WTH8804>} correspond to Hebrew אֲשֶׁר-יָלְדָה הָגָר ('whom Hagar had borne'). LCC renders this explicitly as 就是夏甲所生的, so braces are dropped per Rule 3: WAH0834→就是, WH01904→夏甲, WH03205+WTH8804→所生的.

The morphology pair WTH8799/WTH8804 distinguishes the two occurrences of WH03205 (yalad): Qal imperfect (8799) for the main narrative birth clause, Qal perfect (8804) for the retrospective relative clause — alignment preserved accordingly.

Gen/16.lcc_original: 夏甲給亞伯蘭生了以實瑪利的時候，亞伯蘭正八十六歲。
notes: LCC lacks 年 (year); UNV has 年<WH08141> before 八十 and a second standalone <WH08141> between 八十 and 六, representing שָׁנָה twice in the Hebrew idiom בֶּן שְׁמֹנִים שָׁנָה וְשֵׁשׁ שָׁנִים. Both WH08141 instances are redistributed to trail their respective numerals (八十 and 六) for closest per-token association.

LCC inserts aspect particle 了 after 生; 了 has no Hebrew equivalent and is left unannotated. SN tags (WAH09002, WH03205, WTH8800) attach to 生 before 了, keeping them on the semantically bearing morpheme.
LCC adds 正 (just/exactly) as a connective before the age numeral; 正 has no Hebrew equivalent and is left unannotated.
{<WAH0853>} (את direct object marker) has no explicit word in LCC either, so braces are preserved and it is placed immediately after 了 before 以實瑪利.

Gen/17.lcc_original: 亞伯蘭九十九歲的時候，永恆主向亞伯蘭顯現，說：『我是全能的上帝；你在我面前往來，要純全無疵。
notes: LCC's '九十九歲' condenses UNV's age phrase (九十<WH08673>+年<WH08141>+九<WH08672>+歲<WH01121>); both WH08141 (שָׁנָה) instances are stacked on 歲 since LCC drops the 年 character entirely
LCC uses explicit '亞伯蘭' where UNV has implicit {<WH087>} on 他; braces dropped and tag attached directly to the explicit name
LCC omits the second directional 'to him' (אֵלָיו) from 'said to him'; its WAH0413 is absorbed into 說 alongside WH0559+WTH8799
LCC has explicit '往來' for UNV's implicit {<WH01980>}{<WTH8690>} (הִתְהַלֵּךְ Hitpael); braces dropped and tags attached to the explicit verb
LCC uses 上帝 (where UNV uses 神) and 永恆主 (where UNV uses 耶和華); both map to WH0410 (אֵל) and WH03068 (יְהוָה) respectively
LCC's four-character phrase 純全無疵 covers the single Hebrew word תָמִים (WH08549); tag attached at end of phrase

Gen/17.lcc_original: 我就在我與你之間立我的約，使你的後裔大大增多。』
notes: LCC's 在我與你之間 explicitly renders both occurrences of H0996 (בֵּין = between) that UNV splits across two positions (與你<WAH0996> before 立 and implicit {<WAH0996>} after 約); both tags consolidate at 之間 and braces are dropped from the originally implicit marker since LCC has an explicit word

UNV places 'between you' before the verb and 'between me' implicitly after 約, following Hebrew word order; LCC restructures to 在我與你之間立 (fronted prepositional phrase), so both H0996 SNs naturally attach at the end of that phrase on 之間
<WAH09002> (ו conjunction prefix, properly belonging to verb וְהִרְבֵּיתִי) follows UNV's annotation pattern of placing it on the adverbial modifier — attached to 大大 rather than 增多
使你<WAH0853>: H0853 (אֵת, direct object marker) is grammatically implicit in Chinese in both UNV and LCC; preserved attached to 使你 without braces per UNV convention

Gen/17.lcc_original: 亞伯蘭臉伏於地，上帝又告訴他說：
notes: LCC '臉伏' is split: 臉→<WH06440> (פָּנִים, face) because LCC makes it explicit while UNV leaves it implicit {}; 伏→<WH05307><WTH8799> (נָפַל, fell/prostrated). Braces dropped from <WH06440> per rule 3.

LCC '地' (ground) has no direct Hebrew counterpart — it is a contextual Chinese addition completing 'prostrated to the ground'; left unannotated. The positional semantics of עַל (H5921) are carried by 於.
LCC '上帝' maps to UNV '神' — both render אֱלֹהִים <WH0430>.
LCC '告訴' renders H1696 (דָּבַר, speak/tell) explicitly where UNV has implicit {<WH01696>}{<WTH8762>}; braces dropped per rule 3.
LCC condenses UNV '對他說' into '告訴他說'; 他 receives <WAH0854> (אֵת, him) as in UNV's 對他<WAH0854>.

Gen/17.lcc_original: 『論到我，我的約是同你立的；你必做羣國之父。
notes: 論到 is treated as an explicit rendering of הִנֵּה (WAH02009): LCC reorders the Hebrew 'I–behold' (אֲנִי הִנֵּה) into the natural Chinese 'as-for–me' (論到我), so 論到 captures the behold/presentative particle and drops the braces.
The Chinese 是…立的 cleft construction has no Hebrew equivalent — it is purely a Chinese grammatical scaffold for 'is established'; 是 and 立的 are left unannotated.
羣 (multitude/flock) maps to הֲמוֹן (WH01995) and 國 maps to גּוֹיִם (WH01471); LCC compresses 多國 → 羣國 but the two-morpheme structure is preserved.
WAH09001 (ל prefix) and WH01 (אַב) both attach after 父 following UNV convention; 之 is a classical Chinese structural particle with no direct Hebrew counterpart and is left unannotated.

Gen/17.lcc_original: 你的名必不再叫亞伯蘭；你的名要改作亞伯拉罕，因爲我已立了你做羣國之父。』
notes: UNV's opening phrase 從此以後 is absent in LCC; it carries no SN so nothing is lost.
LCC adds emphatic 必 before 不; 必 has no Hebrew equivalent (H3808 attaches to 不 only).
Second clause: LCC rephrases UNV's 要叫 as 你的名要改作. H8034 attaches to the second 名 (second occurrence of שִׁמְךָ), and H1961+WTH8804 attaches to 改作 (וְהָיָה).
LCC's 做羣國之父 covers UNV's 你作多國的父: H1995→羣 (המון/multitude), H1471→國 (גּוֹיִם/nations), H1→父 (אַב/father); 做 and 之 are connective particles with no Hebrew equivalents.
Aspect particle 了 after 立 is left unannotated per rules; WH05414+WTH8804 attach after 了 to the full verbal complex 立了.
{<WAH0853>} retained as implicit: LCC also restructures the clause so 你的名 becomes the subject rather than the direct object, leaving no explicit word for the Hebrew direct object marker את.

Gen/17.lcc_original: 我必使你的後裔極能生殖：我必使你立成爲國；君王必從你而出。
notes: <WAH0853> (את direct-object marker) attaches to 你 as in UNV, marking 你的後裔 as the direct object of 使.

UNV 極其<WAH09002><WH03966><WH03966>繁多 → LCC 極能生殖: 極 absorbs both 極其 and the doubled H3966 (מְאֹד מְאֹד); 能 is a Chinese aspectual particle with no Hebrew equivalent and is left unannotated; 生殖 takes H6509+WTH8689.
Second clause word order is inverted: UNV '國度<WAH09001><WH01471>從你而立<WH05414><WTH8804>' → LCC '你立<WH05414><WTH8804>成爲國<WAH09001><WH01471>'; SNs follow LCC word order per rule 7.
君王必從你而出 maps cleanly: 君王<WH04428>, 從你<WAH04480> (מִן prefix), 而出<WH03318><WTH8799>; 必 is a Chinese modal with no separate SN.

Gen/17.lcc_original: 在我與你以及你以後的苗裔之間，我必堅立我的約，做世世代代永遠的約；好讓我做你和你以後的苗裔的上帝。
notes: LCC consolidates all three Hebrew occurrences of בֵּין (H996: בֵּינִי, וּבֵינֶךָ, and the third implicit instance after my covenant in UNV) onto the single token 之間 at the end of the first clause — all three <WAH0996> tags attach there, braces dropped since 之間 is explicit.
Both UNV implicit {<WH0310>} (אַחַר = after) instances become explicit 以後 in LCC — braces dropped in both occurrences.
UNV places 世世代代<WAH09001><WH01755> in the first clause before 堅立; LCC repositions it into the second clause (做世世代代永遠的約). SNs follow the semantic content to its new position.
LCC's first 做 (做世世代代永遠的約) expresses the Hebrew לִ preposition in לִבְרִית — no standalone SN for 做 itself; the <WAH09001> prefix attaches to 約 as in UNV.
LCC's second 做 (好讓我做) corresponds to Hebrew לִהְיוֹת (H1961, to be) with its prefix and morphology code; 好讓我 is Chinese purposive phrasing with no direct Hebrew equivalent and is left unannotated.
LCC uses 苗裔 (H2233) where UNV uses 後裔; LCC uses 上帝 (H430) where UNV uses 神 — standard systematic lexical differences between the two versions.

Gen/17.lcc_original: 我要將你現在寄居的地，就是迦南全地，賜給你和你以後的苗裔，做永遠的產業；我還要做他們的上帝。』
notes: UNV {<WH0310>} was implicit (no explicit Chinese word for אַחַר 'after'), but LCC uses explicit '以後' — dropped braces and attached as 以後<WH0310>
UNV '後裔' → LCC '苗裔' (both render זֶרַע H2233, descendants/seed); SN transferred without issue
UNV '為業' → LCC '做…的產業': ל prefix (WAH09001) + אֲחֻזָּה (WH0272) both attach after 產業, the head noun; '做' is a copula/preposition rendering the ל and left unannotated
UNV '神' → LCC '上帝' (both render אֱלֹהִים H430); double WAH09001 sequence (他們的<WAH09001>上帝<WAH09001><WH0430>) preserved following UNV token order
Both <WAH0853> accusative markers placed in same structural positions as UNV: after '將' and after '就是'

Gen/17.lcc_sn: 上帝<WH0430>又對<WAH0413>亞伯拉罕<WH085>說<WH0559><WTH8799>：『你<WAH0859>，你務要守<WH08104><WTH8799>{<WAH0853>}我的約<WH01285>，你<WAH0859>和你以後<WH0310>的苗裔<WH02233>，世世代代<WAH09001><WH01755>都要守。
Gen/17.lcc_original: 上帝又對亞伯拉罕說：『你，你務要守我的約，你和你以後的苗裔，世世代代都要守。
notes: LCC 上帝 = UNV 神 = H0430 (Elohim); different lexical choice, same referent
LCC restructures clause order: main predicate (你務要守我的約) stated first, then appositional subject (你和你以後的苗裔), then clause-completing verb (都要守) at end — only the first 守 is tagged with H8104+WTH8799
The second 你 in '你務要守' is unannotated: Chinese requires an explicit subject pronoun where Hebrew encodes it in the 2ms imperfect verb form (תִשְׁמֹר); no separate H859 token in Hebrew
LCC explicitly writes 以後 for H0310 (אַחֲרֶיךָ = after you), which was implicit {<WH0310>} in UNV; tagged as WH0310 on 以後 with 和你 treated as conjunction + pronominal suffix
Final 都要守 is unannotated — LCC's stylistic addition to close the hanging appositional clause; has no counterpart in the Hebrew source
{<WAH0853>} remains implicit: LCC is Chinese and uses no explicit accusative marker (אֶת)

Gen/17.lcc_sn: 你們<WAH09001>中間所有的<WAH03605>男子<WH02145>都要受割禮<WH04135><WTH8736>：這就是<WAH02063>我的約<WH01285>，在我與你們以及你以後<WH0310>的苗裔<WH02233>之間<WAH0996><WAH0996><WAH0996>所立的，就是你們所<WAH0834>當守<WH08104><WTH8799>的。
Gen/17.lcc_original: 你們中間所有的男子都要受割禮：這就是我的約，在我與你們以及你以後的苗裔之間所立的，就是你們所當守的。
Gen/17.unv_sn_reference: 你們<WAH09001>所有的<WAH03605>男子<WH02145>都要受割禮<WH04135><WTH8736>；這就是<WAH02063>我{<WAH0996>}與你<WAH0996>並{<WAH0996>}你{<WH0310>}的後裔<WH02233>所立的約<WH01285>，是你們所<WAH0834>當遵守<WH08104><WTH8799>的。
notes: WAH09001 (inseparable prefix particle) stays after 你們; LCC's added 中間 (among) likely paraphrases the same prefixed preposition sense but is left unannotated as a Chinese gloss

All three WAH0996 (H996 בֵּין = between) consolidated onto 之間 per Rule 6: LCC's '在…之間' construction spans the full Hebrew בֵּינִי וּבֵינְכֶם וּבֵין idiom, so there is only one surface word to attach them to
WH0310 (H310 אַחַר = after): UNV marks it implicit {<WH0310>} on 你, but LCC renders it as the explicit word 以後, so braces are dropped per Rule 3 and tag attaches to 以後
WH01285 (H1285 בְּרִית = covenant): LCC reorders the clause — 約 appears before the covenant-parties phrase, unlike UNV where 約 comes last; tag attached to 約 in its new position

LCC 以及 (and also, conjoining you and your descendants) left unannotated: it corresponds to the conjunctive vav prefix on the second וּבֵין, whose H996 root is already captured in the three WAH0996 tags on 之間

Gen/17.lcc_sn: 你們{<WAH0853>}包皮<WH06190>的肉<WH01320>都要受割禮<WH05243><WTH8804>：這就要做<WAH01961><WTH8804>我與你們之間<WAH0996><WAH0996>所立的約<WH01285>的憑證<WAH09001><WH0226>。
Gen/17.lcc_original: 你們包皮的肉都要受割禮：這就要做我與你們之間所立的約的憑證。
notes: LCC explicitly includes 包皮的肉 (foreskin + flesh) where UNV relegates these to a footnote; consequently WH06190 (עָרְלָה, foreskin) attaches to 包皮 and WH01320 (בְּשַׂר, flesh) attaches to 肉 directly in the main text rather than in a note.

{<WAH0853>} (direct object marker אֵת) has no explicit Chinese equivalent in LCC; kept as implicit, placed immediately before the direct object phrase 包皮 where it marks the beginning of the object constituent.

LCC 之間 covers both Hebrew בֵּינִי (between me, WAH0996) and וּבֵינֵיכֶם (between you, the {WAH0996} implicit in UNV); since LCC has an explicit word for both instances, both WAH0996 tags attach to 之間 per Rule 6 (one LCC phrase covering multiple Hebrew words) and Rule 3 (explicit word drops braces).
LCC 這就要做 renders Hebrew וְהָיָה (WAH01961+WTH8804) more dynamically than UNV 這是; SNs attach to 做 as the main verb carrier.

Gen/17.lcc_original: 你們中間世世代代的一切男子，無論是家裏生的，是用銀子從外人買來的，就是不屬於你後裔的、生下來八天，都要受割禮。
notes: LCC 一切 explicitly renders כֹּל (H3605) which UNV leaves implicit as {<WAH03605>}; braces dropped per Rule 3, tag attached to 一切
LCC inverts clause order vs UNV: 'bought with silver from foreigners' precedes 'not of your seed'; SNs placed at semantically corresponding positions following LCC's word order
UNV 是<WAH01931> (הוּא = he) mapped to LCC 就是, not to the 是 opening the 'bought with silver' clause — the latter 是 is an unannotated Chinese connective LCC uses to introduce the parallel clause
LCC 不屬於 receives <WAH0834><WAH03808> (אֲשֶׁר לֹא = 'which not'), rendering UNV 之外
LCC 天 (days) = UNV 日 — same Hebrew יוֹם H3117; LCC omits ordinal marker 第, so 八 directly receives H8083
{<WH01121>} kept with braces — LCC also has no explicit word for בֶּן (son) in this position, matching UNV's implicit marker
LCC 中間 is an expansion of לָכֶם with no independent Hebrew token of its own; left unannotated

Gen/17.lcc_sn: 你家裏<WH01004>生的<WH03211>，和你的銀子<WH03701>買來的<WH04736>、都一定要<WH04135><WTH8736>受割禮<WH04135><WTH8735>：這樣，我的約<WH01285>就在你們肉身上<WAH09002><WH01320>做<WAH01961><WTH8804>永遠<WH05769>的約<WAH09001><WH01285>了。
Gen/17.lcc_original: 你家裏生的，和你的銀子買來的、都一定要受割禮：這樣，我的約就在你們肉身上做永遠的約了。
notes: The double WH04135 reflects the Hebrew infinitive absolute construction (הִמּוֹל יִמּוֹל = 'shall surely be circumcised'); first instance (WTH8736 inf. abs.) anchored to 一定要 (UNV 必須), second (WTH8735 Niphal impf.) anchored to 受割禮.
LCC 肉身 is a synonym of UNV 肉體; both map to WH01320 (בָּשָׂר) with prefix WAH09002 (ב = in/on).
LCC 做 = UNV 作 = WH01961 (הָיָה, 'to be/become'); WAH01961 carries the ו-consecutive prefix.
LCC final aspect particle 了 has no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated per Rule 5.
UNV 就立在 has no dedicated SN; Hebrew lacks a separate 'establish' verb here (הָיְתָה = 'shall be'). LCC 就在 likewise carries no tag.

Gen/17.lcc_sn: 但不受割禮的<WH06189>男子<WH02145>，就是<WH0834>他包皮<WH06190>的肉<WH01320>{<WAH0853>}沒有<WAH03808>受割禮<WH04135><WTH8735>的，那人<WH05315><WAH01931>就必須從<WAH04480>他的族人<WH05971>中被剪除<WH03772><WTH8738>：他是違背了<WH06565><WTH8689>我的約<WH01285>的。』
Gen/17.lcc_original: 但不受割禮的男子，就是他包皮的肉沒有受割禮的，那人就必須從他的族人中被剪除：他是違背了我的約的。』
notes: UNV implicit block {WH0834}{WAH03808}{WH04135}{WTH8735}{WAH0853}{WH01320}{WH06190} is fully expanded in LCC ('就是他包皮的肉沒有受割禮的'). Dropped braces and attached each SN to its explicit LCC word, except WAH0853 (אֵת direct object marker) which has no Chinese equivalent and remains implicit.

WH05315 (נֶפֶשׁ, soul) and WAH01931 (הִוא, that) both attached to '那人', which is LCC's rendering of הַנֶּפֶשׁ הַהִוא ('that soul/person'). The two SNs stack on the same word since they form one nominal phrase in Hebrew.
LCC '他是違背了' rephrases the subject more explicitly than Hebrew; '他是' has no SN (subject pronoun implied by verb in Hebrew, '是' is emphatic copula added by LCC). Only '違背了' maps to WH06565+WTH8689.
LCC '族人' is used for עַם (WH05971, people/kin) — a natural but slightly interpretive rendering of 'from her peoples'.

Gen/17.lcc_original: 上帝又對亞伯拉罕說：『你的妻子撒萊，你不要把她名叫撒萊；她的名要叫撒拉。
notes: 上帝 (LCC) maps to 神 (UNV), both = <WH0430>

LCC restructures the prohibition clause as '你不要把她名叫撒萊' vs UNV's '不可再叫{<WAH0853>}{<WH08034>}撒萊': LCC uses explicit 把 (object marker, drops braces from {<WAH0853>}) and explicit 名 (name, drops braces from {<WH08034>}), both attached to their respective words; LCC subject pronoun 你 and absent adverb 再 carry no SN
{<WH03588>} (כִּי) remains implicit — LCC uses ；(semicolon) with no explicit conjunction word

Gen/17.lcc_sn: 我必賜福<WH01288><WTH8765>與她<WAH0853>，{<WAH01571>}賜給<WH05414><WTH8804>你<WAH09001>一個兒子<WH01121>由她<WAH04480>而出：我必賜福<WH01288><WTH8765>與她，使她做<WAH01961><WTH8804>多國<WAH09001><WH01471>之母；必有<WAH01961><WTH8799>多族之民<WH05971>的王<WH04428>由她<WAH04480>而出。』
Gen/17.lcc_original: 我必賜福與她，賜給你一個兒子由她而出：我必賜福與她，使她做多國之母；必有多族之民的王由她而出。』
Gen/17.unv_sn_reference: 我必賜福<WH01288><WTH8765>給她<WAH0853>，也<WAH01571>要使你<WAH09001>從她<WAH04480>得<WH05414><WTH8804>一個兒子<WH01121>。我要賜福給她<WH01288><WTH8765>，她也要作<WAH01961><WTH8804>多國<WAH09001><WH01471>之母；必有<WAH01961><WTH8799>百姓<WH05971>的君王<WH04428>從她<WAH04480>而出。」
notes: WAH01571 (גַּם = also/moreover) is explicit in UNV as 也 but absent in LCC; inserted as {<WAH01571>} as a floating marker before 賜給 to preserve the SN while signaling no explicit LCC word hosts it.
LCC '多族之民' expands UNV '百姓' (H5971 = am = people/peoples) interpretively; WH05971 attached to 民 as the semantic head noun of the expanded phrase.
LCC restructures UNV '她也要作' (she shall become) into causative '使她做' (make her become); WAH01961 + WTH8804 attach to the core predicate verb 做 rather than the causative 使.
Both occurrences of '由她而出' in LCC correspond to '從她…而出' in UNV; WAH04480 (מִן = from) attached to 她 in each case.

Gen/17.lcc_original: 亞伯拉罕就伏臉而笑，心裏說：『一百歲的人還能生孩子麼？撒拉已經九十歲，還能生養麼？』
notes: UNV 俯伏<WH05307><WTH8799>在<WAH05921>地<WH06440> ('fell upon his face') collapses into LCC 伏臉; SNs distributed as 伏<WH05307><WTH8799>臉<WAH05921><WH06440> since 臉 (face) directly corresponds to H6440 (פָּנִים) and WAH05921 (עַל, upon) is its governing preposition
{<WAH09001>}{<WH01121>} implicit in UNV but LCC explicitly has 孩子; braces dropped per Rule 3 and attached as 孩子<WAH09001><WH01121>
{<WH01323>} (בַּת, daughter) remains implicit in LCC — Hebrew age construct 'daughter of ninety years' has no explicit counterpart in LCC's 九十歲, so the implicit marker is preserved
WAH0518 (H518, אִם conditional/modal particle) attached after 還能 in the second clause, mirroring UNV structure

Gen/17.lcc_original: 亞伯拉罕對上帝說：『但願以實瑪利在你面前活着就好啦！』
notes: 神→上帝: LCC uses 上帝 for אֱלֹהִים (WH0430); this is an explicit word, so braces are dropped and tag attaches normally.
Word order inversion: UNV has 活…在你面前, but LCC inverts to 在你面前活. Each SN follows its semantic counterpart in LCC word order: 在你面前<WAH09001><WH06440> precedes 活<WH02421><WTH8799>.
着就好啦: purely Chinese aspect particle (着) plus idiomatic modal ending (就好啦) with no Hebrew lexical equivalents — left unannotated per rule 5.

Gen/17.lcc_original: 上帝說：『不，是你妻子撒拉必給你生個兒子；你要給他起名叫以撒【1】；我要同他堅立我的約，做他以後的苗裔永遠的約。
notes: 上帝 (LCC) maps to H0430 instead of UNV's 神 — systematic LCC preference for 上帝 for אֱלֹהִים
不 (LCC) corresponds to 不然 (UNV) for H0061 (אֲבָל — but/however); LCC is more terse
{<WAH0853>} kept implicit before 約: LCC's 我的 is an exegetical addition not corresponding to H0853 (the accusative marker אֵת) itself
LCC footnote marker 【1】 preserved immediately after 以撒<WH03327>
H0310 (אַחַר, after) mapped to LCC's 以後 in the phrase 做他以後<WH0310>
苗裔 (LCC) replaces 後裔 (UNV) as the translation of H02233 (זֶרַע, seed/descendants) — near-synonym, straightforward alignment

Gen/17.lcc_original: 至於以實瑪利呢，我也聽你所求；看吧，我已給他祝福；我必使他繁殖，子孫大大增多；他必生十二個族長；我必使他成爲大國。
notes: 呢 (LCC topic particle after Ishmael) has no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated
看吧 is LCC's explicit rendering of UNV's implicit {<WAH02009>} — braces dropped per Rule 3; WAH02009 placed after the full phrase 看吧
LCC 聽你所求 expands UNV 應允你; SNs (WH08085/WTH8804) attached after 聽 as the core verb שָׁמַע
LCC 給他祝福 reorders UNV 賜福給他; WAH0853 placed after 他, WH01288/WTH8765 placed after 祝福 (the bless verb)
子孫 is an LCC interpretive expansion for the implied object of 增多 — no direct Hebrew counterpart, left unannotated
{<WAH0853>} kept implicit in the 大大增多 clause; LCC does not repeat 他 in this phrase

Gen/17.lcc_original: 論到我的約，我是要同以撒堅立的；以撒就是明年這時節撒拉所要給你生下來的。』
notes: LCC radically restructures the verse into a topic-comment + cleft construction (論到我的約 as topic; 以撒就是...的 as cleft). All 17 SN tags are preserved but their surface positions shift substantially from Hebrew/UNV word order.

以撒 appears twice in LCC but only once in Hebrew (יִצְחָק, WH03327). The FIRST occurrence (同以撒堅立) directly corresponds to Hebrew אֶת-יִצְחָק — direct object of אָקִים — and receives WH03327+WAH0853. The SECOND occurrence (以撒就是...) is a structural pivot of LCC's cleft and is left unannotated to avoid double-annotating one Hebrew word.
{<WAH0834>} was implicit in UNV (no Chinese word for אֲשֶׁר). In LCC, 所 explicitly serves the relative-clause function of אֲשֶׁר, so WH0834 is promoted to explicit (braces dropped) and attached to 所.
明年 in LCC is split for annotation: 明<WH0312> (= הָאַחֶרֶת, next/following) and 年<WAH09002><WH08141> (= בַּשָּׁנָה, in-the-year), matching the token split used in UNV.

{<WAH0853>} before 約 remains implicit (no explicit LCC word for the direct object marker אֶת before בְּרִיתִי). The first WAH0853 (before Isaac) is explicit because LCC names 以撒 directly rather than using the pronoun 他 that UNV uses.

Gen/17.lcc_original: 上帝對亞伯拉罕說完了話，就離開他上升去了。
notes: LCC 上帝 ← UNV 神, both = WH0430 (Elohim); systematic UNV/LCC difference, straightforward substitution
LCC 對 ← UNV 和 for WAH0854 (אֵת used as 'with/to'); UNV renders the preposition as 和 (with), LCC as 對 (to/toward), both anchoring the same Hebrew particle in context of speaking to Abraham
Verse structure is otherwise identical between UNV and LCC; all SN alignments are one-to-one with no reordering or merging needed

Gen/17.lcc_original: 就在這一天，亞伯拉罕就照上帝所對他說的，拉了他的兒子以實瑪利和自己家中的男人，一切男子，就是所有在家裏生的、和所有用銀子買的，都在他們包皮肉上給行了割禮。
notes: 就<WH06106>在<WAH09002>: LCC splits 就/在 where UNV merges 正當 — WH06106 (עֶצֶם, 'selfsame/very') aligns with 就 ('precisely/right'); WAH09002 (ב prefix 'on') aligns with 在; 就 also functions as an aspect particle so this is a judgment call.

照<WAH09003>上帝<WH0430>所<WAH0834>對他<WAH0853>說<WH01696>: UNV bundles WAH09003+WAH0834 on 遵著; LCC distributes them — 照='according to'=WAH09003, 所='what/which'=WAH0834. The {<WAH0853>} from UNV's 神的{<WAH0853>}命 is dropped to explicit <WAH0853> on 他 since LCC explicitly renders the prepositional object 對他 ('to him', H853 אֵת/אִתּוֹ).

WH085 (אַבְרָהָם) appears twice: first for Abraham's name (亞伯拉罕), second as possessor of 家中 — UNV has 家裡{<WH085>} (implicit), LCC renders it explicitly as 自己 ('his own'), so braces are dropped per Rule 3.

LCC 和自己家中的男人，一切男子 distributes Hebrew כָּל-זָכָר בְּאַנְשֵׁי בֵּית (all males among the men of the household): 男人<WAH09002><WH0582> captures אֲנָשִׁים (men, WH0582 with prefix WAH09002 ב), 一切<WAH03605>男子<WH02145> captures כֹּל-זָכָר (all males).

包皮<WH06190>肉<WH01320>: LCC explicitly renders what was fully implicit {<WH01320>}{<WH06190>} in UNV (the foreskin flesh); braces dropped per Rule 3. Hebrew order is בְּשַׂר עָרְלָה (flesh of foreskin) but LCC reverses to 包皮肉 (foreskin-flesh), so tags follow LCC word order.
LCC 就是 is an explanatory copula with no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated.
LCC 了 aspect particles and 給 (benefactive marker on 割禮) left unannotated as Chinese grammatical particles with no Hebrew equivalents.

Gen/17.lcc_original: 亞伯拉罕給自己包皮肉上行割禮的時候、是九十九歲。
notes: UNV implicit {<WH01320>} and {<WH06190>} become explicit in LCC: 包皮 = foreskin (H6190), 肉 = flesh (H1320); braces dropped per Rule 3.
LCC reverses Hebrew word order (בְּשַׂר עָרְלָה = flesh→foreskin) to 包皮肉 (foreskin→flesh); SNs assigned to match LCC word positions rather than Hebrew order.
H1121 (בֵּן, the age-idiom relational noun) has no dedicated word in LCC; merged onto 歲 alongside H8141, as 歲 covers the full semantic weight of the 'son of X years' idiom.
給自己 (reflexive clarification) reflects the Niphal morphology encoded in WTH8736; no separate tag assigned — WTH8736 remains attached to the verb phrase 行割禮的時候.
是 (copula) and 上 (localizer) have no Hebrew equivalents and are left unannotated.

Gen/17.lcc_original: 他兒子以實瑪利包皮肉上受了割禮的時候，是十三歲。

The second WH01121 (Hebrew age-construct בֶּן in בֶּן שְׁלֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה = 'son of thirteen years') has no explicit word in LCC's '是十三歲'; retained as {<WH01121>} placed before the numeral.

Gen/17.lcc_sn: 就在<WAH09002><WH06106>這<WAH02088>一天<WH03117>，亞伯拉罕<WH085>和他兒子<WH01121>以實瑪利<WH03458>就都受了割禮<WH04135><WTH8738>。

Gen/17.lcc_original: 他家中所有的男人，無論是家裏生的，是用銀子從外人買的，都和他一同受割禮。

UNV 受了割禮 → LCC 受割禮: LCC omits perfective particle 了; SNs H4135+WTH8738 attach after 割禮

Gen/18.lcc_sn: 永恆主<WH03068>在幔利<WH04471>聖篤耨香樹【1】<WAH09002><WH0436>那裏，向<WAH0413>亞伯拉罕顯現<WH07200><WTH8735>；亞伯拉罕{<WAH01931>}正在帳棚口<WH0168><WH06607>坐着<WH03427><WTH8802>；那時<WH03117>乃是一天最熱<WAH09003><WH02527>的時分；
Gen/18.lcc_original: 永恆主在幔利聖篤耨香樹【1】那裏，向亞伯拉罕顯現；亞伯拉罕正在帳棚口坐着；那時乃是一天最熱的時分；
notes: 永恆主 is LCC's rendering of יהוה (Yahweh); WH03068 applied to the full phrase as the semantic unit

LCC restructures UNV's 那時正熱 into 那時乃是一天最熱的時分; WH03117 (יוֹם, day) attached to 那時, WAH09003+WH02527 (בְּחֹם, in-heat) attached to 最熱 as the semantic core of the phrase

Gen/18.lcc_original: 亞伯拉罕舉目觀看，忽見三個人在他對面站着；亞伯拉罕一看見，就從帳棚口跑去迎接他們，在地上下拜，
notes: LCC uses 忽見 for UNV 見<WAH02009> (הִנֵּה, behold); entire 忽見 tagged as LCC's idiomatic rendering of the exclamation.

在他對面: LCC inserts 他 vs UNV 對面 alone; WAH05921 attaches after 對面 covering the full prepositional phrase.

Gen/18.lcc_original: 說：『我主，我若蒙你賞臉，求你不要離開僕人而走過去。
notes: LCC 蒙你賞臉 condenses UNV 在你眼前蒙恩 (מָצָאתִי חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ): 蒙 receives <WH04672><WTH8804> (מָצָאתִי, found/received); 你賞臉 receives <WAH09002><WH05869><WH02580> covering both בְּעֵינֶיךָ (in your eyes) and חֵן (grace), since 賞臉 (grant-face/show-favor) lexically fuses both concepts
{<WAH04994>} (נָא, particle 'pray/please') retained as implicit — LCC has no explicit word for it, same as UNV
LCC 而走過去 vs UNV 往前去 (עֲבֹר): 而 is a Chinese connective conjunction with no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated; 走過去 receives <WH05674><WTH8799>

Gen/18.lcc_original: 容我叫人拿點兒水來，你們洗洗腳，就在樹底下靠着、歇息歇息。
notes: WH04994 (נָא, particle of entreaty): no explicit LCC word; attached after 容我 as the closest positional anchor, same as UNV placement.
LCC adds 叫人 before 拿 to render the Hophal passive of לָקַח (03947) — 'let it be taken' becomes 'have someone take'; WH03947+WTH8714 attached to 拿 (the verbal root).
LCC uses 點兒 for מְעַט (04592) vs UNV's 點; SN attached to 點兒 as one unit.
LCC uses 底下 for תַּחַת (WAH08478) vs UNV's 下; tag attached to full compound 底下.

Gen/18.lcc_original: 我再拿點餅來，你們喫喫點心，然後往前走；因爲你們旣從僕人這裏經過，我理當招待。』他們說：『就照你所說的作吧。』
notes: LCC 喫喫點心 is a free rendering of UNV 加添心力 (sustain-heart, WH05582+WH03820); mapped WH05582/WTH8798 to 喫喫 (the refreshing action) and WH03820 to 點心 (the object, representing לֵב 'heart'). Mapping is approximate due to LCC's idiomatic paraphrase.
WAH05921+WAH03651 (Hebrew עַל-כֵּן, 'therefore') placed after 理當, which is LCC's rendering of 'for this reason ought'; UNV's 如此 has no direct parallel in LCC.
WAH03588 (כִּי, 'because/for') attached to 旣 matching UNV's 既 — LCC's 因爲 is left unannotated as the semantic conjunction is carried by 旣 in both versions.
עָבַר (WH05674) appears twice: once as 往前走 (imperfect, WTH8799) and once as 經過 (perfect, WTH8804) — both correctly assigned.
WAH03651 (כֵּן) correctly appears twice: once in עַל-כֵּן (therefore) and once in the reply clause 就...照 (likewise/so as you said).

Gen/18.lcc_original: 亞伯拉罕趕快進帳棚去見撒拉說：『快拿三斗【2】細麵和和、作烙餅。』
notes: 趕快 (LCC) ← 急忙 (UNV): both render WH04116<WTH8762>; single LCC word covers the same Hebrew form straightforwardly.
LCC adds 去 before 見: 去 has no Hebrew equivalent (no SN); 見 inherits WAH0413 (the directional preposition אֶל) exactly as in UNV.
斗<WH05429>【2】: footnote marker 【2】 kept in place after the SN tag on 斗 (= seah, H05429 = סְאָה); LCC gloss of the measure unit.
細<WH05560>麵<WH07058>: LCC's two-character 細麵 cleanly parallels UNV's 細<WH05560>麵<WH07058>, so tags are distributed character-by-character rather than stacked.
烙餅<WH05692>: LCC adds 烙 (baked/griddled) as a specifying modifier; the whole phrase maps to WH05692 (עֻגָּה = round/griddle cake), tag placed at phrase end.
快<WH04116><WTH8761>: LCC uses single 快 vs UNV's reduplicated 速速 for the imperative מַהֲרִי; one-to-one mapping is unambiguous.

Gen/18.lcc_original: 亞伯拉罕又跑到牛羣裏，牽了一隻又嫩又好的小牛來，交給僮僕，僮僕就趕快去豫備。
notes: LCC 小牛 replaces UNV 牛犢; both SNs (WH01121 + WH01241) attach to 小牛 as a compound meaning 'young of cattle'
LCC 僮僕 replaces UNV 僕人; WH05288 attaches to first occurrence (object of 交給), second occurrence is subject resumption with no additional SN
LCC 趕快 replaces UNV 急忙; WH04116 + WTH8762 attach to 趕快. Preceding 就 is a Chinese aspectual connector with no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated
LCC splits UNV 預備 into 去豫備: WAH09001 (infinitive prefix לְ) attaches to 去 which expresses the Hebrew infinitive construct; WH06213 + WTH8800 attach to 豫備
LCC omits any explicit object ('it') at end of clause; {<WAH0853>} remains implicit as in UNV

Gen/18.lcc_sn: 亞伯拉罕又拿<WH03947><WTH8799>了奶酪<WH02529>和奶子<WH02461>、以及他所<WAH0834>豫備<WH06213><WTH8804>的小牛肉<WH01121><WH01241>來，擺<WH05414><WTH8799>在他們面前<WAH09001><WH06440>；自己<WAH01931>卻在樹<WH06086>底下<WAH08478>站<WH05975><WTH8802>在旁邊<WAH05921>伺候。他們就喫<WH0398><WTH8799>了。
Gen/18.lcc_original: 亞伯拉罕又拿了奶酪和奶子、以及他所豫備的小牛肉來，擺在他們面前；自己卻在樹底下站在旁邊伺候。他們就喫了。
notes: 取→拿: both render H03947 (לָקַח, take/fetch); direct lexical equivalents

奶→奶子: H02461 (חָלָב, milk); LCC adds 子 suffix for naturalness
WAH0834 (אֲשֶׁר, relative pronoun with waw prefix) attached after 所, the classical Chinese relative marker in 他所豫備的, which is the semantic equivalent of אֲשֶׁר

下→底下: H08478 (תַּחַת, under) attached after 底下 as a unit

Gen/18.lcc_original: 他們問亞伯拉罕說：『你妻子撒拉在哪裏？』他說：『在帳棚裏。』

Gen/18.lcc_original: 那位說：『在婦人懷孕滿期的時候【3】，我一定要回到你這裏來。看吧，你妻子撒拉必生個兒子。』撒拉在後邊帳棚聽着呢。

Footnote marker 【3】 retained in its original position after 時候

Gen/18.lcc_original: 當時亞伯拉罕和撒拉已經老邁，上了年紀；撒拉的女人事兒也停止了。

Gen/18.lcc_original: 撒拉肚子裏暗笑着說：『我已經衰敗，我的丈夫也老邁，哪裏還能有婚媾的樂趣呢？』

Gen/18.lcc_sn: 在<WAH04480>永恆主<WH03068>、還有奇難<WH06381><WTH8735>事<WH01697>麼？到了所定的日期<WAH09001><WH04150>，在<WAH09003>婦人懷孕滿期<WH02416>的時候<WH06256>【3】，我必回到<WH07725><WTH8799>你這裏<WAH0413>來，撒拉<WAH09001><WH08283>必生個兒子<WH01121>。』

Gen/18.lcc_original: 那三位就從那裏起身，向着所多瑪方面眺望；亞伯拉罕也和他們同行，要送送他們。

Gen/18.lcc_original: 永恆主說：『我所在作的事、哪裏可瞞着亞伯拉罕呢？
notes: LCC uses 永恆主 for YHWH (UNV 耶和華); WH03068 attached to 永恆主 as the equivalent divine name phrase
LCC uses 在作 where UNV has 要做 — same semantic content (doing/to do); WH06213+WTH8802 attached to 在作
{<WAH0589>} kept implicit after 的事 — LCC does not add an explicit standalone second-person pronoun here, so braces are preserved
WAH04480 (מִן preposition prefix) co-annotated with WH085 on 亞伯拉罕 — LCC has no explicit preposition word, the 'from' sense is absorbed into the verbal complement 瞞着亞伯拉罕

Gen/18.lcc_sn: 亞伯拉罕<WH085>一定<WAH01961><WTH8800>成爲<WAH01961><WTH8799>又大<WH01419>又強盛<WH06099>之國<WAH09001><WH01471>；地上<WH0776>萬<WAH03605>國<WH01471>都必用他的名<WAH09002>而給自己祝福<WH01288><WTH8738>。

notes: LCC 一定 renders the infinitive absolute הָיוֹ and takes <WAH01961><WTH8800>; 成爲 renders the finite יִהְיֶה and takes <WAH01961><WTH8799>.
LCC 又大又強盛 reverses UNV word order: 大 maps to גָּדוֹל <WH01419>, 強盛 maps to עָצוּם <WH06099>.

之 in 之國 is a structural particle equivalent to UNV 的; SNs attach to 國.

Gen/18.lcc_original: 我和他知交，是要叫他吩咐他的子孫、和他以後的家屬一直走我永恆主的道路，秉公行義，爲要使永恆主指着亞伯拉罕所應許的話都歸給他。』
notes: H3045 (ידע 'know'): UNV 眷顧 → LCC 知交 ('intimate acquaintance'); semantically equivalent, tag attached after 知交
H310 (אַחֲרָיו 'after him'): implicit {<WH0310>} in UNV; LCC renders explicitly as 以後 → braces dropped per rule 3, tag attached after 以後
H3068 (יְהוָה / YHWH): implicit in UNV for both occurrences; LCC renders explicitly as 永恆主 both times → braces dropped for both instances

Gen/18.lcc_sn: 亞伯拉罕<WH085>走近前去<WH05066><WTH8799>，說<WH0559><WTH8799>：『你眞地<WAH0637>要將義人<WH06662>同<WH05973>惡人<WH07563>一齊掃滅<WH05595><WTH8799>麼？

Gen/18.lcc_original: 萬一城中有五十個義人呢，你還眞地要掃滅，也不爲了其中五十個義人的緣故而饒了那地方麼？

LCC does not restate the city word in the second clause — its 其中 covers only the locative בְּקִרְבָּהּ (<WAH09002><WH07130>), and 那地方 covers the place being spared (לַמָּקוֹם = <WAH09001><WH04725>). The bare <WH04725> is thus consolidated into 那地方; no word in LCC's second clause separately expresses the 'city as place' concept.
LCC's 眞地要 is a rhetorical intensifier ('truly/really will') with no UNV or Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated. The verbal SNs <WH05595><WTH8799> attach to the main verb 掃滅.

LCC's 的緣故 completes the 爲了…的緣故 construction ('for the sake of'), but corresponds to no Hebrew word beyond <WH04616> already attached to 爲了; left unannotated. Likewise 而 is a grammatical connector with no Hebrew equivalent.
LCC's sentence-final 呢 is a rhetorical particle with no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated.
Missing SNs: 04725

Gen/18.lcc_original: 將義人同惡人一齊殺死，你這樣作麼！絕對不然！讓義人像惡人一樣麼！絕對不然！審判全地的主、難道不行公義麼？』
notes: LCC restructures the verse: each clause ends with a question tag 麼！, then 絕對不然！ as a standalone exclamation — so חָלִלָה appears AFTER its clause rather than before as in Hebrew/UNV. SNs are placed accordingly.

First {<WH02486>}{<WAH09001>} were both implicit (braces) in UNV. In LCC, 絕對不然 is explicit for WH02486 (Rule 3: braces dropped), and the first WAH09001 (לְּ of לְּךָ) is attached to 你 in the '你這樣作麼' clause.
The second WAH09001 (לָּ of second לָּךְ, tagged on 你 in UNV) is attached to the second 絕對不然 in LCC since no explicit second 你 appears there.
WAH09003+WH01697+WAH02088 (כַּדָּבָר הַזֶּה = such a thing) are implicit/dangling in UNV; attached to 這樣 in LCC where it is explicitly expressed.
WAH01961+WTH8804 (וְהָיָה = and be) is attached to 一樣 in LCC ('be alike'), which corresponds to the verbal predicate in UNV's 一樣看待.
同 in 將義人同惡人 is tagged WAH05973 (עִם = with), corresponding to UNV's 與<WAH05973>.

Gen/18.lcc_original: 永恆主說：『我若在所多瑪城中見有五十個義人，我就要因他們的緣故而饒了那全地方。』
notes: 耶和華→永恆主: LCC's rendering of YHWH; WH03068 applied to 永恆主 as a single compound
城裡→城中: WAH09002+WH08432 (בְּתוֹךְ, in the midst of) attached to 中; 城 retains WH05892 (הָעִיר, city)

就要 is a Chinese volitional/aspectual addition with no direct Hebrew counterpart; left unannotated
