UNV 你們不要 covers subject pronoun (unannotated) + negative particle WAH0408; LCC condenses to 別, which absorbs both — WAH0408 attaches to 別
LCC uses 作 vs UNV 做; semantically identical, H07489+WTH8686 attach to 作壞事

Gen/19.lcc_original: 看哪，我有兩個女兒，是沒有親近過男人的；容我叫她們出來見你們；你們看怎麼好、就怎麼作：只是這兩個人呢，他們是到我舍下來的，你們可不要向他們作甚麼。』
notes: הִנֵּה is explicit in LCC as 看哪 → WAH02009 drops braces; first נָא (WAH04994) stays implicit — LCC has no standalone 'please/now' particle after 看哪
אֲשֶׁר (WAH0834) kept implicit — LCC uses 是…的 focus/relativizer construction rather than an explicit relative pronoun word
אֶתְהֶן (WAH0853, direct-object marker) kept implicit; אֲלֵיכֶם (WAH0413, 'to you') treated as explicit via LCC's 見你們 — braces dropped

כַּטּוֹב בְּעֵינֵיכֶם is restructured in LCC: WAH09002+WH05869 (בְּעֵינֵיכֶם, in-your-eyes) mapped to 看; WAH09003+WH02896 (כַּטּוֹב, as-good) mapped to 好; word order inverted relative to Hebrew but semantic match holds
כִּי-עַל-כֵּן (WAH03588+WAH05921+WAH03651) all kept implicit — LCC omits the causal conjunction entirely and states the arrival clause as plain fact with 是…的 structure

Gen/19.lcc_original: 當下就有人說：『走開走開！』又有人說：『這一個人來寄居，還要作官哪！』『現在我們要害你、比害他們還厲害呢。』衆人就極力向着羅得一個人擠去，逼近前去，要攻破房門。
notes: 走開走開 maps to UNV 退去 (WH05066+WTH8798+WH01973); the repetition is LCC's emphatic rendering of the single Hebrew imperative, all tags attach to the full phrase
LCC 還要<WH08199><WTH8800>作官<WH08199><WTH8799>哪 splits two Hebrew שָׁפַט instances between 要 (infinitive WTH8800) and 作官 (imperfect WTH8799), mirroring UNV's 想要…作官 split
LCC 極力<WH03966> drops braces for {<WH03966>}: LCC explicitly translates מְאֹד with 極力, so implicit marker becomes normal tag
LCC 一個人<WAH09002><WH0376> drops braces for {<WAH09002>}{<WH0376>}: LCC explicitly renders בָּאִישׁ (the man) as 一個人, though LCC reverses the Hebrew order placing 羅得 before 一個人
LCC expands UNV 要<WH05066><WTH8799>攻破 into two verbs: 逼近前去<WH05066><WTH8799> (drawing near) and 要攻破<WAH09001><WH07665><WTH8800> (to break), preserving the semantic distinction
當下 is LCC's added transitional phrase with no SN correspondence; left unannotated

Gen/19.lcc_original: 那兩個人就伸出手來，將羅得拉進屋去，到自己身邊，隨卽把門關上。
notes: UNV 二人 → LCC 兩個人: WH0582 placed after 人, covering the whole NP
LCC 就 (aspect particle) has no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated
{<WAH0853>} before 手 kept with braces: the object marker את has no explicit LCC word
LCC adds 到自己身邊 with no UNV/Hebrew parallel — left unannotated
LCC adds 隨卽 (adverb, 'immediately') with no Hebrew parallel — left unannotated
WAH0413 (אֶל) tagged to 去, same as UNV, preserving directional sense

Gen/19.lcc_original: 他們又擊打了房門口的人，使他們無論大小都眼目昏眩，以致找到累死也找不着房門。
notes: LCC '擊打' directly translates H5221 (smite/strike), whereas UNV attaches H5221 to '使'; the SN is placed on '擊打' in LCC as the more faithful lexical match
LCC '房門口' split as 房<H1004> (house/בַּיִת) + 門口<H6607> (entrance/פֶּתַח) following the Hebrew construct chain; H1004 and H6607 both occur here without a second instance of H1004 at the verse end
LCC inserts '使他們' (causative phrase) as an interpretive addition not corresponding to a distinct Hebrew lexeme; H5575 (סַנְוֵרִים, blindness) is assigned to '眼目昏眩' and H5221 remains on '擊打'

Final clause is a significant paraphrase: Hebrew וַיִּלְאוּ לִמְצֹא הַפָּתַח ('they wearied to find the entrance') becomes '以致找到累死也找不着房門'; H4672 (מָצָא, to find) → first '找', H3811 (לָאָה, to be weary) → '累'; the second '找不着' is LCC's idiomatic doubling with no additional SN assigned
{<WAH0834>} (relative pronoun אֲשֶׁר) and {<WAH0853>} (direct object marker אֵת) kept implicit as LCC has no explicit lexical equivalents for either

Gen/19.lcc_original: 二人對羅得說：『你這裏還有甚麼人沒有？無論是女婿、是兒女，或是這城裏所有屬你的人，你都要從這地方帶出去。
notes: UNV question particle 嗎 carries no SN; LCC substitutes 沒有 for the rhetorical question — left unannotated as it is a grammatical gloss with no Hebrew equivalent.
UNV connector 和 (and) has no SN; LCC rephrases as 或是 (or) — also left unannotated.
UNV's 將他們 (causative object 'them') is absent in LCC; the preposition 從<WH04480> is still present in LCC and tagged correctly.
UNV 城中 → LCC 城裏: same semantic referent (inside the city); prefix <WAH09002> and <WH05892> attached to 城裏.

Gen/19.lcc_original: 我們要毀滅這地方，因爲在永恆主面前那攻擊他們的喧嚷聲很大；永恆主差遣了我們來毀滅它。』
notes: LCC uses 永恆主 for 耶和華<WH03068> throughout — standard LCC rendering of the divine name
LCC inverts clause-2 word order: 在永恆主面前 precedes 那攻擊他們的喧嚷聲 (UNV order is reversed: outcry first, then before-the-LORD); SNs placed on their corresponding LCC words regardless of order
LCC's 喧嚷聲 maps to UNV's 城內罪惡的聲音<WH06818>; SN attaches to head noun 喧嚷聲 only — the elaboration 那攻擊他們的 is LCC's own expansion with no direct Hebrew anchor
差遣了: SNs attach to verb 差遣; 了 is an aspect particle with no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated
LCC ends with pronoun 它 instead of UNV's 這地方 — the final 毀滅 carries the relevant tags; no additional SNs needed on 它

Gen/19.lcc_original: 羅得就出來，告訴那將要娶他女兒的女婿們說：『你們起來，逃出這地；因爲永恆主要毀滅這城。』但他卻被女婿們看爲戲說笑話的。
notes: LCC renders יהוה as 永恆主 instead of UNV's 耶和華; WH03068 attached to 永恆主 accordingly.
LCC uses 逃出 where UNV uses 離開 for יצא (WH03318); SN attached to 逃出 as the semantically equivalent term.
LCC 地 maps to UNV 地方 (WH04725); single-character form but same referent.
WAH01961+WTH8799 (היה, 'was/to be') treated as implicit — LCC restructures the final clause into a passive construction (被…看爲) with no explicit copula.
WAH09002+WH05869 (בְּעֵינֵי, 'in the eyes of') attached together to 看爲, which captures the same idiomatic sense as UNV's 以為…在…眼中.
LCC's 戲說笑話 renders UNV's 戲言 (WH06711+WTH8764); both SNs attached to the phrase.

Gen/19.lcc_original: 天快亮時候，天使催逼羅得說：『起來，帶着你的妻子、和你身邊的兩個女兒出去，免得你在這城的罪罰中被掃滅。』
notes: Opening clause: UNV '{<WH03644>}天明<WH07837><WH05927><WTH8804>了' covers three Hebrew words: כְּמוֹ (when/as, WH03644) + שַׁחַר (dawn, WH07837) + עָלָה (arose, WH05927+WTH8804). LCC rephrases as '天快亮時候' — distributed as 亮<WH07837><WH05927><WTH8804> for the dawn-arose concept and 時候<WH03644> for the temporal 'when' particle. LCC '快' (about to) has no Hebrew counterpart and is left unannotated.
LCC '罪罰' (guilt/punishment) replaces UNV '罪惡' (sin-evil) — both translate עָוֹן (WH05771, avon = iniquity/punishment/guilt); WAH09002+WH05771 attached to 罪罰.
LCC '被掃滅' replaces UNV '同被剿滅' for סָפָה (WH05595+WTH8735 = sweep away/consume). UNV's '同' (together) carried no SN so nothing is lost. WH05595+WTH8735 attached to 掃滅.
{<WAH0853>} (direct object marker אֶת) before 妻子 kept implicit — LCC also has no explicit word for the Hebrew accusative particle.

Gen/19.lcc_original: 羅得還在猶豫耽延，二人因爲永恆主憐惜羅得，就拉着羅得的手、和他妻子的手、跟他兩個女兒的手，把他們領出來，安置在城外。
notes: LCC '猶豫耽延' (hesitating and delaying) renders UNV '遲延不走' — both represent WH04102 (מָהַהּ, to linger/tarry); tags placed after 耽延 as the verbal head.
LCC '永恆主' is LCC's translation of יְהוָה (WH03068); UNV has '耶和華'.
UNV begins with '但' (adversative conjunction) which has no SN; LCC omits it — no tag needed.
LCC makes the indirect object explicit ('羅得的手') where UNV uses pronoun ('他的手'); SN placement follows naturally without restructuring.
LCC '拉着' is written as a unit; WH02388+WTH8686 placed after '着' to cover the whole verbal compound.

Gen/19.lcc_original: 卽領了他們出來，一位就說：『逃命吧！不可回頭看望！在這一片平原上、哪裏都不可站住！只要往山上逃跑！免得你被掃滅。』
notes: WAH01961+WTH8799 kept implicit: LCC's 卽 is an adverb of immediacy, not a direct rendering of וַיְהִי, so braces retained rather than attaching to 卽
WAH0853 kept implicit: LCC has no explicit direct-object marker particle
LCC adds 一位 (one of them/the angel) before 就說 with no Hebrew counterpart; left unannotated
LCC uses 看望 (gaze/look upon) vs UNV 看; WH05027+WTH8686 attached to the full compound 看望 as one phrase
WAH03605 (כֹּל = all/whole) mapped to 一片 in LCC's 這一片平原, which captures the 'whole expanse of plain' sense of כָּל-הַכִּכָּר
LCC adds 哪裏都 for rhetorical emphasis ('nowhere must you stop'); this is a LCC expansion with no direct SN; left unannotated
LCC uses 掃滅 vs UNV 剿滅; both render WH05595 (ספה = be swept away/destroyed); WTH8735 (Niphal imperfect) attached accordingly

Gen/19.lcc_original: 羅得對他們說：『我主阿，別這樣吧！
notes: 吧 in LCC treated as explicit rendering of נָא (H04994/WAH04994), so braces dropped per Rule 3. It functions as an entreaty/softening particle, semantically matching נָא, though it could also be read as a purely stylistic Chinese modal particle.
別 = UNV 不要 (both render H0408 אַל 'not/no'); 這樣 = UNV 如此 (unannotated in UNV, no SN to transfer).
LCC 阿 = UNV 啊, both are vocative particles; left unannotated as no SN is associated with it.
Preserved LCC's 『』 quotation marks and 阿 spelling over UNV's 「」 and 啊.

Gen/19.lcc_original: 你看，你僕人旣在你面前蒙恩，你又向我大施慈愛，救活我的性命；我，我沒有力量往山上逃跑，恐怕這災禍追上了我，我便死去。
notes: WH02009 (הִנֵּה, behold): was implicit {<WH02009>} in UNV; LCC has explicit 你看, so braces dropped and tag attached to 你看.
WH04994 (נָא, emphatic particle): kept implicit {<WH04994>} — LCC has no corresponding word.
UNV's 顯出 (WH06213)…莫大 (WH01431) is reversed in LCC's 大施; WH01431+WTH8686 attaches to 大 and WH06213+WTH8804 to 施; WH0834 remains implicit between them.
UNV's 不 (WH03808) + 能 (WH03201) expressed as 沒有力量 in LCC; WH03808 attached to 沒有, WH03201+WTH8799 to 力量.
LCC's 逃跑 is a single compound for UNV's 逃+去; all three tags WAH09001+WH04422+WTH8736 attach to 逃跑.
LCC's 追上 (overtake/catch up) corresponds to UNV's 臨到 (WH01692 = דָּבַק, cleave/overtake); 了 after 追上 is an aspect particle left unannotated.
WH05869 (עַיִן, eyes): UNV uses 眼前, LCC uses 面前 (presence/face); tag attaches to 面前 as the semantically equivalent location phrase.

Gen/19.lcc_original: 看哪，這城很近，可以逃到，又是個小的；那不是個小的麼？哦，容我逃到那裏，我的性命就可以存活了。』
notes: LCC reorders the Hebrew elements relative to UNV: UNV renders 小+近 (small+near) before 逃到, but LCC follows the Hebrew word order more closely (קְרֹבָה → לָנוּס שָׁמָּה → וְהִיא מִצְעָר = near → flee-there → and-it-small). SNs assigned to match Hebrew semantics rather than UNV surface order.
哦 (LCC) ← 求 (UNV) ← H04994 (נָא, particle of entreaty/please). Both render the same Hebrew particle though with different Chinese words.

H01931 (הִיא) appears twice with different tags: (1) 又是<WAH01931> in the description clause — the vav prefix (ו) is absorbed into 又 and the copula הִיא into 是; (2) 那<WH01931> in the rhetorical question as demonstrative/pronoun.
First 到{<WAH08033>} kept implicit because LCC also lacks an explicit 那裏 in that clause — only 到 as a directional complement, paralleling UNV's implicit treatment of שָׁמָּה.
了 (perfective aspect particle at end of LCC) has no Hebrew equivalent and is left unannotated.
LCC's 可以 (modal 'can') renders the purposive infinitive aspect of לָנוּס; all three SN tags (WAH09001, WH05127, WTH8800) grouped on 逃 as the main verb, matching UNV's grouping convention.

Gen/19.lcc_original: 那一位對他說：『你看，就是對這事、我也給你面子；你所說的這城、我也不覆滅。
notes: <WH02009> (הִנֵּה/behold): LCC '你看' is an explicit rendering, so braces dropped and tag attached directly after 你看.

WH05375+WTH8804 (נָשָׂא) and WH06440 (פָּנִים) form the Hebrew idiom נָשָׂא פָּנִים ('to show favor/grant face'). UNV splits across 應允(verb)+你(face-suffix). LCC '給你面子' covers both: 給 receives WH05375+WTH8804, 面子 receives WH06440.
Word order inversion in the final clause: LCC fronts '你所說的這城' before '我也不覆滅', so SN tags follow LCC word order rather than UNV order.
LCC adds a second '也' in '我也不覆滅' that has no SN in UNV's '我不傾覆'; left unannotated.
LCC '就是對' (emphasis + preposition) has no SN counterpart in UNV; left unannotated.

Gen/19.lcc_original: 快往那裏逃！因爲你還沒到那裏，我不能作甚麼。』因此那城名叫瑣珥。
notes: 速速<WH04116><WTH8761> (UNV) → 快<WH04116><WTH8761> (LCC): both represent מַהֵר (quickly/hurry); morphology WTH8761 (Piel participle) attaches to 快 as its functional equivalent
Word order inversion: UNV '速速地逃到那城' vs LCC '快往那裏逃' — H04116 goes to 快, H08033 goes to 那裏 (mid-phrase), H04422 goes to 逃 (end); tags distributed by semantic target not linear position
到那城<WAH08033> (UNV) → 往那裏<WAH08033> (LCC): שָׁמָּה (there/thither) maps to 那裏; 往 has no separate Hebrew anchor and is left untagged
你還沒有<WAH05704> (UNV) → 你還沒<WAH05704> (LCC): LCC omits 有 but semantically equivalent; H05704 (עַד = until) attached after 沒
做<WAH09001><WH06213><WTH8800> (UNV) → 作<WAH09001><WH06213><WTH8800> (LCC): 做/作 are orthographic variants for 'do'; all three tags preserved on 作
因<WAH05921>此<WAH03651> (UNV, two separate tokens) → 因此<WAH05921><WAH03651> (LCC, lexicalized compound): both SNs appended after the compound

Gen/19.lcc_original: 羅得到了瑣珥，日剛剛出，照在地上。
notes: 剛剛 (just/already) is a Chinese stylistic adverb with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated.
照 ('shining') is LCC's explanatory expansion of the verbal action; no separate SN in UNV — left unannotated.
Both {<WH05921>} and {<WH0776>} were implicit in UNV but LCC has explicit words: braces dropped. WH0776 (אֶרֶץ, earth) → 地; WH05921 (עַל, upon) → 上 in the 在地上 compound prepositional phrase.
Confidence reduced slightly due to LCC's restructuring of the second clause into 照在地上 versus UNV's bare implicit markers.

Gen/19.lcc_original: 當時永恆主從天上、永恆主那裏、下硫磺雨跟火雨、在所多瑪和蛾摩拉上頭；
notes: LCC elaborates 硫磺 and 火 into compound noun phrases 硫磺雨/火雨 ('sulfur rain'/'fire rain'); 雨 is LCC's own addition with no Hebrew equivalent and is left unannotated.

在...上頭 is a single prepositional frame spanning both Sodom and Gomorrah, covering both instances of WAH05921 (עַל); the first WAH05921 attaches to 在 (introduces the preposition), and the second remains implicit {<WAH05921>} after 和 since 上頭 is a shared suffix that cannot be double-tagged.
那裏 receives both WH04480 and WAH0854, corresponding to Hebrew מֵאֵת (from-with), a compound preposition split across two SN tokens in UNV.
LCC's verb order differs from UNV: 下 (descend/rain) precedes the object nouns, but WH04305+WTH8689 attach to 下 as the sole verbal head.

Gen/19.lcc_original: 把這些城、和這一片平原、跟城裏所有的居民、連地上所生的、都覆滅了。
notes: 那些<WH0411>→這些: LCC uses 這些 (these) vs UNV 那些 (those) for the same Hebrew אֵל referent; tag attaches to 這些
全<WAH03605>→這一片: LCC renders כֹּל as 這一片 (this whole piece/expanse) rather than UNV 全; <WAH03605> attaches after 這一片 before 平原
並<WAH0853>→跟: LCC uses 跟 as the coordinating conjunction carrying the second את; same function
生長的<WH06780>→所生的: LCC 所生 vs UNV 生長 for צֶמַח (sprout/growth); same semantic referent
毀滅<WH02015>→覆滅: LCC 覆滅 vs UNV 毀滅 for הָפַךְ (overthrow); both convey the same destruction sense

Gen/19.lcc_original: 羅得的妻子向後一望，就變成了鹽柱。
Gen/19.unv_sn_reference: 羅得的妻子<WH0802>在後邊<WAH04480><WH0310>回頭一看<WH05027><WTH8686>，就變成了<WAH01961><WTH8799>一根鹽<WH04417>柱<WH05333>。
notes: 向後 (LCC) maps to 在後邊 (UNV) — both express 'from behind/after', carrying <WAH04480><WH0310> (H4480 מִן + H310 אַחַר)
一望 (LCC) maps to 回頭一看 (UNV) — both are a single look/glance, carrying <WH05027><WTH8686> (H5027 נָבַט Hiphil)
LCC omits the measure word 一根 (no Hebrew equivalent); 鹽柱 maps cleanly to H04417 (מֶלַח salt) + H05333 (נְצִיב pillar) as in UNV

Gen/19.lcc_original: 亞伯拉罕清早起來，在他前天站在永恆主面前的地方，
notes: LCC '在' (first) maps to UNV '到了' (WH0413/אֶל); both denote movement toward/position at the place — LCC uses a locative framing rather than UNV's directional '到了'
LCC '站在' — the second '在' absorbs implicit WH08033 (שָׁם/there); LCC uses it as a locative postverb rather than a standalone adverb
LCC '永恆主' maps to UNV '耶和華' (WH03068/יְהוָה) — LCC's characteristic rendering of the Tetragrammaton
LCC '前天' (previously/the other day) is an interpretive temporal rendering with no direct Hebrew lexeme; left unannotated

Both implicit markers {<WAH0834>} (אֲשֶׁר, relative pronoun) and {<WAH0853>} (את, object marker) are grouped on '的' before 地方, reflecting LCC's relative-clause-final '的' structure vs. UNV's mid-clause position for {<WAH0834>}

Gen/19.lcc_original: 向所多瑪蛾摩拉、那一片平原全地眺望觀看，哎呀，那地方的煙氣還往上冒，就像燒窰的煙氣一般。
notes: LCC's 那一片 explicitly renders the implicit {<WAH05921>}{<WH06440>} (וְעַל פְּנֵי, 'and upon the face of') from UNV — braces dropped per Rule 3 and tags attached to 那一片.
眺望 maps to UNV's 觀 (WH08259/WTH8686 = שָׁקַף Hiphil, to look down); 觀看 maps to UNV's 看 (WH07200/WTH8799 = רָאָה Qal, to see).
哎呀 explicitly renders UNV's implicit {<WAH02009>} (הִנֵּה, behold) — braces dropped per Rule 3.
Hebrew כְּקִיטֹר הַכִּבְשָׁן word order is smoke→furnace; LCC reverses to 燒窰的煙氣 (furnace→smoke), so SNs are split accordingly: 燒窰<WH03536>的煙氣<WH07008>.
還往上冒 as a phrase covers עָלָה (WH05927/WTH8804); 還 is a Chinese aspect particle with no direct Hebrew equivalent but is part of the translation unit.
就 (intensifier in 就像) has no Hebrew equivalent and is left unannotated; 像 carries WAH09003 (כְּ prefix, like/as).

Gen/19.lcc_original: 當上帝毀滅了那一片平原諸城的時候，上帝記起了亞伯拉罕來；當他覆滅了羅得所住之城的時候，他打發了羅得從覆滅之中出來。
notes: LCC restructures the verse into two parallel 當…的時候 clauses; the second 當 is a structural addition with no direct Hebrew equivalent (no second וַיְהִי) and is left unannotated.
那一片 ('that whole expanse of') is LCC's expansion with no Hebrew SN; left unannotated, with {<WAH0853>} placed before it as usual.
來 after 亞伯拉罕 and all 了 aspect particles are Chinese grammatical particles with no Hebrew equivalents; left unannotated.
LCC uses 上帝 for both occurrences of אֱלֹהִים (WH0430): once as subject of 毀滅 (where UNV has 神), and once as subject of 記起 (where UNV has 他).
The subject 他 of the second temporal clause (覆滅) and the final main clause (打發) are implicit in Hebrew verb inflection; left unannotated.

Gen/19.lcc_original: 羅得因爲怕住在瑣珥，就從瑣珥上去、住在山地，他兩個女兒也跟他一同去；他住在一個洞裏，他和他的兩個女兒在一起。
notes: WAH05973 (עִם, 'with') maps from UNV '同他' to LCC '跟他一同'; attached after '一同' as it most directly expresses the 'together/with' relation

LCC restructures UNV's single clause '就同他兩個女兒從瑣珥上去' into two parts: '就從瑣珥上去' (main action) + '他兩個女兒也跟他一同去' (daughters' participation); WH05927+WTH8799 placed on '上去', WH08147+WH01323+WAH05973 distributed across the daughters clause

LCC's final clause '他和他的兩個女兒在一起' expands Hebrew הוּא וּשְׁתֵּי בְנֹתָיו; WAH01931 attaches to the first '他' (subject of 住), the second '他' is an unannotated Chinese repetition for clarity, and '在一起' has no Hebrew equivalent
'去' at end of '他兩個女兒也跟他一同去' left unannotated — the movement sense is already represented by '上去<WH05927><WTH8799>' in the preceding clause

Gen/19.lcc_original: 大女兒對小女兒說：『我們父親老了；此地又沒有男人可以按着全地上的常規進來找我們。
notes: 此地 (LCC) maps to 地上 (UNV) for WAH09002+WH0776 — different phrasing but same Hebrew ארץ referent
{<WH03605>} is implicit in UNV (no Chinese word for כָּל) but LCC has explicit 全; braces dropped per Rule 3: 全<WH03605>
UNV 世上<WH0776> and LCC 地上<WH0776> both render הָאָרֶץ; second WH0776 placed after LCC's 地上
LCC adds 可以 between 男人 and 按着 — no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated
LCC adds 找 between 進來 and 我們 — no Hebrew equivalent (interpretive gloss), left unannotated; WAH05921 (עָלֵינוּ = to us) attaches to 我們
進來 (LCC) replaces 進到 (UNV) for the same Hebrew בּוֹא (WH0935) — direction word differs but verb is the same

Gen/19.lcc_original: 來，我們叫父親喝酒，然後和他同寢，好從父親存活後裔。』
notes: UNV 從他<WAH04480><WH01> groups both SNs on 他; LCC 從父親 allows splitting: H4480 attaches to 從 (preposition), H1 attaches to 父親 (noun), which is more precise alignment to the Hebrew מֵאָבִינוּ construct chain.
LCC 存活 vs UNV 存留: different Chinese words, same Hebrew root H2421 (live/preserve alive) — mapping is unambiguous.
LCC 然後 vs UNV 這樣: both are discourse connectives with no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated.
LCC 和他 vs UNV 與他: H5973 (with) attaches after the full phrase 和他, treating it as a unit equivalent to UNV 與他.

Gen/19.lcc_original: 於是那一天夜裏、她們叫父親喝酒，大女兒就進去、和她父親同寢；她就寢、她起來，她父親都不知道。
notes: LCC adds '一天' (one day) not present in Hebrew or UNV; no SN assigned to it
WAH0853 (direct object marker אֵת) relocated from floating position after 叫 to prefix-position on 父親, since LCC has no explicit particle for it
UNV temporal clauses '幾時躺下/幾時起來' (when she lay down/arose) are simplified to bare '就寢/起來' in LCC; WAH09002 prefix SNs attached directly to those verbs
LCC adds 她 before 父親 in the final clause for clarity; no SN needed

Gen/19.lcc_original: 第二天、大女兒對小女兒說：『昨夜我跟父親同寢，今天夜裏、我們也要叫他喝酒；你要進去、跟他同寢，我們好從父親存活後裔。』
notes: H01961 (היה, 'it came to pass') retained as implicit {<WAH01961>}{<WTH8799>} — LCC omits this verb just as UNV does.
H02005 (הנה, 'behold') retained as implicit {<WAH02005>} — LCC has no explicit word for it.
UNV 與 → LCC 跟 in both occurrences: both mean 'with'; H0854 and H05973 transferred to 跟 accordingly.
UNV 今夜 (H03915, לַיְלָה) → LCC 今天夜裏: tag attached to the fuller phrase 今天夜裏 as it covers the same Hebrew word.
UNV 再 (H01571, גַּם, 'also/again') → LCC 也: semantically equivalent; tag transferred to 也.
UNV 存留 (H02421, חָיָה) → LCC 存活: same Hebrew root, different Chinese rendering; tag transferred.
UNV 你可以 / 你要: auxiliaries 可以 and 要 carry no Hebrew SN — left unannotated in both.

Gen/19.lcc_original: 那一天夜裏、她們也叫父親喝酒；小女兒就起來，和她父親同寢；她就寢、她起來，她父親都不知道。
notes: LCC '一天' (one day/that very night) has no Hebrew equivalent — it is LCC's idiomatic intensifier; H1931 placed on 那 (הַהוּא = that), H3915+H9002 placed on 夜裏 which carries the semantic content of בַּלַּיְלָה
LCC '她就寢、她起來' renders UNV '她幾時躺下...幾時起來' — both translate the Hebrew infinitive constructs בְּשִׁכְבָהּ וּבְקוּמָהּ; WAH09002+WH07901+WTH8800 and WAH09002+WH06965+WTH8800 placed accordingly
'和她<WH05973>' covers עִמּוֹ (with him); Hebrew encodes the pronoun as a suffix on עִם, Chinese '她' makes it explicit — H5973 attaches to 和她 following UNV pattern '與她<WH05973>'
WAH0853 (direct object marker אֵת) placed after 叫 following UNV convention; the actual drinking verb H8248+WTH8686 remains on 喝 in both versions

Gen/19.lcc_sn: 這樣，羅得<WH03876>的兩<WH08147>個女兒<WH01323>都從她們父親<WAH04480><WH01>而懷了孕<WH02029><WTH8799>。
Gen/19.lcc_original: 這樣，羅得的兩個女兒都從她們父親而懷了孕。
Gen/19.unv_sn_reference: 這樣，羅得<WH03876>的兩<WH08147>個女兒<WH01323>都從她父親<WAH04480><WH01>懷了孕<WH02029><WTH8799>。
notes: LCC uses 她們 (plural pronoun) vs UNV 她 (singular) before 父親 — pronoun carries no SN, so no impact on tag placement.
LCC adds connective 而 before 懷了孕 with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated.
<WAH04480><WH01> both attach after 父親 as in UNV, representing the prefixed מֵאֲבִיהֶן (from-their-father).

Gen/19.lcc_original: 大女兒生個兒子，給他起名叫摩押，就是今日摩押人的始祖。
notes: LCC 生個 vs UNV 生了: SN tags placed after 生 (the verb); 個 is a measure word and left unannotated.
LCC 今日 corresponds to UNV 現今; both compound tags <WAH05704><WH03117> collapse onto 今日.

Gen/19.lcc_original: 小女兒也生個兒子，她給他起名叫便亞米，就是今日亞捫人的始祖。
notes: UNV's {<WAH01931>} (implicit pronoun 'she') is explicit in LCC as 她, repositioned as subject of second clause ('她給他起名…'); braces dropped per Rule 3 → 她<WAH01931>.
LCC's 今日 maps to UNV's 現今 for the compound WAH05704+WH03117 (עַד־הַיּוֹם).
LCC's measure word 個 (before 兒子) has no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated.
UNV's 便‧亞米 (middle dot) written as 便亞米 in LCC; <WH01151> attached to LCC's form.

Gen/20.lcc_original: 亞伯拉罕從那裏向南地往前行，就住在加低斯和書珥之間，寄居在基拉耳。
notes: UNV collapses H03427 (וַיֵּשֶׁב, dwell) and H01481 (וַיָּגָר, sojourn) onto a single 寄居; LCC splits them — 住 carries H03427 and 寄居 carries H01481 — matching the Hebrew's two distinct clauses more faithfully.
LCC reorders the clauses relative to UNV: 'dwelt between Kadesh and Shur' precedes 'sojourned in Gerar', which mirrors the Hebrew word order (UNV had merged both destinations into one phrase).
WAH09002 (the ב prefix of בִּגְרָר = 'in Gerar') is assigned to LCC's prepositional 在 before 基拉耳, since LCC uses 在 where UNV used 的 to represent that prefix.
就 (Chinese aspectual/cohesive particle before 住) is left unannotated — it has no Hebrew lexeme equivalent.
向南<WH05045>地<WH0776> confirmed by Hebrew אַרְצָה הַנֶּגֶב: אַרְצָה (H0776, 'toward the land') + הַנֶּגֶב (H05045, 'the Negev').

Gen/20.lcc_sn: 提到他的妻子<WH0802>撒拉<WH08283>、亞伯拉罕<WH085>就說<WH0559><WTH8799>{<WH0413>}：『她<WAH01931>是我的妹妹<WH0269>』；於是基拉耳<WH01642>王<WH04428>亞比米勒<WH040>打發<WH07971><WTH8799>人將<WAH0853>撒拉<WH08283>取<WH03947><WTH8799>了去。
Gen/20.lcc_original: 提到他的妻子撒拉、亞伯拉罕就說：『她是我的妹妹』；於是基拉耳王亞比米勒打發人將撒拉取了去。
notes: LCC significantly restructures the first clause into a topic-comment pattern ('提到他的妻子撒拉、亞伯拉罕就說') vs UNV's SVO ('亞伯拉罕稱…'). <WH0559><WTH8799> is paired with 就說 (the main saying verb); 提到 is left unannotated as a narrative connector with no direct Hebrew equivalent.
{<WH0413>} (אֶל, 'to/concerning') remains implicit — LCC's topic-comment structure absorbs the prepositional sense without an explicit particle.
<WAH01931> (הִוא, 'she') is assigned to LCC's explicit 她, which is a cleaner match than UNV's copula-serving 為.
LCC 打發 ('dispatched') corresponds to UNV 差 ('sent'), both tagged <WH07971><WTH8799>.
LCC 將 (object marker before 撒拉) parallels UNV 把, both tagged <WAH0853> for the Hebrew direct object marker אֵת.

Gen/20.lcc_original: 但是夜間上帝來找亞比米勒於夢中，對他說：『看吧，你該死啦，因爲你所取的那女人、是有夫之婦的。』
notes: 神→上帝: UNV uses 神 (WH0430), LCC uses 上帝; both render Hebrew אֱלֹהִים — same SN applies.
{<WH02009>} → 看吧<WH02009>: LCC explicitly translates הִנֵּה (behold) as 看吧, so braces dropped per Rule 3.
亞比米勒→他: LCC uses the pronoun 他 rather than repeating the name; WH040 still attaches to 他 as the referent.
來找: 找 is an LCC expansive gloss ('came to find'); only 來 carries WH0935+WTH8799; 找 left unannotated.
{<WAH0834>} → 所<WAH0834>: LCC makes the relative pronoun אֲשֶׁר explicit via 所 (forming 你所取的); braces dropped per Rule 3.
她<WH01931> remains implicit {<WH01931>}: LCC restructures '那女人、是有夫之婦的' without a separate pronoun, so the Hebrew הִוא has no explicit LCC host at this point.
別人的妻子 → 有夫之婦: UNV uses 別人 (WH01167, noun בַּעַל=husband/owner) + 妻子 (WH01166+WTH8803, Qal passive participle בְּעֻלַת). LCC's 有夫之婦 maps neatly: 夫←WH01167, 婦←WH01166+WTH8803.
你是個死人 → 你該死: LCC idiom 該死 (deserve to die) renders Hebrew מֵת; WH04191+WTH8801 attach to 該死, leaving 啦 (aspect particle) unannotated.

Gen/20.lcc_original: 亞比米勒卻還沒有親近撒拉；他說：『主阿，連正義的人你也要殺滅麼？
notes: H6662 (צַדִּיק righteous): UNV 有義 → LCC 正義; different renderings of same concept, tag attached to 正義
H1471 (גּוֹי nation/people): UNV 國 → LCC 人; LCC individualizes the collective noun, tag attached to 人
H2026 (הָרַג kill/slay): UNV 毀滅 → LCC 殺滅; tag and morphology code <WTH8804> attached to 殺滅
H1571 (גַּם also/even): tagged on 也要 following UNV convention; 連 at clause start also carries this semantic but is left unannotated
{<WH0413>} retained as implicit after 撒拉 — preposition אֶל is grammatically absorbed in Chinese structure for both UNV and LCC

Gen/20.lcc_original: 那人豈不是親自對我說：「她是我的妹妹」麼？就是那女人、也親自說：「他是我哥哥」呀：我作這事、是心端正手無辜的。』
notes: UNV 自己 → LCC 親自 for הוּא/הִוא used reflexively; <WH01931> attached to 親自 in both occurrences
UNV 女人 → LCC 那女人 for הִיא (she); <WH01931> attached after full phrase 那女人
UNV 正 (תָם = integrity) → LCC 端正; <WAH09002><WH08537> attached after 端正
UNV 潔 (נִקְיֹן = cleanness/innocency) → LCC 無辜; <WAH09002><WH05356> attached after 無辜
UNV 妹子 → LCC 妹妹 (same referent, different character choice); <WH0269> attached after 妹妹
UNV 做 → LCC 作 (variant characters, same verb); <WH06213><WTH8804> attached after 作

Gen/20.lcc_original: 上帝對亞比米勒夢中說：『我也知道你作這事乃心裏端正，因此我也攔阻你犯罪得罪了我，所以我不容你和她有接觸。
notes: UNV {<WH01571>} (גַּם, 'also/even') is implicit in UNV but LCC has explicit 也 → dropped braces, attached as 也<WH01571> (Rule 3 applied)
UNV 他 (him) → LCC 亞比米勒 (Abimelech named explicitly); H0413 (אֶל preposition) attached after 亞比米勒 as the full prepositional phrase
LCC reorders the opening: UNV 在夢中對他 → LCC 對亞比米勒夢中; SNs distributed to semantically matching words in LCC word order
{<WAH03588>} (ו+כִּי, conjunction introducing subordinate clause) kept implicit — LCC's 乃 functions as a copula restructuring the clause rather than as a direct equivalent of כִּי
LCC 犯罪得罪 is a compound covering H02398 (חָטָא, sin); WAH04480 (מִן 'from', producing infinitive construct 'from sinning') absorbed into the compound verb phrase
UNV 沾著她 → LCC 和她有接觸: split as 她<WH0413> (אֶל 'unto/to' + suffix) and 接觸<WAH09001><WH05060><WTH8800> (ל+נָגַע 'to touch', infinitive construct)

Gen/20.lcc_original: 如今你要把這人的妻子還給他，因爲他是個神人，他會爲你禱告，使你活着。如果你不還給他，你可要知道、你必定死，你和你所有的一切人都必定死。』
notes: LCC renders נָבִיא (H5030, 'prophet') as 神人 rather than UNV's 先知 — atypical since 神人 usually translates אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים ('man of God'); WH05030 mapped to 神人 as the only candidate in this position

Hebrew infinitive-absolute clause מוֹת תָּמוּת אַתָּה וְכָל-אֲשֶׁר-לָךְ (one clause) is split by LCC into two sentences: '你必定死，你和你所有的一切人都必定死'; WH04191×WTH8800 mapped to 必定 and WH04191×WTH8799 to 死 in the first clause; second 都必定死 is LCC's rhetorical expansion and left unannotated
{<WH03588>} kept implicit after 、 — LCC has no explicit subordinating conjunction introducing the object clause of 知道, matching the UNV implicit-brace convention

Gen/20.lcc_original: 亞比米勒清早起來，把他的衆臣僕召來，將這一切事說給他們聽；那些人都很懼怕。
notes: 把他的: '把' is a Chinese grammatical object-fronting marker with no Hebrew equivalent; '他的' encodes the possessive suffix of עֲבָדָיו (his servants) which is implicit in the Hebrew noun — both left unannotated.
LCC restructures UNV's SVO clause 召了…臣僕來 into a 把-construction (把…臣僕召來); WH07121+WTH8799 placed on 召來 to follow LCC's word order.
LCC '這一切' (all these) fuses UNV's separate 這些<WH0428> and 都<WH03605> into one phrase; both SNs attached to 這一切 together.
LCC '那些人' (those men) corresponds to UNV '他們' for WH0582 (אֲנָשִׁים = men/people); LCC makes the subject explicit where UNV uses a pronoun.

Gen/20.lcc_original: 亞比米勒把亞伯拉罕召來，對他說：『你怎麼向我們這樣行呢？我得罪了你甚麼，你竟使我和我國內的人都陷於大罪呢？你向我行了不該行的事了。』
notes: LCC '向我們' (plural) vs UNV '向我' (singular) — WAH09001 transferred to 我們; LCC may reflect a different textual reading of the pronoun
LCC '我得罪了你甚麼' reverses UNV word order '我在甚麼事上得罪了你' — WH04100 placed after 甚麼 at clause-end; WH02398+WTH8804 on 得罪, WAH09001 on 你
LCC '把' (disposal marker introducing object) and '都' (emphasis adverb) have no Hebrew equivalents — left unannotated
{<WAH0834>} kept as implicit — LCC also has no explicit word for the Hebrew relative particle אֲשֶׁר at the clause boundary
LCC '不該行' vs UNV '不當行' — semantically equivalent; H03808 on 不, H06213+WTH8735 on 該行

Gen/20.lcc_original: 亞比米勒對亞伯拉罕說：『你何所見而作這事呢？』
notes: UNV 又對<WAH0413> — LCC drops 又 (adverb not rendered); WAH0413 attaches to 對 alone.
LCC 何所見 rearranges UNV 見...甚麼: classical 何所見 maps 何←甚麼(WH04100) and 所見←見(WH07200+WTH8804).
UNV 才<WAH03588> (כִּי conjunction) → LCC 而 (same connective function); tag attached to 而.
LCC 作 = UNV 做 (WH06213+WTH8804), straightforward synonym swap.
{<WAH0853>} kept implicit — LCC has no explicit direct-object-marker word between 作 and 這.

Gen/20.lcc_original: 亞伯拉罕說：『我心裏說，這地方總沒有畏懼上帝的心，總會爲了我妻子的緣故來殺我。
notes: LCC '我心裏說' expands UNV '我以為' — both render H559 (אָמַר); SN attaches to 說, with 心裏 unannotated as LCC's amplification of the verb
{<WH03588>} kept implicit: LCC's paraphrase '我心裏說' absorbs the כִּי clause-introducer without an explicit word for it
LCC adds '的心' after 上帝 (no Hebrew equivalent for this noun in this clause) — left unannotated
LCC's second 總會爲了 is a stylistic parallel construction; the second 總 has no Hebrew counterpart (only one רַק/WH07535 in the source)
LCC adds 來 before 殺我 as a directional/aspectual particle with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated
爲了 left unannotated; WH05921+WH01697 (עַל דְּבַר = for the sake of) both attach to 緣故, following UNV convention of grouping both onto the head noun of the prepositional phrase

Gen/20.lcc_original: 況且她也實在是我妹妹：她和我是同父異母；後來、就做了我的妻子。
notes: UNV 妹子 → LCC 妹妹: both render H269 (אָחוֹת, sister); tag placed after 妹妹
UNV 與我 → LCC 和我: conjunction variant, no SN of its own; H1931 (היא) placed after 她

Implicit markers {<WH01323>}{<WH0389>}{<WH03808>} (daughter/but/not) and trailing {<WH01323>} retained as implicit — LCC 同父異母 likewise has no explicit Chinese words for these Hebrew structural elements
LCC adds aspectual 就 before 做了; left unannotated as it has no Hebrew counterpart
WAH09001 prefix tags preserved in same positions relative to 我的 and 妻子 as in UNV

Gen/20.lcc_original: 當上帝叫我離開我父家、飄流在外的時候，我對她說：「我們無論走到甚麼地方，提到我、你總要說，『他是我的哥哥』：這就是你待我的恩情了。」』
notes: 神→上帝: LCC uses 上帝 for אֱלֹהִים (WH0430) where UNV uses 神; tag follows the word.
LCC adds possessive 我 before 父 (rendering the suffix in אָבִי explicitly); WH01 (אָב, father) attached to 父 specifically: 我父<WH01>.
UNV's {<WAH09001>} (לִי, 'of me', implicit) is rendered explicitly as 我 in LCC's phrase 提到我; per rule 3, braces dropped and tag attached: 提到我<WAH09001>.
LCC restructures UNV's '你可以對人說{<WAH09001>}' into '提到我、你總要說': WH0559+WTH8798 (אִמְרִי, imperative 'say!') assigned to 說.
恩典→恩情: LCC uses 恩情 for חֶסֶד (WH02617) instead of UNV's 恩典; tag follows LCC's word.

Gen/20.lcc_original: 亞比米勒取了羊羣、牛羣、奴僕、婢女、給亞伯拉罕，又將亞伯拉罕的妻子還給他。
notes: LCC reverses UNV's livestock order (牛/羊 → 羊羣/牛羣); SNs assigned by semantic meaning: 羊羣=WH06629, 牛羣=WH01241
撒拉 (Sarah, WH08283) is absent in LCC → kept implicit as {<WH08283>} immediately after 妻子<WH0802>
UNV splits the giving action across 把<WH03947><WTH8799> (took) and 賜給<WH05414><WTH8799> (gave); LCC maps these cleanly to 取了 and 給 respectively
又將 carries WAH0853 (waw-conjunction ו + direct object marker את)

Gen/20.lcc_original: 亞比米勒又說：『看哪，我的地都在你面前；你看哪裏好，就住在哪裏。』
notes: UNV bundles WH05869 (eyes/עַיִן) and WH02896 (good/טוֹב) with their two WAH09002 prefixes onto the single phrase 隨意; LCC splits these concepts into 看 (look/see → eyes) and 好 (good), so each prefix+root pair is distributed to its matching LCC word: 看<WAH09002><WH05869> and 好<WAH09002><WH02896>.
LCC adds 哪裏…在哪裏 (where…there) to form a relative clause; these have no direct Hebrew equivalent and are left unannotated.
LCC's 就 (connective aspect particle) is a Chinese addition with no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated.

Gen/20.lcc_original: 對撒拉他也說：『看哪，我把一千錠銀子給你哥哥，做你在全家人面前「遮羞眼」的錢，你就在衆人面前沒有不是了。』

LCC combines כְּסוּת עֵינַיִם (covering + eyes) into the single coined phrase 「遮羞眼」: 遮<WH03682> receives the 'covering' SN, 眼<WH05869> receives the 'eye' SN; the bridging character 羞 has no direct Hebrew referent and is left unannotated.
LCC adds 錠 (measure word for silver ingots) and 的錢 ('the money for') with no Hebrew equivalents — both left unannotated.
LCC restructures the giving clause with a 把-construction (把一千錠銀子給你哥哥) vs. UNV's direct-object order; SNs follow their semantic referents regardless of word order.
他也 (he also) has no direct Hebrew words — הוּא (WAH01931) is mapped to 做, which carries the predicate meaning in LCC's clause.

Gen/20.lcc_sn: 亞伯拉罕<WH085>禱告<WH06419><WTH8691>{<WAH0413>}上帝<WH0430>，上帝<WH0430>就將<WAH0853>亞比米勒<WH040>和<WAH0853>他妻子<WH0802>、以及他的衆婢妾<WH0519>都醫好<WH07495><WTH8799>，她們便能生育<WH03205><WTH8799>了。

Final 了 in LCC (aspect particle after 生育) left unannotated per Rule 5; it has no Hebrew morpheme correspondence

Gen/20.lcc_sn: 因爲<WAH03588>爲了<WAH05921>亞伯拉罕<WH085>妻子<WH0802>{<WAH0834>}{<WH08283>}的緣故<WH01697>、永恆主<WH03068>曾經把亞比米勒<WH040>家<WAH09001><WH01004>中所有<WAH03605>的婦女都閉起<WH06113><WTH8804>子宮<WH07358>來、使她們不能生育<WH06113><WTH8800>。

notes: Sarah (WH08283) is not named in LCC ('亞伯拉罕妻子' vs UNV '亞伯拉罕的妻子撒拉'); kept implicit as {<WH08283>} positioned after 妻子 alongside the already-implicit relative particle {<WAH0834>}.
{<WAH03605>} (כֹּל, 'all') was implicit in UNV but LCC renders it explicitly as 所有; braces dropped per Rule 3.
WH07358 (רֶחֶם, 'womb') attaches to LCC's literal 子宮, not to 婦女 — LCC adds 婦女 for clarifying context but it has no direct Hebrew lexeme.

The cognate accusative (inf. abs. עָצֹר + finite עָצַר, both H6113): LCC splits the action into two clauses; finite WTH8804 goes on 閉起 (the closing action), inf. abs. WTH8800 goes on 生育 (the birthing concept), paralleling UNV's split across 不能/生育.
LCC front-loads the purpose clause ('爲了亞伯拉罕妻子的緣故') before the subject ('永恆主'), reversing UNV's order; SN tags follow LCC word order throughout.

Gen/21.lcc_original: 永恆主按先前所說的眷顧了撒拉；永恆主照所應許過的給撒拉作成。
notes: LCC uses 永恆主 for 耶和華 (YHWH); <WH03068> applied to both occurrences
כַּאֲשֶׁר (09003+0834) maps to 按 in the first clause and 照 in the second, as both function as the 'as/according as' conjunction
LCC '先前所說的' renders UNV '先前的話' for אמר (0559); SN attached to verb 說, with 所...的 as the relative nominalizer left structurally intact
LCC '應許過' (promised) is a semantic paraphrase of דבר (1696, 'spoke'); SN still attached to this verb as the closest lexical correspondent
{<WAH0853>} retained implicit — LCC has no explicit accusative particle, so the marker sits before 撒拉 as in UNV
了 is a Chinese aspectual particle with no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated per Rule 5

Gen/21.lcc_sn: 當亞伯拉罕年老<WAH09001><WH02208>的時候、撒拉<WH08283>懷了孕<WH02029><WTH8799>；到上帝<WH0430>所<WAH0834>對他說到<WH01696><WTH8765>{<WAH0853>}的時節<WAH09001><WH04150>就給亞伯拉罕<WAH09001><WH085>生<WH03205><WTH8799>了一個兒子<WH01121>。
Gen/21.lcc_original: 當亞伯拉罕年老的時候、撒拉懷了孕；到上帝所對他說到的時節就給亞伯拉罕生了一個兒子。
notes: UNV 神<WH0430> → LCC 上帝<WH0430>: systematic theological substitution, same Hebrew אֱלֹהִים
UNV 日期<WAH09001><WH04150> → LCC 時節<WAH09001><WH04150>: both render מוֹעֵד (appointed time/season), lexically compatible
LCC adds 對他 (to him) within the relative clause 所對他說到; no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated
UNV 說<WH01696><WTH8765> → LCC 說到: tags attached after the compound verb 說到, as 到 is a directional complement with no separate SN
{<WAH0853>} (accusative marker אֵת) kept implicit: LCC has no explicit word for it, placed after the verb phrase and before 的時節 to preserve original slot

Gen/21.lcc_original: 亞伯拉罕給撒拉爲他所生的兒子起名叫以撒。
notes: 爲他 in LCC (between 撒拉 and 所) is an explanatory addition with no Hebrew counterpart — left unannotated
{<WAH09001>} after 的 remains implicit since LCC has no additional explicit word for the vav-prefix here
The three trailing implicit markers {<WH03205>}{<WTH8737>}{<WAH09001>} remain implicit — LCC does not repeat an explicit birth verb for them

Gen/21.lcc_sn: 亞伯拉罕的兒子<WH01121>以撒<WH03327>生下來八<WH08083>天<WH03117><WH01121>、亞伯拉罕<WH085>就給<WAH0853>他行了割禮<WH04135><WTH8799>，照<WAH09003>上帝<WH0430>所<WAH0834>吩咐<WH06680><WTH8765>他<WAH0853>的。
Gen/21.lcc_original: 亞伯拉罕的兒子以撒生下來八天、亞伯拉罕就給他行了割禮，照上帝所吩咐他的。
notes: UNV {<WH01121>} (his son / בְּנוֹ, implicit) → LCC has explicit 兒子; braces dropped per rule 3 — 兒子<WH01121>.

WH01121 appears twice in UNV: once for בְּנוֹ (his son) and once for בֶּן in the idiom בֶּן-שְׁמֹנַת יָמִים (eight days old). LCC makes the first explicit (兒子) but has no explicit word for the second, so the idiom WH01121 is attached bare after 天, mirroring UNV's own bare placement after 日.

LCC repeats 亞伯拉罕 twice: the first occurrence expands the possessive suffix in אַבְרָהָם ... בְּנוֹ → 亞伯拉罕的兒子 (no Hebrew word for this second Abraham); WH085 is assigned only to the second 亞伯拉罕, the subject of circumcision.
LCC uses 上帝 where UNV uses 神 (both = אֱלֹהִים / WH0430); SN assigned to 上帝.
UNV 的{<WAH0853>} (implicit 'him', object of commanded) → LCC has explicit 他 in 吩咐他的; braces dropped, tag placed after 他.

WAH0853 (direct object marker אֶת before Isaac) placed after 給 in LCC, consistent with UNV's convention of attaching it to the governing particle rather than the object pronoun. WH03327 and the second WH01121 are already anchored to 以撒 and 兒子 earlier in the sentence, so 他 in 給他 carries only WAH0853.

Gen/21.lcc_original: 他兒子以撒生的時候，亞伯拉罕正一百歲。
notes: LCC omits UNV's 年 between 亞伯拉罕 and 一百, but all SNs (H03967, H08141, H01121) are still fully accounted for via 一百歲.
LCC adds 正 (exactly/just) with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated.
H01121 (בן) appears twice: once for 兒子 (Isaac as Abraham's son) and once in the age idiom בֶּן־מְאַת שָׁנָה (100 years old), both attachments preserved.
WAH0853 (את) and WAH09001 (לְ) remain implicit in LCC as in UNV — no explicit Chinese words to attach them to.

Gen/21.lcc_original: 撒拉說：『上帝使我喜笑；凡聽見的也必爲了我而喜笑。』
notes: UNV 神<WH0430> → LCC 上帝<WH0430>: standard UNV/LCC Elohim difference; SN identical
Second clause restructured: UNV '必與我<WAH09001>一同喜笑' → LCC '也必爲了我<WAH09001>而喜笑' — 我 is the clear pronoun anchor for <WAH09001> in both
LCC 也、爲了、而 are Chinese connective/preposition particles with no direct Hebrew equivalents; left unannotated

Gen/21.lcc_original: 又說：『誰能對亞伯拉罕說，撒拉要乳養兒女呢？在他年老時候、我竟給他生了一個兒子！』
Gen/21.unv_sn_reference: 又說<WH0559><WTH8799>：「誰<WAH04310>能預先對亞伯拉罕<WAH09001><WH085>說<WH04448><WTH8765>『撒拉<WH08283>要乳養<WH03243><WTH8689>嬰孩<WH01121>』呢？因為<WAH03588>在他年老<WAH09001><WH02208>的時候，我給他生<WH03205><WTH8804>了一個兒子<WH01121>。」
notes: LCC has 兒女 where UNV has 嬰孩; both map to WH01121 (בֵּן = son/child) — alignment is semantically sound
UNV's 因為 (WAH03588/כִּי) has no explicit LCC equivalent; LCC uses a pause mark 、 instead, so inserted as {<WAH03588>} implicit marker before 在他
LCC omits UNV's 預先 (beforehand) — no SN was attached to 預先 in UNV, so no alignment issue
LCC's 竟 (unexpectedly/actually) is a Chinese expressive particle with no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated per rule 5

Gen/21.lcc_original: 孩子漸漸長大，就斷了奶；以撒斷奶的日子，亞伯拉罕設擺了盛大的筵席。
notes: LCC 漸漸長大 expands UNV 漸長; WH01431+WTH8799 attached to the full phrase end
LCC 盛大 replaces UNV 豐盛 for WH01419 (both convey 'great/magnificent' — straightforward synonym)
LCC adds aspect particle 了 after 設擺; left unannotated as a Chinese grammatical particle with no Hebrew equivalent (Rule 5)
{<WAH0853>} retained as implicit marker — the direct object marker אֵת has no explicit LCC correspondent; placed before 以撒 as in UNV

Gen/21.lcc_original: 撒拉看見埃及人夏甲給亞伯拉罕所生的兒子在嬉戲，
notes: UNV opens with 當時 (temporal phrase) which LCC omits; 當時 carries no SN in UNV so no annotation is lost.
LCC adds 在 before 嬉戲 as an aspectual/locative particle with no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated.

{<WAH0853>} (Hebrew direct-object marker את) has no explicit Chinese equivalent in LCC either; kept as implicit and placed after 看見's morphology tag, matching its UNV position relative to the following noun phrase.

Gen/21.lcc_sn: 就對亞伯拉罕<WAH09001><WH085>說<WH0559><WTH8799>：『把這<WAH02063>使女<WH0519>和<WAH0853>她兒子<WH01121>趕出去<WH01644><WTH8761>吧；因爲<WAH03588>這<WAH02063>使女<WH0519>的兒子<WH01121>萬不能<WAH03808>和<WAH05973>我兒子<WH01121>以撒<WH03327>一同<WAH05973>繼承<WH03423><WTH8799>產業。

UNV 不可<WAH03808> → LCC 萬不能<WAH03808>: semantically equivalent (both negate the verb), WAH03808 (לֹא) attached to 萬不能 as a unit.

Gen/21.lcc_original: 因了兒子的緣故，亞伯拉罕很不高興。
notes: LCC uses topic-comment word order (因了兒子的緣故 fronted) vs UNV's subject-first order; SNs follow their LCC host words accordingly

{WAH09002}{WH05869} (בְּעֵינֵי, 'in the eyes of') remain implicit braces — LCC omits this phrase just as UNV does, so no explicit host word exists
不高興 (displeased/unhappy) is LCC's rendering of H7489 רָעַע (to be evil/grievous); WTH8799 (Qal imperfect) attaches to it as the governing verb

Gen/21.lcc_original: 上帝對亞伯拉罕說：『你不要因這兒童和你使女的緣故而不高興；凡撒拉對你說的，你都要聽她的話；因爲本着以撒而生下來的、纔要叫做你的後裔。
notes: 神→上帝: standard UNV/LCC difference for Elohim (WH0430), straightforward substitution.

{<WAH09002>}{<WH06963>} (בְּקֹלָהּ, her voice): LCC explicitly renders this as 她的話, so braces dropped per rule 3 and tags attached to 她的話.

而生下來的 has no direct Hebrew equivalent in this verse (Hebrew: כִּי בְיִצְחָק יִקָּרֵא לְךָ זָרַע has no birth verb); left untagged as LCC gloss.

Gen/21.lcc_original: 至於使女的兒子，我也要使他成立一個國，因爲他是你的後裔。』
Gen/21.unv_sn_reference: 至於{<WAH0853>}使女<WH0519>的兒子<WH01121>，我也必<WAH01571>使<WH07760><WTH8799>他的後裔<WH02233>成立一國<WAH09001><WH01471>，因為<WAH03588>他是<WAH01931>你所生的。」

{<WAH0853>} kept implicit — LCC has no explicit direct-object marker word, same as UNV
WAH01571 (גַּם, also) attaches to 也要 in LCC, parallel to 也必 in UNV
WAH09001+WH01471 (לְגוֹי, into a nation) attach to 一個國, the LCC expansion of UNV's 一國

Gen/21.lcc_original: 亞伯拉罕清早起來，拿餅和一皮袋水、給了夏甲，搭在她肩膀上，把孩子也給打發走。夏甲就走了；她在別是巴野地走迷了路。
notes: LCC 肩膀 (shoulder) replaces UNV 肩 — WH07926 attached to 肩膀 as the semantically equivalent phrase
LCC 野地 (wilderness/field) replaces UNV 曠野 — WAH09002+WH04057 attached to 野地

{<WAH0413>} kept implicit: LCC 了 is a Chinese aspect particle with no Hebrew equivalent, so no explicit word hosts the preposition H0413

Gen/21.lcc_original: 皮袋裏的水用完了，夏甲就把孩子丟在小樹底下。
notes: WH04480 (מִן, 'from') is implicit in UNV but LCC has explicit 裏 (locative 'inside') covering the same prepositional relation — dropped braces per Rule 3 and attached to 裏, though the semantic nuance shifts slightly from ablative to locative
WAH0853 (אֵת, direct object marker) attached to 把, which is the standard Chinese explicit DO marker — straightforward structural parallel
WH0259 (אֶחָד, 'one') kept in braces since LCC also has no explicit numeral before 小樹

Gen/21.lcc_original: 自己走開、約有一箭之遠，相對而坐，說：『我不忍見孩子死』；她相對而坐，孩子放聲大哭。
notes: LCC makes Hagar's subject explicit with 她 before the second 相對而坐 — no SN needed for this pronoun as it is LCC's interpretive addition, not a distinct Hebrew word.

LCC attributes the weeping to 孩子 (the child) rather than leaving the subject implicit as in UNV/Hebrew. The UNV SNs for 放聲大哭 (WH05375+WH06963+WH01058) are attached to the LCC phrase beginning at 放, following LCC's syntax; 孩子 receives no SN as it is LCC's explicit subject inserted for clarity.
{<WAH09001>} (ו conjunction) and {<WAH03588>} (כִּי complementizer) are retained as implicit braced markers before 說 since LCC has no explicit words for them.
{<WAH0853>} (אֵת direct object marker) is kept implicit as LCC uses a bare verb-phrase without explicit object marking.
The second occurrence of 相對而坐 uses WAH-prefix forms (WAH04480, WAH05048) matching UNV exactly, placed after 她 which is LCC's addition.

Gen/21.lcc_original: 上帝聽見兒童的聲音；上帝的使者從天上呼叫夏甲說：『夏甲，你怎麼啦？不要害怕；上帝已經聽見兒童在那裏的聲音了。
notes: UNV 神→LCC 上帝: SN WH0430 transfers normally to 上帝 throughout.

LCC explicitly renders the four trailing UNV implicit markers {<WAH09002>}{<WAH0834>}{<WAH01931>}{<WAH08033>} (בַּאֲשֶׁר הוּא שָׁם = 'where he was') as 在那裏; braces dropped per rule 3, all four tags attached to that phrase per rule 6.
UNV 為何<WAH04100>這樣呢 → LCC 怎麼啦: WAH04100 placed on 怎麼 (direct semantic equivalent of מה); 啦 covers the implicit 這樣呢 aspect and is left unannotated.
{<WAH0413>} (preposition אֶל governing קֹול 'voice') kept implicit before 聲音 in both clauses, as LCC uses structural particle 的 rather than an explicit directional preposition.
{<WAH03588>} (כִּי 'for/because') kept implicit and placed at the clause boundary before 上帝 in the final clause, matching the Hebrew subordinating conjunction that UNV also left implicit.

Gen/21.lcc_original: 起來，把兒童拉起來，用手抓住；我必使他成爲大國。』
notes: LCC splits the two Hebrew imperatives cleanly: 起來 = קוּמִי (WH06965), 拉起來 = שְׂאִי (WH05375) — better than UNV which merged both into 抱.

LCC's 用手抓住 covers three Hebrew tokens from וְהַחֲזִיקִי אֶת-יָדֵךְ בּוֹ: WAH0854 (accusative marker אֶת) placed on 用, WH03027 (יָד hand) on 手, WH02388+WTH8685 (hold fast, hiphil impv) on 抓住, WAH09002 (בּוֹ in/on him) appended to 抓住.
{WAH03588} retained — כִּי is implicit in LCC; no explicit conjunction before 我必使.

LCC 使他 is actually more literal than UNV 使他的後裔: Hebrew אֲשִׂימֶנּוּ has only a 3ms suffix (him), not descendants. 他 carries no separate SN as it is the verb's pronominal suffix, absorbed into the WH07760 tag on 使.

Gen/21.lcc_original: 上帝開了夏甲的眼，她就看見一口水井，便去將皮袋裝滿了水，給兒童喝。
notes: UNV splits פָּקַח (WH06491) into 使…明亮 (caused…to be bright); LCC renders it directly as 開 (opened). All three tags (WAH0853, WH06491, WTH8799) are consolidated onto 開 since it alone carries the full semantic and grammatical load of the Hebrew verb phrase.
LCC uses 眼 (eye) where UNV uses 眼睛 — same referent, WH05869 attached to 眼 without issue.
LCC uses 裝滿 for UNV 盛滿 — both translate מָלֵא (WH04390); straightforward substitution.
LCC uses 兒童 for UNV 童子 — both translate נַעַר (WH05288); straightforward substitution.

Gen/21.lcc_original: 上帝和兒童同在；他漸漸長大，住在野地，長大成人，成了個弓箭手。
notes: UNV 保佑 carries all three implicit tags {H1961}{8799}{H854} as a free-translation cluster; LCC 和兒童同在 expresses the same Hebrew phrase with explicit words, so braces are dropped and tags distributed: 和→H854 (את = 'with'), 兒童→H5288 (הַנַּעַר), 同在→H1961+8799 (וַיְהִי = 'was'). Main uncertainty is whether H854 belongs on 和 or bundled onto 同在.
LCC 長大成人 is an expansionary gloss with no Hebrew equivalent in MT (MT only has וַיִּגְדַּל = grew); left unannotated.
Chinese measure word 個 before 弓箭手 has no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated.
UNV 神 vs LCC 上帝: both render H430 (אֱלֹהִים); straightforward substitution.

Gen/21.lcc_original: 他住在巴蘭野地；他母親從埃及地給他取了一個妻子。
notes: LCC uses 野地 instead of UNV's 曠野 for מִדְבַּר (WH04057) — same Hebrew referent, different Chinese rendering; SNs attach to 野地 identically.
LCC uses 取 instead of UNV's 娶 for לָקַח (WH03947) — same Hebrew verb (take/marry), different Chinese rendering; morphology tag WTH8799 follows.
WAH09002 (prefix ב) attaches before WH04057 on 野地, and WAH04480 (prefix מִן) attaches before WH0776 on 地 — both follow the same prefix-compound pattern as UNV.
了 (aspect particle after 取) has no Hebrew equivalent and is left unannotated.

Gen/21.lcc_original: 當那時候，亞比米勒和他的軍長非各對亞伯拉罕說：『在你所作的一切事上、上帝都和你同在。
notes: {<WAH01961>}{<WTH8799>} kept implicit — LCC 當那時候 has no explicit word for Hebrew וַיְהִי (was/happened)
{<WH0559>}{<WTH8799>} kept implicit — represents Hebrew main verb וַיֹּאמֶר; LCC 說 carries the explicit לֵאמֹר tags <WAH09001><WH0559><WTH8800>
UNV 凡<WAH09002><WAH03605> split across two LCC words: 在 receives WAH09002 (ב prefix = 'in') and 一切 receives WAH03605 (כֹּל = 'all'), since LCC uses a separate preposition rather than a unified 凡
UNV 同他軍長 → LCC 和他的軍長: H08269 (שַׂר, commander) and H06635 (צָבָא, army) both attach to 軍長 as the head noun
UNV 行<WH06213> → LCC 作<WH06213>: different Chinese verb choice for the same Hebrew root עשׂה
UNV 神的保佑<WAH05973> → LCC 上帝都和你同在<WAH05973>: LCC renders עִמְּךָ ('with you') more literally as 和你同在; 都 is a stylistic adverb with no Hebrew correspondent and left unannotated
上帝<WH0430> for LCC vs 神<WH0430> in UNV — systematic UNV/LCC difference for אֱלֹהִים (H0430), both correctly tagged

Gen/21.lcc_original: 如今請在這裏指着上帝對我起誓：你不要以詐僞待我和我的苗裔及後代；我怎樣厚待了你，你也要怎樣厚待我、和你所寄居的這地。
notes: UNV「欺負」→ LCC「以詐僞待」: LCC rephrases deception as a verbal phrase; <WH08266><WTH8799> attached after 待 as the verbal unit carrying the Hebrew שָׁקַר sense.
UNV「與我的兒子」<WH05209> → LCC「和我的苗裔」; UNV「並我的子孫」<WH05220> → LCC「及後代」: LCC uses different but semantically equivalent generational terms for נִין and נֶכֶד.
UNV ends with「這地<WH0776>的民」(people of this land); LCC omits 的民 and ends at「這地」— <WH0776> attached to 這地 only.
{<WAH09002>} retained as implicit marker positioned before 這地 (after the relative clause particle 的), as LCC has no explicit surface word for this Hebrew prefixed element.

Gen/21.lcc_original: 亞伯拉罕說：『我倒情願起誓。』
notes: LCC inserts 倒 (emphasis/contrast particle, 'indeed/rather') between 我 and 情願起誓; it has no Hebrew equivalent and is left unannotated per Rule 5.
All other lexical correspondences are direct: 亞伯拉罕→WH085, 說→WH0559+WTH8799, 我→WAH0595, 情願起誓→WH07650+WTH8735.
LCC uses 『』 quotation marks instead of UNV's 「」; preserved exactly as original.

Gen/21.lcc_sn: 但亞伯拉罕<WH085>卻屢次爲了<WAH05921>{<WH0182>}一口水井<WH04325><WH0875>而指責<WH03198><WTH8689>{<WAH0853>}亞比米勒<WH040>，因爲{<WAH0834>}亞比米勒<WH040>的僕人<WH05650>把那口水井霸佔<WH01497><WTH8804>了。
Gen/21.lcc_original: 但亞伯拉罕卻屢次爲了一口水井而指責亞比米勒，因爲亞比米勒的僕人把那口水井霸佔了。
notes: LCC restructures the Hebrew sentence significantly: the UNV/Hebrew relative clause (אֲשֶׁר + servants seized) becomes a causal clause (因爲...霸佔了), requiring {<WAH0834>} (אֲשֶׁר) to be placed at the clause boundary as an implicit marker.
LCC adds 屢次 (repeatedly) with no Hebrew/UNV counterpart — left unannotated.
עַל-אֹדוֹת (WAH05921 + WH0182) maps to LCC 爲了: WAH05921 attaches explicitly to 爲了; WH0182 (אֹדוֹת, 'matter/account') remains implicit {<WH0182>} as LCC has no explicit noun for it.
WH04325 (water) and WH0875 (well) both attach after the compound 水井, per the multi-SN-per-phrase rule.
Second mention 那口水井 (resumptive noun in Chinese for the relative clause object) is left unannotated — SNs for the well are already assigned to the first mention.
{<WAH0853>} (אֵת, direct object marker) stays implicit — Chinese 指責亞比米勒 needs no explicit object marker, and 把 in the relative clause marks a different object.

Gen/21.lcc_original: 亞比米勒呢、也屢次說：『誰作了這事、我都不知道；你也沒有告訴我；我也沒有聽見；到今天纔聽見。』
notes: LCC adds 呢、也屢次 before 說 with no Hebrew equivalent; only 說 receives <WH0559><WTH8799>
LCC 作了: SN attaches to 作<WH06213><WTH8804>; 了 is a Chinese aspect particle with no Hebrew equivalent, unannotated
{<WAH0853>} (object marker את) kept implicit — LCC's 了 is not a translation of את
LCC 我都不知道: 都 is a Chinese intensifier with no Hebrew equivalent, unannotated

UNV final clause ({<WAH01571>}今日<WH01115><WH03117>我<WAH0595>才{<WH03808>}聽見<WH08085><WTH8804>了) expands into two LCC clauses: implicit {<WAH01571>}→explicit 也<WAH01571> and implicit {<WH03808>}→explicit 沒有<WH03808> in 我也沒有聽見; <WH08085><WTH8804> attaches to first 聽見; 今天<WH01115><WH03117> covers the temporal phrase 到今天; second 聽見 in 到今天纔聽見 is LCC's stylistic repetition for clarity, left unannotated

Gen/21.lcc_original: 亞伯拉罕取了羊羣牛羣給亞比米勒，二人就立了約。
notes: LCC 取 (take/took) maps to UNV 把<WH03947><WTH8799>; both render לָקַח — same verb, different Chinese construction
LCC 羊羣/牛羣 map to UNV 羊/牛 — same Hebrew words (WH06629/WH01241), LCC adds 羣 (flock/herd suffix)
UNV 彼此 (each other) between 就 and 立 has no SN of its own and is absent from LCC — no alignment loss
Aspect particle 了 appears twice in LCC (after 取 and after 立) with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated per rule 5; SN tags attach to the verb immediately before 了

Gen/21.lcc_sn: 亞伯拉罕<WH085>把<WAH0853>羊羣<WH06629>中七<WH07651>隻母羊羔<WH03535>另放<WH05324><WTH8686>在一處<WAH09001><WAH0905>。
Gen/21.lcc_original: 亞伯拉罕把羊羣中七隻母羊羔另放在一處。
notes: WH06629 (הַצֹּאן = flock) maps to UNV's 羊羔 (end of noun phrase) but to LCC's 羊羣 (front of noun phrase, 羊羣中七隻母羊羔). LCC makes the partitive 'from the flock' explicit and restructures the phrase, so WH06629 shifts position. The particle 中 is LCC's syntactic addition with no SN equivalent and is left unannotated.

WH03535 (כִּבְשֹׂת = ewe lambs) covers 隻母羊羔 in LCC (classifier + adjective + noun collapsed), matching UNV's 隻母 attribution but extended to the full classifier phrase since LCC fuses the morphology differently.

Gen/21.lcc_original: 亞比米勒問亞伯拉罕說：『你另放在一處的這七隻母羊羔要做甚麼？』
Gen/21.unv_sn_reference: 亞比米勒<WH040>問<WAH0413>亞伯拉罕<WH085>說<WH0559><WTH8799>：「你把<WAH0834>這<WH02008>七<WH07651>隻母羊羔<WH03535>另放<WH05324><WTH8689>在一處<WAH09001><WAH0905>，<WAH02007>是甚麼<WAH04100>意思呢？」
notes: LCC restructures the Hebrew question: the relative clause '你另放在一處的' fronts before the noun phrase, reversing UNV's disposal-marker (把) construction. SNs redistributed accordingly.
<WAH0834> (H834 אֲשֶׁר 'which/that') attaches to 的 in LCC — the relative particle serves the same grammatical role as the Hebrew relative pronoun, vs UNV where it attaches to 你把.

<WAH02007> (H2007 הֵנָּה 'they/these, f.') attaches to 要做 — Hebrew 'מָה הֵנָּה' ('what are they?') is rendered as 要做甚麼 ('what will they do/be for?'); 要做 represents the predicate and 甚麼 the interrogative.
隻 (Chinese measure word) left unannotated — no Hebrew equivalent, part of Chinese grammatical structure.
你 (subject of relative clause) left unannotated — implied in the Hebrew verb conjugation הִצַּבְתָּ, not a standalone lexeme with its own SN.

Gen/21.lcc_original: 亞伯拉罕說：『這七隻母羊羔、你要從我手裏收取了去，好給我做證據我挖了這口井。』
notes: LCC fronts the object 這七隻母羊羔 before the verb phrase, while UNV has verb-object order; SNs aligned semantically regardless of word order
好 explicitly renders Hebrew בַּעֲבוּר (H5668 with prefix H9002), which was implicit {<WAH09002>}{<WH05668>} in UNV; braces dropped per Rule 3
了 (aspect particles after 收取 and 挖) left unannotated as Chinese grammatical markers with no Hebrew equivalent
LCC uses explicit subject 亞伯拉罕 where UNV has pronoun 他; proper name receives no SN

給我<WAH09001>做<WAH01961><WTH8799>證據<WAH09001><WH05713> restructures UNV's 作<WAH01961><WTH8799>我<WAH09001>...的證據<WAH09001><WH05713>; both WAH09001 instances preserved for לִי (for me) and לְעֵדָה (as a witness) respectively

Gen/21.lcc_sn: 因此<WAH05921><WAH03651>他給那<WAH01931>地方<WAH09001><WH04725>起名叫<WH07121><WTH8804>別是巴<WH0884>，因爲<WAH03588>他們二人<WH08147>起了誓<WH07650><WTH8738>就在那裏<WAH08033>。
Gen/21.lcc_original: 因此他給那地方起名叫別是巴，因爲他們二人起了誓就在那裏。
Gen/21.unv_sn_reference: 所以<WAH05921><WAH03651>他給那<WAH01931>地方<WAH09001><WH04725>起名叫<WH07121><WTH8804>別是巴<WH0884>（就是盟誓的井的意思），因為<WAH03588>他們<WH08147>二人在那裡<WAH08033>起了誓<WH07650><WTH8738>。
notes: 「所以」(UNV) → 「因此」(LCC)：同義詞，SNs <WAH05921><WAH03651> 皆轉移
LCC 省略括號內的詮釋說明「（就是盟誓的井的意思）」，無對應標記
LCC 語序倒置：UNV「在那裡<WAH08033>起了誓<WH07650><WTH8738>」→ LCC「起了誓<WH07650><WTH8738>就在那裏<WAH08033>」，按語意位置分配各 SN
LCC 多出語氣助詞「就」，無希伯來文對應詞，不標記
<WH08147> 標於完整詞組「他們二人」之後（UNV 原本置於「他們」與「二人」之間，推斷涵蓋全詞組 שְׁנֵיהֶם）

Gen/21.lcc_original: 他們在別是巴立了約；亞比米勒和他的軍長非各就起身，他們就回非利士地去了。
notes: LCC adds explicit subject 他們 before 就回 (subject repetition for clarity) — no separate SN; WH07725+WTH8799 attach to 回 only
LCC 和他的 replaces UNV 就同他 as the connective phrase — conjunction and pronoun carry no SN in either version
{<WAH0413>} kept with braces: LCC has no explicit preposition between 回 and 非利士, matching UNV's implicit marker pattern

Gen/21.lcc_sn: 亞伯拉罕在別是巴<WAH09002><WH0884>栽<WH05193><WTH8799>了一棵垂絲柳樹<WH0815>，在那裏<WAH08033>呼求<WH07121><WTH8799>耶和華<WH03068>永恆<WH05769>上帝<WH0410>的名<WAH09002><WH08034>。
Gen/21.lcc_original: 亞伯拉罕在別是巴栽了一棵垂絲柳樹，在那裏呼求耶和華永恆上帝的名。
Gen/21.unv_sn_reference: 亞伯拉罕在別是巴<WAH09002><WH0884>栽<WH05193><WTH8799>上一棵垂絲柳樹<WH0815>，又在那裡<WAH08033>求告<WH07121><WTH8799>耶和華<WH03068>─永生<WH05769>　神<WH0410>的名<WAH09002><WH08034>。
notes: 神<WH0410> → 上帝<WH0410>: standard UNV/LCC divergence for H0410 (אֵל); SN transferred to LCC's 上帝
求告<WH07121> → 呼求<WH07121>: LCC rephrases the verb for H07121 (קָרָא 'to call/cry out'); tag attached to 呼求
永生<WH05769> → 永恆<WH05769>: LCC uses 永恆 for H05769 (עוֹלָם 'everlasting'); semantically equivalent
了 after 栽 is a Chinese aspect particle with no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated
UNV's 又 ('again/also') has no SN and is absent in LCC; nothing to transfer

Gen/21.lcc_sn: 亞伯拉罕<WH085>在非利士人<WH06430>的地方<WAH09002><WH0776>寄居<WH01481><WTH8799>了許多<WH07227>日子<WH03117>。
Gen/21.lcc_original: 亞伯拉罕在非利士人的地方寄居了許多日子。
notes: LCC 地方 (place/land) expands UNV 地 — both render H0776 אֶרֶץ; WAH09002 (ב prefix) and WH0776 both attach to 地方 as a unit
LCC 許多 expands UNV 多 — both render H07227 רַב; tag attaches after 許多 as the full phrase
LCC 日子 expands UNV 日 — both render H03117 יוֹם; tag attaches to 日子
了 is a Chinese aspect particle with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated per Rule 5

Gen/22.lcc_original: 這些事以後，上帝要試驗亞伯拉罕，就對他說：『亞伯拉罕』；亞伯拉罕說：『我在這裏呢。』
notes: LCC uses 上帝 for God (H0430) where UNV uses 神 — straightforward synonym alignment.

UNV renders וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו as 呼叫他...說, splitting H413 onto 他 and H559 onto 說. LCC condenses this to 對他說; H413 (= אֵל, the preposition 'to/toward him') is attached after 他 as a phrase-final tag, matching UNV's convention of tagging the full prepositional unit.
LCC has 亞伯拉罕說 where UNV has 他說 for the second occurrence of H559 — same SN, different pronoun vs. proper name; both receive <WH0559><WTH8799>.
Sentence-final particle 呢 in LCC has no Hebrew counterpart — left unannotated.
{<WAH01961>}{<WTH8799>} (וַיְהִי) and {<WAH0853>} (את direct-object marker) remain implicit: LCC, like UNV, has no explicit lexical words for these.

Gen/22.lcc_original: 上帝說：『你帶着你兒子，你獨生的兒子、你所愛的以撒、到摩利亞地，在我所要對你說明的一個山上、把他獻上來做燔祭。』
notes: LCC 上帝 (God) carries no SN, matching UNV where 神 is also untagged in this verse.
UNV 就是<WAH0853> (appositive marker before 你獨生的兒子) has no LCC equivalent word; kept as {<WAH0853>} after the comma.
UNV {<WH0259>} (אחד = one) is implicit in UNV, but LCC explicitly writes 一個; braces dropped per Rule 3 → 一個<WH0259>.
UNV split directional structure 往<WAH0413>…去<WH03212><WTH8798> merged onto LCC 到, which covers both the directional preposition and the verb of motion.
UNV 要指示<WH0559><WTH8799>你<WAH0413> maps to LCC 要對你<WAH0413>說明<WH0559><WTH8799>; the preposition WAH0413 (אֵלֶיךָ = to you) attaches after 你, and 說明 carries WH0559+WTH8799.
{<WAH08033>} (שָׁם = there) remains implicit in LCC; LCC has no explicit locative adverb corresponding to it.
LCC 把他獻上來 expands UNV 把他獻 with 上來 (directional complement); all of WH05927+WTH8685 attach after the full phrase 獻上來.

Gen/22.lcc_original: 亞伯拉罕清早起來，備上了驢，帶着兩個僮僕和他的兒子以撒，也劈好了燔祭的柴，就起身往上帝所對他說明的地方去了。
notes: UNV 神<WH0430> → LCC 上帝<WH0430>: systematic lexical substitution, same H430 (אֱלֹהִים)
UNV 僕人<WH05288> → LCC 僮僕<WH05288>: different Chinese term for servants, same H5288

UNV 指示<WH0559><WTH8804>他<WAH09001> → LCC 對他<WAH09001>說明<WH0559><WTH8804>: LCC rephrases the verb (H559 אָמַר) as 說明 with prepositional phrase 對他; pronominal suffix <WAH09001> attached to explicit 他, verbal SN+morphology attached to 說明
LCC aspect particles 了 (in 備上了, 劈好了) and 着 substituted for 著 have no Hebrew equivalents and are left unannotated
Implicit {<WAH0853>} object markers retained as implicit in both positions (before 驢 and after 着) since LCC has no explicit Chinese word covering the Hebrew אֶת

Gen/22.lcc_original: 第三天、亞伯拉罕舉目，遠遠地看那地方。
notes: LCC omits 到了 (arrival aspect phrase) from the beginning — no SN was attached to it in UNV, so nothing is lost.
LCC uses 天 for יוֹם (H3117) where UNV uses 日; both mean 'day', straightforward lexical substitution.
LCC uses 看 for רָאָה (H7200) where UNV uses 看見; same verb, different surface form.
Direct object marker {<WAH0853>} kept implicit in both positions as LCC has no explicit word for the Hebrew אֵת particle.

Gen/22.lcc_original: 亞伯拉罕對他的僮僕說：『你們同驢在這裏等候着；我和兒童往那裏去敬拜，就回到你們這裏來。』
notes: UNV 僕人 → LCC 僮僕 (both = servants/lads); SN 05288 (נַעַר) attaches to 僮僕
UNV 和<WAH05973> (in '你們和驢') → LCC 同 — LCC uses 同 ('together with') for Hebrew עִם (05973)
UNV 與童子<WH05288> → LCC 和兒童 — both = 'with the young man'; preposition 和/與 carries no separate SN, so 05288 attaches to 兒童
UNV 拜一拜<WH07812><WTH8691> → LCC 敬拜 — LCC uses a single verb where UNV reduplicates; both SNs attach to 敬拜
Aspect particle 着 (after 等候) has no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated per Rule 5

Gen/22.lcc_original: 亞伯拉罕把燔祭的柴放在他兒子以撒身上，自己手裏卻拿着火跟刀：二人就這樣一齊走。
notes: LCC 卻 (adversative particle) has no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated
LCC 就這樣 ('in this way') is a connective expansion with no direct SN; left unannotated
LCC 一齊 corresponds to UNV 同 (H03162, יַחְדָּו 'together')
LCC 走 corresponds to UNV 行 (H03212, הָלַךְ 'walk/go')
LCC 跟 corresponds to UNV 與; <WAH0853> (object marker את before 刀) attached to 跟 following the same UNV pattern
Both {<WAH0853>} implicit object markers retained: one before 燔祭 (object of 把-clause), one before 火 (first object of 拿-clause)

Gen/22.lcc_original: 以撒對他父親亞伯拉罕說：『爸爸。』亞伯拉罕說：『怎麼啦，孩子？』以撒說：『請看，火跟柴都有了；燔祭的小羊在哪裏呢？』
notes: Abraham's response differs significantly: UNV 我兒，我在這裡 vs LCC 怎麼啦，孩子？ — WAH02009 (הִנֶּנִּי, 'here I am / present') mapped to 怎麼啦 as the closest semantic anchor for Abraham's response-of-presence; WH01121 (בְנִי, 'my son') mapped to 孩子
LCC uses 爸爸 (colloquial 'dad') where UNV uses 父親 for WH01 in Isaac's address — both are H0001 (father), alignment is clear
LCC uses 小羊 ('small sheep/lamb') where UNV uses 羊羔 for WH07716 — both designate a young sheep, alignment is clear
Implicit markers {<WH0559>}{<WTH8799>} before 對 retained as implicit — no explicit LCC word precedes 對 to absorb them
跟 (LCC conjunction) left unannotated, matching UNV treatment of 與 — WH06086 attaches only to 柴

Gen/22.lcc_original: 亞伯拉罕說：『孩子，上帝自己會顧到燔祭小羊的。』二人仍這樣一齊走着走着。
notes: 孩子 (LCC) maps to 我兒 (UNV), both translating בֵּן (WH01121)
上帝 (LCC) maps to 神 (UNV), both translating אֱלֹהִים (WH0430)
Chinese modal 會 has no Hebrew equivalent and is left unannotated; 顧到 carries WH07200+WTH8799 for יִרְאֶה
仍這樣 is an interpretive addition unique to LCC with no Hebrew basis; left unannotated

走着走着 (LCC reduplication) = 行 (UNV), both carrying WH03212+WTH8799
