Gen/23.lcc_original: 『我主請聽！你在我們中間是一位有神威的族長；你只管在我們最好的墳地埋葬你死了的親人；我們必沒有一個人不容你在他的墳地埋葬你死了的親人。』
notes: UNV 尊大<WH0430>的王子<WH05387> → LCC 有神威<WH0430>的族長<WH05387>: WH0430 (אֱלֹהִים, mighty/divine) maps to 有神威 (having divine authority); WH05387 (נָשִׂיא, prince/chief) maps to 族長 (clan chief)
LCC adds explicit pronoun 你 before 只管 as subject of the Hebrew imperative; no SN assigned since UNV treats that subject as implied within the verb form
LCC adds emphatic particle 必 with no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated
LCC 一個人 expands UNV 一人; WH0376 (אִישׁ) attached after 一個人 as the complete phrase
LCC 你死了的親人 renders UNV 你的死人; WH04191+WTH8801 attached after 親人 since the whole phrase functions as the translation unit for מֵת with pronominal suffix
LCC omits 裡 after 墳地 in both burial clauses; tags still attach to 埋葬 as in UNV

Gen/23.lcc_original: 亞伯拉罕就起來，向當地人赫人下拜；
notes: 那地 (UNV) → 當地 (LCC): synonymous phrases for 'the local land'; WH0776 attaches to 當地
{<WAH09001>}{<WH05971>} were implicit in UNV (no surface Chinese text), but LCC has explicit 人 for עַם — dropped braces per Rule 3 and attached both tags to 人
LCC terminal punctuation ；preserved (UNV had ，)

Gen/23.lcc_original: 對他們說：『你們若有意叫我埋葬我死了的親人、使她不在我眼前，就請聽我，爲我向瑣轄的兒子以弗崙接洽，
notes: WH01696 (דָּבַר speak) and WTH8762 kept implicit as in UNV — LCC's 說 is aligned to WH0559 (אָמַר say), same as UNV
WH04191 (מוּת dead) placed after 死了 rather than 親人, since 死了 is the explicit translation of the Hebrew participle; LCC 親人 (loved one) has no separate SN
WH08085+WTH8798 placed after 我 in 聽我 — LCC omits 的話 from UNV's 聽我的話; Hebrew שְׁמָעוּנִי is 'hear me', matching LCC more precisely
WAH09001 (vav conjunction) placed after 爲我 mirroring UNV's pre-verb position; WH06293+WTH8798 attach to 接洽 as LCC's verb for פָּגַע (UNV: 求)
LCC's 向 (toward) before 瑣轄 is a Chinese prepositional interpolation with no distinct SN — left unannotated per Rule 5

Gen/23.lcc_original: 把他所有的、他田頭上那麥比拉的洞給我，他好按足額的價銀賣給我，使我在你們中間有業產爲墳地。』
notes: UNV's implicit {<WAH0834>} (אֲשֶׁר-לוֹ, 'which is his') becomes explicit '他所有的' in LCC; braces dropped per Rule 3 and <WAH0834> attached to end of phrase
UNV 足<WH04392> and 價<WAH09002><WH03701> expand to LCC 足額<WH04392>的價銀<WAH09002><WH03701>; tags attach to the expanded compound words 足額 and 價銀 respectively

UNV's 墳<WH06913>地<WAH09001><WH0272> (Hebrew construct chain קֶבֶר-אֲחֻזַּת reversed) maps to LCC 業產<WAH09001><WH0272>爲墳地<WH06913>; LCC places possession (業產 ← אֲחֻזַּת) before burial (墳地 ← קָבֶר), matching the Hebrew word order but differing from UNV's arrangement
The possessive pronoun 他 before 田 in LCC (translating the suffix on שָׂדֵהוּ) is left unannotated; the possessive suffix is not separately tagged in UNV+SN either

Gen/23.lcc_original: 那時以弗崙正坐在赫人中間，赫人以弗崙就在赫人所有出入城門的人聽得到的地方回答亞伯拉罕說：
notes: UNV {<WH06030>}{<WTH8799>} (implicit 'answered') made explicit as 回答<WH06030><WTH8799> in LCC per Rule 3.
UNV {<WAH03605>} (implicit כֹּל 'all') made explicit as 所有<WH03605> per Rule 3; its prefix {<WAH09001>} (ל) has no standalone LCC word so stays implicit.
UNV 面前<WAH09002><WH0241> ('in the ears of', Hebrew בְּאָזְנֵי) is rendered as 聽得到的地方 in LCC — an idiomatic paraphrase; tags anchored to the end of that phrase.
LCC inserts 的人 between 城門 and 聽得到 as a structural nominalizer with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated.
<WAH0853> (אֵת direct-object marker, expressed via 對 in UNV) has no corresponding word in LCC — kept implicit as {<WAH0853>}.
LCC reorders the second clause: UNV places 城門出入 before 赫人; LCC places 赫人 first then 出入城門, matching the Hebrew word order more closely (בְּאָזְנֵי בְנֵי-חֵת לְכֹל בָּאֵי שַׁעַר עִירוֹ).

Gen/23.lcc_original: 『不，我主請聽我！那田地我給你，其中的洞我也給你，在我族人眼前給了你，讓你可以埋葬你死了的親人。』
notes: 不然 (UNV) → 不 (LCC): both negate WH03808 (לֹא); single character covers the full negation
其中 in LCC covers both WAH0834 (אֲשֶׁר = which/that) and WAH09002 (ב prefix = in it), which UNV splits across 連 and 田間 separately
族人 in LCC covers both WH05971 (עַם = people) and WH01121 (בֵּן = sons of), which UNV expresses as 同族的人
給了: aspect particle 了 is unannotated (no Hebrew equivalent); WH05414+WTH8804 attaches to 給
讓你可以 is LCC's expansion of the Hebrew infinitive construct; WH06912+WTH8798 attaches to 埋葬
死了的親人: WH04191+WTH8801 attaches to 死了 (the 'dead' concept = מֵת); 親人 is LCC's idiomatic expansion with no direct Hebrew counterpart

Gen/23.lcc_original: 亞伯拉罕就在當地的人面前下拜；
Gen/23.unv_sn_reference: 亞伯拉罕<WH085>就在那地<WH0776>的人民<WH05971>面前<WAH09001><WH06440>下拜<WH07812><WTH8691>，
notes: 那地(UNV)→當地(LCC): same referent (that land/locality), WH0776 attached to 當地
人民(UNV)→人(LCC): LCC uses the shorter form; WH05971 (עַם, people) attached to 人
面前 carries both WAH09001 prefix particle and WH06440 (פָּנִים) as in UNV — structure identical

Gen/23.lcc_original: 就在當地人民聽得到的地方對以弗崙說：『只要你肯的話，請聽我；我給了銀兩買田地；請收下，我就在那裏埋葬我死了的親人。』
notes: 只要 in LCC covers both {<WAH0389>} (אַךְ, implicit in UNV) and <WAH0518> (אִם = 若 in UNV); braces dropped per rule 3 since LCC has an explicit word.

LCC 說 receives both the implicit {<WH01696>}{<WTH8762>} (וַיְדַבֵּר, main verb, implicit in UNV) and the explicit <WAH09001><WH0559><WTH8800> (לֵאמֹר); braces dropped since LCC's 說 is an explicit verb covering both.
LCC restructures כֶּסֶף הַשָּׂדֶה ('silver of the field') as 銀兩買田地 ('silver to buy the field'); 買 is LCC's interpretive addition with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated.
{<WAH04480>} (מִמֶּנִּי, 'from me') remains implicit — LCC also omits it explicitly, so braces are retained.
LCC uses 親人 ('relatives/loved ones') where UNV has 死人 ('dead'); both translate מֵתִי — SNs attached to 親人 as the closest semantic match.

Gen/23.lcc_original: 以弗崙回答亞伯拉罕說：
notes: LCC and UNV are word-for-word identical for this verse; all SNs map directly with no reordering or rephrasing.
{<WAH0853>} retained as implicit — direct object marker (את) has no overt Chinese equivalent in LCC.
{<WAH09001>} retained as implicit — the trailing vav prefix has no corresponding explicit word in LCC's 說：clause.

Gen/23.lcc_original: 『我主請聽我；値四百舍客勒【1】銀子的一塊田地，在你我之間、還算得了甚麼？你只管埋葬你死了的親人吧。』
notes: LCC adds explicit object 我 after 請聽 and an explicit subject 你 before the imperative clause; neither receives a separate SN tag as they are Chinese syntactic additions with no Hebrew correspondent.
LCC footnote marker 【1】 after 舍客勒 is preserved in place; WH08255 inserted immediately after 舍客勒 and before 【1】.
LCC 田地 expands UNV 田 but both map to WH0776 (אֶרֶץ / land); tag placed after 田地.
UNV 呢<WAH01931> (הִוא) has no LCC counterpart; rendered as {<WAH01931>} (implicit) placed after 甚麼.
LCC 死了的親人 expands UNV 死人; WH04191 + WTH8801 attached to 死了 as the closest verbal correspondent of מֵת, with 的親人 left unannotated as a Chinese expansion.

Gen/23.lcc_original: 亞伯拉罕聽從了以弗崙；就平了銀子給以弗崙，就是他在赫人聽得到的地方所說的，平商人通用的銀子四百舍客勒【1】。
notes: LCC restructures the verse into a summary clause (就平了銀子給以弗崙) and a specification clause (平商人通用的銀子四百舍客勒). H8254 attaches only to the first 平 (the verb 'weigh'); the second 平 is LCC's stylistic connector with no direct Hebrew equivalent.
UNV 面前 (H0241 + prefix H09002 = 'in the ears of') becomes LCC 聽得到的地方 ('a place where one can be heard'); both render Hebrew בְּאָזְנֵי. Tags <WAH09002><WH0241> placed after 聽得到的地方.
把<WAH0853> (accusative marker אֵת) has no explicit counterpart in LCC; kept as {<WAH0853>} inserted before the first 銀子 in the weigh clause.
UNV 買賣 (H5503 = merchant, with H09001 lamed prefix) maps to LCC 商人; both render הַסֹּחֵר.

LCC splits the silver reference across two clauses. First 銀子 (就平了銀子) is left without H3701 to avoid double-tagging; H3701 is applied to the second 銀子 (in 平商人通用的銀子) matching UNV's placement on the 'merchant-current silver' phrase, and again after 舍客勒 per UNV's dual-occurrence pattern.
他<WH085> in UNV (照著他) maps to 他 in LCC (就是他); follows UNV tagging of H85 = Abraham, though contextually the speaker before the Hittites was Ephron (Gen 23:14–15) — a known ambiguity in UNV's tagging.

Gen/23.lcc_sn: 於是以弗崙<WH06085>的田地<WH07704>、那在麥比拉<WAH09002><WH04375>在幔利<WH04471>東面<WAH09001><WH06440>的、那塊田地<WH07704>和其<WAH0834>中<WAH09002>的洞<WH04631>、以及田地<WAH09002><WH07704>中間<WAH0834>跟四圍<WH05439>界限<WAH09002><WAH03605><WH01366>所有的一切<WAH03605>樹木<WH06086>，
Gen/23.lcc_original: 於是以弗崙的田地、那在麥比拉在幔利東面的、那塊田地和其中的洞、以及田地中間跟四圍界限所有的一切樹木，
notes: LCC renders לִפְנֵי מַמְרֵא (UNV: 幔利前) as 幔利東面 — an interpretive gloss (east-facing = before); SNs <WAH09001><WH06440> attached to 東面 as the functional equivalent of 前.

Hebrew בְּכָל גְּבֻלוֹ סָבִיב: UNV assigns [ב+כֹּל+גְּבוּל] to 四 and [סָבִיב] to 圍; LCC inverts the order to 四圍[surrounding]+界限[border], so <WH05439> goes to 四圍 and <WAH09002><WAH03605><WH01366> to 界限.
UNV implicit {<WAH03605>} (כֹּל before trees) is rendered explicitly in LCC as 所有的一切; braces dropped per Rule 3 and <WAH03605> attached to 一切 as the lexical head.
שָׂדֶה appears three times in Hebrew; all three occurrences of 田地 in LCC are tagged accordingly with their respective prefix combinations.
Extra SNs: 07704

Gen/23.lcc_original: 都定準歸於亞伯拉罕做業產，是他在赫人和出入城門的人眼前買妥了的。
notes: LCC adds 做業產 (as a possession/estate) not explicit in UNV structure; mapped <WAH09001><WH04736> (לְמִקְנָה) to 做業產 as it directly renders the Hebrew nominal 'purchase/possession', leaving 買妥了的 unannotated as a verbal elaboration of the same concept.
LCC collapses UNV's two instances of 面前 (annotated + unannotated) into a single 眼前 at the end covering both groups; applied <WAH09001><WH05869> to that single 眼前.
{<WAH03605>} kept as implicit since LCC has no explicit word for כֹּל ('all') before 出入城門的人; placed immediately before 出入 to reflect its Hebrew role as modifier of the participle.
LCC word order is 出入城門 (verb-object) vs UNV's 城門出入 (object-verb); SNs follow LCC word order, so 出入<WH0935><WTH8802> precedes 城<WH05892>門<WH08179>.

Gen/23.lcc_original: 這事以後，亞伯拉罕就把他妻子撒拉埋葬在迦南地幔利東面麥比拉田間的洞裏：幔利就是希伯崙。
notes: 此後 (WH0310 אַחַר + WH03651 כֵּן) split across LCC's 這事<WH03651>以後<WH0310>: כֵּן ('so/thus') maps to 這事 ('this thing'), אַחַר ('after') maps to 以後 ('after').
UNV 前 (WH06440 פָּנִים = face/front/east) rendered in LCC as 東面 ('east face'): WH06440 attaches to 面 (face); {<WAH05921>} (עַל, 'upon/at') kept implicit as LCC has no explicit equivalent.
LCC's 就 (discourse/aspectual particle) is unannotated; 把 carries WAH0853 (direct object marker את).

Gen/23.lcc_original: 從此那塊田地和其中的洞、就定準由赫人轉歸亞伯拉罕做業產爲墳地。
notes: UNV '藉著[prepositions]赫人定準' is restructured in LCC to '定準由赫人' — WAH04480+WAH0854 attach to '由' (LCC's preposition 'by/from') rather than UNV's '藉著'
LCC '其中' (therein/in it) maps to UNV '田間' — both carry WAH09002 (prefix -בְּ, 'in')
LCC '轉' in '轉歸' has no Hebrew/SN equivalent (LCC elaboration) and is left unannotated; SNs for Abraham (WAH09001+WH085) attach to '亞伯拉罕'

LCC reverses Hebrew/UNV order at the end: '做業產' receives WAH09001+WH0272 (possession/אֲחֻזָּה) and '爲墳地' receives WH06913 (burial/קֶבֶר), matching semantic referents in LCC word order rather than UNV word order

Gen/24.lcc_original: 亞伯拉罕老邁，上了年紀；在一切事上、永恆主都賜福與亞伯拉罕。
notes: Hebrew idiom בָּא בַּיָּמִים (lit. 'came in days'): UNV folds the verb WH0935 (בּוֹא) into the idiomatic phrase 年紀老邁 with no explicit Chinese word for 'came'; LCC explicitly renders it as 上了年紀, so WH0935+WTH8804 attaches to 上了 rather than remaining implicit.
UNV 向來 carries no SN and is absent in LCC; no effect on SN transfer.
UNV 耶和華<WH03068> → LCC 永恆主 (LCC's rendering of יְהוָה); WH03068 attaches normally to 永恆主.
UNV 給<WAH0853>他<WH085> = 'gave to him (Abraham)' → LCC 與<WAH0853>亞伯拉罕<WH085>: WAH0853 attaches to 與, WH085 attaches to the explicit 亞伯拉罕 instead of a pronoun.

Gen/24.lcc_original: 亞伯拉罕對他的僕人、他家中的老者、那管理他所有的一切的、說：『請把手放在我的大腿下。
notes: UNV implicit {<WH01004>} (בֵּיתוֹ, house) maps to LCC's explicit 家 — braces dropped, attached as 家<WH01004>
UNV collapses servant description into one phrase ('管理…最老的僕人'); LCC uses three Hebrew-order appositives — SNs redistributed: WH05650→僕人, WH02205→老者, WH04910+WTH8802→管理
WAH09001+WAH09002+WAH03605 (בְּכָל, 'over all') clustered on 一切 as semantic head of LCC's 所有的一切
WAH0834 (אֲשֶׁר) assigned to 他 in '管理他所有的一切' — in LCC this pronoun covers both the relative particle and the possessive לוֹ
LCC omits 你 in the imperative (UNV '請你<WAH04994>') — WAH04994 (נָא, please) attaches directly to 請

Gen/24.lcc_original: 我要叫你指着永恆主、天之上帝、地之上帝、來起誓，不要從迦南人、就是我住在他們中間的迦南人中爲我兒子娶妻。
notes: 天之上帝 (first): UNV marks first H0430 as implicit {<WH0430>} (no explicit Chinese), but LCC has explicit 上帝 → braces dropped per rule 3.
我住: UNV marks H3427+WTH8802 as implicit {<WH03427>}{<WTH8802>} (dwell), but LCC explicitly says 我住 → braces dropped per rule 3.

H1323 (בְּנוֹת, daughters): UNV has 的女子<WAH04480><WH01323>; LCC renders this generically as 迦南人 with no separate daughters word. <WAH04480> attaches to 從 (the preposition), H3669 to 迦南人, and H1323 kept as implicit {<WH01323>}.
就是 maps to UNV's 這<WAH0834>: both represent Hebrew אֲשֶׁר introducing the relative clause 'among whom I dwell'.
The second 迦南人中 inside the relative clause is LCC's resumptive clarification with no direct Hebrew counterpart; left unannotated.
LCC's 來 before 起誓 is a Chinese directional complement with no Hebrew morpheme; unannotated.

Gen/24.lcc_original: 你可要往我本地、我親族那裏，爲我兒子以撒娶妻。』
notes: LCC restructures UNV's motion phrase 往…去 into 往…那裏: 往 absorbs the first אֶל (WAH0413) plus the main verb הָלַךְ (WH03212/WTH8799); 那裏 carries the previously-implicit second אֶל ({<WAH0413>}), now explicit in LCC — braces dropped per Rule 3.
LCC 親族 (kinfolk/relatives) corresponds to UNV 本族 — both translate מוֹלַדְתִּי (WH04138); word choice differs but semantic referent is identical.
LCC 妻 is a contracted form of UNV 妻子; both correspond to אִשָּׁה (WH0802) — tag attached to 妻.
LCC 可 is an epistemic modal added by the translator with no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated.

Confidence reduced to 0.82 due to ambiguity in distributing WH03212/WTH8799 between 往 and 那裏 — attaching to 往 is preferred since it is the primary motion word in Chinese, but 那裏 as verb-bearer is also defensible.

Gen/24.lcc_original: 僕人對亞伯拉罕說：『萬一女子不情願跟我到此地來呢，那我必須將你兒子帶回你所由出之地麼？』
notes: UNV '他' (him) is replaced by '亞伯拉罕' in LCC; WAH0413 attached after '亞伯拉罕' following the same post-object pattern as UNV.
UNV '倘若' → LCC '萬一': both render H194 אוּלַי (perhaps/suppose); WAH0194 attached to '萬一'.
UNV '肯' → LCC '情願': both render H14 אָבָה (to be willing/consent); WH014+WTH8799 attached to '情願'.
UNV {<WAH0834>} made explicit: LCC uses '所' as a relative clause marker, directly corresponding to H834 אֲשֶׁר; braces dropped.
UNV {<WAH04480>} made explicit: LCC uses '由' (from/through) for H4480 מִן; braces dropped and tag attached to '由'.
{<WAH08033>} kept implicit: H8033 שָׁם (there) has no explicit counterpart in LCC's '由出之地'.
Double WH07725 with codes WTH8687 and WTH8686 preserved as-is from UNV source data and all attached to '帶回'.
LCC adds '呢' (sentence-final question particle) and '那' (connective) which have no Hebrew equivalents; both left unannotated.

Gen/24.lcc_original: 亞伯拉罕對他說：『你要小心、不可帶我兒子回那裏去。
notes: UNV 謹慎 → LCC 小心: both translate H8104 שָׁמַר (to guard/keep); tags attach to 要小心 as a unit
UNV 不要 → LCC 不可: both translate H6435 פֶּן (lest/do not); direct substitution
UNV 我的兒子 → LCC 我兒子: LCC omits possessive particle 的, H1121 tag attaches to 我兒子
那裡 (UNV) vs 那裏 (LCC): orthographic variant only, no alignment impact

Gen/24.lcc_original: 天上之上帝永恆主、那曾帶領我離開我父的家和我親族之地、曾對我說話、曾向我起誓說：「我要將這地賜給你後裔」的，他必差遣他的使者在你前面，你就可以從那裏爲我兒子娶妻。
notes: LCC restructures UNV's 耶和華─天上的主 as 天上之上帝永恆主: 天上→<WH08064>, 上帝→<WH0430>, 永恆主→<WH03068> (YHWH as 'Eternal Lord')

First {<WAH0834>} surfaces as explicit 那<WAH0834> since LCC uses the 那…的 relative clause construction; second and third אשר remain implicit {<WAH0834>} as LCC expresses them through parallel 曾… structure
LCC adds 他的 pronoun before 使者 and 我 before 父 and 親族 as Chinese expansions — left unannotated; <WH04397> attaches to 使者 only
LCC uses 前面 rather than UNV's 面前 — semantically identical; tags placed after 前面

Gen/24.lcc_original: 倘若女子不情願跟你來，我叫你起的誓就與你無干；只不可帶我兒子回那裏去就是了。
notes: UNV 肯 → LCC 情願: both render H014 (אָבָה, be willing); tags transfer cleanly to 情願
UNV 只是<WAH07535> → LCC 只<WAH07535>: LCC omits 是; H7535 (רַק, only) attaches to 只 alone
UNV 我的兒子 → LCC 我兒子: structural particle 的 absent in LCC; H1121 attaches to 兒子 within 我兒子
LCC sentence-final 去就是了 vs UNV 去: 就是了 is a LCC idiomatic sentence-final phrase with no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated
UNV 無干了, → LCC 無干；: LCC uses semicolon instead of 了 + comma; 了 has no SN in UNV so no impact on transfer

Gen/24.lcc_original: 僕人就把手放在他主人亞伯拉罕的大腿下、根據這訓話向他起誓。
notes: UNV 底下 → LCC 下: <WAH08478> attaches after the abbreviated 下
UNV 為 (H05921, עַל) → LCC 根據: prepositional nuance differs but semantic referent is the same

notes: H01992 (הֵם, 'they/them') attaches to 人 — LCC renders the pronoun explicitly as 人 (people) where UNV uses 是 (is/are copula) for the same token
Second occurrence of H0428 was implicit {<WAH0428>} in UNV; LCC has explicit 這幾名, so braces dropped per Rule 3 and tag attached to 這幾名
H0523 (אֻמָּה, 'clan') with prefix WAH09001 was 族 mid-sentence in UNV (十二族的族長); LCC reorders to end as 宗族, so the tag follows LCC word order rather than UNV structure
LCC 各 (each, distributive) has no direct Hebrew equivalent and is left unannotated
WAH09002 prefix retained on both 村莊 and 營房 following the UNV tagging pattern, though the second instance likely represents ו (waw conjunction) rather than ב (beth)

Gen/25.lcc_original: 以實瑪利一生的年日是一百三十七歲；他氣絕而死，就被收殮歸他先族人。
notes: UNV's 享壽 covers both H08141 (years-of construct) and H02416 (life) as a compound; LCC splits these into distinct words 年日 (H08141) and 一生 (H02416), allowing more precise per-word tagging.

Hebrew counting repeats שָׁנָה (H08141) after each numeral — 'a hundred years and thirty years and seven years'; LCC condenses to 一百三十七歲 with no explicit year-word between numbers. Intermediate H08141 tags are attached to 一百 and 三十 following UNV's positional pattern; the final H08141 attaches to 歲.
LCC restructures the 'gathered to his people' clause: 被收殮 (passive, 'was gathered in') covers UNV's 歸 for H0622+WTH8735; LCC's 歸 ('returned to') covers UNV's 到 for the preposition H0413.
H05971 (עַמָּיו = his people) maps to LCC 先族人 vs. UNV's parenthetical 本民 — different lexical choices for the same Hebrew word.
{<WAH0428>} kept implicit: H0428 (אֵלֶּה = these) has no explicit LCC word, same as UNV.

Gen/25.lcc_sn: 他居住<WH07931><WTH8799>的是從<WAH04480>哈腓拉<WH02341>直到<WAH05704>埃及<WH04714>東面<WAH05921><WH06440>的<WAH0834>書珥<WH07793>，正在<WAH05921><WAH06440>往亞述<WH0804>的道兒<WH0935><WTH8800>上：以實瑪利是面對<WH06440>着衆<WAH03605>邦親<WH0251>住下來<WH05307><WTH8804>的。
Gen/25.lcc_original: 他居住的是從哈腓拉直到埃及東面的書珥，正在往亞述的道兒上：以實瑪利是面對着衆邦親住下來的。
notes: UNV splits the second עַל-פְּנֵי (WAH05921+WAH06440) across two positions: WH06440 alone on 東邊 (facing all his brothers) and WAH05921+WAH06440 on 正在 (directional toward Assyria). In LCC, 面對 receives WH06440 parallel to UNV's 東邊<WH06440>, while 正在 receives WAH05921+WAH06440 following UNV's same distribution.
LCC adds 以實瑪利是 as an explicit subject not found in UNV or the Hebrew text — left unannotated.

LCC follows Hebrew word order more closely than UNV, placing 面對着衆邦親住下來的 at the end matching the Hebrew final clause (עַל-פְּנֵי כָל-אֶחָיו נָפָל), whereas UNV moves this to the beginning of the verse.
着 after 面對 is a Chinese aspect particle with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated.

Gen/25.lcc_sn: 以下這些人<WAH0428>是亞伯拉罕<WH085>的兒子<WH01121>以撒<WH03327>的後代<WH08435>：亞伯拉罕<WH085>生<WH03205><WTH8689>以撒<WH03327>。
Gen/25.lcc_original: 以下這些人是亞伯拉罕的兒子以撒的後代：亞伯拉罕生以撒。
Gen/25.unv_sn_reference: 亞伯拉罕<WH085>的兒子<WH01121>以撒<WH03327>的後代<WH08435>記在下面<WAH0428>。亞伯拉罕<WH085>生<WH03205><WTH8689>以撒<WH03327>。
notes: <WAH0428> (וְאֵלֶּה, 'and these') is attached to 以下這些人 — LCC fronts this demonstrative phrase to mirror Hebrew word order, whereas UNV places 記在下面 at the clause end; both render the same Hebrew token.
是 (copula) is left unannotated — it has no explicit Hebrew equivalent (the predication is implied in the Hebrew construct chain).
All other alignments are direct one-to-one: Abraham × 2, son, Isaac × 2, generations, begat + morphology code.

Gen/25.lcc_original: 以撒娶利伯加爲妻的時候、正四十歲。利伯加是巴旦亞蘭的亞蘭人彼土利的女兒，是亞蘭人拉班的妹妹。
notes: UNV 利百加 → LCC 利伯加 (alternate Rebekah transliteration); WH07259 attached to both occurrences
UNV 巴旦‧亞蘭地的 → LCC 巴旦亞蘭的 (LCC omits 地 and middle dot); WAH04480+WH06307 follow 的 in both cases
UNV 妹子 → LCC 妹妹 (both = younger sister); WH0269 attached to 妹妹
{<WAH01961>}{<WTH8799>} kept implicit — no explicit Hebrew copula rendered in LCC either
{<WAH0853>} kept implicit — direct object marker has no LCC equivalent word
LCC ideographic comma 、after 時候 preserved; tags placed correctly relative to surrounding text
Extra SNs: 07259

Gen/25.lcc_original: 以撒因爲他妻子不能生育，就爲她懇求永恆主；永恆主應允他的懇求，他的妻子利伯加就懷了孕。
notes: UNV '因' → LCC '因爲': WAH03588 (כִּי) attached to the full conjunction '因爲' in LCC.
UNV '不生育' → LCC '不能生育': H06135 (עָקָר, barren) spans the expanded phrase; tag placed after full phrase.
UNV '祈求' → LCC '懇求' (both occurrences): different verb choice translating the same H06279 (עָתַר, to entreat); morphology codes follow accordingly.
UNV '耶和華' → LCC '永恆主': LCC's distinctive rendering of YHWH; WAH09001+WH03068 attached to '永恆主' in both occurrences.
UNV '利百加' → LCC '利伯加': different transliterations of Rebekah; H07259 attached to LCC's spelling.

Gen/25.lcc_original: 兒子們在她腹中彼此相擠，她就說：『若是如此，我爲甚麼這樣呢？』她就去尋問永恆主。
notes: LCC swaps the two Hebrew deictic words: LCC 如此 = כֵּן (WAH03651, 'so/thus') matching UNV 這樣; LCC 這樣 = זֶּה (WH02088, 'this') matching UNV's parenthetical alternative 如此 — confirmed by Hebrew word order אִם כֵּן לָמָּה זֶּה אָנֹכִי
UNV 活著 (in the main clause) is an interpretive expansion with no SN; LCC instead renders זֶּה as 這樣 and leaves no equivalent for 活著, so WH02088 attaches to LCC 這樣 (based on the UNV alternate reading)
LCC 尋問 = UNV 求問 = דָּרַשׁ (WH01875) — different Chinese synonyms, same Hebrew root
LCC 永恆主 = UNV 耶和華 = יְהוָה (WH03068) — LCC's distinctive rendering of the divine name
{<WAH0853>} retained as implicit — LCC has no explicit word for the Hebrew direct-object marker אֶת

Gen/25.lcc_original: 永恆主對她說：『兩國在你腹內，從你肚腹中就有兩族分立着，這族必強過那族，大的必服事小的。』
notes: 耶和華 (UNV) → 永恆主 (LCC): both render YHWH; <WH03068> attached to 永恆主
LCC restructures second clause: UNV '兩族要從你身上出來' → LCC '從你肚腹中就有兩族分立着'; <WAH04480><WH04578> placed on 肚腹中, second 兩<WH08147>族<WH03816> preserved, <WH06504><WTH8735> on 分立着
UNV 身上 → LCC 肚腹中 for <WH04578> (מֵעִים, bowels/womb); LCC 肚腹 is semantically more precise than UNV 身上
UNV 出來 → LCC 分立着 for <WH06504> (פָּרַד, to separate/divide); LCC's rendering better captures the Hebrew nuance
UNV 將來 (before 大的) has no SN and no LCC equivalent — unannotated by omission
<WAH04480><WH03816> on 那族: מִן prefix creates comparative sense ('stronger than that nation')

Gen/25.lcc_original: 她生產的日期到了，腹中果然是一對雙子！
notes: 她 left unannotated: subject implied by Hebrew verb conjugation, made explicit in LCC with pronoun — no Hebrew SN equivalent
日期 (LCC) aligns with 日子 (UNV), both rendering יוֹם (WH03117)
一對 left unannotated; WH08380 (תְּאוֹמִים = twins) attached to full phrase 一對雙子 at 雙子
是 left unannotated (copula supplied by Chinese syntax, not a Hebrew lexeme here)

Gen/25.lcc_original: 先出來的渾身有紅毛、像毛皮衣；他們就給他起名叫以掃。
Gen/25.unv_sn_reference: 先<WH07223>產<WH03318><WTH8799>的身體發紅<WH0132>，渾身<WAH03605>有毛<WH08181>，如同皮衣<WAH09003><WH0155>，他們就給他起<WH07121><WTH8799>名<WH08034>叫以掃<WH06215>（就是有毛的意思）。
notes: LCC merges UNV's separate 身體發紅(H0132) and 渾身有毛(H8181) into 渾身有紅毛 — split by attaching H0132 to 紅 and H8181 to the first 毛.
The second 毛 in 像毛皮衣 is LCC's own descriptive compound element (no Hebrew equivalent); H8181 is not reused.
UNV's parenthetical 就是有毛的意思 is absent in LCC — no SNs dropped, it was a gloss with no own SN tags.
渾身 appears in different relative position vs. UNV but the WAH03605 attachment is unambiguous.

Gen/25.lcc_original: 隨後他的兄弟也出來了；他的手抓住以掃的腳跟；他的名字就叫做雅各；以撒生下兩個兒子的時候、正六十歲。
Gen/25.unv_sn_reference: 隨後<WH0310>又<WAH03651>生了<WH03318><WTH8804>以掃的兄弟<WH0251>，手<WH03027>抓住<WH0270><WTH8802>以掃<WH06215>的腳跟<WAH09002><WH06119>，因此給他起名<WH08034>叫<WH07121><WTH8799>雅各<WH03290>（就是抓住的意思）。利百加生下<WAH09002><WH03205><WTH8800>兩個兒子<WAH0853>的時候，以撒<WH03327>年正六十<WH08346>歲<WH08141><WH01121>。
notes: Clause 1: LCC reorders to subject-first (他的兄弟…也出來了) vs UNV's verb-first (又生了…兄弟); WH0251 attaches to 他的兄弟, WAH03651 to 也 (capturing the 'also/so' sense of כֵּן), WH03318+WTH8804 to 出來了
Clause 4: LCC uses 以撒 (Isaac) as subject of 生下 rather than UNV's 利百加 (Rebekah); 利百加 carries no SN tag in UNV so no annotation is lost; WH03327 follows 以撒 as in UNV
UNV's explanatory parenthetical （就是抓住的意思）is absent in LCC; all SNs in that clause were already assigned to words before the parenthesis
因此 (UNV) and 的時候 (LCC) are Chinese structural connectives with no direct Hebrew counterpart; left unannotated

Gen/25.lcc_original: 兩個孩子漸漸長大；以掃很懂得打獵，是個田野的人；雅各爲人安靜；他常住在帳棚裏。
notes: LCC restructures the Hebrew 'אִישׁ יֹדֵעַ צַיִד אִישׁ שָׂדֶה' (a man knowing hunting, a man of the field) into 很懂得打獵，是個田野的人 — SNs redistributed accordingly across the two clauses.
UNV's {<WAH01961>}{<WTH8799>} (implicit 'was/became') is explicit in LCC as 是 — braces dropped, annotated as 是<WAH01961><WTH8799>.

First {<WH0376>} (implicit 'man' modifying 'knowing hunting') has no explicit LCC counterpart since LCC uses 很懂得 without a preceding 個人 structure — kept implicit as {<WH0376>}, placed after 打獵 at the clause boundary.
Second {<WH0376>} ('a man of the field') is explicit in LCC as 人 in 的人 — braces dropped.
LCC adds pronoun 他 before 常住 (no Hebrew equivalent) — left unannotated.

Gen/25.lcc_original: 以撒愛以掃，因爲以掃獵取的肉合他的胃口；利伯加卻愛雅各。
notes: UNV's 常吃 carries no SN of its own — it is a Chinese paraphrase of the Hebrew stative clause כִּי-צַיִד בְּפִיו (because game was in his mouth); LCC renders this as two phrases instead
LCC's 以掃獵取的肉 covers צַיִד (WH06718, game/venison); the repeated 以掃 here is LCC's explicit subject clarification with no Hebrew counterpart — left unannotated
LCC's 合他的胃口 (suited his taste) is an idiomatic rendering of בְּפִיו (WAH09002+WH06310, in his mouth) — both tags attached to the full phrase
LCC happens to follow Hebrew word order here (game → in-his-mouth), unlike UNV which reverses them for Chinese readability; tag order follows LCC's surface order accordingly
{<WAH0853>} retained in both clauses — LCC has no explicit direct-object particle, same as UNV

Gen/25.lcc_original: 有一天，雅各正熬着豆湯，以掃從田野間回來，疲乏極了。
notes: LCC expands UNV 湯 to 豆湯 (lentil stew) — H05138 attaches to the full compound 豆湯 as one semantic unit
LCC 正…着 is a durative aspect construction with no Hebrew equivalents; both particles left unannotated
LCC 田野間: 間 is a spatial particle added by LCC; H07704 attaches only to 田野
{WAH01931} kept implicit — LCC also has no explicit word for the Hebrew pronoun הוּא here
LCC 疲乏極了 vs UNV 累昏了: H05889 (עָיֵף) attaches to 疲乏 (semantic core); 極了 is an LCC intensifier with no Hebrew equivalent

Gen/25.lcc_original: 以掃對雅各說：『那紅的那紅的、給我嘓點兒吧；我疲乏極了；因此以掃的名字也叫以東。
notes: LCC inverts clause order from UNV/Hebrew: the food request comes before the reason clause (我疲乏極了), while Hebrew/UNV places the reason clause first — {<WAH03588>} (כִּי = because) is repositioned accordingly to before 我疲乏極了.

WAH04480 (מִן = from/partitive) attached to 給我 as the best available correspondence; LCC's idiom 給我嘓點兒 absorbs the Hebrew partitive 'from the red' into a single request phrase with no standalone 'from' word.
那紅的那紅的: the leading 那 assigned WAH02088 (הַזֶּה = this/that demonstrative); each 紅的 gets one WH0122 for the doubled הָאָדֹם הָאָדֹם.
吧 (sentence-final request particle) assigned WAH04994 (נָא = please) as the closest semantic equivalent.
{<WH08034>} (שֵׁם = name) is implicit in UNV (以掃{<WH08034>}) but LCC explicitly renders it as 名字 — braces dropped per rule 3: 名字<WH08034>.

Gen/25.lcc_original: 雅各說：『你先把你的長子名分賣給我吧。』
notes: 今日 (UNV, כַּיּוֹם H09003+H03117 = 'as of this day/right now') → 先 (LCC, 'first/at once'): different lexical choices but both express immediacy; SNs attached to 先 as the functional equivalent
長子的名分<WH01062> (UNV) → 你的長子名分<WH01062> (LCC adds 你的 possessive); SN placed after 名分 as the head noun anchor
No SN for 你 (pronoun) or 吧 (particle), consistent with UNV source having no annotations for these

Gen/25.lcc_original: 以掃說：『我快要死了，長子名分於我有甚麼益處？』
notes: LCC 快要 maps to UNV 將要 (H1980, הוֹלֵךְ, 'going/walking' = 'about to'); morphology WTH8802 follows.
LCC 了 is a Chinese aspect particle with no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated.
UNV demonstrative 這 (WAH02088) has no explicit LCC equivalent; WAH02088 merged with WH01062 onto 長子名分 per rule 6 (one LCC phrase covering multiple Hebrew words).
{<WAH02009>} kept implicit — LCC has no explicit word for הִנֵּה (behold/lo).
益處 carries no SN tag in UNV either; it is a Chinese explanatory addition with no direct Hebrew lexeme, so left unannotated in LCC as well.
LCC omits sentence-final particle 呢; no SN was attached to 呢 in UNV so no tag loss occurs.

Gen/25.lcc_original: 雅各說：『先對我起誓吧。』以掃就對他起誓，把長子的名分賣給雅各。
notes: UNV '你今日' (Hebrew כַּיּוֹם = 'as today/this very day') → LCC '先' ('first/right now'): different surface form but both translate the same Hebrew phrase; <WAH09003><WH03117> attached to '先'.
UNV has '起了誓' with aspect particle 了; LCC has '起誓' — 了 has no Hebrew equivalent and is correctly left unannotated.
LCC uses 『』 quotation marks vs UNV 「」; LCC punctuation preserved exactly.

Gen/25.lcc_original: 於是雅各將餅和紅豆湯給了以掃，以掃就喫就喝，便起來，逕自走他的去了。以掃這樣地輕看了他的長子名分。
notes: 就喫/就喝: LCC prefixes 就 (aspect/sequential connector) before each verb; 就 has no Hebrew equivalent and is left unannotated
逕自走他的去了: LCC elaborates UNV 走了 with 逕自 (straightaway) and idiomatic 他的去了 (went on his way); SNs attached after 走 as the primary lexical match for הָלַךְ, leaving 逕自 and 他的去了 unannotated
這樣地: LCC inserts 這樣地 (in this way/manner) before 輕看了 as an explicative addition with no Hebrew counterpart; left unannotated
{<WAH0853>} retained: the direct object marker אֵת has no explicit Chinese word in LCC, so braces are preserved per Rule 4

Gen/26.lcc_original: 當亞伯拉罕在世的日子、頭一次饑荒之外，那地又有饑荒，以撒就往基拉耳、到非利士人的王亞比米勒那裏。
notes: WAH0834 (אֲשֶׁר, relative particle) attached to 當: LCC uses 當…的日子 as a unified temporal construction; 當 carries the relative/temporal function rather than an explicit relative clause marker.
WH03212+WTH8799 (הָלַךְ, 'go') co-attached to 往 alongside WAH0413 (אֶל): LCC omits a separate 去 character; 往 absorbs both the directional preposition and the motion verb.

WAH04480+WAH09001+WH0905 (מִלְּבַד, 'besides/apart from') attached to 之外: Hebrew/UNV preposes this preposition before the noun phrase, but LCC postposes 之外 after 饑荒; tags follow LCC word order by attaching after 之外.
WAH09002 appears twice (once for 的日子, once for 那地) matching the two occurrences of the ב- prefix in Hebrew (בִּימֵי and בָּאָרֶץ); both are preserved in the annotated output.

Gen/26.lcc_original: 永恆主向以撒顯現說：『你不要下埃及去，要在我給你說明之地居住。
notes: 耶和華→永恆主: LCC rendering of YHWH (H03068); tag attached to full name 永恆主
UNV relative clause 所<WAH0834>指示你的地 restructured in LCC as 給你說明之地; WAH0834 (אֲשֶׁר) assigned to 之, the classical Chinese attributive/relative marker serving the same grammatical role as 所...的
UNV 指示<WH0559> (to tell/indicate) → LCC 說明 (to explain/make clear); same Hebrew root אמר applies
UNV 住<WH07931> → LCC 居住 (compound verb for 'dwell'); LCC also inverts word order from 住在…地 to 在…居住, so WH07931+WTH8798 attach to 居住 at end of clause
給你<WAH0413>: 給 carries the directional sense of אֶל; tag placed after 你 to match UNV tagging convention (tag follows last syllable of phrase)

Gen/26.lcc_original: 你寄居在這地，我必與你同在，賜福與你，因爲我要將這些地賜給你和你的後裔；我必實行我向你父亞伯拉罕所起的誓。
notes: WAH03605 (כֹּל, 'all') dropped: UNV renders it explicitly as 都, but LCC omits this word entirely from '這些地'; no LCC word to attach the tag to.
UNV 堅定 (WH06965, qum = confirm/establish) → LCC 實行 (carry out/fulfill); same Hebrew referent but different Chinese rendering; WH06965+WTH8689 attached to 實行.
LCC 賜福與你 vs UNV 賜福給你: parallel phrasing, tags placed at phrase end following UNV positioning pattern.
Missing SNs: 03605

Gen/26.lcc_original: 我必使你的後裔增多、如同天上的星；我必將這一切地都賜給你的後裔；地上萬國都必用你後裔的名來給自己祝福。
notes: LCC restructures first clause as causative 使…增多 rather than transitive 加增；WH07235+WTH8689 placed on 增多 as the primary verb of multiplication
{<WAH0853>} kept implicit before 你的後裔 in first clause — LCC 使 is a causative marker, not an explicit accusative particle, so no Chinese word directly represents אֵת

LCC adds 一切 (not present in UNV SN structure); WH0411 (אֵלֶּה, 'these') placed on 這, WAH03605 (כֻּלָּנָה, 'all') placed on 都 following UNV's own choice of 都 for WAH03605; LCC's extra 一切 left unannotated

Third clause: LCC expands the Hebrew Hithpael reflexive (הִתְבָּרְכוּ) as 用你後裔的名來給自己祝福 — WAH09002 (ב prefix 'by/through') placed on 用, WH02233 on 後裔, WH01288+WTH8694 on 祝福; the added words 的名來給自己 are LCC's interpretive rendering of the reflexive stem and carry no separate SN
LCC inserts an extra 都 before 必 in the third clause (not in UNV); left unannotated as a Chinese discourse particle

Gen/26.lcc_sn: 這是因爲<WH06118>{<WAH0834>}亞伯拉罕<WH085>聽了<WH08085><WTH8804>我的聲音<WAH09002><WH06963>，遵守<WH08104><WTH8799>我所吩咐守的<WH04931>、又守我的命令<WH04687>、條例<WH02708>和律法<WH08451>。』
Gen/26.lcc_original: 這是因爲亞伯拉罕聽了我的聲音，遵守我所吩咐守的、又守我的命令、條例和律法。』
notes: 都因 (H6118) → 因爲: tag attached after 因爲; {<WAH0834>} kept implicit since LCC has no explicit relative pronoun corresponding to אֲשֶׁר — 因爲 absorbs both semantically
我的話 (H6963 = קוֹל voice) → 我的聲音: LCC's 聲音 is actually more literal for H6963 than UNV's 話
H4931 (מִשְׁמֶרֶת, charge/obligation) expands in LCC to the fuller phrase 我所吩咐守的; tag placed at end of the full phrase
LCC's 又守 before 命令 is a stylistic repetition of the governing verb שָׁמַר; H8104 tagged only on first 遵守 per UNV's single occurrence
律例 (H2708 חֻקָּה statute) → 條例; 法度 (H8451 תּוֹרָה law/Torah) → 律法

Gen/26.lcc_original: 以撒就住在基拉耳。
notes: LCC and UNV are lexically identical for this verse; all five tags transfer directly with no ambiguity. WAH09002 (prepositional prefix ב) + WH01642 (גְּרָר/Gerar) attach together to 在基拉耳 as in UNV.

Gen/26.lcc_original: 那地方的人問到他的妻子，以撒就說：『那是我的妹妹』，原來他怕、不敢說『是我的妻子』；他心裏想：『恐怕這地方的人爲了利伯加的緣故來殺我，因爲她容貌俊美。』
notes: UNV 他便說 → LCC 以撒就說 (LCC names Isaac explicitly; SNs 0559+8799 attach to 說)
UNV 妹子 → LCC 妹妹 (different word, same referent; WH0269 transferred to 妹妹)
UNV 說<WAH09001><WH0559><WTH8800> → LCC 不敢說 (LCC adds 不敢 to express the fear nuance; all three tags attach after 說)
UNV 為 → LCC 爲了 (WAH05921 placed after 爲了 as single phrase)
UNV 利百加 → LCC 利伯加 (same person/Rebekah, different romanization; WH07259 transferred)
UNV 殺我 → LCC 來殺我 (LCC adds directional 來; WH02026+8799 attach after 殺我)
UNV places 因為她容貌俊美 outside the closing quote; LCC folds it inside the 『』 — SNs transferred faithfully regardless of punctuation scope difference
他心裏想 has no SN in UNV; left unannotated in LCC as well

Gen/26.lcc_original: 以撒住在那裏的日子長了；有一天，非利士人的王亞比米勒從窗戶裏眺望，看見以撒和他的妻子利伯加在嬉戲。
notes: UNV uses pronoun 他 for Isaac in the first clause; LCC explicitly names 以撒 — H9001 (waw prefix) transferred to 以撒 as the corresponding explicit subject

UNV bundles H748+WTH8804+H3117 onto the phrase 住了許久; LCC's structure allows disambiguation: 日子<WH03117> (הַיָּמִים = the days) and 長了<WH0748><WTH8804> (אָרְכוּ = were long); 住 is a Chinese translation aid with no Hebrew correspondent, left unannotated
UNV 往外觀看 → LCC 眺望 (synonymous, both render שָׁקַף = to look out); H8259+WTH8686 attached to 眺望
H2009 (הִנֵּה = behold) has no explicit counterpart in LCC — kept as implicit {<WAH02009>} before 看見
利百加 (UNV) → 利伯加 (LCC) — same person, different transliteration convention; H7259 transferred unchanged
UNV 戲玩 → LCC 在嬉戲; 在 is a Chinese progressive aspect particle with no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated; H6711+WTH8764 attached to 嬉戲

Gen/26.lcc_original: 亞比米勒就召了以撒來，說：『你看，她實在是你的妻子；你怎麼說：她是你的妹妹呢？』以撒對他說：『因爲我心裏說：「恐怕我因她而死。」』
notes: UNV {<WAH02009>} (הִנֵּה, behold) is implicit, but LCC renders it explicitly as 你看 — dropped braces per Rule 3
UNV {<WAH0413>} (אֵלָיו, to him) is implicit in Isaac's speech attribution, but LCC renders it explicitly as 對他 in 以撒對他說 — dropped braces per Rule 3
UNV {<WAH03588>} (כִּי, because/that) is implicit, but LCC renders it explicitly as 因爲 — dropped braces per Rule 3
LCC restructures dialogue: UNV places 對他說 before the speech for Abimelech (with no SN on 對他), while LCC omits 對他 there; for Isaac's reply LCC adds 對他 explicitly matching the Hebrew אֵלָיו
就 (LCC connective particle) and 呢 (sentence-final question particle) have no Hebrew equivalents — left unannotated
UNV 妹子 → LCC 妹妹 (same meaning, sister) — <WH0269> transferred to 妹妹

Gen/26.lcc_sn: 亞比米勒<WH040>說<WH0559><WTH8799>：『你這向我們<WAH09001>作<WH06213><WTH8804>的是甚麼事<WAH04100><WAH02063>呢？民間<WH05971>險些兒<WAH09003><WH04592>有人<WH0259>和<WAH0854>你妻子<WH0802>同寢<WH07901><WTH8804>呢；那你就使<WH0935><WTH8689>我們<WAH05921>有了罪<WH0817>了。』
Gen/26.lcc_original: 亞比米勒說：『你這向我們作的是甚麼事呢？民間險些兒有人和你妻子同寢呢；那你就使我們有了罪了。』
notes: 民間 (LCC) covers both 民 (WH05971) and 中 in UNV; SN attached to the full compound word.
險些兒 (LCC) = 險些 (UNV) + 兒 suffix; WAH09003+WH04592 placed after the full form.

Last clause heavily restructured: UNV '把我們<WAH05921>陷在<WH0935><WTH8689>罪<WH0817>裡' → LCC '使我們有了罪了'. WH0935+WTH8689 (בוֹא causative) anchored to 使; WAH05921 (עַל upon) anchored to 我們; WH0817 (אָשָׁם guilt) anchored to 罪.
LCC adds sentence-final particles 呢 (mid) and 了 (final) with no Hebrew equivalents; left unannotated.
UNV 你的妻 → LCC 你妻子: same referent, WH0802 attached to 妻子.

Gen/26.lcc_original: 於是亞比米勒吩咐衆民說：『凡觸害着這個人或是他妻子的，一定得死。』
notes: 吩咐 (LCC) maps to 曉諭 (UNV) for WH06680 (צוה, to command/charge) — clear semantic equivalent
觸害 (LCC) maps to 沾 (UNV) for WH05060 (נגע, to touch/strike) — LCC adds 害 (harm) but covers the same Hebrew root
LCC 一定得死 splits as 一定<WH04191><WTH8800>得死<WH04191><WTH8714> to preserve the cognate infinitive absolute construction (מות יומת — 'dying he shall die')
{<WAH0853>} kept implicit — LCC has no explicit object marker word, same as UNV
LCC omits UNV's 把他 (him) before 治死; tags consolidated onto 得死

Gen/26.lcc_original: 以撒在那地播種，就在那一年得了百倍的收成：永恆主賜福與他。
notes: LCC 播種 maps to UNV 耕種 (different character, same root WH02232 זָרַע = sow)
WH04672 (מָצָא = find/attain) anchors to 得了 in LCC rather than 收成 as in UNV — 得了 is the explicit verb in LCC's phrasing
LCC 永恆主 = UNV 耶和華 = WH03068 (יְהוָה)
Chinese connective 就 and aspect particle 了 have no Hebrew equivalents; left unannotated
LCC punctuation (colon ：instead of period, final 。) preserved exactly

Gen/26.lcc_original: 他就昌大，越來越大，直到成了極大的財主。
notes: 日增月盛 (H3212+H1980+H1432: וַיֵּלֶךְ הָלוֹךְ וְגָדֵל, 'kept going and growing') maps as a unified idiom to 越來越大; all three SNs and morphology codes attached to the end of that phrase per Rule 6.
{<WAH05704>}{<WAH03588>} were implicit in UNV (עַד כִּי, 'until that'); LCC has explicit 直到 covering both, so braces dropped per Rule 3 and both tags attached to 直到.
Final clause 成了極大的財主 covers גָדַל מְאֹד; H1431 (great) and H3966 (very/exceedingly) merge into 極大 while 財主 is the nominal predicate; all tags placed at phrase end following UNV's pattern.

Gen/26.lcc_original: 他有羊羣、牛羣、又有許多僕婢，非利士人就嫉妒他。
notes: LCC uses 僕婢 (male and female servants) where UNV has 僕人 (servants); <WH05657> attaches to 僕婢 as the semantically equivalent phrase
LCC uses traditional character 羣 vs UNV's 群 — same word, no alignment impact
LCC uses 、 (enumeration comma) between list items instead of UNV's ，; punctuation preserved exactly as in LCC source

Gen/26.lcc_sn: 當他父親<WH01>亞伯拉罕<WH085>在世的日子<WAH09002><WH03117>，他父親<WH01>的僕人<WH05650>所<WAH0834>挖<WH02658><WTH8804>的井<WH0875>、非利士人<WH06430>全都<WAH03605>塞住<WH05640><WTH8765>，塡滿<WH04390><WTH8762>了土<WH06083>。
Gen/26.lcc_original: 當他父親亞伯拉罕在世的日子，他父親的僕人所挖的井、非利士人全都塞住，塡滿了土。
Gen/26.unv_sn_reference: 當他父親<WH01>亞伯拉罕<WH085>在世的日子<WAH09002><WH03117>，他父親<WH01>的僕人<WH05650>所<WAH0834>挖<WH02658><WTH8804>的井<WH0875>，非利士人<WH06430>全都<WAH03605>塞住<WH05640><WTH8765>，填滿<WH04390><WTH8762>了土<WH06083>。
notes: LCC uses 、(enumeration mark) after 井 instead of UNV's ，— punctuation preserved as-is per rules
LCC uses variant character 塡 (vs UNV 填) — same word, SN attached identically
了 left unannotated: Chinese perfective aspect particle with no Hebrew correspondent

Gen/26.lcc_original: 亞比米勒對以撒說：『你離開我們去吧；因爲你比我們非常強盛。』
notes: LCC inverts the word order of UNV's 強盛得多: LCC uses 非常強盛 (intensifier before verb) vs UNV 強盛<WH06105><WTH8804>得多<WH03966>. Mapped 非常→<WH03966> (מְאֹד, very/greatly) and 強盛→<WH06105><WTH8804>.
LCC 因爲 (traditional 爲) vs UNV 因為 — same lexeme, SN <WAH03588> attached identically.
LCC's original punctuation (『』 guillemets, semicolon after 吧) preserved exactly as-is.

Gen/26.lcc_original: 以撒就離開那裏，在基拉耳的谿谷支帳棚，住在那裏。
notes: LCC 谿谷 (wadi/ravine) covers the same referent as UNV 谷 (נַחַל WH05158); both WAH09002 (בְּ prefix) and WH05158 attach to 谿谷, matching UNV's grouping on its 谷.
LCC inserts 的 (possessive particle) between 基拉耳 and 谿谷; left unannotated as a Chinese grammatical particle with no Hebrew equivalent.
LCC 支帳棚 is a condensed form of UNV 支搭帳棚 (חָנָה WH02583); SN attaches normally to the shorter form.
在 before 基拉耳 is an unannotated Chinese preposition; the Hebrew בְּ prefix is captured on 谿谷 as WAH09002, consistent with UNV's annotation pattern.

Gen/26.lcc_original: 當他父親亞伯拉罕在世的日子、僕人們所挖的水井、非利士人在亞伯拉罕死後都塞住了；以撒又挖出來，仍照他父親所叫的名字叫那些井。
notes: LCC '僕人們' has no Hebrew equivalent (subject was implicit in Hebrew); left unannotated.
LCC '都' (all/both) is a Chinese clarifying word with no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated.
LCC '又' corresponds to UNV '就重新' — both express WH07725 (שׁוּב, to return/again); tagged '又<WH07725><WTH8799>'.

UNV has WH08034 (name) twice: once implicit '{<WH08034>}' in the relative clause, once explicit at the end ('的名字'). LCC collapses these into one '名字' before 叫. The first WH08034 is explicit in LCC so braces are dropped and tagged '名字<WH08034>'. The second WH08034 has no corresponding LCC word and is kept implicit as '{<WH08034>}' after 那些井.
{<WAH0853>} (direct object marker את) remains implicit after 挖出來 — LCC has no explicit word for it, same as UNV.

Gen/26.lcc_original: 以撒的僕人在谿谷中挖着挖着，在那裏挖得了一口活水井。
notes: LCC '谿谷' vs UNV '谷' — both render נחל (H05158); tags WAH09002+WH05158 placed after the full phrase 在谿谷中
LCC reduplicates the digging verb as '挖着挖着' (continuous aspect) where UNV has '挖井'; WH02658+WTH8799 placed after the full reduplicated form
UNV {<WAH08033>} is implicit (no Chinese word for שם); LCC explicitly renders it as '那裏' — per Rule 3 braces dropped and tag attached directly after 那裏
LCC '挖得了' conflates digging and finding into one compound verb; SN for מצא (WH04672) and its morphology (WTH8799) placed after the full compound
UNV first '井' (in 挖…井) carries no SN and has no LCC counterpart at that position — LCC moves directly to the found-well clause; no annotation gap introduced

Gen/26.lcc_original: 基拉耳的牧人和以撒的牧人就爭鬧起來說：『這水是我們的。』以撒就給那井起名叫埃色，因爲他們和他相爭。
notes: LCC uses 和 where UNV has 與 for WAH05973 ('with/and'); SN transferred to 和.

LCC's verbal phrase 就爭鬧起來 expands UNV's single verb 爭競; 就 and 起來 are Chinese aspectual/directional additions with no Hebrew equivalents, so WH07378/WTH8799 are attached after the full verbal phrase 爭鬧起來.
LCC omits UNV's parenthetical gloss （就是相敵的意思）entirely; no SNs are lost as that text was explanatory and carried no additional SN tags.
Second occurrence of 以撒 (in 以撒就給那井) correctly receives no WH03327 tag, matching UNV.

Gen/26.lcc_sn: 以撒的僕人另<WH0312>挖<WH02658><WTH8799>了一口井<WH0875>，他們又<WAH01571>爲這井<WAH05921>爭鬧<WH07378><WTH8799>，因此以撒給這井起名<WH08034>叫<WH07121><WTH8799>西提拿<WH07856>。
Gen/26.lcc_original: 以撒的僕人另挖了一口井，他們又爲這井爭鬧，因此以撒給這井起名叫西提拿。
Gen/26.unv_sn_reference: 以撒的僕人又挖<WH02658><WTH8799>了一口井<WH0875>，他們又<WAH01571>為這井<WAH05921>{<WH0312>}爭競<WH07378><WTH8799>，因此以撒給這井起名<WH08034>叫<WH07121><WTH8799>西提拿<WH07856>（就是為敵的意思）。
notes: H0312 (אַחֶרֶת, 'another') is implicit {<WH0312>} in UNV, placed awkwardly in the second clause; in Hebrew it belongs to the first clause modifying 'well'. LCC makes it explicit as '另' in '另挖了一口井' — Rule 3 applied: braces dropped, tag attached to '另' in first clause.
LCC '爭鬧' (quarrel/bicker) corresponds to UNV '爭競' for H07378 (רִיב, to contend/strive).

Gen/26.lcc_original: 以撒從那裏往前進，另挖了一口井；他們不爲這井爭鬧了，他就給那井起名叫利河伯；他說：『現在永恆主使我們擴張出去，我們就要在這地生殖起來了。』
notes: 從<WAH04480>那裏<WAH08033>往前進<WH06275><WTH8686>: LCC restructures UNV '離開那裡' as '從那裏往前進' — 從 takes WAH04480 (מִן 'from'), 那裏 takes WAH08033 (שָׁם 'there'), and 進 takes the main verb WH06275+WTH8686.
Word order in quoted speech differs: LCC has 現在永恆主 vs UNV's 耶和華現在 — SNs follow LCC's word order accordingly.
{<WAH03588>} retained as implicit: LCC begins the quotation without any explicit כִּי conjunction.
永恆主<WH03068>: LCC's rendering of יְהוָה (WH03068).
使我們<WAH09001>擴張出去<WH07337><WTH8689>: LCC renders the Hiphil הִרְחִיב לָנוּ as a causative construction 使我們擴張出去 — 我們 represents לָנוּ (WAH09001), 擴張出去 represents the Hiphil verb (WH07337+WTH8689).
生殖<WH06509><WTH8804>起來了: 起來了 are directional/aspect complements with no Hebrew equivalents; only 生殖 receives WH06509+WTH8804.

Gen/26.lcc_original: 以撒從那裏上別是巴。
notes: UNV 從那裡 and LCC 從那裏 are the same word (裡/裏 variant characters); <WAH04480><WAH08033> attached after 那裏 as in UNV
UNV has a trailing 去 with no SN; LCC omits it entirely — no annotation impact

Gen/26.lcc_sn: 那<WAH01931>一夜<WAH09002><WH03915>裏、永恆主<WH03068>向他<WAH0413>顯現<WH07200><WTH8735>說<WH0559><WTH8799>：『我是<WAH0595>你父親<WH01>亞伯拉罕<WH085>的上帝<WH0430>；你不要<WAH0408>怕<WH03372><WTH8799>，因爲<WAH03588>是我與你同在<WH0854>；我必賜福<WH01288><WTH8765>與你，使<WAH0853>你的後裔<WH02233>增多<WH07235><WTH8689>，都是爲了我僕人<WH05650>亞伯拉罕<WH085>的緣故<WAH09002><WAH05668>。』
Gen/26.lcc_original: 那一夜裏、永恆主向他顯現說：『我是你父親亞伯拉罕的上帝；你不要怕，因爲是我與你同在；我必賜福與你，使你的後裔增多，都是爲了我僕人亞伯拉罕的緣故。』
Gen/26.unv_sn_reference: 當<WAH01931>夜<WAH09002><WH03915>耶和華<WH03068>向他<WAH0413>顯現<WH07200><WTH8735>，說<WH0559><WTH8799>：「我是<WAH0595>你父親<WH01>亞伯拉罕<WH085>的　神<WH0430>，不要<WAH0408>懼怕<WH03372><WTH8799>！因為<WAH03588>我與你同在<WH0854>，要賜福給你<WH01288><WTH8765>，並要為我僕人<WH05650>亞伯拉罕<WH085>的緣故<WAH09002><WAH05668>，使<WAH0853>你的後裔<WH02233>繁多<WH07235><WTH8689>。」
notes: UNV 神 (WH0430 = אֱלֹהִים) → LCC 上帝: systematic translation divergence, no alignment ambiguity
LCC reverses clause order: '使你的後裔增多，都是爲了…的緣故' vs UNV '為…的緣故，使你的後裔繁多'; SNs placed with semantic equivalents regardless of clause position
UNV '當<WAH01931>夜<WAH09002><WH03915>' → LCC '那一夜裏': 那 takes WAH01931 (הוּא = that/demonstrative), 一夜 takes the ב-prefix + לַיְלָה complex (WAH09002+WH03915); 裏 is a locative particle, unannotated
LCC adds emphatic 是 in '因爲是我與你同在' and auxiliary 必 in '我必賜福與你'; both left unannotated as they have no Hebrew equivalents
WAH0853 (אֵת direct-object marker) retained on 使, consistent with UNV's attachment pattern for the causative construction

Gen/26.lcc_original: 以撒就在那裏築了一座壇，呼求永恆主的名，在那裏搭帳棚；以撒的僕人也在那裏開掘了一口井。
notes: 求告 (UNV) → 呼求 (LCC): different verbs, same semantic domain 'call upon/invoke'; SN WH07121 attached to 呼求
耶和華 (UNV) → 永恆主 (LCC): LCC's rendering of the divine name YHWH; SN WH03068 attached to 永恆主
UNV implicit {<WAH08033>} after 帳棚 becomes explicit 在那裏 in LCC (placed before 搭 per LCC word order); braces dropped per Rule 3
UNV pronoun 他{<WH03327>} becomes explicit 以撒 in LCC; braces dropped per Rule 3 — results in two tagged 以撒 occurrences in the verse
支搭 (UNV) → 搭 (LCC): LCC uses shorter verb; morphology WTH8799 follows immediately after 搭
LCC 也 (discourse particle, cf. UNV 便) has no SN and is left unannotated; <WAH08033> attaches to 在那裏 that follows it

Gen/26.lcc_sn: 亞比米勒<WH040>和他的參謀<WH04828>亞戶撒<WH0276>、他的軍長<WH06635><WH08269>非各<WH06369>從基拉耳<WAH04480><WH01642>來<WH01980><WTH8804>見<WAH0413>以撒。
Gen/26.lcc_original: 亞比米勒和他的參謀亞戶撒、他的軍長非各從基拉耳來見以撒。
Gen/26.unv_sn_reference: 亞比米勒<WH040>，同他的朋友<WH04828>亞戶撒<WH0276>和他的軍<WH06635>長<WH08269>非各<WH06369>，從基拉耳<WAH04480><WH01642>來<WH01980><WTH8804>見<WAH0413>以撒。
notes: UNV '朋友' (friend) → LCC '參謀' (counselor/advisor): both render H4828 (רֵעַ), which spans 'companion/friend/advisor'; WH04828 attached to 參謀.
UNV splits 軍<WH06635>長<WH08269> across two tokens; LCC writes 軍長 as a single compound — both SNs attach to the compound word.
UNV '同' (with/and) carries no SN; LCC '和' is its semantic equivalent and likewise receives no SN tag.
WAH04480 (מִן prefix, 'from') kept with 基拉耳 per UNV placement; LCC's 從 expresses the same preposition but carries no separate SN as the prefix is already encoded in the place-name tag.

Gen/26.lcc_original: 以撒對他們說：『你們旣然恨我，打發我走了，爲甚麼又來找我呢？』
notes: LCC renders UNV's 到我這裡來 as 又來找我: WH0935+WTH8804 attached to 來 (the motion verb), WAH0413 attached to 我 (the directional object 'to me'); LCC's added 找 (seek/look for) has no Hebrew equivalent and is left unannotated
{<WAH04480>}{<WAH0854>} retained as implicit — LCC's 走了 does not explicitly render the 'from you' complement any more than UNV does

Gen/26.lcc_original: 他們說：『我們明明看見永恆主與你同在，因此我們說：「讓我們中間，就是你我之間，彼此起誓吧，讓我們與你立約吧；
notes: 明明 (without 地) takes WH07200+WTH8800 (infinitive absolute); 看見 takes WH07200+WTH8804 (finite verb) — preserves the Hebrew rhetorical intensifier ראה ראינו
{WAH03588} kept implicit: LCC has no explicit complementizer 'that' before 永恆主, just as UNV has none
永恆主 is LCC's rendering of 耶和華 → annotated WH03068
因此 left unannotated; SN 0559+8799 placed on 說 only (LCC 因此我們說 ≈ UNV 便說, where only the verb root carries the SN)
讓 (first clause) annotated WAH01961+WTH8799+WAH04994, matching UNV 不如 for Hebrew תְּהִי נָא (let there be + entreaty particle)
中間<WAH0996> maps to UNV 我們<WAH0996>, both rendering בֵּינוֹתֵינוּ (between us)

Three SNs for 直到 (05704+0834+0518 = עַד אֲשֶׁר אִם) all attach to LCC's single word 直到
{WAH0853} (direct object marker אֵת) kept implicit in LCC
LCC adds 過 (aspect particle) and 的事 (nominalizer) in the final clause—Chinese grammar additions, left unannotated
Second and third occurrences of 我 in LCC (in 我必領你回 and 我對你) are subject pronouns embedded in Hebrew verb conjugations; not re-tagged

Gen/28.lcc_original: 雅各睡醒了來，就說：『永恆主居然在這地方，我竟不知道阿！』
notes: 睡醒了來: SNs attach after 睡醒了 (= H03364 יָקַץ + from-sleep H04480+H08142); LCC's 來 is a directional/aspect particle with no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated
就說: LCC's 就 is a connective particle with no Hebrew counterpart, left unannotated; 說 receives H0559+morphology
永恆主 = UNV 耶和華 = H03068 (YHWH); LCC renders the divine name as 永恆主 (Eternal Lord)

這<WAH02088>地方<WAH09002><WH04725>: WAH02088 (זֶה this) attaches to 這; WAH09002 (ב prefix) + WH04725 (מָקוֹם place) attach to 地方

Gen/28.lcc_original: 就起了敬畏的心、說：『這地方何等可畏阿！這不是別的；這就是上帝的殿！這就是天門！』
notes: 就懼怕 → 就起了敬畏的心: WH03372+WTH8799 attached to 心 as the semantic endpoint of the expanded phrase; the full LCC idiom 起了敬畏的心 expresses יִירָא as a single unit.
LCC restructures UNV's 乃是...也是 into two parallel 這就是... sentences. The extra 這 before 就是上帝的殿 is an LCC clarifying addition with no Hebrew equivalent and is left unannotated.
WAH03588+WAH0518 (כִּי אִם, 'none other than / but rather') mapped to 就是 in 這就是上帝的殿.
LCC uses 上帝 instead of 神 for WH0430 (אֱלֹהִים) — systematic LCC convention, no impact on SN assignment.
天的門 (UNV) → 天門 (LCC): WH08064 placed after 天, WH08179 after 門; the 的 is dropped and carries no SN.
就是 in 這<WAH02088>就是天門 represents the implied Hebrew copula in וְזֶה שַׁעַר ('and this [is] the gate') and is left unannotated.

Gen/28.lcc_original: 雅各清早起來，拿放在頭底下的石頭立爲聖柱，澆油在那上頭。
notes: UNV 把<WH03947> → LCC 拿: different Chinese word, same Hebrew root (לָקַח); SN attaches to 拿 normally

UNV relative clause 所<WAH0834>枕<WH07760><WTH8804><WH04763>的 restructured in LCC as 放在頭底下的: WAH0834 (אֲשֶׁר relative pronoun) and verb SNs WH07760+WTH8804 attached to 放 (head of relative clause); WH04763 (מְרַאֲשֹׁתָיו, 'at his head') attached to 在頭底下 as the positional phrase

LCC adds demonstrative 那 before 上頭; left unannotated as it has no Hebrew equivalent; WH07218 (רֹאשׁ, top/head) attaches to 那上頭 as a whole

Gen/28.lcc_original: 就給那地方起名叫伯特利【2】；那城的名字原來叫做路斯。
notes: H0853 (את direct object marker) is implicit in LCC with no explicit Chinese word; kept as {<WAH0853>} before 那地方 phrase
H0199 (אוּלָם 'but/however') is absent in LCC; only the semicolon marks the clause boundary — kept as {<WH0199>}

LCC 那城 (that city) maps to UNV's 那地方 for H05892 (עִיר); LCC more precisely uses 城 'city' matching the Hebrew root, while UNV uses the looser 地方 'place'
UNV initial 他 (subject pronoun) has no SN and is dropped in LCC — no tag needed

Gen/28.lcc_original: 雅各許願說：『上帝如果與我同在，在我所走的這路上保護我，給我食物喫、衣服穿，
notes: UNV 神<WH0430> → LCC 上帝<WH0430>: systematic UNV/LCC difference for אֱלֹהִים; SN maps correctly to 上帝

UNV 的<WAH02088>路上 → LCC 的這<WAH02088>路上: LCC makes the demonstrative זֶה (02088) explicit as 這; 的 is left untagged as a Chinese grammatical particle; SN placed after 這
UNV 又給<WH05414><WTH8804> → LCC 給<WH05414><WTH8804>: 又 is a Chinese stylistic addition in UNV with no Hebrew SN; LCC omits it; SN maps directly to 給
UNV 保佑我<WH08104><WTH8804> → LCC 保護我<WH08104><WTH8804>: synonymous renderings of שָׁמַר (keep/guard/protect)
UNV 吃 → LCC 喫: same morpheme in traditional character form; tags transferred identically

Gen/28.lcc_original: 使我安安然然回到我父親家裏，永恆主就必做我的上帝，

notes: LCC renders YHWH (H03068) as 永恆主 instead of UNV's 耶和華

Gen/28.lcc_original: 我所立爲聖柱的這根石頭就必做上帝的殿；凡你所賜給我的、我必將十分之一獻與你。』
notes: UNV 神<WH0430> → LCC 上帝<WH0430>: systematic LCC preference for 上帝 over 神 for אֱלֹהִים
UNV 的<WAH02063> (זֹאת, 'this') → LCC 這根<WAH02063>: LCC makes the demonstrative explicit with 這根; tag attaches to 這根 which carries the semantic value
爲聖柱<WH04676>: LCC adds 聖 ('holy/sacred') as interpretive gloss not in Hebrew מַצֵּבָה; <WH04676> covers the whole phrase since 柱 is the core referent
Double עָשַׂר emphatic construction (infinitive absolute + finite): 我必<WH06237><WTH8763>將十分之一<WH06237><WTH8762> — LCC structure mirrors UNV exactly so same split applies
獻給你 → 獻與你<WAH09001>: LCC uses 與 as dative marker instead of UNV 給; <WAH09001> (לְךָ) attaches to the full phrase

Gen/29.lcc_original: 雅各舉起腳來再走，到了東方人之地。
notes: 舉起 (LCC) replaces UNV's 起 as the rendering of H05375 (נָשָׂא, to lift); LCC makes the lifting more explicit with the compound verb 舉起
腳 (LCC, foot) replaces UNV's 行 as the rendering of H07272 (רֶגֶל, foot/feet); LCC is more literal while UNV uses 行 idiomatically for the journey

LCC expands the single Hebrew verb וַיֵּלֶךְ (H03212) into 再走…到了; H03212+WTH8799 attached to 到了 to parallel UNV's rendering; 再走 and 來 are Chinese expansions with no Hebrew equivalents and are left unannotated

Gen/29.lcc_original: 他一察看，只見田地裏有一口井；那裏有三羣羊躺在井旁；因爲人都是將那井裏的水給羊羣喝；那井口上的石頭很大。
notes: 察看 ← H7200 (UNV: 看見): LCC uses 察看 (to survey/inspect) vs UNV 看見 (to see); both map to H7200 (ראה).
只見 ← {<WAH02009>}: LCC explicitly renders the first וְהִנֵּה (behold) as 只見; braces dropped per Rule 3 since LCC has an explicit word.
Second {<WAH02009>} kept implicit: no explicit LCC word for the second הִנֵּה; 那裏 maps only to שָׁם (WAH08033).
WAH04480 (מִן/from) → 裏: the prepositional 'from' of מִן-הַבְּאֵר is carried by 裏 in LCC's 那井裏的水, since UNV attaches it to 用 (using/from).
LCC restructures the watering clause as 將那井裏的水給羊羣喝 (take that well's water to give flocks to drink) vs UNV's 人飲羊群都是用那井裏的水; SN roles follow semantics across the reordering.
很 (very, intensifier) before 大 has no Hebrew counterpart in גְּדֹלָה and is left unannotated.

Gen/29.lcc_original: 所有的羊羣都在那裏聚集；人把石頭輥開井口，給羊喝水；然後把石頭輥回井口原處。
notes: 所有的<WAH03605>羊羣<WH05739>: splits Hebrew כֹּל הָעֲדָרִים (H3605=all, H5739=flock) — 所有 → H3605, 羊羣 → H5739
LCC 輥開 absorbs UNV 轉離: 輥→H1556+8804 (roll, qal perf), 開→H4480+H5921 (from-upon = 'rolled open away')
LCC restructures 飲羊 as 給羊喝水 (causative 'let sheep drink'): 羊→H6629, 喝水→H8248+8689; {<WAH0853>} retained as implicit object marker since LCC has no explicit 把 here
Second clause lacks 在 (עַל, H5921): <WAH05921> folded into 輥回 tag cluster since LCC embeds the prepositional sense in the single verb phrase 輥回 rather than a separate preposition word
LCC 輥回 covers UNV 放 (H7725 hiphil = restored/returned the stone); the rolling action implied by 輥 in LCC has no separate SN in this clause — UNV simply used 放

Gen/29.lcc_original: 雅各問牧人說：『弟兄們，你們是哪裏來的？』他們說：『我們是喀蘭來的。』
notes: LCC uses 問...說 where UNV uses 對...說 for the speech-to construction. The <WAH09001> (preposition לְ, 'to/toward') is attached to 牧人 as the governed noun, matching UNV's placement. The word 問 is left unannotated — it is a Chinese stylistic addition with no direct Hebrew counterpart; H0559 (אמר) attaches to 說 as in UNV.
哈蘭 (UNV) → 喀蘭 (LCC): different transliterations of חָרָן (Haran, H02771); SNs transferred normally to 喀蘭.

Gen/29.lcc_original: 他問他們說：『拿鶴的孫子拉班你們認識麼？』他們說：『我們認識。』
notes: LCC is lexically near-identical to UNV here; only punctuation differs (『』vs「」, 麼 vs 嗎, no comma before 你們認識). All SN placements transfer 1:1.
{<WAH0853>} kept implicit — LCC likewise has no explicit Chinese word for the Hebrew direct object marker אֵת, same as UNV.
<WAH09001> (waw-consecutive prefix) and <WH0559><WTH8799> both attach to 說 in the same position as UNV.

Gen/29.lcc_original: 雅各說：『他平安麼？』他們說：『平安。你看，他女兒拉結正和羣羊一同來呢。』
notes: UNV 看哪 → LCC 你看: both render הִנֵּה (WAH02009); tag placed after 看 as the head verb of the interjection
UNV 領著<WAH05973> (loose rendering of עִם 'with') → LCC 正和...一同: WAH05973 attached after 和 as the closest lexical match to עִם; 正 and 一同 are Chinese aspectual/adverbial additions left unannotated
LCC 羣羊 (flock of sheep) vs UNV 羊: tag attaches after the full word 羣羊
UNV 來了 → LCC 來呢: morphology code <WTH8802> follows <WH0935> on 來; sentence-final particle 呢 left unannotated

Gen/29.lcc_original: 雅各說：『你看，日頭還高，不是牲畜聚集的時候呀；給羊喝水，去放放吧。』
notes: UNV's {<WH02005>} (implicit הֵן 'behold') maps to LCC's explicit 你看; braces dropped per Rule 3 since LCC has an explicit word for it.
LCC uses 牲畜 where UNV uses 羊群, both translating WH04735 (מִקְנֶה = livestock/cattle); tag attaches to 牲畜.
UNV's 飲<WH08248><WTH8685> 羊<WH06629> ('water the flock') is restructured in LCC as 給羊喝水; WH06629 attaches to 羊, WH08248+WTH8685 attaches to 喝水; 給 is an unannotated Chinese benefactive marker.
LCC's sentence-final particles 呀 and 吧 have no Hebrew equivalents and are left unannotated.

Gen/29.lcc_original: 他們說：『我們不能；必須等到牧人【1】都聚齊了，人把石頭輥開井口，我們纔能給羊喝水。』
notes: 牧人【1】 left unannotated: LCC uses 'shepherds' where UNV/Hebrew has 羊群 (H5739 = flock/herd); LCC makes the implied human agent explicit while omitting the flock as grammatical subject — attaching H5739 to 牧人 would be semantically misleading
{<WAH0834>} kept implicit: LCC has no explicit word corresponding to H834 (אֲשֶׁר, subordinating conjunction)
輥開 bundles H1556 (גָּלַל, roll) + preposition complex H4480/H5921 (מֵעַל, from upon): LCC fuses the rolling motion and its directional result into one compound verb, so all four tags attach to 輥開
喝水 receives H8248 (שָׁקָה Hiphil = give to drink) + morphology H8689; LCC expresses the causative 'water the flock' as the periphrastic 給羊喝水, with 羊 taking H6629 and 喝水 taking the verbal SNs
Missing SNs: 05739

Gen/29.lcc_sn: 雅各還<WH05750>和他們<WAH05973>說話<WH01696><WTH8764>的時候，拉結<WH07354>和<WAH05973>羣羊<WH06629>一同來了<WH0935><WTH8804>；{<WAH03588>}那些羊<WAH0834>是她父親的<WAH09001><WH01>；是她<WAH01931>在牧放<WH07462><WTH8802>的。

Gen/29.unv_sn_reference: 雅各正<WH05750>和他們<WAH05973>說話<WH01696><WTH8764>的時候，拉結<WH07354>領著<WAH05973>她父親的<WAH09001><WH01>羊<WH06629>來了<WH0935><WTH8804>，因為<WAH03588>那些羊<WAH0834>是她<WAH01931>牧放<WH07462><WTH8802>的。

LCC splits UNV's main+causal two-clause structure into three parallel clauses with semicolons, which accounts for the reduced confidence.

Gen/29.lcc_original: 雅各看見他母舅拉班的女兒拉結，又看見他母舅拉班的羊，就走近前去，把石頭輥開井口，給他母舅拉班的羊喝水。

LCC's 輥開 (roll open/away) compresses UNV's 轉...離 into a single compound, absorbing both the rolling root WH01556/WTH8686 and the 'from upon' preposition WAH04480/WAH05921; all four tags attach to 輥開.

Gen/29.lcc_original: 雅各給拉結親嘴，就放聲而哭。

{<WAH0853>} (direct object marker את) retained as implicit — LCC has no explicit particle for it between 放 and 聲, matching UNV structure exactly.

Gen/29.lcc_original: 雅各告訴拉結說自己是她父親的外甥，是利伯加的兒子；拉結就跑去告訴她父親。

LCC uses 利伯加 vs. UNV's 利百加 — both are transliterations of Rebekah (H07259); SN attached to LCC's form 利伯加

Gen/29.lcc_original: 拉班一聽見他妹妹的兒子雅各的消息【2】，就跑去迎接他，抱着他，直和他親嘴，便領他進自己家裏；雅各就將這一切事向拉班敍說。
notes: וַיְהִי ({<WAH01961>}{<WTH8799>}) placed as implicit at sentence start — LCC does not render this Hebrew narrative opening formula, so braces are retained.
LCC's 一 (in 一聽見, meaning 'upon hearing / as soon as') is assigned <WAH09003><WAH0834> (כַּאֲשֶׁר = 'when/as soon as'). Since LCC has an explicit word, braces are dropped.
UNV's 外甥 (nephew) is glossed as H269 (אָחוֹת = sister) + H1121 (בֵּן = son). LCC expands this to 他妹妹的兒子 — 妹妹 receives H269, 兒子 receives H1121; 他 is an LCC addition and is left unannotated.
Word order is inverted in the final clause: LCC has 這(H428)一切(H3605) while UNV has 一切(H3605)…H428. Tags are assigned to the semantically matching LCC words in their LCC order.
LCC's 向 (toward/to) is assigned <WAH09001> (ל- prefix), corresponding to UNV's prefix attached to 拉班 in 告訴拉班<WAH09001>.

Gen/29.lcc_original: 拉班對雅各說：『你眞是我的骨肉呀你！』雅各就同拉班住了一個月工夫。

UNV '和他<WAH05973>同住' → LCC '同拉班住': <WAH05973> (H05973 עִם, 'with') attached after 同, which serves as the preposition 'with' in LCC
H0389 (אַךְ, surely/indeed) maps to LCC '眞' rather than UNV '實在' — both convey emphatic certainty
LCC '呀你！' is a rhetorical exclamation device (particle 呀 + emphatic repetition of 你) with no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated
LCC '工夫' (duration/period) is an explanatory addition to 一個月 with no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated

Gen/29.lcc_sn: 拉班<WH03837>對雅各<WAH09001><WH03290>說<WH0559><WTH8799>：『是不是因爲<WAH03588>你<WAH0859>是我的外甥<WH0251>，你就得白白地<WH02600>服事我<WH05647><WTH8804>呢？請告訴<WH05046><WTH8685>我<WAH09001>；你的工價<WH04909>怎麼樣<WAH04100>？』
Gen/29.lcc_original: 拉班對雅各說：『是不是因爲你是我的外甥，你就得白白地服事我呢？請告訴我；你的工價怎麼樣？』
Gen/29.unv_sn_reference: 拉班<WH03837>對雅各<WAH09001><WH03290>說<WH0559><WTH8799>：「你<WAH0859>雖是<WAH03588>我的骨肉（原文是弟兄<WH0251>），豈可白白地<WH02600>服事我<WH05647><WTH8804>？請告訴<WH05046><WTH8685>我<WAH09001>，你要甚麼<WAH04100>為工價<WH04909>？」
notes: LCC 外甥 (nephew) and UNV 弟兄 (brother) both render the same Hebrew אָח (H0251); same SN attached despite the different translation choice.
