LCC's opening 是不是 is a Chinese rhetorical yes/no question marker with no Hebrew counterpart; left unannotated.
WAH03588 (כִּי) aligns to 因爲 in LCC vs 雖是 in UNV — both are valid renderings of the causal/concessive particle.

Gen/29.lcc_original: 拉班有兩個女兒；大的名叫利亞，小的名叫拉結。
notes: LCC is lexically identical to UNV; only punctuation differs (LCC uses ；after 女兒, UNV uses ，). All SN tags transferred in place with LCC punctuation preserved exactly.

Gen/29.lcc_original: 利亞的眼睛沒有神氣，拉結卻生得丰姿俊秀、容貌美麗。
notes: The first clause (利亞…拉結…卻生得) maps directly with no ambiguity.

The Hebrew double construct יְפַת-תֹּאַר וִיפַת מַרְאֶה ('beautiful of form and beautiful of appearance') surfaces as two balanced phrases in LCC: 丰姿俊秀 and 容貌美麗. Aligned WH08389 (תֹּאַר, form/figure) to 丰姿 and WH04758 (מַרְאֶה, appearance) to 容貌, with the two instances of WH03303 (יָפֶה, beautiful) attached to 俊秀 and 美麗 respectively.

Confidence slightly reduced because LCC's reordering to an explicit parallel structure (丰姿俊秀、容貌美麗) versus UNV's 美貌俊秀 requires distributing the four SNs by semantic role rather than surface word order.

Gen/29.lcc_original: 雅各愛拉結，就說：『我願爲你的小女兒拉結服事你七年。』
notes: LCC adds 的 between 你 and 小 (structural particle with no Hebrew equivalent) — left unannotated
{<WAH0853>} (accusative marker את) kept implicit as LCC has no explicit word for it
LCC uses 爲 vs UNV 為 and 『』 vs 「」 — LCC original characters and punctuation preserved exactly

Gen/29.lcc_original: 拉班說：『將她給你、比給別人好；你就和我同住吧。』
notes: H2896 (טוֹב, good/better) shifts from UNV's 勝似 to LCC's 好 — UNV uses 勝似 as a single comparative word, LCC uses a 比…好 frame; H2896 belongs to 好 as the semantic carrier of 'good/better'
UNV disposal marker 把 becomes 將 in LCC; neither has a Hebrew equivalent so both are unannotated
WAH05973 (עִם, with) attaches to 和我 in LCC, parallel to 與我 in UNV
{<WAH0853>} retained as implicit in the second clause since LCC also omits the direct object 她 there (比給別人好 has no explicit 她)

Gen/29.lcc_original: 雅各就爲了拉結的緣故服事拉班七年；因爲他愛拉結，這七年在他看、也就如同幾天。
notes: 就爲了拉結<WAH09002><WH07354>的緣故: tags placed after 拉結 (the lexical head) even though LCC appends 的緣故 — ל prefix + Rachel both annotate 拉結 as their anchor
LCC adds 拉班 as explicit object of 服事 (UNV omits it in this verse); left unannotated as it has no SN counterpart
UNV 深愛 → LCC 愛; SN tags (<WAH09002><WH0157><WTH8800>) attach to 愛 since 深 is a Chinese intensifier with no Hebrew equivalent
UNV 就看<WAH09002><WH05869> (Hebrew בְּעֵינָיו, in his eyes) → LCC 在他看; tags attach after 看 as the lexical equivalent
LCC 也就 (Chinese connective bridging the two clauses) left unannotated

Gen/29.lcc_original: 雅各對拉班說：『日期滿了；給妻子呀！我好進去找她。
notes: 已經 (aspect particle) in UNV has no Hebrew equivalent and is absent in LCC; SN tags for H04390+WTH8804 attach only to 滿了.
UNV's polite imperative 求你把 + 給 restructures into LCC's bare imperative 給...呀; accusative marker <WAH0853> attaches to 妻子 per Rule 6 (one LCC word covers both אֵת and אִשָּׁה).
LCC uses 進去找她 ('go in and find/reach her') for UNV's 與她同房 ('enter with her'), both rendering וְאָבֹאָה אֵלֶיהָ; 進去 takes H0935+WTH8799, and 找她 takes WAH0413 (אֵלֶיהָ).
{<WAH03588>} retained as implicit — LCC uses a semicolon (；) structural break with no explicit conjunction word for כִּי.

Gen/29.lcc_original: 拉班就聚集那地方的衆人，擺設筵席。
notes: LCC reverses UNV clause order: UNV has 擺設筵席 (set up feast) before 請齊衆人 (gathered people); LCC has 聚集衆人 before 擺設筵席 — SNs redistributed to match LCC word order
UNV 請齊<WH0622> → LCC 聚集<WH0622>: different words, same Hebrew root H622 (אָסַף, to gather/assemble); mapping is semantically clean

{<WAH0853>} retained as implicit direct-object marker placed after 聚集 since LCC has no explicit particle equivalent for Hebrew אֵת; UNV's aspect particle 了 has no LCC counterpart and is left unannotated

Gen/29.lcc_sn: 到了<WAH01961><WTH8799>晚上<WAH09002><WH06153>，拉班領了<WH03947><WTH8799>他的女兒<WH01323>利亞<WH03812>進去<WH0935><WTH8686>見雅各<WAH0413>，雅各就進去<WH0935><WTH8799>找利亞<WAH0413>。
Gen/29.lcc_original: 到了晚上，拉班領了他的女兒利亞進去見雅各，雅各就進去找利亞。
notes: UNV marks 'took' (H3947) as implicit {<WH03947>}{<WTH8799>}, but LCC has an explicit verb 領了; dropped braces per Rule 3. 了 is a Chinese aspect particle with no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated.
H853 (direct object marker אֶת and pronoun אֹתָהּ) appears in UNV both as implicit {<WAH0853>} and on 將<WAH0853>; LCC uses no corresponding object-marker word, so both instances of H853 are skipped.

LCC restructures the middle clause as 進去見雅各 (lit. 'went in to see Jacob') vs. UNV 送來給雅各 (brought to Jacob). 見 is LCC's interpretive word with no direct Hebrew equivalent; <WAH0413> (אֵלָיו = to him) is attached after 雅各 as the nearest explicit referent.
LCC restructures the final clause as 進去找利亞 vs. UNV 與她同房. 找 is an interpretive expansion (not in Hebrew); <WAH0413> (אֵלֶיהָ = to her) is attached after 利亞 as the nearest explicit referent.
Missing SNs: 0853, 0853

Gen/29.lcc_original: 拉班又將自己的婢女悉帕給他的女兒利亞做婢女。
notes: Implicit cluster {<WH05414>}{<WTH8799>}{<WAH09001>} was split across two LCC words: WAH09001 (ו conjunction) → 又 (LCC has explicit 又 for it, braces dropped); WH05414 + WTH8799 (verb נָתַן + Qal imperfect morphology) → 給 (LCC has explicit 給 where UNV leaves the verb implicit, braces dropped)
自己的 in LCC is an expansion of the Hebrew 3rd-person possessive suffix on שִׁפְחָה; left unannotated as Chinese explicitation with no separate SN
他的 in LCC is an expansion of the Hebrew possessive suffix on בִּת; left unannotated for the same reason
WAH09001 on 利亞 (second occurrence) is the לְ prefix in לְלֵאָה ('to Leah'), preserved as in UNV

Gen/29.lcc_original: 到了早晨，一看，竟是利亞呀！雅各就對拉班說：『你這向我作的是甚麼事阿？我跟你做長工、不是爲了拉結的緣故麼？你爲甚麼哄騙我？
notes: UNV has 雅各一看<WAH02009> but LCC moves 雅各 after the discovery clause; H2009 (hinneh 'behold') attaches to 一看 where the discovery action is expressed.
LCC adds 竟 as a stylistic intensifier ('to one's surprise') with no Hebrew equivalent; H1931 (hi 'she') attaches to the unit 竟是.
UNV 服事<WH05647>你<WAH05973> reordered in LCC as 跟你做長工 — H5973 (im 'with/alongside') maps to 跟你, H5647 (abad 'serve/work') maps to 做長工.
LCC 的緣故 is an explanatory expansion of 爲了拉結 with no Hebrew counterpart; left unannotated.
LCC 爲了 (for the sake of) expands UNV 為; H07354 (Rachel) attaches after 拉結 as the head noun.

Gen/29.lcc_original: 拉班說：『把年幼的比年長的先嫁給人：我們這地方沒有這樣行的。
notes: LCC rephrases significantly: UNV's 大女兒…先…把小女兒給人 becomes 把年幼的比年長的先嫁給人, reversing the order of younger/older and using a 比…先 comparative construction instead of a sequential clause

WAH09001+WH06440 (לִפְנֵי, 'before') aligned to 先 in LCC — consistent with UNV's 先<WAH09001><WH06440>; 比 is left unannotated as a Chinese structural comparison particle with no direct Hebrew counterpart
WH01067 (הַבְּכִירָה, firstborn/older) aligned to LCC 年長的 (UNV: 大女兒)
WH06810 (הַצְּעִירָה, younger) aligned to LCC 年幼的 (UNV: 小女兒)
LCC 嫁給 (marry off) is semantically more specific than UNV 給 (give) but both correspond to WH05414 (נָתַן); tags attached after 嫁給 before 人, mirroring UNV's 給<WAH09001><WH05414><WTH8800>人 pattern
LCC 行的 (what is done/practiced) corresponds to UNV 規矩 (custom/rule) = WH06213 (עָשָׂה, to do/practice) with Niphal morphology WTH8735

Gen/29.lcc_original: 你同這個滿了七天吧，那個也就給你，來報答你要跟我再作七年長工。
notes: 把<WAH0853> in UNV (bǎ construction) has no parallel in LCC; accusative marker <WAH0853> attached to 那個 as the direct object, alongside <WAH02063>
{<WH05656>} (עֲבֹדָה, service/labor) was implicit in UNV; LCC explicitly uses 長工 (long-term laborer) — braces dropped per Rule 3

{<WAH09002>} (ב prefix) and {<WAH0834>} (אֲשֶׁר, relative pronoun) remain implicit; LCC uses 來報答 as a semantic paraphrase of בַּעֲבֹדָה אֲשֶׁר — 來 is a Chinese purpose particle, not a direct lexical translation of ב
{<WH0312>} (אֲחֵרוֹת, another/other) stays implicit; LCC omits 另外 before 七年
LCC's 就 and 要 are aspectual/modal particles with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated per Rule 5

Gen/29.lcc_original: 於是雅各這樣作：他同利亞滿了七天，拉班就將他的女兒拉結給雅各爲妻。
notes: <WAH02063> (זֹאת=this) is attached to 利亞的 in UNV, but LCC restructures the clause as 他同利亞…七天 (he with Leah…seven days); <WAH02063> attached to 利亞 as the closest available referent for the demonstrative.
UNV marks נתן as implicit {<WH05414>}{<WTH8799>}{<WAH09001>} before 將, but LCC has explicit 給 for the giving action; per Rule 3, braces dropped and all three tags attached to 給.
Hebrew has two לוֹ instances: the first (in the verb cluster) is folded onto 給 as <WAH09001>; the second (second לוֹ, 'to him') is attached to 雅各 as <WAH09001>, matching UNV's 給雅各<WAH09001> pattern.
LCC's 他的 (making the pronominal suffix on בִּתּוֹ explicit) is left unannotated since UNV does not tag the pronominal suffix separately on 女兒<WH01323>.

Gen/29.lcc_original: 拉班又將自己的婢女辟拉給他的女兒拉結做婢女。
notes: 自己的 and 他的 are LCC expansions (making the possessive pronouns explicit from Hebrew suffix forms) with no standalone Hebrew lemma — left unannotated
又將 carries WAH0853 (וְאֵת, waw + direct object marker) as a unit, mirroring UNV treatment; 將 functions as the Chinese direct-object particle equivalent
做婢女 maps to 作使女 in UNV and carries WAH09001+WH08198 (לְשִׁפְחָ֖ה)
Final {<WAH09001>} is לָֽהּ ('to her'); LCC has no explicit word for it, so braces are preserved

Gen/29.lcc_original: 雅各也進去找拉結；他並且愛拉結，過於愛利亞；於是他又跟拉班再作七年長工。
notes: 找 assigned <WAH0413> (אֶל 'to/toward'): LCC dynamically renders the directional preposition as 進去找 ('went in to find') rather than UNV's 與 ('with/toward'); 找 is the closest explicit carrier of the directionality encoded by אֶל.
再 receives <WH0312> (H0312 אַחֵר 'other/another'): implicit in UNV as {<WH0312>}, but LCC explicitly expresses 'another [set of years]' via 再, so braces dropped per Rule 3.
長工 (long-term laborer) is LCC's idiomatic expansion of 服事 with no direct Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated.
<WAH05973> (עִם 'with') attached to 拉班 following UNV's convention of attaching preposition SN to the governed noun, even though LCC makes the preposition explicit via 跟.
LCC's added pronouns 他 (×2) and explicit preposition 跟 have no SN assignments.

Gen/29.lcc_original: 永恆主見利亞少得寵愛，就開她的子宮使她受孕；而拉結卻不能生育。
notes: 永恆主 is LCC's standard rendering of יְהוָה (H03068), replacing UNV's 耶和華
少得寵愛 (lit. 'less favored') maps to H08130 (שָׂנֵא = to hate/be hated), which UNV footnotes as 被恨; the morphology code TH8803 (Qal passive participle) attaches to the same phrase
LCC expands UNV's 她生育 into 她的子宮使她受孕; H07358 (רַחְמָהּ = her womb/matrix) attaches to 子宮, while 使她受孕 is an LCC elaboration with no corresponding Hebrew word and is left unannotated
{<WAH0853>} (direct object marker אֵת) retained with braces as it is a purely grammatical particle with no lexical counterpart in Chinese; placed before the object phrase 她的子宮

Gen/29.lcc_original: 利亞懷孕生子，就給孩子起名叫如便，因爲她說：『永恆主看見我的苦難；如今我丈夫必愛我了。』
notes: 流便 (UNV) → 如便 (LCC): different transliterations of Reuben (רְאוּבֵן WH07205), SN transferred normally
耶和華 (UNV) → 永恆主 (LCC): LCC's rendering of the Tetragrammaton יהוה; WH03068 attached to 永恆主
因而 (UNV) → 因爲 (LCC): both render כִּי WH03588; WH03588 placed after 因爲
她 in LCC (因爲她說) has no Hebrew equivalent and is left unannotated
{<WH03588>} kept implicit: the second כִּי introducing the speech content has no explicit counterpart in LCC (quote begins directly)
了 at end of 必愛我了 is a Chinese aspect particle with no Hebrew equivalent; SNs attach only to 必愛我
UNV parenthetical gloss （就是有兒子的意思）has no LCC counterpart and carried no SNs; no impact on transfer
我的苦情 (UNV) → 我的苦難 (LCC): both render עָנְיִי with prefix בְּ (WAH09002); both tags attached to 苦難

Gen/29.lcc_original: 她又懷孕生子，就說：『永恆主聽見我少得寵愛，所以又給我這個兒子』，於是給孩子起名叫西緬。
notes: UNV 耶和華 → LCC 永恆主: both map to <WH03068>.
UNV 因為<WAH03588> is an explicit word that LCC drops entirely; converted to implicit {<WAH03588>} placed before 聽見 to preserve the conjunction annotation.
Second {<WAH03588>} (כִּי introducing the 'unloved' clause) also kept implicit since LCC has no explicit causal particle before 少得寵愛.
UNV 失寵 → LCC 少得寵愛: different phrasings for שְׂנוּאָה (hated/unloved); <WH08130><WTH8803> attached to the whole LCC phrase.
UNV 賜<WH05414><WTH8799>給我<WAH09001> → LCC 給我: split as 給<WH05414><WTH8799>我<WAH09001> to preserve the Hebrew verb/dative distinction.
UNV 給他 → LCC 給孩子 for the naming clause; neither carries an SN, consistent with UNV.

Gen/29.lcc_original: 她又懷孕生子，就說：『如今這一次、我丈夫必同我聯合了，因爲我給他生了三個兒子了』；因此她給孩子起名叫利未。
notes: LCC inverts UNV sentence structure: the direct quote precedes the naming clause, and within the quote the main clause (聯合) precedes the causal clause (因爲...兒子), opposite to UNV's ordering. SNs transferred by semantic content, not position.

Three implicit UNV markers become explicit in LCC and are promoted per Rule 3: {<WAH05921>}{<WAH03651>} → 因此 (therefore); {<WAH06258>}{<WH06471>} → 如今這一次 (now this time); {<WAH03588>} → 因爲 (because). Braces dropped in all three cases.
<WAH09001> (לוֹ = dative 'for him') attaches to 他 in 我給他生了, corresponding to 丈夫 in UNV — both represent the dative pronoun referring to the husband.
孩子 (child) added by LCC for clarity has no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated per Rule 5.
Aspect particles 了 left unannotated as Chinese grammatical additions with no Hebrew equivalents.

Gen/29.lcc_original: 她又懷孕生子，就說：『這一次我要稱謝永恆主了』；因此她給孩子起名叫猶大。此後就停了生育了。
notes: UNV 讚美<WH03034> → LCC 稱謝: different verbs but same semantic field (praise/give thanks); clear alignment.
UNV 耶和華<WH03068> → LCC 永恆主: Lü's characteristic rendering of YHWH as 'Eternal Lord'; SN attaches to 永恆主 as a unit.
{<WAH0853>} kept with braces: the Hebrew direct object marker אֵת has no explicit word in LCC (as in UNV), positioned between 稱謝 and 永恆主 to preserve Hebrew word order.
UNV 給他起名<WH08034> → LCC 她給孩子起名: 起名 is the attachment point for שֵׁם (H08034); LCC adds 她 and replaces 他 with 孩子 but the name-giving act is the same.
UNV 這才停了<WH05975> → LCC 此後就停了: paraphrase of 'then stopped'; 停 carries H05975 (עָמַד).
Final 了 and 了 after 永恆主 are Chinese aspect particles with no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated per rules.
UNV parenthetical gloss '（就是讚美的意思）' is absent in LCC — it was an editorial addition in UNV, not part of the Hebrew; no SN lost.

Gen/30.lcc_original: 拉結見自己沒有給雅各生兒子，就嫉妒她姐姐，對雅各說：『給我兒子吧，不然，我就死啦。』
notes: UNV 不<WAH03808> → LCC 沒有<WAH03808>: LCC uses 沒有 for the negation לֹא where UNV uses 不; tag attaches to 沒有 as the semantic equivalent.
UNV 你給<WH03051><WTH8798>: LCC drops the 你 (2sg subject implied), tag attaches directly to 給.
UNV 孩子<WH01121> → LCC 兒子<WH01121>: both render בֵּן (son/child), clean substitution.
LCC adds sentence-final particle 吧 (imperative softener) with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated.
LCC inserts an extra comma after 不然 compared to UNV; tag <WAH0518><WH0369> still attaches to 不然 and the comma follows as original LCC punctuation.
Both implicit markers {<WAH03588>} (כִּי) and {<WH07354>} (Rachel as implied subject of 嫉妒) are retained with braces: LCC has no explicit lexical items to anchor them.

Gen/30.lcc_original: 雅各的怒氣就向拉結發作，說：『我哪能代替上帝做主呢？是他不使你有腹中的果子呀。』
notes: LCC reverses clause order inside Jacob's speech: 代替上帝做主 (H8478+H430) precedes 不使你有腹中的果子, whereas UNV presents the withholding clause first then the rhetorical question.
LCC uses 上帝 where UNV uses 神; H0430 transferred to 上帝 accordingly — standard UNV/LCC lexical difference.
UNV collocates 生<H2734><T8799>氣<H639> on a single compound; LCC splits the same semantics across 怒氣<H0639> (noun, earlier) and 發作<H2734><WTH8799> (verb, later).
WAH04480 (מִמֵּךְ 'from you'): UNV attaches it to 叫你; in LCC the closest pronoun anchor is 你 in 使你, so the tag moves there.
H0990 (בָּטֶן womb) and H6529 (פְּרִי fruit) are merged on UNV's single word 生育; in LCC the phrase 腹中的果子 allows splitting: 腹中<WH0990> and 果子<WH06529>.

Gen/30.lcc_sn: 拉結說<WH0559><WTH8799>：『你看<WAH02009>我的使女<WH0519>辟拉<WH01090>在這裏；你進去<WH0935><WTH8798>找她<WAH0413>，使她生<WH03205><WTH8799>子抱在我膝<WH01290>上<WAH05921>，我<WAH0595>的後裔也<WAH01571>好由她<WAH04480>建立<WH01129><WTH8735>起來。』
Gen/30.lcc_original: 拉結說：『你看我的使女辟拉在這裏；你進去找她，使她生子抱在我膝上，我的後裔也好由她建立起來。』
Gen/30.unv_sn_reference: 拉結說<WH0559><WTH8799>：「{<WAH02009>}有我的使女<WH0519>辟拉<WH01090>在這裡，你可以與她<WAH0413>同房<WH0935><WTH8798>，使她生<WH03205><WTH8799>子在<WAH05921>我膝<WH01290>下，我<WAH0595>便因她<WAH04480>也<WAH01571>得孩子（原文是被建立<WH01129><WTH8735>）。」
notes: UNV has {<WAH02009>} implicit (hinneh/behold) with no explicit rendering; LCC has explicit 你看, so braces dropped per Rule 3 and tag placed after 看 (你 is a Chinese naturalness addition, not a separate lexeme).
UNV euphemism 與她同房 (come to her) maps to LCC 進去找她 with different phrasing but same Hebrew source: <WH0935> (בּוֹא, enter/come) placed on 進去, <WAH0413> (אֵלֶיהָ, to her) placed on 找她.

UNV annotates 建立 parenthetically as a footnote ('原文是被建立') and translates freely as 得孩子; LCC translates the Hebrew literally as 建立起來, so <WH01129><WTH8735> placed directly on 建立 — more natural alignment in LCC than UNV.

UNV 我便因她也得孩子 vs LCC 我的後裔也好由她建立起來: <WAH0595> (אָנֹכִי, I) attaches to 我; 後裔 is an interpretive expansion (left unannotated); 好 is a modal addition (left unannotated); <WAH04480> (מִמֶּנָּה, from her) attaches to 由她.
<WAH05921> (עַל, upon) placed after 上 in LCC's 在我膝上 phrase; 在 is a locative preposition addition while 上 carries the directional/positional meaning closest to עַל.

Gen/30.lcc_original: 拉結就把她的婢女辟拉給雅各爲妾【1】；雅各便進去找辟拉。
notes: 丈夫 (husband, UNV) → 雅各 (Jacob, LCC): same referent; WAH09001 (ל prefix on לוֹ, 'to him') transferred to 雅各 in first clause; second 雅各 after semicolon gets WH03290 as in UNV
使女 (UNV) → 婢女 (LCC): synonymous terms for handmaid; WH08198 transferred normally

同房 (UNV, 'lay with her') → 進去找辟拉 (LCC, 'went in to find Bilhah'): LCC uses a circumlocution for Hebrew וַיָּבֹא אֵלֶיהָ; WH0935+WTH8799 (בּוֹא, to come/enter) assigned to 進去, WAH0413 (אֵלֶיהָ, to her) assigned to 找辟拉
Second 辟拉 in LCC (in 找辟拉) represents Hebrew pronoun אֵלֶיהָ, not a new occurrence of בִּלְהָה — not tagged with WH01090
【1】 editorial note marker preserved in place after 爲妾

Gen/30.lcc_original: 辟拉就懷孕，給雅各生了一個兒子。
notes: LCC text is character-for-character identical to UNV; all SN tags transfer directly to the same positions with no alignment ambiguity.

Gen/30.lcc_original: 拉結說：『上帝爲我伸訴了，也聽了我的聲音，給了我一個兒子；所以她給孩子起名叫但。
notes: UNV 神<WH0430> → LCC 上帝: systematic lexical difference (both = God), same SN attached to 上帝
UNV 伸了我的冤<WH01777><WTH8804> → LCC 爲我伸訴了: the verbal root דִּין (judge/vindicate) maps to 伸訴 in LCC; tags attached after 了 as the verbal phrase boundary
UNV 賜<WH05414><WTH8799>我<WAH09001> → LCC 給了<WH05414><WTH8799>我<WAH09001>: 給了 is the LCC equivalent of 賜; <WH05414>+morphology attach after 了, <WAH09001> after 我
UNV 因此<WAH05921><WAH03651> → LCC 所以: both express 'therefore'; both prefix-tags grouped after 所以
UNV 給他起名<WH08034> → LCC 她給孩子起名: <WH08034> (שֵׁם, name) attached after 起名; pronoun shift (他→孩子) is LCC's rephrasing, no tag impact
UNV explanatory gloss （就是伸冤的意思） has no LCC counterpart; no SNs were lost as it carried no additional tags

Gen/30.lcc_original: 拉結的婢女辟拉又懷孕，給雅各生了第二個兒子。
notes: 使女 (UNV) → 婢女 (LCC): synonymous terms for 'maidservant/female slave', both map to <WH08198>. All other words are identical between versions.

Gen/30.lcc_sn: 拉結<WH07354>說<WH0559><WTH8799>：『我跟<WAH05973>我姐姐<WH0269>角力<WH06617><WTH8738>，簡直是天大的<WH0430>角力<WH05319>，而我竟<WAH01571>得勝<WH03201><WTH8804>了』；於是她給孩子起名<WH08034>叫<WH07121><WTH8799>拿弗他利<WH05321>。
Gen/30.lcc_original: 拉結說：『我跟我姐姐角力，簡直是天大的角力，而我竟得勝了』；於是她給孩子起名叫拿弗他利。
notes: LCC expands UNV's 大大相爭 into an echo construction 角力，簡直是天大的角力. The Hebrew נִפְתַּלְתִּי (verb, WH06617+WTH8738) → first 角力; אֱלֹהִים used as superlative intensifier (WH0430) → 天大的; נַפְתּוּלִים (noun, WH05319) → second 角力.
WAH01571 (גַּם with waw prefix, 'and also/even') spans LCC's discontiguous 而…竟; tag placed after 竟 as the semantic core of גַּם, treating 而 as the conjunction equivalent of the waw prefix.
了 after 得勝 is a Chinese aspect particle with no Hebrew equivalent and is left unannotated.
UNV's parenthetical gloss （就是相爭的意思） is absent in LCC; no SNs are dropped as a result.

Gen/30.lcc_original: 利亞見自己停了生育，就把她的婢女悉帕給雅各爲妾【1】。
notes: LCC adds possessive pronoun 她的 before 婢女 — 她的 has no Hebrew equivalent and receives no SN; WH08198 (שִׁפְחָה) attaches to 婢女 alone
{<WAH03588>} kept implicit: UNV has no explicit character for כִּי and LCC likewise omits a conjunction word here
{<WH03947>}{<WTH8799>} kept implicit: LCC uses the disposal construction 把…給 rather than an explicit verb for לָקַח (take); the verb is semantically absorbed into the clause structure
LCC footnote marker 【1】 preserved after 妾 without annotation

Gen/30.lcc_original: 利亞的婢女悉帕給雅各生了一個兒子。
notes: LCC 婢女 (handmaid/slave-girl) maps directly to UNV 使女 (H8198, שִׁפְחָה); both are semantically equivalent terms for a female servant
WAH09001 + WH03290 kept together after 雅各, mirroring UNV placement — the prefix ל is represented by 給 in Chinese but the tag block follows the noun per UNV convention
WTH8799 (Qal imperfect morphology) attaches immediately after the verb 生 as required

Gen/30.lcc_original: 利亞就說：『好萬幸阿！』於是給孩子起名叫迦得。
notes: LCC adds intensifier 好 and exclamation particle 阿 around 萬幸 with no Hebrew equivalents; SNs <WAH09002><WH01409> placed after 萬幸 only.
LCC uses 孩子 (child) where UNV has 他 (him) as the referent of the direct-object marker <WAH0853>; attached to 孩子 as an explicit word.
LCC's 就 before 說 is a Chinese aspectual/connective particle with no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated.
LCC omits UNV's parenthetical gloss （就是萬幸的意思）entirely.

Gen/30.lcc_original: 利亞的婢女悉帕又給雅各生了第二個兒子。
notes: 使女 (UNV) → 婢女 (LCC): both render H08198 (שִׁפְחָה, handmaid/maidservant); tag attaches to 婢女 without issue. All other tokens are identical between versions.

Gen/30.lcc_original: 利亞就說：『我有福阿！衆女子必稱我爲有福。』於是她給孩子起名叫亞設。
Gen/30.unv_sn_reference: 利亞<WH03812>說<WH0559><WTH8799>：「我有福<WAH09002><WH0837>啊，{<WAH03588>}眾女子<WH01323>都要稱我是有福的<WH0833><WTH8765>」，於是給<WAH0853>他起名<WH08034>叫<WH07121><WTH8799>亞設<WH0836>（就是有福的意思）。
notes: 就說: 就 is a Chinese connective with no Hebrew equivalent; tag attaches after 說 (the verb = H0559)
{<WAH03588>} kept implicit — LCC has no explicit כִּי connector between the two clauses
<WH0833><WTH8765> attached to end of 必稱我爲有福 — the entire phrase translates the single Hebrew verb אַשְּׁרֻנִי (Piel imperfect + suffix)
她 (explicit subject pronoun in LCC) left unannotated — subject is encoded in the Hebrew verb, not a separate lexeme
<WAH0853> (direct object marker אֵת) attached to 給 following UNV pattern; 孩子 (= 他 in UNV) has no SN tag as it is the pronominal object

Gen/30.lcc_original: 割麥子的日子，如便出去，在田地裏發現了些催愛果，就拿進來給他母親利亞。拉結對利亞說：『把你兒子的催愛果一點兒給我吧。』
notes: LCC uses 日子 instead of UNV 時候 for WH03117 (יוֹם, day); both are valid renderings of the Hebrew
LCC restructures 往田裡去 as 出去…在田地裏, splitting the locative from the verb; WAH09002+WH07704 attached to 在…田地 and WH03212+WTH8799 to 出去 separately
LCC uses 催愛果 (mandrakes, lit. love-urging fruit) vs UNV 風茄; WH01736 transferred to 催愛果 throughout
{<WAH0853>} (direct object pronoun אֹתָם, 'them') remains implicit in LCC just as in UNV — no explicit pronoun in 就拿進來
WAH04994 (נָא, entreaty particle) mapped to sentence-final 吧 in LCC, which carries the same pragmatic request/entreaty function; confidence on this mapping is moderate
如便 (LCC) vs 流便 (UNV) are different transliterations of the same person Reuben (WH07205)

Gen/30.lcc_original: 利亞對拉結說：『你奪取了我的丈夫、還算小事麼？現在又要奪取我兒子的催愛果麼？』拉結說：『好吧，爲了交換你兒子的催愛果，丈夫今夜可以和你同寢了。』
notes: LCC 好吧 explicitly renders UNV's implicit {<WAH03651>} (H3651, כֵּן 'so/thus/indeed'); braces dropped per Rule 3, SN attached directly to 好吧
LCC 爲了交換 expands UNV 為 alone (H08478, תַּחַת 'in exchange for/instead of'); SN anchored to end of phrase after 換
LCC 現在 has no Hebrew counterpart and is left unannotated; 又 carries <WAH01571> as in UNV
UNV pronoun 他 becomes explicit 丈夫 in LCC at that position; no SN assigned since 丈夫 already bore H0376 earlier and the pronoun itself carries no SN in UNV
催愛果 (LCC) maps to 風茄 (UNV) = mandrakes (H01736); both occurrences tagged identically

Gen/30.lcc_original: 到了晚上，雅各從田地裏回來，利亞出去迎接他，說：『你要進來找我，因爲我實在用我兒子的催愛果把你雇下了。』那一夜、雅各就和利亞同寢。
notes: LCC 田地 vs UNV 田 — both translate H07704 (שָׂדֶה, field); SN attached to 田地
LCC 出去 vs UNV 出來 — both translate H03318 (יָצָא, go out); SN attached to 出去

UNV 與我<WAH0413>同寢<WH0935> is a free rendering of Hebrew בֹּא אֵלַי (come to me) as 'sleep with me'; LCC 進來<WH0935>找我<WAH0413> is more literal — SN tag order follows LCC/Hebrew word order (H935 then H413), reversing UNV's arrangement
LCC 催愛果 vs UNV 風茄 — both translate H01736 (דּוּדָאִים, mandrakes); SN attached to 催愛果
LCC 和利亞 vs UNV 與她 — LCC uses the proper name where UNV uses pronoun; <WAH05973> (H05973 = עִם, with) attached to 和利亞 covering the whole prepositional phrase

Gen/30.lcc_original: 上帝垂聽了利亞；利亞就懷孕，給雅各生了第五個兒子。
notes: 神→上帝: systematic UNV/LCC substitution, same referent, same SN H0430
應允→垂聽: semantic equivalent ('answered prayer' vs 'graciously heard'); both SNs H08085+WTH8799 attach after 垂聽
LCC repeats subject 利亞 instead of UNV pronoun 她 before 就懷孕; SN H02029+WTH8799 attaches to 懷孕 unchanged
LCC uses semicolon (；) to split the clause rather than 她就, but this is purely punctuation/structural — no SN placement affected

Gen/30.lcc_original: 利亞說：『上帝給了我工價，因爲我把婢女給了我丈夫』；於是她給孩子起名叫以薩迦。
notes: UNV 神 → LCC 上帝: both map to H430 (Elohim); tag attaches after 上帝
UNV 使女 → LCC 婢女: both map to H8198 (maidservant/bondwoman)
UNV 價值 → LCC 工價: both map to H7939 (śākār = hire/wages); tag placed after the noun in both cases
Second H5414+WTH8804 placed after 把 (disposal particle) following UNV annotation convention for split-verb 把...給 constructions — the tag marks the semantic onset of the giving action
LCC adds explicit subject 她 and uses 孩子 (child) where UNV uses 他; these have no Hebrew equivalents so left unannotated; WH08034 (שֵׁם = name) attaches to 起名 in both versions

Gen/30.lcc_original: 利亞又懷孕，給雅各生了第六個兒子。
notes: LCC text is lexically and syntactically identical to UNV; all SN tags transfer directly with no realignment needed.

Gen/30.lcc_original: 利亞就說：『上帝贈送給我好贈品；這一次我丈夫必抬舉我了，因爲我給他生了六個兒子』；於是她給孩子起名叫西布倫。
notes: LCC uses 上帝 instead of 神 for H0430 (אֱלֹהִים); mapped as expected
{<WH06471>} is implicit in UNV but LCC explicitly has 這一次 (this time); braces dropped per Rule 3
H02082 (זָבַל): UNV renders as 與我同住 but LCC renders as 必抬舉我 — a legitimate but divergent translation of the same root; SN attached to 必抬舉我
了 after 必抬舉我 is a Chinese aspect particle with no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated
就 before 說 is a Chinese discourse connective with no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated
叫 in 起名叫 is a Chinese complement connector with no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated
WAH0853 in the narrative section (object marker אֶת) attached to 孩子, corresponding to UNV's 他, following the same object-marker positioning pattern

Gen/30.lcc_original: 後來利亞生了一個女兒，她給她起名叫底拿。
notes: 利亞 is explicit in LCC but has no SN in UNV (subject is dropped in Hebrew/UNV) — left unannotated
The first 她 (before 給) represents Leah as subject pronoun — no corresponding SN
<WAH0853> (direct object marker אֵת) assigned to 給 as the closest functional match in the LCC phrasing 她給她起名

Gen/30.lcc_original: 上帝懷念着拉結，垂聽了她，就開她的子宮使她受孕。
notes: 神(UNV)→上帝(LCC): systematic lexical difference; WH0430 attached to 上帝
着 after 懷念 is a Chinese aspect particle with no Hebrew equivalent; WH02142+WTH8799 attach to 懷念着 as a unit
First {<WAH0853>} (אֵת before Rachel) kept implicit — LCC has no explicit direct object marker word between 懷念着 and 拉結
H06605 (פָּתַח, open) maps to 就開; WAH0853 attaches to 她的 (explicit possessive in LCC); H07358 (רֶחֶם, womb) maps to 子宮
使她受孕 is LCC's explanatory gloss beyond the Hebrew רַחְמָהּ; left unannotated as no additional source words remain

Gen/30.lcc_original: 拉結懷孕生子，就說：『上帝把我的恥辱收拾掉了』；
notes: 上帝 (LCC) replaces 神 (UNV) as the standard rendering of H430 in LCC — attached normally

把 (object-introducing preposition) corresponds to the direct object marker <WAH0853>; in UNV this fell on the particle 了, but LCC restructures the clause as 把…收拾掉了, so the object marker is better anchored to 把
收拾掉 carries H622+WTH8804 (the removal verb); trailing 了 is a Chinese aspect particle with no Hebrew equivalent and is left unannotated
就 (then/so) before 說 is a Chinese connective with no Hebrew correspondent — SN attaches only to 說

Gen/30.lcc_original: 於是她給孩子起名叫約瑟，說：『永恆主把另一個兒子增添給我。』
notes: 永恆主 (LCC) ← 耶和華 (UNV): both map to H3068 (יְהוָה)
LCC restructures the quotation into SVO declarative order (永恆主把另一個兒子增添給我) vs. UNV's optative願-clause (願耶和華再增添我一個兒子); H3254+WTH8686 placed on 增添 accordingly
<WAH0853> (direct object marker H853 = אֶת) attached to 孩子 as the nominal object of the naming action
UNV 再 ('again') carries no SN and is absent in LCC — left unannotated by omission
Second <WAH09001> represents the lamed prefix on Hebrew לִי ('to me'); attached to 我 at end of 給我

Gen/30.lcc_original: 拉結生了約瑟之後，雅各對拉班說：『請讓我走吧！我好回我本地本國去。
notes: H01961 (וַיְהִי, narrative formula) + WTH8799 kept implicit — no explicit LCC equivalent for this clause-opener

H09003+H0834 (כַּאֲשֶׁר, 'when/after') attached to 之後 per explicit-word rule; UNV leaves them implicit even though 之後 is present in the text — LCC's 之後 is a direct explicit rendering so braces dropped
H7971 (שָׁלַח, 'send/let go'): UNV 打發我走 → LCC 讓我走; tag placed after 走 and before the untranslated particle 吧
H3212 (הָלַך, 'go/return'): UNV 叫我回 → LCC 我好回; 好 is a purpose/modal particle with no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated; 回 is the direct correspondence
WAH0413 (אֶל, 'to/toward') appears twice: once on 對 (Jacob said TO Laban) and once on 去 (return TO my homeland) — directional 去 in LCC absorbs the second occurrence that UNV renders as 到
LCC 本地/本國 ≈ UNV 本鄉/本土 for H4725 (מָקוֹם) and H0776 (אֶרֶץ); different lexical choices but same semantic referents
Aspect particle 了 in 生了 left unannotated per rules on untranslatable Chinese grammatical particles

Gen/30.lcc_original: 請把我的妻子和兒女，我跟你作長工所得的妻兒都給我，讓我走；我怎樣替你作工、你是知道的。』
notes: LCC restructures the first clause significantly: UNV's relative clause (服事你所得的妻子和兒女) becomes a topic-comment structure in LCC where 妻子和兒女 appears as the main object first, then is resumed as 妻兒 within the relative clause (我跟你作長工所得的妻兒). SNs for WH0802 and WH03206 placed at first occurrence; 妻兒 in the relative clause is left unannotated as an LCC-specific resumptive element.
LCC expands UNV's 服事 to 作長工 (work as a laborer) in both clauses; WH05647+WTH8804 attached to 作長工 in both occurrences.

The 的<WAH0853> from UNV (originally preceding 妻子 as the ות direct-object marker) is mapped to 的 in 所得的妻兒, since LCC's main clause has no 的 before 妻子. 跟你<WAH0853> covers the other ות instance (object of the serving relationship).
{<WAH09002>}{<WH02004>} remain implicit after 得, matching UNV treatment.

{<WAH03588>}、{<WAH0853>}、{<WH05656>} remain implicit: LCC has no explicit lexical rendering for כִּי, the second ות, or the nominal עֲבֹדָה (service). LCC subsumes the noun 'service' into the verbal phrase 替你作工.

Gen/30.lcc_original: 拉班對雅各說：『若蒙你賞臉，請仍然住下，因爲我觀察了徵兆，知道永恆主賜福與我、是因你的緣故。』
Gen/30.unv_sn_reference: 拉班<WH03837>對他<WAH0413>說<WH0559><WTH8799>：「我若<WAH0518>在你眼前<WAH09002><WH05869>蒙<WH04672><WTH8804>恩<WH02580>，請<WAH04994>你仍與我同住，因為我已算定<WH05172><WTH8765>，耶和華<WH03068>賜福與我<WH01288><WTH8762>是為你的緣故<WAH09002><WH01558>」；
notes: LCC 對雅各 makes explicit UNV 對他 (他→雅各); WAH0413 attached after 雅各

LCC 若蒙你賞臉 is an idiomatic compression of UNV 若在你眼前蒙恩; 蒙 receives WH04672+WTH8804 (מָצָא, found/received), 賞臉 receives WAH09002+WH05869 (בְּעֵינֶיךָ, in your eyes) + WH02580 (חֵן, favor) since the idiom fuses both concepts
LCC 觀察了徵兆 renders UNV 算定 (נָחַשׁ WH05172+WTH8765); tags placed on the verb 觀察, 徵兆 is the object implied by the verb meaning
LCC 知道 is a translator-added connective bridging the divination clause to its result; no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated
LCC 永恆主 renders UNV 耶和華 (יְהוָה WH03068); tag placed after 永恆主

Gen/30.lcc_original: 又說：『你只管指定你的工價，我就給。』
notes: UNV '請你定' → LCC '你只管指定': both mean 'please/just designate'; <WH05344> attaches to 指定 as the main verb
UNV ends with '給你' but LCC omits the explicit pronoun 你; <WH05414><WTH8799> still attaches to 給
{<WAH05921>} kept implicit — LCC has no explicit word for this particle just as UNV does not

Gen/30.lcc_original: 雅各對拉班說：『我怎樣服事你，你的牲畜在我手裏怎樣，你是知道的。
notes: UNV uses pronoun 他 but LCC explicitly names 拉班 (Laban); WAH0413 attaches to 拉班 as the preposition target
UNV word order 是你<WAH0859> reversed to 你<WAH0859>是 in LCC; WAH0859 follows 你 accordingly
Both {<WAH0853>} implicit direct object markers (Hebrew אֵת) retained in braces — LCC has no explicit Chinese words for them
LCC uses 裏 (variant form) vs UNV 裡; LCC text preserved exactly

Gen/30.lcc_sn: {<WAH03588>}我未來以前<WAH09001><WH06440>，你所<WAH0834>有<WAH01961><WTH8804>的很少<WH04592>，現在卻突破限量<WH06555><WTH8799>地增多<WAH09001><WH07230>了；隨着我的腳步<WAH09001><WH07272>、永恆主<WH03068>都賜福<WH01288><WTH8762>與你<WAH0853>：如今<WAH06258>我<WAH0595>甚麼時候<WH04970>纔<WAH01571>爲自己的家<WAH09001><WH01004>作點兒事<WH06213><WTH8799>呢？』
Gen/30.lcc_original: 我未來以前，你所有的很少，現在卻突破限量地增多了；隨着我的腳步、永恆主都賜福與你：如今我甚麼時候纔爲自己的家作點兒事呢？』
notes: UNV 未來之先 → LCC 未來以前: tags moved to 以前 (same semantic role, 'before')
UNV 發大<WH06555><WTH8799>眾多<WAH09001><WH07230> split across LCC 突破限量地增多: 突破限量 = פָּרַץ (break forth), 增多 = רֹב (abundance); 了 is aspect particle with no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated
LCC 永恆主 = UNV 耶和華 = יְהוָה <WH03068>; straightforward divine name substitution
LCC 作點兒事 is a colloquial paraphrase of UNV 立業 (= עָשָׂה <WH06213>); tags attached to 事 as head of the phrase
{<WAH03588>} kept as implicit braces: כִּי has no explicit Chinese word in LCC just as in UNV
UNV 才<WAH01571> = LCC 纔 (same character, traditional form); גַּם rendered as emphasis particle in both

Gen/30.lcc_original: 拉班說：『我當給你甚麼？』雅各說：『你甚麼也不用給我；只有這一件事你若實行，我便仍舊牧放你的羊羣而看守牠。
notes: UNV splits H7462/H8104 across 牧/放 character by character, but LCC restructures as 牧放＋看守: H7462 (ra'ah=shepherd) maps to 牧放, H8104 (shamar=watch/guard) maps to 看守, preserving LCC's expanded phrasing.
WAH02088 (H2088 zeh=this) moves from UNV's 一件 to LCC's explicit demonstrative 這, which is the direct lexical equivalent.
WAH03808 (H3808 lo=not) attaches to LCC's 也不用 (≈UNV's 也不必), covering the negation phrase.
{<WAH09001>} kept in braces after 實行: the pronominal suffix 'it' on the Hebrew verb is implicit in LCC's 實行 with no explicit object pronoun.
LCC-only tail 牠 (referring back to 羊羣) has no Hebrew equivalent and is left unannotated.

Gen/31.lcc_original: 我是伯特利的上帝；你在那裏用膏膏過聖柱，在那裏向我許過願的；現在你要起身，離開這地，回你親族之地。』

Gen/31.lcc_sn: 拉結<WH07354>和利亞<WH03812>回答<WH06030><WTH8799>雅各<WAH09001>說<WH0559><WTH8799>：『在我們父親<WH01>家裏<WAH09002><WH01004>還有<WAH05750>我們<WAH09001>可得的分兒<WH02506>和產業<WH05159>麼？

Gen/31.lcc_original: 我們不是被他當作外人麼？因爲他賣了我們，也拚命吞喫了你娶我們的聘銀。

{<WAH0853>} (אֵת, direct object marker) kept implicit — purely grammatical with no Chinese equivalent in either version.

Gen/31.lcc_original: 又趕着他一切的牲畜、他所積蓄的一切活財物、他所得的牲畜，就是他在巴旦亞蘭所積蓄的，要往迦南地、他父親以撒那裏去。

Gen/31.lcc_original: 當時拉班剪羊毛去了；拉結偷了她父親的家神像。

Gen/31.lcc_original: 雅各也窃奪了亞蘭人拉班的心機：他沒告訴他就逃走了。

H7971 (שָׁלַח, send) with WTH8762 attaches to 送行 in 給你送行; 給你 expresses the 2nd-person object suffix embedded in וָאֲשַׁלֵּחֲךָ.

UNV 甚麼東西 collapses to LCC 甚麼; <WAH04100> (מָה, what) attaches to 甚麼 alone

Gen/31.lcc_original: 拉班進了雅各的帳棚，利亞的帳棚，和兩個使女的帳棚，都找不着，就從利亞的帳棚出來，進了拉結的帳棚。
notes: Three instances of {<WAH09002>}{<WH0168>} (implicit tent in UNV) become explicit 的帳棚 in LCC; per Rule 3, braces dropped and tags attached directly: 帳棚<WAH09002><WH0168>.

UNV 都沒有<WAH03808>搜出來<WH04672><WTH8804> → LCC 都找不着: all three tags attached to 找不着 as a unit, since LCC fuses the negation and result into a single compound verb; 都 has no Hebrew correspondent and is left unannotated.
UNV 並兩個 → LCC 和兩個: 和 is a Chinese conjunction with no direct SN; 兩個<WH08147> and 使女<WH0519> attach normally.
從利亞的帳棚 (second occurrence): <WAH04480> (מִן prefix) and <WH0168> (אֹהֶל) both remain on 帳棚 following UNV attachment pattern, consistent with the preposition being fused to the noun in Hebrew.

Gen/31.lcc_original: 拉結早已把家神像放在駱駝馱簍裏，坐在上頭。拉班把整個帳棚使勁地摩挲，也找不着。
notes: LCC's 早已 captures UNV's 已經 (already/had already) but provides no explicit verb for H03947 (לקח = take); {<WH03947>}{<WTH8804>} kept implicit as in UNV
UNV's {<WAH0853>} (implicit אֶת direct-object marker) in the second clause becomes explicit 把 in LCC per Rule 3; braces dropped: 把<WAH0853>
LCC's 整個 maps to WAH03605 (כֹּל = all/entire) preceding 帳棚<WH0168>
LCC condenses UNV's 並沒有<WAH03808>摸著<WH04672><WTH8804> into 也找不着; all three SNs attached to the compound verb phrase at the end
LCC adds 使勁地 as a Chinese intensifier for 摩挲 (H04959 מָשַׁשׁ = to feel/search); SNs attach to end of the adverb+verb phrase

Gen/31.lcc_original: 拉結對她父親說：『我主眼中、請不要生氣我不能在你面前起來；因爲我正有婦人事兒。』這樣，拉班搜尋來搜尋去，竟沒有把家神像找出來。
notes: LCC significantly reorders Rachel's speech: the reason clause (menstrual period) moves to a terminal 因爲... position; SNs for H3588 (現在→因爲) and WAH09001+H1870+H0802 (身上不便→婦人事兒) reassigned to LCC's rearranged clause
UNV implicit {<WAH09002>}{<WH05869>} (עֵינֵי = eyes) are explicit as 眼中 in LCC — braces dropped per Rule 3; 眼中 annotated with both the בְּ prefix (WAH09002) and H5869
UNV implicit {<WAH0853>} (direct object marker אֵת) surfaces as explicit 把 in LCC — braces dropped per Rule 3; 把<WAH0853> placed before 家神像
LCC 搜尋來搜尋去 is an idiomatic intensifier ('searched here and there'); SN H2664+WTH8762 attached to the first 搜尋 only, the repeated 搜尋去 left unannotated
LCC 請 (politeness particle before 不要) has no Hebrew equivalent in UNV's 求; left unannotated

Gen/31.lcc_original: 雅各就生氣，和拉班爭論起來；雅各回答拉班說：『我有甚麼過犯，甚麼罪惡，你竟火急地追我？
notes: LCC restructures the opening clause: 就生氣 (H2734) + 和拉班爭論起來 vs UNV 就發怒斥責拉班. H7378 (strive/contend) assigned to 爭論起來 as semantic equivalent of 斥責; the first explicit 拉班 absorbs WAH09002+WH03837.

UNV's implicit sequence {<WH03290>}{<WH03290>}{<WH03837>}...{<WAH09001>}{<WAH03837>} — representing the condensed Hebrew וַיַּעַן יַעֲקֹב וַיֹּאמֶר לְלָבָן — is distributed to LCC's explicit second 雅各 (→ WH03290×2) and second 拉班 (→ WH03837 + WAH09001 + WAH03837). 回答 is left unannotated as UNV carried no SN for the answering verb.
LCC omits 這樣; WAH03588 (כִּי H3588) placed on 竟 as the closest semantic equivalent expressing the force/extent of the pursuit.
LCC omits 有 before the second 甚麼 clause; WAH04100 placed directly on 甚麼 in both occurrences.

Gen/31.lcc_original: 你摩挲了我一切的物件，你找着了甚麼是你家的物件沒有？請放在這兒，當着你我弟兄們面前；讓他們在你我之間辨別辨別。
notes: LCC makes explicit two words that are implicit in UNV: 物件 for כְּלֵי (WH03627) and 你家 for בֵּיִת (WH01004) in the second clause. WH01004 had no explicit Chinese word in UNV (oddly not in braces either in the source) — treated as implicit-in-UNV but explicit-in-LCC, applied Rule 3 to drop braces.

LCC restructures the second clause as a copular relative (甚麼是你家的物件沒有 = 'what is your household's articles?') vs. UNV's bare question form (搜出甚麼...來呢). Implicit {<WAH04480>}{<WAH03605>} placed between 甚麼<WAH04100> and 是, since 是 is a purely LCC grammatical addition with no Hebrew counterpart.
LCC has 這兒 as an explicit word for כֹּה (WH03541), which is implicit in UNV ({<WH03541>}). Applied Rule 3: dropped braces and attached tag after 這兒.

WH0251 (אָח, brother): follows UNV's possessive+noun tagging pattern. Hebrew has אַחַי (my brothers) and וְאַחֶיךָ (your brothers), both tagged H0251. UNV tags 你 and 我弟兄 separately; LCC does the same with 你 and 我弟兄們 (LCC adds plural marker 們, included within the tag span).

Gen/31.lcc_sn: 我<WAH0595>同你在一起<WAH05973>這<WAH02088>二十<WH06242>年<WH08141>，你的母綿羊<WH07353>母山羊<WH05795>沒有<WAH03808>掉過胎<WH07921><WTH8765>；你羊羣<WH06629>中的公羊<WH0352>、我沒有<WAH03808>喫過<WH0398><WTH8804>。
Gen/31.lcc_original: 我同你在一起這二十年，你的母綿羊母山羊沒有掉過胎；你羊羣中的公羊、我沒有喫過。
notes: H5973 (עִם, 'with'): UNV renders as '在你家' with the tag after '你'; LCC restructures this as '同你在一起'. Tag placed after '一起' to cover the full prepositional phrase, since '同...在一起' together expresses עִם.
H6629 (צֹאן, 'flock'): UNV uses bare '群'; LCC uses the more explicit '羊羣'. Tag placed after '羣' (end of the flock noun).
LCC's closing punctuation is 。(period) vs UNV's ；(semicolon) — LCC original punctuation preserved throughout, including absence of 、between 母綿羊 and 母山羊.
LCC uses 喫 (traditional form) where UNV uses 吃 — LCC character preserved as-is.

Gen/31.lcc_sn: 被野獸撕裂的<WH02966>、我沒有<WAH03808>帶<WH0935><WTH8689>來給你<WAH0413>；我都自己<WAH0595>賠上<WH02398><WTH8762>；無論是日間<WH03117>被偷<WH01589><WTH8803>，是夜裏<WH03915>被偷<WH01589><WTH8803>，你都從我<WAH04480>手裏<WH03027>追討<WH01245><WTH8762>。
Gen/31.lcc_original: 被野獸撕裂的、我沒有帶來給你；我都自己賠上；無論是日間被偷，是夜裏被偷，你都從我手裏追討。
notes: UNV uses implicit {<WH01589>}{<WTH8803>} after 白日 (daytime theft unexpressed); LCC explicitly writes 被偷 for both day and night, so braces were dropped and tags attached directly to both occurrences of 被偷.
白日<WH03117> (UNV) → 日間<WH03117> (LCC); 黑夜<WH03915> (UNV) → 夜裏<WH03915> (LCC) — synonymous phrasing, straightforward mapping.
向我<WAH04480><WH03027>索要<WH01245> (UNV) → 從我<WAH04480>手裏<WH03027>追討<WH01245> (LCC); 從我 renders the מִן prefix, 手裏 renders יָד, 追討 renders בָּקַשׁ.
<WAH0595> (אָנֹכִי, I/myself) attached after 我都自己, following UNV's post-phrase tag convention for pronoun-emphasis constructions.

Gen/31.lcc_original: 日間炎熱銷磨我，夜裏寒霜侵襲我，合眼睡覺都顧不得：這對我都是常事。
notes: LCC reverses the noun/verb order in the first clause: UNV has 受盡(H398)乾熱(H2721) but LCC has 炎熱(H2721)銷磨(H398). SNs assigned to their semantic matches regardless of order.
LCC's 侵襲 corresponds to the second 受盡 in UNV, which is untagged (gapping construction — the Hebrew verb H398 governs both clauses but UNV only marks it once). 侵襲 is therefore left unannotated.
The sleep-flight clause reorders in LCC: UNV/Hebrew order is fled(H5074)→sleep(H8142)→from-eyes(H4480+H5869); LCC reads 合眼(eyes)睡覺(sleep)都顧不得(fled). SNs distributed to semantic matches.
常是這樣(UNV) → 是常事(LCC): H1961+H8804 attached after 是 as the copular verb.

Gen/31.lcc_original: 我這二十年在你家裏：爲了你的兩個女兒，我服事你十四年；爲了你的羊羣，我服事你六年；你竟十次八次地更換了我的工價。
notes: LCC inserts explicit subject 我 in both service clauses (爲了你的兩個女兒，我服事你 / 爲了你的羊羣，我服事你) — Hebrew verb conjugation implies the subject, so no additional SN is needed for 我.
LCC expands UNV 十次 to 十次八次地 — only the first 十次 receives SNs (WH06235 + WH04489) since 八次地 has no Hebrew counterpart; it is LCC's idiomatic intensification.
LCC 更換 corresponds to UNV 改, both mapping to WH02498 (חָלַף, to change/replace); SNs transferred normally.
{<WAH0853>} kept implicit: the Hebrew direct object marker אֵת (WH0853) has no explicit lexical word in LCC, so braces are preserved.

Gen/31.lcc_sn: 若不是<WH03884>我父親<WH01>的上帝<WH0430>，亞伯拉罕<WH085>的上帝<WH0430>，以撒<WH03327>所敬畏<WH06343>的，與我<WAH09001>同在<WAH01961><WTH8804>，你如今<WAH06258>必定<WAH03588>打發我<WH07971><WTH8765>空手<WH07387>回去的。但是{<WAH0853>}我的苦情<WH06040>和{<WAH0853>}我親手<WH03709>所勞碌<WH03018>的，上帝<WH0430>都看見<WH07200><WTH8804>了，所以他昨夜<WH0570>指正<WH03198><WTH8686>你。』
Gen/31.lcc_original: 若不是我父親的上帝，亞伯拉罕的上帝，以撒所敬畏的，與我同在，你如今必定打發我空手回去的。但是我的苦情和我親手所勞碌的，上帝都看見了，所以他昨夜指正你。』
Gen/31.unv_sn_reference: 若不是<WH03884>我父親<WH01>以撒<WH03327>所敬畏<WH06343>的　神<WH0430>，就是亞伯拉罕<WH085>的　神<WH0430>與我<WAH09001>同在<WAH01961><WTH8804>，你如今<WAH06258>必定<WAH03588>打發我<WH07971><WTH8765>空手<WH07387>而去。　神<WH0430>看見<WH07200><WTH8804>{<WAH0853>}我的苦情<WH06040>和<WAH0853>我的勞碌<WH03018><WH03709>，就在昨夜<WH0570>責備<WH03198><WTH8686>你。」
notes: LCC reorders the three divine epithets: UNV sequences 父親(WH01)→以撒(WH03327)→敬畏(WH06343)→神(WH0430)→亞伯拉罕(WH085)→神(WH0430), while LCC reorders to 父親→上帝(1st WH0430)→亞伯拉罕(WH085)→上帝(2nd WH0430)→以撒(WH03327)→敬畏(WH06343); SN tags follow LCC word order.
LCC topicalizes the direct objects ('我的苦情和我親手所勞碌的，上帝都看見了') vs UNV's verb-object order ('神看見…苦情…勞碌'); SN placement follows LCC clause structure.
LCC 親手 (with own hands) renders Hebrew כַּף WH03709 (palm/hand); WH03018 (יְגִיעַ, toil) assigned to 所勞碌.

Both direct object markers WAH0853 kept as {<WAH0853>} since LCC has no explicit Chinese word for the Hebrew accusative particle אֵת — this applies to the second instance which lacked braces in UNV as well.
LCC 指正 (point out/correct) renders WH03198 יָכַח (reprove/rebuke) with morphology WTH8686 (Hiphil imperfect) attached.
LCC 回去 (directional complement 'go back') adds directionality absent from the Hebrew; left unannotated. LCC 都 (adverb 'all/both') and 所以他 (consequential 'so he') similarly unannotated.

Gen/31.lcc_original: 拉班回答雅各說：『這些女兒是我的女兒；這些孩子是我的孩子；這些羊羣是我的羊羣：其實凡你所看見的、都是我的：對【3】我這些女兒、或是她們所生的孩子們，我今天能作甚麼呢？
notes: UNV 眼前<WH07200><WTH8802> (before eyes) maps to LCC 看見 (see) — both render Hebrew רֹאֶה (Qal participle); UNV's implicit position for <WAH0834> (אֲשֶׁר) is expressed by LCC's 所 particle in 你所看見.

LCC restructures UNV's 向他們<WAH09001><WAH0428> (to these) from its clause-final position into topic position 對...我這些女兒 at clause head: <WAH09001> assigned to 對 (expressing the לָ- prefix of לָאֵלֶּה) and <WAH0428> assigned to 這些 (אֵלֶּה); the possessive <WAH09001> of לִבְנֹתַי assigned to 我.
其實 (LCC connective/emphatic particle introducing the second half) has no direct Hebrew lexical equivalent; left unannotated.
LCC 或是<WH0176> more faithfully renders Hebrew אוֹ (or) than UNV 並 (and) — same SN H0176 applies.
{<WAH0413>} kept implicit: LCC expresses 回答雅各 without an explicit preposition 至/向/對, same as UNV.

Gen/31.lcc_sn: 來吧<WH03212><WTH8798>，現在<WAH06258>我們立<WH03772><WTH8799>個約<WH01285>吧：我<WAH0589>與你<WAH0859>。就讓以下這個、做<WAH01961><WTH8804>你<WAH0996>我之間<WAH0996>的證據<WAH09001><WH05707>。』
Gen/31.lcc_original: 來吧，現在我們立個約吧：我與你。就讓以下這個、做你我之間的證據。』
notes: H6258 (עַתָּה = now) was implicit {<WAH06258>} in UNV (no explicit Chinese word), but LCC has explicit 現在 — dropped braces and attached as normal per Rule 3.

UNV's 你<WAH0859>我<WAH0589> (the covenant parties listed before 立約) map to LCC's 我<WAH0589>與你<WAH0859> after the colon — LCC restructures the sentence order, placing the parties after 立個約吧 as an appositive, so the SNs follow that reordering.

LCC 我們 (we) before 立 has no direct SN — it is a paraphrastic subject covering both parties and is left unannotated; the explicit 我/你 SNs are placed on the covenant-party phrase 我…與你 later in the verse.

Double H0996 (בֵּין × 2, between me and between thee): UNV pattern 你<WAH0996>我中間<WAH0996> is followed in LCC as 你<WAH0996>我之間<WAH0996>, attaching first instance to 你 and second to 之間 to mirror the Hebrew dual-preposition construct.
LCC phrase 就讓以下這個 is a periphrastic idiom with no Hebrew lexical equivalent — left unannotated.

Gen/31.lcc_original: 雅各就取了一塊石頭，立爲聖柱。
notes: 了 is a Chinese aspect particle with no Hebrew equivalent (rule 5); SNs for 'take' (H03947 + morphology) attach after 取, before 了
LCC 爲聖柱 corresponds to UNV 作柱子 (H04676, מַצֵּבָה); LCC adds 聖 ('sacred') as an interpretive gloss — no separate SN, all of H04676 attaches to the full phrase 爲聖柱

Gen/31.lcc_original: 拉班【4】又對他的族弟兄們說：『撿石頭！』他們就拿石頭作成一堆，大家就在那裏，在那一堆旁邊，喫喝。
notes: UNV has implicit {H03290} (Jacob/יַעֲקֹב) as subject; LCC has explicit 拉班 (Laban) — these name different persons, indicating a translation divergence (Hebrew Gen 31:46 has Jacob as speaker, וַיֹּאמֶר יַעֲקֹב). Per Rule 3, since LCC makes the subject explicit, H03290 is attached to 拉班 without braces, but this semantic mismatch lowers confidence.

LCC elaborates the locative clause as 在那裏，在那一堆旁邊 vs. UNV's compact 在...旁邊那裏. Mapped H08033 (שָׁם, there) to 那裏 and H05921 (עַל, upon/at) to the second 在 before 那一堆. The second heap mention (那一堆) is explicit in LCC but implicit in UNV, so braces are dropped per Rule 3.
喝 (drink) carries no SN tag in UNV; left unannotated per Rule 5.

Gen/31.lcc_original: 拉班將它叫做伊迦爾撒哈杜他【5】；雅各卻把它叫做迦累得。
Gen/31.unv_sn_reference: 拉班<WH03837>稱<WH07121><WTH8799>那石堆<WAH09001>為伊迦爾‧撒哈杜他<WH03026>，雅各<WH03290>卻稱<WH07121><WTH8804>那石堆<WAH09001>為迦累得<WH01567>（都是以石堆為證的意思）。
notes: LCC replaces 那石堆 (that heap) with pronoun 它 (it) in both clauses — <WAH09001> attached to 它 as the referent of the heap
LCC uses 將…叫做 / 把…叫做 constructions in place of UNV's 稱…為; <WH07121> and morphology codes attached to 叫做 (the semantically equivalent verb)
將 and 把 are Chinese grammatical aspect/disposal markers with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated
The UNV parenthetical (都是以石堆為證的意思) is absent from LCC; no SNs were attached to it in UNV so no loss of annotation
LCC footnote marker 【5】 preserved in situ after the Aramaic name

Gen/31.lcc_original: 拉班說：『今天、這一堆是你我之間的證據』；於是給它起名叫迦累得。
notes: UNV 石堆 (stone heap) → LCC 一堆 (heap): LCC omits the 石 (stone) qualifier, but H01530 (גַּל = cairn/heap) still maps cleanly to 一堆.
作你<WAH0996>我中間<WAH0996> → 是你<WAH0996>我之間<WAH0996>: the two בֵּין tokens (בֵּינִי / בֵּינְךָ) are split across 你 and 我之間, mirroring UNV's split. Copula 是 is unannotated (same as UNV's 作).

這地方名<WH08034>叫<WH07121><WTH8804> → 起名<WH08034>叫<WH07121><WTH8804>: LCC adds 給它 as a Chinese expression; these two characters are unannotated. H08034 (שֵׁם = name) attaches to 起名, H07121+H8804 (קָרָא = called) attaches to 叫.
因此 (UNV) → 於是 (LCC): both idioms cover עַל-כֵּן, receiving the same <WAH05921><WAH03651> pair.

Gen/31.lcc_original: 又叫米斯巴，就是，他說，「我們隔別、彼此不見面時願永恆主在你我之間也鑒察」。
notes: UNV 意思<WH0834> → LCC 就是 (both render אֲשֶׁר as 'namely/that is')
LCC adds explicit subject pronoun 他 before 說; SN tagged to the verb: 他說<WH0559><WTH8804>
{<WAH03588>} (כִּי) remains implicit — LCC also has no explicit conjunction here; placed at start of quoted speech matching UNV structure
LCC reverses UNV's 彼此/離別 order: 隔別 (WH05641/WTH8735) comes before 彼此 (WH0376/WAH04480/WH07453), which actually matches Hebrew word order: נִסְתֵּר אִישׁ מֵרֵעֵהוּ
LCC's 不見面 elaborates on 隔別 with no direct Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated
永恆主 is LCC's rendering of יְהוָה (WH03068)
Both instances of WAH0996 (בֵּינִי וּבֵינֶךָ = 'between me and between you') attach to the single phrase 之間, as LCC fuses both into 在你我之間
也 is a Chinese discourse/emphasis particle with no Hebrew equivalent — unannotated; SN attaches to 鑒察

Gen/31.lcc_sn: 你若是<WAH0518>苦待<WH06031><WTH8762>{<WAH0853>}我的女兒<WH01323>，若是<WAH0518>在我的女兒<WH01323>以外<WH05921>、另娶<WH03947><WTH8799>些妻子<WH0802>、而沒有<WAH0369>人<WH0376>同<WAH05973>我們在一起，看哪<WH07200><WTH8798>，上帝<WH0430>就是你我之間<WAH0996><WAH0996>的見證<WH05707>。』
Gen/31.lcc_original: 你若是苦待我的女兒，若是在我的女兒以外、另娶些妻子、而沒有人同我們在一起，看哪，上帝就是你我之間的見證。』
notes: LCC restructures the parallel clauses: both conditions open with 若是, so the second UNV 又<WAH0518> maps to LCC's second 若是<WAH0518>
{<WAH05973>} was implicit in UNV (עִמָּנוּ = 'with us'), but LCC renders it explicitly as 同…在一起; per Rule 3, braces dropped and tag attached to 同
UNV 知道<WH07200><WTH8798> (רָאָה 'to see') maps to LCC 看哪 — LCC renders the imperative 'see!' as an exclamatory interjection; tag placed after 看哪 as a unit
Hebrew בֵּינִי וּבֵינֶךָ uses H0996 twice (UNV: 在你<WAH0996>我中間<WAH0996>); LCC compresses to 你我之間, so both <WAH0996> tags consolidate there
UNV 神<WH0430> → LCC 上帝<WH0430>: both render אֱלֹהִים (H0430), systematic UNV/LCC lexical difference

Gen/31.lcc_original: 拉班對雅各說：『你看這一堆；你看我所立在你我之間的這聖柱。

UNV '他容納<WH05375><WTH8799>我<WH06440>' renders יִשָּׂא פָנַי freely ('accept me'); LCC '他會讓我的臉抬得起' is more literal ('let my face be lifted'). WH05375+WTH8799 assigned to 抬得起 (the lifting verb), WH06440 assigned to 臉 (face), matching the Hebrew lexemes directly.

LCC '去解' contains a Chinese directional complement 去 that has no independent Hebrew correspondent; WH01980<WTH8802> (הָלַךְ, participial) is assigned to 走 in the relative clause 在我前面走的禮物, not to the directional 去.
LCC '用' (by means of) and UNV '藉著' both introduce the instrumental phrase — neither has a SN in UNV, so 用 is left unannotated.

Gen/32.lcc_original: 於是禮物在他前面過去了。那一夜雅各在營中過夜。
notes: 先 (UNV) → 在他前面 (LCC): UNV compresses עַל פָּנִים (H5921+H6440) into adverb 先; LCC expands to full prepositional phrase 在他前面. Both SNs appended after 前面 as the phrase end.
住宿 (UNV) → 過夜 (LCC): different lexical renderings of לוּן H3885 (to lodge/spend the night).
隊 (UNV) → 營 (LCC): synonymous renderings of מַחֲנֶה H4264 (camp/encampment).
LCC adds 一 before 夜 (一夜) as a Chinese numeral/article with no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated.

Gen/32.lcc_original: 那一夜雅各起來，帶着他的兩個妻子、兩個婢女和十一個孩子、過了雅博渡。
notes: UNV uses pronoun 他<WAH01931> but LCC uses explicit name 雅各; WAH01931 attached to 雅各 per Rule 3 (implicit pronoun → explicit name)
帶着 in LCC absorbs WH03947+WTH8799 (from 帶) and WAH0853 (from 著) as a single coverb unit since 着 directly corresponds to 著
{<WAH0853>} before 兩個婢女 remains implicit (Rule 4) — LCC uses 、 punctuation to separate the list item, not an explicit Chinese word carrying the Hebrew וְאֶת
並(UNV) → 和(LCC), both carrying WAH0853 for the conjunction+DO marker וְאֶת before 十一個孩子
Lexical differences bridged by same Hebrew lemma: 使女→婢女 (H08198), 兒子→孩子 (H03206), 渡口→渡 (H04569)

Gen/32.lcc_original: 他帶着他們，打發他們過河，又打發他所有的都過去。，
notes: H3947 (לָקַח, 'to take') → LCC 帶着 (UNV uses 打發 for the same word; LCC's rendering is a valid paraphrase of 'took with him').

First clause: LCC uses 打發他們過 for H5674 Hiphil ('caused to cross'); tag placed on 過 (the crossing verb = lexical root), consistent with UNV where 過 carries H5674 in the same clause. LCC's 打發 here serves as a causative helper and is left unannotated.
Second clause: 打發 in LCC directly parallels UNV 打發<WH05674> — tag placed on 打發 per UNV pattern.
LCC adds 他 (possessive pronoun for לוֹ 'his') before 所有的; {<WAH0853>} placed immediately after 打發 and before 他所有的, following UNV's positional pattern for the implicit DO marker.

Gen/32.lcc_original: 只剩下雅各自己一人，有一個人來同他摔跤【3】，直到天快亮的時候。
notes: UNV 一人<WAH09001><WAH0905> maps to LCC 自己一人 — LCC adds 自己 to make the 'alone' sense explicit; SNs attached after 一人 at end of phrase
UNV 和他<WAH05973> maps to LCC 同他 — 同 is the functionally equivalent preposition 'with'; <WAH05973> attached after 同他
UNV 黎明<WH05927><WTH8800><WH07837> (lit. 'rising of the dawn') maps to LCC 天快亮 — LCC renders the Hebrew construct phrase idiomatically; all three SNs attached after 天快亮, before 的時候
Footnote marker 【3】 preserved in original position after 摔跤 SN tags

Gen/32.lcc_original: 那人見自己勝不過他，就將他的大腿窩打了一下，雅各的大腿窩在同那人摔跤的時候就扭了。
notes: LCC uses 打了一下 (struck once) instead of UNV's 摸了一把 (touched/felt); both correspond to נגע WH05060 — attached to 打 which carries the action
WAH05973 (עִם, 'with') was implicit {<WAH05973>} in UNV since Chinese has no explicit word; LCC explicitly uses 同 ('with'), so braces dropped and tag attached to 同
LCC explicitly adds 那人 as the referent in 同那人摔跤, making the implicit pronoun in the Hebrew (עִמּוֹ) explicit — the 那人 repetition itself has no distinct Hebrew lemma and is left unannotated
{<WAH03588>} (כִּי, 'that') remains implicit in LCC as in UNV — no explicit conjunction bridges 見 and 自己勝 in either translation

Gen/32.lcc_original: 那人說：『天快亮了，讓我走吧。』雅各說：『你不給我祝福，我就不讓你走。』
notes: UNV 黎明 (daybreak) → LCC 快亮: both render עָלָה (WH05927) describing the dawn rising; WH07837 (שַׁחַר) attaches to 天 in both versions
UNV 容 → LCC 讓: both mean 'let/allow', mapping to שָׁלַח (WH07971); morphology codes WTH8761/8762 follow the full phrase in each clause
Both {<WAH03588>} occurrences remain implicit in LCC — no explicit Chinese word for כִּי in either clause
{<WH0518>} (אִם) remains implicit in LCC as in UNV; the negative condition is carried by 不 which has no separate SN
LCC 了 (aspect particle) left unannotated — no Hebrew equivalent
LCC punctuation (『』vs UNV 「」) preserved exactly as given

Gen/32.lcc_original: 那人對他說：『你名叫甚麼？』他說：『雅各。』
notes: UNV's {<WAH0413>} (implicit אֵלָיו, 'to him') is explicit in LCC as '對他'; braces dropped per Rule 3. Tag attached after '他' since '對他' together represents the Hebrew suffixed preposition (אֵל + pronominal suffix -יו). Placement after the full phrase rather than just '對' to better reflect the unit.
LCC omits UNV's '我名叫' in Jacob's reply, retaining only '雅各'; <WH03290> attached directly to '雅各' with no other words to annotate in that clause.

Gen/32.lcc_original: 那人說：『你的名不要再叫雅各，要叫以色列【4】，因爲【5】你跟神跟人較力，都得了勝【5】。』
notes: UNV uses 與 (with/preposition) twice; LCC substitutes 跟 in both instances — <WAH05973> attaches to 跟 each time
LCC footnote markers 【4】 and 【5】 preserved in their original positions; SN tags inserted before the markers, not after
{<WAH03588>} and {<WAH0518>} remain implicit (braces kept) — LCC also has no explicit lexical words at those positions
UNV has an ideographic space before 神 (　神); LCC omits it — no effect on SN alignment

Gen/32.lcc_original: 雅各問說：『請將你的名告訴我。』那人說：『你爲甚麼問我的名？』他就在那裏給雅各祝福。
notes: UNV '問…他說' (WH07592+WTH8799 / WH0559+WTH8799) maps to LCC '問說' — distributed across the two characters respectively.

UNV '何必' (WAH09001+WAH04100+WH02088, lit. לָמָּה זֶּה) maps to LCC '你爲甚麼'; the 你 is a LCC clarification not present in Hebrew, so the three tags are attached to 甚麼 as the end of the equivalent phrase.
UNV '於是' carries no SN; LCC '他就' likewise left unannotated — both are transition markers added for readability.
WAH0853 (direct object marker אֵת) retained on 雅各 as in UNV.

Gen/32.lcc_original: 雅各便給那地方起名叫毘努伊勒【6】，因爲他說：『我面對面地見了上帝，我的性命還得保全。』
Gen/32.unv_sn_reference: 雅各<WH03290>便給那地方<WH04725>起名<WH08034>叫<WH07121><WTH8799>毘努伊勒<WH06439>（就是　神之面的意思），意思說<WAH03588>：「我面<WH06440>對<WAH0413>面<WH06440>見了<WH07200><WTH8804>　神<WH0430>，我的性命<WH05315>仍得保全<WH05337><WTH8735>。」
notes: UNV uses 神 but LCC uses 上帝 for H0430 (אֱלֹהִים) — standard lexical difference between the two versions; tag attached to 上帝 normally.
UNV's parenthetical '（就是　神之面的意思）' is absent in LCC; no SNs were assigned there so nothing is lost.
意思說<WAH03588> in UNV → 因爲<WAH03588>他說 in LCC. כִּי (H03588) maps directly to 因爲; 他說 is LCC's interpretive addition with no Hebrew correspondent and is left unannotated.
LCC's adverbial particle 地 (in 面對面地) has no Hebrew equivalent and is left unannotated between the second 面<WH06440> and 見了<WH07200>.

Gen/32.lcc_original: 雅各剛過了毘努伊勒，日剛剛出、來照他；他卻斜靠着大腿瘸着瘸着走了。
notes: LCC reverses clause order vs UNV/Hebrew: 'Jacob crossed Penuel' precedes 'sun rose', whereas UNV (and Hebrew) opens with the sun rising. SN tags were distributed to their semantic counterparts across the reordered clauses.
UNV 日頭 (WH08121) → LCC 日 only; the 頭 suffix is absent in LCC so only 日 is tagged.
UNV 剛出來 (WH02224+WTH8799) → LCC 剛剛出; tags attached to 出 as the verb of rising.
{<WAH09001>} (כ temporal prefix from כַּאֲשֶׁר) has no explicit LCC counterpart; kept implicit and placed before 日 at the temporal clause boundary.
LCC adds 來照他 for the Hebrew pronominal suffix לוֹ on the verb זָרַח; this suffix is not separately tagged in UNV and is left unannotated.
LCC 斜靠着 (leaning askew) is an interpretive expansion with no direct Hebrew or UNV counterpart; left unannotated.
LCC reduplicative 瘸着瘸着走 renders H6760 צָלַע; WH06760+WTH8802 attached to the first 瘸.

Gen/32.lcc_original: 故此以色列人不喫大腿窩上的坐骨神經筋，直到今日；因爲那人在坐骨神經筋上將雅各的大腿窩打了一下。
notes: LCC uses compound 坐骨神經筋 (sciatic nerve) to render both H1517 (גִּיד, sinew) and H5384 (הַנָּשֶׁה, nasheh) — both tags attached to this single word; braces dropped since LCC explicitly names the concept (Rule 3 applied to H5384).
LCC's explicit 上 in 大腿窩上 (first clause) renders the implicit {<WAH05921>} — braces dropped per Rule 3.
{<WAH0834>} kept implicit: LCC's 的 is a Chinese structural/genitive particle, not an explicit rendering of the Hebrew relative particle אשׁר.

Second clause is heavily restructured in LCC ('on the sciatic nerve struck Jacob's thigh hollow' vs. Hebrew/UNV order). WAH09002 (ב prefix) follows the UNV convention of attaching to the noun it prefixes in Hebrew: 坐骨神經筋<WAH09002><WH01517><WH05384> (for בְּגִיד הַנָּשֶׁה) and 窩<WAH09002><WH03709> (for בְּכַף). The Chinese preposition 在 and particle 上 carry no separate SN tags.
LCC's 打了一下 (struck once) maps to H5060+H8804 (נָגַע, touch/strike, qal perfect) — LCC intensifies 'touch' to 'struck once' but it is the same Hebrew root.

Gen/33.lcc_original: 雅各舉目一看，只見以掃來了；同他一齊來的還有四百人。雅各就把孩子們分爲兩隊，交給利亞、拉結和兩個婢女，
notes: 觀看<WH07200><WTH8799> → 一看<WH07200><WTH8799>: LCC condenses 觀看 to 一看; same Hebrew root, tags attached after 看
見<WAH02009> → 只見<WAH02009>: LCC adds 只 for emphasis; WAH02009 (הִנֵּה, 'behold') attached after 見
後頭跟著<WAH05973> → 同<WAH05973>: H5973 is עִם ('with'); LCC expands to 同他一齊來的還有 — 同 is the lexical anchor for עִם; the remainder are LCC's natural-language elaboration with no SN equivalents

分開<WH02673><WTH8799> → 分爲兩隊<WH02673><WTH8799>: H2673 is חָצָה ('to halve/divide'); LCC expands to 分爲兩隊 (divide into two groups) making the 'two' explicit; tags attached after 隊 as the phrase is a single semantic unit
他就把<WAH0853> → 雅各就把<WAH0853>: LCC restarts with the proper noun for clarity; 把 is the Chinese direct-object marker corresponding to את (H853)
使女<WH08198> → 婢女<WH08198>: LCC uses 婢女 for handmaids; same semantic referent, tag transferred normally
{<WAH05921>} before 拉結 remains implicit: LCC's 、 separator introduces no explicit word for the second עַל, so braces are preserved

Gen/33.lcc_original: 把兩個婢女和她們的孩子放在頭裏，利亞和她的孩子在後頭，拉結和約瑟在儘後頭。
notes: LCC uses a 把-construction (把…放) inverting UNV's verb-first order (叫<WH07760>…在前頭). <WH07760><WTH8799> attached to 放 (the actual verb in LCC) rather than 叫.
First {<WAH0853>} (implicit את in UNV) maps to explicit 把 in LCC → braces dropped, tag placed after 把.
LCC 婢女 vs UNV 使女: synonyms, both = maidservant (WH08198).
LCC 在頭裏 vs UNV 在前頭: different phrasing for 'at the front/first position' (WH07223); tag attached to 頭裏.
Second and third {<WAH0853>} (before Leah and Rachel) kept with braces — LCC has no explicit object marker in those clauses.

Gen/33.lcc_original: 他自己卻在他們前面過去，一連七次地下拜在地上，直到挨近他哥哥。
notes: LCC adds 卻 (adversative particle, Chinese stylistic addition) — left unannotated
LCC 下拜 = UNV 俯伏, both translate H7812 שָׁחָה; SNs attached after 下拜
LCC 在地上 vs UNV 在地 — added 上 for naturalness; H776 attached after 在地上 as the whole phrase is the referent
LCC 直到 covers UNV 才 for the first H5704 עַד; placed immediately after 直到
LCC 挨近 = UNV 就近, both translate H5066 נָגַשׁ with infinitive construct morphology H8800
The second H5704 (עַד אָחִיו, 'until his brother') remains implicit {<WAH05704>} — LCC connects 挨近 directly to 他哥哥 without an explicit preposition, so no explicit Chinese word absorbs this second עַד
LCC 地 between 次 and 下拜 is a Chinese verbal modifier particle with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated

Gen/33.lcc_original: 以掃跑來迎接他，將他抱住，伏在他脖子上，和他親嘴；兩個人都哭了。
notes: UNV 又摟著<WH05307><WTH8799>{<WAH05921>}他的頸項<WH06677> → LCC 伏在他脖子上: H05307 (nāpal, fell/prostrated) attaches to 伏; WAH05921 (עַל, upon) was implicit/braced in UNV but LCC explicitly expresses it as 在…上, so braces dropped per Rule 3 and tag attached to 在; H06677 (neck) attaches to 脖子.
LCC 和他親嘴 vs UNV 與他親嘴: both mean 'kissed him'; H05401+WTH8799 attach after 親嘴 unchanged.
LCC 兩個人都哭了 vs UNV 兩個人就哭了: 都/就 are stylistic adverbial particles with no independent SN; H01058+WTH8799 attach after 哭了.

Gen/33.lcc_original: 以掃舉目、看見婦人孩子，就說：『這些跟着你的是誰？』雅各說：『是上帝施恩給你僕人的孩子。』
notes: <WAH0834> (אֲשֶׁר) transfers from 是 in UNV to 的 in LCC — LCC restructures the relative clause so that 的 (not 是) serves as the relativizer linking the predicate clause to 孩子 at the end.
神 (UNV) → 上帝 (LCC): standard lexical difference for אֱלֹהִים between the two versions; <WH0430> follows 上帝.
<WAH09001> (ל prefix = 'to/with you') attaches to 跟着你 in LCC, corresponding to 和你 in UNV — both render לָּךְ.
LCC omits possessive 的 in 你僕人 vs UNV's 你的僕人; <WH05650> attaches to 僕人 in both cases.
孩子<WH03206> moves from sentence-initial position in UNV (這些孩子) to sentence-final in LCC (的孩子) due to structural reorganization; SN follows word in its LCC position.

Gen/33.lcc_sn: 於是兩個婢女<WH08198>和她們<WAH02007>的孩子<WH03206>就走近前來<WH05066><WTH8799>下拜<WH07812><WTH8691>。
Gen/33.lcc_original: 於是兩個婢女和她們的孩子就走近前來下拜。
Gen/33.unv_sn_reference: 於是兩個使女<WH08198>和她們<WAH02007>的孩子<WH03206>前來<WH05066><WTH8799>下拜<WH07812><WTH8691>；
notes: 使女 (UNV) → 婢女 (LCC): different lexeme for maidservant/bondwoman, same referent, WH08198 attaches to 婢女

H05066 (נגשׁ, draw near/approach) is rendered in LCC as the expanded phrase 走近前來; SNs attached after the full phrase; 就 is a Chinese connective particle with no Hebrew equivalent and is left unannotated
LCC terminal punctuation 。 preserved (UNV has ；)

Gen/33.lcc_original: 利亞和她的孩子也走近前來下拜：隨後約瑟和拉結也走近前來下拜。
notes: LCC expands UNV 前來 to 走近前來 in both clauses; since Hebrew H05066 (נגשׁ, draw near/approach) covers the entire approach action, all tags for 前來 are attached after the full LCC phrase 走近前來
Second clause 也 carries no separate WAH tag (matching UNV pattern where only the first clause 也 has <WAH01571>)

Gen/33.lcc_original: 以掃說：『我所遇見的這一整隊的牲畜，是甚麼意思阿？』雅各說：『是要求我主賞臉的。』
notes: LCC '一整隊的牲畜' covers UNV '些群畜': WAH03605 (כֹּל, all/whole) attached to '一整', WH04264 (מַחֲנֶה, camp/company) attached to '隊'; '的牲畜' is LCC's added clarifying noun with no Hebrew equivalent.

LCC '賞臉' is a single idiomatic compound (show favor/grace with one's presence) covering both WH02580 (חֵן, grace) and WAH09002+WH05869 (בְּעֵינֵי, in the eyes of); all three SNs attached to '賞臉' as one unit per rule 6.

LCC '求' maps to UNV '蒙' (WAH09001+WH04672+WTH8800, לִמְצֹא = to find/seek, Qal inf.cs.); word order differs between UNV and LCC (UNV: 在我主面前蒙恩 vs. LCC: 求我主賞臉) but the verb-of-seeking maps cleanly to '求'.
{<WAH09001>} kept implicit after '阿' — LCC similarly lacks an explicit word for לְךָ (to you) in the question, parallel to UNV's placement after '呢'.

Gen/33.lcc_original: 以掃說：『我的已經彀了；你的仍歸你吧，弟弟。』
notes: UNV places 兄弟<WH0251> (WH0251, אָח) as a vocative at the start of the speech (「兄弟啊」), but LCC moves the address to the end of the speech as 弟弟. WH0251 is attached to 弟弟 at its actual LCC position.
LCC uses the archaic character 彀 where UNV uses 夠 — both represent WH07227 (רַב, 'enough/many'); SN transferred without change.
Aspect particle 了 remains unannotated as it has no Hebrew equivalent.

Gen/33.lcc_original: 雅各說：『不，若蒙你賞臉，求你從我手裏收下我這一點禮物；因爲我旣見了你的面、如同見了上帝的面，而你還容納我，就理當如此。
notes: 不然 (UNV) → 不 (LCC): both WAH0408+WAH04994 attached to 不, which carries the full negation-entreaty force of אַל-נָא.
蒙你賞臉 covers Hebrew מָצָאתִי חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ; distributed as: 蒙=WH04672+WTH8804 (found, מָצָאתִי), 你=WAH09002+WH05869 (in your eyes, בְּ+עֵינֶיךָ), 賞臉=WH02580 (grace, חֵן).
Second נָא {WAH04994} after אִם kept implicit: UNV itself marks it implicit (UNV also has 求 yet still uses braces), so LCC follows the same convention.
WAH03588+WAH05921+WAH03651 (כִּי עַל-כֵּן) all compressed onto 因爲, following UNV's own compression; LCC's closing 就理當如此 expresses the same כֵּן idea rhetorically but is left unannotated.
旣 (LCC aspectual 'already/since') has no Hebrew SN equivalent and is left unannotated.
神 (UNV) → 上帝 (LCC): same אֱלֹהִים root WH0430; LCC makes the word explicit so braces are dropped per rule 3.

Gen/33.lcc_original: 請收下我的祝福禮，我所帶來給你的，因爲上帝施恩給我，又因爲我一切都有了。』逼着他，他纔收下。
notes: UNV {<WAH03588>} was implicit (braces), but LCC has explicit 又因爲, so braces dropped per Rule 3 — attach as 又因爲<WAH03588>.

LCC restructures the gift clause: '我的祝福禮，我所帶來給你的' (my blessing gift, which I brought to you) vs UNV's inline relative '我帶來給你的禮物'; SNs distributed accordingly — <WH01293> on 祝福禮, <WH0935><WTH8717> on 帶來.
{<WAH0834>} (אֲשֶׁר, relative pronoun) remains implicit — LCC uses 所…的 to form the relative clause rather than a word directly translating אֲשֶׁר; placed after 我所 to mirror UNV's positioning.
都有了 carries <WH03426> (יֵשׁ, 'there is/to have') as the verbal component closest to the existential meaning; 一切 carries <WH03605> (כֹּל).
LCC omits the subject 雅各 in the final clause; 逼 carries <WH06484><WTH8799> as the direct verb equivalent of UNV 求 (פָּצַר, to press/urge).

Gen/33.lcc_original: 以掃說：『我們起身走吧；我在你前頭走。』
notes: LCC merges UNV's 起身(H05265)+前往(H03212) into 起身+走, with 走 carrying H03212; the mapping is semantically direct since both mean 'set out' and 'go/walk'.
UNV's modal 可以 has no LCC equivalent and no separate SN — correctly left unannotated.
LCC's sentence-final modal particle 吧 has no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated.
The second 走 (final clause) repeats H03212+WTH8799, identical to UNV's second 走.

Gen/33.lcc_original: 雅各對他說：『我主知道孩子們嬌嫩，牛羊也正在我管餵奶的時候；把牠們催趕一天，整羣就都死了。

Gen/35.lcc_original: 他們便起行，隨有極大的驚慌佈滿了四圍的城市，他們就不追趕雅各的兒子了。
notes: H5265+TH8799 (נָסַע journeyed): UNV 前往 is absorbed — both 起行 and 前往 render the same verb; attached to 起行 as the primary motion word.

H430 (אֱלֹהִים God): Hebrew construct חִתַּת אֱלֹהִים = 'terror of God' (divine terror). UNV restructures it with 神 as subject; LCC collapses the divine intensifier into 極大的 (extreme/great), so H430 attaches there.
H1961 (הָיָה was/there was): UNV embeds it mid-clause as 都甚; LCC fronts the existential verb as 隨有 ('there followed/there was') — clean correspondence.
H5921 (עַל upon/over): UNV uses causative 使; LCC uses 佈滿了 (spread/fill over), which captures the 'over' spatial sense of עַל — best available match.
H834 (אֲשֶׁר which/that): Relative clause marker collapsed into the 四圍的 attributive structure; attached to 四圍 as the head of the relative description.
H310 (אַחַר after): Implicit {<WH0310>} in UNV and likewise implicit in LCC — 追趕…兒子 has no explicit 'after' word, so braces preserved.

Gen/35.lcc_original: 於是雅各到了迦南地的路斯，就是伯特利，他跟所有在一起的人口一同去。

H0935 (בּוֹא, came) assigned to 到 only; LCC's trailing 去 in 一同去 is a secondary clause verb added for natural Chinese flow with no Hebrew counterpart, left unannotated.
UNV 人 (H05971) → LCC 人口; semantic equivalent, tag preserved.
一同 in LCC is a Chinese adverb added for fluency, no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated.

Gen/35.lcc_original: 他在那裏築了一座祭壇，就給那地方起名叫伊勒伯特利【2】，因爲他逃避他哥哥那時候，上帝是在那裏向他顯示的。

Gen/35.lcc_original: 說：『你的名原是雅各；但今後你的名必不再叫雅各；要叫以色列：以色列纔要做你的名。』就給他起名叫以色列。

Gen/36.lcc_original: 羅坍的兒子是何利、希幔【6】；羅坍的妹妹是亭納。

The second 是 (before 亭納) carries no SN: in Hebrew this is a nominal clause (no explicit copula), so 是 is a Chinese addition with no Hebrew equivalent.

Gen/36.lcc_original: 朔巴的兒子是亞勒文【7】、瑪拿轄、以巴錄、示玻【8】、阿南。

Gen/36.lcc_original: 祭便的兒子是亞雅和亞拿。當時在曠野放他父親祭便的驢子、遇着毒蛇【9】的，就是這亞拿。

Gen/36.lcc_sn: 底順<WH01787>族系長<WH0441>、以察<WH0687>族系長<WH0441>、底珊<WH01789>族系長<WH0441>：以上這些<WAH0428>人是何利人<WH02753>所出的族系長<WH0441>，在西珥<WH08165>地<WAH09002><WH0776>按着他們的族系作的族長<WAH09001><WH0441>。

Gen/36.unv_sn_reference: 底順<WH01787>族長<WH0441>、以察<WH0687>族長<WH0441>、底珊<WH01789>族長<WH0441>。這是<WAH0428>從何利人<WH02753>所出的族長<WH0441>，都在西珥<WH08165>地<WAH09002><WH0776>，按著宗族作族長<WAH09001><WH0441>。

<WAH0428> (אֵלֶּה, 'these' with prefix) attached to 這些 within LCC's expanded phrase 以上這些人是, as 這些 is the closest demonstrative equivalent to UNV's 這是
LCC adds 他們的 before 族系 in the final clause with no SN counterpart in UNV; left unannotated per rule 5
<WAH09001><WH0441> (לְאַלּוּף, 'as chief') attached to 族長 at clause end, matching UNV attachment point

Gen/36.lcc_original: 當沒有王治理以色列人以前、在以東地執政的王就是以下這些人。
notes: UNV 君王<WH04428> → LCC 王 (first occurrence, in 沒有王 clause): LCC abbreviates to single character
UNV 作<WH04427><WTH8804>王<WH04428> splits across two LCC words: H4427+WTH8804 attach to 執政 (the verbal sense of ruling), H4428 attaches to 王 (the nominal king)
UNV 以先<WAH09001><WH06440> → LCC 以前: same compound meaning; tags attach to 以前
H0428 (אֵלֶּה, 'these') → LCC 這些; the trailing 人 is LCC's explicit addition with no Hebrew counterpart, left unannotated
UNV 當 and 就是 have no corresponding SN tags in UNV source, left unannotated in LCC as well

Gen/36.lcc_sn: 那時在以東<WAH09002><WH0123>作王<WH04427><WTH8799>的有比珥<WH01160>的兒子<WH01121>比拉<WH01106>；他的京城<WH05892>名<WH08034>叫亭哈巴<WH01838>。
Gen/36.lcc_original: 那時在以東作王的有比珥的兒子比拉；他的京城名叫亭哈巴。
notes: LCC inverts UNV's subject-first order to a topicalized predicate-first structure ('在以東作王的有比珥的兒子比拉'), but all Hebrew lexemes are present and map 1-to-1; SNs attach to the same words in their new positions.
LCC adds 那時 (temporal marker) and 的有 (copular structure) with no Hebrew equivalents — left unannotated.
Morphology tag <WTH8799> retained on 作王 as in UNV.

Gen/36.lcc_original: 比拉死了，波斯拉人謝拉的兒子約巴接替他作王。
notes: 接續他<WAH08478> (UNV, 'succeeded him') → 接替他<WAH08478> (LCC, 'replaced him'): same semantic role (H8478 = in place of/instead of), SN attaches to the same positional phrase; all other tokens are character-for-character identical between UNV and LCC.

Gen/36.lcc_original: 約巴死了，提幔人之地的戶珊接替他作王。
notes: UNV orders '提幔(WH08489) + 地的(WAH04480+WH0776) + 人 + 戶珊(WH02367)'; LCC reorders to '提幔人之地的戶珊'. WH08489 (Teman) still anchors to 提幔; WAH04480+WH0776 (מֵאֶרֶץ, 'from the land of') attaches to the whole phrase 人之地的 which covers the same semantic content as UNV's 地的.
UNV's 人 carries no SN; in LCC it merges into 人之地的 as part of the Temanite demonym — no SN gap introduced.
接替他 maps cleanly to WAH08478 (תַּחְתָּיו, 'in his place'), matching UNV's 接續他.

Gen/36.lcc_original: 戶珊死了，比達的兒子哈達接替他作王；這哈達就是在摩押田野上擊敗了米甸人的；他的京城名叫亞未得。
notes: 接續他→接替他: both render H8478 (תַּחַת 'in his place'); tag attaches after 他
地→田野上: H7704 (שָׂדֶה 'field/plain') maps to 田野; 上 is a Chinese spatial particle with no Hebrew correspondent and is left unannotated
殺敗→擊敗: both render H5221 (נָכָה 'to smite')
了 after 擊敗 is a Chinese aspect particle, not a translation of H853 (אֵת direct object marker), so {<WAH0853>} remains implicit between 了 and 米甸人
LCC uses ；after 米甸人的 (vs ，in UNV); LCC punctuation preserved exactly

Gen/36.lcc_original: 哈達死了，瑪士利加人桑拉接替他作王。
notes: UNV 接續他 → LCC 接替他: synonymous ('succeeded him / took his place'); <WAH08478> (תַּחְתָּיו, 'in his place') attaches to 他 in both versions without ambiguity. All other tokens are identical.

Gen/36.lcc_original: 桑拉死了，大河邊的利河伯人掃羅接替他作王。
notes: 接續他 (UNV) → 接替他 (LCC): synonym substitution, both render H08478 (תַּחְתָּיו, 'in his place'); <WAH08478> attaches to 接替他 without issue.

Gen/36.lcc_original: 掃羅死了，亞革波的兒子巴勒哈南接替他作王。
notes: LCC writes 巴勒哈南 without the middle dot (‧) used in UNV's 巴勒‧哈南; SN WH01177 attaches to the full name as one unit
LCC uses 接替 (replace/succeed) where UNV uses 接續 for the same Hebrew root underlying WAH08478; tag attaches after 接替他 in LCC

Gen/36.lcc_original: 亞革波的兒子巴勒哈南死了，哈達【14】接替他作王；他的京城名叫巴烏【15】；他的妻子名叫米希他別，是米薩合的孫女瑪特列的女兒。
notes: 巴勒‧哈南 (UNV, with middle dot) → 巴勒哈南 (LCC, without middle dot) — same referent, WH01177 attached to full name
接續他 (UNV) → 接替他 (LCC) — synonymous verb phrase; WAH08478 (תַּחַת, 'in place of') attaches to 接替他 as a unit
米希她別 (UNV) → 米希他別 (LCC) — orthographic variant (她/他), same SN WH04105
米‧薩合 (UNV, with middle dot) → 米薩合 (LCC) — same name, WH04314 attached
LCC footnote markers 【14】 and 【15】 are editorial glosses; placed after their respective SN tags to preserve LCC text structure
LCC restructures the clause ending: UNV has comma after 作王 then 他的京城...; LCC uses semicolons for both breaks — punctuation preserved as-is per rules

Gen/36.lcc_original: 以掃所出的族系長的名字，按着宗族地方、照名字排列的是亭納族系長、亞勒瓦【16】族系長、耶帖族系長、
notes: LCC's '族系長的名字' makes UNV's implicit {<WH08034>} explicit; braces dropped per Rule 3 and SN attached to 名字 directly
LCC's 地方 (WH04725) maps to UNV's 住處 (place/location); 宗族地方 annotated per-word since each Chinese word corresponds to a distinct Hebrew root (WH04940 families, WH04725 locations)
排列的是<WAH0428> maps the demonstrative וְאֵלֶּה (UNV: 記在下面); LCC rephrases as participial + copula, SN attached to end of phrase
亞勒瓦【16】 footnote marker preserved in its original position; SN tag follows after the bracket

Gen/36.lcc_sn: 阿何利巴瑪<WH0173>族系長<WH0441>、以拉<WH0425>族系長<WH0441>、比嫩<WH06373>族系長<WH0441>、
Gen/36.lcc_original: 阿何利巴瑪族系長、以拉族系長、比嫩族系長、
Gen/36.unv_sn_reference: 阿何利巴瑪<WH0173>族長<WH0441>、以拉<WH0425>族長<WH0441>、比嫩<WH06373>族長<WH0441>、
notes: 族長 (UNV) → 族系長 (LCC): different renderings of H441 (אַלּוּף, chieftain/clan-head); LCC adds 系 for "lineage" nuance but covers the same Hebrew word
All three proper names (阿何利巴瑪, 以拉, 比嫩) are graphically identical between UNV and LCC

Gen/36.lcc_sn: 基納斯<WH07073>族系長<WH0441>、提幔<WH08487>族系長<WH0441>、米比薩<WH04014>族系長<WH0441>、
