Gen/36.lcc_sn: 瑪基疊<WH04025>族系長<WH0441>、以蘭<WH05902>族系長<WH0441>：以上這些<WAH0428>人是以東<WH0123>所有的族系長<WH0441>，在他們所得爲業產<WH0272>的地上<WAH09002><WH0776>、按着他們住的地方<WAH09001><WH04186>排列的。以東<WH0123>的始祖<WH01>就是<WAH01931>以掃<WH06215>。
Gen/36.lcc_original: 瑪基疊族系長、以蘭族系長：以上這些人是以東所有的族系長，在他們所得爲業產的地上、按着他們住的地方排列的。以東的始祖就是以掃。
Gen/36.unv_sn_reference: 瑪基疊<WH04025>族長<WH0441>、以蘭<WH05902>族長<WH0441>。這是<WAH0428>以東<WH0123>人<WH0441>在所得為業<WH0272>的地上<WAH09002><WH0776>，按著他們的住處<WAH09001><WH04186>。〈所有的族長都是<WAH01931>以東人<WH0123>的始祖<WH01>以掃<WH06215>的後代。〉
notes: UNV '人<WH0441>' in '以東人<WH0441>' translates אַלּוּף (chief/duke); LCC uses 族系長 consistently throughout, so the third WH0441 attaches to the second 族系長 in the main clause.
LCC '以上' (the above-listed) is a Chinese clarifying addition with no Hebrew equivalent; WAH0428 (אֵלֶּה = these) attaches to 這些 which directly corresponds to the Hebrew demonstrative.
LCC '業產' expands UNV '業' for WH0272 (אֲחֻזָּה = possession/property); SN attached to the full phrase 所得爲業產.
LCC '排列的' is a Chinese syntactic filler with no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated.

Final clause word order is inverted from Hebrew הוּא עֵשָׂו אֲבִי אֱדוֹם ('he Esau father-of Edom'); SNs assigned to semantic equivalents in LCC's restructured order: 以東<WH0123>的始祖<WH01>就是<WAH01931>以掃<WH06215>.

Gen/37.lcc_original: 雅各住在他父親寄居的地，就是在迦南地。
notes: LCC reverses clause order vs UNV: father's sojourning land appears first, Canaan second — matching the Hebrew (בְּאֶרֶץ מְגוּרֵי אָבִיו בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן) but opposite to UNV's rendering
LCC adds explicit 在 before 迦南地 to express the Hebrew בְּ prefix; <WAH09002> kept on 地 (consistent with UNV pattern) rather than split onto 在
First 地 (他父親寄居的地) has no explicit preposition 在 in LCC, so <WAH09002><WH0776> attach directly to 地

Gen/37.lcc_original: 以下這些人是雅各的後代……。約瑟十七歲，和他的哥哥們一同牧羊。他旣是個兒童，便和他父親的妾【1】的兒子們、就是辟拉的兒子和悉帕的兒子、常在一起。約瑟將他們的壞行爲報告他們的父親。
notes: WAH0428 (אֵלֶּה = 'these'): UNV places this at sentence-end as 如下; LCC opens with 以下這些人是. WAH0428 attached after the full phrase 以下這些人 since 這些人 is the direct rendering of אֵלֶּה.
{<WH01121>} for Bilhah's sons: originally implicit in UNV (辟拉{<WH01121>}), but LCC explicitly writes 辟拉的兒子 — braces dropped per Rule 3, tag attached to 兒子.
{<WAH01961>}{<WTH8804>} kept implicit: both LCC and UNV omit an explicit copula verb 'was/were'; the participial pasturing clause follows directly.
WAH0413 (אֶל = 'to'): UNV has explicit 給; LCC uses bare coverb 報告 with no separate directional marker, so tag kept implicit as {<WAH0413>}.
WH01121 age idiom (בֶּן = 'son of [years]'): tagged after 歲 following UNV convention, since the Hebrew age construction is wholly absorbed into 十七歲 in Chinese.
便 (consequential adverb in 旣…便 construction) has no Hebrew equivalent and is left unannotated; WAH0854 ('with') attached to 和 in that clause.
LCC footnote marker 【1】 preserved in original position after 妾<WH0802>.

Gen/37.lcc_sn: 以色列<WH03478>因爲<WAH03588>約瑟是<WAH01931>他<WAH09001>年老<WH02208>生的兒子<WH01121>，就愛<WH0157><WTH8804>{<WAH0853>}約瑟<WH03130>過於愛他的衆<WAH04480><WAH03605>兒子<WH01121>；他給約瑟<WAH09001>作了<WH06213><WTH8804>一件有袖子的<WH06446>長褂<WH03801>。
Gen/37.lcc_original: 以色列因爲約瑟是他年老生的兒子，就愛約瑟過於愛他的衆兒子；他給約瑟作了一件有袖子的長褂。
notes: LCC reorders the clause structure: the 因爲 clause fronts the sentence (Israel, because Joseph is his old-age son, loved…) whereas UNV puts it at the end of the first clause. SNs are attached to their LCC equivalents in their new positions without reordering the tags themselves.
UNV '年老生的' carries WH02208 on 年老 and WH01121 on 生的 (i.e. 'son born of old age'). LCC renders this as '年老生的兒子'; WH01121 is attached to 兒子 since בֵּן means 'son' and 兒子 is the explicit nominal head.

UNV '彩衣' (כְּתֹנֶת פַּסִּים, H03801+H06446) is rendered by LCC as '有袖子的長褂' (long robe with sleeves), an alternative reading of פַּסִּים as 'sleeved'. H06446 is attached to 袖子的 and H03801 to 長褂 as the closest semantic correspondence.
WAH0853 (את direct-object marker) has no explicit LCC word; kept in braces {<WAH0853>} between 愛 and 約瑟 per Rule 4.
WAH09001 (prefix particle) appears twice: once as the possessive/genitive on 他 in '他年老生的', and once on 約瑟 in '給約瑟作了', mirroring the UNV attachment points.

Gen/37.lcc_original: 約瑟的哥哥們見父親愛約瑟過於愛弟兄們，就恨約瑟，對他說話老是不能和和氣氣地說。
notes: LCC uses 弟兄們 (brothers) where UNV uses 他們 (them) — WH0251 attached directly to 弟兄們 without braces since it is explicit in LCC.
{<WAH03588>} kept implicit: LCC likewise has no explicit conjunction for כִּי between 見 and 父親.
UNV collapses לֹא+יָכֹל onto a single 不 (三 tags: WAH03808+WH03201+WTH8804) because UNV omits an explicit 能; LCC has 不能 explicitly, so WAH03808 goes on 不 and WH03201+WTH8804 go on 能.
LCC restructures the final clause: the speaking verb phrase 對他說話 (= דַּבְּרוֹ) precedes the negation 不能, so WH01696+WTH8763 attach to 說話 rather than a later 說.
WAH09001+WH07965 attached to the whole phrase 和和氣氣地說 (= לְשָׁלֹם, 'peaceably'), treating the trailing 說 as part of the Chinese idiomatic adverbial pattern.
老是 ('always/invariably') is a Chinese rhetorical addition with no Hebrew equivalent and is left unannotated.

Gen/37.lcc_original: 約瑟作了一個夢，告訴他的哥哥們，他們就更加恨他。
notes: 一夢 (UNV) → 一個夢 (LCC): <WH02472> attaches after 夢 at phrase end, as 個 is an added measure word with no Hebrew equivalent.

越<WH03254><WTH8686>發<WAH05750> (two UNV tokens: H3254 יסף 'to add/increase' + H5750 עוד 'yet/more') collapse into LCC 更加; all three tags are bundled onto 更加 since that single phrase covers both Hebrew lexemes.
他的 in 他的哥哥們: 的 is a Chinese structural particle with no Hebrew counterpart, left unannotated; tags attach to phrase end 們 following the UNV pattern.

Gen/37.lcc_original: 約瑟對他們說：『請聽我所作的這個夢。
notes: UNV 做 → LCC 作 for H2492 (חָלַמְתִּי, 'dreamed'): synonymous verbs, straightforward mapping.
H2088 (הַזֶּה, 'this'): in UNV tagged after 的 (used demonstratively in context 做的夢), but LCC makes the demonstrative explicit as 這個, so tag attaches after 這個 instead.

Gen/37.lcc_original: 我們在田間捆禾稼；我所捆的竟起來，並且立着；你們所捆的竟來圍着我所捆的下拜。』

notes: UNV had all three coat tokens implicit {<WAH0853>}{<WH03801>}{<WH06446>}; LCC makes all explicit: 把=WAH0853 (את), 有袖子的=WH06446 (פסים), 長褂=WH03801 (כתנת) — Rule 3 applied, braces dropped on all three
Chinese grammar reverses Hebrew noun-genitive order: WH06446 (有袖子的) precedes WH03801 (長褂) as attributive modifier before noun
LCC 踫到了 (stumbled upon/came upon) for מָצָא WH04672 — synonymous phrasing, SN attached after the full resultative complement 踫到了
LCC inserts a comma between 認一認 and 是 (original punctuation preserved exactly)

Gen/37.lcc_original: 他認得，就說：『我兒的褂子呀！惡獸把他喫了；約瑟一定被撕碎了，撕碎了。』
notes: UNV '兒子' (WH01121) → LCC '兒' (abbreviated form; SN attached to '兒')
UNV '外衣' (WH03801) → LCC '褂子' (semantic equivalent; different word, same garment referent)
UNV '吃了' → LCC '喫了' (variant character for eat; same SN WH0398+WTH8804 attached)
LCC adds '一定' (certainly/surely) before '被撕碎了' — no Hebrew equivalent in UNV; left unannotated
LCC '呀' is a Chinese exclamatory particle after '褂子呀' — no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated

Gen/37.lcc_original: 雅各便撕裂衣裳，腰間加上麻布，爲他兒子哀悼了許多日子。
notes: 衣服 (UNV) → 衣裳 (LCC): synonym pair, both render H08071 שִׂמְלָה (garment)
圍上 (UNV) → 加上 (LCC): different verbs rendering the same H07760 שִׂים (to put/place); morphology tag WTH8799 follows
悲哀了 (UNV) → 哀悼了 (LCC): different mourning verbs, both render H056 אָבַל; morphology tag WTH8691 follows
多日 (UNV) → 許多日子 (LCC): LCC uses disyllabic forms; H07227 (רַב = many) attaches to 許多, H03117 (יוֹם = day) attaches to 日子
爲 is the traditional-character form of 為; WAH05921 attached normally

Gen/37.lcc_original: 他的衆兒女都起來勸他停止服喪，他卻不肯停止服喪，說：『我要哀悼着下陰間到我兒子那裏。』約瑟的父親爲約瑟哀哭了。
notes: UNV has two implicit {<WAH03605>} for כָּל-בָּנָיו וְכָל-בְּנֹתָיו; LCC has a single explicit 衆 (all/many) covering both. First כָּל is attached to 衆 per Rule 3 (drop braces), second כָּל stays implicit {<WAH03605>} since no second explicit character exists in LCC.

LCC paraphrases נִחֵם (H5162, comfort/console) as 勸他停止服喪 (urged him to stop mourning) in the first occurrence and 停止服喪 (to stop mourning) in the second. SNs attached to end of each corresponding phrase per Rule 6.
LCC 要 renders the emphatic/modal כִּי (WAH03588, 'surely/for') — common mapping for this particle in Chinese modal constructions.
LCC uses explicit proper name 約瑟 where UNV uses pronoun 他 for the object of weeping (Hebrew אֹתוֹ); WAH0853 attached to 約瑟 accordingly.
着 after 哀悼 and 了 after 哀哭 are Chinese aspect particles with no Hebrew equivalents; left unannotated per Rule 5.

Gen/37.lcc_original: 米甸人把約瑟賣到埃及，賣給法老的內臣、護衛長波提乏。
notes: LCC has two 賣 instances (賣到埃及 + 賣給法老) where UNV uses 帶...到埃及 + 賣給. Hebrew has one verb (מָכְרוּ, H04376). H04376+H8804 assigned to the first 賣 (the primary verbal correspondent). The second 賣給 is LCC stylistic repetition with no additional Hebrew verb; only 給 receives H0413 (the preposition 'el before the recipient).
<WAH0853> (direct object marker 'et) attached after 約瑟 in the 把-construction (把約瑟), corresponding exactly to UNV's 把他<WAH0853>. 把 functions as the Chinese direct-object marker paralleling Hebrew אֵת.
UNV's 帶 (bring) has no SN and is a paraphrase addition—correctly omitted from LCC since LCC expresses the motion with 賣到埃及 instead.

Gen/38.lcc_original: 那時猶大離開他的弟兄下去，直走到一個亞杜蘭人名叫希拉家裏。
notes: H01961+H8799 (וַיְהִי) remain implicit {braces} — LCC has no explicit 'was/happened' word, same as UNV.
H05704 (עַד) upgraded from implicit to explicit: UNV had {<WAH05704>} with no Chinese word, but LCC's '直走到' ends with '到' which explicitly renders עַד, so braces dropped and tag attached to '直走到'.
LCC '直走到' covers both H05186 (נָטָה - to turn/go) and H05704 (עַד - unto) in a compound directional verb; all three tags (H05186, H8799 morphology, H05704) attach to this compound unit.
LCC adds possessive 的 in '他的弟兄' vs UNV's '他弟兄'; H0251 (אָח - brother) attaches after 弟兄 as the head noun.
LCC omits 的家裡去 final verb/particle of UNV; LCC ends simply with 家裏 — no SN was present on these elements in UNV either.

Gen/38.lcc_original: 在那裏猶大看見一個名叫書亞的迦南人的女兒【1】，就娶了她，進去找她。
notes: Word order inversion: LCC opens 在那裏猶大 (there-Judah) vs UNV's 猶大在那裡 (Judah-there); SNs placed on the same words regardless.
名叫書亞 split as 名<WH08034>叫書亞<WH07770>: 名 = שְׁמוֹ (name, H08034), 書亞 = שׁוּעַ (Shua, H07770).
進去找她 covers both H0935 (בּוֹא, go in → 進去) and H0413 (אֵלֶיהָ, unto her → 找她); LCC renders the preposition interpretively as 找 (seek/go to).
Chinese aspect particle 了 left unannotated; 她 (her, object pronoun) also unannotated as both are grammatical function words with no distinct Hebrew lexeme.
【1】 footnote marker preserved untouched.

Gen/38.lcc_original: 她就懷孕，生個兒子；猶大給他起名叫珥。
notes: 生了→生個: tag attaches after the verb 生, before measure word 個 which has no Hebrew equivalent
{<WAH0853>} stays implicit — LCC has no explicit direct-object marker אֵת, same as UNV

Gen/38.lcc_original: 她又懷孕，生個兒子，就給他起名叫俄南。
notes: LCC omits 母親 as an explicit subject (no SN in UNV either, so no loss)
LCC uses 生個兒子 vs UNV 生了兒子 — classifier 個 is a Chinese grammatical particle with no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated; 生 carries <WH03205><WTH8799>
{<WAH0853>} (object marker אֵת) is implicit in UNV but LCC has explicit 名, so braces dropped and both <WAH0853> and <WH08034> attach after 名
LCC connective 就 has no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated

Gen/38.lcc_original: 她又再生個兒子，就給他起名叫示拉；她生示拉的時候，猶大正在基悉。
notes: LCC 又再 condenses UNV 復<WH03254><WTH8686>又<WAH05750> (יָסַף + עֹוד); assigned 又=WAH05750 (עֹוד=again/still) and 再=WH03254+WTH8686 (יָסַף=do again) — order is ambiguous since both characters mean 'again'.
{<WAH0853>} kept implicit in name-giving phrase (起{<WAH0853>}名): LCC has no explicit word for the Hebrew direct object marker אֵת.
個 (measure word before 兒子) left unannotated — no Hebrew equivalent.
就 left unannotated — Chinese transitional particle with no Hebrew equivalent.

Gen/38.lcc_original: 猶大爲他的長子珥娶了妻名叫他瑪。
notes: LCC adds 他的 (his) before 長子; SN WH01060 attaches to 長子 as the head noun
LCC aspect particle 了 after 娶 is left unannotated per rules
WAH09001 prefix marker and WH06147 both attach to 珥 as in UNV

Gen/38.lcc_original: 猶大的長子珥、永恆主看爲壞人，永恆主就使他死了。
notes: 耶和華→永恆主: LCC's consistent rendering of YHWH; same WH03068 applied to both occurrences.

眼中 (WH05869 + WAH09002 prefix) has no explicit equivalent in LCC. The Hebrew idiom בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה ('in the eyes of Yahweh') is absorbed into LCC's 看爲 ('regard as'), so all four SNs from UNV's 眼中+看為 are attached to 看爲.
LCC's 壞人 ('bad person') expands UNV's 惡 but maps to the same Hebrew רַע (WH07451).
LCC's 使他死了 vs UNV's 叫他死了: different causative phrasing but same Hebrew וַיְמִתֵהוּ (WH04191+WTH8686 Hiphil).

Gen/38.lcc_original: 猶大對俄南說：『你要進去找你哥哥的妻子，向她盡你做弟弟的本分，爲你哥哥樹立後裔。』
notes: 進去<WH0935><WTH8798>找<WAH0413>: LCC restructures UNV's 與(H0413)…同房(H0935) into 進去找; 進去 maps to H0935 (בּוֹא, go in) and 找 maps to H0413 (אֶל, to/toward) — 找 as a rendering of the directional preposition is non-standard, hence lowered confidence.
盡你做弟弟的本分<WH02992><WTH8761>: LCC's 做弟弟 vs UNV's 為弟 are stylistically different but both render the levirate duty idiom for H02992 (יָבַם); tags attached at phrase end per UNV pattern.
後裔<WH02233>: LCC uses 後裔 (descendants) vs UNV's bare 後 for H02233 (זֶרַע, seed/offspring); straightforward expansion.

Gen/38.lcc_original: 俄南知道後裔將會不歸自己，所以每次進去找他哥哥的妻子時，總給蹧蹋在地上，免得把後裔給了他哥哥。
notes: LCC uses 後裔 for both occurrences of זֶרַע (WH02233); UNV uses 生子 and 後 respectively — semantic equivalents for 'seed/offspring'
Implicit {<WAH01961>}{<WTH8799>} (יִהְיֶה 'would be') becomes explicit 將會 in LCC — braces dropped, tags attached to 將會
Implicit temporal {<WAH01961>}{<WTH8804>}{<WH0518>} (וְהָיָה אִם 'whenever') becomes explicit 每次 in LCC — braces dropped, all three tags attached to 每次
Implicit {<WAH0413>}{<WH0802>}{<WH0251>} (אֶל-אֵשֶׁת אָחִיו 'to his brother's wife') all become explicit in LCC: <WAH0413> attached to 找 (directional 'go to'), <WH0802> to 妻子, <WH0251> to 哥哥
{<WAH03588>} (כִּי 'that') remains implicit — LCC also lacks an explicit conjunction here, kept in braces between 知道 and 後裔
LCC's 總給 and 把 are Chinese grammatical particles (habitual aspect + object marker) with no Hebrew equivalents — left unannotated

Gen/38.lcc_original: 他所行的、永恆主看爲大壞事，永恆主也叫他死了。
notes: 看爲 receives WAH09002+WH05869 (בְּעֵינֵי = in the eyes of): LCC encodes the Hebrew 'in the eyes' idiom through the verb 看爲 ('regard as'), so the eye-reference SNs attach here rather than to a standalone noun
大壞事 receives WH07489+WTH8799 (וַיֵּרַע = was evil): LCC makes the evil judgment explicit as a noun phrase, cleanly separating it from 看爲
Second 永恆主 carries no SN — Hebrew וַיָּמֶת גַּם אֹתוֹ has no explicit יְהוָה; the subject is implied, consistent with UNV's untagged second 耶和華
行 aligns to UNV 做 (both translate עָשָׂה, WH06213); 也 aligns to UNV 也就 (both translate גַּם, WAH01571)

Gen/38.lcc_original: 猶大心裏說：恐怕示拉也死，像他兩個哥哥一樣，就對兒媳婦他瑪說：『你要在你父親家裏守寡，等我兒子示拉長大了。』他瑪就去住在她父親家裏。
notes: {<WAH03588>} (כִּי, conjunctive 'for/that') is retained as implicit and placed after the colon introducing the private thought; LCC omits the inner quotation marks UNV uses (「...」) so there is no equivalent explicit word.
UNV 兒婦 → LCC 兒媳婦 (both = daughter-in-law, כַּלָּה WH03618); WH03618 attached to 兒媳婦.
UNV 回去<WH03212><WTH8799>，住<WH03427><WTH8799> → LCC 去住 (combined, no comma); WH03212 on 去, WH03427 on 住.
LCC adds 了 (perfective aspect particle) after 長大 — left unannotated as a Chinese translator addition with no Hebrew equivalent.
UNV's 你去 (unannotated translator addition) corresponds to LCC's 你要 (also unannotated).

Gen/38.lcc_original: 過了許多日子，猶大的妻子拔書亞【1】死了；旣停止了服喪，猶大就和他的朋友亞杜蘭人希拉上亭拿去，到他羣羊的剪毛人那裏。
notes: 許多<WH07235><WTH8799>日子<WH03117>: UNV 許久 maps to LCC 許多日子; WH07235 (רָבָה, be many, Qal impf WTH8799) attaches to 許多, WH03117 (יוֹם, days) attaches to 日子
拔<WH01323>書亞<WH07770>【1】: LCC renders בַּת-שׁוּעַ as transliterated compound 拔書亞; 拔 = בַּת (daughter, WH01323), 書亞 = שׁוּעַ (Shua, WH07770); footnote marker 【1】 preserved immediately after
旣停止了服喪<WH05162><WTH8735>: LCC paraphrases UNV 得了安慰 (was comforted) as 停止了服喪 (stopped mourning) — both render נָחַם Niphal impf (WH05162+WTH8735); tags attach to end of the whole phrase as a unit
羣羊<WH06629>的剪毛<WH01494><WTH8802>人: LCC reorders UNV 剪羊毛的人 to 羣羊的剪毛人; WH06629 (צֹאן, flock) moves forward to 羣羊, WH01494+WTH8802 (גָּזַז, shear, Qal ptc) attach to 剪毛

Gen/38.lcc_original: 有人告訴他瑪說：『你公公上亭拿剪羊毛去了。』
notes: LCC drops the possessive particle 的 (你的公公→你公公), but 你公公 is a full semantic equivalent of 你的公公, so <WH02524> attaches to 你公公 unchanged.
{<WAH02009>} (הִנֵּה/behold) remains implicit — LCC likewise has no explicit exclamative word here.
Quotation marks 「」→『』 are preserved as LCC style; no SN impact.

Gen/38.lcc_original: 他瑪見示拉已經長大，公公還沒有將她給示拉爲妻，就脫去做寡婦的衣服，用面帕蒙着臉，拿披服包圍身體，坐在亭拿路上、伊拿印的出入口。
notes: 她<WAH01931>給<WH05414><WTH8738>: LCC reorders UNV's 娶…她 → 將她給示拉; pronoun (H1931=הִוא) placed before verb (H5414=נתן) to match LCC word order, with no change to which word each SN annotates

{<WAH04480>}{<WAH05921>}: prepositions מֵעָלֶיהָ (from upon her) are fully absorbed into LCC's 脫去 with no explicit words for either מִן (H4480) or עַל (H5921); kept implicit rather than attaching to the verb
拿披服包圍<WH05968><WTH8691>身體: LCC expands H5968 (וַתִּתְעַלָּף, hithpael 'wrapped herself') into 拿披服包圍身體; SN attached to the main verb 包圍; 拿披服 is LCC's free addition with no separate SN
上{<WAH0834>}、: relative pronoun אֲשֶׁר (H834) has no explicit word in LCC — the clause boundary is marked by 、 punctuation instead; kept implicit
公公 (father-in-law): LCC makes the implied subject explicit; no corresponding SN in UNV source

Gen/38.lcc_original: 猶大看見她，以爲她是妓女，因爲她把臉蒙着。
notes: LCC inserts explicit pronoun 她 before 是妓女 (UNV has no explicit subject there) — left unannotated as a Chinese grammatical addition with no Hebrew equivalent.
LCC uses a 把-construction (她把臉蒙着) vs. UNV's direct verb-object order (蒙著臉), inverting 臉 and the verb. SNs follow their respective words in LCC word order: 臉<WH06440> then 蒙着<WH03680><WTH8765>.
把 is a Chinese disposal-marker particle with no Hebrew counterpart — left unannotated.

Gen/38.lcc_original: 猶大就由路旁轉到她跟前，說：『來吧，讓我進去找你吧，他原不知道那女人就是他的兒媳婦。他瑪說：『你要進來找我，要把甚麼給我呢？』
notes: LCC restructures the approach phrase: UNV '轉…到她那裡去' → LCC '由路旁轉到她跟前'. WAH0413+WH01870 (אֶל-הַדֶּרֶךְ, to the road) assigned to '由路旁'; the second WAH0413 (אֵלֶיהָ, to her) assigned to '到她跟前'.

LCC '進去找你吧' expands UNV '同寢' across three sub-elements: 進去<WH0935><WTH8799> (בּוֹא = come in), 找你<WAH0413> (אֵלַיִךְ = to you), 吧<WAH04994> (נָא = entreaty particle). Since LCC has an explicit word (吧) for נָא, braces are dropped per Rule 3.
LCC '那女人' makes הִוא (WAH01931) explicit where UNV uses the copula 是 alone. WAH01931 attached to 那女人.
{<WAH03588>} (כִּי = that/for, subordinating conjunction) remains implicit in LCC — no single Chinese word clearly maps to it; the clause boundary is handled grammatically without an overt connector.
LCC Tamar's speech repeats 要 ('要進來找我，要把甚麼…') — the second 要 is a Chinese grammatical particle with no SN counterpart and is left unannotated.

Gen/38.lcc_original: 猶大說：『我把羣羊中一隻山羊羔送來。』他瑪說：『在未送來以前，你要不要給個當頭？』
notes: UNV's 從<WAH04480>羊群<WH06629>裡 restructures to LCC's 把羣羊<WH06629>中<WAH04480>: 把 is a Chinese object marker with no Hebrew equivalent (unannotated); 羣羊 carries WH06629 (צֹּאן, flock); 中 carries WAH04480 (מִן, from/out of) as the source-preposition role
UNV's 願意<WAH0518> (willingness/conditional אִם) maps to LCC's 要不要<WAH0518>, which rephrases the same volitional question as a Chinese affirmative-negative construction
UNV's first-person object 我 in 給我一個 is dropped in LCC (給個當頭); since 我 carried no SN in UNV, this causes no annotation loss

Gen/38.lcc_original: 猶大說：『要給你甚麼當頭？』他瑪說：『你的印章，印帶，和你手裏的杖。』猶大就給了她，便進去找她；她就從猶大而懷了孕。
notes: LCC makes the subject explicit: '猶大說' vs UNV '他說' — no SN attaches to 猶大 as the subject pronoun has no SN in UNV either.
{<WH0834>} kept implicit: LCC has no explicit relative/interrogative particle in the question structure '要給你甚麼當頭？'; 要 is a modal auxiliary added by LCC, left unannotated.
UNV 印<WH02368> → LCC 印章<WH02368>: LCC uses the fuller term 印章 (signet seal) for the same Hebrew חֹתָם.
UNV 帶子<WH06616> → LCC 印帶<WH06616>: LCC uses 印帶 (seal cord) for the same Hebrew פְּתִיל; semantically equivalent.

UNV '與她<WAH0413>同寢<WH0935><WTH8799>' vs LCC '便進去找她': LCC rephrases the euphemism (Hebrew וַיָּבֹא אֵלֶיהָ = 'came to her'); WH0935+WTH8799 attaches to 進去 (the motion verb), WAH0413 attaches to 她 (the directional object); 找 is LCC's added interpretive gloss, left unannotated.
LCC adds 而 before 懷了孕 as a resultative conjunction; left unannotated.

Gen/38.lcc_original: 他瑪起來，走了；脫去面帕，仍舊穿上寡婦的衣服。
notes: UNV 除去 → LCC 脫去: different verbs, same meaning (H05493 sur = remove/turn aside); straightforward alignment
UNV 帕子<WH06809> → LCC 面帕: LCC adds 面 (face) as a modifier, but the referent is the same veil; SN attaches to 面帕 as a unit
Implicit markers {<WAH04480>}{<WAH05921>} (מִן + עַל, 'from upon') kept implicit — LCC has no explicit words for these preposition prefixes, same as UNV
UNV 作寡婦<WH0491> → LCC 寡婦: 作 is a Chinese copula/classifier with no Hebrew equivalent; dropped in LCC, SN attaches directly to 寡婦
UNV 衣裳<WH0899> → LCC 衣服: synonymous terms for garment; SN attached to 衣服

Gen/38.lcc_original: 猶大由他的朋友亞杜蘭人經手、把一隻山羊羔送去，要從那女人手裏拿回當頭，卻找不着她。
notes: Hebrew בְּיַד ('by the hand of') = WAH09002 (ב prefix) + WH03027 (יָד). UNV fuses both onto the single word 託; LCC splits the idea across two words, so WAH09002 attaches to 由 ('by means of') and WH03027 attaches to 經手 ('through [someone's] hand').

LCC's 把 functions as an explicit direct object marker corresponding to Hebrew אֶת (WAH0853), which was implicit in UNV ({<WAH0853>}). Per Rule 3, braces are dropped and the tag attaches normally: 把<WAH0853>.
LCC 拿回 = UNV 取回 (both mean 'take back'), carrying WH03947 (לָקַח) with its associated prefix WAH09001 and infinitive morphology WTH8800.
LCC 去 (after 送) and 着 / 她 remain unannotated — aspect particle and implied pronoun with no Hebrew lexeme correspondences.

Gen/38.lcc_original: 就問那地方的人說：『伊拿印路旁的妓女在哪裏？』他們說：『在這裏並未曾有過妓女呀。』
notes: WAH09002 (ב prefix, 'in/at') split from its host: UNV attaches it with 這裡<WAH09002><WH02088>, but LCC makes the preposition explicit as a standalone 在; so WAH09002 attaches to 在 and WH02088 to 這裏.
UNV's negation 沒<WAH03808> maps to LCC's 未曾<WAH03808> (both render H3808 = לֹא); 並 in both versions is an emphasis particle co-occurring with the negation.
UNV's 有<WAH01961><WTH8804> maps to LCC's 有過<WAH01961><WTH8804>; the perfective aspect particle 過 has no Hebrew equivalent and is left unannotated.
LCC's sentence-final 呀 (emphasis/exclamation particle) has no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated.
{<WAH0853>} kept as implicit braces; LCC has no explicit direct object marker word for the Hebrew אֵת.

Gen/38.lcc_original: 那人回去見猶大說：『我沒有找着她；並且那地方的人也說：「這裏並未曾有過妓女。」』
notes: UNV 他 → LCC 那人 (subject expanded to 那人); no SN on subject pronoun in either version so no gap.
LCC 也 (added intensifier after 的人) has no Hebrew equivalent; WH0559+WTH8804 attached to 說 only.
LCC 並未曾有過 rephrases UNV 沒有...有 for the inner denial clause: WAH03808 (לֹא negation) attached to 並未曾 as the full negation phrase; WAH01961+WTH8804 (הָיָה, exist) attached to 有過.
LCC uses 『』 for outer and 「」 for inner quotation marks (opposite of UNV); original LCC punctuation preserved exactly.

Gen/38.lcc_sn: 猶大<WH03063>說<WH0559><WTH8799>：『你看<WAH02009>，我把這<WAH02088>山羊羔<WH01423>送去<WH07971><WTH8804>，你<WAH0859>竟沒<WAH03808>找着<WH04672><WTH8804>她；任憑她<WAH09001>把當頭拿去<WH03947><WTH8799>做她自己的吧，免得<WAH06435>我們受<WAH01961>賤視<WAH09001><WH0937>。』
Gen/38.lcc_original: 猶大說：『你看，我把這山羊羔送去，你竟沒找着她；任憑她把當頭拿去做她自己的吧，免得我們受賤視。』
notes: UNV's implicit {<WAH02009>} (הִנֵּה, behold) is rendered explicitly as 你看 in LCC; per Rule 3 braces dropped and tag attached after 看.
UNV negation order is 找...不著 (verb then negation); LCC reorders to 沒找着 (negation then verb), so WAH03808 attaches to 沒 and WH04672/WTH8804 to 找着.
LCC elaborates UNV's 拿去 with 拿去做她自己的吧; SNs WH03947/WTH8799 attach to core verb phrase 拿去; 做她自己的 is LCC expansion with no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated.
WAH01961 (היה, be/become) maps to 受 in LCC's 受賤視 construction (UNV uses 被 as passive marker for same copula).
Second WAH09001 (conjunctive prefix ו) co-attaches with WH0937 (contempt) to 賤視, mirroring UNV's 羞辱<WAH09001><WH0937> pattern.

Gen/38.lcc_original: 約過了三個月，有人告訴猶大說：『你的兒媳婦做了妓女了，並且因爲行淫而懷了孕呢。』猶大說：『把她拉出來，給燒死。』
notes: Tamar (他瑪 / <WH08559>) is explicit in UNV but absent in LCC's text — converted to implicit marker {<WH08559>} positioned immediately after 兒媳婦<WH03618>
LCC '兒媳婦' is a fuller form of UNV '兒婦'; both correspond to <WH03618> (כַּלָּה, daughter-in-law)
{<WAH01961>}{<WTH8799>} (וַיְהִי, 'it came to pass') kept as implicit — no explicit equivalent in LCC's opening phrase '約過了'
{<WAH02009>} (הִנֵּה, 'behold') remains implicit — LCC has no particle corresponding to it
LCC clause-final particles 了 (aspect) and 呢 (sentence mood marker) left unannotated as they have no Hebrew equivalents
Imperative clause word order differs (LCC '把她拉出來' vs UNV '拉出她來') but semantic mapping is clear: <WH03318><WTH8685> attach after 拉出來, <WH08313><WTH8735> after 燒死

Gen/38.lcc_original: 他瑪被拉出來的時候，便打發人去見她公公說：『這些東西是哪一個人的，我就是從哪一個人懷的孕』；她說：『請認一認；這印章，這印帶，這手杖，都是誰的。』
notes: UNV treats the second speech act as implicit ({<WH0559>}{<WTH8799>}), but LCC renders it explicitly as 她說; braces dropped and SNs attached to 說 per Rule 3.
UNV's 對他說 collapses to just 說 in LCC (LCC omits 對他); all three SNs (<WAH09001><WH0559><WTH8800>) attach to the single 說.
LCC repeats 這 before each of the three objects (印章/印帶/手杖); only the first 這 receives <WAH0428> following UNV's single tagging; the subsequent 這 are LCC's stylistic choice with no SN counterpart.
UNV's 誰 rendered as 哪一個人 in LCC (twice); SNs attached to the full phrase in each case.
LCC splits UNV's single extended quote into two distinct speech acts separated by 』；她說：『; SNs distributed accordingly across both segments.

Gen/38.lcc_original: 猶大承認說：『她理直、我輸她，因爲我沒有將她給了我的兒子示拉』；從此猶大就不再和她同房了。
notes: LCC restructures the comparative clause 她比我更有義 (Hebrew צָדְקָה מִמֶּנִּי) into two balanced clauses '她理直、我輸她': WH06663+WTH8804 (righteous/צדק) attaches to 理直; WAH04480 (מִן comparative, 'than me') attaches to 輸她 as the word carrying the comparative sense.
Three UNV prefix tags on 因/為 (WAH03588/WAH05921/WAH03651) collapse onto single 因爲 conjunction in LCC.
LCC adds aspect particle 了 after 給 and a final 了 — both left unannotated (no Hebrew equivalents, per rule 5).
LCC adds 就 after 從此猶大 — left unannotated (connective particle with no direct Hebrew equivalent).
WAH04480 placement on 輸她 is the main uncertainty — LCC rephrases the comparison as a new clause rather than a single comparative phrase.

Gen/38.lcc_original: 到快生產的時候，竟發現她腹中是一對雙子呢。
notes: <WAH01961><WTH8799> (וַיְהִי, narrative 'came to pass') attached to 到 as the clause-initiating temporal word; LCC's 到...的時候 distributes the Hebrew וַיְהִי + בְּעֵת across two anchor points
<WAH09002><WH06256> (בְּעֵת, at the time) attached to 的時候 — 時候 directly renders עֵת (H6256) and the ב prefix (H9002) is expressed by LCC's prepositional 到...structure

<WAH02009> (הִנֵּה, behold/unexpectedly) attached to 竟發現 as a unit — LCC expands the Hebrew presentative particle into an explicit verb phrase; 竟 alone carries the 不料-equivalent 'unexpectedly' sense while 發現 is LCC's added explicit verb with no direct Hebrew correspondent
LCC's 快 (nearly/soon) and sentence-final 呢 have no direct Hebrew equivalents and are left unannotated
雙子 (LCC) and 雙生 (UNV) both render H8380 (תְּאוֹמִים, twins)

Gen/38.lcc_original: 在生產中，一個孩子伸出一隻手來；助產婦拿朱紅線繫在他手上，說：『這是先出來的。』
notes: WAH01961+WTH8799 (וַיְהִי, 'and it came to pass') has no explicit LCC equivalent; kept implicit as {<WAH01961><WTH8799>} at the start of the verse.
WAH09002 (בְּ prefix, 'in/when') mapped to 在, the Chinese prepositional equivalent of the Hebrew infinitive prefix in בְּלִדְתָּהּ; 生產 receives the root WH03205+WTH8800.
收生婆 (UNV) = 助產婦 (LCC) — synonymous terms for midwife; WH03205+WTH8764 (Piel participle of yalad) attached to 助產婦.
紅線 (UNV) → 朱紅線 (LCC) — LCC specifies 朱 (vermilion/scarlet); WH08144 attached to the full compound 朱紅線.
拴 (UNV) → 繫 (LCC) — synonyms meaning to tie/bind; WH07194+WTH8799 attached to 繫.
頭生 (UNV) → 先出來 (LCC) — LCC unpacks the compound into an adverb + verb; WH07223 (rishon, first) → 先, WH03318+WTH8804 (yatsa, came out, Qal perfect) → 出來.

Gen/38.lcc_original: 隨後這孩子正要把手收回去，他哥哥就出來了。那婦人說：『你這一下子突圍而出、多厲害阿！』就給孩子起名叫法勒斯。
notes: 正要 ('was just about to') is LCC's clarifying addition with no Hebrew counterpart — left unannotated.
{<WAH02009>} kept implicit: LCC has no word corresponding to הִנֵּה ('behold').

The exclamation מַה־פָּרַצְתָּ עָלֶיךָ is heavily rephrased in LCC as 你這一下子突圍而出、多厲害阿！ — mapped as: 你→<WAH05921>(עָלֶיךָ), 這一下子→<WAH04100>(מַה), 突圍而出→<WH06555><WTH8804><WH06556>(פָּרַצְתָּ/פֶּרֶץ paronomasia), 多厲害阿 left unannotated as interpretive expansion.
就, 那, 給孩子 are Chinese connectives/additions with no Hebrew equivalents — left unannotated.

Gen/38.lcc_original: 後來他弟弟、那手上有朱紅線的、也出來了；就給他起名叫謝拉。
notes: UNV 兄弟<WH0251> → LCC 弟弟 (both render the same Hebrew אָח, LCC specifies younger brother)
UNV 紅線<WH08144> → LCC 朱紅線 (same Hebrew שָׁנִי, LCC adds 朱 for emphasis on crimson)
UNV 生出來<WH03318><WTH8804> → LCC 出來了; morphology <WTH8804> attaches to 出來, aspect particle 了 is left unannotated as it has no Hebrew equivalent

Gen/39.lcc_original: 約瑟被帶下埃及去；有一個埃及人，法老的內臣，護衛長波提乏，從那些帶約瑟下來的以實瑪利人手下給買了去。
notes: LCC uses explicit name 約瑟 where UNV has pronoun 他 in '帶下他來'; SNs WH03381+WTH8689 attached after 下 and WAH08033 after 來, matching the same split in UNV
LCC omits 是 before 法老 (UNV: '是法老的內臣'); 是 was untagged in UNV so no SN adjustment needed
LCC '給買了去' expresses the passive more explicitly than UNV '買了他去'; WH07069+WTH8799 attached to the end of the full buying phrase
WAH08033 appears twice, matching UNV's double assignment: once on 那些 (from those) and once on 來 (thither/שָׁמָּה)

Gen/39.lcc_sn: 但永恆主<WH03068>和<WAH0854>約瑟<WH03130>同在<WAH01961><WTH8799>，約瑟就成了<WAH01961><WTH8799>一個凡事順利<WH06743><WTH8688>的人<WH0376>，在他主人<WH0113>埃及人<WH04713>家中<WAH09002><WH01004>作事<WAH01961><WTH8799>。
Gen/39.lcc_original: 但永恆主和約瑟同在，約瑟就成了一個凡事順利的人，在他主人埃及人家中作事。
notes: LCC inverts the clause order from UNV: YHWH+Joseph clause first, then prosperous-man clause, then house clause — all SNs redistributed accordingly across the reordered structure.
永恆主 (Eternal Lord) is LCC's distinctive rendering of 耶和華 (YHWH/WH03068).
和 in LCC corresponds to UNV's 與<WAH0854> (Hebrew waw+אֵת = 'and with'); tagged on 和 as the semantic equivalent.
The second occurrence of 約瑟 in LCC ('約瑟就成了') has no Hebrew word equivalent — Hebrew uses an implicit subject via the verb וַיְהִי — left untagged.
作事 in LCC ('working') corresponds to the first Hebrew וַיְהִי (was/dwelt in) in the house clause — LCC renders the existential 'was in' as active work; <WAH01961><WTH8799> attached to 作事.
Hebrew ב prefix (<WAH09002>) inseparably joins בַּיִת; both tags kept together on 家中 rather than splitting across 在 and 家中.
人<WH0376> captures Hebrew אִישׁ (man); UNV rendered this as the pronoun 他 ('he/man') but LCC makes it explicit with 的人.

Gen/39.lcc_original: 他主人見永恆主和他同在，見永恆主叫他所作的在他手裏盡都順利，
notes: LCC 永恆主 (both instances) maps to UNV 耶和華 → <WH03068> applied to each
LCC 和他 maps to UNV 與他 → <WAH0854>
LCC 叫他 maps to UNV 使他 → <WAH01931> (Hebrew הוּא)
LCC 所作的 parallels UNV 所辦的 → split identically: 所<WAH0834>作的<WH06213><WTH8802>
LCC word order differs from UNV: UNV has 手裡...所辦的 but LCC has 所作的...在他手裏; tags follow LCC word order — ב+יד tags appended to end of full phrase 在他手裏<WAH09002><WH03027>
{<WAH03588>} (כִּי) kept implicit — LCC also has no explicit word for it, placed before 永恆主 as in UNV

Gen/39.lcc_original: 約瑟就在他主人面前蒙恩，伺候他主人；他主人並且派他管理他的家，把一切所有的都交在他手裏。
notes: UNV 眼前 (before the eyes, WH05869=עין) → LCC 面前 (before the face/presence); both render לְפָנָיו, so WAH09002+WH05869 attach to 面前
UNV 家務<WH01004> (household affairs) → LCC 他的家<WH01004>; core lemma בַּיִת attaches to 家, LCC adds 他的 for clarity (no extra SN)
{<WAH05921>} (עַל, 'over') remains implicit: LCC absorbs the 'over' sense into the verb 管理 with no separate preposition word
{<WAH09001>} remains implicit in LCC as no conjunction particle is explicitly rendered there
UNV clause order ,並且主人… vs LCC ；他主人並且… — different punctuation and fronting of 他主人 as subject of second clause; no SN impact since 主人 in that UNV position carries no SN tag

Gen/39.lcc_original: 自從主人派約瑟管理他的家和他一切所有的，永恆主就因約瑟的緣故賜福與那埃及人的家；凡他一切所有的，無論是在家裏的、是在田裏的、都蒙永恆主賜福。
notes: UNV 管理家務 → LCC 管理他的家: both represent בְּבֵיתוֹ (09002+01004); tags placed after 家 (last word of the phrase).
UNV 耶和華 → LCC 永恆主: both = YHWH (03068); tag transferred to 永恆主 at both occurrences.

Second clause word-order inversion: UNV places 家裡[09002+01004]…和田間[09002+07704] BEFORE 一切所有的; LCC restructures to 凡他一切所有的，無論是在家裏的、是在田裏的. SNs for house (09002+01004) attached to 家裏 and field (09002+07704) attached to 田裏 within the 無論…是…是… structure.
Implicit {WAH09001} in UNV second clause (after 一切) retained as implicit in LCC second clause at the same relative position—no explicit LCC word corresponds to the Hebrew waw conjunction there.
LCC 他 before 一切 in second clause (pronoun suffix לוֹ) carries no SN, consistent with UNV which also leaves the pronoun suffix untagged in both clauses.

Gen/39.lcc_original: 波提乏將一切所有的、都放交約瑟手中，除了自己喫的飯以外，別的事一槪不知，不跟約瑟計較。約瑟生得丰姿俊秀、容貌美麗。
notes: LCC 放交 covers UNV 交 (H5800 עָזַב); tags placed after the final character 交 of the compound
LCC 喫的 absorbs UNV's 所<WAH0834>吃的 — relative particle 所 has no standalone equivalent in LCC, so both H834 and H398+8802 are attached together after 喫的
LCC adds 以外 (after 飯) and the clause 不跟約瑟計較 (no Hebrew counterpart) — both left unannotated

Beauty description order reversal: UNV 秀雅<WH03303><WH04758>俊美<WH03303><WH08389> (appearance then form) vs. LCC 丰姿俊秀 (form) then 容貌美麗 (appearance); LCC's order actually matches Hebrew word order (יְפֵה-תֹאַר form first, יְפֵה מַרְאֶה appearance second), so 丰姿俊秀→H3303+H8389 and 容貌美麗→H3303+H4758
LCC 生得 (born with/naturally endowed) corresponds to UNV 原來 for H1961 הָיָה (to be)

Gen/39.lcc_original: 這些事以後，約瑟主人的妻子舉目送情給約瑟說：『和我同寢吧。』
notes: LCC 這些 covers UNV 這 + implied plurality; WAH0428 attached to 這些 as a unit
LCC 妻子 replaces UNV 妻; WH0802 attached to 妻子
UNV attaches WH05375 (נָשָׂא, lift) to 送情; LCC uses explicit 舉 (lift) — WH05375+WTH8799 moved to 舉, leaving 送情 unannotated as part of the Chinese idiom
WAH0853 (direct object marker אֶת) was explicit in UNV (以) but has no LCC equivalent; placed as implicit {<WAH0853>} before 目 since it marks 目 as the direct object
UNV 你與我 → LCC 和我; WAH05973 (עִם, with) attached to 和 as the corresponding preposition; 你 has no LCC equivalent and is left unannotated

Gen/39.lcc_original: 約瑟不肯；他對他主人的妻子說：『看哪，在家裏、我主人甚麼也不知道，不跟我計較；他把他一切所有的、都交在我手裏。
notes: UNV 不從<WH03985> → LCC 不肯<WH03985>: different lexical choice, same semantic (refuse/be unwilling), SN attaches to 不肯 as a unit.
{<WAH0854>} (אִתִּי, 'with me') was implicit in UNV (no Chinese word), but LCC renders it explicitly as 不跟我計較 ('does not consult with me') — braces dropped per Rule 3, tag appended after the phrase.
LCC reorders בַּבַּיִת and מַה: UNV has 一切(מַה)家務(בַּבַּיִת), while LCC puts 在家裏(בַּבַּיִת) first, then 甚麼(מַה) — SNs follow LCC word order accordingly.
LCC's 一切 takes WAH03605 (כֹּל = all); the 都 before 交 is a Chinese grammatical adverb reinforcing the clause with no direct Hebrew counterpart — left unannotated.
也 in 甚麼也不知道 is a Chinese intensifier particle with no Hebrew equivalent; WAH03808 (לֹא) attaches to the 也不 cluster.
לוֹ ('his/to him') has no SN tag in the UNV source; the second 他 in 他一切所有的 (possessive reference to the master) is therefore unannotated.

Gen/39.lcc_original: 在這家裏、他並不比我大；他並沒有留下一樣而不交給我；只有留下了你，因爲你是他的妻子。我怎能行這個大壞事、來犯罪得罪上帝呢？』
notes: First clause restructured: UNV uses existential negative 在這家裡沒有比我大的 ('in this house there is none greater than me'), LCC rephrases as predicative 他並不比我大 ('he is not greater than me'); WAH0369 (אַיִן) attached to 不 as the closest negation equivalent.
LCC inserts 並 (emphatic particle) before 不 and before 沒有 — left unannotated as a Chinese rhetorical addition with no Hebrew source.
LCC 行 corresponds to UNV 作 — both translate WH06213 (עָשָׂה, to do/make).
LCC 壞事 corresponds to UNV 惡 — both translate WH07451 (רָעָה, evil/wickedness).
LCC expands UNV 得罪 into 來犯罪得罪; WH02398+WTH8804 (חָטָא, to sin) attached to 得罪 as the more direct lexical equivalent; 來 and 犯罪 left unannotated.
LCC 上帝 corresponds to UNV 神 — both translate WH0430 (אֱלֹהִים); WAH09001 (ל prefix) retained on 上帝.
LCC 而 (concessive connector before 不交給我) left unannotated — Chinese syntactic addition.

Gen/39.lcc_original: 婦人天天和約瑟說話，約瑟總不聽她，不在她那裏同寢，也不同她在一處，
notes: <WAH01961><WTH8799> kept implicit: LCC omits UNV's narrative opener 後來 entirely; placed as {…} at sentence start since no LCC word carries this Hebrew wayyiqtol marker
天天 receives both <WH03117> SNs (Hebrew יוֹם יוֹם) appended together after the reduplicated word rather than split between each character
那裏<WH0681>: Hebrew אֵצֶל (beside/near her) rendered in LCC as 那裏 (at her place); locative sense is preserved and this is the closest LCC word to the Hebrew spatial particle
LCC 說話 ← UNV 說 <WH01696><WTH8763>: LCC elaborates with 話, both characters together carry the single Hebrew root דָּבַר; SNs attach after the full word 說話
LCC 聽 ← UNV 聽從 <WH08085><WTH8804>: LCC uses the shorter form; same semantic referent שָׁמַע, no alignment ambiguity

Gen/39.lcc_original: 有這麼一天，約瑟進屋裏去作工，家裏的人並沒有一個人【1】在屋裏。
notes: H1961 (הָיָה) was implicit {<WAH01961>} in UNV; LCC 有 is an explicit correspondent (Rule 3: drop braces, attach directly). WTH8799 morphology follows as explicit too.
H2088 (זֶה this) was implicit {<WAH02088>} in UNV; LCC 這麼 explicitly renders 'this/such', so braces dropped and tag attached (Rule 3).
UNV 辦事 (H6213+H4399) → LCC 作工: split cleanly — 作 takes H6213 (to do/make), 工 takes H4399 (work/task).
UNV 在那<WAH08033> (在那 = 'there') → LCC drops 那 and has only 在; H8033 (שָׁם there) attached to 在 as the closest locative.
UNV 一個<WH0376> → LCC 一個人; H376 (אִישׁ person) attached after 人 since 人 carries the 'person' meaning.
LCC 並 (adversative emphasis) and 的 (possessive particle) have no Hebrew equivalents; left unannotated.
【1】 footnote marker preserved without any SN insertion.

Gen/39.lcc_original: 婦人就抓住約瑟的衣服說：『和我同寢吧。』約瑟撇下衣服在婦人手裏，逃出來到外邊。
notes: LCC uses proper name 約瑟 where UNV has pronoun 他的; SNs attach to 衣服 unchanged
LCC 撇下衣服 reverses UNV's verb-object order (把衣裳丟); each word tagged after itself: 撇下<WH05800><WTH8799>衣服<WH0899>
LCC 逃出來 conflates H5127 (נוּס flee) and H3318 (יָצָא go out) into one compound; split as 逃<WH05127><WTH8799> and 出來<WH03318><WTH8799> respectively
到 before 外邊 is a directional particle with no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated, H2351 (חוּץ outside) attaches to 外邊 only

Gen/39.lcc_original: 婦人見約瑟撇下衣服在她手裏，逃到外邊，
notes: LCC uses 撇下衣服 (V-O order) vs UNV's 把衣裳…丟 disposal construction; H5800/WTH8804 attached to 撇下, H899 to 衣服 — order follows LCC syntax not UNV
逃到外邊 covers Hebrew וַיָּנָס הַחוּצָה; H5127/WTH8799 attached to 逃 (the semantic carrier of 'flee'), directional complement 到 left unannotated, H2351 attached to 外邊
{<WAH03588>} kept implicit — LCC uses an asyndetic clause with no explicit 既/因 equivalent
SNs for 在她手裏 placed before the comma per UNV convention of tag-before-punctuation

Gen/39.lcc_original: 就把家裏的人叫來，對他們說：『你們看，他帶一個希伯來人進我們這裏來，要調戲我們。他進來找我，要和我同寢；我大聲喊叫。
notes: UNV clause order rewritten in LCC: 就叫了...家裡的人...來 → 就把家裏的人叫來; SNs redistributed to match LCC word order: 家裏<WH01004>、的人<WAH09001><WH0582>、叫<WH07121><WTH8799>

{<WTH8762>} is a verbal morphology code (Piel imperfect); kept implicit since LCC has no separate verbal form to attach it to — 說 already carries WH0559+WTH8800; placed immediately after 事<WH01697> to preserve relative position

UNV 如此如此<WAH09003><WH01696><WAH0428> (כַּדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה = like these words) → LCC restructures as 這些事這麼: WAH0428 (הָאֵלֶּה = these) → 這些; WH01697 (דְּבָרִים = matters) → 事; WAH09003+WH01696 (כַּ+manner) → 這麼
UNV {<WAH0413>} is implicit for אֵלַי (to me); LCC 找我 makes this directional reference explicit → dropped braces: 找我<WAH0413>

Gen/39.lcc_original: 我提高了聲音喊叫，他就撇下衣服在我這裏，逃到外邊去了。』

UNV 起來 (directional aspect complement) has no LCC counterpart; H7121+8799 attached to 喊叫 which covers the full crying-out action
H2351 (חוּץ, outside) attached to LCC 外邊; LCC 到 and 去了 are directional/aspect complements with no Hebrew SN counterparts
{<WAH01961>}{<WTH8799>} kept implicit — LCC omits the wayehî 'and it came to pass' temporal frame, beginning the clause directly with the action

Gen/39.lcc_original: 主人聽了他妻子所告訴他的話說：『你的僕人這樣對我作了這些事』，他的怒氣就發作了。
notes: LCC omits 約瑟的 (Joseph's) before 主人; H0113 attaches to 主人 alone.
LCC uses 告訴他 for UNV's 對他說: 告訴 receives H01696+WTH8765 (the speaking verb), 他 receives H0413 (the 'to him' directional אֵל).

UNV clusters all three tags (H09003+H01697+H0428) on the idiom 如此如此; LCC splits the Hebrew כַּדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה across two phrases: 這樣 receives H09003+H01697 (כ + דְּבָרִים, 'in this manner') and 這些事 receives H0428 (הָאֵלֶּה, 'these').
LCC inverts the verb-object order inside the quote: UNV 如此如此待我 → LCC 這樣對我作了這些事; SNs are realigned to their semantic targets (對我<H09001>, 作了<H06213+WTH8804>, 這些事<H0428>).

For the anger clause: LCC 怒氣就發作了 restructures UNV 生氣 (verb-noun) into noun-verb; 怒氣 receives H0939 (the noun of anger) and 發作 receives H02734+WTH8799 (the burning/flaring verb). Note: H0939 as given may be a typo for H0639 (אַף, nose/anger, which is the expected Hebrew for Gen 39:19 וַיִּחַר אַפּוֹ); tags are used as-is per the input.
{<WAH01961>}{<WTH8799>} retained as implicit — LCC likewise has no explicit Chinese word for the narrative-opening וַיְהִי.
Missing SNs: 0639
Extra SNs: 0939

Gen/39.lcc_original: 約瑟的主人便把約瑟下在監裏，王的囚犯被囚的地方；於是約瑟就在監裏。
notes: UNV implicit {<WH0113>} (master/lord) — LCC spells out 主人 explicitly, so braces dropped per Rule 3: 主人<WH0113>
UNV 就是<WAH0834> (relative pronoun אֲשֶׁר) has no lexical counterpart in LCC, which uses ；punctuation instead — kept as {<WAH0834>} per Rule 4
UNV 那裡<WAH08033> (שָׁם, 'there') absent in LCC — kept as {<WAH08033>} per Rule 4
UNV 坐監<WAH09002> — LCC drops 坐; WAH09002 (ב prefix, 'in') co-attached with WH01004 and WH05470 to 監, representing the whole prepositional phrase בְּבֵית הַסֹּהַר ('in the house of the dungeon')
LCC 便 is a Chinese connective particle with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated
LCC 就 (second clause) is a Chinese emphatic/conjunctive particle absorbed into the translation of וַיְהִי — left unannotated; WAH01961 attached to 就在 as a unit

Gen/39.lcc_original: 但是永恆主卻和約瑟同在，向他施慈愛，使他在監長面前蒙恩。
notes: 永恆主 is LCC's standard rendering of YHWH (H03068); SN attached after the full title
LCC's 慈愛 corresponds to UNV's 恩 for H02617 (חֶסֶד, steadfast love/lovingkindness)
LCC's 監長 compresses three Hebrew words (שַׂר בֵּית הַסֹּהַר: H08269+H01004+H05470) into a single compound; all three SNs appended to 監長
LCC uses 面前 (face/front) where UNV uses 眼前 (eyes/sight) for H05869 (עַיִן); semantically equivalent, SN attached to 面前
LCC's 卻 is a Chinese adversative particle with no Hebrew counterpart; left unannotated
WAH0854 (אֵת 'with') attached to 和, which carries the same prepositional function as UNV's 與

Gen/39.lcc_original: 看監的把監裏所有的囚犯都交在約瑟手裏；凡那裏所作的事、都是他作的。
notes: 看監的 consolidates UNV's 司<WH08269>獄 into a single phrase (WH08269=שַׂר chief, WH01004+WH05470=בֵּית-הַסֹּהַר prison-house).
WAH03605 (כָּל) fronts the relative clause in LCC as 凡, whereas UNV places it later as 都; tag migrated to 凡.
UNV's {<WH06213>}{<WTH8802>} (implicit repeated עֹשֶׂה) becomes explicit 作的 in LCC; braces dropped per Rule 3.
UNV's 他們在那裡<WAH08033>: LCC omits 他們; WAH08033 placed on 那裏 only.

Gen/39.lcc_original: 凡在約瑟手下的事，看監的都不察看，因爲永恆主和約瑟同在；永恆主使他所作的盡都順利。
notes: UNV 司獄 (officer + house + prison: 08269+01004+05470) maps to LCC 看監的 as a single phrase; all three SNs appended to the phrase end
UNV 耶和華 → LCC 永恆主: LCC's distinctive rendering of YHWH; SN 03068 attached to 永恆主 in both occurrences
UNV 察<WH07200><WTH8802> → LCC 察看: LCC expands the verb with 看; morphology tag attaches after the full two-character verb
{<WAH0853>} kept implicit: the Hebrew direct-object marker has no explicit correspondent in LCC word order

Gen/40.lcc_original: 這些事以後，埃及王的酒政和膳長得罪了他們的主子埃及王。
notes: LCC uses 這些 vs UNV's 這 for H0428 (אֵלֶּה, 'these'); SN attached after full phrase 這些
LCC uses 主子 vs UNV's 主 for H0113 (אָדוֹן, 'lord/master'); SN attached after 主子
LCC omits the em-dash appositive construction; 埃及王 follows 主子 directly as a compound noun phrase — second 埃及王 receives same SNs as in UNV
{<WAH01961>}{<WTH8799>} kept implicit — neither UNV nor LCC has an explicit Chinese word for H01961 (היה, 'it came to pass')

Gen/40.lcc_original: 法老就惱怒他的兩個內臣，酒政長和膳長。
notes: LCC follows Hebrew word order (שְׁנֵי סָרִיסָיו first, then שַׂר הַמַּשְׁקִים / שַׂר הָאֹפִים), while UNV reverses this — placing the two officers at the end appositively. All SN tags are redistributed to match LCC's canonical order.

{<WAH05921>} from UNV's 這二臣 position is reassigned to before 他的兩個內臣, corresponding to the first Hebrew עַל (before שְׁנֵי סָרִיסָיו). {<WH05921>} from UNV's position before 酒政 is placed before 酒政長 in LCC.

In UNV, 酒政 carries both WH08269 (שַׂר, chief) and WH04945 (הַמַּשְׁקִים, cupbearers) on a single word. In LCC, 酒政長 separates these: 酒政<WH04945> (cupbearers) and 長<WH08269> (chief), which is the more precise alignment.
他的 (possessive 'his') reflects the pronominal suffix -יו on סָרִיסָיו; it is left unannotated as the suffix is subsumed under WH05631 on 內臣.

Confidence reduced from the word-order inversion and the WAH05921 vs WH05921 tag assignment for the first Hebrew עַל, which is bare (no waw conjunction) in MT but UNV tagged the corresponding element as {WAH05921}.

Gen/40.lcc_original: 把他們下在護衛長府內的看守所，放在監裏，約瑟被囚的地方。
notes: H4929 (מִשְׁמַר ward/custody) attached to LCC's explicit word 看守所; in UNV it was implicit, absorbed into 在 — LCC promotes it to an explicit noun
放在 (LCC transitional connective before 監裏) left unannotated: H413 (אֶל into) is already consumed by 下, and 放在 has no remaining Hebrew correspondent
Second H1004 + H5470 attached to 監 in 放在監裏, corresponding to Hebrew בֵּית הַסֹּהַר (house of the prison)
H834 (אֲשֶׁר relative pronoun) attached to the structural particle 的 in LCC's 被囚的地方 relative clause, replacing UNV's explicit 就是
{<WAH08033>} retained as implicit — LCC also omits a word for שָׁם (there)

Gen/40.lcc_sn: 護衛<WH02876>長<WH08269>派<WH06485><WTH8799>約瑟<WAH0853><WH03130>和他們<WAH0853>在一起，約瑟便伺候<WH08334><WTH8762>他們<WAH0853>，他們在看守所裏<WAH09002><WH04929>有<WAH01961><WTH8799>些日子<WH03117>，

notes: LCC restructures clause 1: UNV '把他們交給約瑟' (entrusted them to Joseph) → LCC '派約瑟和他們在一起' (assigned Joseph to be with them); H6485 maps to 派; the two WAH0853 markers are distributed to 約瑟 (direct object in LCC) and 他們 in 和他們在一起 (the prepositional 'with them' phrase) respectively

Gen/40.lcc_original: 被囚在監裏的，埃及王的酒政和膳長，他們兩個人同一夜裏作了一個夢，各人各有自己的夢，各人也都各帶着自己的夢的解釋。
notes: UNV uses classical 之<WAH0834> between 在監 and 埃及 as a possessive bridge (corresponding to אֲשֶׁר לְמֶלֶךְ). LCC replaces this with a comma boundary; the second <WAH0834> is attached to the structurally equivalent 的 (after 監裏), which functions as the relative clause closer and possessive bridge.

H02472 (חֲלוֹם, dream) appears three times: UNV has {<WH02472>} implicit (חֲלֹמוֹ, his dream), 一夢<WH02472> (cognate accusative), and 夢<WH02472> (in 各夢). LCC distributes these across: 一個夢<WH02472> (cognate acc.), 夢<WH02472> in 各人各有自己的夢 (implicit→explicit per Rule 3), and 夢<WH02472> in 自己的夢的解釋.
LCC's 他們 (makes subject pronoun explicit) and 自己 (reflexive, own) are LCC additions with no Hebrew equivalent — correctly left unannotated.
H0259 (אֶחָד, one/same) attached to 同 in LCC's 同一夜裏; the 一 also expresses the same concept semantically but H0259 is not double-tagged since 同 is the primary carrier.
LCC restructures heavily: UNV's single clause 各…做…一夢 is expanded into two clauses (作了一個夢 / 各人各有自己的夢), requiring the implicit {<WH02472>} and verb H02492 to be separated across different clauses.

Gen/40.lcc_sn: 到了早晨<WAH09002><WH01242>，約瑟<WH03130>進去<WH0935><WTH8799>到他們那裏<WAH0413>看看<WH07200><WTH8799>他們<WAH0853>，只見他們都有愁悶<WH02196><WTH8802>的樣子<WAH02009>。

WAH0853 (אֹתָם, direct object 'them') attached to first 他們 which is the syntactic object of 看看; second 他們 after 只見 is resumptive and left untagged
LCC adds 都 as a quantifier before 有愁悶 — left unannotated as a Chinese addition with no Hebrew equivalent
WAH02009 (הִנֵּה, behold) placed on 的樣子 following UNV pattern

Gen/40.lcc_sn: 他就問<WH07592><WTH8799>{<WAH0853>}法老<WH06547>的內臣<WH05631>，就是<WAH0834>在<WAH09002>他主人<WH0113>府<WH01004>上看守所<WH04929>裏和他<WAH0854>在一起的那兩個人，問他們說<WAH09001><WH0559><WTH8800>：『你們今天<WH03117>爲甚麼<WAH04069>面帶<WH06440>愁容<WH07451>呢？』
Gen/40.lcc_original: 他就問法老的內臣，就是在他主人府上看守所裏和他在一起的那兩個人，問他們說：『你們今天爲甚麼面帶愁容呢？』
notes: LCC restructures 'אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ בְמִשְׁמַר בֵּית אֲדֹנָיו' into '在他主人府上看守所裏和他在一起'; SNs distributed to closest semantic equivalents in the reordered clause.
LCC adds '那兩個人' (those two men) — a clarifying elaboration with no Hebrew basis; left unannotated.
LCC inserts a second '問他們' before 說 for explicitness; only 說 receives the לֵאמֹר tokens (WAH09001+WH0559+WTH8800), the repeated 問他們 is unannotated.
{<WAH0853>} kept as implicit braces since LCC has no explicit direct-object particle.
Spatial particles '上' (after 府) and '裏' (after 看守所) have no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated.

Gen/40.lcc_original: 他對他們說：『我們各作了一個夢，沒有人能解釋。』約瑟對他們說：『解夢不是在於上帝麼？請向我敍說。』
notes: Pronoun reversal: UNV '他們對他' (they→him) vs LCC '他對他們' (he→them). <WAH0413> (H413 = אֶל, 'to/toward') is attached to the indirect object 他們 in LCC, consistent with UNV's pattern of tagging the object word rather than the preposition.
UNV {<WAH0413>} in Joseph's speech is implicit (braces), but LCC has explicit '對他們' — braces dropped per Rule 3.
{<WAH0853>} (H853 = direct object marker את) kept implicit: LCC '解釋' has no explicit object marker word, per Rule 4.

<WAH09001> after 我 in UNV represents the prepositional prefix לִ ('to me' = לִי). In LCC '向我' the prefix sense is carried by 向, but the tag is attached to 我 to mark the pronoun as the SN anchor, consistent with UNV placement.
神 (UNV) → 上帝 (LCC): standard systematic difference; both <WAH09001> and <WH0430> attached together after 上帝 as they appear together after 神 in UNV.

Gen/40.lcc_original: 酒政長便將他的夢向約瑟敍述說：『在我夢中，有一棵葡萄樹在我面前。
notes: LCC 酒政長 covers both WH08269 (שַׂר, chief/officer) and WH04945 (מַשְׁקֶה, cupbearer); LCC adds 長 to spell out the 'chief' sense that UNV keeps implicit in 酒政, so both SNs attach to the compound 酒政長.
LCC uses explicit preposition 向 to express the Hebrew prefix particle WAH09001 on יוֹסֵף; treating 向約瑟 as one phrase, both WAH09001 and WH03130 attach after 約瑟.
LCC 敍述 is a semantic equivalent of UNV 告訴 (WH05608 + WTH8762 morphology); verb-for-verb substitution.

UNV 見<WAH02009> (הִנֵּה, hinneh/behold) has no explicit LCC correspondent — LCC restructures 我夢見... into 在我夢中...; WH02472 stays on 夢中, and WAH02009 is kept as implicit {<WAH02009>} placed before the scene description.
LCC inverts the final clause order: UNV 在我面前有一棵葡萄樹 → LCC 有一棵葡萄樹在我面前; SNs follow their respective words in LCC's word order.

Gen/40.lcc_original: 葡萄樹上有三根枝子，正要發芽，花也就開了，它那一挂一挂的都結成了熟的葡萄了。
notes: LCC makes the vine explicit (葡萄樹) where UNV has just 樹; WAH09002+WH01612 attach to the full phrase 葡萄樹上.

H01931 kept implicit as {<WAH01931>} — LCC has no subject pronoun for the budding clause; the later 它 functions as possessive for clusters (rendering the Hebrew suffix -הָ on אַשְׁכְּלֹתֶיהָ), not as the independent subject pronoun.
WAH09003 (כ- prefix, 'like/as') and H06524+WTH8802 attach to 發芽; LCC's modal 正要 ('about to') has no Hebrew equivalent and is left unannotated.
H0811 (אַשְׁכְּלֹתֶיהָ, 'her clusters') maps to 它那一挂一挂的, LCC's paraphrase of the cluster-with-suffix concept.
H01310+WTH8689 (בָּשַׁל, ripened, Hiphil perf.) attaches to 結成了; the resultant adjective 熟的 is part of this semantic field but left as bridge; H06025 attaches to 葡萄.

Gen/40.lcc_original: 法老的杯在我手中；我拿葡萄擠在法老杯裏，將杯遞在法老手掌中。』
notes: LCC omits 的 before the second 杯 (法老杯裏 vs UNV 法老的杯裡) — SN placement adjusted to attach directly to 杯 without the possessive particle.
LCC uses explicit 法老 at the end where UNV uses the pronoun 他; H6547 transferred to 法老 accordingly.
LCC uses 手掌 (palm of hand) where UNV has simply 手; H3709 (כַּף = palm/sole) is actually a more precise match for 手掌 than for 手, so attached to 手掌.
Both {<WAH0853>} implicit direct object markers preserved — LCC has no explicit equivalent particles.
LCC semicolon (；) replaces UNV comma after 手中 — punctuation preserved exactly as in LCC original.

Gen/40.lcc_original: 約瑟對他說：『這夢的解釋是這樣；三根枝子就是三天。
notes: LCC reorders the Hebrew זֶה פִּתְרֹנוֹ (this / its-interpretation): UNV renders 是這樣<WAH02088>解<WH06623> (this-interpretation), while LCC renders 解釋<WH06623>是這樣<WAH02088> (interpretation-is-this). SNs follow each respective word in LCC's order.
LCC 解釋 expands UNV 解 but both render WH06623 (פִּתְרֹן = interpretation).
LCC 這夢的 (like UNV 你所做的夢) has no Hebrew equivalent in Gen 40:12 — the Hebrew simply says 'this is its interpretation'; both versions added the noun for clarity. Left unannotated.

Gen/40.lcc_original: 三天之內，法老必使你抬起頭來，必回復你的職位；你必將法老的杯遞在他手中，像先前做他酒政時那樣。
notes: Rule 3 applied to {<WAH0853>}: UNV renders 'lift up your head' idiomatically as '提你出監' (leaving רֹאשׁ/H7218 implicit as 你 and אֵת/H0853 implicit), but LCC restores the literal Hebrew — '抬起頭來'. Since 頭 is explicit in LCC, braces dropped: <WAH0853><WH07218> attach to 頭.

UNV's second 法老<WH06547> (possessor of 手) maps to LCC's anaphoric pronoun 他, because LCC restructures the clause to '將法老的杯遞在他手中'. The 法老 in '法老的杯' is LCC's own elaboration with no corresponding separate SN tag in the UNV source, so left unannotated.
Word order reversal in the cup clause: UNV has 遞[H5414]…杯[H3563] (give…cup), but LCC fronts the object: 杯<WH03563>遞<WH05414><WTH8804>. Tags follow their respective words.
{<WAH05921>} (עַל = upon/to) remains implicit in LCC: '必回復你的職位' has no overt preposition corresponding to על, mirroring the UNV treatment.
LCC '使' (causative) and '必' (modal) carry no Hebrew equivalents; left unannotated. LCC '時' (temporal particle after 酒政) likewise unannotated.

Gen/40.lcc_original: 不過你得好處時，求你記得我，拿恩情待我，在法老面前替我說一聲，救我出這一間獄室。
notes: 但→不過: both render כִּי-אִם ('but if'), carrying WAH03588+WAH0518 together
{<WAH09001>}的時候<WAH09003><WAH0834>→時<WAH09001><WAH09003><WAH0834>: LCC's 時 explicitly realizes all three temporal markers (ב+ל+אֲשֶׁר); braces dropped per rule 3

施恩與我 (עָשָׂה חֶסֶד אִתִּי) → 拿恩情待我: LCC uses a 拿-construction; 恩情 takes WH02617 (חֶסֶד), 待 takes WH06213+WTH8804 as the main verb (עָשָׂה), 我 takes WAH05973 (אִתִּי); 拿 is a Chinese instrumental particle with no Hebrew equivalent and is left unannotated
提說我→替我說一聲: LCC rephrases הִזְכַּרְתַּנִי ('mention me') as 'speak for me on my behalf'; WH02142+WTH8689 attached after 一聲 as end of the verbal phrase
{<WH04994>} (נָא entreaty particle) kept implicit — LCC's 拿 is the instrumental bā-particle, not a rendering of נָא

Gen/40.lcc_sn: 我實在<WAH03588>是從希伯來人<WH05680>之地<WAH04480><WH0776>被拐來<WH01589><WTH8795>的；就是在這裏<WAH06311>、我也<WAH01571>沒有<WAH03808>作過<WH06213><WTH8804>甚麼<WH03972>、足以<WAH03588>叫他們把我<WAH0853>下<WH07760><WTH8804>在這監【1】裏<WAH09002><WH0953>的』
Gen/40.lcc_original: 我實在是從希伯來人之地被拐來的；就是在這裏、我也沒有作過甚麼、足以叫他們把我下在這監【1】裏的』
notes: UNV {<WAH03588>} is implicit (כִּי 'so that/that'); LCC renders this with the explicit phrase 足以, so braces dropped and tag attached to 足以 per rule 3
LCC adds 就是 before 在這裏 — this is a Chinese rhetorical addition with no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated
LCC adds demonstrative 這 in 在這監【1】裏 (vs UNV 在監裡); tags attached after 裏 following UNV end-of-phrase placement
LCC 作過 vs UNV 做過 — orthographic variant of the same word; aligned straightforwardly

Gen/40.lcc_original: 膳長見解釋得好，就對約瑟說：『我也作了一個夢；在我夢中，有三筐白餅在我頭上。
notes: UNV implicit {<WH0637>} (אַף, also): LCC has explicit 也 at this position, so braces dropped and tag attached as 也<WH0637>; LCC word order 我...也 preserved, giving 我<WAH0589>也<WH0637>
{<WAH03588>} kept implicit: LCC omits the conjunction 'that' between 見 and 解釋, no explicit Chinese counterpart
LCC adds 作了一個夢 before 在我夢中 — this clause is an LCC expansion with no direct SN assignments; WH02472 (חֲלוֹם, dream) anchored to 夢 in 在我夢中<WAH09002><WH02472>
UNV 見<WAH02009> (וְהִנֵּה, behold) maps to LCC 有: LCC restructures into an existential clause ('there are three baskets') rather than a perception clause ('I saw'), so WAH02009 attaches to 有
LCC inverts word order: UNV has 見...頭上頂著三筐白餅 while LCC has 有三筐白餅在我頭上; SNs placed at semantically corresponding words in LCC order

Gen/40.lcc_original: 頂上頭的筐子裏，有膳長爲法老作的各樣食物；有飛鳥從我頭上筐子裏直喫。』
notes: LCC 膳長 (chief baker/food steward) takes H0644+WTH8802: it renders the Heb אֹפֶה (Qal ptcp 'baker'), which UNV renders verbally as 烤; LCC 作的 then takes H04939 (מַעֲשֶׂה, work/deed) parallel to UNV 的<WH04939>
Two WAH04480 (מִן prefix) instances in the locative phrase: explicit 從 absorbs the first; the second מִן (before הַסַּל 'the basket') has no separate LCC lexeme so is kept implicit as {<WAH04480>}
上<WH05921> covers only the עַל component of Hebrew מֵעַל ('from upon'); the מִן component is covered by the preceding explicit 從<WAH04480>

LCC omits an explicit food object at the end of the second clause (UNV 的食物<WAH0853>); the direct-object marker H853 (את) is kept implicit as {<WAH0853>} since 直喫 subsumes the action without naming the object
Missing SNs: 04639
Extra SNs: 04939

Gen/40.lcc_original: 約瑟回答說：『這夢的解釋是這樣：三個筐子就是三天。
notes: UNV has {<WH06030>}{<WTH8799>} as implicit markers (no explicit Chinese word for 'answered'), but LCC has explicit 回答; per Rule 3 dropped braces and attached as 回答<WH06030><WTH8799>
UNV 解 (H06623) maps to LCC 解釋 — LCC uses the fuller noun form but same semantic unit; SN attached to 解釋
UNV 你的夢 vs LCC 這夢 — 夢 carries no SN in UNV so no transfer needed; 這 left unannotated
LCC closing punctuation 。 preserved (UNV used ；)

Gen/40.lcc_original: 三天之內，法老必將你的頭提【2】起離開你身上，把你掛在木頭上：必有飛鳥從你身上喫你的肉。』
notes: UNV 必斬斷 and LCC 提起 both translate WH05375 (נשׂא = lift/take/carry); morphology tag WTH8799 follows 提【2】起 as the verb anchor.
First {<WAH0853>} was implicit in UNV before 你的頭; LCC has explicit 你的頭, so braces dropped and tag placed on 你 (the start of the accusative NP): 你<WAH0853>的頭<WH07218>.
First {<WAH04480>}{<WAH05921>} pair (both implicit in UNV) is rendered explicitly in LCC as 離開你身上; split as 離開<WAH04480> (from/off) and 你身上<WAH05921> (upon you).
Second 你身上<WAH04480><WAH05921> in UNV (not implicit) maps to LCC 從你身上; split as 從<WAH04480> (from) and 你身上<WAH05921> (upon), since 從 explicitly renders the מִן prefix.
Third {<WAH0853>} was implicit in UNV before 你身上...的肉; LCC has explicit 你的肉 as direct object, so braces dropped and tag placed on 你<WAH0853>.
LCC footnote marker 【2】 on 提 is preserved exactly as-is; it does not affect SN placement.

Gen/40.lcc_original: 到了第三天，法老的生日，他爲衆臣僕設擺了筵席，使酒政長的頭和膳長的頭在衆臣僕中都抬得起。
notes: WAH0853 (אֵת) shifted from UNV 是 → LCC 法老, since UNV's copula 是 has no LCC counterpart; the accusative marker logically belongs to 法老 (object of birth).
WAH0853 (אֵת) shifted from UNV 把 → LCC 使; both words introduce the direct object phrase, but LCC uses a causative construction (使…抬得起) rather than UNV's disposal construction (把…提出).

UNV 酒政<WH08269><WH04945> combined שַׂר+מַשְׁקֶה on one word; LCC makes the distinction explicit: 酒政<WH04945> (cupbearer) and 長<WH08269> (chief/שַׂר). Same split applied to 膳<WH0644><WTH8802>長<WH08269>.
Implicit {WH07218} in UNV becomes explicit 頭<WH07218> in LCC (twice) per Rule 3 — LCC renders רֹאשׁ literally as 頭 rather than leaving it unexpressed.
Implicit {WAH09002}{WH08432}{WH05650} in UNV become explicit in LCC as 在<WAH09002>…臣僕<WH05650>中<WH08432> per Rule 3 — LCC renders בְּתוֹךְ עֲבָדָיו literally.
Chinese 了 (perfective aspect particle) and 都 (adverb) left unannotated — no Hebrew equivalents.
衆 in the final phrase 在衆臣僕中 left unannotated — the end-phrase Hebrew (בְּתוֹךְ עֲבָדָיו) has no כָּל, unlike the earlier 他爲衆臣僕 which does carry WAH09001+WAH03605.
WH05375+WTH8799 (וַיִּשָּׂא = he lifted up) attached to 抬得起; LCC translates the idiom more literally than UNV's interpretive 提出監來.

Gen/40.lcc_original: 回復了酒政長去做他的酒政：將杯遞在法老手掌中；
notes: 回復了<WH07725><WTH8686>: Hiphil וַיָּשֶׁב 'restored'; morphology tag attaches to the verb 回復了
{<WAH0853>} kept implicit — LCC omits explicit direct-object marker particle corresponding to את
酒政長<WH08269><WH04945> bundles שַׂר (chief, WH08269) + מַשְׁקִים (cupbearers, WH04945) onto LCC's compound 酒政長
{<WAH05921>} kept implicit in first clause; LCC phrase 去做他的 rephrases Hebrew עַל-מַשְׁקֵהוּ ('unto his office') without an explicit preposition
Second 酒政<WH04945> corresponds to מַשְׁקֵהוּ (his cupbearer-post)
LCC 手掌 maps precisely to כַּף WH03709 (palm of hand) — more faithful than UNV's 手

Gen/40.lcc_original: 卻把膳長掛起來，正如約瑟向他們所解釋的。
notes: UNV 所解的話<WH06622><WTH8804> → LCC 所解釋<WH06622><WTH8804>的: LCC uses the compound verb 解釋 (interpret/explain) where UNV uses 解…的話 (interpreted words); SNs attach to the verb 解釋, trailing 的 is a Chinese structural particle with no Hebrew equivalent.
UNV 但 → LCC 卻: both are adversative conjunctions with no SN annotation in UNV, so left unannotated in LCC.

Gen/40.lcc_original: 然而酒政長卻沒有懷念到約瑟，竟把他忘了。
notes: UNV 酒(H8248)政(H8269) maps to LCC 酒政長: split as 酒<WH08248><WTH8688> and 政長<WH08269>, since 長 reinforces the 'chief' meaning of H8269 rather than introducing a new root
然而 (LCC discourse connector) has no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated
LCC 懷念到 covers UNV 記念; SNs attached to 懷念, with 到 (aspectual particle) left unannotated
LCC 把他 (bǎ-construction for object topicalization) has no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated; H7911 attached after 忘了

Gen/41.lcc_original: 過了兩年工夫，法老作了一個夢，夢見他站在尼羅河旁邊。
notes: WAH01961+WTH8799 remain implicit — no explicit word in LCC for 'it came to pass' (וַיְהִי); LCC's 過了 corresponds to min+qets (WAH04480+WH07093) just as in UNV
WH03117 (yom/יָמִים = days) attached to LCC's 工夫 (time/period) rather than 年, since 工夫 is the lexical item expressing the 'days' duration concept absent in UNV's rendering
LCC 尼羅河 (explicit proper name for the Nile) tagged with WH02975 (ye'or), replacing UNV's generic 河 (river); tag placed after the full noun phrase
作了一個夢 expands UNV's 做夢 into a nominal construction; WH02492+WTH8802 attached to end of phrase after 夢 as the semantic head
LCC's pronoun 他 (Pharaoh) replaces UNV's 自己; no SN assigned — pronouns are not independently tagged in this scheme

Gen/41.lcc_original: 忽有七隻母牛從尼羅河裏上來，體格俊秀，肌豐肉肥，在菖蒲中喫草。
notes: 忽 is LCC's explicit rendering of הִנֵּה (WAH02009), which is implicit in UNV (braces dropped per Rule 3).
LCC uses 尼羅河 (fuller name 'Nile River') where UNV has simply 河; WH02975 (יְאֹר) attaches to the full 尼羅河 phrase.
體格俊秀 covers both WH03303 (יָפֶה, beautiful) and WH04758 (מַרְאֶה, appearance) as a single LCC compound phrase.
肌豐肉肥 covers both WH01277 (בָּרִיא, fat/healthy) and WH01320 (בָּשָׂר, flesh), which LCC renders as a parallel four-character idiom.

Gen/41.lcc_original: 隨後另有七隻母牛從尼羅河上來，體格醜陋、肌細肉瘦，在尼羅河岸上、站在那些母牛旁邊。
notes: H02009 kept implicit {<WAH02009>}: LCC has no explicit 'behold/lo' word, matching UNV's braced form
H4758 (מַרְאֶה, appearance/form) mapped to 體格; H7451 (רַע, ugly/bad) mapped to 醜陋 — together rendering UNV's 醜陋 phrase as LCC's 體格醜陋
H1851 (דַּק, lean/thin) mapped to 肌細; H1320 (בָּשָׂר, flesh) mapped to 肉瘦 — LCC rephrases UNV 乾瘦 as compound 肌細肉瘦
LCC restructures final clause: UNV '與那七隻母牛一同站在河邊' → LCC '在尼羅河岸上、站在那些母牛旁邊'; SNs reordered to match LCC word order
H5921 (עַל, on/upon) attached to first 在 following UNV precedent (在<WAH05921>河<WH02975>邊); second 在 in 站在 is a verb complement particle with no independent Hebrew correspondent
H2975 (יְאֹר, Nile/river) tagged at both occurrences of 尼羅河 corresponding to UNV's two uses of 河<WH02975>

Gen/41.lcc_original: 那些體格醜陋、肌細肉瘦的母牛、把那七隻體格俊秀的肥母牛都喫下去；法老就醒了。
notes: <WH04758> (מַרְאֶה, appearance/form) maps to 體格 in LCC both times — LCC uses 體格 where UNV uses implicit form embedded in 醜陋/美好

<WH01851><WH01320> (thin of flesh) both attach to the compound 肌細肉瘦 as a whole — LCC expands into a doubled intensifier (fine-sinewed/lean-fleshed) that cannot be cleanly split, so both tags follow the phrase in Hebrew word order
<WAH0853> (Hebrew direct object marker את) maps to 把 — LCC recasts the clause as a 把-construction, shifting the verb 喫 to post-object position; 把 is the closest functional equivalent
都 (adverb, all) and 下去 (directional complement) are Chinese grammatical additions with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated
<WH03303> (יָפֶה, beautiful) maps to 俊秀 in LCC rather than UNV's 美好 — different lexical choice, same semantic field

Gen/41.lcc_original: 他又睡着，第二次又作了夢，夢見有七個穗子在一棵莖上長起來，又肥又好。
notes: LCC significantly reorders the middle clause: UNV has 一棵麥子長了七個穗子 (one stalk grew seven ears), while LCC has 七個穗子在一棵莖上長起來 (seven ears on one stalk grew up). SNs placed at semantically corresponding words despite the inversion.
WAH02009 (וְהִנֵּה, and behold) attached to 夢見 following the UNV pattern; LCC adds 有 after as an existential marker (unannotated) rather than a direct Hebrew equivalent.

LCC uses 棵莖 (stalk/stem) where UNV uses 棵麥子 (stalk of wheat) — 莖 is semantically closer to H07070 (קָנֶה = reed/stalk). WAH09002 (ב prefix = on/in) and WH07070 both attach to 棵莖; LCC's locative 在...上 expresses the same preposition but 在 and 上 are left unannotated as structural elements.
UNV 肥大 → LCC 肥 (H01277), UNV 佳美 → LCC 好 (H02896): synonymous renderings of the same Hebrew adjectives.
LCC 了 in 作了夢 is a Chinese aspect particle with no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated inside the annotated unit rather than splitting the phrase.

Gen/41.lcc_original: 隨後又發生了七個穗子，又細瘦，又被熱東風吹焦了。
notes: LCC 發生了 = UNV 長了: both render H06779 (צָמַח, to sprout/grow), straightforward swap
LCC 細瘦 = UNV 細弱: both render H01851 (דַּק, thin/lean), synonymous
LCC adds 熱 before 東風; H06921 (קָדִים, east wind) attaches to the full phrase 熱東風 since both characters together name the referent
{WAH02009} (הִנֵּה, behold) remains implicit — LCC has no explicit Chinese word for it, same as UNV
LCC punctuation preserved exactly: extra comma after 細瘦 retained

Gen/41.lcc_original: 這些細瘦的穗子把那七個又肥又飽滿的穗子吞下去；法老就醒了，阿，原來是個夢。
notes: LCC restructures with 把-construction (把那七個...吞下去); WH01104+WTH8799 placed after core verb 吞, before directional complement 下去
把 is a Chinese grammatical pivot marker with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated
UNV 不料 (WAH02009, הִנֵּה 'behold') rendered in LCC as 阿，原來; attached to 阿 as the primary exclamatory equivalent; 原來 is a secondary Chinese connective left unannotated
LCC 就 (transitional adverb before 醒了) has no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated

Gen/41.lcc_original: 到了早晨，法老心裏煩亂，就打發人把埃及所有的學術士和智慧人都召了來；法老將他的夢向他們敍說，卻沒有人能給法老解釋。
notes: LCC restructures 'sent to summon': 打發<WH07971>人...召了<WH07121>來 vs UNV's 差人<WH07971>召了<WH07121>來, placing the second verb at the end of the clause
UNV's implicit {<WAH0853>} after 埃及 becomes explicit 把<WAH0853> in LCC (braces dropped per rule 3)

Hebrew has two כֹּל (WAH03605) for both groups; LCC uses one 所有的 upfront — annotated 和<WAH0853><WAH03605> to preserve the second token; LCC's 都 is a stylistic addition with no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated
LCC reverses 告訴他們 word order to 向他們敍說; <WAH09001> (ל prefix) stays on 他們, <WH05608><WTH8762> moves to 敍說
將 replaces 把 as the object marker for <WAH0853>; both are explicit Chinese particles covering the Hebrew accusative את

Gen/41.lcc_original: 於時酒政長告訴法老說：『我今天要提起我的罪來了。
notes: WH01696+WTH8762 were implicit braces in UNV (no explicit verb for 'spoke'), but LCC has explicit 告訴 — braces dropped per Rule 3
WAH0853 (אֶת/אֶל preposition 'to') had no standalone correspondent in LCC (UNV used 對); attached to 告訴 since it covers the 'tell-to' semantic relationship
想起 (UNV) → 要提起 (LCC): 要 is an aspectual auxiliary with no Hebrew equivalent; SNs attach to 提起 as the main verb
來了 at sentence end are Chinese aspect/completion particles with no Hebrew equivalents — left unannotated
Confidence slightly reduced due to WAH0853 placement ambiguity (could alternatively be left as implicit {<WAH0853>} before 法老)

Gen/41.lcc_original: 從前法老惱怒臣僕，把我和膳長下在護衛長府內的看守所裏。
notes: LCC 看守所裏 substitutes for UNV 監裡; both render H04929 (מִשְׁמָר, guardhouse/prison) with the prefix H09002 (בְּ, in) — SNs attached to 看守所裏
{<WAH05921>} retained as implicit: LCC omits an explicit preposition 'against' between 惱怒 and 臣僕, matching the UNV implicit token
Two occurrences of <WAH0853> (אֵת accusative marker) preserved on 把我 and 和 respectively, following the double-object structure of the Hebrew

Gen/41.lcc_sn: 我<WAH0589>和他<WAH01931>，我們倆在同一<WH0259>夜<WAH09002><WH03915>裏都作<WH02492><WTH8799>了夢<WH02472>；我們作<WH02492><WTH8804>了夢，各人<WH0376>各帶着自己的夢<WH02472>的解釋<WAH09003><WH06623>。
Gen/41.lcc_original: 我和他，我們倆在同一夜裏都作了夢；我們作了夢，各人各帶着自己的夢的解釋。
notes: H0589 (אֲנַחְנוּ, we/I) mapped to 我; H01931 (הוּא, he) mapped to 他 — LCC expands UNV's implied 我們 into explicit '我和他', making the two pronouns individually taggable.
H0259 (אֶחָד, one/same) placed at 一 in 同一夜裏 rather than 倆; the Hebrew בְּלַיְלָה אֶחָד = 'in one night' maps cleanly to LCC's 同一夜, not to the 'two people' concept.
H02492+WTH8804 (dream verb, perfect aspect, second occurrence) mapped to 作 in 我們作了夢 — LCC repeats the verb phrase before the semicolon where UNV has 各夢.

H02472 (חֲלוֹם, dream noun, second occurrence) mapped to 夢 in 自己的夢; H06623 (פִּתְרוֹן, interpretation) mapped to 解釋; LCC restructures the Hebrew 'interpretation of his dream' (לְפִתְרוֹן חֲלֹמֹו) into the genitive chain 自己的夢的解釋, which reverses the head-modifier order.
帶着 (carrying/bearing) in LCC is a loose dynamic rendering with no direct Hebrew SN equivalent — left unannotated.
