Gen/41.lcc_original: 他們要把將要來到的七個好年頭的糧食收集起來，堆積麥子在法老手下，讓他保存着，在城市裏做糧食。
notes: {<WAH0428>} kept implicit — LCC uses 七個 (seven) rather than an explicit demonstrative 'those/these'; the demonstrative הָאֵלֶּה has no direct counterpart in LCC's phrasing
{<WAH03605>} kept implicit — LCC's phrasing 七個好年頭的糧食 already specifies 'the food of the seven good years', subsuming כֹּל (all) without a separate word
LCC reorders the second clause: 在法老手下 precedes 讓他保存着, whereas UNV sequences as 收存在各城裡做食物，歸於法老的手下; SNs transferred to semantically corresponding LCC positions respecting LCC's word order
五穀 (UNV) ↔ 麥子 (LCC): different Chinese terms for grain (五穀 = cereals broadly, 麥子 = wheat/grain), both map to WH01250 (בָּר)

Gen/41.lcc_original: 這糧食便可以貯藏着【4】；來應付此地七年的饑荒，就是將要來到埃及地的，免得這地被饑荒所剪滅。』
notes: UNV implicit {<WAH01961>}{<WTH8804>} (וְהָיָה, 'and shall be') dropped braces and attached to LCC 貯藏着, since LCC makes the storage/deposit action explicit rather than leaving it as a bare copula.
<WAH09001><WH06487> (לְפִקָּדוֹן, 'as a deposit') also attached to 貯藏着; both H01961 and H06487 converge on this single LCC verb that jointly expresses 'shall be stored as a deposit'.
UNV implicit {<WAH09001>}{<WH0776>} (לָאָרֶץ, 'for the land') dropped braces and attached to LCC 此地, since LCC makes this beneficiary phrase explicit with 來應付此地.

LCC restructures the relative clause: UNV order '將來<H01961>的<H0834>...七個荒年' becomes LCC '七年的饑荒，就是將要來到埃及地的<H0834>'; SNs redistributed to match LCC word order, with <WAH0834> anchored on the final 的 of the relative clause.
LCC uses 剪滅 for H03772 (כָּרַת, cut off) vs UNV 滅; SN attached to 所剪滅 with morphology <WTH8735> (Niphal imperfect) preserved.

Gen/41.lcc_original: 法老和衆臣僕對這計劃都很滿意。
notes: LCC uses one 對 where Hebrew/UNV had two distinct בְּעֵינֵי (in the eyes of) phrases — one for Pharaoh, one for his servants. Per rules 3+6, both implicit pairs {<WAH09002>}{<WH05869>} are merged onto 對 with braces dropped, since 對 is an explicit Chinese rendering of 'in the eyes of'.
UNV 一切 (WAH03605) → LCC 衆 (same semantic: 'all'); WAH03605 tag follows 衆 as it followed 一切 in UNV.
UNV 這事 (WH01697, דָּבָר 'matter/word') → LCC 這計劃 ('this plan') — LCC rephrases with a more specific noun; same SN retained.
WTH8799 (verbal morphology) attaches to 滿意 immediately after WH03190, mirroring UNV attachment to 為妙.
LCC 都很 (adverbial intensifiers) have no direct Hebrew correspondents; left unannotated.

Gen/41.lcc_original: 法老對臣僕說：『像這樣的人有上帝的靈在他裏面，我們哪能找得着呢？』
notes: 神 (UNV) → 上帝 (LCC): both are H0430 Elohim; tag attaches to 上帝
裡頭 (UNV) → 裏面 (LCC): synonymous location words; WAH09002 (ב prefix) attaches to 裏面
豈能 (UNV) → 哪能 (LCC): neither carries a Strong's number, no tag needed
找得著 (UNV) → 找得着 (LCC): same word, variant character form only

Gen/41.lcc_sn: 法老<WH06547>對<WAH0413>約瑟<WH03130>說<WH0559><WTH8799>：『上帝<WH0430>旣<WH0310>將<WAH0853>這<WAH02063>事<WAH03605>告知<WH03045><WTH8687>了你<WAH0853>，那就沒有人<WAH0369>像你這樣有見識<WH0995><WTH8737>有智慧<WH02450>了。
Gen/41.lcc_original: 法老對約瑟說：『上帝旣將這事告知了你，那就沒有人像你這樣有見識有智慧了。
notes: 神 (UNV) → 上帝 (LCC): systematic lexical difference; both map to WH0430 (אֱלֹהִים)
指示 (UNV) → 告知 (LCC): both render יָדַע Hiphil (WH03045 WTH8687)
聰明 (UNV) → 見識 (LCC): both render בִּין Niphal participle (WH0995 WTH8737)

事都<WAH03605> (UNV) → 事<WAH03605> (LCC): LCC omits 都; WAH03605 (כֹּל = all) attached to 事 as nearest semantic carrier rather than kept implicit, since 這事 as a unit covers the full Hebrew phrase אֶת כָּל זֹאת
可見 (UNV) → 那就 (LCC): both are Chinese-added connectives with no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated in both
LCC sentence-final 了 left unannotated (aspect particle with no Hebrew equivalent)

Gen/41.lcc_original: 你可以掌管我的家；我的人民都必須聽從【5】你所吩咐的；惟獨在王位上，我纔比你大。』
notes: UNV 我的民 → LCC 我的人民: H05971 (עַם, people) — straightforward semantic match despite expansion
UNV 必聽從 → LCC 必須聽從: 必須 reinforces the Hebrew imperfect aspect with no separate SN; WH05401+WTH8799 attach to 聽從
{<WAH05921>} remains implicit in LCC — 【5】 is a footnote reference, not an explicit Hebrew equivalent; implicit tag placed before 【5】 to preserve LCC text structure
UNV 你的話 (H06310 פֶּה, mouth/word) → LCC 你所吩咐的 (what you command): LCC paraphrases; WH06310 attached to the whole phrase
UNV 寶座 (H03678 כִּסֵּא, throne) → LCC 王位: different lexeme, same referent
LCC 纔 (focusing adverb 'only then') has no Hebrew equivalent; <WAH04480> stays on 你 as the comparative particle מִמְּךָ (than you)

Gen/41.lcc_original: 法老對約瑟說：『看哪，我立了你來治理埃及全地。』
notes: UNV 又 (again/also) has no equivalent in LCC; WAH0413 (אֶל, 'unto') attaches to 對 alone
UNV implicit {<WH07200>}{<WTH8798>} (behold) mapped to explicit LCC 看哪 — braces dropped per Rule 3, both SNs attached to 看哪
UNV 派 (H05414, נָתַן, 'to set/appoint') rendered as LCC 立了; morphology WTH8800 attaches after 立了; aspect particle 了 left unannotated
LCC 來 (directional/purpose complement before 治理) has no Hebrew correspondent — left unannotated

Gen/41.lcc_original: 法老就脫下他手上的打印戒指，戴在約瑟手上，給他穿上麻絲織的衣服，把金鍊掛在他的脖子上；
notes: UNV 摘下<WH05493> → LCC 脫下: both mean 'remove/take off'; same referent, straightforward alignment
LCC inserts 他 before 手上 (grammatically required in Chinese but absent in Hebrew); left unannotated
UNV 細麻<WH08336>衣<WH0899> → LCC 麻絲織的<WH08336>衣服<WH0899>: LCC expands 'fine linen' to 'hemp-silk woven cloth'; WH08336 attached to 麻絲織的, WH0899 to 衣服
UNV 戴<WH07760><WTH8799> (put on) → LCC 掛<WH07760><WTH8799> (hang): different verbs but same semantic act of placing the gold chain; WH07760 attached to 掛
UNV 頸項<WH06677> → LCC 脖子: exact synonyms for 'neck'

Gen/41.lcc_original: 又讓約瑟坐他的副車，有喝道的在前面呼叫說：『跪下』【6】。這樣，法老就立了約瑟來治理埃及全地。
notes: UNV 叫→LCC 讓: both serve as causative markers; no SN attaches to either (H7392 Hiphil covers the causative force).
LCC adds 有 before 喝道的 with no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated.
在前面 (LCC) vs 在前 (UNV): <WAH09001><WH06440> attach after 前面 since both phrases represent H6440 (פָּנֶה) with prefix.
UNV 派<WH05414><WTH8800>→LCC 立了: 立 = appoint (H5414), 了 is a Chinese aspect particle with no Hebrew equivalent; tag inserted between 立 and 了.
UNV second clause uses 他<WAH0853> (object marker for Joseph); LCC substitutes the full name 約瑟 — <WAH0853> attaches to 約瑟 as the explicit object.
治理<WAH05921>: <WAH05921> (על = over/upon) attaches to 治理 in both UNV and LCC, encoding 'rule over'.
Footnote marker 【6】 preserved in situ after 跪下<WH086>』.

Gen/41.lcc_original: 法老對約瑟說：『我是法老；在埃及全地，若沒有你的命令，就沒有人會動手動腳作甚麼事。』
notes: UNV's parenthetical gloss '（原文是動手動腳）' is integrated directly into LCC's main clause as '動手動腳作甚麼事'; SNs from the parenthetical (WH07311/WTH8686, WAH0853×2, WH03027, WH07272) are mapped to LCC's 動手動腳 accordingly.
UNV '不許<WAH03808>人<WH0376>擅自辦事' maps to LCC '就沒有<WAH03808>人<WH0376>會動手動腳作甚麼事'; Chinese modal 會 and phrase 作甚麼事 left unannotated as expansion with no Hebrew equivalent.
The second 動 in LCC's idiom '動手動腳' receives no SN, mirroring UNV's parenthetical where the second 動 is also tagless (single Hebrew verb יָרִים governs two coordinated objects).
在 before 埃及 receives no SN — it is a Chinese prepositional addition; same convention as UNV.

Gen/41.lcc_original: 法老給約瑟起名叫撒發那忒巴內亞；又將安城祭司波提非拉的女兒亞西納給約瑟爲妻。約瑟就出來視察埃及地。
notes: LCC reorders 給約瑟 before 起名 (vs UNV 賜名給約瑟); WH03130 attaches to 約瑟 and WH08034 attaches to 起名, following LCC word order
UNV 賜名<WH08034> → LCC 起名<WH08034>: different verbs with same semantic function (give a name); 名 in both cases carries the שֵׁם root
UNV 他<WAH09001> (3ms pronominal suffix on verb) → LCC uses explicit 約瑟; WAH09001 transferred to 約瑟
UNV 巡行<WAH05921> → LCC 視察<WAH05921>: different verbs (patrol/tour vs inspect/survey), both render Hebrew movement-over-land idiom; WAH05921 (וְעַל prefix) attached to 視察
LCC omits 的 between 安城 and 祭司 (UNV: 安城的祭司); no impact on SN placement — WH0204 still after 安城, WH03548 still after 祭司

Gen/41.lcc_original: 約瑟侍立在埃及王法老面前的時候，年三十歲；約瑟從法老面前出來，遍行埃及全地。
notes: UNV's {<WAH09001>}{<WH06440>} (implicit לִפְנֵי markers after 法老 in first clause) become explicit 面前<WAH09001><WH06440> in LCC, since LCC explicitly states 面前 — braces dropped per Rule 3.
UNV uses 他<WH03130> in the second clause but LCC repeats 約瑟; SN H3130 attached to 約瑟 unchanged.
WAH09002 (ב prefix on the infinitive construct) kept on 侍立 rather than on Chinese preposition 在, following UNV's pattern of grouping prefix tags with the main verbal root.
在 left unannotated — it is a Chinese syntactic preposition bridging 侍立 and the locative phrase, with no independent Hebrew lexeme counterpart.

Second-clause 從法老面前: WAH04480 (מִן prefix) + WAH09001 (לִ prefix) + WH06440 (פָּנִים) all placed on 面前, mirroring UNV's grouping where 從 is also unannotated and the compound מִלִּפְנֵי is carried by 面前.

Gen/41.lcc_sn: 當七<WAH09002><WH07651>年<WH08141>豐收<WH07647>的時候，那地<WH0776>出產<WH06213><WTH8799>豐盛，一把一把地<WAH09001><WH07062>收進來。
Gen/41.lcc_original: 當七年豐收的時候，那地出產豐盛，一把一把地收進來。
notes: LCC reorders UNV's 七個豐年 → 七年豐收: SNs distributed as 七<WAH09002><WH07651>, 年<WH08141>, 豐收<WH07647>
UNV's parenthetical editorial note (原文是一把一把的<WAH09001><WH07062>) becomes LCC's main clause; SNs attached to 一把一把地
LCC 豐盛 (bountiful) and 收進來 (bringing in) are elaborative renderings with no direct Hebrew equivalents; left unannotated

Gen/41.lcc_original: 約瑟收集了埃及地七年豐收的一切糧食，把糧食存在城市裏，將各城周圍田地的糧食存在城中。
notes: 收集 covers UNV 聚斂 (H06908); aspect particle 了 is unannotated (Chinese grammatical particle with no Hebrew equivalent)

Implicit {<WAH0834>}{<WAH01961>}{<WTH8804>} (אֲשֶׁר הָיוּ = 'that were') remain implicit — LCC rephrases the relative clause as the attributive nominal 豐收 rather than an explicit relative construction; 豐收 itself receives no SN tag
LCC 城市 (two-char compound) corresponds to UNV 各城 (H05892); the prepositional phrase 在城市裏 receives the prefix tag <WAH09002> at the end of the locative phrase, matching UNV convention
城中 corresponds to UNV 本城裡 (H08432 = midst/interior)
LCC uses 將 as a clause-connector with no Hebrew equivalent; the implicit {<WAH0834>} is placed before 將, matching UNV's position at the start of the second relative clause

Gen/41.lcc_original: 約瑟堆積麥子極多，就像海沙，多到無法計算，因爲是不能計算的。
notes: LCC 麥子 replaces UNV 五穀 for WH01250 (בָּר = grain/wheat); both are valid renderings of the same Hebrew word
UNV implicit markers {<WAH05704>}{<WAH03588>} (עַד כִּי = 'until that') become explicit in LCC as 到 in the phrase 多到; per Rule 3+6, both tags attached to 到 with braces dropped
WAH09003 (כְּ prefix = 'like/as') is part of the Hebrew token כְּחוֹל (like-sand) and kept with 沙, even though the comparative sense is separately expressed by 就像 in LCC

LCC ending 是不能計算的 restructures UNV 穀不可勝數 significantly: WH0369 (אֵין = there is not/without) maps to 不能, WH04557 (מִסְפָּר = number) maps to 計算; the 是 and 的 are LCC-only structural particles with no Hebrew equivalent
Missing SNs: 03588

Gen/41.lcc_original: 饑荒年頭未到以前，約瑟生了兩個兒子，就是安城祭司波提非拉的女兒亞西納給他生的。
notes: LCC 饑荒 expands UNV's single 荒 for H07458 (רָעָב); 年頭 expands 年 for H08141 (שָׁנָה) — SNs applied to full LCC phrases
UNV implicit {WAH0834} (אֲשֶׁר) is explicit 就是 in LCC; {WAH09001} (לוֹ, 'to him') is explicit 他 — braces dropped per Rule 3

LCC restructures sentence order: main clause 約瑟生了兩個兒子 (Hebrew passive יֻלַּד = Pual WTH8795) + relative clause 就是...給他生的 (Hebrew active יָלְדָה = Qal WTH8804). UNV collapses both into one active-voice clause; LCC more closely follows Hebrew syntax with two distinct clauses
給 in 給他生的 has no direct Hebrew equivalent (Chinese preposition only); WAH09001 (ל prefix of לוֹ) attaches to the pronoun 他

Gen/41.lcc_original: 約瑟給長子起名叫瑪拿西【7】，因爲他說：『上帝使我忘卻了我一切困苦、和我父全家。』
Gen/41.unv_sn_reference: 約瑟<WH03130>給<WAH0853>長子<WH01060>起名<WH08034>叫<WH07121><WTH8799>瑪拿西<WH04519>（就是使之忘了的意思），因為<WAH03588>他說：「　神<WH0430>使我忘了<WH05382><WTH8765>一切<WAH03605>的<WAH0853>困苦<WH05999>和<WAH0853>我父<WH01>的全<WAH03605>家<WH01004>。」
notes: 神(UNV)→上帝(LCC): different lexemes for H0430 (אֱלֹהִים); SN attached normally per Rule 3 since LCC has explicit word
WAH0853 between 一切 and 困苦: UNV represents את with 的 particle; LCC omits 的, so kept as implicit {<WAH0853>}
忘了(UNV)→忘卻了(LCC): extra aspect particle 卻 in LCC has no Hebrew equivalent; SN attaches to end of full verb phrase
UNV parenthetical gloss （就是使之忘了的意思） absent in LCC — no SNs were on those gloss characters anyway
LCC footnote marker 【7】 after 瑪拿西 preserved verbatim; SN placed before it

Gen/41.lcc_original: 他給老二起名叫以法蓮【8】，因爲他說：『上帝使我在受苦難之地果實昌盛。』
Gen/41.unv_sn_reference: 他給<WAH0853>次子<WH08145>起名<WH08034>叫<WH07121><WTH8804>以法蓮<WH0669>（就是使之昌盛的意思），因為<WAH03588>他說：「　神<WH0430>使我在受苦<WH06040>的地方<WAH09002><WH0776>昌盛<WH06509><WTH8689>。」
notes: LCC 老二 ↔ UNV 次子 (H8145, שֵׁנִי 'second') — different lexical choice, same referent; SN attached to 老二
LCC 上帝 ↔ UNV 神 — both render H430 (אֱלֹהִים); standard UNV/LCC divergence, SN attached to 上帝
LCC 果實昌盛 renders H6509 (פָּרָה 'to be fruitful') more literally than UNV 昌盛 alone; both SNs <WH06509><WTH8689> attached to the full phrase 果實昌盛
LCC 受苦難 ↔ UNV 受苦 (H6040); extra 難 is LCC's stylistic expansion, treated as one unit for H6040
Footnote marker 【8】 preserved in original position, after the SN tag for 以法蓮<WH0669>

Gen/41.lcc_original: 埃及地的七年豐收一完，
notes: UNV renders שֶׁבַע שְׁנֵי הַשָּׂבָע as 七個豐(H7647)年(H8141), with H7647 on 豐 and H8141 on 年; LCC reorders to 七年豐收, so H8141 attaches to 年 and H7647 attaches to 豐收, following each word's semantic correspondence.
Implicit markers {WAH0834} (אֲשֶׁר), {WAH01961} (הָיָה), and {WTH8804} (Qal perfect morphology) have no explicit lexical equivalents in LCC and are preserved as implicit.

Gen/41.lcc_original: 正如約瑟所說的：七個饑荒的年頭開始來了，各地都有饑荒，惟獨埃及全地有食物。
notes: LCC restructures the verse: 正如約瑟所說的 is fronted as an introductory clause covering the whole verse, whereas UNV (following Hebrew word order) places it mid-verse after the first clause (七個荒年就來了。正如約瑟所說的，…). SNs are attached to their respective words regardless of this reordering.
UNV 荒年 → LCC 饑荒的年頭: H7458 (רָעָב, famine) attaches to 饑荒, H8141 (שָׁנָה, year) attaches to 年頭.
UNV 就 → LCC 開始: H2490 (חָלַל, to begin) + WTH8686 attach to 開始, which is LCC's explicit rendering of the Hiphil 'began to'.
UNV 糧食 → LCC 食物: both render H3899 (לֶחֶם, bread/food); SN transfers cleanly despite the different Chinese term.

Gen/41.lcc_original: 趕到埃及全地有了饑荒，衆民就向法老哀求食物；法老便對埃及衆人說：『去見約瑟；他對你們說甚麼，你們就作甚麼。』
notes: UNV 糧食 → LCC 食物: both = לֶחֶם (H3899), different Chinese terms for the same Hebrew word
UNV '對他們' compresses לְ+כֹּל+מִצְרַיִם into one phrase; LCC '對埃及衆人' spells it out — SNs distributed: 對<WAH09001>(לְ), 埃及<WH04714>(מִצְרַיִם), 衆人<WAH03605>(כֹּל)
UNV implicit {<WAH09001>} for לָכֶם ('to you') becomes explicit 你們 in LCC — braces dropped, attached as 你們<WAH09001>
LCC 去見約瑟 expands UNV 往...那裡去; 見 is LCC elaboration with no Hebrew equivalent — unannotated; <WAH0413> (אֶל) attaches to the destination 約瑟
LCC correlative structure 說甚麼...作甚麼: first 甚麼 = אֲשֶׁר <WAH0834>; second 甚麼 is LCC stylistic correlative, no additional Hebrew counterpart — unannotated

Gen/41.lcc_original: 當時饑荒佈滿了遍地；約瑟打開了各處糧倉，將倉裏所有的都賣給埃及人；在埃及地饑荒很厲害。
notes: 佈<WAH05921>滿<WAH03605>了遍<WH06440>地<WH0776>: LCC's idiomatic 佈滿了遍地 distributes across 4 Hebrew tokens — 佈=עַל (over/upon), 滿=כָּל (all), 遍=פְּנֵי (face/surface), 地=אֶרֶץ (land); aspect particle 了 left unannotated
打開了<WH06605><WTH8799>: LCC adds coverb 打 and aspect marker 了 (both unannotated); SN tags appended after the full verbal phrase 打開了

糧倉{<WAH0834>}{<WAH09002>}: Hebrew relative pronoun אֲשֶׁר and prefix preposition -בּ kept as implicit markers since LCC's 糧倉 is a lexical rendering of the implied concept, not a direct translation of these function words
將倉裏所有的都: LCC expansion elaborating 糶糧 (sold grain) with no direct Hebrew counterpart; left entirely unannotated
很 left unannotated (LCC intensifier with no Hebrew equivalent); <WH02388><WTH8799> (חָזַק, was severe/strong) attached to 厲害

Gen/41.lcc_original: 各地都往埃及去，到約瑟那裏去買，因爲饑荒在各地都很厲害。
notes: LCC '各地' covers UNV '各地的人' — Hebrew כָּל-הָאָרֶץ has no explicit person word; SNs <WAH03605><WH0776> attach to 各地 directly without loss

LCC '去買' renders UNV '糴糧' (buy grain, שָׁבַר); 去 functions as the infinitive prefix particle corresponding to Hebrew לִ (<WAH09001>), so all three SNs <WAH09001><WH07666><WTH8800> attach after 買 as the content word

Second clause word order differs: LCC 'because famine IN ALL PLACES very severe' vs UNV 'because ALL THE LAND famine severe' — Hebrew בְּכָל-הָאָרֶץ maps to LCC '在各地' (<WAH09002><WAH03605><WH0776>), with annotation following LCC word order
LCC '厲害' (severe/fierce) renders UNV '甚大' for Hebrew חָזַק; SN <WH02388><WTH8804> attaches after 厲害

Gen/42.lcc_original: 雅各見埃及有穀子，就對兒子們說：『你們爲甚麼彼此觀望呢？』
notes: UNV 糧 → LCC 穀子: both render שֶׁבֶר (WH07668, grain/food); SN attached to 穀子
{<WAH03588>} kept implicit — LCC has no explicit conjunction (כִּי) between 見 and 埃及
{<WH03290>} kept implicit — LCC also omits the repeated subject 雅各 before 就對兒子們說

Gen/42.lcc_original: 他說：『𠺶，我聽說在埃及有穀子；你們下那裏去，從那裏給我們買，我們就可以活着，免得死。』
notes: H0559 (say): UNV implicit {<WH0559>}{<WTH8799>}; LCC has explicit 他說 → dropped braces, SNs attached after 說
H02009 (behold/הִנֵּה): UNV implicit {<WAH02009>}; LCC has explicit interjection 𠺶 → dropped braces, SN attached
WAH09002 (ב prefix, 'in'): assigned to LCC 在 since 在 expresses the locative preposition; H04714 (Egypt) stays on 埃及
H08033 (שָׁם, 'there') first occurrence: UNV implicit after 下去; LCC has explicit 那裏 in 你們下那裏去 → dropped braces; 去 is a Chinese directional complement with no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated
WAH09001 (לְ prefix, 'for'): assigned to LCC 給 since 給 expresses the benefactive 'for us' meaning of לָנוּ
H02421 (live): attached to 活着; 就可以 are Chinese modal/aspectual particles with no direct Hebrew equivalents, left unannotated

WAH03808 (לֹא, 'not'): assigned to LCC 免得 ('lest/so as not to') which encodes the negation semantically; confidence slightly reduced here as 免得 is a compound negation construction rather than a bare negative

Gen/42.lcc_original: 於是約瑟的十個哥哥就下去，要從埃及買麥子。
notes: UNV 都下 → LCC 就下去: 都/就 are connective particles with no SN; verb 下 receives WH03381+WTH8799; directional complement 去 left unannotated
WAH09001 (lamed of purpose, לְ- prefix on infinitive) attached to 要, which explicitly renders the purpose/infinitive sense in LCC
WAH04480 (מִן 'from' prefix) split from WH04714: attached to 從 since LCC uses an explicit preposition to express the prefix meaning; WH04714 (Egypt) attached to 埃及
UNV 糴 (WH07666, buy grain) → LCC 買; UNV 糧 (WH01250, grain) → LCC 麥子 — straightforward lexical correspondence despite different word choice

Gen/42.lcc_original: 但是約瑟的弟弟便雅憫、雅各沒有打發他和哥哥們一同去，因爲雅各說：恐怕他遭害。
notes: UNV 但 → LCC 但是: both represent the waw-adversative + direct object marker (H0853); <WAH0853> attaches to 但是 as the corresponding word.
UNV 兄弟 → LCC 弟弟: LCC specifies 'younger brother' where UNV uses the generic sibling term; both map to H0251 (אח).
UNV 同去 (unannotated) → LCC 一同去: LCC adds 一 for stylistic fullness; 一 is left unannotated and the tag structure 他和<WAH0854>哥哥們<WH0251> is preserved unchanged.
LCC omits Japanese-style quotation marks 「」 present in UNV; punctuation preserved as-is per LCC original.

Gen/42.lcc_original: 在那些來買五穀的人中間，有以色列的兒子們也來要買，因爲在迦南地也有饑荒。
notes: UNV has {<WH0935>}{<WTH8802>} as implicit (the comers / Israel's sons coming), but LCC makes it explicit with 也來要買; braces dropped per Rule 3, H935+WTH8802 attached to 來.

買五穀 treated as a unified phrase corresponding to H7666 (שָׁבַר, to buy grain); WAH09001+H7666+WTH8800 placed after 五穀 since the grain object is lexically contained in the Hebrew root but explicit in LCC.
要買 after 也來 is LCC's stylistic expansion (echoing the purpose clause) with no additional Hebrew lexeme; left unannotated.

LCC's sentence-opening 在那些 and the second 在 before 迦南 are Chinese prepositions handled by LCC's restructuring; the prefix tags WAH09002 remain with their main words (中間 and 地) following UNV's encoding convention.

WTH8799 (Qal imperfect, main verb) stays on the relative-clause 來 in 那些來, and WTH8802 (Qal participle, הַבָּאִים) goes on the explicit 也來, preserving UNV's morphology assignments even though LCC inverts the surface structure.

Gen/42.lcc_sn: 當時治理{<WAH05921>}埃及地<WH0776>的執政者<WH07989>就是<WAH01931>約瑟<WH03130>；賣糧食<WH07666><WTH8688>給那地<WH0776>的衆<WAH09001><WAH03605>民<WH05971>的就是他<WAH01931>。約瑟<WH03130>的哥哥們<WH0251>來了<WH0935><WTH8799>，就面<WH0639>伏於地<WH0776>向約瑟<WAH09001>下拜<WH07812><WTH8691>。
Gen/42.lcc_original: 當時治理埃及地的執政者就是約瑟；賣糧食給那地的衆民的就是他。約瑟的哥哥們來了，就面伏於地向約瑟下拜。
notes: WH07989 (שַׁלִּיט = ruler) re-anchored from UNV 治理 to LCC 執政者: LCC splits the concept into verb 治理 + noun 執政者, and 執政者 is the direct nominal parallel to שַׁלִּיט
{<WAH05921>} kept implicit: LCC also has no overt word for 'over' — the preposition עַל is absorbed into the governing construction 治理埃及地
UNV 向他<WAH09001> → LCC 向約瑟<WAH09001>: LCC substitutes the explicit name for the pronoun; WAH09001 (לְ prefix of לוֹ) attaches to the object 約瑟
LCC adds aspect particle 就 before 面伏於地 — left unannotated as a Chinese grammatical element with no Hebrew equivalent
UNV 糶糧 → LCC 賣糧食: different phrasing, same semantic range; WH07666 + WTH8688 attached together to 賣糧食 as a unit

Gen/42.lcc_original: 約瑟看見他哥哥們，就認得他們，卻向他們裝作別人，對他們說些嚴厲的話：問他們說：『你們從哪裏來？』他們說：『從迦南地來買糧食。』
notes: LCC reorders the mid-verse phrase: UNV '卻裝作生人<WH05234><WTH8691>{<WAH0413>}，向他們<WAH0854>說' → LCC '卻向他們裝作別人，對他們說'. The implicit {<WAH0413>} (אֲלֵיהֶם = to them) from UNV becomes explicit via LCC's 向他們; braces dropped and <WAH0413> attached after 他們. The second 對他們 then carries <WAH0854> (אִתָּם).
UNV 糴 → LCC 買: both map to WH07666 (שָׁבַר, to buy grain). LCC uses the more general verb.
UNV 糧 → LCC 糧食: both map to WH0400 (אֹכֶל, food/grain). LCC adds 食 for naturalness.

問 in LCC '問他們說' has no independent SN — it is a Chinese translation addition with no separate Hebrew correspondent (Hebrew has only וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם = 'he said to them'). <WAH0413> attaches after 他們, <WH0559><WTH8799> after 說, consistent with UNV pattern.

Gen/42.lcc_original: 約瑟認得他哥哥們，他們卻不認得他。
notes: LCC and UNV are character-for-character identical for this verse; all SNs transfer directly with no alignment decisions required.
{<WAH0853>} retained as implicit — LCC has no explicit direct-object marker word corresponding to Hebrew את (H853).

Gen/42.lcc_original: 約瑟記起從前所作關於他們的夢，就對他們說：『你們是探子，來看這地不設防之情形的。』
notes: LCC 記起 = UNV 想起, both map to WH02142 (זָכַר, to remember); morphology WTH8799 carried over.
First {<WAH0853>} retained: LCC likewise has no explicit accusative particle before the dream clause.
<WAH09001> (ל prefix from לָהֶם) placed on 關於 in the first clause — LCC renders 'to them' as 關於他們的 where UNV uses 的<WAH09001>; 關於 functions as the preposition here.
LCC 探子 = UNV 奸細, both map to WH07270 (רָגַל, spy/scout) as a participle WTH8764.
LCC 看 = UNV 窺探, both map to WH07200 (רָאָה, to see); <WAH09001><WH07200><WTH8800> all attached to 看 as in UNV's attachment to 窺探.
Second {<WAH0853>} retained before 這地: no explicit accusative word in LCC.
LCC 不設防之情形 expands UNV 虛實 (WH06172, עֶרְוָה nakedness/vulnerability); SN attached to 情形 as the head noun.
Final 的 in LCC is a Chinese aspect/nominalization particle with no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated.
Confidence slightly reduced due to ambiguity in anchoring <WAH09001> within 關於他們的 in the first clause.

Gen/42.lcc_original: 他們對他說：『不是的，我主；僕人是買糧食來的。
notes: LCC reverses word order vs UNV: UNV has '我主啊，不是的' but LCC has '不是的，我主' — SNs placed at their respective LCC positions accordingly.
LCC 僕人 (without 們) maps to H05650 (עֶבֶד); singular form covers the same referent.
LCC 買 is a single verb covering UNV's 糴 which carried both the lamed prefix particle <WAH09001> and the root <WH07666><WTH8800> — all three tags attached to 買.
LCC 糧食 (grain/food) maps to H0400 (אֹכֶל); slightly fuller expression than UNV 糧 but same referent.
Chinese copula 是 (between 僕人 and 買) has no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated.

Gen/42.lcc_original: 我們都是一個人的兒子；我們是老實人；僕人不是探子。』
notes: H0587 (אֲנַחְנוּ, 'we') attaches to the second 我們 in LCC rather than to 是 as in UNV — LCC makes the pronoun explicit as a standalone subject, so the SN follows the actual lexical correspondent
LCC 老實 (plain-spoken/honest) renders UNV 誠實 for H03651 (כֵּנִים) — same referent, different register
LCC 不是 split as 不<WAH03808>是<WAH01961><WTH8804> to mirror UNV's 並不|是 split: 不 ← לֹא (H03808), 是 ← הָיוּ (H01961+WTH8804)
LCC 探子 vs UNV 奸細 — different vocabulary, same referent מְרַגְּלִים (H07270+WTH8764)
人 after 老實 left unannotated (Chinese nominal classifier, no Hebrew lexeme)

Gen/42.lcc_sn: 約瑟對他們<WAH0413>說<WH0559><WTH8799>：『不是<WAH03808>；你們一定<WAH03588>是來<WH0935><WTH8804>看<WAH09001><WH07200><WTH8800>這地<WH0776>不設防之情形<WH06172>的。』
Gen/42.lcc_original: 約瑟對他們說：『不是；你們一定是來看這地不設防之情形的。』
notes: UNV {<WAH0413>} is implicit ('to them' unexpressed); LCC makes it explicit as 對他們 — per Rule 3, braces dropped and tag attached after 他們
LCC 來看 merges two Hebrew verbs: בָּאתֶם (WH0935+WTH8804, 'you came') and לִרְאוֹת (WAH09001+WH07200+WTH8800, 'to see/spy'); split 來←came verb, 看←infinitive

LCC 一定 captures the emphatic force of כִּי (WAH03588); UNV uses 必是 for the same word
Copula 是 between 一定 and 來看 left unannotated — Chinese syntactic glue with no Hebrew correspondent

Gen/42.lcc_original: 他們說：『僕人們弟兄十二個；是迦南地一個人的兒子；頂小的現今【1】和我們的父親在一起，還有一個不在了。』
notes: UNV 本是<WAH0587> (H587 = אֲנַחְנוּ, 'we') has no explicit equivalent in LCC; retained as implicit {<WAH0587>} between 僕人們 and 弟兄.

十二人 (UNV) → 十二個 (LCC): different measure words, same SNs WH08147 and WH06240 attached to 十二個.
Footnote marker 【1】 preserved in original LCC position after 現今.

Gen/42.lcc_original: 約瑟對他們說：『我剛纔對你們說「你們是探子」，這話正對呀。
notes: UNV has {<WAH0413>} (אֵל = to) twice as implicit; LCC makes both explicit as 對 (once in 對他們, once in 對你們), so braces are dropped in both occurrences.
LCC restructures UNV's verb-first order 說{<WAH0413>}你們 → 對你們說; SNs are attached to their corresponding LCC words in LCC's order rather than UNV's.
他們 in 對他們說 has no SN — it was implicit in Hebrew and UNV (hence original braces on WAH0413 with no object tag), so 他們 remains unannotated.
WAH0859 (אַתֶּם = you pl.) maps to the 你們 inside 對你們說 (object of the preposition 對), not the 你們 inside the quote 「你們是探子」 — the quote subject is untagged in UNV as well.
LCC 探子 (spies) corresponds to UNV 奸細 — same WH07270 (רָגַל).
LCC 正對 covers UNV 實在不錯; {<WAH01931>} (הוּא) and {<WAH0834>} (אֲשֶׁר) remain implicit since LCC also expresses this without explicit equivalents; placed before trailing particle 呀.

Gen/42.lcc_sn: 我指着法老<WH06547>的性命<WH02416>來起誓，若是<WAH03588><WAH0518>你們頂小<WH06996>的弟弟<WH0251>不到<WAH09001><WH0935><WTH8800>這裏<WAH02008>來，你們就不能<WAH0518>出<WH03318><WTH8799>這地方<WAH04480><WAH02088>：由這一件事<WAH09002><WH02063>就可以把你們試驗出來了<WH0974><WTH8735>。

notes: LCC omits UNV's opening 到 (no SN attached, so no impact).

notes: LCC restructures clause order: UNV ends with 來到…寄居 but LCC opens the speech with it (我們來…是要在這地寄居的); SNs <WH0935><WTH8804> and <WAH09001><WH01481><WTH8800> are placed on 來 and 寄居 respectively at their new positions.

First {<WAH03588>} (implicit כִּי) had braces dropped because LCC supplies the explicit conjunction 因爲; second {<WAH03588>} has no explicit LCC word so braces are retained and placed at the clause boundary before 那裏.
<WAH04994> (נָּא, particle of entreaty) attached to 王, parallel to UNV where it follows 你—both are the addressee of the request.
LCC's 可以供給 is an expansive rendering with no direct Hebrew lexeme; left unannotated.
<WAH0413> placed on 對 (the directional preposition corresponding to אֶל).

Gen/47.lcc_original: 法老對約瑟說：『你父親和你弟兄到你這裏來；
notes: The implicit markers {<WH0559>}{<WTH8799>} have no explicit LCC counterpart between 法老 and 對, so they are retained as implicit.
LCC omits the aspect particle 了 after 來, which has no Hebrew equivalent anyway — SN tags attach to 來 only.
Punctuation differences preserved: LCC uses 『 (not 「) and ；(not ，) — only tags inserted, no text altered.

Gen/47.lcc_original: 埃及地都在你面前；只管叫你父親和你弟兄住在這地最好的區域；他們可以住在歌珊地。你若知道他們中間有能幹的人，要立他們做牧長來看管我所有的牲畜。
notes: UNV has 國中最好的(H4315)地(H776) — LCC inverts this to 這地(H776)最好的(H4315)區域; H776 attached to 這地 and H4315 to 最好的; LCC's 區域 (area/district) is an explicitation with no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated.

UNV uses 看管(H8269) for שָׂרֵי (chiefs/princes); LCC splits this into 牧長(H8269) for the nominal 'chief' and 看管 for the verbal sense. H5921 (עַל = over), implicit in UNV as {<WAH05921>}, is made explicit in LCC via 來看管, so braces dropped: 來看管<WAH05921>.
Three implicit UNV markers made explicit in LCC: {<WAH05921>}→來看管<WAH05921>, {<WAH0834>}→所<WAH0834> (relative marker 所 ≈ אֲשֶׁר), {<WAH09001>}→我<WAH09001> (lamed+1cs suffix לִי expressed as 我).
LCC's 能幹的 (capable/competent) cleanly maps to UNV's 能(H2428=חַיִל valor/capable); both precede 人(H582).

Gen/47.lcc_original: 約瑟領他父親雅各進去、站在法老面前，雅各向法老祝福請安。
notes: WH05975 (עמד, to stand/present) assigned to 站在 rather than 進去; LCC expands UNV's 進到 into two verbs (進去、站在), with 站在 being the direct semantic match for 'stand before'
First WAH0853 (object marker before 他父親雅各) kept as implicit {<WAH0853>} since LCC has no explicit particle there
Second WAH0853 (object marker in 就給法老) mapped to LCC's 向, which serves the same dative/object-introducing function
請安 is LCC's interpretive addition with no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated

Gen/47.lcc_original: 法老問雅各說：『你一生的年日有幾歲了？』
notes: 平生 (UNV) → 一生 (LCC): synonymous expressions for 'whole lifetime'; WH02416 (חַי) attached to 一生
是多少 (UNV) → 有幾 (LCC): both render the interrogative מָה (WH04100) + prefix WAH09003; tags attached after 幾 since that carries the interrogative meaning
歲 (measure word for age) and 了 (aspect particle) have no Hebrew equivalents and are left unannotated

Gen/47.lcc_original: 雅各對法老說：『我寄居在世的年日己有一百三十歲：我一生的年日又少又苦，趕不上我祖宗寄居在世的日子一生的年日。』
notes: UNV 平生<WH02416> → LCC 一生<WH02416>: both render חַי (life/living); straightforward synonym swap.

UNV 不<WAH03808>及<WH05381><WTH8689> → LCC 趕不上: LCC idiom 趕不上 (cannot catch up to) compresses the same Hebrew root נָשַׂג (to attain/reach) with its negation; all three SNs condensed onto the single phrase.

Implicit {<WAH09002>}{<WH03117>} in UNV: WH03117 (יוֹם, days) has an explicit counterpart in LCC's 日子, so braces dropped and attached normally; WAH09002 (conjunction prefix ו-) has no explicit LCC word, kept implicit as {<WAH09002>} placed before 日子.
LCC ending 一生的年日 adds an extra 一生 not present in UNV's SN-tagged structure at that position — left untagged as a LCC stylistic elaboration; 在世<WH02416> retains WH02416 following the UNV pattern.
LCC adds 己有 (already amounts to) before 一百, which has no Hebrew equivalent — left untagged.

Gen/47.lcc_original: 雅各又向法老祝福辭別，就從法老面前退出來了。
notes: WAH0853 (את direct object marker): UNV renders as 給, LCC renders as 向 — both serve as the object-marking preposition before 法老; tag attaches to 向 as its closest Chinese equivalent.

WH01288+WTH8762 (וַיְבָרֶךְ, 'and he blessed'): LCC expands to 祝福辭別, capturing the dual sense of ברך as both blessing and farewell-taking in a departure context. SNs attach to 祝福 (the primary correspondence); 辭別 is left unannotated as a LCC interpretive addition.
WH03318+WTH8799 (וַיֵּצֵא, 'and he went out'): LCC uses 退出來 (withdraw/retreat out) instead of UNV's 出去; SNs attach to the full phrase 退出來了.

Gen/47.lcc_original: 約瑟就照法老所吩咐的叫他父親和弟兄住下，將埃及地、那地最好的區域、蘭塞地、給他們做業產。
notes: LCC restructures UNV's single clause into two sub-clauses: 叫...住下 (settling father and brothers) then 將...給...做業產 (giving land as possession). The Hiphil causative form of ישב (WH03427/WTH8686) is assigned to 住下, with 叫 serving as a Chinese causative particle receiving no SN.
所吩咐的 (LCC) corresponds to 的命 (UNV) for WH06680 (צוה, command); tags placed after the full relative clause 所吩咐的.
LCC's 給 in 給他們做業產 carries WH05414/WTH8799 (נתן, give) rather than 叫, since 給 directly expresses the 'giving' action.
LCC uses 區域 (region/district) where UNV has 地 for the second WH0776 instance in the 'best of the land' phrase — assigned accordingly.
LCC reverses 產業→業產 (common literary Chinese word-order variation); WH0272 assigned to 業產.
{<WAH0853>} kept with braces before 他父親 since LCC has no explicit word for the Hebrew accusative particle אֵת; <WAH0853> after 和 kept unbraced following UNV convention marking the second object.

Gen/47.lcc_sn: 約瑟<WH03130>將食物<WH03899>供養<WH03557><WTH8770>{<WAH0853>}他父親<WH01>和<WAH0853>他弟兄<WH0251>、以及<WAH0853>他父親<WH01>全<WAH03605>家<WH01004>，各照<WAH09001><WH06310>弱小<WH02945>人口的需要。
Gen/47.lcc_original: 約瑟將食物供養他父親和他弟兄、以及他父親全家，各照弱小人口的需要。
Gen/47.unv_sn_reference: 約瑟<WH03130>用糧食<WH03899>奉養<WH03557><WTH8770>{<WAH0853>}他父親<WH01>和<WAH0853>他弟兄<WH0251>，並<WAH0853>他父親<WH01>全<WAH03605>家的眷屬<WH01004>，都是照各家<WH02945>的人口<WAH09001><WH06310>奉養他們。
notes: 將 (Chinese particle introducing object of 供養) left unannotated; no corresponding Hebrew word — אֶת is implicit, so {<WAH0853>} remains braced after 供養
以及 chosen as the attachment point for the second <WAH0853> (וְאֵת), corresponding to UNV's 並<WAH0853>

照<WAH09001><WH06310> covers the entire לְפִי ('according to the mouth of') — UNV splits this across 照 (untagged) and 人口<WAH09001><WH06310>, but LCC's 照 carries the full prepositional meaning so both SNs attach here
弱小<WH02945> maps to הַטָּף (children/little ones) — UNV renders this as 各家 (each family), LCC as 弱小 (the weak/little ones); same referent, different nuance
各 left unannotated — distributive sense is implied in Hebrew, not a standalone lexeme
人口的需要 left unannotated — LCC's elaborative paraphrase; the core SNs for לְפִי הַטָּף are already covered by 照<WAH09001><WH06310> and 弱小<WH02945>
UNV's closing 奉養他們 (second occurrence of the verb, no SN) is absent in LCC — omission consistent with LCC's condensed phrasing

Gen/47.lcc_original: 當時遍地都沒有食物，因爲饑荒非常嚴重；埃及地和迦南地在饑荒之下都餓昏了。
notes: UNV clause order is famine-severity → no food → people fainted; LCC inverts the first two clauses (no food → because famine severe), so SNs were assigned to semantically matching LCC positions rather than linearly.
{<WAH03588>} (כִּי conjunction) is implicit in UNV; LCC has explicit 因爲, so braces dropped and tag attached after 因爲.
全<WAH09002><WAH03605>地<WH0776> (בְּכָל־הָאָרֶץ) consolidates onto LCC 遍地 as a single unit: 遍地<WAH09002><WAH03605><WH0776>.
UNV 因<WAH04480><WH06440>...的緣故 (מִפְּנֵי, 'from before') → LCC 在...之下; SNs attached to 在 as the preposition anchor.
糧<WH03899> (לֶחֶם, bread/food) → LCC 食物; semantically equivalent.

Gen/47.lcc_original: 約瑟收聚了埃及地和迦南地所找得着的銀子，就是衆人買穀子的銀子；約瑟把那銀子帶進法老宮裏。
notes: LCC explicitly renders what UNV had implicit: {WH04672}{WTH8737} (Niphal of מָצָא, 'found') appears as 找得着 in LCC, so braces are dropped and all three tags (WAH03605, WH04672, WTH8737) cluster on 所找得着的 — WAH03605 (כָּל, 'all') has no standalone word in LCC but is subsumed into this phrase
UNV 糴<WH07666><WTH8802> → LCC 買 (same verb meaning); UNV 糧<WAH09002><WH07668> → LCC 穀子 (grain, same referent with ב- prefix tag)
UNV 帶...到法老...宮裡 restructured as LCC 帶進法老宮裏 — the Hiphil directional sense of WH0935 (בּוֹא, bring in) is captured by LCC's 進, so WH0935+WTH8686 attach together to 帶進
{WAH0853} remains implicit in the first clause (LCC has no explicit DO marker there), whereas in the second clause 把 explicitly serves as the DO marker and receives WAH0853 normally

Gen/47.lcc_original: 埃及地和迦南地的銀子都花完了；埃及衆人就來見約瑟說：『給我們食物吧；我們爲甚麼只因銀子用盡了而當着你面前白死呢？』
notes: LCC restructures the speech section significantly: UNV orders [silver spent] → [give us food] → [why die before you], while LCC reorders to [give us food] → [why … because silver spent … die before you]. SNs were reassigned to their semantic equivalents in LCC's word order.
UNV {<WAH03588>} is implicit ki (because) with no UNV surface word; LCC explicitly translates it as 只因, so braces dropped per Rule 3: 只因<WAH03588>.
LCC 食物 (food) maps to UNV 糧食<WH03899> (לחם); tag transferred to 食物.
LCC 白死 = 'die in vain' — 白 is LCC's added nuance with no Hebrew equivalent; SN attached to full phrase 白死<WH04191><WTH8799>.
LCC 當着你面前 = UNV 在你面前 = נגד (<WAH05048>); tag placed after 面前.
Two distinct <WAH09001> usages preserved: (1) לנו 'to us' on first 我們 in the giving clause, (2) למה prefix 'why' on second 我們爲甚麼.

Gen/47.lcc_sn: 約瑟<WH03130>說<WH0559><WTH8799>：『若<WAH0518>是銀子<WH03701>用盡了<WH0656><WTH8804>，儘管把你們的牲畜<WH04735>給<WH03051><WTH8798>我，我就以你們的牲畜<WAH09002><WH04735>爲代價、給<WH05414><WTH8799>你們<WAH09001>食物。』
Gen/47.lcc_original: 約瑟說：『若是銀子用盡了，儘管把你們的牲畜給我，我就以你們的牲畜爲代價、給你們食物。』
Gen/47.unv_sn_reference: 約瑟<WH03130>說<WH0559><WTH8799>：「若<WAH0518>是銀子<WH03701>用盡了<WH0656><WTH8804>，可以把你們的牲畜<WH04735>給<WH03051><WTH8798>我，我就為你們的牲畜<WAH09002><WH04735>給<WH05414><WTH8799>你們<WAH09001>糧食。」
notes: LCC's 儘管 replaces UNV's 可以 — both render the Hiphil imperative sense of H3051 (הָבוּ, 'bring!'); the imperative force is carried by 給<WH03051><WTH8798>, so 儘管 is left unannotated, matching UNV's unannotated 可以

LCC expands the ב prefix (WAH09002) as 以…爲代價 rather than simply 為; the SNs <WAH09002><WH04735> are attached to 牲畜 as the head noun, with 爲代價 serving as LCC's unpacked rendering of the preposition — no extra SN needed
LCC 食物 is synonymous with UNV 糧食; neither carries a SN tag in the source, so 食物 is left unannotated

Gen/47.lcc_original: 於是他們把牲畜帶到約瑟那裏，約瑟就把食物給了他們，換來了馬、羊羣、牛羣和驢。那一年就這樣以他們所有的牲畜爲代價將食物養活他們。
notes: LCC reorders the livestock list (UNV: 牛、羊、驢、馬 → LCC: 馬、羊羣、牛羣、驢); SNs assigned by semantic identity, not position.
{<WAH09001>} kept implicit — it represents the Hebrew prefix לְ in לָהֶם (to them); though LCC has explicit 他們, the prefix particle לְ has no standalone Chinese word so braces are retained.
LCC uses 羊羣/牛羣 (flock/herd + 羣 classifier) where UNV has bare 羊/牛 — same underlying Hebrew צֹאן (WH06629) and בָּקָר (WH01241) with מִקְנֵה (WH04735) prefix.
LCC 帶 (lead/escort) vs UNV 趕 (drive) — both map to hiphil of בּוֹא (WH0935 + WTH8686).
LCC 所有 carries both WAH09002 (בְּ prefix) and WAH03605 (כֹּל = all), matching UNV's 一切的 annotation.

Gen/47.lcc_original: 那一年完了，第二年他們又來見約瑟說：『我們不向我主隱瞞；我們的銀子都花完了，牲畜家獸也都歸了我主了：我們在我主眼前，除了我們的身體和田地之外，一無所剩。
notes: H8552 (שָׁלַם) appears twice: UNV 過去→LCC 完了 (year ending) and UNV 花盡了→LCC 花完了 (silver exhausted); both mapped correctly.
LCC 牲畜家獸 expands UNV's 牲畜 into two explicit words, allowing H4735 (מִקְנֶה, livestock) to attach to 牲畜 and H929 (בְּהֵמָה, beast) to 家獸.

LCC uses 向 (Chinese directional particle) instead of Hebrew מִן (WAH04480 preposition 'from/away from') in 不向我主隱瞞; 向 has no Hebrew equivalent and is left unannotated; WAH04480 attaches to 我主 as the preposition's complement.
{<WAH03588>}{<WAH0518>} (כִּי אִם, 'but/except that') remain implicit in LCC — the clause is introduced by a semicolon without explicit particles.
LCC's trailing 了 in 歸了我主了 is a Chinese aspect/sentence-final particle with no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated.

Gen/47.lcc_sn: 我們<WAH0587>爲甚麼<WAH09001><WAH04100>要連<WAH01571>本身帶<WAH01571>田地<WH0127>都白死<WH04191><WTH8799>在你眼前<WAH09001><WH05869>呢？用食物<WAH09002><WH03899>買<WH07069><WTH8798>我們<WAH0853>和<WAH0853>我們的田地<WH0127>吧，我們<WAH0587>和我們的田地<WH0127>就可以供<WAH01961><WTH8799>法老<WAH09001><WH06547>使用<WH05650>了。給<WH05414><WTH8798>我們種子<WH02233>吧，我們就可以活着<WH02421><WTH8799>，不<WAH03808>至於死<WH04191><WTH8799>，田地<WH0127>也不<WAH03808>至於荒涼<WH03456><WTH8799>了。』
Gen/47.lcc_original: 我們爲甚麼要連本身帶田地都白死在你眼前呢？用食物買我們和我們的田地吧，我們和我們的田地就可以供法老使用了。給我們種子吧，我們就可以活着，不至於死，田地也不至於荒涼了。』
notes: LCC's 連...帶 structure (both...and) maps to the two גַּם (WAH01571) markers in UNV (人{<WAH01571>} and 荒{<WAH01571>}); since LCC has explicit words for both, braces are dropped and tags attach to 連 and 帶 respectively
LCC's 白死: the word 白 (in vain/needlessly) is LCC's interpretive addition with no Hebrew equivalent; SNs for 'die' (WH04191+WTH8799) attach only to 死
hayah (WAH01961+WTH8799) attached to 供 since LCC renders Hebrew 'become servants' as 供法老使用; WH05650 (eved=servants/service) attaches to 使用
LCC's 了 (perfective aspect particles at sentence ends), 要, 都, 就可以, 吧 are Chinese grammatical additions with no Hebrew equivalents and are left unannotated
WAH09001+WH05869 (lamed+eyes = before your eyes) attached to 眼前 as a unit within LCC's 在你眼前 phrase

Gen/47.lcc_original: 於是約瑟爲法老買了埃及所有的田地，這是因爲饑荒很厲害地迫着埃及人，以致埃及人各都賣了自己的田地，那地就都歸了法老。
notes: LCC uses 田地 where UNV uses 地 for the first occurrence — aligned <WH0127> (אֲדָמָה, ground/land) to 田地 there, and <WH07704> (שָׂדֶה, field) to the second 自己的田地, preserving the lexical distinction.

Double כִּי (WAH03588): the first is implicit {<WAH03588>} — kept implicit since LCC's 這是 is an explanatory addition rather than a direct translation of the conjunction; the second 因<WAH03588> maps directly to 因爲<WAH03588>.
LCC restructures the second clause: it repeats 埃及人 before 各 for clarity, but this second 埃及人 has no independent Hebrew referent — <WH0376> (אִישׁ, each man) is attached to 各 only.
{<WAH05921>} (preposition 'upon') kept implicit — LCC renders the sense through the verb-object construction 迫着埃及人 without an explicit preposition.
很厲害地 is LCC's rhetorical intensifier with no SN counterpart; left unannotated.

Gen/47.lcc_original: 至於人民呢，約瑟【1】就叫他們做奴隸【1】，從埃及境內這邊，直到那邊。
notes: LCC follows SP/LXX reading (做奴隸, 'made slaves') rather than MT (歸各城, 'moved to cities'); SNs for UNV 都各歸<WH05674><WTH8689>各城<WAH09001><WH05892> cannot be transferred — no corresponding text in LCC.
{<WH01366>} is implicit in UNV (no explicit Chinese word for 'border/territory'); LCC has explicit 境內, so braces dropped: 境內<WH01366>.
LCC sentence-final particle 呢 and coverb 做 in 做奴隸 are unannotated — no Hebrew equivalent.
Second <WAH0853> (accusative marker) attached after 他們, mirroring UNV pattern 約瑟叫他們<WAH0853>.

Gen/47.lcc_original: 惟有祭司的田地、約瑟沒有買，因爲祭司有從法老發的糧餉；他們喫法老所給的糧餉，所以他們不賣他們的田地。
notes: LCC 田地 (two occurrences) maps to UNV 地 (H0127) — extended term for the same concept, SN placed after 田地 each time.
LCC 糧餉 maps to UNV 常俸 (H02706) in both clauses — straightforward lexical substitution.
LCC 發的 (issued/sent out) aligns structurally with UNV 所得的 (received/obtained); neither carries its own SN in the UNV source, so 發的 is left unannotated and H02706 attaches to 糧餉 as in UNV.
{<WAH09001>} retained as implicit in both occurrences — no lexical counterpart in LCC at those positions.

{<WAH0853>} retained as implicit before 他們的田地: H0853 is the Hebrew definite direct-object marker (אֵת); LCC expresses the possessive with 他們的 (their), which is the pronoun matching 自己的 rather than a lexical rendering of אֵת itself.
LCC 喫 vs UNV 吃 — same word, different character variant; SN attachment unchanged.

Gen/47.lcc_original: 約瑟對人民說：『看哪，我今天替法老買了你們和你們的田地；看哪，這裏有種子給了你們，你們可以種地。
notes: 百姓(H05971)→人民: direct semantic equivalent, same SN retained.
{<WAH02005>} was implicit in UNV (no explicit Chinese word). LCC has an explicit 看哪 at the start of the speech, so braces dropped per Rule 3: 看哪<WAH02005>.

LCC has two explicit 看哪: the first maps to {<WAH02005>} (speech-opening behold), the second maps to UNV's 看哪<WH01887> (mid-verse behold). Different SN roots (H02005 vs H01887) — both correctly render 看哪 in Chinese.
為(WAH09001)→替: 為 is a preposition for/on behalf of; 替 is the LCC equivalent. WAH09001 (inseparable lamed prefix) attached to 替.

地(H0127) appears twice: once as 你們的田地 (possessed agricultural land) and once as 種地 (to till the ground). LCC uses 田地 for the first and 地 for the second, matching UNV's sense. SNs distributed accordingly.
給了你們: 了 is a Chinese aspect particle with no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated. WAH09001 (lamed prefix to/for) attached after 你們.
我 carries no SN in UNV and remains unannotated in LCC.

Gen/47.lcc_original: 到出產的時候，你們要把五分之一給法老，四分可以歸你們自己，做田地裏的種子，做你們和你們家人的食物，做你們那些幼小者的食物。』
notes: UNV 後來<WAH01961><WTH8804> (temporal 'then/when it comes to pass') → LCC 到: 到 captures the temporal-clause function of H1961 (הָיָה); H8393 (תְּבוּאֹת produce) goes onto 出產.
UNV implicit {<WAH09001>}{<WH0400>} (food for you) has no explicit Chinese word in UNV, but LCC's first 食物 is explicit — braces dropped, attached as 食物<WAH09001><WH0400>.
UNV implicit {<WAH09001>}{<WH0398>}{<WTH8800>} (to eat, infinitive construct) → LCC's second explicit 食物 (in the 幼小者 clause) — braces dropped, attached as 食物<WAH09001><WH0398><WTH8800>.

Gen/47.lcc_original: 他們說：『你把我們救活了；我們若在我主面前蒙恩，我們情願給法老做奴隸。』

Gen/47.lcc_original: 於是約瑟爲了埃及的田地立了一個定例、到今日還有效：五分之一給法老；惟獨祭司的田地不歸法老。

LCC 立了 carries <WH07760><WTH8799> on 立; aspect particle 了 is unannotated. Direct object marker {<WAH0853>} retained as implicit since LCC has no explicit word for it.
LCC adds 一個 before 定例 (Chinese numeral classifier) — unannotated; <WAH09001><WH02706> placed after 定例.
LCC uses 到 where UNV has 直到; <WAH05704> attached to 到.
LCC adds 還有效 (still in effect) as an explanatory expansion with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated.
LCC inverts word order: 五分之一給法老 vs. UNV 法老...五分之一; SNs follow LCC order — <WAH09001><WH02569> after 五分之一, <WAH09001><WH06547> after 法老. 給 is a connector added by LCC with no direct SN.

Gen/47.lcc_original: 雅各在埃及地生活了十七年：雅各在世的日子，他一生的歲數是一百四十七歲。
notes: LCC 生活了 covers UNV 住 (H02421+TH8799); aspect particle 了 has no Hebrew equivalent and is left unannotated

在世 is LCC's interpretive addition (no Hebrew counterpart); left unannotated

Gen/47.lcc_original: 以色列死的日期臨近了，他就把他的兒子約瑟叫來，對他說：『我若在你面前蒙恩，請把手放在我大腿下來起誓，要拿忠愛與誠信待我，請不要將我埋葬在埃及。
notes: LCC 面前 maps to UNV 眼前 — both render עֵינַ֙יִם (WH05869, lit. 'eyes') as 'before one's presence'; straightforward semantic equivalent

LCC 誠信 maps to UNV 誠實 — both render אֱמֶת (WH0571, truth/faithfulness); different compound but same Hebrew root
LCC 埋葬 (two-syllable) maps to UNV 葬 (one-syllable) — both render קָבַר (WH06912); SNs attached after full word 埋葬

{<WAH04994>} (נָא particle) kept implicit after 我若 — particle unannotated in both UNV and LCC surface text

Gen/47.unv_sn_reference: 我與<WAH05973>我祖我父<WH01>同睡<WH07901><WTH8804>的時候，你要將我帶出<WH05375><WTH8804>埃及<WAH04480><WH04714>，葬<WH06912><WTH8804>在他們所葬的地方<WAH09002><WH06900>。」約瑟說<WH0559><WTH8799>：「我必<WAH0595>遵著你的命<WAH09003><WH01697>而行<WH06213><WTH8799>。」

Gen/47.lcc_original: 雅各說：『你要向我起誓』；約瑟就向他起誓；於是以色列在牀頭上【2】敬拜上帝。

LCC's 【2】 is a footnote marker replacing UNV's inline gloss 【或譯：扶著杖頭】; preserved in place with no SN impact.

Gen/48.lcc_original: 這些事以後，有人對約瑟說：『看哪，你父親病了』；約瑟就帶着他的兩個兒子瑪拿西和以法蓮一同去見雅各。
notes: WAH01961+WTH8799 (וַיְהִי) kept implicit — LCC has no explicit 'and it came to pass' opener, so braces retained at start

Gen/48.lcc_original: 有人告訴雅各說：『請看，你兒子約瑟來找你來了』；以色列就勉強在牀上坐起來。

Gen/48.lcc_original: 雅各對約瑟說：『全能的上帝在迦南地的路斯向我顯現，給我祝福，
notes: LCC uses 上帝 where UNV uses 神 — both translate אֵל (WH0410); tagged to 上帝 normally (no braces needed since it is explicit).

H06509 (פָּרָה be-fruitful) → UNV 生養, LCC 繁殖; H07235 (רָבָה multiply) → UNV 眾多, LCC 增多 — both tag their respective LCC verbs.

UNV 趁怒 → LCC 氣忿忿; both carry WAH09002+WH0639 (ב+אַף, anger/wrath). The adverbial particle 地 is left unannotated.
命 after 殺人 in UNV is absent in LCC; WH0376 (אִישׁ, man) is attached to 人 directly.

Gen/49.lcc_sn: 他們的忿怒<WH0639>可咒詛<WH0779><WTH8803>，因爲<WAH03588>很猛烈<WH05794>；他們的暴怒<WH05678>可咒詛，因爲<WAH03588>很嚴厲<WH07185><WTH8804>：我必使他們分居<WH02505><WTH8762>於雅各<WAH09002><WH03290>家；使他們散<WH06327><WTH8686>住在以色列<WAH09002><WH03478>。
Gen/49.lcc_original: 他們的忿怒可咒詛，因爲很猛烈；他們的暴怒可咒詛，因爲很嚴厲：我必使他們分居於雅各家；使他們散住在以色列。
notes: LCC restructures clause order relative to UNV but curse verb still precedes the 因爲 clause in both, so alignment is straightforward.
UNV 怒氣 (WH0639, אַף) → LCC 忿怒; UNV 忿恨 (WH05678, עֶבְרָה) → LCC 暴怒. LCC swaps the synonym pair; SNs assigned by semantic/contextual position in each clause.
{<WAH03588>} was implicit in UNV (both occurrences); LCC has explicit 因爲 — braces dropped per Rule 3, attached directly to 因爲.
Second 可咒詛 in LCC left unannotated to mirror UNV's ellipsis (UNV 可詛 carries no SN in the second clause).
WAH09002 (בְּ prefix) attached to 雅各/以色列 as in UNV; the Chinese prepositions 於/在 carry the prepositional meaning but the SN convention follows the Hebrew morpheme boundary.

Gen/49.lcc_sn: 猶大<WH03063>阿，你弟兄們<WH0251>必稱讚<WH03034><WTH8686>【5】你<WAH0859>；你的手<WH03027>必掐住你仇敵<WH0341><WTH8802>的脖子<WAH09002><WH06203>；你父親<WH01>的兒子們<WH01121>必向你<WAH09001>下拜<WH07812><WTH8691>。
Gen/49.lcc_original: 猶大阿，你弟兄們必稱讚【5】你；你的手必掐住你仇敵的脖子；你父親的兒子們必向你下拜。
Gen/49.unv_sn_reference: 猶大<WH03063>啊，你弟兄們<WH0251>必讚美<WH03034><WTH8686>你<WAH0859>；你手<WH03027>必掐住仇敵<WH0341><WTH8802>的頸項<WAH09002><WH06203>；你父親<WH01>的兒子們<WH01121>必向你<WAH09001>下拜<WH07812><WTH8691>。
notes: 讚美 (UNV) → 稱讚 (LCC): both render H03034 (ידה, to praise); <WH03034><WTH8686> attached to 稱讚. 【5】 is a LCC footnote marker preserved in situ between 稱讚 and its object 你.
LCC inserts 的 (你的手 vs UNV 你手): grammatical particle, no Hebrew equivalent; <WH03027> attaches to 手 as in UNV.
LCC adds possessive 你 before 仇敵 (你仇敵): Chinese expansion of Hebrew suffix -ךָ already encoded in <WAH0859>; no new SN needed for the added 你.
掐住 has no direct Hebrew lexeme — Gen 49:8 Hebrew is יָדְךָ בְּעֹרֶף ('your hand at the neck'); 掐住 is a Chinese rendering of the implied action and is left unannotated.
頸項 (UNV) → 脖子 (LCC): different Chinese terms for nape/neck; <WAH09002><WH06203> (בְּ + עֹרֶף) transferred to 脖子.

Gen/49.lcc_original: 猶大是個小獅子；「我兒阿，你抓了所抓到的【6】便上山穴去【6】；」他屈身伏着像公獅、像母獅，誰敢惹他呢？
notes: UNV '食' (prey, WAH04480+WH02964) maps to LCC '所抓到的' — LCC expands the implicit prey noun into a relative clause; SNs attached before the 【6】 footnote marker.
UNV '上去' (WH05927+WTH8804) maps to LCC '上山穴去' — LCC adds '山穴' (mountain cave) as an interpretive expansion; SN attached to the verb phrase before the second 【6】.

UNV '屈下身去' (WH03766+WTH8804) + '臥' (WH07257+WTH8804) map to LCC '屈身伏着' — LCC merges the two parallel verbs (bow + lie) into a single clause; each SN attached to its closest semantic match: 屈身←WH03766, 伏着←WH07257.
UNV '蹲如母獅' has no separate crouching verb in LCC; WH03833 attaches to '像母獅' following the same pattern as '像公獅'.
UNV addresses in second person (你) throughout; LCC shifts to third person (他) in the second stich — no SN conflict since pronouns carry no SN in either text.

Gen/49.lcc_original: 權柄之杖必不離開猶大，指揮之棍必不離開他兩腿【7】之間，直到屬他的那位來到【8】，萬族之民都歸順他。
notes: 圭 (WH07626, שֵׁבֶט scepter) maps to LCC 杖 within 權柄之杖; LCC 棍 in 指揮之棍 receives WH02710 (מְחֹקֵק lawgiver/staff) — two distinct Hebrew words mapped to two distinct LCC nouns despite both being rod-type objects.

WH07886 (שִׁילֹה Shiloh) maps to LCC 屬他的那位 — LCC adopts the alternative pointing שֶׁלּוֹ ('the one to whom it belongs') rather than the proper noun Shiloh; annotation placed after 位 to cover the entire phrase.
直等 (WAH05704 עַד + WH03588 כִּי) merges into LCC 直到 as an inseparable compound; both SNs attached after 到.
Second clause 必不離開 carries no SN tags — UNV likewise leaves 必不 and 離 unannotated in that clause (only WH02710 heads the clause).
萬民 (WH05971) → LCC 萬族之民 (expanded phrase); SN attached after the final character 民.
歸順 (WH03349) is followed by LCC-added pronoun 他 which has no Hebrew equivalent and is left unannotated.
{<WAH09001>} kept implicit — the waw-conjunctive has no explicit LCC character before 萬族.

Gen/49.lcc_sn: 猶大把驢駒<WH05895>拴<WH0631><WTH8802>在葡萄樹<WAH09001><WH01612>旁，把母驢<WH0860>的崽子<WH01121>拴在上好的葡萄樹<WAH09001><WH08321>旁；他在酒<WAH09002><WH03196>中洗淨<WH03526><WTH8765>服裝<WH03830>，在血紅<WAH09002><WH01818>葡萄<WH06025>汁中洗了袍褂<WH05497>：
Gen/49.lcc_original: 猶大把驢駒拴在葡萄樹旁，把母驢的崽子拴在上好的葡萄樹旁；他在酒中洗淨服裝，在血紅葡萄汁中洗了袍褂：
Gen/49.unv_sn_reference: 猶大把小驢<WH05895>拴<WH0631><WTH8802>在葡萄樹<WAH09001><WH01612>上，把驢<WH0860>駒<WH01121>拴在美好的葡萄樹<WAH09001><WH08321>上。他在葡萄酒<WAH09002><WH03196>中洗了<WH03526><WTH8765>衣服<WH03830>，在葡萄<WH06025>汁中<WAH09002><WH01818>洗了袍褂<WH05497>。
notes: LCC first-clause '驢駒' maps to UNV '小驢' (WH05895, עִיר = young donkey), not to UNV's second-clause '驢駒'; LCC second-clause '母驢的崽子' maps to UNV '驢<WH0860>駒<WH01121>' (אָתוֹן + בֵּן). The '的' possessive particle between 母驢 and 崽子 is left unannotated.

LCC '血紅' (blood-red adjective) stands in for Hebrew דָּם (WH01818 = blood) + ב prefix (WAH09002). LCC chose an adjectival rendering rather than the noun '血/血液', so WAH09002+WH01818 are attached to '血紅' as the closest lexical equivalent.
Second '拴' (second clause) and second '洗了' carry no SN tags, mirroring UNV where the verb tags are not repeated in the parallel clause.
LCC '旁' (beside) vs UNV '上' (upon) — different preposition choice for the same Hebrew לַ- (WAH09001); WAH09001 is attached to '葡萄樹' in both clauses as in UNV.
LCC '上好的葡萄樹' covers UNV '美好的葡萄樹' (WH08321 שֹׂרֵקָה = choice/noble vine); the adjective '上好的' is part of the nominal phrase and left unannotated, with the SN attached to the head noun '葡萄樹'.

Gen/49.lcc_sn: 他的眼睛<WH05869>必因酒<WAH04480><WH03196>而發昏<WH02447>，他的牙齒<WH08127>必因奶子<WAH04480><WH02461>而白亮<WH03836>。
Gen/49.lcc_original: 他的眼睛必因酒而發昏，他的牙齒必因奶子而白亮。
notes: WH02447 (חַכְלִילִי): UNV renders as 紅潤 (sparkling/ruddy), LCC renders as 發昏 (dim/darkened) — opposite surface meanings but both translate the same ambiguous Hebrew root; attached to 發昏 as the LCC equivalent.
WH02461 (חָלָב): LCC uses 奶子 vs UNV 奶 — both mean milk; SNs attached to full word 奶子.
LCC's connective particle 而 is left unannotated (no Hebrew equivalent; Chinese grammatical filler).

Gen/49.lcc_original: 西布倫必在沿海地帶居住，他必成爲停船之地帶，他的極邊必延到西頓。
notes: LCC restructures the first clause with verb moved to clause-final position; 居住 receives H7931+8799, 沿海 receives H3220, 地帶 receives the H2348 compound (WAH09001+WH02348) — matching UNV's 海口 split across two characters.
UNV repeats 海口<WAH09001><WH02348> twice (once for 'haven', once for 'haven of ships'); LCC mirrors this with 地帶 appearing twice — both receive the same WAH09001+WH02348 tags.
WAH01931 (וְהוּא, 'and he') is attached to LCC's explicit pronoun 他, which renders the implicit Hebrew pronoun that UNV absorbs into 必成為.
LCC uses a comma where UNV uses a semicolon — LCC punctuation preserved as-is.

Gen/49.lcc_original: 以薩迦是骨格粗大之驢，躺在羊圈之間；
notes: WH01634 (גֶּרֶם, 'bone/strong') — UNV renders as 強壯 (strong), LCC renders as 骨格粗大 (large-boned); semantically the same root; tag attached to 骨格粗大 as the covering phrase
WH07257 (רָבַץ, 'lie down') with morphology WTH8802 both attached to 躺在, which directly corresponds to UNV's 臥在
WAH0996 (בֵּין, 'between/among') — UNV uses 之中, LCC uses 之間; same syntactic slot, tag transferred to 之間

Gen/49.lcc_original: 他看安居爲美好，以土地爲可喜悅，便屈肩背重，成了苦工奴隸。
notes: UNV '以<WH07200>' uses an idiomatic '以…為' construction (consider/regard); LCC makes this explicit with verb '看' — a cleaner one-to-one match for H7200 (ראה, to see/regard). SNs attach directly after '看'.
UNV '佳<WH02896>' (H2896 טוֹב) rendered as LCC '美好' (one two-character word); both SNs map to '美好' as a single phrase covering that Hebrew root.
UNV '美<WH05276>' (H5276 נָעֵם, to be pleasant) rendered as LCC '可喜悅'; both morphology and core SN attach after '悅'.
UNV '低<WH05186>' (H5186 נָטָה, to incline/bow) rendered as LCC '屈' — direct synonym; SNs attach after '屈'.
UNV '服苦<WAH09001><WH04522>' (H4522 מַס, tribute/forced labor) maps to LCC '苦工'; '奴隸' covers UNV '的僕人<WH05647><WTH8802>' (H5647 עָבַד, to serve/labor).
WAH09001 (ל preposition prefix) preserved in both '背重' and '苦工' positions, matching UNV.

Gen/49.lcc_original: 但必爲他人民伸權利、做以色列一個族派。
notes: UNV 判斷<WH01777><WTH8799> (shall judge) is rendered in LCC as 伸權利 (vindicate/plead rights); SNs attached to 伸權利 as the semantic equivalent verb.
UNV word order: 支派<WH07626>之一<WAH09003><WH0259> — LCC inverts to 一個族派; <WAH09003><WH0259> attached to 一個, <WH07626> to 族派.
UNV 他的民 → LCC 人民 (dropped possessive pronoun, absorbed into prepositional phrase 爲他); <WH05971> attaches to 人民.

Gen/49.lcc_original: 但必做道路上的蛇，路徑上的角蛇，咬傷馬的腳後跟，以致騎馬的向後墜落。
notes: UNV 道上 → LCC 道路上: WH01870 (דֶּרֶךְ, way/road) attaches to expanded 道路; WAH05921 (עַל, upon) attaches to 上
UNV 路中 → LCC 路徑上: WH0734 (אֹרַח, path) attaches to expanded 路徑; WAH05921 attaches to 上 (LCC uses 上 instead of 中 for the same preposition)
UNV 虺 → LCC 角蛇: both render שְׁפִיפֹן (WH08207), the horned viper; SN attaches to 角蛇
UNV 蹄 (WH06119) → LCC 腳後跟: WH06119 is עָקֵב meaning heel; LCC renders it as 腳後跟 (heel) rather than hoof — semantically accurate and the SN is clear
UNV 使騎馬的 → LCC 以致騎馬的: 以致 is LCC's connecting phrase with no Hebrew equivalent; WH07392 (רָכַב, to ride) attaches to 騎馬的
UNV 於後 → LCC 向後: both render WH0268 (אָחוֹר, backward); SN attaches to 向後

Gen/49.lcc_sn: 永恆主<WH03068>阿，我向來切候<WH06960><WTH8765>着你的拯救<WAH09001><WH03444>。
Gen/49.lcc_original: 永恆主阿，我向來切候着你的拯救。
Gen/49.unv_sn_reference: 耶和華<WH03068>啊，我向來等候<WH06960><WTH8765>你的救恩<WAH09001><WH03444>。
notes: 耶和華 (WH03068) → 永恆主: LCC's standard rendering of the Tetragrammaton; tag attached to full phrase 永恆主.
等候 (WH06960 + WTH8765) → 切候: LCC adds aspect particle 着 with no Hebrew equivalent; SN tags attach to the verb 切候, leaving 着 unannotated.
救恩 (WAH09001 + WH03444) → 拯救: straightforward semantic equivalent; both SNs attach to 拯救.

Gen/49.lcc_sn: 論迦得<WH01410>，一羣追逼者<WH01416>必追逼<WH01464><WTH8799>他，但他<WAH01931>必追逼<WH01464><WTH8799>【9】他們的腳跟<WH06119>。
Gen/49.lcc_original: 論迦得，一羣追逼者必追逼他，但他必追逼【9】他們的腳跟。
notes: LCC adds the particle 論 ('concerning') before 迦得; 迦得 itself receives H01410 as the proper noun.

Hebrew גְּדוּד (H01416, 'troop/band') is rendered by LCC as 一羣追逼者 ('a band of raiders') — the nominal 追逼者 is LCC's expansion of the troop concept, not a separate verb; H01416 attaches to the full phrase.
The first verb יְגוּדֶנּוּ (H01464+WTH8799, 'shall press upon him') maps to 必追逼 with 他 as the object suffix, placed after 追逼.
וְהוּא (WAH01931, 'and he') maps to LCC 他 in 但他; the conjunction 但 is LCC's rendering of וְ and needs no separate tag.
The footnote marker 【9】 is preserved in situ between the second verb and its object, as required.

Gen/49.lcc_original: 論亞設【9】，他的食物必定肥甘；他必豫備出君王爽口之物。
notes: LCC reverses the Hebrew/UNV order of שְׁמֵנָה (肥甘) and לַחְמוֹ (食物); SN tags follow LCC word order accordingly
LCC's opening 論 (concerning) has no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated
SN tags placed immediately after 亞設 and before footnote marker 【9】 to stay adjacent to the annotated word
LCC's modal intensifiers 必定 and 必 are translation additions with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated
LCC's 豫備出 (prepare and bring forth) is an elaboration of יִתֵּן (give); both WH05414 and WTH8799 attach to 豫備出 as a unit
爽口之物 (mouth-pleasing things) maps cleanly to מַעֲדַנֵּי (WH04574 = dainties)

Gen/49.lcc_original: 拿弗他利是【10】枝幹伸展的篤耨香樹，他伸出美麗的樹頂【10】。
Gen/49.unv_sn_reference: 拿弗他利<WH05321>是被釋放<WH07971><WTH8803>的母鹿<WH0355>；他出<WH05414><WTH8802>嘉美<WH08233>的言語<WH0561>。
notes: LCC abandons the doe metaphor entirely and substitutes a tree metaphor (terebinth/mastic tree with spreading branches); SN alignment follows semantic correspondence of the underlying Hebrew roots rather than surface lexical match.
H7971 (שׁלח, 'spread/set free') → 伸展 (spread/extend); the Pual morphology WTH8803 attaches here. 枝幹 (branches) is Lü's elaboration with no Hebrew equivalent and is left unannotated.
H355 (אַיָּלָה, doe/hind) → 篤耨香樹 (terebinth tree); Lü's interpretive rendering of the noun.
H5414 (נתן, 'give/put forth') → 伸出; WTH8802 (Qal participle) attaches to the same word.
H561 (אֵמֶר, 'words/sayings') → 樹頂 (treetops); Lü sustains the tree metaphor where UNV has 言語, creating a significant lexical divergence.
【10】 footnote markers are left in place and unannotated.

Gen/49.lcc_original: 約瑟是母牛的崽子，在水泉旁的母牛崽子；他的女兒踏步在書珥曠野【11】。
notes: H6509 (פרה): LCC reads as 母牛 (cow/heifer) rather than UNV's 多結果 (fruitful) — a competing lexical interpretation of the same root; WTH8802 (qal ptcp) attaches to 母牛 in both occurrences.
H1121 (בן): LCC uses 崽子 (young one/cub) where UNV uses 樹枝/枝子 (branch) — both are valid polysemy readings of בֵּן.
H7791 (שׁור): LCC reads as the place name 書珥曠野 (Wilderness of Shur) rather than UNV's 牆 (wall); both renderings are attested in scholarship. The entire phrase 書珥曠野 receives the single tag.
WAH05921 (עַל with prefix): first instance maps to 旁 (beside the spring); second instance maps to 在 (over/at Shur).
H5869 (עַיִן): LCC expands to 水泉 (water-spring) — 水 is a clarifying addition with no separate SN; tag placed after the compound unit.
H1323 (בַּת): LCC renders as 女兒 (daughters), matching the literal meaning; UNV used 枝條 (branches) as a botanical metaphor.

Gen/49.lcc_original: 弓箭手苦害他，向他射箭，懷恨逼迫他。
notes: 弓箭手 is a single compound in LCC covering both H2671 (弓箭/arrows) and H1167 (手/master-of = archer); both SNs attach after the compound per rule 6.
LCC reorders 將他苦害 → 苦害他; H4843+WTH8762 attach after 苦害 as the main verb.
LCC adds 懷恨 before 逼迫他 to render the full semantic range of H7852 (שָׂטַם = bear animosity/be hostile); attached H7852+WTH8799 after 逼迫 as the primary verb of that clause.
LCC drops the auxiliary 將 with no SN equivalent — correctly left unannotated.

Gen/49.lcc_original: 但他的弓仍然堅硬，他的手臂強健敏捷，這是因着雅各之大能者的手；（【12】以色列的牧者、以色列的石頭是從那裏而出的【12】，）
notes: LCC 手臂 consolidates two Hebrew words — WH02220 (זְרֹעֵי, arms) and WH03027 (יָדָיו, hands) — into one noun; both SNs attached together.

Hebrew מִידֵי (from the hands of) = WAH04480 + WH03027. LCC splits this across '因着<WAH04480>…的手<WH03027>' rather than one word as in UNV '就是'. WAH04480 attached to 因着 (the from/by means of sense) and WH03027 to 手.
LCC restructures the second clause as a parenthetical ('是從那裏而出的') inverting Hebrew word order. מִשָּׁם (WAH04480+WAH08033) maps to '從那裏'; placed after 石頭 rather than before 牧者 as in UNV.
UNV 磐石 → LCC 石頭: different Chinese words for אֶבֶן (WH068); SN placed after 石頭.
First occurrence of 以色列 (before 牧者) carries no SN per UNV convention — Hebrew יִשְׂרָאֵל appears only once in the source; WH03478 assigned to the second 以色列 (before 石頭) as in UNV.

Gen/49.lcc_sn: 因着你父親<WH01>的上帝<WAH04480><WH0410>──他必幫助你<WH05826><WTH8799>，{<WH0854>}因着全能的上帝<WH07706>──他必賜福與你：必將上面<WAH04480><WH05920>來的天<WH08064>福<WH01293>，將伏<WH07257><WTH8802>於地底下<WAH08478>的淵泉<WH08415>之福<WH01293>，將胸哺<WH07699>胎生<WH07356>之福<WH01293>、都賜給你<WH01288><WTH8762>。
Gen/49.lcc_original: 因着你父親的上帝──他必幫助你，因着全能的上帝──他必賜福與你：必將上面來的天福，將伏於地底下的淵泉之福，將胸哺胎生之福、都賜給你。
notes: UNV uses 神 while LCC uses 上帝 systematically; WAH04480+WH0410 attached to 上帝 in both clauses.

LCC adds an anticipatory clause 他必賜福與你 before the blessing list, which has no direct UNV counterpart. WH01288+WTH8762 (וִיבָרֲכֶךָּ = will bless you) is attached to 都賜給你 at the end, matching UNV's structural placement of the verb after the blessing list.
{<WH0854>} (וְאֵת connective/direct-object particle) is implicit in both UNV and LCC; placed as a floating tag at the clause boundary before 因着全能的上帝.
LCC reverses the order of breast and womb relative to UNV (胸哺 before 胎生 vs. UNV's 生產 before 乳養); SNs assigned by semantic match: 胸哺<WH07699> (שָׁדַיִם = breasts), 胎生<WH07356> (רָחַם = womb).
地底下<WAH08478> covers תַּחַת (under/beneath); 淵泉<WH08415> covers תְּהוֹם (deep/abyss). LCC's 伏<WH07257><WTH8802> = רֹבֶצֶת (crouching) aligns well.

Gen/50.lcc_original: 他們到了約但河東邊，亞達的禾場，就在那裏舉哀，大大的非常傷痛的舉哀：約瑟爲他父親舉行了哀悼七天。
notes: LCC renders the Hebrew cognate accusative (וַיִּסְפְּדוּ מִסְפֵּד) as two instances of 舉哀; first 舉哀 receives the verb tag <WH05594><WTH8799>, second receives the nominal tag <WH04553>, with adjectives 大大/非常/傷痛 mapped between them
LCC 東邊 (east side) maps to UNV 外 (outside/beyond), both rendering Hebrew בְּעֵבֶר (across/beyond Jordan)
LCC 舉行 explicitly renders the implicit {<WH06213>}{<WTH8799>} in UNV — braces dropped per Rule 3
{<WAH0834>} kept with braces: LCC uses a comma rather than an explicit relative pronoun

Gen/50.lcc_original: 那地的居民、迦南人、見亞達禾場上的哀悼，就說：『這是給埃及人所行的一場傷痛的哀悼』；因此那地方名叫亞伯麥西，是在約但河東邊。
notes: UNV {<WH0776>} is implicit (no explicit Chinese word); LCC has explicit 那地, so braces dropped and H0776 attached: 那地<WH0776>.
Word order reversed: UNV leads with 迦南<WH03669>...居民<WH03427>, LCC leads with 那地的居民...迦南人; SNs distributed accordingly.
LCC expands UNV '埃及人' to '給埃及人所行的'; SNs WAH09001+WH04714 attached to 埃及人, with surrounding LCC syntax left unannotated.
LCC '傷痛' (painful/grievous) maps to H3515 (כָּבֵד, heavy/grievous) in place of UNV '極大的'.
LCC '東邊' (east side) is the natural expansion of UNV '東' for H5676 (עֵבֶר, beyond); both SNs WAH09002+WH05676 appended after 東邊.

Gen/50.lcc_sn: 雅各的兒子們<WH01121>是這樣<WAH03651>照<WAH09003><WAH0834>他所吩咐<WH06680><WTH8765>的給他<WAH09001>辦了<WH06213><WTH8799>。
Gen/50.lcc_original: 雅各的兒子們是這樣照他所吩咐的給他辦了。
Gen/50.unv_sn_reference: 雅各的兒子們<WH01121>就遵<WAH03651>著<WAH09003><WAH0834>他父親所吩咐<WH06680><WTH8765>的辦了<WH06213><WTH8799>{<WAH09001>}，
notes: Hebrew word order: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ בָנָיו לוֹ כֵּן כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּם. UNV reorders to SVO; LCC also reorders but differently from UNV.
是這樣 ← כֵּן (WAH03651): LCC uses 是這樣 where UNV uses 就遵; both render 'thus/so'. Tag attaches after 這樣.
照 ← כַּאֲשֶׁר (WAH09003 + WAH0834): LCC 照 compresses the כְּ prefix + אֲשֶׁר relative particle into a single preposition; both SNs attach to it.
給他 ← לוֹ (WAH09001): UNV has {<WAH09001>} (implicit), but LCC has explicit 給他. Per Rule 3, braces dropped and tag attached after 他.
UNV has 他父親 (his father) while LCC shortens to 他; WH06680 still attaches to 吩咐 as both refer to Jacob's command.

Gen/50.lcc_original: 兒子們把他運到迦南地，將他埋葬在麥比拉田地間的洞裏；那洞和田地是亞伯拉罕向赫人以弗崙買來做業產爲墳地的；是在幔利東面。
notes: UNV {<WH01121>} was implicit (no explicit 'sons'), but LCC has explicit 兒子們 → braces dropped, tag attached normally.
UNV's second {<WAH0853>} (implicit object marker before 葬) → LCC has explicit 將他 → braces dropped, tag attached to 將他.
LCC reorders the 幔利 clause: UNV places 在幔利前 before 麥比拉, while LCC moves it to the end as 是在幔利東面. SNs for WAH05921, WH04471, WH06440 distributed to that final clause accordingly.
UNV 為業<WAH09001><WH0272>，作墳地<WH06913> → LCC 做業產<WAH09001><WH0272>爲墳地<WH06913>: 做業產 absorbs WAH09001+WH0272, 爲墳地 absorbs WH06913.
LCC combines 田 and 地 into the compound 田地 in both occurrences (burial location and purchase clause); WH07704 assigned to 田地 each time.
WAH09002 (ב prefix) left on 洞裏 following UNV convention; the preceding Chinese 在 is unannotated as it serves as a readability locative, not a separate Hebrew token.

Gen/50.lcc_sn: 約瑟<WH03130>埋葬了<WAH09001><WH06912><WTH8800>{<WAH0853>}他父親<WH01>以後<WH0310>，就回<WH07725><WTH8799>埃及<WH04714>去，他<WAH01931>和他的弟兄<WH0251>跟一切<WAH03605>同他<WAH0854>上去<WH05927><WTH8802>埋葬<WH06912><WTH8800>{<WAH0853>}他父親<WH01>的人都回去。
Gen/50.lcc_original: 約瑟埋葬了他父親以後，就回埃及去，他和他的弟兄跟一切同他上去埋葬他父親的人都回去。
notes: <WAH01931> (הוּא, 'he') attached to the explicit pronoun 他 in '他和他的弟兄' rather than 就, because LCC makes the subject pronoun explicit where UNV uses 就 as a discourse connector

<WH07725><WTH8799> (וַיָּשָׁב, returned) attached to the first 回 in 就回埃及去 as the main predicate; the resumptive 都回去 at sentence-end is LCC's syntactic device to close the long parenthetical list and has no direct Hebrew counterpart, so it is left unannotated
LCC's 埋葬 (two-character compound) covers both the <WAH09001> waw-consecutive prefix and the root <WH06912> in both occurrences, matching the same attachment pattern as UNV's 葬了/<WH06912>
Both occurrences of 他父親 receive <WH01> (אָבִיו), consistent with UNV which tags both mentions identically

Gen/50.lcc_original: 約瑟的哥哥們見他們父親死了，就說：『或者約瑟會懷恨我們，照我們從前向他行的一切壞事、足足地報復我們。』
notes: LCC 他們 (before 父親) is a LCC addition not in UNV — left unannotated; 父親 takes <WH01> as normal
{<WAH03588>} (כִּי, 'that') kept implicit — LCC has no explicit conjunction word between 見 and 父親
LCC 會 is a modal aspect marker added by LCC with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated
UNV 照著 → LCC 照: 著 dropped, <WAH0834> attaches to 照
UNV 待他 → LCC 向他行: verb shifts from 待 to 行; 行 takes <WH01580><WTH8804>, 他 takes <WAH0853>; second {<WAH0853>} (direct object marker) kept implicit
UNV 惡 → LCC 壞事: synonymous rephrasing; 壞事 takes <WH07451>
Infinitive absolute construction (WH07725 × 2): 足足地 takes <WH07725><WTH8687>, 報復 takes <WH07725><WTH8686>, preserved as in UNV

Gen/50.lcc_original: 他們就吩咐人去見約瑟說：『你父親未死以前曾吩咐說：
notes: UNV 打發人 (send someone) → LCC 吩咐人 (instruct someone): both map to WH06680 (צוה, to command/charge); LCC's rendering is semantically closer to the Hebrew root than UNV's 打發
UNV 以先 → LCC 以前 (both = 'before'): mapped to <WAH09001><WH06440> (לִפְנֵי)
LCC adds 曾 (perfective aspect particle) before the second 吩咐 — Chinese grammatical particle with no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated

Gen/50.lcc_original: 「你們要對約瑟這樣說：從前你哥哥們以惡待你；懇求你饒恕他們的過犯和罪惡」：如今求你饒恕你父親的上帝之僕人的過犯。』他們對約瑟說話的時候，約瑟哭了。
notes: 神(WH0430) → 上帝: classic UNV/LCC lexical difference; SN attaches to 上帝 without braces since LCC has an explicit word.
UNV '惡待你' split as 惡<WH07451>+待你<WH01580>; LCC '以惡待你' restructures with 以 as an untagged particle, 惡 and 待你 retain their respective SNs.
UNV '求<WH0577>你<WAH04994>' → LCC '懇求你': 懇 is LCC's intensifier with no Hebrew root; WH0577(אָנָּא) attaches to 懇求 as the closest lexical match, WAH04994(נָּא) remains on 你.
Second instance '求你<WAH04994>' has no WH0577 in UNV and LCC likewise drops 懇, consistent.
UNV '說這話<WAH09002><WH01696><WTH8763>' → LCC '說話的時候': SNs attach to 說話; 的時候 is LCC's temporal expansion with no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated.
{<WAH03588>} kept implicit: LCC has no explicit conjunction between 說 and 從前, same as UNV.
Punctuation follows LCC exactly (」: vs UNV's 。』) with no SN adjustment needed.

Gen/50.lcc_original: 他的哥哥們又來伏在他面前說：『看哪，我們是你的奴僕。』
notes: UNV 俯伏 → LCC 伏 (single character); WH05307+WTH8799 attached to 伏
UNV {<WAH02009>} is implicit (no explicit 看哪 in UNV), but LCC has 看哪 explicitly; braces dropped and tag attached after 哪
UNV 僕人 → LCC 奴僕 (synonymous); WH05650 attached to 奴僕

Gen/50.lcc_original: 約瑟對他們說：『不要害怕；我哪能代替上帝呢？
notes: 哪 (LCC) ↔ 豈 (UNV) — both serve as the rhetorical interrogative particle; WAH03588 (כִּי) attached to 哪
上帝 (LCC) ↔ 神 (UNV) — systematic Elohim rendering difference; WH0430 attached directly (explicit word, no braces)
LCC punctuation preserved: semicolon ；after 害怕 (vs. UNV comma ，), and 『』quotes (vs. UNV 「」)

Gen/50.lcc_original: 在你們，你們從前所圖謀的原是要加害於我，但上帝所圖謀的卻很好，就是爲要成就像今天這樣、叫許多人得以存活。
notes: LCC's doubled construction '在你們，你們' renders the emphatic Hebrew pronoun אַתֶּם (H0859); tag attached to the topicalized first 你們 since it directly represents the Hebrew pronoun.
神(UNV)→上帝(LCC): systematic divine-name difference; H0430 transferred normally to 上帝.
Word order diverges sharply in the final clause: UNV order is 保全→許多人→性命→成就→今日, while LCC follows Hebrew order more closely (成就→今天→叫許多人→存活); SNs redistributed to match LCC word positions.
LCC '像今天這樣' renders כַּיּוֹם הַזֶּה: 今<WAH02088> (=זֶה, this) and 天<WAH09003><WH03117> (=כַּ+יּוֹם); 像 and 這樣 left unannotated as Chinese comparative framing with no independent Hebrew lexeme.

H02421+H00 assigned to causative 叫 (Hiphil causative force of לְהַחֲיֹת), and H09001+H02421+WTH8687 to 存活 — mirrors UNV's split of 保全<WH02421><WH00> / 性命<WAH09001><WH02421><WTH8687> for the single Hebrew root חָיָה.

Gen/50.lcc_sn: 現在<WAH06258>你們不要<WAH0408>害怕<WH03372><WTH8799>；我必定<WAH0595>供養<WH03557><WTH8770>你們<WAH0853>和<WAH0853>你們那些弱小的<WH02945>。』於是約瑟安慰<WH05162><WTH8762>他們<WAH0853>，和他們談<WAH05921><WH01696><WTH8762>心<WH03820>。
Gen/50.lcc_original: 現在你們不要害怕；我必定供養你們和你們那些弱小的。』於是約瑟安慰他們，和他們談心。
Gen/50.unv_sn_reference: 現在<WAH06258>你們不要<WAH0408>害怕<WH03372><WTH8799>，我必<WAH0595>養活<WH03557><WTH8770>你們<WAH0853>和<WAH0853>你們的婦人孩子<WH02945>。」於是約瑟用<WAH05921>親愛<WH03820>的話<WH01696><WTH8762>安慰<WH05162><WTH8762>他們<WAH0853>。
notes: 養活(WH03557 כּוּל)→供養: direct semantic match for 'sustain/nourish'.
婦人孩子(WH02945 טַף 'little ones')→弱小的: LCC paraphrases the referent but maps to the same Hebrew word.

Second clause restructured: UNV '用親愛的話安慰他們' vs LCC '安慰他們，和他們談心'. Hebrew is וַיְנַחֵם אֹתָם וַיְדַבֵּר עַל-לִבָּם ('comforted them and spoke to their hearts'). 安慰←WH05162/WTH8762, 他們←WAH0853, 談←WAH05921+WH01696/WTH8762 ('speak upon'), 心←WH03820 (לֵב 'heart').
The resumptive '和他們' in LCC's 談心 clause is LCC's idiomatic expansion with no Hebrew counterpart; left unannotated.
Confidence reduced due to the idiom 用親愛的話 (UNV) vs 談心 (LCC) requiring token-splitting across the compound 談心.

Gen/50.lcc_original: 約瑟就住在埃及，他和他父親的家都住下。約瑟活了一百一十歲。
notes: LCC splits the Hebrew single-clause וַיֵּשֶׁב יוֹסֵף בְּמִצְרַיִם הוּא וּבֵית אָבִיו into two parallel clauses: 約瑟就住在埃及 + 他和他父親的家都住下. <WH03427><WTH8799> and 在埃及<WAH09002><WH04714> assigned to the first clause's 住; the second 都住下 is LCC's stylistic restatement of the same verb and is left unannotated.
{<WAH01931>} was implicit (braces) in UNV, but LCC has explicit 他 — per Rule 3, braces dropped and SN attached directly: 他<WAH01931>.
眷屬<WH01004> (UNV) → 家<WH01004> (LCC); both render בַּיִת (house/household).

Gen/50.lcc_original: 約瑟見了以法蓮系的第三代子孫【4】；瑪拿西的兒子瑪吉的兒子們也是養在約瑟膝上的。
notes: LCC 見了: tag placed after 見 (semantic verb), not after aspect particle 了, which has no Hebrew equivalent.
LCC adds 系的 ('lineage/line') between 以法蓮 and 第三 — no Hebrew counterpart; left unannotated.
UNV 孫子 (grandson) and 兒子 (son) both render the same Hebrew בֵּן <WH01121>. LCC uses 兒子 for the first occurrence where UNV says 孫子 — aligned to the same SN as both map to בֵּן.
LCC 兒子們: 們 is a Chinese plural marker with no Hebrew equivalent; SN attached to the full phrase.
LCC 是 (copula linking 也是養) is a Chinese addition with no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated.
LCC 的 (possessive) after 膝 is dropped compared to UNV; 膝<WH01290> stands alone before 上的 — tag placed after 膝.
LCC 【4】 footnote marker preserved in place.

Gen/50.lcc_original: 約瑟對他弟兄們說：『我快要死了；但上帝必定眷顧你們，領你們從這地上去、到他所起誓應許給亞伯拉罕、以撒、雅各的地。』
notes: UNV 神<WH0430> → LCC 上帝<WH0430>: systematic UNV/LCC difference for אֱלֹהִים; SN attached to 上帝 as explicit equivalent.
UNV 看顧<WH06485><WTH8799> → LCC 眷顧<WH06485><WTH8799>: different Chinese gloss for the same Hebrew root פָּקַד; infinitive absolute 必定<WH06485><WTH8800> preserved in both.
LCC adds 快 before 要死了 as a degree/aspect adverb with no Hebrew equivalent; <WH04191><WTH8801> attached after 死了.
UNV word order 起誓<WH07650><WTH8738>所<WAH0834> inverted in LCC to 所<WAH0834>起誓<WH07650><WTH8738> (standard 所+V relative clause construction); SNs follow their respective words.
LCC 的地 vs UNV 之地 for the final <WH0776>: both are the same semantic word, SN attached normally.

Gen/50.lcc_original: 約瑟叫以色列的子孫起誓、就說：『上帝必定眷顧你們；你們要把我的骸骨從這裏搬上去。』
notes: UNV 神<WH0430> → LCC 上帝: LCC uses an explicit word for H0430 (Elohim); braces dropped, tag attached normally.
UNV 看顧 → LCC 眷顧: both translate פקד (H06485 Qal imperfect, WTH8799); tag transferred to 眷顧.
LCC inserts 就 before 說 as a Chinese connective particle with no Hebrew equivalent; 就 left unannotated, all three tags (WAH09001, WH0559, WTH8800) attach to 說.
WAH0853 (direct object marker את) before 骸骨 attaches to 把 in LCC's 把-construction, mirroring UNV placement.

Gen/50.lcc_original: 約瑟死了，正一百一十歲：人用香料灌他的屍體，放在木乃伊棺材裏，停在埃及。
notes: UNV '將他<WAH0853>薰了<WH02590><WTH8799>' → LCC '灌<WH02590><WTH8799>他的屍體<WAH0853>': verb and object reordered; <WTH8799> attached to verb 灌, accusative marker <WAH0853> placed after the explicit object phrase 屍體.
UNV '收殮<WH03455>' (lay/put in) → LCC '放<WH03455>': straightforward verb swap; morphology <WTH8799> follows.
LCC adds '木乃伊' (mummy) as an elaboration before 棺材; <WAH09002><WH0727> attach after 棺材 to tag the coffin, leaving 木乃伊 unannotated as a LCC explanatory gloss.
UNV '棺材裡' has the ב prefix encoded as <WAH09002> before <WH0727>; same tagging applied to LCC 棺材 since 裏 is the locative particle.

Exod/1.lcc_sn: 以色列<WH03478>衆兒子<WH01121>、各人<WH0376>帶着<WH0935><WTH8804>家眷<WH01004>和<WAH0854>雅各<WH03290>一同到埃及<WH04714>去<WH0935><WTH8802>：他們的名字<WH08034>記在下面<WAH0428>：
Exod/1.lcc_original: 以色列衆兒子、各人帶着家眷和雅各一同到埃及去：他們的名字記在下面：
notes: LCC splits the motion verb as 到...去 (circumlocution); placed H0935+WTH8802 after 去 which completes the verbal action
帶着 treated as a verb unit; SN tags placed after 着 (aspect particle) to keep the verb phrase intact
H0428 (אֵלֶּה, 'these') mapped to 下面 following UNV's structural reordering of the Hebrew clause

Exod/1.lcc_original: 如便、西緬、利未、猶大、
notes: UNV 流便 → LCC 如便: both are transliterations of רְאוּבֵן (Reuben), different character choices but same referent — SN WH07205 transfers directly.
UNV prefix 有 (there were) has no SN tag and no LCC equivalent in this fragment — no action needed.

Exod/1.lcc_original: 以薩迦、西布倫、便雅憫、
notes: All three proper names (Issachar, Zebulun, Benjamin) are identical in UNV and LCC — direct 1:1 transfer.

Exod/1.lcc_original: 但、拿弗他利、迦得、亞設。
notes: All four names (Dan, Naphtali, Gad, Asher) are identical between UNV and LCC — direct 1:1 SN transfer.

Exod/1.lcc_original: 凡雅各親生的人共有七十【2】人。約瑟是已經在埃及的。
notes: UNV implicit {<WH03409>} (yarek/thigh) mapped to LCC 親 in 親生 — LCC explicitly conveys biological descent where UNV leaves it implicit. Braces dropped per Rule 3.
UNV implicit {<WH05315>} (nephesh/soul) mapped to LCC first 人 (凡雅各親生的人) — LCC makes the head noun explicit. Braces dropped per Rule 3.
LCC 是 (copula) and sentence-final 的 have no Hebrew equivalents — left unannotated per Rule 5.
【2】 is a LCC textual-critical note marker — preserved in situ between 七十 and 人.

Exod/1.lcc_sn: 約瑟<WH03130>死<WH04191><WTH8799>了，他的衆<WAH03605>弟兄<WH0251>、和他那<WAH01931>一代的人<WH01755>也都<WAH03605>死了。
Exod/1.lcc_original: 約瑟死了，他的衆弟兄、和他那一代的人也都死了。
notes: LCC repeats 死了 twice (約瑟死了…也都死了) but Hebrew has only one verb וַיָּמָת; SN tags assigned to the first 死 only, second left unannotated as stylistic repetition.
LCC 衆 (in 衆弟兄) maps to the first כָל (H3605 = 'all his brothers'); 都 (in 也都) maps to the second כֹל (H3605 = 'all that generation').
也 left unannotated — Chinese additive particle with no Hebrew equivalent.

Exod/1.lcc_original: 以色列人生殖，孳生衆多，極其強盛：那地滿是他們的人。
notes: UNV maps 眾多→H8317(shārats) but LCC 衆多 is in the third verb position corresponding to H7235(rābāh); alignment follows Hebrew word order (פָּרוּ וַיִּשְׁרְצוּ וַיִּרְבּוּ), not Chinese character matching
UNV {<WAH0853>} (implicit אֵת object marker) becomes explicit in LCC 他們的人 ('their people'), so braces dropped per Rule 3
LCC 滿是 split: 滿 carries H4390 (mālēʾ, be full); 是 is unannotated Chinese copula with no Hebrew equivalent

Exod/1.lcc_original: 當時有新的王起來、治理埃及，跟約瑟不相知。
notes: H0834 (אֲשֶׁר 'who') attached to 有 following UNV pattern; LCC restructures the relative clause '有…的' into a verbal complement '跟…不相知'
H0853 (אֵת, object marker) remains implicit {<WAH0853>} — LCC's 跟 ('with') is a Chinese preposition, not a translation of the Hebrew object marker
相知 ('know each other') absorbs H3045+H8804; LCC uses reciprocal form vs UNV's transitive 認識
當時 ('at that time'), 的 (attributive particle), and 跟 ('with') are LCC-only elements with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated

Exod/1.lcc_original: 他對他的人民說：「看哪，以色列人衆民繁多強盛，勝過我們。
notes: LCC adds explicit subject 他 (he) which is embedded in the Hebrew verb וַיֹּאמֶר — left unannotated as no separate SN exists for it.
