notes: LCC 設立 (set up/establish) corresponds to UNV 立 — WH07760+WTH8804 attach to 設立你 as a unit.
{<WAH09001>}{<WH0376>} kept implicit: LCC 做首領做審判官 omits any explicit equivalent of Hebrew לְאִישׁ (as a man/one), so braces are preserved between 做 and 首領.
UNV 我們的<WAH05921>首領 restructured in LCC as 來管我們; <WAH05921> (עַל = over/upon) attaches to 我們 at end of the expanded phrase.
LCC 害怕 replaces UNV 懼怕 for WH03372 (יָרֵא); SN attaches directly to 害怕.
LCC 給人知道 vs. UNV 被人知道 — semantically equivalent passive constructions; WH03045+WTH8738 attach to 知道, and the Chinese aspect particle 了 is left unannotated.
UNV separates 懼怕 and 說 with 便; LCC merges to 害怕說 with no connective — both SNs assigned to their respective verbs in sequence.

Exod/2.lcc_original: 法老聽見這事，就想法子要殺摩西；摩西便逃避法老，去住米甸地。
notes: LCC '就想法子要殺' expands UNV '就想殺': H01245 (seek/desire) attaches to 想, H02026 (slay) attaches to 殺; '法子要' is LCC elaboration with no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated.
LCC '逃避' maps to UNV '躲避' — both render H01272 (בָּרַח, to flee); morphology WTH8799 preserved.
LCC '去住' compresses UNV '逃往…居住': UNV's 逃往 carries no SN, so '去' is unannotated; H03427 (יָשַׁב, to dwell) with WTH8799 attaches to the compound '去住' as a unit.
{<WAH04480>}{<WH06440>} kept implicit — LCC '逃避法老' does not explicitly render 'from before the face of'; the implicit markers are preserved before 法老<WH06547>.
UNV conjunction '但' vs LCC '便' — both are discourse connectives with no SN, unannotated.

Exod/2.lcc_original: 有一天他在井旁坐着。米甸的祭司有七個女兒；她們來打水，打滿了槽，要給她們父親的羊羣喝。
notes: UNV '坐下' → LCC '坐着': both map to H3427 (יָשַׁב, to sit/dwell); morphology <WTH8799> follows.

H8248 (שָׁקָה, Hiphil 'to water/give drink') is split in LCC into '給…喝'; SNs attached to '喝' as the primary semantic carrier of the drinking action, with <WAH09001> prefix and <WTH8687> morphology following it.
LCC inserts '她們' (pronoun) before '父親' — this is a LCC expansion with no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated.
UNV '群羊' → LCC '羊羣': word order reversed but same H6629 (צֹאן, flock).
{<WAH0853>} retained as implicit: the accusative particle אֵת has no explicit counterpart in LCC text, same as UNV.
UNV '一日' has no SN tag; LCC '有一天' likewise left unannotated.

Exod/2.lcc_original: 有牧羊的人來、把她們趕走，摩西起來救她們，打水給她們的羊羣喝。
notes: UNV 幫助她們<WH03467> → LCC 救她們: 救 (to rescue/save) is a synonym covering the same Hebrew yasha (H03467), straightforward alignment.

UNV 又飲<WH08248>了{<WAH0853>}她們的群羊<WH06629> → LCC 打水給她們的羊羣喝: LCC restructures the watering action as '打水給…喝' (drew water and gave to drink). WH08248 (shaqah, to give drink/water) is attached to 喝 as the semantic completion of the watering act. 打水 is an added LCC explanatory phrase with no Hebrew equivalent.
{<WAH0853>} kept in braces: the Hebrew direct-object marker (את) has no explicit lexical counterpart in LCC; placed between 羊羣 and 喝 to preserve proximity to the object it marks.
LCC omits 卻 (adversative) and 又 (additive) connectors present in UNV — both are Chinese discourse particles with no Hebrew equivalent, so no SN loss.
Morphology codes (<WTH8xxx>) attached immediately after their governing verb in each case, consistent with spec.

Exod/2.lcc_sn: 她們來<WH0935><WTH8799>到<WAH0413>父親<WH01>流珥<WH07467>那裏，父親說<WH0559><WTH8799>：『今天<WH03117>你們爲甚麼<WH04069>來<WH0935><WTH8800>得這麼快<WH04116><WTH8765>呢？』
Exod/2.lcc_original: 她們來到父親流珥那裏，父親說：『今天你們爲甚麼來得這麼快呢？』
notes: UNV '他說' → LCC '父親說': '他' carries no SN; only 說 receives <WH0559><WTH8799>. The explicit subject '父親' in this clause is LCC's stylistic expansion and is left unannotated.
UNV '今日' → LCC '今天': synonymous; <WH03117> transferred.
UNV '為何' → LCC '爲甚麼': synonymous interrogative phrase; <WH04069> attached to 爲甚麼 as a unit.
UNV '那裡' → LCC '那裏': variant spelling only, no SN in either.

Exod/2.lcc_original: 她們說：『有一個埃及人援救了我們脫離那些牧羊人的手，並且使勁地替我們打水、給羊羣喝。
notes: 援救<WH05337><WTH8689>了我們: SN attaches to 援救 (the rescue verb); 了 is a Chinese aspect particle, left unannotated
那些: added by LCC translator to specify definiteness; no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated
使勁地<WH01802><WTH8800>: LCC renders the Hebrew infinitive absolute (WTH8800) as the adverb 使勁地 rather than repeating the verb; SN+morphology attached there to capture that semantic role
打水<WH01802><WTH8804>: the finite verb form (WTH8804 imperfect) attached to the 打水 phrase as a unit, matching UNV's 水<WH01802><WTH8804>
替我們<WAH09001>: 替 is the functional equivalent of UNV 為, both rendering the Hebrew preposition with pronominal suffix (לָנוּ); tag placed after full prepositional phrase

給{<WAH0853>}羊羣<WH06629>喝<WH08248><WTH8686>: LCC uses a split causative construction 給…喝 for the Hiphil of שָׁקָה; 給 is a Chinese causative marker (unannotated), SN+morphology attached to 喝; {<WAH0853>} (direct object marker את) remains implicit as LCC has no explicit word for it

Exod/2.lcc_original: 父親問女兒們說：『他在哪裏？你們爲甚麼撇下這個人呢？去請他來喫飯。』
notes: UNV 他對<WAH0413>...說 → LCC 父親問<WAH0413>...說: LCC replaces the pronoun subject (他) + directional preposition (對) with the explicit noun 父親 and the verb 問. The preposition אֶל (WAH0413) is absorbed into 問, which inherently encodes 'asking toward' the daughters; attached to 問 rather than 女兒們 to preserve the directional sense.
UNV 他 (subject, no SN) → LCC 父親: 他 in UNV carries no SN tag; LCC's explicit 父親 likewise receives no SN.
UNV 那個<WAH02088>人 → LCC 他: LCC replaces the demonstrative noun phrase with a simple pronoun. WAH02088 (זֶה, 'that') attaches to 他 as the closest semantic equivalent.

UNV {<WAH0853>}他<WH0376> → LCC {<WAH0853>}這個人<WH0376>: LCC makes the object explicit (這個人 = 'this man'). The object marker אֵת (WAH0853) has no explicit Chinese word in LCC, so braces are preserved. H0376 (אִישׁ, 'man') attaches to 這個人.
UNV 你們去請 → LCC 去請: LCC drops the explicit subject 你們 and retains 去請 as a serial verb. 去 carries no SN in UNV and remains unannotated.

Exod/2.lcc_original: 摩西甘心樂意地和那人同住；那人把他的女兒西坡拉給摩西爲妻。
notes: LCC expands UNV '甘心' (H2974) into '甘心樂意地'; all SNs for that root (<WH02974><WTH8686>) are attached after the full expanded phrase as a single semantic unit.
'爲妻' carries no SN in UNV either (the concept is embedded in the verb H5414); left unannotated in LCC as well.
Structure is parallel throughout; no reordering or rephrasing required.

Exod/2.lcc_original: 西坡拉生了一個兒子，摩西給他起名叫革舜，因爲他說：『我在外地做了寄居的。』
notes: Structural rearrangement of כִּי אָמַר: UNV renders it as 意思說(WH0559+WTH8804)…「因(WAH03588)…」 with כִּי inside the quote; LCC restructures to 因爲(WAH03588)他說(WH0559+WTH8804)：『…』 with כִּי outside the quote.

UNV's 外邦→LCC's 外地: both cover the Hebrew compound אֶרֶץ נָכְרִיָּה, so WH0776 (אֶרֶץ) and WH05237 (נָכְרִיָּה) are both attached to 外地. WH0776 appeared pre-word in UNV raw data (FHL artifact); normalized to post-word per convention.
在<WAH09002> preserved: 在 corresponds to the inseparable preposition בְּ in both versions.
UNV's 作了→LCC's 做了: WAH01961+WTH8804 transferred directly.
UNV's 意思 has no SN (explanatory Chinese connector with no Hebrew equivalent); correctly omitted.

Exod/2.lcc_original: 那許多日子當中、埃及王死了。以色列人因作苦工而歎息，就哀呼；他們作苦工的呼救聲上達於上帝。
notes: <WAH01961><WTH8799> (וַיְהִי, 'and it came to pass') has no direct lexical word in LCC — the temporal clause is restructured as 那...日子當中; attached to 當中 as the anchor of that clause.
{<WH01992>} is implicit in UNV (הָהֵם, 'those'), but LCC 那 explicitly renders it — braces dropped, annotated as 那<WH01992>.

Hebrew מֵעֲבֹדָתָם ('from their bondage', H04480+H05656) appears twice: first explicitly as UNV 因做苦工 → LCC 因作苦工, second as implicit {<WAH04480>}{<WH05656>} after 神 in UNV. LCC's relative clause 他們作苦工的呼救聲 explicitly renders the second occurrence — braces dropped, annotated on the second 作苦工.
LCC 上帝 vs. UNV 神 — both map to H0430 (אֱלֹהִים); standard systematic difference between the two versions.

Exod/2.lcc_original: 上帝聽見他們的唉哼，就記起他的約來、他同亞伯拉罕、以撒、雅各所立的約。
notes: LCC uses 上帝 for UNV 神; both map to H0430 as expected.
LCC uses 唉哼 for UNV 哀聲; both carry H05009 (groaning/cry of distress).

LCC restructures the covenant clause: UNV has a single 約<WH01285> at the end of a relative clause, while LCC introduces 他的約 (direct object of 記起) and then restates with 所立的約 as an appositive. H01285 is tagged only on the first 約 (syntactic direct object), as it represents one Hebrew lexeme (בְּרִיתוֹ); the final 所立的約 is LCC's stylistic expansion with no additional Hebrew lexeme.
LCC 同 corresponds to UNV 與 as the preposition H0854; tagged after 同 to preserve positional convention.
{<WAH0853>} (direct object marker H853) kept implicit in both clauses — no explicit Chinese surface form in LCC.
{<WH0430>} kept implicit in second clause — LCC omits a second mention of 上帝 just as UNV does.

Exod/2.lcc_original: 上帝察看以色列人，知道他們的苦情。
notes: 上帝 (LCC) replaces 神 (UNV) as the rendering of <WH0430> (אֱלֹהִים) — standard UNV/LCC lexical difference
察看 (LCC) replaces 看顧 (UNV) as the rendering of <WH07200> (רָאָה) — synonymous verbs; <WTH8799> morphology attaches to 察看
UNV has 也知道 but LCC has only 知道 (adverb 也 dropped); SNs <WH03045><WTH8799> attach to 知道
{<WAH0853>} kept implicit — LCC also has no explicit accusative particle
{<WH0430>} kept implicit — LCC similarly elides the second mention of God (as Hebrew does)

Exod/3.lcc_original: 摩西正在牧養他岳父米甸祭司葉忒羅的羊羣：他把羊羣領到曠野的西邊，到了上帝的山、就是何烈山。
notes: LCC 正在 is a Chinese progressive aspect particle expressing the Hebrew היה+participle (was-shepherding) construction; it carries no independent Hebrew lexeme and is left unannotated.
WH01961+WTH8804 kept implicit: LCC expresses the durative state via 正在 rather than an explicit 'was' word, so braces retained.
First {<WAH0853>} (UNV direct object marker before 他岳父) kept implicit: LCC has no explicit object-marking particle before 他岳父.
Second WAH0853 attached explicitly to 把: LCC's 把-construction is an explicit syntactic marker of the direct object (羊羣), corresponding to the Hebrew אֵת; braces dropped per Rule 3.
UNV 一日 ('one day') has no SN and no LCC counterpart — it is a UNV-specific temporal gloss; omitted cleanly.
LCC 上帝 correctly receives WH0430 (אֱלֹהִים), same referent as UNV 神.
UNV 往野外 (WH04057 + WH0310) maps to LCC 曠野的西邊: 曠野←WH04057, 西邊←WH0310 (אַחַר = 'behind/west of'); LCC makes the directional sense explicit.
WTH8802 after WH02859 (他岳父) is an unusual morphology tag on a noun in the source; preserved as-is per source fidelity.

Exod/3.lcc_original: 永恆主的使者從刺叢中火燄裏向他顯現。摩西一看，只見刺叢在火中燒着，而刺叢竟沒有被燒燬！
notes: UNV {<WH05572>} (implicit) dropped braces → 刺叢<WH05572>: LCC explicitly restates 刺叢 in the second clause ('而刺叢竟沒有被燒燬'), so rule 3 applies.
從刺叢中: UNV attaches H4480 (מִן, from) + H8432 (תָּוֶךְ, midst) to 裡; LCC's structurally equivalent 中 receives the same two tags. 從 is left unannotated (absorbed into the prefix).
火燄裏: LCC swaps UNV's 焰中 for 燄裏; H9002 (ב-prefix, in) + H3827 (flame) attach to 燄裏 as a unit.
UNV 不料<WAH02009> (הִנֵּה, behold) → LCC 只見<WAH02009>: 只見 ('only to see / behold') is LCC's rendering of the presentative particle; confidence slight dip here.
LCC adds 他 (him/Moses) with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated.
在火中: ב+אֵשׁ (H9002+H784) split across 在…火…中; tags attached after 火, with 中 as an elaborative particle left unannotated, paralleling UNV's 被火<WAH09002><WH0784> grouping style.
LCC 一看 (took a look) vs UNV 觀看: both map to H7200 (רָאָה) with morphology TH8799.

Exod/3.lcc_original: 摩西說：『我要過去，看這大異象，爲甚麼這刺叢沒有燒掉。』
notes: {<WAH04994>} (נָּא, entreaty particle 'please/pray') — LCC omits this particle entirely; implicit marker preserved
{<WAH0853>} (direct object marker אֵת) — LCC has no explicit word; implicit marker preserved
UNV word order '這荊棘<WH05572>為何<WH04069>' is inverted in LCC to '爲甚麼<WH04069>這刺叢<WH05572>'; SNs assigned to their semantic equivalents at their LCC positions
LCC '燒掉' maps to UNV '燒壞' <WH01197><WTH8799> (בָּעַר, to burn/consume); sense differs slightly (burn away vs. burned up) but is the same root event

Exod/3.lcc_original: 永恆主見摩西過來要看，上帝從刺叢中呼叫他說：『摩西，摩西』；摩西說：『我在這裏呢。』
notes: 永恆主 (Eternal Lord) = LCC's rendering of YHWH (耶和華), tagged WH03068.
{<WAH03588>} remains implicit — LCC's clause '見摩西過來' embeds the כִּי subordination structurally with no explicit Chinese conjunction.

The 摩西 in '見摩西過來要看' is left untagged: Hebrew has only an implied pronoun here (סָר = 'he turned aside'); UNV likewise uses 他 (untagged). LCC names Moses explicitly for clarity, but no Hebrew noun corresponds.
{<WH0430>} → 上帝<WH0430>: LCC has explicit 上帝 where UNV marks אֱלֹהִים as implicit; braces dropped per Rule 3.
{<WAH0413>} → 他<WAH0413>: LCC has explicit 他 (him) where UNV marks אֵלָיו as implicit; braces dropped per Rule 3.
荊棘 (UNV: thorny bush) → 刺叢 (LCC: thorn-thicket): tagged WH05572. 裡 (UNV: midst) → 中 (LCC: inside/midst): tagged WAH04480+WH08432.
The final 摩西 in '摩西說' is left untagged — Hebrew/UNV uses pronoun 他 (he said); LCC names Moses explicitly but no Hebrew noun corresponds.
呢 (LCC emphasis particle at end of '我在這裏呢') has no Hebrew equivalent and is left unannotated per Rule 5.

Exod/3.lcc_original: 永恆主說：『不可走近這裏來；要把你腳上的鞋脫下，因爲你所站的地方是聖地。』
notes: 神(UNV) → 永恆主(LCC): both untagged as subject nouns; only the verb 說 carries WH0559+WTH8799.
走近(LCC) vs 近(UNV): 走 is a Chinese motion verb with no Hebrew equivalent; WH07126+WTH8799 attach after 近 as the direct correspondent of קָרַב.
這裏(LCC) vs 前(UNV): both render הֲלֹם (WH01988, 'hither/here'); straightforward mapping.
把<WAH04480><WAH05921>: Hebrew מֵעַל ('from upon') is a compound preposition; LCC encodes this across 把...腳上 structure. Both SNs attached to 把 as the grammatical head of the prepositional complex.

{<WAH05921>} retained as implicit: LCC 的地方 renders מָקוֹם (WH04725) but has no explicit Chinese word for עַל in the relative clause 'the place where you are standing upon', so the implicit braces are preserved.
LCC omits 來 after 脫下 (UNV has 脫下來); SNs attach to 脫下 with no loss of coverage.
LCC 地方 (two characters) maps to WH04725 (מָקוֹם, 'place'), replacing UNV 地 in 之地.

Exod/3.lcc_original: 又說：『我是你父的上帝，亞伯拉罕的上帝、以撒的上帝、雅各的上帝。』摩西掩着面，因爲怕望着上帝。
notes: 父親(UNV)→父(LCC): LCC shortens the term but refers to the same Hebrew אָב (WH01).
神(UNV)→上帝(LCC): systematic lexical substitution throughout this verse; all five occurrences of WH0430 transferred to 上帝.
蒙上(UNV)→掩着(LCC): both render סָתַר (WH05641, Hiphil) as 'cover/hide'; morphology WTH8686 attaches after 掩着.
臉(UNV)→面(LCC): both render פָּנִים (WH06440); no ambiguity.
看(UNV)→望着(LCC): both render נָבַט (WH05027); the prefix WAH04480 (מִן) and morphology WTH8687 follow 望着. The 着 is an aspect particle in LCC, not a translation of אֶל.
{<WAH0413>}: the preposition אֶל 'toward' is implicit in UNV and remains implicit in LCC — LCC's 望着 does not provide an explicit lexical equivalent, so braces are preserved.
UNV repeats 是 before 亞伯拉罕 (unannotated copula); LCC omits it — no SN is affected.

Exod/3.lcc_original: 永恆主說：『我的人民在埃及的困苦我實在看見了；他們在督工之下所發的哀叫聲、我也聽見了；他們的苦痛、我是知道的。
notes: 耶和華 → 永恆主: standard LCC rendering of YHWH (WH03068 attached to 永恆主).
百姓 → 人民: lexical difference, same referent, WH05971 transfers cleanly.

UNV 所<WAH0834>受的 is a relative clause marker + verb; LCC compresses to plain 的 between 埃及 and 困苦. WAH0834 (אֲשֶׁר) attached to 的 as the nearest structural equivalent. The verb 受 has no explicit correspondent in LCC and carries no SN of its own, so nothing is lost.
Hebrew infinitive absolute + finite verb (רָאֹה רָאִיתִי): both WH07200 instances preserved, with WTH8800 (infinitive) on 實在 and WTH8804 (perfect) on 看見了, matching UNV placement.

מִפְּנֵי (WAH04480+WH06440 = 'from before/under') → LCC 在...之下. Both tags attached to 在 as the head of the prepositional phrase; 之下 left unannotated as it completes the idiom without a distinct Hebrew lexeme.
UNV 哀聲 → LCC 哀叫聲: LCC expands with 叫 but same cry referent; WH06818 attached to 哀叫聲.
כִּי emphatic (WAH03588) → LCC emphatic copula 是 in 我是知道的; 是 carries WAH03588.
UNV 痛苦 → LCC 苦痛: transposed characters, same meaning; WH04341 transfers cleanly.
All three {<WAH0853>} (direct-object markers) retained as implicit since LCC has no explicit 把/將 or object-marking particle.

Exod/3.lcc_original: 我下來、是要援救他們脫離埃及人的手，領他們出那地，上美好寬闊之地，流奶與蜜之地，迦南人、赫人、亞摩利人、比利洗人、希未人、耶布斯人的地方。
notes: LCC uses 援救 (expanded form) where UNV has 救; WAH09001+WH05337+WTH8687 attach to the full phrase 援救他們
LCC uses 上 where UNV has 到 for WAH0413 (directional preposition); tag attaches to 上
LCC drops 了 after 出; WAH04480 attaches directly to 出
UNV {<WH0776>} after 寬闊 is implicit in UNV but LCC writes 之地 explicitly (美好寬闊之地), so braces dropped and WH0776 attaches to 之地
The second WAH0413 before 寬闊 remains implicit {<WAH0413>} since LCC does not repeat 上/到 before 寬闊
LCC drops 就是到 before the people groups; WAH0413 kept implicit {<WAH0413>} with no LCC anchor word
LCC uses 的地方 where UNV has 之地 for WH04725 (מָקוֹם = place/location); tags attach to 地方

Exod/3.lcc_original: 現在你看，以色列人的哀叫聲已經到達了我了；埃及人怎樣壓迫他們、我也看見了。
notes: UNV {<WAH02009>} (הִנֵּה, 'behold') is implicit in UNV but LCC renders it explicitly as 你看 — braces dropped per Rule 3: 你看<WAH02009>.
LCC 哀叫聲 covers UNV 哀聲 (WH06818); the added 叫 is LCC's own amplification with no separate Hebrew root, left unannotated.

LCC 到達 absorbs UNV 達 (WH0935/WTH8804); the aspect marker 已經 and both instances of 了 have no Hebrew equivalents and are left unannotated. Preposition אֵל (WAH0413) attaches to 我 as its nearest overt recipient.

Hebrew structure (Exod 3:9b) is רָאִיתִי אֶת הַלַּחַץ אֲשֶׁר מִצְרַיִם לֹחֲצִים אֹתָם — 'I saw the oppression with which the Egyptians oppress them.' LCC restructures to 埃及人怎樣壓迫他們、我也看見了. Exod/4.lcc_original: 摩西亞倫就去聚集以色列人的衆長老。
notes: UNV 招聚 → LCC 聚集: synonymous verbs (both 'gather/assemble'); WH0622+WTH8799 attached to 聚集
UNV 以色列<WH01121><WH03478> + 的 → LCC 以色列人: LCC adds 人 to render בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל ('children of Israel') as a single nominal; both WH01121 and WH03478 attached together to 以色列人
{<WAH0853>} retained as implicit: LCC has no overt direct-object marker corresponding to Hebrew אֵת
UNV 眾 → LCC 衆 (variant character): WAH03605 attached normally

Exod/4.lcc_original: 亞倫將永恆主對摩西說的一切話、說了一遍，又在人民眼前行了那些神迹。
notes: 耶和華<WH03068> → 永恆主: standard LCC rendering of the Tetragrammaton; SN attached to 永恆主 as a unit
百姓<WH05971> → 人民: standard LCC lexical substitution; SN attached to 人民
述說了<WH01696><WTH8762> → 說了: LCC omits the 述 prefix but the verb root is identical (WH01696); both morphology code and root SN attached to 說了
神蹟 → 神迹: variant character spelling in LCC; same word, SN attached to 神迹
The 、 punctuation after 話 is preserved exactly as in LCC original

Exod/4.lcc_original: 人民就相信；他們聽見永恆主眷顧以色列人，看見他們的困苦，就俯伏敬拜。
notes: LCC restructures syntax: UNV has '以色列人' as subject of '聽見', but LCC uses '他們' as subject and moves '以色列人' to object of '眷顧'. SNs WH03478+WH01121 are placed on '以色列人' where it appears in LCC; '他們' is left unannotated as a pronoun added for grammatical cohesion.
UNV '低頭'(WH06915/קָדַד)+'下拜'(WH07812/שָׁחָה) split to LCC '俯伏'(WH06915)+'敬拜'(WH07812) — LCC separates the prostration gesture from the act of worship similarly.
UNV '鑒察'→LCC '看見' for WH07200 (רָאָה, to see/behold) — straightforward lexical substitution.
Both {<WAH03588>} implicit conjunctions kept: LCC uses comma and clause structure instead of explicit 'that/because' particles.
Both {<WAH0853>} direct object markers kept implicit: LCC has no overt equivalent for the Hebrew אֶת particle.

Exod/5.lcc_original: 後來摩西亞倫去對法老說：『永恆主以色列的上帝這麼說：「讓我的人民走吧，他們好在曠野過節拜我。」』
notes: 耶和華 → 永恆主: LCC's rendering of YHWH; <WH03068> attached to 永恆主.
神 → 上帝: LCC's rendering of אֱלֹהִים (H0430); attached to 上帝.

UNV splits 容<WAH0853>...去<WH07971><WTH8761>; LCC equivalently splits to 讓<WAH0853>...走<WH07971><WTH8761>. The את marker (H0853) stays on the causative opener 讓; the main verb שָׁלַח (H07971) goes to 走.
UNV 向我守節 → LCC 過節拜我: word order is inverted. <WH02287><WTH8799> attached to 過節 (festival-keeping); <WAH09001> (לִי = to me) attached to 拜.
LCC 他們好 (purpose clause marker) has no Hebrew lexeme equivalent — left unannotated.
吧 (suggestion particle after 走) is a Chinese-only pragmatic particle — left unannotated.

Exod/5.lcc_original: 法老說：『永恆主是誰，我須聽他的話，而讓以色列人走呢？我不認識永恆主；我不讓以色列人走。』
notes: 耶和華→永恆主: LCC's theological rendering of יהוה; SN <WH03068> attaches to 永恆主 in both occurrences.
使我聽→我須聽: UNV uses causative 使 to render the syntax; LCC restructures as modal 須. SN <WH08085><WTH8799> attaches to the verb 聽; 須 is unannotated.
容→讓: Direct synonym; <WAH0853> (את object marker) transfers with it in both occurrences.
去→走: Direct synonym; all three SNs <WAH09001><WH07971><WTH8763> (first occurrence) and <WH07971><WTH8762> (second) attach to 走.
而讓: LCC adds conjunction 而 with no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated.
也<WAH01571> (גם): Explicit in UNV but absent in LCC's second clause; rendered as implicit {<WAH01571>} placed before the resumptive clause.
{<WAH0834>} (אשׁר): Relative pronoun implicit in UNV; LCC also has no explicit word for it, kept implicit.
{<WAH0853>} (את object marker before 永恆主): No explicit word in either version; kept implicit.

Exod/5.lcc_original: 他們說：『希伯來人的上帝踫見了我們；求你容我們走三天的路程到曠野，去獻祭給永恆主我們的上帝，免得他用瘟疫或刀兵襲擊我們。』
notes: Word order inversion: UNV '往曠野去，走三天的路程' → LCC '走三天的路程到曠野'. SNs redistributed: WH03212<WTH8799> attaches to 走 (main motion verb), WAH09002+WH04057 attach to 到曠野.
The 去 before 獻祭 is a Chinese directional auxiliary particle with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated. WH02076<WTH8799> attaches to 獻祭 as the semantic head.
UNV 神 (×2) → LCC 上帝 (×2): WH0430 attached to both occurrences.
UNV 耶和華 → LCC 永恆主 (LCC's rendering of YHWH): WAH09001+WH03068 attached to 永恆主.
UNV {<WAH0176>} (implicit 'or') → LCC 或 (explicit word present): braces dropped per Rule 3, tag attached directly as 或<WAH0176>.
UNV 攻擊 → LCC 襲擊 (semantic synonym): WH06293<WTH8799> attached to 襲擊我們.

Exod/5.lcc_original: 埃及王對他們說：『摩西亞倫，你們爲甚麼使人民懶惰不作工呢？去挑你們的擔子。』
notes: UNV 叫<WAH0853>百姓<WH05971>曠<WH06544><WTH8686>工<WAH04480><WH04639> maps to LCC 使<WAH0853>人民<WH05971>懶惰<WH06544><WTH8686>不作工<WAH04480><WH04639>; <WAH0853> (אֶת, direct object marker) attached to causative verb 使, following the same UNV pattern where it attaches to 叫

H06544 (פרע, to let loose/idle) is rendered as UNV 曠工 but LCC splits this into 懶惰 (idleness, carrying H6544+H8686) and 不作工 (not work, carrying H4480+H4639 = מִמַּעֲשָׂיו); slight confidence reduction because LCC restructures one Hebrew verbal phrase into two clauses
LCC omits explicit subject pronoun before 去 (Hebrew imperative לְכוּ implies plurality); H3212+H8798 attach to 去
LCC 挑 (lift/carry) corresponds to UNV 擔 but neither carries an independent SN in UNV; the burden noun 擔子 carries <WAH09001><WH05450> in both

Exod/5.lcc_original: 法老說：『看哪，這地的人民如今很多，你們竟叫他們歇下擔子。』
notes: {<WH06547>} was implicit in UNV (Pharaoh not named, braces used), but LCC opens with explicit 法老 — braces dropped, tag attached directly.
UNV '又說' → LCC '說': the particle 又 carries no SN; H0559 (אָמַר, said) maps to 說 alone.
UNV '以色列人<WH05971>' → LCC '人民': H05971 is עַם (people); LCC omits the 以色列 specificity but 人民 is the correct semantic target. יִשְׂרָאֵל is untagged in UNV so no SN is lost.
UNV '眾多<WH07227>' → LCC '很多': H07227 (רַב, many/great) maps cleanly to 很多.

Exod/5.lcc_original: 就在那一天、法老就吩咐民間的督工和頭目說：
notes: 那一天 consolidates both the demonstrative pronoun <WAH01931> (הַהוּא) and the day noun <WAH09002><WH03117> (בַּיּוֹם); both SNs placed after 天 since the whole phrase is a single unit in LCC.

LCC reorders the Hebrew constituents: UNV follows Hebrew word order (taskmasters + {among the people}), while LCC preposes the domain: 民間的督工. Hebrew בָּעָם (among the people) is implicit in UNV ({<WAH09002>}{<WH05971>}) but explicit as 民間 in LCC, so braces are dropped per Rule 3.
頭目 (LCC) renders שֹׁטְרָיו just as 官長 (UNV) does; <WH07860><WTH8802> transferred straightforwardly.
<WAH0853> on 和 represents וְאֶת (conjunction + direct object marker before שֹׁטְרָיו); retained on 和 as in UNV.

Exod/5.lcc_original: 『你們再別將草給人民作甎、像素常那樣了；叫他們去給自己撿草。
notes: UNV's {<WH03254>}{<WTH8686>} was implicit (no explicit Chinese word for 'continue/add'); LCC's 再 explicitly expresses this concept, so braces dropped per Rule 3 → 再<WH03254><WTH8686>.
UNV's negative 不可<WAH03808> aligns to LCC's 別<WAH03808>; the WAH prefix retained.

UNV places 照<WAH09003><WH08543>常<WH08032> near the start; LCC repositions this clause to 像素常那樣 after 作甎. WAH09003 attached to 像 (the כ-like preposition), H8543+H8032 both attached to 素常 since 素常 as a compound covers both temporal words (yesterday/day-before-yesterday = 'formerly/as usual').
LCC's 那樣 and aspect particle 了 have no Hebrew equivalents — left unannotated.
UNV's 自己<WAH09001>去<WH03212><WTH8799> order is reversed in LCC to 去<WH03212><WTH8799>給自己<WAH09001>; WAH09001 follows 自己 in both to mark the ל-prefix ('for themselves').

Exod/5.lcc_original: 他們素常作甎的數量、你們仍舊要逼着他們作完，一點也別讓減少，因爲他們懶惰，纔喊叫說：「容我們去獻祭給我們的上帝。」
notes: UNV '向他們<WAH05921>要<WH07760>' → LCC '要<WH07760>逼着他們<WAH05921>作完': verb-object order inverted; '逼着' is an intensifying aspect marker with no direct SN; '作完' (complete/do in full) is an LCC expansion with no corresponding SN in this verse
UNV '所以<WAH05921><WAH03651>' → LCC '纔<WAH05921><WAH03651>': LCC uses '纔' (only then/thereupon) to render עַל כֵּן (therefore); SNs attached to '纔' as the functional equivalent
UNV '不可<WAH03808>' → LCC '也別讓<WAH03808>': '也' and '讓' are LCC-specific particles; WAH03808 (לֹא) attached to '別讓' as the negation head
UNV '{<WAH0853>}' (direct object marker אֵת) kept implicit in LCC — Chinese has no overt accusative marker
UNV '神<WH0430>' → LCC '上帝<WH0430>': systematic UNV/LCC lexical difference; same SN applied

Exod/5.lcc_original: 你們要把更重的工作加在這些人身上，叫他們專在那上頭作，不去注意虛假話。』
notes: LCC '工作' replaces UNV '工夫' — both map to H5656 (עֲבֹדָה, labor/service).
LCC '叫他們專在那上頭作' expands UNV '叫他們勞碌'; '專在那上頭' is LCC interpretive elaboration with no Hebrew equivalent; H6213 (עָשָׂה) tags attach to the main verb '作'.
{<WAH09002>} kept implicit: LCC uses a comma break between the two clauses rather than an explicit conjunction word.
LCC '去注意' interprets UNV '聽' (H8159, שָׁעָה = to regard/look at); tag attached after '注意'.
LCC '虛假話' condenses UNV '虛謊的言語': '虛假' ← H8267 (שֶׁקֶר, falsehood); '話' ← H09002+H1697 (ב+דָּבָר, words).

Exod/5.lcc_original: 人民的督工和頭目出來對人民說：『法老這麼說：「我不給你們草。
notes: UNV {<WH05971>} is implicit (督工{的人民}), but LCC has explicit 人民 before 督工; rule 3 applied: braces dropped, 人民<WH05971> used.
UNV 官長 → LCC 頭目: different lexical choice for שֹׁטֵר (WH07860), alignment clear from context.
UNV 百姓 → LCC 人民: both map to WH05971; second occurrence of עַם in the verse handled consistently.
UNV 這樣 → LCC 這麼: both render כֹּה (WAH03541), straightforward synonym substitution.

{<WH0559>}{<WTH8799>} (לֵאמֹר, the introductory 'saying') kept implicit after 出來; LCC does not add a second explicit verb here — the single 說 covers only the main speech verb (WAH09001<WH0559><WTH8800>).
Quote marks preserved as in LCC original (『…「) rather than UNV order (「…『).

Exod/5.lcc_original: 你們自己能在哪兒找得着草，就自己到哪兒去拿；作品呢、一點也不許減少。」』
notes: LCC repeats 自己 a second time (就自己到哪兒) for stylistic emphasis — no direct Hebrew correspondent; <WAH04480><WH0834> attached to the directional phrase 到哪兒, corresponding to UNV 往那裡
UNV 但<WH03588> (כִּי, contrastive conjunction) mapped to LCC 呢, which serves as a topic/contrast discourse particle in this position — the semantic role is parallel but the form differs
UNV 你們的工<WAH04480><WH05656> → LCC 作品; both SNs (H4480 prefix + H5656 עֲבֹדָה) collapsed onto 作品 since LCC drops the possessive 你們的 here
LCC 拿 (take/fetch) correctly maps to UNV 找<WH03947><WTH8798> — H3947 is לָקַח (to take/fetch), not H4672 (to find); LCC's verb choice is semantically more precise than UNV's 找 here

Exod/5.lcc_original: 於是人民分散在埃及遍地、去撿碎稭當做草。
notes: 百姓(UNV)→人民(LCC): both render H05971 עַם; straightforward lexical variant
散(UNV)→分散(LCC): LCC expands H06327 קָשַׁשׁ Hithpoel (scatter/spread) to two-character phrase; tags attached after 分散 as a unit
遍地 covers three tags (WAH09002 ב-prefix + WAH03605 כֹּל + WH0776 אֶרֶץ): UNV separates as 遍+地 but LCC writes as single compound; all three SNs appended after 遍地
LCC inserts 去 before 撿 as a directional complement with no Hebrew equivalent; tags placed after 去撿 as the full verbal phrase
碎秸(UNV)→碎稭(LCC): variant character 秸/稭 for H07179 קַשׁ; identical meaning

Exod/5.lcc_original: 督工的催着說：『你們的工、每天的本份、要在當天作完，像先前有草時一樣。』
notes: UNV {<WH04639>} (מַלְאַכְתְּכֶם, 'your work') is implicit in UNV but LCC renders it explicitly as 工, so braces dropped → 工<WH04639>.

LCC restructures the predicate: UNV '一天當完{工}一天的工' becomes LCC '每天的本份、要在當天作完'. The two WH03117 (יוֹם) instances map to 每天 (bare יוֹם in the construct דְּבַר-יוֹם) and 當天 (בְּיֹומֹו with WAH09002 prefix) respectively.
WH01697 (דָּבָר, 'matter/portion') maps to UNV 工 but to LCC 本份 — both render the same Hebrew word in context.
LCC adds 時 ('when/at the time') after 草 for natural Chinese phrasing; no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated.
WAH09003+WAH0834 (כַּאֲשֶׁר, 'just as') attached to 先前 following UNV's tagging pattern.

Exod/5.lcc_original: 以色列人的頭目、就是法老的督工所設立來管理衆民的、受責打說：『你們昨天今天爲甚麼沒有作完你們受派的工去作甎、像素常一樣呢？』
notes: LCC inverts the syntactic subject: UNV has 'Pharaoh's taskmasters beat the Israelite foremen,' while LCC has 'The Israelite foremen (installed by Pharaoh's taskmasters) received a beating' — SNs for 以色列/人/頭目 (WH03478/WH01121/WH07860) moved to head position accordingly.
{<WAH05921>} is implicit in UNV (Hebrew עַל, 'over') but LCC explicitly renders it as 管理 ('manage/oversee') — braces dropped per Rule 3, tag attached to 管理.
UNV lists quota-bricks-finish in order 做磚…完…工作; LCC reorders to 作完…工…去作甎. SNs redistributed: WH03615/WTH8765 on 完 (within 作完), WH02706 on 工, WAH09001/WH03835/WTH8800 on 作甎.

衆民 ('the multitude/people') in LCC rephrases the implicit referent of 以色列人 in the prepositional clause; left unannotated as its SN identity (WH03478/WH01121) is already consumed by the explicit 以色列人 earlier in the verse.
受派的工: 受派 is a descriptive modifier back-referencing the 設立 clause; only 工 receives WH02706 (חֹק, quota/portion). No additional SN assigned to 受派.
WH08543 (תְּמוֹל) appears twice: once for 昨天 (yesterday) and once within the idiom 素常 (= תְּמוֹל שִׁלְשֹׁם, H8543+H8032 = 'as heretofore'), consistent with its dual use in UNV.

Exod/5.lcc_original: 以色列人的頭目就來、向法老哀叫說：『你爲甚麼這樣待你僕人呢？
notes: UNV 官長 → LCC 頭目 (both render שֹׁטֵר); SN WH07860+WTH8802 attached to 頭目

UNV word order: 哀求…{<WAH0413>}法老; LCC reorders to 向法老哀叫 — preposition 向 is explicit in LCC so braces dropped: 向<WAH0413>; 法老<WH06547> follows; 哀叫<WH06817><WTH8799> placed after 法老 to match LCC word order
UNV 哀求 → LCC 哀叫 (both render צָעַק WH06817)
LCC adds 你 before 爲甚麼 with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated; SNs WAH09001+WAH04100 attach to 爲甚麼
LCC 你僕人 (omits 的 vs UNV 你的僕人) — SNs WAH09001+WH05650 attach to 你僕人
LCC sentence-final particle 呢 has no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated

Exod/5.lcc_original: 草沒有給你僕人，甎卻對我們說：「要作。」看哪，你僕人並且受責打呢；其實是你自己人民的錯處。』
notes: LCC repositions 甎 (磚 WH03843) as a fronted topic ('as for bricks, they say...') rather than object of 做, requiring tag placement after 甎 at head of its clause rather than after the verb.
沒有 in LCC covers the UNV negation 不<WAH0369>; tag placed after 沒有 as the semantic equivalent of אַיִן.
Second WAH09001 (prefix on לָנוּ / us) placed after 我們 per UNV token order: 對我們<WAH09001>說.
受責打 covers UNV 挨了打; SNs WH05221+WTH8716 attached after 打.
人民 maps to 百姓<WH05971>; 錯處 maps to 錯<WH02398>.

Exod/5.lcc_original: 法老說：『你們懶惰，你們懶惰，纔說：「容我們去獻祭給永恆主。」
notes: UNV 但 has no SN and is dropped in LCC — no transfer needed.
Second 你們 carries no SN in UNV, so left unannotated in LCC as well.
所以 (עַל-כֵּן, WAH05921+WAH03651) → LCC 纔: LCC uses a single resultative particle to render the compound Hebrew connector; both prefix SNs attached to 纔.
{<WAH0859>} kept as implicit braces: LCC likewise omits an explicit subject before the second 說.
耶和華 (ל prefix WAH09001 + יהוה WH03068) split across LCC 給永恆主: 給 carries WAH09001 (ל = 'to/for'), 永恆主 carries WH03068 (יהוה). This is more linguistically precise than collapsing both onto 永恆主.
給 as a standalone Chinese preposition also has no independent Hebrew root, so annotating it only with the prefix SN (WAH09001) rather than a core SN is consistent with project conventions.

Exod/5.lcc_original: 現在你們去作工；草是不給你們的，甎卻要如數照交。』
notes: LCC 作工 (vs UNV 做工) — variant character, same word, SN <WH05647><WTH8798> attached normally.
LCC 甎 (vs UNV 磚) — traditional/variant character for 'brick', same referent, <WH03843> attached normally.
UNV 吧 is a Chinese modal particle with no Hebrew equivalent and no SN — LCC omits it entirely, no annotation needed.

UNV 如數交納 → LCC 如數照交: <WH08506> attaches to 如數 in both; <WH05414><WTH8799> attaches to LCC 照交 (which covers UNV 交納). The 照 in LCC is a stylistic modifier with no separate SN in UNV, so it is absorbed into the phrase bearing <WH05414><WTH8799>.

Exod/5.lcc_original: 這樣，旣有話說：『你們的甎不可減少，每天的本份要在當天作完』，以色列人的頭目就見他們有禍了。
notes: LCC structurally inverts the Hebrew: the direct speech (לֵאמֹר clause) is fronted as a temporal clause '旣有話說：…', while the main verb וַיִּרְאוּ (就見) is pushed to the end — all SNs are repositioned accordingly.
לֵאמֹר (WAH09001+WH0559+WTH8800 = 'saying') is attached to 說 in '旣有話說'; 旣 and 有 are LCC aspect/existential particles with no Hebrew equivalent.
UNV '{<WAH0853>}' is implicit (braces); LCC has explicit '他們', so braces dropped per rule 3: 他們<WAH0853>.
מִלִּבְנֵיכֶם (WAH04480+WH03843 = 'from your bricks') maps to '你們的甎' as a phrase; 你們的 is absorbed into the Hebrew possessive suffix.

UNV '每天<WH03117><WAH09002><WH03117>' (יֹום בְּיֹומֹו = day in its day) split across LCC: first יֹום → 每天<WH03117>; בְּיֹומֹו → 在當天<WAH09002><WH03117>; '要' and '作完' are LCC additions with no Hebrew equivalent.
בְּרָע (WAH09002+WH07451 = 'in evil/trouble') maps to LCC '有禍'; both tags attach to the phrase.
WTH8799 appears twice in UNV (for 減少 and 就知道); correctly re-attached to 減少 and 就見 respectively.
這樣 is a LCC transitional particle with no Hebrew correspondence — left unannotated.

Exod/5.lcc_original: 他們從法老面前退出來時，正遇見摩西亞倫站在對面，
notes: WAH04480+WAH0854 form the compound preposition מֵאֵת ('from before'); both attached together to 從 since they are inseparable. LCC's 面前 renders the spatial nuance already covered by these tags and is left unannotated.
LCC 退出來時 covers UNV 出來 plus the temporal clause implied by בְּצֵאתָם (infinitive construct with ב prefix); WAH09002+WH03318+WTH8800 attached to the full phrase ending at 時.
LCC omits the 、 between 摩西 and 亞倫 but both {<WAH0853>} accusative markers are preserved — LCC has no explicit words for the Hebrew particle אֵת so braces are kept.
Chinese 時 (temporal clause particle) at end of 退出來時 is left unannotated as it is a Chinese grammatical addition with no Hebrew equivalent.

Exod/5.lcc_original: 就對他們說：『願永恆主鑒察你們，審判你們，因爲你們使我們的香氣在法老和他臣僕面前都發臭了，你們把刀遞在他們手中來殺我們。』
notes: 耶和華<WH03068>→永恆主: standard LCC substitution for the Tetragrammaton; tag placed after 永恆主
施行判斷<WH08199><WTH8799>→審判: LCC condenses UNV's verb phrase to a single verb; both render שָׁפַט; LCC adds a second 你們 for clarity, left untagged as it has no Hebrew counterpart
Hebrew verb-noun order (בָּאַשׁ רֵיחֵנוּ = stink our-smell) is inverted in LCC: 香氣<WH07381> precedes 發臭<WH0887><WTH8689>; tags follow their respective lexemes in LCC word order
UNV's implicit WAH0853 (אֵת) marks the direct object; in LCC the object is 我們的香氣, so the tag anchors after 我們 to mirror UNV's attachment point before the genitive phrase
LCC inserts 來 before 殺 as a purposive aspect marker; it has no Hebrew equivalent and is left untagged; WAH09001+WH02026+WTH8800 attach to 殺 as the head verb

Exod/5.lcc_original: 摩西回到永恆主面前說：『主阿，你爲甚麼苦待這人民？爲甚麼差遣了我呢？
notes: 耶和華<WH03068>那裡 → 永恆主<WH03068>面前: LCC renders YHWH as '永恆主'; WH03068 attaches to 永恆主 as a unit; 面前 (like 那裡 in UNV) is untagged — both render the prepositional directionality with no separate SN
百姓<WAH09001><WH05971> → 人民<WAH09001><WH05971>: LCC substitutes 人民 for 百姓 as the rendering of עַם (H05971); full SN set transferred unchanged

打發我去<WH07971><WTH8804> → 差遣<WH07971><WTH8804>了我: LCC uses 差遣 for שָׁלַח (H07971); morphology WTH8804 stays on the verb; 了 is a Chinese aspect particle with no Hebrew equivalent (unannotated); 我 is implied in the Hebrew form (unannotated)
{<WAH02088>} kept implicit: the demonstrative הַזֶּה in the second clause has no explicit counterpart in LCC's 爲甚麼差遣了我, same as it lacked one in UNV

Exod/5.lcc_original: 自從我去見法老、奉你的名說話以來，他就苦待這人民；你一點也沒有援救你的人民。』
notes: LCC adds 以來 after 說話 to close the temporal clause — purely Chinese grammatical addition, left unannotated
UNV 百姓 → LCC 人民 (first occurrence): same H5971, <WAH09001> vav-conjunction retained on 人民
UNV {<WAH0853>}他們<WH05971> → LCC 你的人民: LCC is more literal (Hebrew עַמְּךָ = your people); H853 drops braces since 人民 is an explicit noun; both H853 and H5971 attach to 人民
Infinitive absolute <WH05337><WTH8687> (emphatic) stays on 一點也 matching UNV structure; main verb <WH05337><WTH8689> attaches to 援救 (= UNV 拯救, same root H5337)

Exod/6.lcc_sn: 永恆主<WH03068>對<WAH0413>摩西<WH04872>說<WH0559><WTH8799>：『我對<WAH09001>法老<WH06547>所<WAH0834>要行<WH06213><WTH8799>的事、現在<WAH06258>你就可以看見<WH07200><WTH8799>了；因爲<WAH03588>我用大力<WH02389>的手<WAH09002><WH03027>、他就必讓衆民走<WH07971><WTH8762>，我用大力<WH02389>的手<WAH09002><WH03027>、他就必將衆民趕出<WH01644><WTH8762>他的地<WAH04480><WH0776>。』
Exod/6.lcc_original: 永恆主對摩西說：『我對法老所要行的事、現在你就可以看見了；因爲我用大力的手、他就必讓衆民走，我用大力的手、他就必將衆民趕出他的地。』
notes: LCC reorders the main clause: UNV says '現在你必看見我向法老所行的事' but LCC inverts to '我對法老所要行的事、現在你就可以看見了' — SNs follow LCC word order throughout.
UNV '向法老' → LCC '對法老': WAH09001 placed on LCC '對' as it functions as the same directional preposition אֶל.
The implicit markers {<WAH09002>}{<WH03027>}{<WH02389>} in UNV correspond to the second occurrence of '我用大力的手' in LCC, which is lexically explicit — braces dropped and SNs attached normally.
LCC '了' (perfective aspect particle) has no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated per Rule 5.
LCC '衆民' replaces UNV '以色列人' for both the 'let go' (WH07971) and 'drive out' (WH01644) clauses — same SNs applied to the corresponding LCC verbs.
WAH04480 (מִן prefix 'from') + WH0776 (אֶרֶץ 'land') attached to '地' as a compound as in UNV.

Exod/6.lcc_original: 上帝告訴摩西說：『我是永恆主。
notes: 神(WH0430=אֱלֹהִים) → 上帝: semantic equivalent, standard UNV/LCC divergence for Elohim
曉諭(WH01696=דָּבַר, WTH8762) → 告訴: both render the Piel 'spoke/told'; morphology tag attaches to 告訴
{<WAH0413>}: preposition אֶל 'to' remains implicit in LCC just as in UNV — no standalone word to attach it to
耶和華(WH03068=יְהוָה) → 永恆主: LCC's standard rendering of the Tetragrammaton; tag attaches to full phrase 永恆主
是 left unannotated: Chinese copula with no Hebrew counterpart in the source

Exod/6.lcc_original: 我從前向亞伯拉罕、以撒、雅各顯現爲全能的上帝，至於我名「耶和華」、我是未嘗用這名叫人認識我的。
notes: UNV 神 → LCC 上帝: same referent (WH0410 = God/El); WAH09002 and WH0410 attached to 上帝
向 in LCC covers all three patriarchs; second and third {<WAH0413>} remain implicit — LCC does not repeat 向 before 以撒 or 雅各
Second clause heavily rephrased: UNV 他們未曾知道 → LCC 我是未嘗用這名叫人認識我的 (LCC takes a causative/Niphal reading); WH03045+WTH8738 mapped to 認識 as the best lexical correspondent
WAH09001 (conjunction/pronoun prefix on 他們) has no explicit LCC equivalent; kept implicit as {<WAH09001>} before 我是
WAH03808 (negation לֹא): UNV 未曾 → LCC 未嘗 — direct correspondence

Exod/6.lcc_original: 我並且同他們立了我的約，要把迦南地、他們寄居的地、賜給他們。
notes: LCC '並且' explicitly renders the implicit H01571 (גַּם) from UNV {<WAH01571>}, so braces are dropped.

LCC inverts the phrase order compared to UNV: UNV reads '[land-implicit] 他們寄居的迦南地' (one compressed phrase); LCC reads '迦南地、他們寄居的地' (two parallel noun phrases). SNs redistributed accordingly: 迦南<WH03667>地<WH0776> receives the second pair, and 他們寄居<WH04033>的地<WH0776> receives the first pair.
The implicit {<WH0776>} in UNV (first אֶרֶץ, land of sojourning) becomes explicit as the second '地' in LCC '他們寄居的地', so braces are dropped there.
The second <WAH0853> (second אֵת object marker in Hebrew) has no explicit counterpart in LCC's 把-marked structure; kept implicit before 他們寄居.
Terminal implicit cluster {<WAH0834>}{<WH01481>}{<WTH8804>}{<WAH09002>} (אֲשֶׁר, גּוּר, Qal perfect, בְּ) preserved as-is; LCC does not render these explicitly either.

Exod/6.lcc_original: 以色列人因埃及人給他們作工而發的唉哼、我聽見了，我也記起我的約來。
notes: LCC restructures the Hebrew word order significantly: the object clause (以色列人…唉哼) is fronted, while UNV follows Hebrew order (verb 聽見 first). All SNs are remapped to their semantic positions in the LCC restructured sentence.

WAH01571 (גַּם, 'also/even') attaches to 也 in LCC's second clause (我也記起). In Hebrew it heads the whole verse (וְגַם); LCC does not render it in the first clause (我聽見了 has no 也), so it is attached to the only 也 in the sentence.
作工 covers מַעֲבִדִים (WH05647+WTH8688, Hophal 'cause to labour'). UNV uses 苦待 ('oppress/make serve'); LCC uses 給他們作工 ('made them do labour') — semantically equivalent; both SNs attach to 作工.
{<WH0834>} (אֲשֶׁר, relative pronoun) is kept implicit; LCC's 而發的 conveys the relative function analytically with no discrete word for אֲשֶׁר.
了 (aspect particle) and 來 (sentence-final particle) are Chinese grammatical elements with no Hebrew equivalents and are left unannotated.

Exod/6.lcc_sn: 所以<WAH09001><WH03651>你要對以色列<WH03478>人<WAH09001><WH01121>說<WH0559><WTH8798>：『我<WAH0589>永恆主<WH03068>；我要領<WH03318><WTH8689>你們<WAH0853>從<WAH04480>埃及人<WH04714>所加的重擔<WH05450>下<WAH08478>出來；我要援救<WH05337><WTH8689>你們<WAH0853>脫離<WAH04480>他們所派作的苦工<WH05656>；我要用伸出<WH05186><WTH8803>的膀臂<WAH09002><WH02220>藉着大<WH01419>判罰<WAH09002><WH08201>贖救<WH01350><WTH8804>你們<WAH0853>。
Exod/6.lcc_original: 所以你要對以色列人說：『我永恆主；我要領你們從埃及人所加的重擔下出來；我要援救你們脫離他們所派作的苦工；我要用伸出的膀臂藉着大判罰贖救你們。
notes: LCC restructures the three divine actions into separate 我要 clauses, but follows the same Hebrew order as the source (bring out → rescue → redeem); UNV had reversed the first and third actions.
UNV implicit {<WH05337>}{<WTH8689>}{<WAH0853>} → LCC explicit 援救, so braces dropped and SN attached directly: 援救<WH05337><WTH8689>
UNV implicit {<WH01350>}{<WTH8804>}{<WAH0853>} → LCC explicit 贖救, so braces dropped: 贖救<WH01350><WTH8804>
מִתַּחַת (from-under) is split across LCC's 從...下 frame: 從<WAH04480>...下<WAH08478>; 埃及人<WH04714> and 重擔<WH05450> tagged within the relative clause they appear in
領...出來 is a resultative compound for Hifil יָצָא; SNs attached to 領 as the causative head; 出來 left unannotated as directional complement
永恆主 (LCC's rendering of יְהוָה) receives <WH03068>; LCC omits copula 是 so no additional tag needed
Subsequent occurrences of 我 (in 我要領…, 我要援救…, 我要用…) left untagged — first person is encoded in Hebrew verb conjugation, not a separate pronoun

Exod/6.lcc_sn: 我要拿<WH03947><WTH8804>你們<WAH0853>當作我的<WAH09001>子民<WAH09001><WH05971>；我要做<WAH01961><WTH8804>你們的<WAH09001>上帝<WAH09001><WH0430>；你們要認識<WH03045><WTH8804>{<WAH03588>}我<WAH0589>是永恆主<WH03068>、你們的上帝<WH0430>、是領<WH03318><WTH8688>你們<WAH0853>從<WAH04480>埃及人<WH04714>所加的重擔<WH05450>下<WAH08478>出來的。
Exod/6.lcc_original: 我要拿你們當作我的子民；我要做你們的上帝；你們要認識我是永恆主、你們的上帝、是領你們從埃及人所加的重擔下出來的。
notes: LCC 上帝 ← UNV 神 (both = WH0430 אֱלֹהִים); double-WAH09001 pattern on 上帝 preserved to mirror UNV's 神<WAH09001><WH0430>
LCC 永恆主 ← UNV 耶和華 (both = WH03068 יְהוָה); LCC's theological rendering of the divine name

LCC splits verb as 領…出來 for UNV's 救 (WH03318 Hiphil of יָצָא); WH03318+WTH8688 anchored to 領 as the main verb head; 出來 is the directional complement of the same root, left unannotated to avoid double-tagging
UNV 脫離<WAH04480><WAH08478> (מִן+תַּחַת, 'from under') distributes across LCC's 從<WAH04480>…下<WAH08478>: preposition split is semantically exact
LCC 所加的 is a genitive expansion ('what was imposed by') with no Hebrew lexical counterpart; left unannotated
כִּי (WAH03588) remains implicit {<WAH03588>} — LCC folds the conjunction into the clause structure without an overt Chinese word

Exod/6.lcc_original: 我舉手起誓應許、給亞伯拉罕、以撒、雅各的地、我必領你們進去，將那地賜給你們爲基業：我永恆主。』
notes: LCC's '舉手' explicitly renders נָשָׂא יָד (raise hand): WH05375(נָשָׂא)→舉, WH03027(יָד)→手; UNV had compressed these into '起…誓' — braces on {<WAH0853>} (DOM for יָד) retained since Chinese has no explicit DOM particle.
{<WAH0834>}(אֲשֶׁר) promoted to explicit: LCC's '的' (before 地) functions as the relative clause marker — dropped braces, attached as 的<WAH0834>.
LCC word order in '領你們進去' differs from UNV '把你們領進去': WH0935+WTH8689 placed on 領, WAH0853 on 你們, WAH0413 on 進去.
Second {<WAH0853>} (אֹתָהּ, 'it/her' as object of לָתֵת) retained as implicit — LCC has no explicit pronoun here.
WH03068(יְהוָה)→永恆主: LCC's theological rendering of the divine name; WAH0589(אֲנִי)→我 as in UNV.
WH04181(מוֹרָשָׁה)→爲基業: LCC's 基業 is more explicit than UNV's 業, but maps cleanly to the same lexeme.

Exod/6.lcc_original: 摩西這樣告訴以色列人，以色列人卻因了心裏着急、又因了很難作的苦工、不肯聽摩西的話。
notes: LCC reverses the order of the two causal clauses: UNV lists 苦工 (hard labor) before 愁煩 (anguish of spirit), while LCC puts 心裏着急 (anguish of heart) first, then 苦工. SNs assigned by semantic match, not positional order.

UNV 愁煩 carries WAH04480+WH07115+WH07307 (מִן קֹצֶר רוּחַ = anguish of spirit); mapped to LCC 心裏着急, attaching all three tags there. WH07307 (spirit/רוּחַ) aligns with 心裏 and WH07115 (shortness/anguish) with 着急.
UNV 苦<WH07186>工<WAH04480><WH05656>: the adjective WH07186 (קָשֶׁה = hard) maps to LCC 很難作的; the noun WH05656 (עֲבֹדָה = labor) with WAH04480 prefix maps to LCC 苦工.
LCC uses explicit name 摩西 instead of UNV pronoun 他 for the final reference; both receive WH04872.
Both implicit prepositions {<WAH0413>} remain braced: LCC has no standalone word for אֶל in either 告訴…以色列人 or 聽…摩西的話 (direction is embedded in the verbs).
LCC 以色列人卻 (second occurrence, resumptive subject) and the 因了/又因了 connectives have no Hebrew SN equivalents; left unannotated.

Exod/6.lcc_original: 永恆主告訴摩西說：
notes: 永恆主 (Eternal Lord) corresponds to 耶和華 — both render the divine name, WH03068 attaches cleanly
告訴 corresponds to 曉諭 (both mean 'speak/tell'); WH01696 + morphology WTH8762 attach together
{<WAH0413>} kept implicit — LCC has no explicit 'to' particle between the verb and 摩西, matching UNV's implicit marker
說 is identical in both versions; WAH09001 (prefix וְ) + WH0559 + WTH8800 all attach to it as in UNV

Exod/6.lcc_original: 『你進去告訴埃及王法老；叫他讓以色列人從他的地出來。』
notes: UNV 對<WAH0413>...說<WH01696><WTH8761> collapses into LCC 告訴 (a single 'tell' verb covering both 'to' and 'speak'); all three SNs attached to 告訴
LCC restructures the final clause: UNV 出<WH07971><WTH8762>他的地<WAH04480><WH0776> → LCC 從他的地<WAH04480><WH0776>出來<WH07971><WTH8762>; SNs reordered to follow LCC word order
<WAH0853> (את, direct object marker) attached to 讓, which introduces the object 以色列人, mirroring UNV 容 as the 'let/allow' pivot
LCC 叫他 ('cause him to') has no direct Hebrew lexeme counterpart; left unannotated

Exod/6.lcc_original: 摩西對永恆主抗議說：『看哪，以色列人尚且不聽我，法老怎肯聽我呢？我又是個【1】拙口笨舌【1】的人！』
notes: UNV's implicit {<WH01696>}{<WTH8762>} (וַיְדַבֵּר, 'spoke') is rendered explicitly as 抗議 in LCC; braces dropped and tags attached to 抗議 per rule 3.
UNV's 在耶和華面前 (WAH09001+WH06440 on 面前, WH03068 on 耶和華) maps to LCC's 對永恆主: WAH09001+WH06440 attached to 對, WH03068 to 永恆主.
UNV's {<WAH02005>} (הֵן, 'behold') is rendered explicitly as 看哪 in LCC; braces dropped.
UNV's {<WH0589>} (אֲנִי, 'I') is rendered explicitly as 我 in LCC (sentence-initial subject); braces dropped.

LCC restructures the final clause: UNV appends 拙口笨舌的人 as a relative modifier on the speaker; LCC promotes it to a standalone exclamation. SNs WH06189+WH08193 attached to 【1】拙口笨舌【1】 (preserving footnote markers in place).
LCC's 的話 (in 聽我的話) carries no Hebrew equivalent SN — left unannotated; the prepositional אֶל (WAH0413) already attaches to 我.
LCC's connective 又是個 and question particle 呢 have no Hebrew equivalents — left unannotated.

Exod/6.lcc_original: 關於以色列人和埃及王法老的事，永恆主就告訴摩西亞倫要把以色列人從埃及地領出來。
notes: LCC topicalizes the prepositional phrases as 關於…的事 (topic-comment structure), while UNV places them mid-sentence as 往…那裡去. The WAH0413 for UNV 往 (toward Israel) maps to LCC 關於, and the second WAH0413 for 和埃及王法老 maps to LCC 和, preserving the two distinct אֶל occurrences.

UNV has two verbs: implicit {<WH01696>}{<WTH8762>} (דִּבֶּר, spoke) and explicit 吩咐<WH06680><WTH8762> (צִוָּה, commanded). LCC collapses both into a single 告訴 (told/charged). Per Rule 6, all four tags are attached to 告訴. Per Rule 3, braces on WH01696/WTH8762 are dropped since LCC has an explicit word.
The four {<WAH0413>} occurrences in UNV were all implicit; in LCC the nouns are explicit (摩西, 亞倫, 以色列人, 埃及王法老), so braces are dropped throughout.
WAH04480 (מִן, from) mapped to LCC 從, which carries the 'from' meaning explicitly.
就 (aspect particle), 要 (modal auxiliary), and 的事 (topic nominalizer) are left unannotated as Chinese-specific grammatical particles with no Hebrew equivalents.

Exod/6.lcc_sn: 以下這些人<WAH0428>是他們父系<WH01>家屬<WH01004>的首領<WH07218>：以色列<WH03478>長子<WH01060>如便<WH07205>的兒子<WH01121>是哈諾<WH02585>、法路<WH06396>、希斯崙<WH02696>、迦米<WH03756>：這些人<WAH0428>是如便<WH07205>的家族<WH04940>。
Exod/6.lcc_original: 以下這些人是他們父系家屬的首領：以色列長子如便的兒子是哈諾、法路、希斯崙、迦米：這些人是如便的家族。
Exod/6.unv_sn_reference: 以色列人家長<WH07218><WH01004><WH01>的名字記在下面<WAH0428>。以色列<WH03478>長子<WH01060>流便<WH07205>的兒子<WH01121>是哈諾<WH02585>、法路<WH06396>、希斯崙<WH02696>、迦米<WH03756>；這是<WAH0428>流便<WH07205>的各家<WH04940>。
notes: Opening clause restructured: UNV '以色列人家長<WH07218><WH01004><WH01>的名字記在下面<WAH0428>' maps to LCC '以下這些人是他們父系家屬的首領' — WAH0428 (אֵלֶּה, these) attaches to '以下這些人'; WH07218 (ראשֵׁי, heads) → '首領'; WH01004 (בֵּית, house) → '家屬'; WH01 (אֲבֹת, fathers) → '父系'.
UNV '流便' and LCC '如便' are variant transliterations of the same person (Reuben, WH07205); tagged identically.
Second WAH0428 occurrence: UNV '這是<WAH0428>' → LCC '這些人' — same אֵלֶּה referent.
LCC '家族' (WH04940, מִשְׁפָּחֹת, families) corresponds to UNV '各家<WH04940>' — straightforward.

Exod/6.lcc_original: 西緬的兒子是耶母利、雅憫、阿轄、雅斤、瑣轄，和迦南女子的兒子掃羅：這些人是西緬的家族。
notes: UNV '這是<WAH0428>' → LCC '這些人是'; <WAH0428> (אֵלֶּה, 'these') attached to '這些人' which explicitly expands the demonstrative pronoun.
UNV '各家<WH04940>' → LCC '家族<WH04940>'; both render H4940 (מִשְׁפָּחָה, clans/families), straightforward substitution.
LCC uses colon '：' where UNV uses semicolon '；' after 掃羅 — LCC punctuation preserved exactly.
All proper nouns (seven sons + Saul + Simeon) are identical in both versions, alignment is unambiguous.

Exod/6.lcc_original: 以下這些是利未衆子的名字，按他們的世系排列的：革順、哥轄、米拉利。利未一生的歲數、是一百三十七歲。
notes: WAH0428 (וְאֵלֶּה, 'and these') maps to '以下這些' at the start of LCC's clause rather than UNV's clause-final '記在下面'; attached to '這些' as the direct translation of the demonstrative pronoun.
按他們的世系 (LCC) corresponds to 按著他們的後代 (UNV); WAH09001 (lamed prefix) + WH08435 (תּוֹלְדוֹת, generations) both attached to 世系 as a single prepositional phrase.
'排列的' in LCC is a syntactic addition with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated.
Second 歲數<WH08141> and 歲<WH08141> both carry WH08141 (שָׁנָה, year), matching UNV's double occurrence.

Exod/6.lcc_original: 革順的兒子、按他們的家族、是立尼、示每。

Exod/7.lcc_sn: 他們各人<WH0376>丟下<WH07993><WTH8686>自己的手杖<WH04294>，手杖就變爲<WAH01961>蛇<WAH09001><WH08577>；但是亞倫<WH0175>的手杖<WH04294>卻吞了<WH01104><WTH8799>{<WAH0853>}他們的手杖<WH04294>。
Exod/7.lcc_original: 他們各人丟下自己的手杖，手杖就變爲蛇；但是亞倫的手杖卻吞了他們的手杖。
notes: LCC uses 手杖 (hand-staff) throughout where UNV uses 杖; <WH04294> (מַטֶּה) attached to 手杖 at all three occurrences.
LCC 變爲 corresponds to UNV 變作 for <WAH01961> (הָיָה); tag placed after 變爲.
LCC adds 但是 (expanding UNV 但) and emphatic 卻 before 吞了; neither has a Hebrew equivalent and both are left unannotated.
{<WAH0853>} (accusative marker את) kept implicit — LCC has no explicit word for it, same as UNV.

Exod/7.lcc_original: 法老心裏頑強，不聽摩西亞倫，正如永恆主所說的。
notes: UNV '剛硬' → LCC '頑強': both render חָזַק <WH02388>; morphology <WTH8799> attaches to 頑強 as the verbal predicate.
UNV '不肯聽從' collapses to LCC '不聽': negation particle <WAH03808> attaches to 不; verb שָׁמַע <WH08085><WTH8804> attaches to 聽. LCC's 肯 equivalent is absent — no unmatched SN lost.
UNV '耶和華' → LCC '永恆主': LCC renders the divine name YHWH as '永恆主'; <WH03068> attaches to 主 as the head noun of the title.
LCC omits the '、' separator between 摩西 and 亞倫 but both names are present; <WAH0413> (אֶל) attaches after 亞倫 as in UNV.

Exod/7.lcc_original: 永恆主對摩西說：『法老心裏固執，不肯讓人民走。
notes: 耶和華 → 永恆主: LCC's distinctive rendering of the Tetragrammaton; <WH03068> attached to 永恆主 as a unit.
裡 vs 裏: character variant only, 固執<WH03515> alignment is unambiguous.

UNV '容百姓去' → LCC '讓人民走': 容 was unannotated in UNV (Chinese bridging causative); 讓 similarly left unannotated. 百姓/人民 both = עַם <WH05971>. 走 parallels 去 and carries <WAH09001><WH07971><WTH8763> (שָׁלַח = send/let go).
Minor uncertainty: whether 讓 or 走 should bear שָׁלַח tags. Following UNV's pattern of annotating the motion verb (去) rather than the causative (容), 走 receives the tags.

Exod/7.lcc_original: 明天早晨你去見法老；看吧，他出來往水邊去；你要站在河邊迎接他；那變過蛇的杖、你要拿在手裏。
notes: H03212 (הָלַךְ, go) and H06547 (פַּרְעֹה, Pharaoh) are implicit {} in UNV but explicit in LCC ('去' and '法老'); braces dropped per Rule 3.

WAH0413 (אֶל, to/toward) mapped to LCC '見': UNV leaves it implicit, LCC rephrases the directional preposition as a visitation verb '你去見法老'. Attaching to '見' is the closest semantic anchor; could alternatively be left unannotated.
WAH02009 (הִנֵּה, behold) implicit in UNV but LCC has explicit '看吧'; braces dropped per Rule 3.
H05324 (נָצַב, stand) and WTH8738 implicit in UNV but LCC has explicit '站'; braces dropped per Rule 3.
WAH05921 (עַל, upon/at) attached to locative '在' in '站在河邊', representing Hebrew עַל-שְׂפַת.
LCC rearranges the hand clause: UNV '手裡<WAH09002><WH03027>要拿著<WH03947>' → LCC '你要拿在手裏'; H3947+WTH8799 attach to '拿', H3027+H9002 prefix attach to '手裏'.

Exod/7.lcc_original: 對他說：「永恆主希伯來人的上帝差遣了我來見你，說：『讓我的人民走吧，他們好在曠野事奉我』；你看，到如今你還是不聽。
notes: 耶和華→永恆主<WH03068>: LCC renders the Tetragrammaton as 永恆主; SN attached to end of that phrase.
神→上帝<WH0430>: Standard UNV/LCC lexical divergence for אֱלֹהִים.
打發我→差遣<WH07971><WTH8804>了我: SN attached after 差遣 (the verb); 了 is an aspect particle with no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated.

容<WAH0853>…去<WH07971><WTH8761>→讓<WAH0853>…走<WH07971><WTH8761>吧: LCC uses a 讓…走 split-verbal construction. WAH0853 (אֶת accusative marker) placed on 讓 as the closest host; WH07971<WTH8761> placed on 走, mirroring UNV's placement on 去. 吧 is a modal particle, unannotated.
百姓→人民<WH05971>: Lexical variation for עַם; same SN.
{<WAH02009>}→你看<WAH02009>: LCC has the explicit phrase 你看 for הִנֵּה (behold); braces dropped per Rule 3, SN attached after 你看.
他們 (before 好在曠野): Translator-added subject pronoun with no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated.
WAH09002 (בְּ preposition) on 曠野: Follows UNV pattern of attaching the inseparable-preposition prefix tag after the host noun 曠野.

Exod/7.lcc_original: 永恆主這麼說：「看吧，我必用我手中的杖擊打河裏的水，水就變爲血：藉着這個，你就知道我乃是永恆主。
notes: 耶和華→永恆主: LCC's fixed rendering of YHWH (H03068); SN attaches to 永恆主 both times
{<WAH02009>} (הִנֵּה): LCC has explicit 看吧, so braces dropped and SN attaches directly
因此→藉着這個: UNV treats ב+זֶה as a unit; LCC splits them — ב maps to 藉着<WAH09002>, זֶה maps to 這個<WAH02063>
必用 carries no SN — it is an aspectual/modal auxiliary with no direct Hebrew counterpart
{<WAH05921>} (עַל) and {<WAH03588>} (כִּי) remain implicit: LCC has no explicit word for either

Exod/7.lcc_original: 河裏的魚必死，河必發臭，埃及人就必厭惡、不喫這河裏的水。」』
notes: UNV 腥臭 (H0887) → LCC 發臭: different phrasing, same Hebrew root (become foul/stink); tag attaches after 臭
UNV 吃 (H08354, שָׁתָה = drink) → LCC 不喫: LCC adds explicit negation 不 and uses 喫 for 吃; all three SN tags attach after 喫
{<WAH04480>} retained as implicit: LCC has no explicit word corresponding to the מִן prefix, same as UNV implicit treatment
LCC 必 in 必發臭 and 就必厭惡 are Chinese auxiliaries with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated
Punctuation order 。」』 follows LCC original (UNV has 。』」)

Exod/7.lcc_original: 永恆主對摩西說：『你要對亞倫說：「拿你的杖，伸手在埃及所有的水以上，在他們的江、河、池塘以上，以及一切積水之地以上，叫水都變爲血，以致在埃及全地，無論在木器中、在石器中、都有了血。」』
notes: 耶和華→永恆主: LCC's '永恆主' is an explicit rendering of H03068 (יְהוָה); annotated normally
{<WAH0413>}→對: UNV's implicit preposition אֶל (braces) becomes explicit '對' in both LCC speech introductions; braces dropped per Rule 3
曉諭(H0559+WTH8799)→說: LCC restructures to '對...說'; the verb H0559 and morphology WTH8799 move to '說' as the main verbal carrier
你{<WH03027>}的杖/伸: UNV's implicit H03027 (יָד, hand) in '你的杖' phrase becomes explicit '手' in LCC's '伸手'; braces dropped and H03027 attached to '手' per Rule 3

池(H098)、塘(H04723)→池塘/一切積水之地: LCC lexically splits these differently from UNV; H098 (אֲגַם, pool) → '池塘'; H04723 (מִקְוֶה, reservoir/collection of water) → '一切積水之地', which faithfully renders מִקְוֵה מֵימֵיהֶם; remaining {<WAH05921>} implicit markers retained where LCC uses no second preposition
遍(WAH09002+WAH03605)→在/全: LCC distributes these: ב prefix (WAH09002) → '在', כָּל (WAH03605) → '全', in '在埃及全地'
以致: LCC's consequential conjunction; no Hebrew counterpart, left unannotated
都有了血: '了' is a Chinese aspect particle with no Hebrew equivalent; H01961+WTH8804 attached to '有了' as the verbal unit; '都' left unannotated (not separately tagged in UNV's parallel clause either)
Missing SNs: 05921

Exod/7.lcc_original: 摩西亞倫就照永恆主所吩咐的去行：在法老和法老的臣僕眼前，亞倫舉起手杖，擊打河裏的水，河裏的水就都變爲血。
notes: 耶和華→永恆主: <WH03068> transferred to LCC's rendering of the divine name.
的行→的去行: <WH06213><WTH8799> attached to the phrase 的去行; directional complement 去 is unannotated.

{<WAH09001>}{<WH05869>} kept in braces after 法老<WH06547>: Hebrew has two 'before the eyes of' clauses (לְעֵינֵי פַרְעֹה וּלְעֵינֵי עֲבָדָיו); LCC merges them into a single 眼前 at the end, so the first occurrence for Pharaoh remains implicit.
法老的臣僕: the second 法老 in LCC is possessive elaboration of Hebrew עֲבָדָיו ('his servants'); no separate SN assigned — only 臣僕 carries <WH05650>.
舉起: LCC adds directional complement 起; <WH07311><WTH8686> attached to the whole 舉起 phrase.
手杖 vs 杖: LCC adds 手 for clarity; <WAH09002><WH04294> attached to 手杖 as a unit.
就 before 都: LCC emphasis/cohesive particle with no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated.
變爲 vs 變作: LCC's variant phrasing; <WH02015><WTH8735> attached to 變爲.

Exod/7.lcc_original: 河裏的魚死了，河也發臭，埃及人就不能喫【1】這河裏的水了：埃及全地都有了血。
notes: LCC 發臭 corresponds to UNV 腥臭了 (both render H0887 בָּאַשׁ = stink/become foul); morphology <WTH8799> attached to 發臭 as the main verb
LCC 全地 corresponds to UNV 遍…地; split as 全<WAH09002><WAH03605> (prefix+כֹּל) and 地<WH0776> (אֶרֶץ) following UNV's per-token attachment pattern
Footnote marker 【1】 preserved after 喫's SN tags, before the implicit {<WAH04480>}
{<WAH04480>} kept implicit — LCC 喫這河裏的水 has no explicit word for Hebrew מִן, same as UNV
LCC 也 left unannotated (Chinese connective with no Hebrew counterpart)
LCC aspect particle 了 (end of 水了) left unannotated

Exod/7.lcc_original: 埃及的術士也用他們的祕術照樣地行；但法老心裏剛硬，不聽摩西亞倫，正如永恆主所說的。
notes: LCC 術士 aligns to UNV 行法術的 (WH02748, H2748 חַרְטֹם = magician); the UNV phrase is verbal but LCC nominalizes it — SN attaches to the noun 術士.
LCC 祕術 aligns to UNV 邪術 (WH03909, H3909 לָט = secret arts/enchantment); prefix WAH09002 (ב) retained on 祕術.
LCC adds explicit pronoun 他們的 (their) not present in UNV; left unannotated as it has no SN counterpart.
LCC 照樣地行 vs UNV 照樣而行: WAH03651 attaches to 照樣, WH06213+WTH8799 attach to 行.
LCC 永恆主 = UNV 耶和華 (WH03068, H3068 יְהוָה); SN attaches to 永恆主.
UNV 不肯<WAH03808> maps to LCC 不 (H3808 לֹא = not); 聽<WH08085><WTH8804> maps directly to LCC 聽.

Exod/7.lcc_original: 法老轉身進宮，竟不把這事放在心上。
notes: UNV 也<WAH01571> → LCC 竟: both render גַּם (H1571, 'even/yet/still'); 竟 carries the same concessive force, so <WAH01571> attaches to 竟.
{<WAH0413>} kept implicit: WH0413 is אֶל (directional preposition 'into'); LCC has no explicit word for it — direction is absorbed by 進…宮, same as UNV.

Exod/7.lcc_original: 埃及人都在河的周圍挖地，要得水喫【1】，因爲他們不能喫【1】這河裏的水。
notes: 兩邊 (UNV, 'both sides') → 周圍 (LCC, 'surroundings/all around'): both render H05439 (סָבִיב, round about) — semantically equivalent, straightforward alignment
喝 (UNV) → 喫【1】 (LCC): LCC uses 喫 for 'drink' here (archaic usage), mapped to same WH08354; footnote marker 【1】 preserved after the SN tags
Both occurrences of 喫【1】 carry the full tag cluster <WAH09001><WH08354><WTH8800> matching UNV's pattern

Exod/7.lcc_original: 永恆主擊打了河以後、過了七天，
notes: 耶和華→永恆主: different rendering of WH03068 (יהוה), straightforward alignment
擊打了: 了 is a Chinese aspect particle with no Hebrew equivalent; SN tags placed after the full verb unit 擊打了
{<WAH0853>}: LCC has no explicit word for the Hebrew direct object marker את, so implicit braces retained
滿了→過了: WH04390 (מָלֵא, 'be full/complete') is rendered as 過了 ('passed') in LCC — semantic paraphrase for 'seven days were fulfilled'; tag attached to 過了 as the best lexical correspondent

Exod/8.lcc_original: 【1】永恆主對摩西說：『你進去見法老，對他說：「永恆主這麼說：讓我的人民走吧，他們好事奉我。
notes: 耶和華→永恆主: LCC's consistent rendering of YHWH (WH03068).
吩咐<WAH0413>→對<WAH0413>: UNV renders וַיֹּאמֶר...אֶל as 吩咐...說; LCC renders it as 對...說. WAH0413 (אֶל, 'to/unto') maps to the preposition 對 in LCC rather than the verb.
這樣→這麼: Both render כֹּה ('thus'); WAH03541 attached to 這麼.
容→讓: Both render the permissive sense; WAH0853 (אֶת direct object marker in FHL's annotation) mapped to 讓.
百姓→人民: Both render עַם (WH05971).
去→走: WH07971<WTH8761> (שָׁלַח 'send/let go') maps to 走; 吧 is LCC's aspect/modal particle with no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated.
他們 is LCC's explicit subject pronoun for the implicit suffix on עַבְדּוּנִי; left unannotated. WH05647<WTH8799> placed after 我 to cover the full 事奉我 unit as in UNV.

Exod/8.lcc_original: 你若不肯讓他們走，你就看吧，我必用青蛙擊壞你的全境。
notes: {<WAH02009>} (הִנֵּה, 'behold') is implicit in UNV (no explicit character). LCC renders it explicitly as 你就看吧, so per Rule 3 braces are dropped and <WAH02009> attaches after 吧.
UNV 容他們去 → LCC 讓他們走: straightforward semantic equivalence; all three tags (<WAH09001><WH07971><WTH8763>) attach after 走.
UNV 四<WAH03605>境<WH01366>: 四境 is a Chinese idiom ('all four borders'). LCC uses 全境 where 全 carries כֹּל (<WAH03605>) and 境 carries גְּבוּל (<WH01366>) — semantically equivalent mapping.
{<WAH0853>} (direct-object marker אֵת) has no explicit counterpart in LCC; braces retained per Rule 4.

Exod/8.lcc_original: 河裏必滋生着青蛙；青蛙必上來、進你的宮殿跟臥房，上你的牀，進你臣僕的房屋，上你人民身上，進你的手提爐子、和摶麵盆。
notes: 着 is a Chinese aspect particle with no Hebrew equivalent; WH08317/WTH8804 attach to 滋生, leaving 着 unannotated.
LCC uses 跟 (not 和) to join 宮殿 and 臥房; 跟 is treated as an unannotated connector, preserving WAH09002+WH02315+WH04904 on 臥房.
LCC 人民 (WH05971) corresponds to UNV 百姓 — same Hebrew עַם, different Chinese renderings.
LCC 手提爐子 expands on UNV 爐灶; both render WH08574 (תַּנּוּר, oven/fire-pot); SNs attach after 爐子.
LCC drops 你的 before 臥房 and 摶麵盆 (absorbed into context); the WAH09002 prefix SNs are preserved on the head nouns.
UNV 床榻 = LCC 牀 (WH04296 מִטָּה, bed); straightforward synonym.

Exod/8.lcc_original: 青蛙必上你身上、和你人民、你衆臣僕身上。」』
notes: UNV has {<WH06854>} implicit (no explicit 'frogs' written), but LCC has explicit 青蛙 — per Rule 3, braces dropped and tag attached after 青蛙.
H05927 + WTH8799 (verb 'go up') attached after 上 in 必上; 必 is LCC's auxiliary with no separate Hebrew equivalent.
WAH09002 (prefix ב 'onto') placed after 你 in each occurrence (你身上, 人民, 衆), mirroring the Hebrew preposition attaching to each object.
UNV 百姓 → LCC 人民: both render H05971 (people); straightforward lexical substitution.
LCC repeats 身上 twice (once after 你, once after 臣僕) as a stylistic choice; the second 身上 carries no additional SN as the Hebrew locative is already encoded in the WAH09002 prefix tags.
LCC 衆 = UNV 眾 — both render WAH03605 (all/every).

Exod/8.lcc_original: 【2】永恆主對摩西說：『你要對亞倫說：「你要拿着手杖伸手在江、河、池塘以上，叫青蛙上埃及地來。」』
notes: 永恆主<WH03068>: LCC's rendering of יְהוָה. The first {<WAH0413>} in UNV (implicit, attached to 曉諭) becomes explicit 對<WAH0413> in LCC — braces dropped.

Hebrew נְטֵה אֶת-יָדְךָ בְּמַטֶּךָ ('stretch your hand with your staff') is rephrased in LCC as 拿着手杖伸手. 手杖<WAH09002><WH04294> = בְּמַטֶּךָ (with your staff); 伸手<WAH0853><WH03027><WH05186><WTH8798> = אֶת-יָד + נְטֵה (object marker + hand + stretch verb). 手 is explicit in LCC where UNV had {<WH03027>} implicit — braces dropped. 拿着 is a Chinese clarifying addition with no Hebrew counterpart.

上<WAH05921><WH05927><WTH8685>: LCC merges UNV's 到<WAH05921> (directional preposition) and 上來<WH05927><WTH8685> (Hiphil imperative of עָלָה 'bring up') into the compound 上...來. All three tags cluster on 上 as the primary movement word; 來 is left unannotated as a Chinese directional particle with no independent Hebrew equivalent.
池塘<WH098>: LCC uses the fuller form 池塘 for WH098 (אֲגַם, pool/marsh) vs UNV's 池. Tag placed after 池塘 as a unit.
叫<WAH0853>: second occurrence of WAH0853 (אֶת, direct object marker), paralleling UNV's 使<WAH0853>. The causative verb carries the object-marker tag in both versions.

Exod/8.lcc_original: 亞倫一伸手在埃及的衆水以上，青蛙就上來、遮滿了埃及地。
notes: H03027 (יָד, hand) was implicit in UNV — annotated on 杖 (rod) with braces {<WH03027>} — because UNV rendered it as 'rod' rather than 'hand'. LCC explicitly says 手 (hand), so per Rule 3 the braces are dropped and the tag attaches directly: 手<WH03027>.
LCC's 一伸 vs UNV's 便伸: both express 'stretch out'; 一 is a Chinese adverbial particle with no Hebrew counterpart and is left unannotated; H05186 + morphology WTH8799 attach to 伸.
LCC uses 衆水 vs UNV's 諸水 (synonymous, both = 'all/many waters'); WH04325 attaches to 衆水 in LCC.
The second {<WAH0853>} (direct object marker before 埃及地) has no explicit word in LCC either, so the braces are preserved.

Exod/8.lcc_original: 術士們也用他們的祕術照樣地行，叫青蛙上了埃及地。
notes: 行法術的 (UNV) → 術士們 (LCC): both render חַרְטֹם (WH02748); the UNV uses a verbal phrase 'those who practice magic', LCC uses a nominal 術士們 'the magicians' — WH02748 attaches to 術士們
邪術 (UNV) → 祕術 (LCC): both translate לָט (secret arts, WH03909); the ב prefix marker WAH09002 and WH03909 attach together to 祕術
LCC inserts a structural particle 地 between 照樣 and 行 (a common Chinese syntactic filler); 地 is left unannotated as it has no Hebrew equivalent
{<WAH05921>} kept as implicit: עַל (upon/over) has no explicit counterpart in LCC just as in UNV

Exod/8.lcc_original: 法老把摩西亞倫召了來，說：『你們懇求永恆主叫青蛙離開我和我人民，我就讓你們人民走、去獻祭給永恆主。』
notes: LCC uses a 把-construction (把摩西亞倫召了來) vs UNV's verb-first order (召了摩西亞倫來); SNs for Moses and Aaron placed after their names, 召了來 as the verb phrase end receives H07121+WTH8799.
{<WAH0413>} (Hebrew אֶל, 'to/unto') kept implicit — no explicit Chinese preposition before 永恆主 in LCC; the verb-object relationship (懇求永恆主) absorbs it.
LCC 走 maps to UNV 去<WH07971><WTH8762> (H07971 שָׁלַח, 'send/let go'); both express releasing the people.
LCC adds 你們 before the second 人民 ('讓你們人民走') — 你們 left unannotated as a Chinese clarifying addition with no Hebrew equivalent.
<WAH0853> (Hebrew direct object marker אֵת) attached to 讓 as the causative verb closest in function to UNV 容.
LCC 、去 (coordinative particle before 獻祭) and 給 (preposition before final 永恆主) left unannotated; no Hebrew equivalents.

Exod/8.lcc_original: 摩西對法老說：『承尊旨，我要在甚麼時候爲你和你的臣僕跟人民、懇求永恆主剪滅青蛙離開你和你的宮殿，只留在河裏呢？』
notes: UNV 任憑<WH06286><WTH8690>你吧，{<WAH05921>} → LCC 承尊旨 is a liberal rendering of הִתְפָּאֵר עָלַי ('glorify yourself over me'). All three tags (WH06286, WTH8690, WAH05921) are bundled onto 承尊旨 since the entire idiom is compressed into one phrase. Per Rule 3, {<WAH05921>} braces dropped because LCC has an explicit phrase absorbing that sense.
LCC adds 永恆主 (LORD) as explicit object of 懇求, which has no SN in the UNV source (the Hebrew אַעְתִּיר has first-person 'I' as subject with no explicit divine object in MT). 永恆主 is left unannotated.

LCC appends '神' as explicit object of '懇求' — no corresponding Hebrew SN in source (Hebrew: וְהַעְתִּירוּ בַּעֲדִי = 'pray for me' only); left unannotated.
'倒可以' are Chinese hedging/modal particles with no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated.

Exod/8.lcc_original: 摩西說：『看吧，我要從你這裏出去，懇求永恆主，叫蒼蠅羣明天離開法老跟他的臣僕和人民；只是法老卻不可再愚弄我們、而不讓人民走、去獻祭給永恆主。』
notes: {<WAH02009>} (behold/הִנֵּה) is explicit in LCC as 看吧 — dropped braces, attached as 看吧<WAH02009>
{<WAH04480>}{<WAH05973>} (מֵעִמָּךְ = 'from-with-you') is explicit in LCC as 從你這裏 — dropped braces, split as 從<WAH04480>你這裏<WAH05973>
{<WAH0413>} (אֶל = to) remains implicit — LCC 懇求永恆主 has no separate 'to' preposition
UNV 法老<WH06547>卻<WH07535> reorders in LCC as 只是<WH07535>法老<WH06547>卻 — 只是 absorbs WH07535 (רַק = only/but), 卻 left unannotated as Chinese discourse particle

Double WAH09001 in final clause: first on 獻祭 (ל infinitive prefix לִזְבֹּחַ), second on 給永恆主 (ל prepositional prefix לַיהוָה)

Exod/8.lcc_original: 於是摩西從法老那裏出來，去懇求永恆主。
notes: Hebrew מֵעִם (מִן H4480 + עִם H5973) = 'from beside'. LCC splits this into 從...那裏: 從 explicitly renders מִן (H4480), so braces dropped; 那裏 ('that place/there') renders the proximity sense of עִם (H5973), so braces dropped.
UNV 離開 (H3318) → LCC 出來; same root sense, straightforward.
UNV 求 (H6279) → LCC 懇求 ('earnestly entreat'); LCC intensifies the verb but covers the same Hebrew root.
UNV 耶和華 (H3068) → LCC 永恆主 ('Eternal Lord'); LCC's rendering of the Tetragrammaton, same SN.
{<WAH0413>} kept implicit: no explicit directional particle ('向'/'對') in LCC for אֶל; 去 is a verbal complement ('go'), not a dedicated preposition.

Exod/8.lcc_original: 永恆主就照摩西的話行，叫蒼蠅羣離開法老跟法老的臣僕和人民；一個也沒有留下。
notes: 耶和華→永恆主: LCC's standard rendering of יְהוָה (WH03068) — attached to 永恆主 as a unit.

UNV 他的臣僕/他的百姓 use pronouns; LCC explicitly repeats 法老 ('跟法老的臣僕'). WAH04480+WH05650 attached to 臣僕 and WAH04480+WH05971 to 人民 respectively, as those are the semantic head nouns.
並他的百姓→和人民: LCC uses 人民 for עָם (WH05971) where UNV uses 百姓 — straightforward lexical substitution.
LCC semicolon (；) vs UNV comma (，) before 一個 preserved as-is per original LCC punctuation.

Exod/8.lcc_original: 這一次法老的心又固執，不讓人民走。
notes: LCC renders H3513 (כבד) in Qal intransitive construction '法老的心固執' (Pharaoh's heart was obstinate) rather than UNV's Hiphil causative '法老硬著心' (Pharaoh hardened his heart). 心<WH03820> shifts from direct object (UNV) to subject (LCC), and 固執 absorbs the H3513+WTH8686 verbal tags.
的 (possessive particle between 法老 and 心) has no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated.
{<WAH0853>} (H853, אֶת direct object marker) kept implicit and placed after 固執 verb cluster — LCC's intransitive construction has no natural slot for the object marker, so it remains braced.
讓 (LCC) = 容 (UNV) for the second H853 occurrence; 人民 = 百姓 (H5971); 走 = 去 (H7971+WTH8765).

Exod/9.lcc_original: 永恆主對摩西說：『你進去見法老，對他說：「永恆主希伯來人的上帝這麼說：讓我的人民走吧，他們好事奉我。
notes: 耶和華(H03068) → 永恆主; 神(H0430) → 上帝: both are systematic UNV/LCC differences for YHWH and Elohim respectively.
WAH0413 (אֶל, 'to') appears three times: (1) UNV 吩咐 → LCC 對 in opening clause 'said to Moses'; (2) UNV 見 → LCC 見 as preposition 'to Pharaoh'; (3) UNV 對他 → LCC 對他 in second speech verb.
UNV 百姓(H05971) → LCC 人民; UNV 去(H07971) → LCC 走: lexical equivalents, SNs transferred normally.
LCC adds 他們 before 好事奉我 for Chinese grammatical clarity — 他們 has no Hebrew equivalent and is left unannotated.
吧 (aspect particle after 走) left unannotated as a Chinese-grammar-only addition.
WAH0853 (את, direct object marker) follows UNV convention of attaching to the causative 讓 (= UNV 容), though H0853 is typically implicit in Chinese; kept on 讓 to preserve UNV alignment pattern.

Exod/9.lcc_original: 你若不肯讓他們走，仍舊強留着他們，
notes: {<WAH03588>} kept implicit — no explicit conjunction word in LCC at start of clause, same situation as UNV
容他們去 (UNV) → 讓他們走 (LCC): <WAH09001><WH07971><WTH8763> placed after 走, following UNV's convention of attaching the cluster at phrase-end
着 (aspect particle after 強留) left unannotated — no Hebrew equivalent, purely a Chinese grammatical particle

Exod/9.lcc_original: 你就看吧，永恆主的手必加在你田間的牲畜身上，加在馬、驢、駱駝、牛羣、羊羣身上，帶來極重的瘟疫。
notes: WAH02009 (הִנֵּה, behold): LCC renders it explicitly as '你就看吧' rather than leaving it implicit; braces dropped per Rule 3.
WH03068 (יְהוָה): LCC uses '永恆主' instead of '耶和華' — clear semantic correspondence.

WH01961+WTH8802 (הוֹיָה, participle of היה): mapped to '必加在' as LCC's rendering of 'will be [upon]'; '帶來' later in the sentence is LCC's idiomatic elaboration with no direct Hebrew correspondent and is left unannotated.
WAH0834 (אֲשֶׁר, which/that): Hebrew introduces the specific animal list via a relative clause; LCC achieves the same with a resumptive '加在', so WAH0834 attaches there as the structural equivalent.
WH03966 (מְאֹד, very) + WH03515 (כָּבֵד, heavy): both attach to '極重的' as a compound modifier, mirroring UNV '重重的'.

Exod/9.lcc_original: 但是永恆主必分別以色列的牲畜和埃及的牲畜：凡屬以色列人的、一隻也不死。」』
notes: 但是 unannotated — LCC-added Chinese discourse connector with no Hebrew equivalent
永恆主 (LCC's rendering of יְהוָה) receives <WH03068>
First {<WAH0996>} (בֵּין) stays implicit — LCC, like UNV, has no explicit 'between' word after 分別; second בֵּין with waw prefix aligns to 和<WAH0996> in both versions
一隻 (LCC) vs 一樣 (UNV) both map to H01697 (דָּבָר, 'thing/matter') in the idiom 'not a single one shall die'
也 unannotated — Chinese aspect/filler particle with no Hebrew equivalent

Exod/9.lcc_original: 永恆主就定了一個日期，說：『明天永恆主必在此地行這事。』
notes: 耶和華 → 永恆主 (WH03068): standard LCC rendering of the Tetragrammaton, appears twice.
時候 (WH04150, מוֹעֵד appointed time) → LCC expands to 一個日期; the measure phrase 一個 is a Chinese addition with no Hebrew equivalent and is left unannotated; WH04150 attaches after 日期.
All other lexemes (就定了, 說, 明天, 必在此地, 行, 這, 事) are lexically identical between UNV and LCC, so their SN tags transfer directly.

Exod/9.lcc_original: 第二天永恆主就行這事：埃及的牲畜都死了；屬以色列人的牲畜、一隻也沒有死。
notes: 耶和華 (UNV) → 永恆主 (LCC): both are renderings of YHWH (H03068); SN attached to 永恆主
幾乎都<WAH03605> (UNV) → 都<WAH03605> (LCC): LCC omits 幾乎 ('almost all'); <WAH03605> (כֹּל, 'all') attaches to 都
{<WAH0853>} kept implicit: direct object marker אֵת has no explicit counterpart in LCC's 就行這事
只是 (UNV) → 屬 (LCC): UNV uses 只是 as a contrast particle; LCC restructures with 屬 ('belonging to') — both are translators' syntactic additions with no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated
一個<WH0259> (UNV) → 一隻<WH0259> (LCC): 隻 is the appropriate measure word for animals; same Hebrew אֶחָד underneath

Exod/9.lcc_original: 法老打發人去看；果然看見屬以色列人的牲畜、連一隻也沒有死。法老的心還是固執，不讓人民走。
notes: UNV 誰知 (הִנֵּה, WAH02009) → LCC 果然看見; WAH02009 attached to 果然 which carries the 'sure enough/behold' meaning; 看見 is part of the expansion and left unannotated
UNV 連一個 → LCC 連一隻 (different measure words for livestock context, same WH0259 אֶחָד)
UNV 百姓 → LCC 人民 (synonyms, both map to WH05971 עָם)
WAH0853 (direct object marker אֵת) attached to 讓, which is the closest functional anchor preceding the object; no independent Chinese word exists for it
LCC 還是 (still/yet) has no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated

Exod/9.lcc_original: 永恆主對摩西亞倫說：『你們要取幾捧燒窰的灰，讓摩西在法老眼前向天撒去。
notes: UNV 吩咐<WAH0413> (the preposition אֶל 'to') maps to LCC 對<WAH0413>, which is LCC's explicit prepositional word for the same Hebrew particle.
The second {<WAH0413>} (אֶל before Aaron) remains implicit because LCC uses a single 對 covering both Moses and Aaron rather than repeating the preposition.
LCC 燒窰的灰 splits across the 的 particle: 燒窰<WH03536> (kiln/furnace) + 的 (unannotated particle) + 灰<WH06368> (soot/ash).
LCC 撒去 (scatter) = UNV 揚起來, both representing H02236 זָרַק; morphology WTH8804 attaches to 撒去.
LCC modal 要 and causative 讓 have no Hebrew equivalents and are left unannotated.
眼前<WAH09001><WH05869> consolidates UNV 面前<WAH09001><WH05869>; both 眼 and 面 render H05869 עַיִן ('eye/before').

LCC explicitly writes 在埃及全地 a second time in the second clause, corresponding to UNV's trailing implicit markers {<WAH09002>}{<WAH03605>}{<WH0776>}{<WH04714>} (בְּכָל אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם); braces dropped since LCC supplies explicit text

Exod/9.lcc_original: 摩西亞倫取了燒窰的灰，站在法老面前；摩西把灰向天撒去，灰在人身上和牲口身上就成了帶膿起泡的瘡。

First {<WAH0853>} (את direct-object marker after 取了) kept implicit — LCC has no Chinese word for it, just as UNV does not.
Second {<WAH0853>} (אֹתוֹ = 'it', pronoun object of 揚/撒): LCC explicitly resumes 灰 in 把灰, so braces dropped per Rule 3 → 把灰<WAH0853>.
LCC adds 帶膿 ('with pus') with no UNV/Hebrew SN counterpart — left unannotated.
Resumptive 灰 at the start of LCC's second clause ('灰在人身上…') is a LCC-specific subject reinstatement with no Hebrew word — left unannotated.
UNV 牲畜 → LCC 牲口: both map to WH0929 without issue.
LCC restructures the throwing clause (把灰向天撒去 vs. 向天揚起來) but all SNs align cleanly to same semantic roles.

Exod/9.lcc_original: 術士們因生瘡的緣故在摩西面前都站不住，因爲術士們身上和一切埃及人身上都生着瘡。

LCC renders this explicitly as 因生瘡的緣故: {<WAH04480>} (מִן) drops braces → attaches to 因; {<WH07822>} (שְׁחִין) drops braces → attaches to 瘡; {<WH06440>} (פָּנִים, the 'face' element of compound preposition מִפְּנֵי) has no corresponding LCC lexeme and remains in braces, placed between 因<WAH04480> and 生瘡 to preserve Hebrew morpheme order
LCC front-loads the reason clause (因生瘡的緣故...站不住) whereas UNV places it after the main clause with implicit markers; SN alignment preserved across this word-order inversion
LCC's 生着 ('were afflicted with', aspectual verbal) corresponds to UNV's 都有 annotated with <WH01961> הָיָה; the flanking <WAH09002> prefix is preserved from UNV verbatim
LCC's two 都 adverbs (都站不住, 都生着) have no Hebrew lexical equivalent and are left unannotated
Extra SNs: 09002

Exod/9.lcc_original: 但永恆主使法老的心頑強，不聽摩西亞倫，正如永恆主對摩西所說的。
notes: 但 is a Chinese discourse connector with no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated.
永恆主 (LCC's rendering of YHWH) aligned to 耶和華 and annotated with <WH03068> both occurrences.
UNV 他們<WAH0413> expands to 摩西亞倫 in LCC (LCC makes the referent explicit); <WAH0413> attached to end of the expanded phrase 摩西亞倫.
<WAH09003><WAH0834> (כַּאֲשֶׁר) placed on 所 following UNV's convention of anchoring the relative-clause marker to the 所+verb construction.

Exod/9.lcc_original: 永恆主對摩西說：『你清早起來，進見法老，對他說：「永恆主希伯來人的上帝這麼說：讓我的人民走吧，他們好事奉我。
notes: 耶和華→永恆主, 神→上帝: systematic UNV/LCC substitutions; SNs WH03068 and WH0430 attached to LCC equivalents
UNV 站<WH03320><WTH8690>在…面前<WAH09001><WH06440> condensed into LCC 進見; all four tags attached to 進見 since it semantically covers both 'stand' and 'before [face of]'
UNV 容<WAH0853>…去<WH07971><WTH8761>: WAH0853 (וְאֶת, direct-object marker with conjunction) placed on 讓 (the 'let/allow' word); WH07971+WTH8761 (שָׁלַח, send/release) placed on 走
LCC 他們 before 好事奉 has no Hebrew counterpart (LCC adds explicit subject for clarity); left unannotated

Exod/9.lcc_original: 因爲這一次我必打發我的一切疫症來擊打你本身【1】，和你的臣僕跟人民，叫你知道在全地上沒有神像我一樣。

<WAH0853> (accusative marker אֵת) attached to 一切 as the head of the direct object phrase; in UNV it was hosted on 叫 which does not appear before the object in LCC.
<WAH0413> (אֶל, 'to/upon') attached to 擊打 — UNV's 臨到 and LCC's 來擊打 both convey directed motion; the preposition maps to the directional verb.
你本身<WH03820> renders לִבְּךָ (your heart/inner self); LCC uses 本身 to convey the same reflexive nuance as the Hebrew idiom.
LCC inserts 神 before 像我 with no Hebrew equivalent (H03644 כָּמֹנִי = 'like me'); 神 left unannotated. LCC's 一樣 is also an addition; <WAH03644> attached to 像我 as the closest match.

Exod/9.lcc_original: 如今我儘可以伸手用瘟疫擊打你和你的人民，你就從這地被抹除了。
notes: H6258 (עַתָּה 'now') was implicit {<WAH06258>} in UNV but LCC renders it explicitly as 如今 — braces dropped per Rule 3.
H3588 (כִּי) mapped from UNV's conditional 若 to LCC's 儘可以; כִּי here carries emphatic/assurance force ('surely/indeed I could'), which 儘可以 conveys well.
H5971 (עַם) maps from UNV 百姓 to LCC 人民 — direct semantic correspondence, no ambiguity.
LCC's 這地 adds a deictic 這 not in the Hebrew; SN H776 attaches to 地 as the content word, 這 left unannotated.
H3582+WTH8735 mapped from UNV 除滅了 to LCC 被抹除了 — different Chinese verb but same Hebrew root (כָּחַד Niphal), confident alignment.

Exod/9.lcc_original: 然而我還讓你存立，正爲的是要向你彰顯我的大能力，並傳揚我的名於全地。

向你彰顯 ← 向你顯<WH07200><WTH8687>: LCC adds 彰 for emphasis; both render הַרְאֹתְךָ (Hiphil infinitive construct of ראה).
{<WAH0853>} retained: LCC has no explicit word for the direct object marker אֶת.
