我的名 follows 傳揚 in LCC (inverted from UNV's 使我的名傳); WH08034 attached to 我的名.

於<WAH09002>全<WAH03605>地<WH0776> ← 遍<WAH09002><WAH03605>天下<WH0776>: LCC's 於 (prep.) takes WAH09002 (בְּ prefix), 全 takes WAH03605 (כָּל = all), 地 takes WH0776 (אֶרֶץ = earth/land), matching 天下 semantically.

Exod/9.lcc_original: 你還向我的人民傲慢，不讓他們走麼？
notes: 百姓→人民: both render H05971 עַם (people); SNs transferred directly
自高→傲慢: both render H05549 סָלַל in its reflexive/haughty sense; morphology WTH8706 attached to 傲慢
容→讓: causative helper with no own SN; H07971 שָׁלַח attaches to 走 (parallel to 去 in UNV)
嗎→麼: particle swap, no SN involved

Exod/9.lcc_original: 看吧，明天大約這時候，我必下極重的冰雹，在埃及、自從建國的日子到如今，未曾有過這樣的冰雹的。
notes: <WAH02009> (H2009 = הִנֵּה, behold): UNV attaches this to 我, but LCC explicitly renders הִנֵּה as 看吧, so the tag moves to 看吧. 我 in LCC is left unannotated (implied by the Hebrew verb form).

Word order inversion: UNV orders 自從…埃及…開國…以來, while LCC restructures to 在埃及、自從建國的日子到如今. SNs are distributed accordingly — <WAH09002><WH04714> attach after 埃及 (with 在 realizing the בְּ prefix), <WAH09001><WH04480> after 自從.
開國 (UNV) → 建國的日子 (LCC): LCC expands to include 日子 (H3117, יוֹם), so <WH03117><WH03245><WTH8736> all attach to 建國的日子 as a single phrase.
{<WAH05704>}{<WAH06258>} in UNV were implicit; LCC 到如今 explicitly renders both עַד (H5704, to/until) and עַתָּה (H6258, now), so braces are dropped: 到如今<WAH05704><WAH06258>.
{<WAH0834>} (H834 = אֲשֶׁר, relative particle): LCC has no explicit relative pronoun bridging the hail clause and the since-clause, so the implicit marker is preserved.
未曾有過: 未曾 absorbs the negation (H3808 = לֹא), 有過 covers the existential verb (H1961 = הָיָה) with its morphology tag.

Exod/9.lcc_original: 現在你要打發人、將你的牲畜、和你田間一切所有的、都趕到安穩的地方；凡在田間不聚集在家裏的，無論是人是牲口，冰雹必降在他們身上，他們就必死。」』
notes: UNV 把<WAH0853> → LCC 將<WAH0853>: both are direct object markers for Hebrew אֵת (H853); SN placed after 將 rather than 把
UNV 催<WH05756><WTH8685>進來 → LCC 都趕到安穩的地方: H05756 (עוּז hiphil = bring to safety/shelter) aligns with 趕 as the main verb; LCC makes the destination explicit with 安穩的地方 which has no separate SN

Exod/10.lcc_original: 法老的臣僕對法老說：『這個人陷害我們、要到幾時呢？讓這些人走，去事奉永恆主他們的上帝吧。埃及毀壞了，你還不知道麼？』
notes: UNV 為(H01961+TH8799)...我們的(WAH09001)...網羅(WAH09001+H04170) is compressed into LCC 陷害我們: the predicative lamed+H04170 (snare) and hayah verb attach to 陷害; the referential lamed (for us) attaches to 我們

UNV {<WAH0853>}耶和華 → LCC 永恆主: the direct-object marker remains implicit {<WAH0853>} since 永恆主 is explicit but the marker itself has no Chinese equivalent in either version
神(H0430) → 上帝: systematic UNV/LCC lexical divergence; SN attached normally
{<WAH03588>} (כִּי, causal conjunction) kept implicit — LCC has no explicit connective word at that position

Exod/10.lcc_original: 於是摩西亞倫被召回來見法老；法老對他們說：『去事奉永恆主你們的上帝吧；但誰和誰要去呢？』
notes: LCC 永恆主 = UNV 耶和華 (WH03068); {<WAH0853>} direct-object marker kept implicit as LCC has no explicit particle for it.
LCC 上帝 = UNV 神 (WH0430); straightforward substitution.

Exod/10.lcc_original: 摩西說：『我們去，是要和我們那些年青的跟年老的去，和我們的兒女們去，帶着我們的羊羣牛羣去的，因爲我們的節是個拜永恆主的節。』
notes: LCC has 4 occurrences of 去 vs UNV's 2 annotated instances; assigned WH03212/WTH8799 to the first (我們去, main clause) and last (帶着...去的, after animal groups), leaving the intermediate 去 after 年老的 and 兒女們 unannotated as LCC stylistic repetition

Exod/10.lcc_original: 法老對他們說：『如果我讓你們和你們的弱小者走，願永恆主這樣和你們同在吧！【1】看哪，你們是心懷惡意的【1】。
Exod/10.unv_sn_reference: 法老對他們<WAH0413>說<WH0559><WTH8799>：「我容你們<WAH0853>和<WAH0853>你們婦人孩子<WH02945>去<WH07971><WTH8762>的時候<WAH09003><WAH0834>，耶和華<WH03068>與你們<WAH05973>同在<WAH01961><WTH8799><WAH03651>吧！你們要謹慎<WH07200><WTH8798>；因為<WAH03588>有禍<WH07451>在<WAH05048>你們眼前<WH06440>（或譯：你們存著惡意），
notes: <WAH09003><WAH0834> (כַּאֲשֶׁר = as/when) is rendered as 如果 (if) in LCC — temporal-to-conditional shift; both express the protasis of Pharaoh's sarcastic blessing, attached to 如果
LCC 願 (optative particle) encodes the jussive mood of <WAH01961><WTH8799> grammatically; left unannotated as it is a Chinese modal addition with no independent lexical SN
<WAH03651> (כֵּן = thus/so) attached to 這樣; LCC places it before 和你們 which matches Hebrew word order (כֵּן יְהִי יְהוָה עִמָּכֶם), unlike UNV which places it after 同在

Final clause is heavily paraphrased: כִּי רָעָה נֶגֶד פְּנֵיכֶם ('for evil is before your faces') → LCC '你們是心懷惡意的' ('you harbor evil intent'); <WAH03588> (כִּי = for) attached to copula 是, <WAH05048><WH06440> (נֶגֶד פָּנִים = before faces → in heart/mind) attached to 心懷, <WH07451> (רָעָה = evil) attached to 惡意

Exod/10.lcc_original: 不行，只有你們的男丁可以去事奉永恆主，因爲這是你們所謀求的』。就把他們從法老面前攆走。
notes: UNV '不可<WAH03808>' → LCC '不行<WAH03808>': both negate the command; {<WAH03651>} (כֵּן) kept implicit as LCC has no explicit word for 'so/thus' either.
UNV restructures as negative universal ('不可都去') while LCC restructures as exclusive positive ('只有…可以去'); '只有' and '可以' are LCC additions with no Hebrew equivalents — left unannotated.
LCC '男丁' = UNV '壯年人' = גֶּבֶר (<WH01397>): adult males.
{<WAH04994>} (נָא polite particle) placed after '去<WH03212>' since neither UNV nor LCC has an explicit word for it; kept implicit.
LCC '永恆主' = UNV '耶和華' (<WH03068>).
LCC '所謀求' = UNV '所求' (<WH01245><WTH8764>): LCC uses a richer verb (謀求 = seek/deliberate) but maps to the same Hebrew בָּקַשׁ.

Exod/10.lcc_original: 永恆主對摩西說：『你向埃及地伸手，使蝗蟲上埃及地來，喫地上各樣的菜蔬，就是冰雹所剩下的。』
notes: 耶和華 (H03068) → 永恆主: LCC's standard rendering of the Tetragrammaton YHWH.
杖 → 手 (H03027): H03027 is יָד (hand); UNV loosely rendered it as 'staff' in this rod-stretching context, but LCC correctly translates as 手 (hand). SN attaches to 手.

UNV '到<WAH05921>...上來<WH05927>' restructured in LCC as '上<WAH05921>...來<WH05927>': WAH05921 (עַל, upon) attaches to directional 上, WH05927 (עָלָה, go up/come) attaches to 來. Two distinct WAH05921 occurrences preserved correctly.
一切 (WAH03605) → 各樣: different renderings of כֹּל (all/every).
吃 (WH0398) → 喫: variant characters for the same word; SN attaches normally.
剩 (WH07604+WTH8689) → 剩下: LCC adds aspectual complement 下; SN tags attach to the full 剩下 phrase.
Both {<WAH0853>} implicit direct-object markers retained, as LCC has no explicit word for Hebrew אֵת in either position.

Exod/10.lcc_original: 摩西就向埃及地伸了手杖，那天一整天、那夜一整夜、永恆主引了東風到那地來；到了早晨，東風把蝗蟲都颳了來。
notes: 那一晝一夜 → 那天一整天、那夜一整夜: LCC's parallel expansion required splitting H01931(那)/H03117(天)/H03605(一整天) for the day clause, and H03915(那夜)/H03605(一整夜) for the night clause; the second 那 (before 夜) is LCC's stylistic addition for parallelism — left unannotated.
耶和華(H03068) → 永恆主: standard LCC rendering of YHWH; SN attached to 永恆主.
使(H05090/WTH8765) → 引了: SN attached immediately after 引 (main verb); 了 is a Chinese aspect particle left unannotated.
{<WAH0853>} kept implicit before 手杖: the Hebrew accusative marker אֵת has no explicit Chinese counterpart in LCC.
颳在埃及地上<WAH09002><WH0776> → 到那地來: LCC restructures as a directional VP; <WAH09002><WH0776> attached to 那地 since 地(H0776) is the lexical anchor and the waw prefix (H9002) binds to it.
都 before 颳了來 is LCC's adverbial addition (all/altogether) — left unannotated; <WH05375><WTH8804> placed after 颳了來 following the same end-of-phrase convention as UNV.

Exod/10.lcc_original: 蝗蟲上來，在全埃及地上空，息落在埃及全境，非常嚴重：以前沒有過這樣多的蝗蟲，以後也不會有這樣的。

LCC「過」（完成體助詞）無希伯來對應詞，保留不標注。
LCC「多的」無希伯來對應詞，保留不標注。

Exod/10.lcc_original: 蝗蟲遮滿了地面，弄得那地都暗黑了。牠們又喫了地上各樣的菜蔬，和樹上一切的果子、就是冰雹所留下來的：以致埃及遍地、無論是樹木、是田間的菜蔬、連一點青的也沒有留下。

{WAH03605} (כָּל) is implicit in UNV but rendered explicitly as 一切 in LCC, so braces dropped and tag attached directly to 一切
了 (Chinese perfective aspect particle, appears 3×) left unannotated throughout — no Hebrew morphological equivalent
弄得那 (connective + demonstrative) and 牠們 (pronoun added for clarity) are LCC idiomatic additions — unannotated
LCC 暗黑 reverses UNV character order 黑暗 but maps to the same root WH02821 (חָשַׁך); morphology WTH8799 retained on the verb phrase

Exod/10.lcc_original: 於是法老趕快把摩西亞倫召了來，說：『我犯罪得罪了永恆主你們的上帝，也得罪了你們。
notes: 趕快 ↔ 急忙: synonyms (hurriedly), clear one-to-one match for WH04116+WTH8762.

犯罪得罪了 renders the single Hebrew root חָטָא (WH02398+WTH8804); tags placed at the end of the phrase since LCC expands it into two synonymous Chinese words.
永恆主 is LCC's standard rendering of יְהוָה (WH03068); WAH09001 prefix retained.
上帝 is LCC's standard rendering of אֱלֹהִים (WH0430), replacing UNV's 神.
也得罪了你們: trailing WAH09001 (prefix on the Hebrew לָכֶם 'to you') attached after 你們, matching UNV pattern.

Exod/10.lcc_original: 現在求你，只這一次饒恕我的罪，請你懇求永恆主你們的上帝，只要使我脫離這一次的死亡就好啦。

耶和華 (YHWH) → 永恆主 in LCC; WAH09001 (prefix) + WH03068 transferred together to 永恆主.
神 (WH0430, Elohim) → 上帝 in LCC; tag transferred directly.

LCC adds framing 只要...就好啦 around the final clause; 只要 and 就好啦 left unannotated as LCC-native additions with no Hebrew equivalent.
WAH04480 + WAH05921 (prepositional prefix forms) attached to 使我 as in UNV — LCC uses the same phrasing.

Exod/10.lcc_original: 摩西就從法老面前出來，去懇求永恆主。
notes: H3318 (יָצָא, 'go out') maps to LCC 出來 rather than UNV 離開 — same root meaning, different surface form.
H4480 (מִן, 'from') is implicit in UNV {<WAH04480>} but LCC makes it explicit as 從; braces dropped per Rule 3.

H5973 (עִם, 'with/from before') is implicit in UNV {<WAH05973>} but LCC renders it explicitly as 面前 ('before/in front of'); braces dropped per Rule 3. Together H4480+H5973 = מֵעִם ('from with/from the presence of'), which LCC renders as 從…面前.
H0413 (אֶל, 'unto/to') remains implicit {<WAH0413>} as LCC has no explicit preposition before 永恆主.
H3068 (יהוה) maps to LCC 永恆主 ('Eternal Lord') — LCC's characteristic rendering of the Tetragrammaton.

Exod/10.lcc_original: 永恆主轉了極強勁的西風，把蝗蟲颳了起來，吹進蘆葦海；在埃及四境、連一個蝗蟲也沒有剩下。

留下→剩下: synonymous verbs (WH07604 = שָׁאַר, to remain); WTH8738 morphology retained

Exod/10.lcc_original: 但是永恆主使法老的心頑強，不讓以色列人走。

Exod/10.lcc_original: 永恆主對摩西說：『你向天伸手，讓黑暗來到埃及地：簡直是一種摸得着的黑暗。』
notes: 耶和華 → 永恆主: LCC's rendering of YHWH; <WH03068> attaches to 永恆主.

Confidence reduced to 0.87 due to clause reordering in the second half requiring distributional judgment on <WH02822> placement.

Exod/10.lcc_original: 摩西向天伸手，埃及遍地就有黑漆的黑暗烏了三天。
notes: UNV 杖 vs LCC 手: Both translate WH03027 (יָד = hand/arm). LCC is more literal; UNV uses 杖 (staff) by synecdoche. Tag follows 手.
{<WAH0853>} (direct object marker את) kept as implicit — it is a grammatical particle with no standalone lexical equivalent in LCC.
WAH01961 (וַיְהִי = and it became/there was) maps to LCC 就有 rather than just 就; attached after 有 as the existential verb carrying the Hebrew hayah sense.

UNV 烏黑 (single phrase) vs LCC 黑漆的黑暗烏 (expanded: pitch-black darkness). Both WH0653 (אֲפֵלָה, thick darkness) and WH02822 (חֹשֶׁךְ, darkness) are attached together at the end of the darkness phrase per rule 6.

Exod/10.lcc_original: 三天之久、人彼此都看不見，人也不起來、離開所在之地；惟獨以色列人住的地方都有亮光。
notes: LCC 彼此 (each other) absorbs both WH0376 (אִישׁ, man) and WH0251 (אָח, brother), which UNV renders separately as 相…[implicit]; WH0251 was effectively implicit in UNV (no enclosing braces, but no explicit character between the obj marker and 見), so collapsing both onto 彼此 in LCC is semantically sound.
WAH0853 (direct object marker אֶת) kept implicit with braces — LCC has no explicit equivalent.
Clause 2: UNV 誰 (who/each man = WH0376) → LCC 人 (man = WH0376); WAH03808 attaches to 不 since the negation is split from the verb in LCC (不起來).
LCC 所在之地 (the place where they were) aligns with UNV 本處 for WAH04480+WAH08478 (מִתַּחְתָּיו, from his place).
LCC 住的地方 (dwelling place) covers UNV 家中, taking WAH09002 (בְּ prefix) + WH04186 (מוֹשָׁב, dwelling); WAH09001 (waw conjunction) attaches to 都 as in UNV.

Exod/10.lcc_original: 法老就把摩西召了來，說：『你們去事奉永恆主，只是你們的羊羣牛羣要放下；你們那些弱小者也可以和你們一同去。』
notes: LCC uses a 把-construction (就把摩西召了來) vs UNV's SVO order (就召摩西來); 摩西<WH04872> is fronted before 召<WH07121><WTH8799>; {<WAH0413>} remains implicit since LCC's 把 absorbs the directional preposition grammatically.
LCC 永恆主 = UNV 耶和華 (YHWH, <WH03068>); tag transferred without issue.
LCC 放下 corresponds to UNV 留下 (<WH03322><WTH8714>); different lexical choice but same Hebrew נָצַב referent.
LCC 那些弱小者 corresponds to UNV 婦人孩子 (<WH02945>, H02945 = טַף = household dependents/little ones); LCC abstracts to 'the weak/young ones' rather than specifying women and children.
WAH01571 (גַּם = also/even): UNV renders it as 可以, LCC uses 也可以 — 也 is the direct match for גַּם, so <WAH01571> attaches to 也; 可以 is a Chinese auxiliary added for fluency, left unannotated.

Exod/10.lcc_sn: 摩西<WH04872>說<WH0559><WTH8799>：『你<WAH0859>也<WAH01571>要將祭物<WH02077>和燔祭牲<WH05930>交<WH05414><WTH8799>在<WAH09002>我們手<WH03027>裏，讓我們可以獻祭<WH06213><WTH8804>給<WAH09001>永恆主<WH03068>我們的上帝<WH0430>。
Exod/10.lcc_original: 摩西說：『你也要將祭物和燔祭牲交在我們手裏，讓我們可以獻祭給永恆主我們的上帝。
notes: UNV 總要 → LCC 也要: both render גַּם (H01571); WAH01571 attaches to 也 (the direct equivalent), while 要 is a Chinese modal helper with no Hebrew equivalent.
UNV 給我們<WAH09002><WH03027> expands in LCC to 在我們手裏: WAH09002 (ב prefix, 'in') attaches to 在, and WH03027 (יָד, 'hand') attaches to 手; 裏 is a Chinese locative complement with no Hebrew counterpart.
UNV 耶和華<WAH09001><WH03068> → LCC 給永恆主: WAH09001 (ל prefix, 'to/for') attaches to the preposition 給, while WH03068 attaches to 永恆主 (LCC's rendering of יהוה).
UNV 神<WH0430> → LCC 上帝<WH0430>: standard UNV/LCC difference for אֱלֹהִים.
LCC 讓/可以/要/將 are Chinese grammatical helpers or aspect particles with no direct Hebrew counterpart; left unannotated.

Exod/10.lcc_original: 我們的牲畜也要和我們一同去；連一蹄也不留下；因爲我們要從其中取出來、去事奉永恆主我們的上帝；我們未到那裏之先，還不知道要用甚麼去事奉永恆主。』
notes: UNV 帶去{<WAH05973>}: עִמָּנוּ ('with us') is implicit in UNV but explicit in LCC as 和 — braces dropped, <WAH05973> attached to 和; 去 carries <WH03212><WTH8799>
耶和華<WH03068> → 永恆主<WH03068> (LCC's standard rendering of יהוה)
神<WH0430> → 上帝<WH0430> (LCC's preferred term for אֱלֹהִים)

{<WAH0853>} (direct object marker את) retained as implicit in both clauses — LCC has no explicit word for it

Exod/10.lcc_original: 但是永恆主使法老的心剛硬，不情願讓他們走。
notes: 耶和華 (UNV) → 永恆主 (LCC): different renderings of the Tetragrammaton; WH03068 attached to 永恆主 as a unit
肯 (UNV) → 情願 (LCC): both render Hebrew אָבָה (H014, 'to be willing/consent'); WH014+WTH8804 attached to 情願
容他們去 (UNV) → 讓他們走 (LCC): both render שָׁלַח (H07971, 'send/let go'); WAH09001+WH07971+WTH8763 cluster attached to 走 as the main semantic carrier

Exod/10.lcc_original: 法老對摩西說：『你離開我去吧；可要小心；不要再見我的面；因爲你見我面那日子，你就得死。』
notes: UNV '你要小心' → LCC '可要小心': subject pronoun 你 dropped, 可 added as modal; SN WH08104+WTH8734 attached to 小心 as the verbal head in both versions.
{<WAH09001>} retained as implicit: the לְ prefix particle connecting 小心 to the following clause has no explicit lexical counterpart in LCC, same as UNV.
UNV '的那日<WAH09002><WH03117>' → LCC '那日子<WAH09002><WH03117>': LCC omits 的 and expands 日 to 日子; SNs attached to 那日子 as the equivalent noun phrase.
UNV '必死' → LCC '得死': different modal (必 vs 得) but same verb root; WH04191+WTH8799 attached to 死 as the verbal head.
Punctuation differences (UNV「」→ LCC『』, ！→ ；) preserved as-is per original LCC text.

Exod/10.lcc_original: 摩西說：『你說得好；我不再見你的面了。』
notes: UNV renders לֹא (WAH03808) as 必不; LCC drops 必 and uses only 不 — <WAH03808> attaches to 不
{<WAH05750>} (עוֹד) remains implicit: LCC's 再 already carries <WH03254> for the same 'again/more' semantic slot, leaving no explicit word for 05750
了 is a Chinese aspect particle with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated per rule 5

Exod/11.lcc_original: 永恆主對摩西說：『我再使一種災病擊打法老、也擊打埃及，然後他就讓你們離開這裏；他讓你們走的時候，一定把你們完完全全趕出來離開這裏。
notes: 永恆主 (LCC) = 耶和華 (UNV) — both are YHWH; WH03068 attached to 永恆主
LCC uses 擊打 (strike) where UNV has 臨…到 (come upon, Hiphil of בּוֹא); WAH05921 (עַל, 'upon') has no standalone carrier in LCC so it is bundled onto 擊打 with WH0935<WTH8686>
LCC repeats 擊打 before 埃及 as a stylistic parallel; the second WAH05921 (וְעַל, 'and upon') is attached to 也, which mirrors UNV's 和

UNV infinitive-absolute + finite verb 總要<WH01644><WTH8763>催逼<WH01644><WTH8762> maps to LCC 一定<WH01644><WTH8763>…趕出來<WH01644><WTH8762>; 一定 carries the emphatic inf-abs tag, 趕出來 carries the finite-verb tag
UNV 都<WH03617> (altogether/wholly) maps to LCC 完完全全 (thoroughly) — same semantic function
LCC 這裏 (here) = UNV 這地 (this land) in both occurrences; WAH04480<WAH02088> applied to both instances of 這裏

Exod/11.lcc_original: 你要清清楚楚地吩咐人民，叫他們男女各人都向鄰舍要銀器金器。』
notes: 清清楚楚地 paraphrases UNV's 耳中 (in the ears of); <WAH09002><WH0241> attached here as the closest semantic equivalent — LCC has no explicit word for 'ear', rendering the idea as a manner adverb (clearly/distinctly)
<WAH04994> (נָא, entreaty particle) placed before 吩咐, mirroring UNV's pattern of positioning this prefix marker immediately before its host verb
LCC reverses gold/silver order relative to UNV (銀器金器 vs UNV 金器銀器); <WH03701><WH03627> reassigned to 銀器 and <WH02091><WH03627> to 金器 to match LCC word order
都 in LCC has no Hebrew equivalent and is left unannotated

Exod/11.lcc_original: 永恆主使人民得到埃及人的好感。並且摩西這個人在埃及地、在法老的臣僕和人民眼中、極其偉大。
notes: LCC renders '在埃及人眼前蒙恩' as '得到埃及人的好感', collapsing the Hebrew idiomatic frame 'found favor in the eyes of' (WAH09002+WH05869+WH02580) into a single phrase — all three SNs attached to '好感' as the closest semantic anchor.
UNV's implicit {<WH0376>} (H376 ish = man) is explicit in LCC as '這個人' — dropped braces and attached WH0376 directly to '人'.

UNV has two 'in the eyes of' markers: {<WAH09002>}{<WH05869>} (implicit, for Pharaoh's servants) and <WAH09002><WH05869> (explicit, for people). LCC merges both into a single '眼中' — WAH09002+WH05869 attached once, the implicit set subsumed.
{<WAH0853>} (direct object marker, H853) has no LCC equivalent — kept implicit, positioned between verb phrase and object phrase.
Missing SNs: 05869, 09002

Exod/11.lcc_original: 摩西說：『永恆主這麼說：「大約在半夜，我必出去廵行埃及國中。
notes: 耶和華<WH03068> → 永恆主: LCC's rendering of YHWH; SN attached to 永恆主 as a unit.
這樣<WAH03541> → 這麼: semantic equivalents; SN placed after 這麼.

約到半<WAH09003><WH02676> → 大約在半: Hebrew כַּחֲצִי (כ prefix + חֲצִי = about half). LCC expands to 大約在半; <WAH09003> and <WH02676> both attach to 半 (core lexical word). 大約 and 在 are Chinese clarifying additions left unannotated.
巡行/廵行: UNV uses 巡, LCC uses variant character 廵 — original LCC text preserved exactly.
遍地<WAH09002><WH08432> → 國中: Hebrew בְּתֹוךְ (ב prefix + תֹּוךְ = in the midst). UNV renders loosely as 遍地; LCC as 國中. SNs attached to 國中.
LCC quote nesting is inverted relative to UNV (LCC: 『…「; UNV: 「…『) — LCC punctuation preserved exactly.

Exod/11.lcc_original: 在埃及地所有頭胎生的都必死：從坐王位的法老的長子，到推磨的婢女的長子，以及所有頭胎的牲口，都必死。
notes: LCC restructures the verse fundamentally: the Hebrew opening clause וּמֵת כָּל בְּכוֹר (all firstborn will die) becomes a topic sentence in LCC, then specifics follow. WH04191+WTH8804 are attached to the FIRST 都必死 (the topic sentence), which carries the semantic weight of the Hebrew predicate. The second 都必死 at the end is a Chinese rhetorical echo with no Hebrew counterpart—left unannotated.

WAH04480 (מִ 'from' prefix): UNV marks this implicit {<WAH04480>} after 法老, because UNV's sentence doesn't explicitly state 'from.' LCC uses an overt 從 to begin the enumeration clause, so WAH04480 is upgraded to explicit on 從 (per Rule 3).

WH01060 (firstborn) x3: UNV's implicit {<WH01060>} after 法老 is now the explicit 長子 in 法老的長子—braces dropped per Rule 3. Second WH01060 goes to 婢女的長子. Third WH01060 to 頭胎 before 牲口. LCC's opening 所有頭胎 (which renders Hebrew כָּל בְּכוֹר) has no matching UNV SN at that structural position, so it is left unannotated under strict UNV→LCC transfer.

WAH03605 (כֹּל 'all') x2: UNV's first WAH03605 is in the maidservant clause 所有的<WAH03605>長子, but LCC's maidservant clause omits 所有; marked implicit {<WAH03605>} between 婢女 and 的長子. Second WAH03605 (一切<WH03605> for livestock) attaches to LCC's 所有 in 所有頭胎的牲口.
WAH05921 (עַל 'upon'): LCC's 坐王位 conveys sitting on the throne without an explicit 上/於; kept implicit {<WAH05921>}.

WH0310 (אַחַר 'behind'): LCC renders the maidservant location as 推磨 (grinding at the mill) rather than 磨子後 (behind the millstone); 'behind' has no explicit word, kept implicit {<WH0310>}. WH07347 (millstone) attaches to 推磨.
WAH0834 (אֲשֶׁר relative particle): corresponds to 的 in 推磨的婢女, which structurally functions as the relative clause marker linking the activity to 婢女.

Exod/11.lcc_original: 埃及遍地必有大哀號；從前沒有這樣，將來也必不再有。
notes: UNV splits 沒<WH03808>有<WAH01961><WTH8738> across two characters; LCC fuses them into 沒有 — both SNs attached to 沒有 as one unit in the first clause.

UNV assigns H03254 (יָסַף, 'add/do again') to 後來; LCC recasts this as 再有 ('again have'), which is a better semantic host for H03254 — 將來 is a Chinese temporal elaboration with no direct Hebrew equivalent and is left unannotated.
LCC drops the nominalizer 的 from UNV's 這樣的; WAH03644 (כָּמֹהוּ) attaches to bare 這樣.
WAH03644 appears twice: once for כָּמֹהוּ in the first clause (→ 這樣) and once for וְכָמֹהוּ in the second clause (→ 也必), following UNV's own tag placement.

Exod/11.lcc_original: 但是對以色列中的衆子、無論是人是牲口，連狗也不敢向他們鼓舌吠一聲，好叫你們知道永恆主是將埃及人和以色列人分別出來的。
notes: LCC 但是 explicitly renders the implicit ו conjunction {<WAH09001>}, so braces dropped; {<WAH03605>} (כֹל, all) kept implicit since LCC has no standalone word for it — 衆子 already carries WH01121.
LCC 衆子 explicitly renders {<WH01121>} (בְּנֵי, sons of), so braces dropped.
LCC expands UNV 搖舌 → 鼓舌吠一聲; WH02782+WTH8799 attached to 鼓 (the main verb action), WH03956 (tongue) to 舌; 吠一聲 is LCC's expansive rendering with no direct Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated.
LCC 永恆主 renders UNV 耶和華 (WH03068).
UNV 牲畜 → LCC 牲口: different words, same referent; WH0929 assigned to 牲口.
Missing SNs: 04616
Extra SNs: 04416

Exod/11.lcc_original: 你這一切臣僕都要下來見我，向我俯伏下拜說：「求你和跟從你的衆民都出去」，然後我纔要出去。』於是摩西氣忿忿地離開法老出來了。
notes: LCC inverts UNV's 俯伏-來-見我 sequence to 下來-見我-向我俯伏下拜; WH03381 (יָרַד, come down) attaches to 下來 and WH07812 (הִשְׁתַּחֲוָה, bow) attaches to 俯伏下拜 accordingly.
{WAH09001} (implicit ו-consecutive on יָרַד) repositioned before 下來 since LCC places 下來 first in sequence; remains implicit as LCC expresses no explicit conjunction there.
LCC 向我 before 俯伏下拜 left unannotated — likely renders לִי (a second 'to me' for the bow clause in MT), but UNV carries no separate SN tag for it, so no tag is introduced here.
LCC 衆民 = UNV 百姓 = WH05971 (עַם, people); direct semantic equivalence despite different Chinese terms.
LCC 出來了 = UNV 出去了; both render יָצָא (WH03318 + WTH8799); 了 (aspect particle) left unannotated.

Exod/11.lcc_original: 永恆主對摩西說：『法老必不聽你們；這就使我的奇事在埃及地多起來了。』
notes: LCC uses 永恆主 as an explicit rendering of יהוה (耶和華<WH03068>); braces dropped, tag attached directly after 永恆主.
LCC inserts ；這就 before 使 for discourse flow; 使 is the semantic carrier of the purpose construction <WAH09001><WAH04916>, so both tags attach to 使.
LCC adds aspect particle 了 after 多起來 — no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated.
Missing SNs: 04616
Extra SNs: 04916

Exod/11.lcc_original: 摩西亞倫在法老面前行了這一切奇事；永恆主使法老的心仍然頑強，不讓以色列人離開他的地。
notes: 耶和華 (UNV, WH03068) → 永恆主 (LCC): SN attached to 永恆主
剛硬 (UNV, WH02388+WTH8762) → 頑強 (LCC): SNs attached to 頑強; LCC addition 仍然 has no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated
容 (UNV, WAH0853) → 讓 (LCC): WAH0853 (אֵת object marker) attached to 讓
出離 (UNV, WH07971+WTH8765) → 離開 (LCC): both tags attached to 離開
{<WAH0853>} preserved as implicit between 行了 and 這 — LCC has no explicit word for the Hebrew object marker אֵת here

Exod/12.lcc_original: 永恆主在埃及地對摩西亞倫說：
notes: 永恆主 is LCC's standard rendering of יְהוָה (WH03068), replacing UNV's 耶和華
LCC's 對 explicitly covers both UNV implicit {<WAH0413>} markers (one before 摩西, one before 亞倫); per Rule 3, braces dropped and both <WAH0413> tags attached to 對

LCC collapses UNV's two-verb structure — 曉諭<WH0559><WTH8799> (main verb וַיֹּאמֶר, Qal imperfect) and 說<WAH09001><WH0559><WTH8800> (infinitive לֵאמֹר with ל prefix) — into a single 說; all four tags attached to 說
Hebrew וְ conjunction before אֶל-אַהֲרֹן is left unannotated as LCC has no explicit connective between 摩西 and 亞倫

Exod/12.lcc_original: 『這一個月要做你們的正月，做你們一年中的頭一個月。
notes: 本(H2088 זֶה 'this') → 這; straightforward.
UNV 月(H2320 הַחֹדֶשׁ) → LCC 一個月; SN attached to 月 at the end of the phrase.
UNV 為(WAH09001 ל-prefix) maps to first 做 in LCC; the ל prefix functions as a copular 'to be as', and 要 (modal) before 做 has no Hebrew correspondent.
UNV 正(H7218 רֹאשׁ)+月(H2320 חֳדָשִׁים) → LCC 正(H7218)+月(H2320); both versions use the same two-character compound 正月.
UNV 為(WAH01931 הוּא 'it') → second LCC 做; הוּא acts as a copula resuming the predication.
{WAH09001} after 為<WAH01931> represents ל of לָכֶם; LCC has 你們 for לָכֶם but no separate word for the prefix ל, so implicit braces are retained: {<WAH09001>}.
UNV 一年(H8141 הַשָּׁנָה) → LCC 一年; LCC adds 中 ('in/of') with no Hebrew correspondent — left unannotated.
UNV 之首(H7223 רִאשׁוֹן 'first') → LCC 頭.
UNV final {WAH09001}{WH02320} (implicit לְחָדְשֵׁי) → LCC has explicit 一個月, so Rule 3 applies: braces dropped and tags attached directly as 一個月<WAH09001><WH02320>.

Exod/12.lcc_original: 你們要告訴以色列全會衆說：本月十日、他們要取小羊，各按父系的家屬，一家一隻。
notes: LCC reorders the clause: UNV has '各人要按著父家取羊羔' but LCC restructures to '他們要取小羊，各按父系的家屬'; WH03947+WTH8799 placed on 取, WH0376 placed on 各 in its new position
{<WAH0413>} kept implicit — LCC has no explicit directional particle after 告訴

LCC '小羊' replaces UNV '羊羔' for WH07716 (שֶׂה); both occurrences of WH07716 preserved (once on 小羊, once on 一隻)
LCC '十日' drops UNV's ordinal prefix '初'; SNs WAH09002+WH06218 attached after 十 before 日
他們 receives no SN — the plural subject is embedded in verb morphology WTH8799; WH0376 (אִישׁ, 'each man') redistributes to the distributive 各 later in the clause

Exod/12.lcc_original: 若是一家太小、喫不了一隻小羊，就要和附近他家的鄰居按着人數去取：你們取小羊，要按着每人所能喫的分量計算。
notes: LCC '一家' covers UNV '一家的人' — H01004 attached to 一家, dropping the explicit 的人
UNV's implicit {<WAH04480>}{<WH01961>}{<WTH8800>} (מִהְיֹת, 'from being [sufficient]') is explicitly rendered as LCC '喫不了' — braces removed, tags attached directly
LCC restructures clause boundary: '按着人數去取' in first clause absorbs H05315/H04373/H03947/WTH8804 which UNV places in the second clause
UNV implicit {<WH01004>} (house) becomes explicit '家' in LCC '他家' — braces removed; H01931 (הוא) in UNV '本人' attaches to LCC '他' within '他家'
LCC '附近' renders H07138 (קרוב = near) where UNV uses '他隔壁'
<WAH09005> placement uncertain — likely ו-prefix on שֶׂה (H07716); attached to second-clause '小羊' following UNV's '你們預備<WAH09005>羊羔<WH07716>' pattern

UNV's '人數和飯量' (two coordinated nouns) condensed in LCC second clause into '每人所能喫的分量': H05315/H04373 remain on first-clause '人數'; H0376/H06310/H0400 cover '每人所能喫的分量'; <WAH09001> (ב preposition) assigned to '按着' as its Chinese functional equivalent
Missing SNs: 05921
Extra SNs: 09005

Exod/12.lcc_original: 你們的小羊要完全沒有殘疾、一歲以內公的：從綿羊裏或山羊裏取都可以。
notes: LCC 小羊 maps to UNV 羊羔 (WH07716, שֶׂה); LCC fronts it as the subject while UNV places it near the end.
LCC has only one 從 where UNV has two 從<WAH04480>; distributed the two WAH04480 tags across 從 (綿羊 clause) and 或 position (山羊 clause) to preserve each מִן's association with its respective noun.
LCC 完全沒有殘疾 together render UNV 無殘疾 (WH08549, תָּמִים); SN placed after 殘疾 as the head of the phrase.
{<WAH09001>} kept implicit: LCC has no explicit conjunction character between 要 and 完全沒有殘疾.
LCC 以內 is a LCC expansion with no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated.

Exod/12.lcc_original: 要留到本月十四日；傍晚時分，以色列會衆全體大衆要把羊羔宰了。
notes: LCC 會衆全體大衆 reverses UNV's 全會眾 order; aligned by semantics: 會衆→H5712 (עֲדַת 'edah=congregation), 全體→H3605 (כֹּל kol=all), 大衆→H6951 (קְהַל qahal=assembly).
LCC 傍晚時分 compresses UNV 在黃昏的時候 (בֵּין הָעַרְבַּיִם); 傍晚→H6153 (עֶרֶב erev=evening), 時分→H0996 (בֵּין beyn=between), capturing the 'between the evenings' idiom.
LCC adds a second 要 before 把羊羔 not present in UNV (a Chinese grammatical auxiliary); left unannotated.
{<WAH09001>} remains implicit between 要 and 留 — no explicit conjunction word in LCC at that position.
H853 (direct object marker אֵת) attached after 把羊羔 as a unit, consistent with UNV grouping pattern.

Exod/12.lcc_original: 他們要取點血，塗在喫羊羔的房屋，兩邊的門柱上和門楣上。
notes: 各家 (UNV, 'each household') vs 他們 (LCC, 'they'): 各家 carries no SN tag in UNV, so no transfer needed.
門框<WH04201> (UNV) → 門柱<WH04201> (LCC): both render מְזוּזָה (doorpost); direct lexical equivalent.
左右<WH08147> (UNV) → 兩邊<WH08147> (LCC): both render שְׁנַיִם (two/both sides); direct lexical equivalent.
LCC has a comma after 房屋 not present in UNV; {<WAH05921>} placed after that comma, before 兩邊, since LCC has no explicit preposition word there either.
WAH05921 at 和<WAH05921>門楣 (UNV) represents וְעַל before הַמַּשְׁקוֹף; following UNV positional convention, tag inserted after 和 and before 門楣 in LCC.

Exod/12.lcc_original: 就在這一夜裏、要喫那肉，用火烤了，和無酵餅拌着苦菜喫。
notes: WAH02088 (H2088 הַזֶּה, 'this') → 這 in LCC's 這一夜裏; the 就在 preamble and 一 numeral have no Hebrew correspondent.
WAH09002+WH03915 (ב+לַיְלָה, 'in the night') → 夜裏 as a unit; 裏 is a Chinese positional suffix with no separate SN.
LCC drops 羊羔 (lamb), rendering only 那肉 for Hebrew הַבָּשָׂר (H1320, flesh) — this is actually more faithful to the Hebrew than UNV.
{<WAH0853>} kept implicit: H853 (אֵת, direct object marker) has no explicit word in LCC.

WAH05921 (H5921 עַל, 'upon/over') maps to 拌着 in LCC rather than 和 as in UNV: LCC's 和 functions as a conjunction ('and'), while 拌着 ('mixed/combined with') captures the עַל-stative sense of 'upon bitter herbs'.

Exod/12.lcc_original: 不可喫生的；斷不可用水煮；總要連頭和腿帶臟腑、用火烤了喫。
notes: UNV 五臟 (inner organs) → LCC 臟腑; both map to H7130 (קֶרֶב, inner parts/entrails)
LCC 總要 intensifies UNV 要; <WAH03588><WAH0518> (כִּי אִם) placed after 要 as the semantic head
{<WAH04480>} kept implicit — LCC has no explicit word corresponding to מִן here
Both {<WAH05921>} instances kept implicit — LCC's connective structure 連…和…帶 implies the עַל relationship without an explicit character
<WAH09002><WH04325> (waw + מַיִם) attached after 水; LCC's 用 is a Chinese prepositional construction with no Hebrew equivalent

Exod/12.lcc_original: 一點也不可留到早晨；若有一點留到早晨，就要用火燒掉。
notes: LCC fronts 一點 (topic-fronting) vs. UNV's mid-clause position; aligned to H4480 (מִמֶּנּוּ) in both clauses.
UNV's 剩下<WH03498><WTH8686>...留到<WAH05704> is split across two words. LCC's 留到 collapses this: 留 absorbs H3498+WTH8686 (remain), 到 absorbs H5704 (until). Same split applied to both occurrences.
Second clause: UNV has {<WAH04480>} implicit with no Chinese word. LCC has explicit 一點 — Rule 3 applies: braces dropped, tag attached as 一點<WAH04480>.
LCC's 也 (emphasis particle), 有 (existential verb in 若有), and 就 (consecutive particle) have no Hebrew equivalents; left unannotated.
用 in 用火 carries no SN in UNV either; 火 takes both WAH09002 (prefix waw) and WH0784 (אֵשׁ).

Exod/12.lcc_original: 你們要這樣喫：腰間束着帶，腳上穿着鞋，手中拿着行杖，慌慌張張地喫：這是向永恆主守的逾越節。
notes: WH03602 (כָּכָה, thus/in this manner): implicit {<WH03602>} in UNV becomes explicit 這樣 in LCC — braces dropped per Rule 3.
WAH0853 (object marker את): UNV makes the lamb explicit as 羊羔; LCC omits any lamb reference entirely. Both occurrences kept implicit {<WAH0853>}.
LCC modal 要 and aspect particles 着 are Chinese grammatical additions with no Hebrew equivalents — left unannotated.
WH04731 (מַטֶּה, staff/rod): LCC expands to 行杖 (walking staff) vs UNV's 杖; SN attaches to the full phrase 拿着行杖.
WH02649 (חִפָּזוֹן, haste): LCC's 慌慌張張地 and UNV's 趕緊地 are synonymous renderings of the same Hebrew noun.
WAH09001+WH03068 (לְיהוָה, to/of Yahweh): LCC restructures UNV's genitive 耶和華的 as prepositional 向永恆主; 向 carries the ל prefix (<WAH09001>), 永恆主 = Yahweh (<WH03068>).
LCC adds 守 (to keep/observe) as an interpretive expansion of the construct phrase — no corresponding SN in UNV; left unannotated.

Exod/12.lcc_original: 這一夜裏、我要廵行埃及地，把埃及地一切頭胎生的、無論是人是牲口、都擊殺掉；埃及一切神明我也要判罰：我永恆主。
notes: UNV 那<WAH02088>夜<WAH09002><WH03915> → LCC 這<WAH02088>一夜裏<WAH09002><WH03915>: '一' and '裏' are Chinese grammatical fillers with no independent Hebrew counterparts; WAH09002+WH03915 cluster on 夜裏 as the prepositional noun phrase.

LCC reorders the 'gods' clause: UNV '又要敗壞<WH06213><WTH8799><WH08201>埃及<WH04714>一切<WAH09002><WAH03605>的神<WH0430>' → LCC '埃及<WH04714>一切<WAH09002><WAH03605>神明<WH0430>我也要判罰<WH06213><WTH8799><WH08201>'; tags redistributed to match LCC word order.
LCC '判罰' covers both H06213 (עָשָׂה, execute) and H08201 (שֶׁפֶט, judgments) — two Hebrew words collapsed into one Chinese verb phrase; all three tags (verb + morphology + noun) attach to 判罰.
LCC '牲口' = UNV '牲畜' (synonymous livestock terms); WH0929 attaches normally.
LCC '永恆主' renders the Tetragrammaton (H03068 יהוה) as a descriptive title rather than transliterating; tag attaches to the full phrase.

Exod/12.lcc_original: 在你所住的房屋上、這血要給你們做記號；我一見這血。就把你們越過去；我擊打埃及地的時候，就不至於有疫病臨到你們身上來滅你們。
notes: LCC uses singular '你' (在你所住的房屋上) where UNV has plural '你們'; WAH0859 assigned to '你' accordingly.
{WAH08033} (שָׁם, 'there') kept implicit — LCC has no explicit word for it in this clause.
UNV {WAH09001} before 記號 becomes explicit on '給' in LCC (給你們做記號), since LCC spells out the lamed-benefactive 'for you' with '給'; braces dropped per Rule 3.
UNV '就越過…你們<WAH05921>' reordered in LCC as '把你們<WAH05921>越過去'; WAH05921 ('over/upon you') placed on 你們, WH06452+WTH8804 on 越過.
UNV '災殃<WH05063>必不<WAH03808>' reordered in LCC as '不<WAH03808>…疫病<WH05063>' to match LCC word order in 就不至於有疫病.
UNV '頭生的時候' carries no SN tags (translational gloss absent from Exod 12:13 Hebrew); LCC likewise omits 'firstborn' — no alignment needed.
LCC '擊打' vs UNV '擊殺' — both represent H05221 (נָכָה, smite); all three tags WAH09002+WH05221+WTH8687 attached to 擊打.

Exod/12.lcc_original: 『這一日要給你們做記念日：你們要守爲敬拜永恆主的節；要世世代代地守，作爲永遠的條例。
notes: H1961 (hayah, 'shall be') is implicit in UNV but LCC has explicit 做; dropped braces per Rule 3 and attached to 做
H2287 (chagag, second occurrence) is implicit in UNV but LCC has explicit 守 in 世世代代地守; dropped braces per Rule 3 and attached to that 守
LCC renders YHWH (H3068) as 永恆主 instead of 耶和華; both WAH09001 (ל prefix) and WH03068 attached to 永恆主
LCC inserts 敬拜 as an interpretive gloss ('for worshipping the Eternal Lord'); left unannotated
LCC 條例 maps to UNV 定例, both = H2708 chuqqah
LCC reorders first clause (這一日 fronted as topic); SN assignments follow semantic content, not surface order

Exod/12.lcc_original: 你們要喫無酵餅七天；頭一天、就要把酵從你們家中除去；因爲從頭一天到第七天、凡喫有酵之物的、那人必須從以色列中被剪除。
notes: UNV 日 → LCC 天 (both = 'day'); WH03117 attached to 天 at all four occurrences
{<WH0389>} kept in braces — LCC omits this emphatic asseverative particle entirely
UNV '各家' → LCC '家' (drops 各 'each'); WH01004 attaches to 家 only
{<WH05315>} promoted to explicit: LCC renders נֶפֶשׁ as 那人, so braces dropped → 那人<WH05315>
UNV '有酵之餅' → LCC '有酵之物' (物 vs 餅, same SN WH02557 = חָמֵץ 'leaven'); attached to 物
LCC 就 (connective) and 被 (passive marker) left unannotated — no Hebrew equivalents
WAH09002 (בְּ prefix) retained on first-day construction: 頭一<WH07223>天<WAH09002><WH03117>

Exod/12.lcc_original: 頭一天你們要有聖聚會，第七天也要有聖聚會；這兩天之內、除了各人所必須喫的、你們所可豫備的以外，一切的工作都不可作。
notes: UNV places 預備[WH06213] before 各人所要吃, but LCC restructures the clause: '各人所必須喫的、你們所可豫備的以外'. WH06213+WTH8735 attached to 豫備 as the natural lexical match; the same root עשה appears again on 作.
WH04744 (assembly/convocation) attached to 聚會 as a unit since LCC uses 聚會 where UNV uses 會 alone.
{<WH0389>} (אַךְ = only/surely) kept implicit. LCC's 必須 may represent this emphatic particle explicitly, but since 必須 also carries modal meaning not inherent in אַךְ, implicit is safer.
{<WAH09001>} after the second 聖聚會 kept implicit — LCC's ；separates the two clauses without an explicit lexical equivalent for this prefix.
UNV's 無論何<WAH03605>工<WH04399> maps cleanly to LCC's 一切<WAH03605>的工作<WH04399>.

Exod/12.lcc_original: 你們要守無酵餅的節，因爲正當這一日、我把你們的軍隊從埃及地領出來；所以你們要守這一日，世世代代，作爲永遠的條例。
notes: LCC adds 餅 to form 無酵餅 (making מַצּוֹת H4682 more explicit); H4682 attaches to 無酵餅, the unannotated 的節 carries the 'feast-of' sense with no separate Hebrew root.
LCC inserts 一 in 這一日 (both occurrences); 一 has no Hebrew equivalent, so H2088 (הַזֶּה) attaches to 這 and H3117 (יוֹם) to 日, leaving 一 unannotated.
Word order differs in first clause: UNV 我正當…這日把 vs LCC 正當這一日、我把; SNs were redistributed to follow LCC word order while preserving the same semantic groupings.
LCC 條例 replaces UNV 定例 — both translate חֻקָּה (H2708); same SN applied without issue.
{<WAH0853>} kept implicit in both occurrences; LCC has no explicit particle corresponding to the Hebrew direct object marker אֶת before the feast/day.
LCC 作爲 in second clause (世世代代，作爲永遠…) has no dedicated Hebrew lexeme in that position; left unannotated. The לְ prefix (WAH09001) was assigned to 世世代代 as it modifies the generational scope.

Exod/12.lcc_original: 正月十四日晚上、到二十一日晚上你們要喫無酵餅。
notes: LCC omits the preposition 從 that opens UNV; its SN tags (<WAH09002><WH07223>) belong to 正 (the ordinal 'first'), which LCC retains — attached there.
UNV 直到 → LCC 到; <WAH05704> attached to 到.
Second month is implicit in both UNV ({<WAH09001>}{<WH02320>}) and LCC (no explicit 月 between 到 and 二十一); braces preserved.
UNV 吃 → LCC 喫 (archaic orthographic variant, same word); <WH0398><WTH8799> attached normally.

Exod/12.lcc_original: 七天之內你們家中不可有酵；因爲凡喫有酵之物的、無論是寄居的、是本地人，那人總必須從以色列的會衆中被剪除。
notes: LCC reorders the opening clause: 七天之內 precedes 你們家中, whereas UNV puts 在你們各家中 first. Tags follow LCC word order accordingly.
LCC uses 天 (WH03117) instead of UNV's 日 — same Hebrew יוֹם, tag attached to 天.
UNV 本<WAH09002><WH0249>地<WH0776>的 → LCC collapses to 本地人; all three tags (WAH09002 + WH0249 + WH0776) attached together to 本地人 since the phrase covers both אֶזְרָח (native) and אֶרֶץ (land).
{<WH05315>} is implicit in UNV but LCC has the explicit noun 那人 (that person) for נֶפֶשׁ הַהִוא; braces dropped and both WH05315 + WAH01931 (הִוא, that one) attached to 那人.
LCC 被剪除 uses a Chinese passive marker 被 with no Hebrew equivalent; tags placed after 剪除 as the semantic verb (WH03772 + WTH8738).
LCC 會衆 (congregation + multitude) corresponds to UNV 會 (WH05712 = עֵדָה); WAH04480 (מִן prefix) attached together with WH05712 to 會衆.

Exod/12.lcc_sn: 一切<WAH03605>有酵之物<WH02557>、你們都不可<WAH03808>喫<WH0398><WTH8799>；在你們一切<WAH09002><WAH03605>的住所<WH04186>、你們都要喫<WH0398><WTH8799>無酵餅<WH04682>。』
Exod/12.lcc_original: 一切有酵之物、你們都不可喫；在你們一切的住所、你們都要喫無酵餅。』
notes: WAH03605 (כָּל): UNV attaches it to 都 after 你們 ('你們都<WAH03605>'), but LCC fronts 一切 to directly modify the noun 有酵之物, matching the Hebrew כָּל מַחְמֶצֶת word order more literally. WAH03605 is therefore placed on LCC's 一切 in the first clause.
LCC's second clause adds an explicit 你們都 before 要喫 as a Chinese syntactic clarifier not present in UNV's surface structure; left unannotated.
WAH09002 (בְּ prefix): Grouped with 一切 in the second clause (在你們一切<WAH09002><WAH03605>的住所) to parallel UNV's 在你們一切<WAH09002><WAH03605> grouping, treating 在...一切 as the compound בְּכֹל unit.
住所 (WH04186) substitutes UNV's 住處 — same Hebrew מוֹשָׁב root, straightforward alignment.

Exod/12.lcc_original: 於是摩西把以色列衆長老召了來，對他們說：『你們要按着家口挑取羊羔，把這逾越節的羊羔宰了。
notes: LCC reorders '摩西召了…長老來' → '摩西把…長老召了來'; 把 is a Chinese coverb with no Hebrew equivalent and left unannotated; SNs for 召 (WH07121/WTH8799) placed after 召了 in the new position
LCC 挑取 collapses UNV's two imperatives 取<WH03947><WTH8798> and 出<WH04900><WTH8798> into one compound verb; all four tags attached to 挑取 (rule 6)
{<WAH09001>} retained as implicit after 羊羔 — no explicit LCC word corresponds to this prefix particle at that position

Exod/12.lcc_original: 要拿一把脣形薄荷，蘸碗盆裏的血，將碗盆裏的血打在門楣上、和兩邊的門柱上；直到早晨、你們誰也不可出自己的房門口。
notes: 牛膝草 (UNV, WH0231) → 脣形薄荷 (LCC): different Chinese terms for the same plant (hyssop); SN attached to LCC term.

LCC repeats 碗盆裏的血 explicitly before 打, corresponding to UNV's implicit cluster {WAH04480}{WH01818}{WAH0834}{WAH09002}{WH05592} (Hebrew: מִן-הַדָּם אֲשֶׁר בַּסַּף = 'from the blood that is in the basin'). Per rule 3, braces dropped and SNs attached explicitly: 碗盆裏→WAH09002+WH05592, 的→WAH0834, 血→WAH04480+WH01818. The first 碗盆裏的血 (after 蘸) retains its own SNs separately.
LCC reverses clause order: 直到早晨 leads the second clause rather than closing it as in UNV; SNs follow LCC word order.
兩邊 (LCC) = 左右的 (UNV), both mapped to WH08147 (שְׁתֵּי, 'two/both sides').
門柱 (LCC) = 門框 (UNV), both mapped to WH04201 (מְזוּזָה, doorpost/doorframe).
門口 (LCC) = 門 (UNV), both carry WAH04480+WH06607 (מִן+פֶּתַח, 'from the entrance').
要 and 將 are LCC-specific Chinese function words with no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated.

Exod/12.lcc_original: 因爲永恆主要廵行、來擊死埃及人；他看見有血在門楣上和兩邊的門柱上，永恆主就會把那門越過去，不容那滅命者進你們的房屋來擊死你們。
notes: UNV 耶和華 = LCC 永恆主; second occurrence was implicit {<WH03068>} in UNV but LCC repeats 永恆主 explicitly → braces dropped per Rule 3
UNV 巡行 = LCC 廵行 (variant character, same word)
UNV 擊殺 = LCC 擊死 (synonyms); WAH09001+WH05062+WTH8800 attached to both occurrences
LCC adds 有 before 血 as a Chinese existential construction with no Hebrew equivalent → left unannotated; {<WAH0853>} object-marker kept implicit before 血
UNV 左右的 = LCC 兩邊的 (both = 'two sides'); WH08147 transferred
UNV 門框 = LCC 門柱 (both = door-post/frame); WH04201 transferred
LCC rephrases 越過那門 as 把那門越過去 (把-construction fronts the object); WH06607 attached to 那門, WH06452+WTH8804 to 越, WAH05921 to 過
{<WAH0413>} preposition אֶל kept implicit after 進 SNs — no explicit 'into' word in LCC

Exod/12.lcc_original: 這個禮節你們要守着，給你和你子孫做定例到永遠。
notes: H5704 (עַד, 'until') is implicit in UNV as {<WAH05704>}, but LCC renders it explicitly as 到 — braces dropped per Rule 3, tag attached after 到.
Word order inversion: UNV has 永遠的定例 (everlasting statute), LCC has 做定例到永遠 (as statute until forever). SNs for H2706 and H5769 are placed in LCC's order, not UNV's.
UNV 作為你們<WAH09001> maps to LCC 給你<WAH09001> — 給 carries the לְ ('for') sense; <WAH09001> tag placed after 你 as the full unit.
UNV 著<WAH0853> (object marker H853) maps to LCC 着 (graphic variant); tag attached after 着.
LCC uses 你 (singular) where UNV has 你們 (plural) — this is a translator's choice; LCC text preserved as-is.

Exod/12.lcc_original: 將來你們到了永恆主按所應許而賜給你們的地，總要守這事奉禮。
notes: 日後→將來: H1961 (היה, come to pass) + WTH8804 + H3588 (כִּי, when/that) mapped to 將來; both phrases express temporal futurity.
{<WAH0413>} remains implicit: LCC 到了 carries the directional sense of אֶל just as UNV 到了 does; no explicit word in LCC to attach it to.
按<WAH09003><WAH0834>所<WAH0834>: UNV 按著 collapses to LCC 按, keeping <WAH09003><WAH0834> (כַּ + אֲשֶׁר) on 按; second <WAH0834> stays on 所 as the nominalizing relative particle.
LCC 而 (conjunctive between 應許 and 賜) has no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated.
LCC 事奉禮 expands UNV 禮 but the underlying Hebrew עֲבֹדָה (H5656) covers service/ritual; all three characters tagged together as one semantic unit.

Exod/12.lcc_sn: 將來<WAH01961><WTH8804>你們的兒女<WH01121>若<WAH03588>問你們<WAH0413>說<WH0559><WTH8799>：「這<WAH02063>事奉禮<WH05656>對你們有甚麼<WAH04100>意思{<WAH09001>}？」
Exod/12.lcc_original: 將來你們的兒女若問你們說：「這事奉禮對你們有甚麼意思？」
notes: H01961 (היה, 'come to pass') was implicit {<WAH01961>} in UNV but LCC has explicit 將來; dropped braces per Rule 3. Morphology <WTH8804> attached immediately after.
H03588 (כִּי, 'when/if') was implicit {<WAH03588>} in UNV but LCC has explicit 若; dropped braces per Rule 3.
H05656 (עֲבֹדָה, 'service'): UNV renders as single character 禮, LCC expands to 事奉禮; SN attaches to end of the fuller phrase per Rule 6.
對你們 in LCC's question clause (Hebrew לָכֶם, 'to you') has no corresponding SN in UNV; left unannotated.
{<WAH09001>} (conjunction vav) remains implicit — LCC has no explicit conjunction character at verse end, same as UNV.

Exod/12.lcc_original: 你們就要說：「這是獻給永恆主的逾越節之祭。當以色列人在埃及、永恆主擊死了埃及人的時候，他越過以色列人的房屋，援救了我們的家。」』於是人民俯伏敬拜。
notes: 耶和華→永恆主: LCC's standard rendering of YHWH; WAH09001+WH03068 transferred normally to 永恆主
LCC made the implicit subject 他 explicit (永恆主) in the temporal clause; 擊死了 maps to UNV 擊殺 (WH05062+WTH8800+WAH09002)
LCC restructured the temporal clause: 的時候 moved to end of entire clause rather than after 在埃及, but SN placements remain anchored to their lexical words
越過 is one compound verb in LCC vs UNV's 越...過; all three tags (WH06452+WTH8804+WAH05921) attached to 越過
俯伏←低頭 (WH06915+WTH8799), 敬拜←下拜 (WH07812+WTH8691): morphological split is semantically justified but LCC's pairing differs from UNV
{<WAH0834>} and both {<WAH0853>} kept implicit — LCC has no explicit Hebrew relative particle or accusative markers
LCC's 要 (modal aspect) and 的 (possessive in 永恆主的逾越節) are Chinese grammatical particles with no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated

Exod/12.lcc_original: 以色列人就去辦理；永恆主怎樣吩咐摩西亞倫，以色列人就怎樣行。
notes: LCC restructures the verse with a chiastic arrangement: [obedience] ; [command] , [obedience]. UNV follows the Hebrew order [command] , [obedience].
H3212 ({<WH03212>}{<WTH8799>}, implicit in UNV) is made explicit as 去 in LCC → dropped braces per Rule 3.
H6213+WTH8804 ({<WH06213>}{<WTH8804>}, implicit in UNV) is made explicit as 辦理 in LCC → dropped braces per Rule 3.
以色列人 (H3478+H1121) appears only once in UNV/Hebrew but twice in LCC; annotated both occurrences since both clearly refer to בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל.
永恆主 assigned H3068 (יְהוָה) — LCC's rendering of 耶和華.
{<WAH0853>} (את, direct object marker) kept implicit — LCC has no explicit word for it.

Exod/12.lcc_original: 埃及人催促以色列民，打發他們趕快離開埃及地，因爲埃及人說：『我們都快要死了。』

Exod/12.lcc_original: 以色列民就拿沒有發過酵的生麵、用衣裳把摶麵盆綁着，扛在肩頭上。

LCC reorders clothing before trough: 用衣裳把摶麵盆綁着 vs UNV 摶麵盆包在衣服中; SNs distributed following LCC word order per Rule 7

UNV 就拿著 → LCC 就拿 (aspect particle 著 dropped); <WH05375><WTH8799> attached after 拿

Exod/12.lcc_original: 以色列人照摩西的話而行，向埃及人要銀器金器和衣裳。
notes: LCC reverses the metal order: UNV has 金器、銀器 but LCC has 銀器金器; SNs WH03701/WH03627 assigned to 銀器 and WH02091/WH03627 to 金器 accordingly
UNV 照著 → LCC 照…而行; aspect particle 著 and connective 而 have no SN equivalents and are left unannotated; 行 carries WH06213+WTH8804
WAH09003 (כְּ prefix, 'according to') kept attached to 話 as in UNV

Exod/12.lcc_sn: 永恆主<WH03068>使人民<WH05971>得到<WH05414><WTH8804>埃及人<WH04714>的{<WAH0853>}好感<WAH09002><WH05869><WH02580>，以致埃及人將以色列人所要<WH07592><WTH8686>的給了他們，他們就把<WAH0853>埃及人<WH04714>的財物掠奪<WH05337><WTH8762>走了。
Exod/12.lcc_original: 永恆主使人民得到埃及人的好感，以致埃及人將以色列人所要的給了他們，他們就把埃及人的財物掠奪走了。
Exod/12.unv_sn_reference: 耶和華<WH03068>叫百姓<WH05971>在埃及人<WH04714>眼前<WAH09002><WH05869>蒙<WH05414><WTH8804>{<WAH0853>}恩<WH02580>，以致埃及人給他們所要<WH07592><WTH8686>的。他們就把<WAH0853>埃及人<WH04714>的財物奪去了<WH05337><WTH8762>。

{<WAH0853>} (direct object marker אֶת) kept implicit before 好感 — no explicit equivalent in LCC's phrasing
得到 maps to WH05414+WTH8804 (נָתַן Qal perfect): LCC frames the event from the recipient's perspective (obtained) vs. UNV's 蒙 (received/was granted), but the underlying Hebrew root is the same
掠奪 in LCC replaces UNV's 奪去 as the anchor for WH05337+WTH8762 (נָצַל Niphal, to plunder/strip); 走了 is a Chinese resultative complement with no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated

Exod/12.lcc_original: 以色列人從蘭塞起行，往疎割去；除了弱小的以外，步行的男丁約有六十萬。
notes: LCC uses 疎 (not 疏 as in UNV) for Succoth — preserved LCC's spelling exactly.

UNV '婦人孩子' → LCC '弱小的以外': Hebrew מִלְּבַד הַטַּף splits as לְבַד (H0905+WAH09001) = '除了…以外' exclusion frame, and טַּף (H02945+WAH04480) = '弱小的'. WAH04480+WH02945 attached after '弱小的'; '以外' left unannotated as it is part of the Chinese 除了…以外 construction with no independent Hebrew correspondent.
UNV '男人' → LCC '男丁': semantically equivalent (adult male, H01397), tag transferred directly.
去 carries no SN in UNV and remains unannotated in LCC.

Exod/12.lcc_original: 又有許多雜族衆人、跟極多的牲畜、包括羊羣牛羣、和他們一同上去。
notes: WH06154 (עֵרֶב, mixed multitude): UNV '閒雜人' → LCC '雜族衆人'; same referent, different phrasing — tagged to full noun phrase.

UNV has {WH03966}{WH03515}{WH04735} as implicit markers (מְאֹד + כָּבֵד + מִקְנֶה). LCC renders these explicitly as '極多的牲畜', so braces dropped per Rule 3: WH03966+WH03515 attach to '極多' (very numerous), WH04735 attaches to '牲畜' (livestock).
LCC restructures the livestock passage — placing '極多的牲畜' before '包括羊羣牛羣' (UNV lists sheep/cattle first, then the implicit quantity/livestock tags). SNs follow LCC word order rather than UNV order.
WAH01571 (גַּם, also/moreover) attaches to '又有' as in UNV — same Chinese particle, same position.

Exod/12.lcc_original: 他們用埃及帶出來的生麵烤成了無酵的烙餅；這生麵是沒有發過酵的，因爲他們被催趕離開埃及，不能耽延，也沒有爲自己預備甚麼乾糧。
notes: UNV 原<WAH03588> (כִּי, 'for/that') has no direct LCC equivalent; LCC uses a 是…的 copular construction instead. H03588 rendered implicit as {<WAH03588>} before 沒有 to mark its position in the clause.
LCC 了 (post-verbal aspect particle after 烤成), attributive 的 (after 無酵), and clause-final 的 (after 酵) are left unannotated as Chinese-only grammatical particles with no Hebrew correspondence.

H3605 (כֹּל 'all') is rendered as 都 in UNV but as 全 in LCC — attached to 全

Exod/12.lcc_original: 以色列全會衆都要這樣行。

男子 → 男丁 (same referent: adult male); <WH02145> aligned to 男丁
然後才容他前來 → 纔可以走近前來: 纔 absorbs <WAH0227> (then/after); 走近前來 absorbs <WH07126><WTH8799>
Second 舉行 (LCC) absorbs UNV 遵守<WAH09001><WH06213><WTH8800> — LCC uses the same verb 舉行 for both 守 occurrences

Exod/12.lcc_original: 本地人和寄居在你們中間的外僑、都屬同一樣的法規。』
notes: 外人 (UNV) → 外僑 (LCC): direct semantic equivalent, <WAH09001><WH01616> attached after 外僑 unchanged.

同歸<WAH01961><WTH8799>一<WH0259>例<WH08451> (UNV) → 都屬同一樣的法規 (LCC): LCC rephrases heavily. 都屬 carries the H1961 (הָיָה, to be/belong) verb with its morphology. H259 (אֶחָד, one) is embedded in 同一; tag placed after 一 to mark the specific character rather than the full compound. H8451 (תּוֹרָה, law) attached after 法規.

Confidence reduced slightly due to the restructured predicate clause 都屬同一樣的法規 vs. UNV's 同歸一例 — the H1961 attachment to 都屬 is semantically sound but the morpheme boundary is less clean than a one-to-one match.

Exod/12.lcc_original: 以色列衆人就這樣行：永恆主怎樣吩咐摩西亞倫，以色列人就怎樣行。
notes: LCC restructures the verse with a summary clause before the colon, then restates: [Israel did thus]: [as commanded], [Israel did thus]. MT has only one occurrence of the subject and the action.
UNV implicit {<WH06213>}{<WTH8799>} (וַיַּעֲשׂוּ, initial main verb) maps to explicit 行 in LCC's first clause per Rule 3 — braces dropped, SN attached directly.
永恆主 ← 耶和華 (H3068): LCC's different name for YHWH; no semantic ambiguity.
LCC's second 以色列人 (before final 就怎樣行) has no MT counterpart — subject is not repeated in Hebrew — left unannotated.
就這樣 in first clause: 就 is a Chinese discourse connector with no Hebrew equivalent; 這樣 is also LCC's stylistic addition to the summary; neither receives a SN tag. Only 行 (the verb) is annotated there.
{<WH0853>} before 亞倫 kept implicit: LCC uses no conjunction or DO particle between 摩西 and 亞倫 (written as a bare sequence 摩西亞倫).

Exod/12.lcc_original: 就在這一天、永恆主就將以色列人一軍隊一軍隊地從埃及地領出來。
notes: {<WAH01961>}{<WTH8799>} kept implicit: LCC omits 'it came to pass' (וַיְהִי) entirely, no explicit word to attach to.

'就在這一天' clusters four Hebrew tokens (WAH09002 בְּ + WH06106 עֶצֶם + WH03117 יוֹם + WAH02088 הַזֶּה); LCC reorders Hebrew's 'bone-of-the-day-the-this' to natural Chinese order, so 就在 gets the prep prefix, 這 gets H2088, and 一天 absorbs H6106+H3117.
'就將' — 將 serves the same direct-object-marking function as Hebrew אֵת (WAH0853), following UNV convention where 將 carries the H853 tag.

'一軍隊一軍隊地' is LCC's distributive rendering of Hebrew עַל-צִבְאֹתָם ('according to their hosts'); both WAH05921 and WH06635 appended to the end of the whole distributive phrase since it covers the entire Hebrew unit.
'從埃及地' follows the UNV FHL tagging convention: 從 unannotated, 埃及 carries WH04714 (מִצְרַיִם), 地 carries WAH04480+WH0776 (מֵאֶרֶץ).

Exod/13.lcc_original: 永恆主對摩西說，
notes: 永恆主 renders 耶和華 (WH03068) — SN attaches to the full two-character phrase as a unit
LCC uses explicit 對 for the implicit אֶל ({<WAH0413>}) — dropped braces per Rule 3 (explicit word present)

LCC merges UNV's two-verb structure 曉諭...說 (Hebrew דִּבֶּר + לֵאמֹר) into a single 說 — all five tags (WH01696, WTH8762, WAH09001, WH0559, WTH8800) attach to that single word; confidence reduced because this is a one-to-many collapse

Exod/13.lcc_original: 『要把一切頭胎的分別爲聖而歸我：在以色列人之中、凡頭胎的、無論是人是牲口、都是我的。』
notes: LCC restructures the sentence order: command clause (分別爲聖而歸我) is fronted before the qualifying phrase, reversing the UNV/Hebrew sequence. SNs placed accordingly.

WH06363 (פֶּטֶר, opening-of-womb) and WH07358 (רֶחֶם, womb) were implicit {braces} in UNV because 頭生的 has no explicit 'womb' word. In LCC, 胎 (= womb/fetus) explicitly surfaces this concept, so braces are dropped and both SNs attach to 頭胎的 alongside WH01060.

頭胎的 appears twice in LCC due to LCC's fronted-command restructuring. All noun SNs (WH01060, WH06363, WH07358) placed on the first occurrence (primary object of the command); the second occurrence in the explanatory clause is a resumptive restatement with no additional Hebrew noun behind it, left unannotated.
WAH09002 on 之中 corresponds to UNV's 中<WAH09002><WH01121>; LCC makes 人 (WH01121, sons/people) explicit as a standalone character before 之中.
牲口 (LCC) vs 牲畜 (UNV): different words, same referent (WH0929, בְּהֵמָה).
Extra SNs: 03605

Exod/13.lcc_original: 摩西對人民說：『你們要記念這一天，你們從埃及爲奴之家出來的這一天，因爲永恆主用他手的大權能、將你們從這裏領出去；有酵之物都不可喫。
notes: 人民 (LCC) ← 百姓 (UNV), both = עַם WH05971
永恆主 (LCC) ← 耶和華 (UNV), both = יהוה WH03068; systematic LCC rendering of the Tetragrammaton

UNV word order '大能<WAH09002><WH02392>的手<WH03027>' inverted in LCC to '手的大權能': WAH09002(ב prefix) placed on 用 (which expresses the instrumental ב), WH03027(יָד=hand) on 手, WH02392(חֹזֶק=strength) on 大權能

LCC doubles 這一天 for literary emphasis (記念這一天…出來的這一天); SNs for הַיֹּום הַזֶּה (WH02088+WH03117) annotated on the FIRST occurrence as the direct object of 記念; second 這一天 in the relative clause is LCC's stylistic repetition with no Hebrew counterpart — left unannotated
{<WAH0853>} kept in braces: אֶת is a grammatical accusative marker with no lexical Chinese equivalent, even though LCC makes the object explicit
從這裏<WAH04480><WAH02088> ← UNV 從這地方<WAH04480><WAH02088>; both render מִזֶּה (from here/this place)
有酵之物 (LCC) ← 有酵的餅 (UNV), both = חָמֵץ WH02557
喫 is LCC's orthographic variant of 吃; WH0398+WTH8735 attached normally

Exod/13.lcc_sn: 你們<WAH0859>出去、是在亞筆<WH024>月<WAH09002><WH02320>這一日<WH03117>出去<WH03318><WTH8802>的。
Exod/13.lcc_original: 你們出去、是在亞筆月這一日出去的。
Exod/13.unv_sn_reference: 亞筆<WH024>月<WAH09002><WH02320>間的這日是你們<WAH0859>出來<WH03318><WTH8802>的日子<WH03117>。
notes: LCC uses a cleft/topicalization structure '你們出去、是在...出去的' where 出去 appears twice; SN <WH03318><WTH8802> is attached to the second (predicate) 出去 as the semantically focal occurrence — the first 出去 is a topicalized noun phrase (structural repetition) and left unannotated.
UNV tags H3117 on 日子 (predicate nominal in '是...的日子'); LCC uses 這一日 as the corresponding locative NP — tagged there.
WAH09002 (ב 'in') + WH02320 (חֹדֶשׁ 'month') kept together on 月 as in UNV.
UNV has a dangling 這日 without SN alongside the tagged 日子; LCC collapses both into a single 這一日, so only one H3117 tag is needed.

Exod/13.lcc_original: 將來永恆主領你們進迦南人、赫人、亞摩利人、希未人、耶布斯人之地，就是他向你祖宗起誓應許給你之地，流奶與蜜之地，那時你要在這一個月奉行以下這事奉禮。
notes: 耶和華<WH03068> → 永恆主<WH03068>: LCC uses 永恆主 (Eternal Lord) as its rendering of the Tetragrammaton; SN attached to the full term.

LCC inserts an extra 之地 after 應許給你 (restructuring the relative clause as 'the land he swore to give you'), which has no separate Hebrew אֶרֶץ correspondent — left unannotated. The two <WH0776> instances follow the Hebrew's two actual אֶרֶץ references.
{<WAH03588>} kept implicit: the Hebrew כִּי (when/for) has no explicit LCC word corresponding to it.
守<WH05647><WTH8804> (UNV) → 奉行<WH05647><WTH8804> (LCC): both render עָבַד (serve/keep); morphology tag kept on the verb.
這禮<WH05656> (UNV) → 這事奉禮<WH05656> (LCC): LCC expands to 事奉禮 for עֲבֹדָה; SN attaches to the full nominal phrase.
以下 in LCC has no Hebrew correspondent and is left unannotated.
LCC 一個 (between 這 and 月) has no Hebrew correspondent; <WAH02088> attaches to 這 and <WAH09002><WH02320> attaches to 月 across the LCC expansion.

Exod/13.lcc_original: 你要喫無酵餅七天；到第七天；舉行向永恆主守的節。
notes: LCC uses archaic 喫 for 吃 — same referent, H0398 with morphology WTH8799 attached after 喫
LCC uses 天 throughout where UNV uses 日 — both map to H3117; WAH09002 prefix attaches to the second 天 (第七天)
LCC rephrases 守節 as 舉行向…守的節; 舉行 is a Chinese expansion with no Hebrew equivalent; H2282 (חַג, feast) attaches to the head noun 節
LCC uses 永恆主 for 耶和華 (H3068); WAH09001 (לְ prefix, 'to/for') attaches to 永恆主; the explicit 向 in LCC serves the same directional role as the prefix

Exod/13.lcc_original: 這七天之中、要喫無酵餅；在你四境內、不可見有發過酵之物在你那裏，也不可見有酵在你那裏。
notes: LCC 天 (H03117) and 喫 (H0398) are lexical variants of UNV 日 and 吃 — same roots, straightforward mapping.

LCC clause 1 '有發過酵之物' maps to H02557 (חָמֵץ, leavened product); LCC clause 2 '有酵' maps to H07603 (שְׂאֹר, the leaven agent) — preserves Hebrew word order and confirmed by semantic analysis: 發過酵之物 = the leavened product, 有酵 = having yeast/leaven itself.
UNV final {<WAH09001>} (implicit ב in בְּכָל-גְּבֻלֶךָ) becomes explicit in LCC clause 2 as 在<WAH09001> per Rule 3 — braces dropped.
LCC clause 1's terminal '在你那裏' has no corresponding SN in UNV (UNV places location 在你四境之內 before both clauses; LCC repeats it after each) — left unannotated.
Confidence reduced because H02557/H07603 assignment across LCC's rephrased clauses requires semantic judgment rather than surface matching.

Exod/13.lcc_original: 當那一天，你要告訴你的兒子說：「這是因爲永恆主在我出埃及的時候爲我行的事。」
notes: UNV '那日' splits as 那<WAH01931> (H1931=הוּא, demonstrative) + 日<WAH09002><WH03117> (H3117=יוֹם); LCC '那一天' maps identically: 那<WAH01931> + 一天<WAH09002><WH03117>
UNV '耶和華<WH03068>' → LCC '永恆主<WH03068>': LCC's standard rendering of the Tetragrammaton, straightforward transfer
UNV '因<WAH09002><WH05668>' → LCC '因爲<WAH09002><WH05668>': LCC expands with 爲 but the compound maps to the same H5668 (עֲבוּר, for the sake of); both tags attach to 因爲 as a unit
UNV '所行<WH06213><WTH8804>' → LCC '行<WH06213><WTH8804>': LCC omits the 所 resultative particle; H6213 (עָשָׂה) attaches directly to 行; prefix <WAH09001> placed before 行 as in UNV pattern 爲我<WAH09001>行

Exod/13.lcc_original: 這要在你手上做記號，在你額上做提醒物，好使永恆主的律法常在你口中，因爲永恆主曾用大力的手將你從埃及領出來。
notes: UNV 耶和華 → LCC 永恆主: both render YHWH (H03068); SN transferred to 永恆主 at both occurrences.
UNV 大能 → LCC 大力: both render H02389 (חָזָק, strong/mighty); straightforward lexical substitution.
UNV 紀念 → LCC 提醒物: both render H02146 (זִכָּרוֹן, memorial/reminder); SN attached to 提醒物.
UNV 使 → LCC 好使: both express the purpose clause (H04616 לְמַעַן + WAH09001 waw); SNs attached after the full phrase 好使.
LCC aspect particle 曾 (marking past action) has no Hebrew equivalent SN; left unannotated, consistent with UNV treatment.

Exod/13.lcc_original: 所以你年年要按其制定節期守這條例。
notes: UNV splits 'year by year' across two tokens 每<WAH04480><WH03117>年<WH03117> (מִיָּמִים יָמִימָה); LCC collapses this into the single compound 年年, so both SNs attach to 年年.
UNV's 按著日期<WAH09001><WH04150> (מוֹעֵד with prefix) maps to LCC's expanded phrase 按其制定節期; tags attach at the end of the phrase after 節期.
UNV 例 → LCC 條例 (same חֻקָּה, just fuller form); <WH02708> attaches to 條例.
Implicit {<WAH0853>} (direct object marker את) kept in braces — LCC also has no explicit word for it.

Exod/13.lcc_original: 『將來永恆主照他向你和你祖宗所起的誓、將你領進迦南人之地，把這地賜給你，
notes: 耶和華<WH03068> → 永恆主<WH03068>: LCC uses '永恆主' as its rendering of יהוה (LORD); SN attached to the whole term.
{<WAH03588>}: conjunction כִּי ('when') is implicit in both UNV and LCC; kept in braces after 將來<WAH01961><WTH8804> since LCC has no explicit word for it.
領<WH0935><WTH8686>進<WAH0413>: UNV splits 領/進 across the two morphemes; LCC writes 領進 as a compound — split identically since 領 = Hiphil of בוא, 進 carries the אֶל directional (WAH0413).
UNV comma after {<WAH03588>} is absent in LCC (LCC uses 、later); tag placement preserved at the same semantic boundary regardless.

Exod/13.lcc_original: 那時候、你要使一切頭胎的人和你所有一切頭胎的小牲口、都走過來、歸於永恆主：陽性的都要屬於永恆主。
notes: 頭胎 (LCC) = 頭生 (UNV): first occurrence takes both WH06363 (פֶּטֶר, firstborn) and WH07358 (רֶחֶם, womb); second takes only WH06363.
LCC has two explicit 一切 matching UNV's two instances of WAH03605 (כֹּל); the second WAH03605 is placed on the second 一切 rather than on 和 (= UNV 並).
小牲口 takes WH0929 (בְּהֵמָה = livestock); WH07698 (שֶׁגֶר = young of animals) kept implicit since LCC's 小 does not unambiguously represent שֶׁגֶר.
WH05674 + WTH8689 (Hiphil of עָבַר = cause to pass through/present) attached to 走過來, which renders the literal sense; 歸於 expresses the idiomatic destination but is not the Hebrew verb itself.
永恆主 (LCC) = 耶和華 (UNV); takes WAH09001 + WH03068 in both clauses.
陽性的 (LCC) = 公的 (UNV); takes WH02145 (זָכָר = male).
{<WAH0834>}{<WAH09001>} kept implicit: LCC uses a colon (：) to introduce the apodosis rather than an explicit relative pronoun.

Exod/13.lcc_original: 凡頭胎的驢、你要用小羊去替贖；若不替贖，就要打折牠的脖子。凡你兒子當中頭胎的，你都要贖出來。
notes: UNV 頭生的 → LCC 頭胎的: both render בְּכוֹר (WH06363), straightforward.
UNV 羊羔 → LCC 小羊: both render שֶׂה (WH07716); prefix WAH09002 retained on 小羊.
UNV 代贖 → LCC 替贖: same root פָּדָה (WH06299); LCC inserts directional particle 去 before 替贖 — 去 left unannotated as it has no Hebrew equivalent.
UNV 頸項 → LCC 脖子: WH06202 (עֹרֶף, neck-breaking verb) and morphology WTH8804 both attach after 脖子, covering the whole 打折…脖子 phrase.
UNV 中 → LCC 當中: LCC expands with 當中; no SN assigned to either.
Second sentence: LCC repeats explicit 你 before 都 (你都); WH0120 (אָדָם) remains on the first 你 as in UNV alignment.

Exod/13.lcc_original: 日後你的兒子若問你說：「這是甚麼意思？」，你要對他說：「是永恆主用他手的權能將我們從埃及、從爲奴之家領出來。
notes: {<WAH01961>}{<WTH8804>} remain implicit: Hebrew וְהָיָה (it shall come to pass) has no explicit counterpart in LCC; placed before 若 to reflect Hebrew word order (וְהָיָה כִּי).
WAH03588 (כִּי, when/if) attaches to 若 — LCC's 若 is an explicit rendering, so braces dropped.
WAH0413 (אֶל) was implicit in UNV {<WAH0413>} but LCC renders it explicitly as 對他; braces dropped, attached to 對他.
LCC inverts the construct 大能的手 → 手的權能 (strength-of-hand → hand's-power); SNs redistributed: 手<WH03027> and 權能<WAH09002><WH02392>.
Second 從 in LCC (從爲奴之家) is an explicit preposition corresponding to prefix WAH04480; attached directly to 從 rather than to 家 as in UNV.
永恆主<WH03068>: LCC's theological paraphrase of יְהוָה; WH03068 attaches to the whole title as a single lexical unit.

Exod/13.lcc_original: 那時法老硬不要讓我們走，永恆主就把埃及地所有頭胎的，無論是頭胎的人、或是頭胎的牲口、都殺了，因此我把一切頭胎的公牲畜祭獻給永恆主，而將我一切頭胎的兒子都贖出來。
notes: {<WAH01961>}{<WTH8799>} (וַיְהִי) remains implicit — LCC has no explicit word for this narrative opener
UNV 幾乎不容<WH07185><WTH8689> → LCC 硬<WH07185><WTH8689>; <WAH09001><WH07971><WTH8763> (לְשַׁלְּחֵנוּ) spans 不要讓我們走, attached after 走 as the governing verb
In the 'firstborn' subclauses, {<WAH04480>} and {<WAH05704>} remain implicit (no LCC particle), but their paired {<WH01060>} becomes explicit since LCC states 頭胎 overtly in each branch
UNV 牲畜獻...為祭 → LCC 牲畜祭獻 (inverted compound); SNs <WH02076><WTH8802> attached after 獻 as the main verbal root
<WAH03605> in final clause: UNV attaches to 都; LCC supplies 一切 as the direct כֹּל equivalent, so attached there instead
永恆主 (LCC) = 耶和華 (UNV) = יהוה → <WH03068>

Exod/13.lcc_original: 這要在你手上做記號，在你額上做綁額帶，因爲永恆主用他手的權能將我們從埃及領出來。」』
notes: UNV 耶和華 → LCC 永恆主: both map to H3068 (יְהוָה); SN attached after 主
UNV '大能<WAH09002><WH02392>的手<WH03027>' restructured in LCC as '他手<WH03027>的權能<WAH09002><WH02392>' — word order inverted; SNs redistributed to their semantic correspondents in LCC's phrasing
UNV 作經文 (H2903, טוֹטָפֹת, phylacteries) → LCC 做綁額帶: different Chinese rendering of the same Hebrew term; SN attached after 綁額帶

H0996 (בֵּין, between) attaches to 在; H5869 (עַיִן, eye) attaches to 額 — together rendering the Hebrew idiom 'between your eyes' (= forehead)

Exod/13.lcc_original: 法老讓人民走的時候，非利士地的路雖近，上帝卻不領導他們從那裏走，因爲上帝說：『恐怕人民看見戰爭而後悔，就回埃及去。』
notes: UNV 神 → LCC 上帝 (WH0430): systematic lexical difference, no ambiguity
UNV 百姓 → LCC 人民 (WH05971): equivalent terms for 'people/nation'
UNV 容…去 → LCC 讓…走: WAH0853 (את direct object marker) attached to 讓; WH07971 (שָׁלַח, send/let go) + WAH09002 + WTH8763 attached to 走
UNV 道路 → LCC 路 (WH01870): same root, LCC uses shorter form
UNV 遇見 → LCC 看見 (WH07200, רָאָה): LCC 看見 is a closer match to 'see' than UNV 遇見 'encounter'; confident alignment
UNV 打仗 → LCC 戰爭 (WH04421, מִלְחָמָה): both mean 'battle/war'
UNV 領他們<WH05148><WTH8804> → LCC 領導<WH05148><WTH8804>他們: LCC uses compound 領導 for H05148 (נָחָה, lead/guide); SN attached to 領導
LCC 而 (connective between 戰爭 and 後悔) is a Chinese aspectual connective with no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated
{<WAH01961>}{<WTH8799>} (וַיְהִי, 'and it came to pass') kept implicit at start — LCC omits this formulaic opener entirely

Exod/13.lcc_original: 所以上帝領人民繞道而行，走曠野蘆葦海的路：以色列人出埃及地是列陣上去的。
notes: 神(WH0430)→上帝: standard UNV/LCC divergence for אֱלֹהִים; WH0430 attached to 上帝

LCC word order differs for the sea-wilderness phrase: UNV has 紅(WH05488)海(WH03220)曠野(WH04057), but LCC has 曠野(WH04057)蘆葦(WH05488)海(WH03220), which actually matches the Hebrew מִדְבַּר יַם-סוּף more closely; SNs reassigned to match LCC order
WH05488 (סוּף, reeds) assigned to 蘆葦 in LCC, which renders the word literally rather than as 紅 (red)
WH02571 (חֲמֻשִׁים, armed/in battle array) mapped to 列陣: LCC renders this as 列陣 (in battle formation) rather than UNV's 兵器 (weapons); same Hebrew root, different translational choice
WAH0853 (את accusative marker) retained after 領 as in UNV, before its object 人民(WH05971)
Sentence-final 的 in LCC's 是列陣上去的 is a Chinese aspect particle with no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated

Exod/13.lcc_original: 摩西帶着約瑟的骸骨和他一同去，因爲約瑟曾迫切地叫以色列人起誓，對他們說：『上帝一定眷顧你們；你們要帶着我的骸骨從這裏和你們一同上去。』
notes: 神(WH0430)→上帝: standard UNV/LCC difference for אֱלֹהִים; SN transferred normally as explicit word-level match
把(WAH0853) appears twice in UNV with no counterpart in LCC; kept implicit as {<WAH0853>}, placed after the main verb (帶着) and before the direct object, reflecting the object-marker role of אֵת

叫<WAH0853> in clause 2: FHL explicitly tags the causative particle 叫 with WAH0853 (אֶת before the infinitive complement); LCC retains 叫 in the same causative role so WAH0853 is transferred directly without braces

嚴嚴地(WH07650+WTH8687)→迫切地: LCC renders the Hebrew infinitive absolute intensifier as 迫切地 (urgently/earnestly) rather than UNV's 嚴嚴地 (solemnly/strictly); both WH07650 tokens preserved — WTH8687 (inf.abs.) on 迫切地, WTH8689 (Hiph.impf.) on 起誓
