LCC 板油 corresponds to UNV 脂油 (both translate חֵלֶב WH06309); SNs transferred to 板油.
LCC adds 那人 as an explicit subject and 都 as an emphatic adverb — neither has a Hebrew counterpart, left unannotated.

Lev/1.lcc_original: 至於臟腑和腿、那人卻要用水去洗。祭司就要把這一切全都燻在祭壇上：這是燔祭、是怡神的香氣之火祭獻與永恆主。
notes: 那人 (implied subject in LCC) has no corresponding SN in UNV and is left unannotated.
{<WAH0853>} is implicit in UNV (Hebrew את marker); LCC has explicit 把 as direct object marker, so braces are dropped and tag attaches to 把.
UNV uses two verbs 奉獻<WH07126><WTH8689> and 燒<WH06999><WTH8689>; LCC condenses both into the single verb 燻, so both SN sets are attached there.
WAH09002 (ב inseparable prefix on מַיִם) is attached to 用 rather than 水 because LCC uses 用 as an explicit instrumental preposition, with WH04325 then attaching to 水.
WH05207 (ניחוח, pleasing/soothing) → 怡神的; WH07381 (ריח, scent/aroma) → 香氣; order follows LCC word order, not UNV.
LCC's 獻與 has no dedicated SN; the ל prepositional prefix is captured by WAH09001 on 永恆主.
LCC additions with no Hebrew equivalent (去, 之, 這一切, 那人) are left unannotated.

Lev/1.lcc_original: 『人獻給永恆主的供物若是以禽鳥中的爲燔祭，他就要從斑鳩或雛鴿中帶着【2】他的供物來獻上。
notes: 永恆主 = LCC's rendering of יהוה; WAH09001 (ל prefix) and WH03068 both attached to it, following UNV's pattern of tagging 耶和華 as a unit with its prefix
UNV's {<WAH04480>} before 斑鳩 was implicit (braced); LCC has explicit 從 for מִן, so braces dropped and WAH04480 placed on 從
The second (unbraced) WAH04480 between 或是 and 雛 in UNV is orphaned (no preceding Chinese character in UNV); placed on LCC's 中 which closes the 從…中 frame covering 雛鴿 — this is the weakest alignment
WH07126+WTH8689 placed on 獻上: LCC rephrases 就要獻 as the circumlocution 帶着…來獻上; 帶着 left unannotated as LCC elaboration with no direct Hebrew equivalent
WAH0853 (אֵת direct-object marker) has no corresponding 為 in LCC; attached to 供物 in 他的供物 as the nearest host word
LCC's 以禽鳥中的 renders מִן-הָעוֹף: WAH04480 placed on 以 (preposition, matching UNV's 以<WAH04480>), WH05775 on 禽鳥, 中的 left unannotated as LCC's stylistic addition

Lev/1.lcc_original: 祭司要把禽鳥帶【2】到祭壇前，揪下牠的頭來，將鳥燻在祭壇上；牠的血要讓流在祭壇邊。
notes: UNV 拿 (WH07126) → LCC 帶; both mean 'to bring/take'; SN placed before footnote marker 【2】
UNV 燒 (WH06999) → LCC 燻; both from Hebrew קטר (to make smoke / burn offering); semantically equivalent
LCC inserts 讓 (let/allow) before 流 as a causative periphrasis not present in Hebrew; 讓 left unannotated, WH04680+WTH8738 attached to 流
{<WAH0853>} (Hebrew accusative marker את) kept implicit — LCC has 牠的 as a possessive pronoun, not the accusative particle itself
UNV 壇 (×3, WH04196) becomes LCC 祭壇 throughout; WH04196 attached to 祭壇 in all three occurrences
UNV 壇的旁邊: WH04196 on 壇, WH07023 on 旁邊 → LCC 祭壇邊: WH04196 on 祭壇, WH07023 on 邊

Lev/1.lcc_original: 那人要把禽鳥的嗉子和翎毛除掉，丟在祭壇附近東邊、倒灰的地方。
notes: LCC uses 翎毛 as its main text where UNV has 髒物 with 翎毛 as a parenthetical alternate; transferred <WAH09002><WH05133> directly to 翎毛 since LCC makes the implicit explicit.
LCC reorders the locative phrase: UNV has 東(H6924)邊(H681) but LCC writes 附近(near)東邊(east-side); H681 (אֵצֶל = beside/near) maps to 附近 and H6924 (קֶדֶם = east) maps to 東邊.
{<WAH0853>} kept implicit between 丟 and 在 — LCC also has no explicit object marker there.
把 receives <WAH0853> as the Chinese object-marker particle directly corresponds to Hebrew אֵת (H853).

Lev/1.lcc_sn: 他要在翅膀<WAH09002><WH03671>那裏把禽鳥<WAH0853>撕裂<WH08156><WTH8765>，可不<WAH03808>要完全分開<WH0914><WTH8686>。祭司<WH03548>就要把鳥<WAH0853>燻在<WAH05921>祭壇<WH04196>上，{<WAH0834>}在<WAH05921>壇火<WH0784>上面的柴<WH06086>上燻<WH06999><WTH8689>：這是<WH01931>燔祭<WH05930>，是怡神香氣<WH07381><WH05207>之火祭<WH0801>、獻與永恆主<WAH09001><WH03068>。
Lev/1.lcc_original: 他要在翅膀那裏把禽鳥撕裂，可不要完全分開。祭司就要把鳥燻在祭壇上，在壇火上面的柴上燻：這是燔祭，是怡神香氣之火祭、獻與永恆主。
notes: WAH0853 appears twice: 禽鳥 is the explicit object of 撕裂 (matching UNV 把鳥<WAH0853>撕開), and 鳥 in 把鳥燻 is LCC's explicit rendering of UNV's implicit {<WAH0853>} — braces dropped per Rule 3
LCC uses resumptive-verb structure (把鳥燻...在壇火上面的柴上燻); WH06999+WTH8689 assigned to the second 燻, which closes the two locative phrases and matches UNV's 在壇上、在火的柴上焚燒 structure
怡神香氣 covers two Hebrew words: WH07381 (רֵיחַ = aroma) + WH05207 (נִיחֹחַ = pleasing); both SNs attached to the compound phrase per Rule 6
LCC 壇火 renders UNV 火 (WH0784); 壇 is LCC's clarifying addition and left unannotated
LCC 那裏 (at that location, after 翅膀) has no direct Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated
{<WAH0834>} (אֲשֶׁר, relative particle) placed between the two locative phrases as in UNV; no explicit relative word in LCC either so braces retained
永恆主 (Eternal Lord) is Lü's rendering of יְהוָה (WH03068); WAH09001 (לְ prefix) attaches to the same phrase

Lev/2.lcc_original: 『若有人以素祭爲供物獻與永恆主，他的供物應該是細麵；他要澆上油，加上乳香，
notes: 素祭 consolidates two adjacent UNV tokens (素<WH04503> + 祭<WH07133>) into one LCC compound; both SNs attached together since LCC treats 素祭 as a single lexical unit
以 (Chinese instrumental particle in the literary 以…獻與 construction) left unannotated — it has no direct Hebrew word equivalent; it is a Chinese syntactic device reordering the object before the verb
永恆主 (LCC's rendering of יְהוָה) receives <WAH09001><WH03068>; <WAH09001> reflects the lamed prefix in לַיהוָה

LCC's 他的供物應該是 makes explicit the implicit copular clause in UNV's 要<WAH01961><WTH8799>; H1961 attached to the verbal head 應該是; 他的供物 (= קָרְבָּנוֹ possessive suffix) left unannotated, mirroring UNV which does not re-annotate it
H7133 appears twice (on 素祭 and 爲供物) faithfully following UNV's dual-annotation pattern (祭<WH07133>為供物<WH07133>), reflecting the construct phrase קָרְבַּן מִנְחָה

Lev/2.lcc_original: 帶到亞倫子孫做祭司的那裏。祭司要從細麵中取出一把來，也取它的一些油、連它所有的乳香，都燻在祭壇上做它的表樣、做怡神香氣之火祭獻與永恆主。
notes: WAH04480 (מִן prefix) on 細麵: split across 從<WAH04480>細麵<WH05560> since LCC uses explicit 從 to translate the prefix, whereas UNV attaches both tags to 細麵 alone; the remaining two WAH04480 instances (on 出 and 油) have no explicit prefix word in LCC and stay attached to their content word
WAH0853 (direct object marker אֵת): kept as {<WAH0853>} implicit — in UNV it attaches to explicit 把, but LCC uses no 把 construction; no other word in LCC serves as a direct object marker here
WH0234 (אַזְכָּרָה, memorial portion): UNV 作為紀念 → LCC 做它的表樣 ('as its exemplar/token'); tag attached to 表樣
WH07381+WH05207 (rêaḥ nîḥôaḥ, pleasing aroma): UNV 馨香 → LCC 怡神香氣 ('spirit-soothing aroma'); both tags attached after 怡神香氣
WAH09001+WH03068 (YHWH): UNV 耶和華 → LCC 永恆主 ('Eternal Lord'); clause order differs — LCC moves 獻與永恆主 to the very end, after 火祭, so both tags follow 永恆主

Lev/2.lcc_sn: 素祭<WAH04480><WH04503>中的餘留部分<WH03498><WTH8737>要歸於亞倫<WAH09001><WH0175>和他的子孫<WAH09001><WH01121>：這是獻與永恆主<WH03068>的火祭<WAH04480><WH0801>中之至聖<WH06944><WH06944>的。
Lev/2.lcc_original: 素祭中的餘留部分要歸於亞倫和他的子孫：這是獻與永恆主的火祭中之至聖的。
Lev/2.unv_sn_reference: 素祭<WAH04480><WH04503>所剩的<WH03498><WTH8737>要歸給亞倫<WAH09001><WH0175>和他的子孫<WAH09001><WH01121>；這是獻與耶和華<WH03068>的火祭<WAH04480><WH0801>中為至<WH06944>聖<WH06944>的。
notes: WAH04480+WH04503 placed after 素祭; LCC inserts 中的 before 餘留部分 as a structural rephrasing particle — left unannotated
LCC 餘留部分 ('remainder portion') corresponds to UNV 所剩的 (H03498 + WTH8737 Niphal ptcp)
LCC 永恆主 is the rendering of YHWH (耶和華 H03068)
Hebrew קֹדֶשׁ קָדָשִׁים (most holy) — UNV splits two H06944 tags across 至 and 聖; LCC writes 至聖 as a unit, so both H06944 tags are consolidated after 至聖

Lev/2.lcc_original: 『若獻手提爐子裏烤的素祭爲供物，你就要用無酵的細麵將油調和的哈拉餅，或是抹上油的無酵薄餅。
notes: WH03989 (מַאֲפֶה = baked thing): UNV uses explicit noun 物, LCC folds the concept into the adjective 烤的 modifying 素祭; attached WH03989 to 烤的.
LCC adds 手提 (hand-carried/portable) before 爐子 with no Hebrew equivalent; WH08574 attaches to 爐子 only.
LCC 哈拉餅 is a phonetic transliteration of חַלָּה (WH02471), which UNV renders as generic 餅; WH02471 attached to the full 哈拉餅.
UNV 調 becomes LCC 調和 (both = בָּלַל WH01101); SN and morphology WTH8803 attach after 調和.
LCC 抹上 adds directional complement 上 with no SN; WH04886+WTH8803 attach after the full verb phrase 抹上.
LCC 你 (implied subject from Hebrew verb conjugation) has no SN.

Lev/2.lcc_original: 你的供物若是在煎盤上作的素祭，那就該是用油調和的無酵細麵。
notes: LCC 供物 is the direct rendering of H07133 (קָרְבָּן); UNV paraphrases it as 做的物, but the referent is the same word.
LCC 若是 takes WAH0518 (וְאִם) on 若; the copula 是 is LCC's own addition with no separate SN.
LCC inverts the oil-and-mixing order relative to UNV: UNV has 調…油 while LCC has 用油調和; WAH09002+WH08081 attach to 油 and WH01101+WTH8803 attach to 調和.
LCC 該是 receives WAH01961+WTH8799 (הָיָה Qal imperfect); LCC's 那就 is a discourse connector with no Hebrew equivalent.
你的 (possessive pronoun) has no explicit SN because the Hebrew possessive suffix on קָרְבָּן is not separately tagged in UNV either.

Lev/2.lcc_original: 你要把它擘成塊子，澆上油：這是素祭。
notes: 你要把 (imperative/causative construction) has no direct Hebrew equivalent in the UNV annotation and is left unannotated
LCC 它 (explicit pronoun) is the explicit realization of UNV {<WAH0853>} (implicit object marker את with pronominal suffix); braces dropped per Rule 3 and tag attached to 它
UNV 分成 → LCC 擘成: different Chinese verbs for the same Hebrew פתת (H6626, break into pieces); morphology <WTH8800> co-attached to 擘成

Lev/2.lcc_sn: 你的供物<WH07133>若是<WAH0518>淺鍋裏煮的<WH04802>素祭<WH04503>，那就該是細麵<WH05560>合油<WAH09002><WH08081>作的<WH06213><WTH8735>。
Lev/2.lcc_original: 你的供物若是淺鍋裏煮的素祭，那就該是細麵合油作的。
notes: LCC's 淺鍋裏煮的 (cooked in a shallow pan) renders UNV's 煎盤 — both map to מַחֲבַת (04802); tagged as a single phrase.
LCC's 你的 is the possessive suffix of קָרְבָּנְךָ; left unannotated as a pronoun, with WH07133 placed after 供物.
LCC's transitional phrase 那就該是 has no direct Hebrew equivalent and is left unannotated.
Prefix tag WAH09002 (בְּ, 'with') and oil tag WH08081 (שֶׁמֶן) are both attached to LCC's 合油, which fuses the preposition (合) and noun (油) into one unit.

Lev/2.lcc_original: 你要將這些東西作的素祭帶到永恆主面前，交【1】給祭司，讓他拿到祭壇前。
notes: 把→將 for H853 (direct object marker): LCC uses 將 as the object-introducing preposition, functionally identical to UNV's 把.
H834 (אשר, relative pronoun): was implicit {<WAH0834>} in UNV with no explicit Chinese word; LCC has explicit relative particle 的 in 作的, so per Rule 3 braces are dropped and attached as 的<WAH0834>.
H6213+morphology attaches to 作 (the explicit verb), H834 attaches to 的 (the relative particle), matching Hebrew word order אשר עשה.
耶和華→永恆主 (Yahweh→Eternal Lord in LCC): both SNs <WAH09001><WH03068> attach after 永恆主.
並奉→交 for H7126 (קרב, bring near/present): LCC drops the conjunction 並 and uses 交 as the main verb; SNs attach after 交, with footnote marker 【1】 preserved in its original inter-word position.
帶→拿 for H5066 (נגש, draw near/bring): the main verb within LCC's auxiliary phrase 讓他拿; 讓他 are LCC expansions with no Hebrew SN equivalent.
壇→祭壇: LCC uses the full compound term 祭壇 (altar) where UNV abbreviates to 壇; H4196 attaches after 祭壇.
LCC's explicit subject 你 has no SN — implicit in the Hebrew imperative verb form.

Lev/2.lcc_sn: 祭司<WH03548>要從<WAH04480>這素祭<WH04503>中把<WAH0853>它的表樣部分<WH0234>取出來<WH07311><WTH8689>、燻<WH06999><WTH8689>在祭壇<WH04196>上、做怡神香氣<WH07381><WH05207>之火祭<WH0801>、獻與永恆主<WAH09001><WH03068>。
Lev/2.lcc_original: 祭司要從這素祭中把它的表樣部分取出來、燻在祭壇上、做怡神香氣之火祭、獻與永恆主。
notes: UNV {<WAH0853>} (את direct object marker) is implicit in UNV but LCC explicitly uses 把 as the object marker — dropped braces and attached to 把
LCC 表樣部分 corresponds to UNV 作為紀念的 (H0234 אַזְכָּרָה memorial/representative portion)
LCC 怡神香氣 covers both H07381 (רֵיחַ odor) and H05207 (נִיחוֹחַ pleasing) as a single phrase
LCC 永恆主 is the standard LCC rendering of יהוה (H03068), with ל prefix H09001 carried over from 獻與 construction
LCC restructures UNV's 是獻與耶和華為馨香的火祭 into 做怡神香氣之火祭、獻與永恆主 — SNs follow LCC's word order

Lev/2.lcc_sn: 素祭<WH04503>中<WAH04480>的餘留部分<WH03498><WTH8737>要歸於亞倫<WAH09001><WH0175>和他的子孫<WAH09001><WH01121>：這是獻與永恆主<WH03068>的火祭<WAH04480><WH0801>中之至聖<WH06944><WH06944>的。
Lev/2.lcc_original: 素祭中的餘留部分要歸於亞倫和他的子孫：這是獻與永恆主的火祭中之至聖的。
notes: UNV {<WAH04480>} (מִן, implicit 'from/of') has no explicit UNV word but LCC expresses it with 中 in 素祭中的; per rule 3, dropped braces and attached <WAH04480> after 中.
H6944 appears twice in UNV (至<WH06944>聖<WH06944> = קֹדֶשׁ קָדָשִׁים 'most holy'); LCC 至聖 is a single compound so both tags attached after 聖, before the particle 的.
LCC 永恆主 replaces UNV 耶和華 as the LCC convention for the Tetragrammaton (YHWH).

Lev/2.lcc_original: 『凡你們獻與永恆主的素祭、都不可用發酵物作的，因爲一點酵、一點蜜、你們都不可燻做火祭來獻與永恆主。
notes: LCC restructures second clause: objects (一點酵、一點蜜) precede verb (不可燻), unlike UNV where verb precedes objects — SNs follow LCC word order
UNV 有<WH06213> (Niphal 'be made') + 酵<WH02557> → LCC 發酵物<WH02557>作<WH06213><WTH8735>的: different phrasing but same semantic content; 發酵物 ('leavened substance') maps to chametz H2557
UNV implicit {<WAH04480>} (min, 'as/from') → LCC 做 ('make as') is an explicit rendering of the preposition's function, so braces dropped per rule 3
{<WAH03605>} (kol) kept implicit before 素祭 — LCC has no distinct word for it (凡 already maps to H0834 asher)
你們 in first clause has no SN — LCC adds subject pronoun for clarity; in UNV 你們 only appears in second clause

Lev/2.lcc_sn: 做上好的<WH07225>供物<WH07133>、倒可以將這種東西<WAH0853>獻<WH07126><WTH8686>與永恆主<WAH09001><WH03068>；但要上<WH05927><WTH8799>祭壇<WAH0413><WH04196>燔燒、做怡神之香氣<WAH09001><WH07381><WH05207>嘛，這種東西是不可<WAH03808>用的。
Lev/2.lcc_original: 做上好的供物、倒可以將這種東西獻與永恆主；但要上祭壇燔燒、做怡神之香氣嘛，這種東西是不可用的。
notes: LCC restructures heavily: UNV's single sentence becomes two clauses with 這種東西 repeated; H0853 (אֹתָם, object marker) attached to the first instance where it serves as direct object of 獻
LCC renders H7225 (רֵאשִׁית, firstfruits) as 上好的 (choice/best) — semantic approximation, not literal
LCC adds 燔燒 (burn) with no corresponding SN — left unannotated; H5927 (עלה, go up) attached to 上 which carries the core 'ascend' meaning
H0413 (אֶל, to/toward) and H4196 (מִזְבֵּחַ, altar) both attached to 祭壇 since LCC has no separate preposition

Lev/2.lcc_original: 凡你獻爲素祭的供物都要用鹽調和；在你的素祭上、你的上帝立約之鹽、是不可讓它缺少的；你一切的供物、都要配着鹽而獻上。
notes: LCC restructures the second clause: UNV '不可缺了...的鹽' → LCC '...的鹽、是不可讓它缺少的'; SNs attached to semantically equivalent words (不可←H3808, 缺少←H7673)
LCC uses 上帝 for UNV 神 (both render H0430 Elohim)
LCC adds 讓它 (causative construction) with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated
{<WAH05921>} kept implicit between the second and third clauses as LCC has no explicit word for this preposition
LCC adds several instances of 你/你的 not present in UNV — left unannotated as they are Chinese grammatical additions

Lev/2.lcc_original: 『若將首熟物做素祭獻與永恆主，你要獻上火焙了的青穗子、軋了的新穀子、做首熟物的素祭。
notes: LCC 將 is a Chinese grammatical particle (object-fronting marker) with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated
LCC 你 (you) is implicit in the Hebrew verb conjugation וְהִקְרַבְתָּ — left unannotated since the SN attaches to the verb 獻上

UNV {<WAH09002>}{<WH0784>} (בָּאֵשׁ = in fire) are implicit in UNV because 烘 doesn't explicitly say fire; LCC 火焙 explicitly says fire (火), so braces dropped and tags split: 火<WAH09002><WH0784> + 焙了<WH07033><WTH8803>
LCC 做 (second occurrence) mapped to <WAH0853> (את accusative marker), paralleling UNV 當作<WAH0853> — imperfect semantic match but closest structural equivalent
UNV groups both prefix <WAH09001> and main <WH03068> after the full phrase 向耶和華; same convention followed for LCC 與永恆主<WAH09001><WH03068>

Lev/2.lcc_original: 你要加上油，放上乳香：這是素祭。
notes: UNV 抹 (anoint/pour) maps to LCC 加 (add) for H5414; UNV 加 (add/put) maps to LCC 放 (place) for H7760 — different verb choices but same semantic roles
LCC 你要 is unannotated (no SN); parallels UNV 並要 which also carries no SN

UNV 留 → LCC 留下 (extended form with resultative complement 下); both SNs H5117+WTH8686 attached to 留下
LCC 那、爲...而獻之 are function/structural words with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated
供獻的 in LCC corresponds to UNV 獻的 for H7133 (qorban/offering)

Lev/7.lcc_original: 他供獻的祭若是個還願祭、或是自願獻的祭，也要在獻祭的日子喫，不過所餘留的部分第二天也可以喫。

LCC adds 部分 (portion) with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated
LCC 不過 (however) has no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated
WAH09002 (beth prefix) kept together with WH03117 after 日子 per UNV tagging pattern, though LCC has explicit 在 as separate preposition

Lev/7.lcc_original: 所餘留的祭肉、第三天就要用火燒。

LCC 所餘留的 corresponds to UNV 所剩下的 (both mean 'what remains')
LCC uses 燒 where UNV has 焚燒 — same meaning, SN attached to 燒
就 in LCC is a grammatical connector with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated

Lev/7.lcc_original: 第三天他的平安祭肉如果眞地給人喫了，這祭就不蒙悅納，也不算爲供獻的人獻的：那就會成了「不新鮮」的；喫這祭肉的人就必須擔當他的罪罰。

UNV {<WH05315>} (nephesh, implicit) corresponds to LCC explicit 人 — braces dropped per Rule 3
LCC 供獻的人獻的 restructures UNV 人所獻的…為祭; H7126 (Hiphil ptcp) attached to 供獻 as the participial form
LCC 「不新鮮」的 (not fresh/stale) is a distinctive rendering of H6292 piggul (UNV: 可憎嫌的)
LCC 罪罰 (punishment) vs UNV 罪孽 (iniquity) — both valid renderings of H5771 ʿavon

Lev/7.lcc_original: 『肉髑着任何「不潔淨」的、都喫不得；要用火燒。至於潔淨的肉呢、凡潔淨的都可以喫；
notes: LCC restructures UNV's 平安祭的肉 (peace offering's flesh) as 潔淨的肉 (clean flesh); the first 潔淨 in LCC has no corresponding SN-tagged source word and is left unannotated
UNV's {<WAH03605>} (כל, all/any) is implicit but LCC has explicit 任何; braces dropped per rule 3

Lev/7.lcc_original: 惟獨獻與永恆主的平安祭的肉、人若喫它、而身上卻有不潔淨，那人就必須從他族人中被剪除。
notes: LCC reorders: 'eats it while unclean' vs UNV 'is unclean and eats' — SNs placed on respective LCC words regardless of order change
UNV {<WAH05921>} (עַל, upon) is implicit but LCC has explicit 身上 (on the body) — braces dropped per rule 3
LCC 被剪除 uses passive marker 被 which has no SN; the Niphal (passive) is already encoded in <WTH8738>
LCC 它 (it, object of 喫) has no corresponding SN in UNV — left unannotated
LCC 惟獨 corresponds to UNV 只是 (but/only) which carries no SN — left unannotated

Lev/7.lcc_original: 人若觸着甚麼不潔淨、無論是人的不潔淨、或是不潔淨的牲口、或是任何不潔淨的昆蟲【1】，而去喫屬永恆主的平安祭的肉，那人就必須從他的族人中被剪除。』
notes: UNV implicit {<WAH03588>} (כִּי, if) → LCC has explicit '若', braces dropped
UNV implicit {<WAH09002>}{<WAH03605>} (בְּכָל, in any) → LCC has explicit '任何', braces dropped

UNV '獻{<WAH0834>}與耶和華' → LCC '屬永恆主': '屬' (belonging to) covers the relative pronoun אֲשֶׁר, braces dropped

Lev/7.lcc_original: 永恆主告訴摩西說：
notes: LCC 告訴 explicitly renders UNV's implicit {<WH01696>} (דבר spoke) so braces dropped per Rule 3; <WAH0413> (אל to) is also absorbed into 告訴 since 告訴 = 'told' covers both 'spoke' and the directional 'to'

Lev/7.lcc_original: 『你要告訴以色列人說：牛或綿羊或山羊的脂肪、你們都不可喫。
notes: UNV repeats 的脂油 three times (once per animal) but only the first carries <WH02459>; LCC restructures as '牛或綿羊或山羊的脂肪' with single 脂肪 — attached <WH02459> to that single instance.
LCC 要 (modal auxiliary in 你要告訴) has no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated.
LCC uses 喫 (archaic variant) vs UNV 吃 — preserved LCC's original character exactly.
{<WAH0413>} (אֶל, unto) remains implicit in LCC as there is no explicit preposition before 以色列人.

Lev/7.lcc_original: 自己死的的脂肪或野獸撕裂的的脂肪可作別的使用，卻千萬不可喫。
notes: LCC explicitly has two 脂肪 matching the two Hebrew חֵלֶב (H2459) — one for carcass fat, one for torn-beast fat; each gets its own H2459 tag.
UNV 自死的 maps H5038 (נְבֵלָה carcass) to LCC 自己死的; H2459 (חֵלֶב fat) placed after 脂肪 rather than bundled with the nominalized clause.

千萬 in LCC translates the emphatic function of the Hebrew infinitive absolute אָכֹל (H0398+WTH8800); braces dropped since LCC has an explicit word for the emphasis, though it captures grammatical function rather than lexical meaning of 'eat'.
{<WAH09001>}{<WAH03605>} kept implicit — LCC 別的 ('other') does not explicitly translate לְכָל ('for all/any'); the prefix lamed and כֹּל have no direct LCC surface word.
LCC uses archaic 喫 for 吃 (eat) — preserved exactly as given.

Lev/7.lcc_original: 因爲凡喫了獻與永恆主爲火祭之牲口的脂肪的、那人必須從他的族人中被剪除。
notes: UNV {<WAH03588>} (כִּי) is implicit but LCC has explicit 因爲, so braces dropped per Rule 3.
與 in LCC explicitly translates the ל prefix (<WAH09001>), split from 永恆主<WH03068> for precision.
Two implicit {<WAH04480>} (partitive מִן) kept as implicit — LCC uses structural particles 之/的 rather than an explicit 'from' word.
LCC 他的族人 expands UNV 民 (his people vs. people); 從 explicitly translates the מִן prefix <WAH04480>.
必須 and 被 are LCC grammatical additions with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated.

Lev/7.lcc_sn: 在你們一切的<WAH09002><WAH03605>住所<WH04186>、一切的<WAH03605>血<WH01818>、無論是禽鳥的<WAH09001><WH05775>、是牲口的<WAH09001><WH0929>、你們都不可<WAH03808>喫<WH0398><WTH8799>。
Lev/7.lcc_original: 在你們一切的住所、一切的血、無論是禽鳥的、是牲口的、你們都不可喫。

Lev/7.lcc_original: 無論甚麼人喫甚麼血，那人必須從他的族人中被剪除。

Lev/7.lcc_original: 『你要告訴以色列人說：那將平安祭獻與永恆主的、要從他的平安祭中取些供物奉給永恆主。

Lev/8.lcc_sn: 『你要將<WAH0853>亞倫<WH0175>帶來<WH03947><WTH8798>，叫<WAH0853>他的兒子們<WH01121>和他一同<WAH0854>來，也將<WAH0853>聖衣<WH0899>和{<WAH0853>}膏<WH04888>油<WH08081>、跟<WAH0853>作爲解罪祭<WH02403>的一隻公牛<WH06499>、{<WAH0853>}兩<WH08147>隻公綿羊<WH0352>、和{<WAH0853>}一筐<WH05536>無酵餅<WH04682>、都帶來；
Lev/8.lcc_original: 『你要將亞倫帶來，叫他的兒子們和他一同來，也將聖衣和膏油、跟作爲解罪祭的一隻公牛、兩隻公綿羊、和一筐無酵餅、都帶來；
notes: LCC splits the verb into two: '亞倫帶來' (bring Aaron) and '都帶來' (bring all). H3947/H8798 attached to first 帶來 only; second is resumptive with no separate Hebrew source.
LCC uses 叫 (have/let) to introduce the sons where UNV uses 和+את. Attached WAH0853 to 叫 as the functional equivalent of the direct object marker.
LCC uses 解罪祭 where UNV uses 贖罪祭 — both render H2403 (chattat, sin offering); different translation choice, same referent.
LCC adds 作爲 (as/for) before 解罪祭 with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated.
Three implicit {<WAH0853>} markers retained: before 膏油, 兩隻公綿羊, and 一筐無酵餅. LCC's 和 in these positions is conjunction (=Hebrew ו), not object marker (את).

Lev/8.lcc_original: 又將全會衆召集在會棚的出入處。』
notes: UNV attaches H0853 (אֵת, direct object marker) after 又; in LCC 將 serves as the object marker (把/將 construction), so H0853 placed after 將 instead.
UNV marks H3605 (כֹּל, all) as implicit {<WAH03605>} since 全 is absent in UNV; LCC has explicit 全, so braces dropped per rule 3.
LCC 會棚 splits character-by-character to 會<WH04150>棚<WH0168>, matching UNV 會(meeting)+幕(tent) → LCC 會(meeting)+棚(tent/tabernacle).
LCC 出入處 (entrance/exit place) corresponds to UNV 門口 (doorway), both mapping to H6607 (פֶּתַח, opening/entrance).
的 is a Chinese possessive particle with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated.

Lev/8.lcc_original: 摩西照永恆主所吩咐他的去行，會衆就聚集在會棚的出入處。
notes: UNV 耶和華 → LCC 永恆主 (standard LCC rendering of YHWH)
UNV {<WAH0853>} was implicit (no Chinese text); LCC has explicit 他 (him), so braces dropped per rule 3
UNV 幕(tent) → LCC 棚(shed/tent): same Hebrew 0168 (אהל), different Chinese character; split 會<04150>棚<0168> following UNV's character-level tagging pattern
UNV 門口 → LCC 出入處: both render Hebrew פֶּתַח (06607, entrance)
LCC 去行 treated as single unit for 06213 (עשה, to do); 去 is a Chinese directional complement with no separate Hebrew source
就 and 的 are Chinese grammatical particles with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated

Lev/8.lcc_original: 摩西對會衆說：『永恆主所吩咐行的事乃是這樣。』
notes: UNV 告訴<WAH0413> maps to LCC 對 — H0413 (אֵל, 'unto') is the preposition, which LCC renders as 對 rather than folding into the verb
UNV 這就是<WAH02088> (זֶה, 'this') reordered in LCC to sentence-final 乃是這樣 — SN attached to 這樣 as the demonstrative carrier
UNV 當行<WAH09001><WH06213><WTH8800> maps to LCC 行 — LCC omits the auxiliary 當 but the infinitive construct SNs all attach to 行

Lev/8.lcc_original: 摩西把亞倫和他兒子們帶來【1】，用水給他們洗，
notes: UNV {<WAH0853>} (implicit את before Aaron) → LCC 把 explicitly marks the direct object, so braces dropped and <WAH0853> attached to 把
LCC 給 is a Chinese dative/benefactive marker with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated
LCC 兒子們 (plural marker 們) vs UNV 兒子 — same SN <WH01121>, LCC just makes plurality explicit

Lev/8.lcc_original: 給亞倫穿上內袍，給他束上長腰帶，穿上外袍，又加上聖裲襠，用巧設圖案織成的聖裲襠帶子束上，將聖裲襠繫在他身上。
notes: LCC uses 聖裲襠 (holy vest/surplice) for UNV's 以弗得 (ephod transliteration) — same H0646 applied to all three occurrences
LCC adds 給他 before 束上 in clause 2 — left unannotated as it has no Hebrew equivalent
LCC uses 長腰帶 where UNV has 腰帶 — full phrase takes H073 and its prefix H09002
{<WH02296>}{<WTH8799>} were implicit in UNV (girding verb absorbed into sentence structure), but LCC has explicit 束上 in clause 5 — braces dropped per Rule 3
LCC uses 將 as DOM marker where UNV uses 把 — both render Hebrew את so <WAH0853> attached to 將

Lev/8.lcc_original: 又給他戴上胸牌，將烏陵土明【2】放在胸牌裏，
notes: UNV 把<WAH0853> → LCC 將<WAH0853>: both serve as Chinese object-introducing particles corresponding to Hebrew את
UNV 和<WAH0853> (ואת before Thummim): LCC omits 和, so this WAH0853 becomes implicit {<WAH0853>} between 烏陵 and 土明
UNV {<WAH0853>} implicit before first 胸牌: LCC also has no explicit word for it, kept as implicit
LCC 裏 (inside) has no separate SN — it is part of the locative sense covered by WAH0413 (אל) on 在
Preserved LCC footnote marker 【2】 in its original position after 土明

Lev/8.lcc_original: 把禮冠戴在他頭上；在禮冠上頭、前面、釘上金牌、就是聖冠：照永恆主所吩咐摩西的。
notes: 禮冠 (LCC) = 冠冕 (UNV) = H4701 מִצְנֶפֶת (turban/mitre)
永恆主 (LCC) = 耶和華 (UNV) = H3068 יְהוָה
UNV 的前面 carries H0413+H4136+H6440; LCC splits into 上頭 and 前面 — distributed H0413+H4136 to 上頭 and H6440 to 前面 (אֶל מוּל = toward/opposite → 上頭; פָּנִים = face/front → 前面)
H7760 שׂים (put/set) appears twice in the verse: once for placing the turban, once for fastening the gold plate — both instances tagged in LCC as in UNV

Lev/8.lcc_original: 摩西拿膏油膏帳幕、和其中所有的東西，將它們分別爲聖。
notes: LCC 拿 = UNV 用, both translate לָקַח (H3947 'took')
LCC 膏(verb) = UNV 抹, both translate מָשַׁח (H4886 'anointed')
LCC adds 東西 after 所有的 — no separate SN, subsumed under H3605 (כֹּל 'all')
LCC 將它們 corresponds to UNV 使它 — both render the אֵת object marker (WAH0853); LCC uses plural 它們 vs UNV singular 它
LCC 分別爲聖 = UNV 成聖, both translate קָדַשׁ (H6942 Piel 'consecrate')

Lev/8.lcc_original: 將膏油在祭壇上彈了七次，又膏了祭壇和它一切的器皿，以及洗濯盆和盆座，將盆分別爲聖。
notes: LCC uses 祭壇 where UNV uses 壇 — same referent (altar H4196), SN attached to LCC form
LCC 以及 replaces UNV 並 — both conjunctions carry WAH0853 (accusative marker)
LCC 膏了 (anointed) replaces UNV 抹了 (smeared) — same Hebrew root H4886 (māšaḥ)
LCC 分別爲聖 (set apart as holy) replaces UNV 成聖 — both render H6942 (qādaš) Piel; all three SNs (WAH09001+WH06942+WTH8763) attached after the phrase
LCC 將盆分別爲聖 has 盆 (basin) where Hebrew has pronoun suffix -ם (them) referring to all items; 盆 left unannotated as it has no separate SN
Implicit {WAH0853} retained before second 祭壇 as LCC has no explicit accusative marker word there either
將 at start and before 盆 are Chinese grammatical markers (object-fronting) with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated

Lev/8.lcc_original: 他又把膏油倒在亞倫的頭上，膏立他，將他分別爲聖。
notes: LCC adds 他 at sentence start (subject 'he') with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated
UNV 膏 (H4886) maps to LCC 膏立 — LCC uses a more explicit verb form; both SNs (H4886+TH8799) attached after 膏立
UNV 使他成聖 maps to LCC 將他分別爲聖 — same semantic content (to consecrate), all three tags (WAH09001+WH06942+WTH8763) placed after the full phrase 分別爲聖

Lev/8.lcc_original: 摩西把亞倫的兒子們帶來【1】，給他們穿上內袍，束上長腰帶，包上裹頭巾：照永恆主所吩咐摩西的。
notes: UNV {<WAH0853>} (first occurrence, implicit את before object) → LCC uses 把 as explicit direct-object marker, so braces dropped per rule 3: 把<WAH0853>
UNV 帶了...來 (split verb-complement) → LCC 帶來 (contiguous); both SNs WH07126+WTH8686 attached after 帶來
UNV 耶和華 WH03068 → LCC 永恆主 (Lü's distinctive rendering of YHWH)
LCC 長腰帶 (long sash) corresponds to UNV 腰帶 WH073 (אַבְנֵט); 長 is LCC's added descriptor, SN attaches to whole phrase
Second {<WAH0853>} before final 摩西 kept implicit — no explicit word in LCC for this את

Lev/8.lcc_original: 摩西把解罪祭的公牛牽來；亞倫和他的兒子們按手在解罪祭的公牛頭上，
notes: UNV 他 → LCC 摩西 (Moses): same referent but UNV has no SN for the subject pronoun, so 摩西 left unannotated
LCC 把 serves as explicit direct object marker (BA-construction) paralleling Hebrew אֵת — first {<WAH0853>} attached to 把 with braces dropped per rule 3
Second {<WAH0853>} between 按 and 手 remains implicit as LCC also lacks an explicit word for it
LCC uses 解罪祭 where UNV uses 贖罪祭 — same sin/purification offering concept, SNs transferred to LCC's term

Lev/8.lcc_original: 就宰了公牛；取點兒血，用指頭抹在祭壇四角上的周圍，給祭壇除罪汚，把血倒在祭壇腳那裏，將壇分別爲聖，給壇除罪染。
notes: 摩西(H4872) absent in LCC → kept as implicit {<WH04872>} placed before 取 where Moses is the implied subject
UNV 蘸(dipped) maps to LCC 取(took) — both render H3947 laqach; 點兒 is LCC addition with no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated
LCC 除罪汚(H2398 chata piel = purify from sin) and 除罪染(H3722 kaphar = atone) are interpretive renderings of the Hebrew; SNs attached to the full verbal phrases
Only 3 of 5 altar mentions carry H4196 in UNV; LCC follows same pattern — 壇 in 將壇分別爲聖 and 給壇除罪染 left untagged

Lev/8.lcc_original: 摩西又把臟腑上的一切脂肪、和肝的附屬物、兩個腰子、和腰子的脂肪、都燻在祭壇上。
notes: H4872 (Moses): implicit {<WH04872>} in UNV but LCC has explicit 摩西 → braces dropped per rule 3
把 absorbs both H3947 (take/לָקַח) and WAH0853 (את object marker) since the Chinese 把-construction conveys both handling/taking and object marking
Third WAH0853 (before 兩個腰子) kept implicit — LCC uses list comma 、 with no explicit conjunction word (UNV had 並)
LCC 附屬物 (appendage) maps to H3508 (יֹתֶרֶת/lobe/appendage) where UNV had 網子
LCC 燻 (smoke/burn as incense) maps to H6999 (קָטַר) where UNV had 燒

Lev/8.lcc_original: 至於公牛、其皮、肉、和糞、他都在營外用火去燒：照永恆主所吩咐摩西的。
notes: UNV uses connectors 惟有/連/帶/並 to carry WAH0853 (את) before each noun. LCC lists objects with commas: 至於 carries first את; 其 (its) is possessive not את so marked implicit; 肉 has no carrier word so marked implicit; 和 (and) carries את like UNV's 並.
LCC 他都 (he all) has no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated per rule 5.
LCC 去 in 去燒 is a Chinese directional complement with no Hebrew source — left unannotated, SN attached to 燒 only.
永恆主 = 耶和華 (LORD/YHWH) — LCC's standard rendering mapped to WH03068.

Lev/8.lcc_original: 他將燔祭的公綿羊牽來【1】；亞倫和他的兒子們按手在那公綿羊頭上；
notes: LCC '將' serves as direct object marker (like Hebrew 'eth/H0853), so braces dropped per rule 3: 將<WAH0853>
LCC '牽來' (led/brought) corresponds to UNV '奉上' (presented) — both render H7126 qarab Hiphil (bring near/present)
Second {<WAH0853>} between 按 and 手 kept implicit as LCC also has no explicit word for it
LCC adds '那' (that) before 公綿羊 — left unannotated as it has no Hebrew equivalent
【1】 footnote marker preserved in place

Lev/8.lcc_original: 摩西就宰了牠；把血潑在祭壇的四圍。
notes: UNV 公羊 has no SN in this segment; LCC 牠 (pronoun replacing 公羊) left unannotated accordingly
LCC 潑 = UNV 灑 (both render Hebrew zaraq H2236, to dash/sprinkle blood)
LCC 祭壇 = UNV 壇 (H4196 altar); LCC 四圍 = UNV 周圍 (H5439 round about)

Lev/8.lcc_original: 旣把公綿羊切成了塊子，摩西就把頭和切塊跟板油都燻了。
notes: Moses {<WH04872>} is implicit in UNV but explicit in LCC (摩西), so braces dropped per Rule 3
板油 (LCC suet) = 脂油 (UNV fat) H6309 — same referent, different Chinese term
燻 (LCC smoke/burn) = 燒 (UNV burn) H6999 — synonymous verbs for קטר
旣 (already/after), 就 (then), 了 (aspect) are Chinese grammatical words with no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated per Rule 5
和 and 跟 in LCC correspond to 和 and 並 in UNV, each carrying <WAH0853> (את) marking the subsequent object

Lev/8.lcc_original: 用水洗了臟腑和腿之後，摩西就將整個公綿羊燻在祭壇上：這是燔祭、怡神之香氣，是火祭獻與永恆主的：都照永恆主所吩咐摩西的。
notes: UNV implicit {<WH04872>} (Moses as subject) → LCC has explicit 摩西, so braces dropped per rule 3
UNV 為<WAH01931> mapped to LCC 這<WAH01931> — both render Hebrew הוּא (it/this) but differently; 這 is semantically closer to the pronoun
怡神之香氣 is a reversed construct chain (Hebrew רֵיחַ נִיחֹחַ = aroma soothing); SNs grouped at end of phrase since Chinese reverses the word order
LCC 之後 is an addition with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated per rule 5
LCC 公綿羊 (male sheep/ram) is more specific than UNV 羊 (sheep) but maps to same H0352 (אַיִל, ram)

Lev/8.lcc_sn: 他又把<WAH0853>第二<WH08145>隻公綿羊<WH0352>、就是承受聖職<WH04394>所獻的公綿羊<WH0352>、牽來<WH07126><WTH8686>【1】：亞倫<WH0175>和他兒子們<WH01121>按<WH05564><WTH8799>{<WAH0853>}手<WH03027>在<WAH05921>那公綿羊<WH0352>頭<WH07218>上；
Lev/8.lcc_original: 他又把第二隻公綿羊、就是承受聖職所獻的公綿羊、牽來【1】：亞倫和他兒子們按手在那公綿羊頭上；
notes: UNV implicit {<WAH0853>} (first instance): LCC uses 把 as explicit object-fronting particle, functionally equivalent to Hebrew את — dropped braces per rule 3 and attached to 把
UNV implicit {<WAH0853>} (second instance, before 手): LCC has no explicit equivalent — kept braces as {<WAH0853>} between the verb 按 and its object 手
H4394 (millu'im = consecration/ordination offering) attached after 聖職 as the core semantic correspondent within LCC's rephrased 承受聖職所獻的
LCC 那 (demonstrative 'that') left unannotated — no Hebrew equivalent in this verse's SN set

Lev/8.lcc_original: 摩西就宰了牠；取點兒血，抹在亞倫的右耳垂上、和右手的大拇指上、跟右腳的大拇趾上。
notes: LCC uses 牠 (it/the animal) where UNV has 羊 (sheep/ram); 羊 carries no SN in UNV so 牠 is left unannotated
LCC uses 點兒 (a bit of) where UNV has 些 (some of) — both convey the partitive sense of מִן (WAH04480); grouped with 血(WH01818) following UNV pattern
LCC uses 大拇趾 (big toe) where UNV has 大拇指 (thumb/big toe) for the foot — same H0931 (בֹּהֶן bohen) applies to both
LCC uses 跟 as conjunction where UNV uses 並 — both mapped to WAH05921 (עַל)

Lev/8.lcc_original: 旣把亞倫的兒子們引進了來【1】，摩西就將點兒血抹在他們的右耳垂上、和右手的大拇指上、跟右腳的大拇趾上；摩西又把血潑在祭壇的四圍。
notes: Both {<WH04872>} (Moses) implicit in UNV become explicit 摩西<WH04872> in LCC since LCC names Moses twice
First {<WAH0853>} (אֵת direct object marker) maps to 把 in LCC's bǎ-construction; second <WAH0853> maps to 把 in 又把
LCC 祭壇 (sacrifice-altar) vs UNV 壇 (altar) — both receive H4196 as a unit
LCC 點兒 (a bit of) corresponds to UNV 些 (some) for H4480 (מִן partitive)
LCC uses 大拇趾 (big toe) for foot vs 大拇指 (thumb) for hand — both map to H0931 (bōhen)
LCC 潑 (splash) vs UNV 灑 (sprinkle) — both map to H2236 (zāraq)
將 in LCC carries H5414 (nātan, to put) paralleling 把 in UNV — both are Chinese bǎ-construction particles hosting the verb SN
【1】 footnote marker preserved as-is
Missing SNs: 05921, 05921

Lev/8.lcc_original: 他取脂肪和肥尾巴跟臟腑的一切脂肪、和肝的附屬物、跟兩個腰子和腰子的脂肪、以及右腿：
notes: LCC adds 他 (he) as explicit subject with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated
UNV {<WAH0853>} before 兩個腰子 is implicit, but LCC has explicit 跟 — braces dropped per Rule 3
UNV 臟上 (innards-on) restructured in LCC as 臟腑的 (innards-of); 的 receives <WAH05921> (עַל=on/upon)
UNV 網子 (caul/net) → LCC 附屬物 (appendage) — same Hebrew יֹתֶרֶת H3508
<WAH0834> (אֲשֶׁר=which) has no explicit LCC equivalent in 臟腑的一切脂肪 — kept implicit

Lev/8.lcc_original: 又從永恆主面前裝無酵餅的筐子裏取一個無酵哈拉餅、一個調油的哈拉餅、和一個薄餅，放在脂肪和右腿上；
notes: LCC 永恆主 = UNV 耶和華 (YHWH) — straightforward semantic match
LCC uses 哈拉餅 (transliteration of חַלָּה challah) where UNV simply says 餅; H2471 attached to 哈拉餅 in both occurrences
LCC 調油的哈拉餅 ('oil-mixed challah') vs UNV 油餅 — H8081 attached to 油 within 調油, H2471+H3899 to 哈拉餅
{<WAH0834>} kept implicit: LCC also has no explicit relative pronoun for 'asher'
LCC 脂肪 = UNV 脂油 for חֵלֶב (chelev/fat)

Lev/8.lcc_original: 把這一切都交在亞倫的手掌中、和他兒子們的手掌中、做搖獻物搖在永恆主面前。
notes: UNV 放 → LCC 交: both mean 'to place/give into hands', semantic match for H5414 natan
UNV 手 → LCC 手掌: LCC uses more specific 'palm' but same Hebrew kaph H3709
UNV 搖祭 → LCC 搖獻物: different Chinese rendering of H8573 tenuphah
UNV 耶和華 → LCC 永恆主: standard LCC rendering of YHWH H3068
都 in LCC is an emphatic adverb with no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated
Second WAH05921 attached to 和 since LCC omits the second 在 preposition, using parallel structure 中、和...中

Lev/8.lcc_sn: 然後摩西<WH04872>就從<WAH04480><WAH05921>他們的手掌<WH03709>上接過來<WH03947><WTH8799>，把<WAH0853>這些物品燻<WH06999><WTH8686>在<WAH05921>祭壇<WH04196>上燔祭品<WH05930>上面；這些是<WAH01992>承受聖職<WH04394>獻爲<WAH09001>怡神<WH05207>之香氣<WH07381>的；這是<WAH01931>獻與<WAH09001>永恆主<WH03068>的火祭<WH0801>。
Lev/8.lcc_original: 然後摩西就從他們的手掌上接過來，把這些物品燻在祭壇上燔祭品上面；這些是承受聖職獻爲怡神之香氣的；這是獻與永恆主的火祭。
notes: UNV {<WAH0853>} (implicit אֵת) → LCC '把' explicitly serves as object marker, so braces dropped
UNV {<WAH01931>} (implicit הוּא) → LCC '這是' explicitly renders 'it is', so braces dropped
LCC '永恆主' = YHWH (LCC's characteristic rendering vs UNV '耶和華')
LCC splits UNV's single final clause into two: '這些是承受聖職獻爲怡神之香氣的；這是獻與永恆主的火祭'
LCC adds '然後…就', '這些物品', '上面' with no Hebrew equivalents — left unannotated
Hebrew לְרֵיחַ נִיחוֹחַ split across LCC 怡神(H05207) + 香氣(H07381); WAH09001 (ל prefix) attached to 獻爲

Lev/8.lcc_original: 摩西取羊的胸做搖獻物搖在永恆主面前：這是承受聖職所獻的公綿羊屬於摩西的分兒：照永恆主所吩咐摩西的。
notes: UNV implicit {<WAH01961>}{<WTH8804>} (hayah, 'to be') has explicit rendering 是 in LCC, so braces dropped and tags attached to 是; 這 left unannotated as it has no Hebrew equivalent
LCC expands with 所獻的公綿羊 (the offered ram) in the second clause; H0352 (ram) already tagged on first 羊, so 公綿羊 left untagged to avoid double-tagging
LCC 屬於 (belongs to) is a translational addition with no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated

Lev/9.lcc_original: 亞倫向人民舉手，給他們祝福；他舉行了解罪祭、燔祭、平安祭，就下來。

贖罪祭→解罪祭: LCC uses 解罪祭 for sin offering vs UNV 贖罪祭; same referent H2403
獻了→舉行了: UNV 獻 (offer) maps to LCC 舉行 (conduct/perform); all three SNs (H4480 prefix, H6213 make/do, morphology) attached after the verb+了
{<WAH0853>} kept implicit: LCC has no explicit direct object marker before 手, same as UNV

Lev/9.lcc_original: 摩西亞倫進了會棚，又出來給人民祝福；永恆主的榮耀向衆民顯現。
notes: 會棚 (LCC) = 會幕 (UNV): both render אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד; 棚 takes WH0168 (אֹהֶל) and 會 takes WH04150 (מוֹעֵד), attached together as compound
永恆主 (LCC) = 耶和華 (UNV): standard LCC rendering of YHWH, takes WH03068
了 in 進了 is a Chinese aspect particle with no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated; SN tags placed after the full verb unit
給 (LCC) corresponds to 為 (UNV) carrying WAH0853 (אֵת, object marker)

Lev/9.lcc_original: 有火從永恆主面前出來，在祭壇上燒盡了燔祭和脂肪；衆民看見、就大聲歡呼，臉伏於地。
notes: H06440 (פָּנִים, face): UNV maps it to 地 at end of verse, but LCC explicitly has 臉 (face) — attached H06440 to 臉 instead, which is semantically more accurate to the Hebrew
LCC 大聲歡呼 expands UNV 歡呼 — H07442 (רָנַן, shout for joy) attached after the full phrase since 大聲 is LCC's amplification of the same concept
了 after 燒盡 is a Chinese aspect particle with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated
LCC 祭壇 vs UNV 壇 — same referent (מִזְבֵּחַ H04196), just LCC uses the fuller form

Lev/10.lcc_original: 亞倫的兒子拿答亞比戶拿着自己的香爐，盛上火，加上香，在永恆主面前獻平常的火、是永恆主沒有吩咐他們的。
notes: UNV 各<WH0376> (אִישׁ, each man) has no explicit counterpart in LCC → kept as implicit {<WH0376>}, placed after 亞比戶 before the verb
UNV 獻上 → LCC simply 獻 (no 上); both SNs <WH07126><WTH8686> attached to 獻
UNV 凡火 (strange fire) → LCC 平常的火 (ordinary fire): different renderings of זָרָה H2114; <WH02114><WTH8801> attached to 平常的 as the adjective
UNV 耶和華 → LCC 永恆主 (both = YHWH/יְהוָה)
Second occurrence of 耶和華/永恆主 has no SN in UNV source data, so left untagged in LCC as well

Lev/10.lcc_original: 就有火從永恆主面前發出，燒滅他們，他們就死在永恆主面前。
notes: UNV 把他們<WAH0853>燒滅 reorders to LCC 燒滅他們 — attached WAH0853 (את) to 他們 after the verb
永恆主 = 耶和華 (LCC's rendering of the Tetragrammaton)
UNV 出來 → LCC 發出 (same Hebrew יָצָא H3318, different Chinese verb choice)

Lev/10.lcc_original: 於是摩西對亞倫說：『這就是永恆主告訴我們說的：「在親近我的人中間、我要顯爲聖；在各族之民面前、我要得榮耀。」』亞倫默默無言。
notes: 永恆主 is LCC's standard rendering of 耶和華 (YHWH), mapped to <WH03068>
UNV implicit {<WH01696>}{<WTH8765>} (דבר/spoke) has explicit counterpart 告訴 in LCC — braces dropped per rule 3
我們 added by LCC translator with no Hebrew source word — left unannotated
LCC 各族之 corresponds to UNV 眾 (כֹּל/all <WAH03605>), a freer rendering
的 in LCC serves as relative clause nominalizer corresponding to UNV 所<WAH0834> (אֲשֶׁר)

Lev/10.lcc_original: 摩西把亞倫的叔父烏薛的兒子米沙利、以利撒反叫了來，對他們說：『走近前來，將你們的族弟兄從聖所前抬到營外。』
notes: LCC uses 把-construction (摩西把...叫了來) restructuring UNV's 摩西召了...來; 把 is a Chinese grammatical marker with no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated; the verb SN H07121 attached to 叫了來 (LCC's equivalent of UNV 召了)
LCC 族弟兄 (clan brothers) corresponds to UNV 親屬 (kinsmen), both translating H0251 אָח
將 in LCC serves as object marker like UNV 把, mapped to WAH0853 (אֵת)
Two {<WAH0413>} implicit markers retained before 米沙利 and 以利撒反 as LCC also lacks explicit prepositions before these names

Lev/10.lcc_sn: 二人便走近前來<WH07126><WTH8799>，就他們穿着祭司內袍<WAH09002><WH03801>的情狀、將他們抬<WH05375><WTH8799>到<WAH0413>營<WAH09001><WH04264>外<WAH04480><WH02351>，照<WAH09003><WAH0834>摩西<WH04872>所告訴<WH01696><WTH8765>他們的。
Lev/10.lcc_original: 二人便走近前來，就他們穿着祭司內袍的情狀、將他們抬到營外，照摩西所告訴他們的。
notes: UNV 上前來 → LCC 走近前來: same semantic meaning (to come near), H7126 attached after 走近前來
UNV 袍子 → LCC 祭司內袍: LCC expands to '祭司內袍' (priestly inner robe), SN attached after 袍 before 的情狀
UNV 所吩咐的 → LCC 所告訴他們的: both render H1696 (dābar), LCC adds explicit object 他們 which is left unannotated
UNV implicit markers not present in this verse — all SNs have explicit LCC correspondences

Lev/10.lcc_original: 摩西對亞倫和他兒子以利亞撒、以他瑪說：『不可蓬頭散髮【1】，也不可撕裂衣服，免得你們死亡，免得永恆主惱怒全會衆；只是你們的族弟兄、以色列全家、卻要爲永恆主所燃燒起的焚燒來哀哭。
notes: UNV 向<WAH05921> (preposition 'upon/against') has no separate word in LCC; absorbed into 惱怒 (be angry at) — attached <WAH05921> to 惱怒 along with <WH07107><WTH8799>
UNV {<WAH03605>} is implicit (全/all), but LCC has explicit 全 before 會衆 — dropped braces per Rule 3
LCC 族弟兄 maps to UNV 弟兄<WH0251>; 族 is LCC's addition (no separate SN)
LCC 燃燒起的 = UNV 發的<WH08313><WTH8804> (verb 'burn'); LCC 焚燒 = UNV 火<WH08316> (noun 'burning/conflagration')
LCC 來 before 哀哭 is a Chinese grammatical particle with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated
First 永恆主 (=耶和華) has no SN in UNV source; second 永恆主 carries <WH03068>

Lev/10.lcc_original: 你們不可出會棚的出入處，恐怕你們死亡，因爲永恆主的膏油在你們身上。』他們就照摩西的話行了。
notes: UNV 幕(tent/tabernacle) → LCC 棚(booth/tent): both translate H0168 אֹהֶל, different Chinese word choice
UNV 門(door) → LCC 出入處(entrance): both translate H6607 פֶּתַח, LCC uses a more descriptive term
UNV 耶和華 → LCC 永恆主: standard LCC rendering of the Tetragrammaton YHWH (H3068)
UNV has 也 (also) with no SN; LCC omits it — no impact on annotation

Lev/10.lcc_original: 永恆主告訴亞倫說：
notes: UNV has {<WAH0413>} (implicit 'to/el') but LCC 告訴 ('told') explicitly conveys the directional meaning, so braces dropped and WAH0413 attached to 告訴 per Rule 3.

Lev/10.lcc_original: 『你和你兒子跟你一同進會棚時，清酒濃酒都不可喝，免得死亡：這要做你們世世代代永遠的條例；
notes: LCC adds 跟你一同 (together with you) which expands the meaning but has no separate SN; left unannotated
LCC uses 會棚 (tabernacle/booth) where UNV has 會幕 (tent of meeting); same SNs H4150+H0168 applied to 會棚
LCC uses 條例 where UNV has 定例; same SN H2708 applied
UNV has 你們死亡 but LCC omits 你們 before 死亡; SN H4191 applied to 死亡 alone
{<WAH0413>} kept implicit as LCC also has no explicit preposition for אֶל

Lev/10.lcc_original: 使你們能將聖的和俗的、潔淨的和不潔淨的、分別清楚；
notes: UNV has 4 instances of WAH0996 (בֵּין). The first attaches to 將. Two implicit ones correspond to LCC's explicit 和 connectors (braces dropped per Rule 3). The third implicit בֵּין between the two pairs (holy/profane vs clean/unclean) has only punctuation 、 in LCC, so kept as implicit {<WAH0996>}.
LCC 分別清楚 corresponds to UNV 分別出來 — same semantic role (Hiphil infinitive of בָּדַל), different complement particle (清楚 vs 出來).

Lev/10.lcc_original: 又使你們可以將永恆主經摩西手所告訴以色列人的一切律例、指教他們。』
notes: UNV 耶和華 → LCC 永恆主 (Lü's standard rendering of YHWH)
UNV 藉<WAH09002><WH03027> bundles ב+יד onto one word; LCC splits into 經<WAH09002>...手<WH03027> since LCC explicitly has 手 (hand)
UNV 的<WAH0834> (אשר relative) → LCC 所 (relative marker); the second 的 in LCC is purely grammatical, left unannotated
UNV 教訓 → LCC 指教 (same sense: teach/instruct), carries <WAH09001><WH03384><WTH8687>
{<WAH0853>} implicit object marker kept before 以色列 — no explicit word in LCC for את

Lev/10.lcc_original: 摩西告訴亞倫和他剩下的兒子、以利亞撒和以他瑪、說：『你們獻與永恆主的火祭中所剩下的素祭、要在祭壇旁不帶酵地喫，因爲這是至聖的。
notes: UNV 對<WAH0413> → LCC 告訴<WAH0413>: LCC uses 告訴 (tell) which incorporates the directional sense of אֵל; SN attached to the verb
First {<WAH0413>} retained as implicit — LCC uses punctuation 、 after 兒子, no explicit conjunction word
Second {<WAH0413>} → 和<WAH0413>: LCC has explicit 和 (and) between 以利亞撒 and 以他瑪, so braces dropped per Rule 3
UNV 耶和華 → LCC 永恆主: same WH03068 (YHWH), Lü's characteristic rendering
UNV 壇 → LCC 祭壇: WH04196 attached to 祭壇 (LCC's fuller form of altar)
這<WAH01931>: LCC adds demonstrative 這 (this) which explicitly translates הוּא; placed after 這 since 是 is the copula

Lev/10.lcc_sn: 你們要在聖<WH06918>的地方<WAH09002><WH04725>喫<WH0398><WTH8804>{<WAH0853>}，因爲<WAH03588>在獻與永恆主<WH03068>的火祭中<WAH04480><WH0801>、這是<WAH01931>你的分兒<WH02706>、和你兒子們<WH01121>的分兒<WH02706>；因爲<WAH03588>所吩咐<WH06680><WTH8795>我的就是這樣<WAH03651>。
Lev/10.lcc_original: 你們要在聖的地方喫，因爲在獻與永恆主的火祭中、這是你的分兒、和你兒子們的分兒；因爲所吩咐我的就是這樣。
notes: UNV 處 (place) → LCC 的地方; 聖 gets H6918 separately, 地方 gets the prefix+place tags H9002+H4725
UNV 耶和華 → LCC 永恆主 (Lü's standard rendering of YHWH)
UNV 吃 → LCC 喫 (older character form, same word)
UNV second 本是(H3588) → LCC second 因爲; both render כִּי but differently — UNV as 本是, LCC as 因爲
{<WAH0853>} (את direct object marker) kept implicit — LCC also has no explicit word for it
UNV 分 → LCC 分兒 (兒 is a diminutive/colloquial suffix in Lü's style)
H6680+H8795 morphology tags attached directly to verb 吩咐 per morphology rule

Lev/10.lcc_sn: 至於所<WAH0853>搖獻<WH08573>的胸<WH02373>所<WAH0853>提獻<WH08641>的腿<WH07785>、你們也要在潔淨<WH02889>的地方<WAH09002><WH04725>喫<WH0398><WTH8799>，你<WAH0859>和你兒<WH01121>女<WH01323>跟你一同<WAH0854>喫，因爲<WAH03588>這是你的分兒<WH02706>、和你兒子們<WH01121>的分兒<WH02706>，是從以色列<WH03478>人<WH01121>平安<WH08002>祭<WAH04480><WH02077>中給予<WH05414><WTH8738>你的。
Lev/10.lcc_original: 至於所搖獻的胸所提獻的腿、你們也要在潔淨的地方喫，你和你兒女跟你一同喫，因爲這是你的分兒、和你兒子們的分兒，是從以色列人的平安祭中給予你的。
notes: LCC reorders the sentence: 'this is your portion and your sons' portion, given from peace offerings' vs UNV's 'from peace offerings given to you, as your portion and sons' portion'. SNs attached to corresponding words in LCC's order.
LCC 搖獻/提獻 (wave-offer/heave-offer) are two-char compounds corresponding to UNV single-char 搖/舉; SN attached after full compound.
LCC adds 至於 (as for) with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated.
WAH0854 (with) attached to 一同 in LCC's 跟你一同喫 construction, corresponding to UNV 同<WAH0854>吃.
H5414 (give) attached to 給予 rather than trailing 你, as it is the verb.

Lev/10.lcc_original: 所提獻的腿、所搖獻的胸、他們要跟火祭的脂肪一同帶來、做搖獻物，搖在永恆主面前：這要給你和你兒子們跟你一同享受、做永遠的分兒：照永恆主所吩咐的。』
notes: UNV implicit {<WAH0854>} (et='with') becomes explicit in LCC '跟你一同享受'; dropped braces and attached WAH0854 to 跟你 per rule 3
LCC reorders '搖在永恆主面前' vs UNV '在耶和華面前搖一搖' — SN tags follow LCC word order
LCC '一同享受' (enjoy together) has no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated per rule 5
LCC '做搖獻物' maps to UNV '當搖祭' (WAH09001+WH08573 = tenuphah as wave offering)

Lev/10.lcc_original: 當下那做解罪祭的公山羊、摩西找來找去都找不着；哪知道已經焚燒了！摩西就惱怒亞倫剩下的兒子、以利亞撒、以他瑪，說：
notes: LCC mentions 摩西 twice (topicalized sentence structure); H4872 attached to first occurrence only, matching UNV's single occurrence.
LCC '找來找去都找不着' (searched everywhere, couldn't find) captures UNV's emphatic doubled דָּרֹשׁ דָּרַשׁ (H1875 inf. abs. + H1875 perfect). Both morphology tags attached at end of the LCC phrase.

LCC '惱怒' absorbs both H7107 (qatsaph, be angry) and the first WAH05921 (al, against/upon): UNV has '便向...發怒' with a separate preposition 向, but LCC uses transitive '惱怒亞倫' with no separate preposition, so WAH05921 attached to 惱怒.
Second {<WAH05921>} before 以他瑪 remains implicit — LCC uses comma punctuation (、) between Eleazar and Ithamar with no explicit conjunction or preposition.
{<WAH0853>} (direct object marker אֵת) remains implicit — no Chinese equivalent in LCC's topicalized construction either.

Lev/10.lcc_original: 『這解罪祭旣是至聖的，主又將那祭品給了你們、去擔當會衆的罪罰、而在永恆主面前爲他們行除罪禮，你們爲甚麼沒有在聖的地方喫呢？
notes: 解罪祭(LCC)=贖罪祭(UNV)→H02403 sin offering; different translation, same referent
那祭品 is LCC's clarifying addition for the object; no SN assigned. The implicit {<WAH0853>} is retained before it since 那祭品 does not translate את itself
去 in LCC translates the ל infinitive-prefix (WAH09001) on לָשֵׂאת, split from 擔當(H05375)
永恆主(LCC)=耶和華(UNV)→H03068 YHWH
行除罪禮(LCC)=贖罪(UNV)→H03722 to make atonement; LCC expands to a 4-char phrase, all SNs attach at end
罪罰(LCC)=罪孽(UNV)→H05771 iniquity/guilt
爲甚麼(LCC)=為何(UNV)→H04069 why
地方(LCC)=所(UNV)→H04725 place; 在 left unannotated following UNV convention where ב prefix (WAH09002) attaches to the noun
而 in LCC is a conjunction with no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated
喫(LCC)=吃(UNV) variant character for eat→H0398

Lev/10.lcc_original: 你看，這祭牲的血竟沒有拿到聖所裏面去呀！你們本該照我所吩咐的準準在聖所裏喫纔對呀。』
notes: UNV 看哪 (behold) → LCC 你看 (you see): same Hebrew הֵן H2005, different Chinese rendering
UNV 並沒有 → LCC 竟沒有: 竟 (unexpectedly) is LCC's adverbial addition with no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated; H3808 (לֹא) attached to 沒有
UNV 所裡 H6441 (פְּנִימָה inner part) → LCC 所裏面: same meaning, different character choice
{H0398}{H8800} kept implicit: UNV has an implicit infinitive absolute of 'eat' before 照; LCC also has no explicit word there
UNV 這祭肉+H0853 → LCC omits the object entirely; H0853 (את direct object marker) kept as implicit {<WAH0853>} after 喫
準準 (precisely) and 纔對呀 (that would be right) are LCC rhetorical additions with no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated
Closing quote mark adjusted to match LCC's 『 (single bracket style)

Lev/10.lcc_original: 亞倫對摩西說：『今天他們獻了解罪祭和燔祭在永恆主面前，我尚且遇到了這樣的災，今天我若喫了解罪祭，永恆主哪能滿意呢？』
notes: LCC uses 永恆主 for 耶和華 (the LORD) — direct semantic mapping
LCC uses 解罪祭 for 贖罪祭 (sin offering) — same referent, different translation choice
LCC word order differs: 獻了解罪祭和燔祭在永恆主面前 vs UNV 在耶和華面前獻上…贖罪祭和燔祭; SNs follow each LCC word in LCC's own order
{<WAH02005>} (behold/הֵן) kept implicit — LCC has no explicit equivalent
LCC 滿意 consolidates UNV 看<WAH09002><WH05869>為美<WH03190><WTH8799> (be good in [the] eyes); all four SNs attached to 滿意 since LCC has no separate 'eyes/see' word
LCC 尚且 (even so) and 哪能 (how could) have no Hebrew equivalents — left unannotated
LCC uses archaic 喫 for 吃 (eat)

Lev/10.lcc_original: 摩西聽了，就認爲滿意。
notes: UNV 這話 has no SN and no direct LCC counterpart — omitted without issue.
UNV 以為<WAH09002><WH05869> (lit. 'in eyes of' = בְּעֵינָיו) maps to LCC 認爲 (considered/regarded) — semantic equivalent despite different phrasing.
UNV 美<WH03190><WTH8799> (יָטַב, to be good) maps to LCC 滿意 (satisfied/pleased) — both convey approval but LCC uses a more idiomatic rendering.
了 is a Chinese aspect particle with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated per rules; SN attaches after 聽了 as a unit.

Lev/11.lcc_original: 永恆主告訴摩西亞倫說：
notes: UNV 對<WAH0413> is an explicit preposition, but LCC folds it into the verb 告訴 (tell), so <WAH0413> is attached to 告訢 along with the formerly-implicit <WH01696><WTH8762> (דבר Piel)
UNV {<WH01696>}{<WTH8762>} were implicit (braces) because UNV used 對...說 rather than translating דבר explicitly; LCC 告訴 explicitly renders דבר, so braces are dropped per Rule 3
The two remaining {<WAH0413>} markers stay implicit as LCC has no explicit preposition between Moses/Aaron or after 說

Lev/11.lcc_original: 『你們要告訴以色列人說：以下這些活物是地上一切走獸中你們可以喫的。
notes: UNV has {<WH02416>} (חַי, living creature) as implicit, but LCC explicitly says 活物 — dropped braces and attached as normal tag per Rule 3.
LCC restructures the sentence (以下這些活物是...中...可以喫的) vs UNV order (...中可吃的乃是這些), but SNs are attached to semantically corresponding words regardless of word order.
{<WAH0413>} (אֶל, to) remains implicit in LCC as 告訴 has no explicit preposition marker.

Lev/11.lcc_original: 凡分蹄叉趾、倒嚼的走獸、你們都可以喫。
notes: UNV '蹄分兩瓣' reordered to LCC '分蹄叉趾': 分(split)→H6536, 蹄(hoof)→H6541, 叉(fork)→H8156 שָׁסַע (to cleave), 趾(toe/cleft)→H8157 שֶׁסַע (a cleft)
LCC uses variant character 喫 for UNV 吃 — both mean 'eat', tagged with H0398
Implicit {<WAH0853>} (את) retained: LCC also has no explicit word for the direct object marker

Lev/11.lcc_original: 惟獨以下這一類你們卻不可喫：在倒嚼或分蹄的之中、你們不可喫駱駝；因爲牠倒嚼而不分蹄、牠對於你們就不潔淨。
notes: LCC has explicit 牠 (it) where UNV has implicit {<WAH01931>}, so braces dropped per rule 3 for both occurrences
LCC restructures into two 不可喫 clauses; Hebrew has only one לֹא תֹאכְלוּ — SNs (H3808, H0398, WTH8799) attached to first occurrence only; second left unannotated
First אֶת (H0853) has no explicit LCC word — kept as {<WAH0853>}; second אֶת placed before 駱駝 as direct object marker
對於 translates the ל prefix (H09001) — tag placed after 你們 following UNV convention

Lev/11.lcc_original: 不可喫石貛，因爲牠倒嚼而不分蹄，牠對於你們就不潔淨。

Lev/12.lcc_original: 她若手頭緊，彀不着獻一隻小羊，就要取兩隻斑鳩、或是兩隻雛鴿，一隻作爲燔祭，一隻作爲解罪祭，讓祭司爲她行除罪禮，她就潔淨了。』
notes: UNV {<WAH0518>} is implicit but LCC has explicit 若 (if), so braces dropped per rule 3
LCC 手頭緊 is an idiom for 'financially tight'; 手頭 maps to H3027 (יָד=hand), 緊 is idiomatic Chinese with no separate Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated
LCC 彀不着 splits as 彀(enough)H1767 + 不(not)H3808 + 着(resultative particle, unannotated)
LCC 讓 (causative 'let') has no Hebrew equivalent — it's a Chinese restructuring device, left unannotated
LCC 行除罪禮 ('perform atonement rite') maps to H3722 כָּפַר (atone); LCC rephrases UNV 贖罪 but same semantic content
LCC 作爲 corresponds to UNV 為 for the Hebrew prefix לְ (H9001); tags grouped after the offering noun following UNV pattern

Lev/13.lcc_original: 永恆主告訴摩西亞倫說：
notes: 耶和華→永恆主: LCC's standard rendering of the Tetragrammaton
曉諭→告訴: both mean 'told/spoke to', verb SN+morphology transferred directly
Both {<WAH0413>} (אֶל, 'to') remain implicit — LCC's 告訴 already implies direction, matching UNV's pattern

Lev/13.lcc_original: 『人在肉皮上若腫起來，或是有了癬、或是火斑，而在肉皮上成了痲瘋屬災病，他就必須被帶到祭司亞倫、或亞倫子孫中一個做祭司者面前。
notes: LCC 腫起來 (to swell up) merges UNV's verb 長了<WAH01961><WTH8799> and noun 癤子<WH07613>/שְׂאֵת into one verbal expression; all three tags attached to 腫起來
LCC 痲瘋屬 (leprosy-type) corresponds to UNV 大痲瘋<WH06883>; 屬 is LCC's classifier suffix meaning 'of that category'
LCC reorders UNV's 亞倫作祭司的一個子孫 to 亞倫子孫中一個做祭司者 — tags redistributed to match LCC word order
Second אֶל (H0413) before second 亞倫 has no explicit LCC equivalent, kept as {<WAH0413>}

Lev/13.lcc_original: 祭司要察看肉皮上的災病；若災病處的毛已經變白，災病的現象又深於肉上的皮，這便是痲瘋屬災病；祭司要察看他，斷他爲不潔淨。
notes: LCC uses 又深於 where UNV has 深於; 又 (furthermore) is LCC addition with no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated
LCC uses 痲瘋屬 (leprosy-type) where UNV has 大痲瘋 (great leprosy); WH06883 (צָרַעַת) attached to 痲瘋屬 as the semantic equivalent
LCC uses 斷 (pronounce) where UNV has 定 (determine); same Hebrew root WH02930 via WAH0853 object marker pattern
{<WAH0853>} kept implicit before 肉 as LCC has no explicit object marker there, matching UNV

Lev/13.lcc_original: 若火斑在肉皮上發白，沒有深於皮的現象，上頭的毛也沒有變白，祭司就要將患災病的關閉七天。
notes: UNV 是<WAH01931>白的<WH03836> → LCC 發白<WAH01931><WH03836>: LCC uses compound verb 發白 (to show white) instead of copula+adjective 是白的; both SNs attached to 發白 as a unit
UNV 他肉 → LCC 肉: LCC omits pronoun 他 (no SN on 他, so no impact)
UNV 不<WAH0369> → LCC 沒有<WAH0369>: different negation word, same semantic role
UNV 關鎖 → LCC 關閉: synonym pair, same SNs transferred
UNV 有災病的人 → LCC 患災病的: LCC omits 人 and uses 患 instead of 有; WH05061 attached to 災病 in both

Lev/13.lcc_original: 第七天祭司要察看他；若見災病止住了，並沒有在皮上發散，那麼、祭司還要再把他關閉七天。
notes: UNV 看<WAH09002><WH05869> (H5869=עַיִן eye) mapped to LCC 見 — both render the Hebrew idiom of visual inspection
LCC adds 並 before 沒有 for emphasis; SN <WAH03808> attached to 沒有 portion (並 is unannotated Chinese connective)
LCC uses 關閉 where UNV has 關鎖 — same Hebrew סָגַר H5462 Hiphil
LCC adds 再 alongside 還 to express H8145 שֵׁנִי 'a second time'; SN attached to 還 as in UNV, 再 left unannotated
{<WH05061>} kept implicit — LCC like UNV has no second explicit word for נֶגַע in the subordinate clause
LCC 那麼、 is a discourse connector with no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated

Lev/13.lcc_original: 第七天祭司要再察看他；若見災病暗淡了，災病沒有在皮上發散開，那麼祭司就要斷他爲潔淨；那只是癬；他只要把衣服洗淨，就潔淨了。
notes: UNV implicit {<WH05061>} (而且{災病}) becomes explicit in LCC which repeats 災病 — braces dropped per Rule 3
LCC 若見 covers WAH02009 (הִנֵּה hinneh = behold/if); UNV has just 若 but LCC adds 見 which reinforces the 'behold' sense
LCC 發散開 treated as single verbal unit for H06581; 開 is a Chinese resultative complement with no separate Hebrew equivalent
了 particles (暗淡了, 潔淨了) left unannotated — Chinese aspect markers with no Hebrew counterpart (Rule 5)
LCC 那麼 is a Chinese discourse connector with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated

Lev/13.lcc_sn: 但是爲了證明自己已經潔淨<WAH09001><WH02893>、他給<WAH0413>祭司<WH03548>察看<WH07200><WTH8736>了以後<WH0310>，癬<WH04556>若<WAH0518>在皮上<WAH09002><WH05785>發散<WH06581><WTH8800>開了<WH06581><WTH8799>，那麼、他就要將自己再<WH08145>給<WAH0413>祭司<WH03548>察看<WH07200><WTH8738>。
Lev/13.lcc_original: 但是爲了證明自己已經潔淨、他給祭司察看了以後，癬若在皮上發散開了，那麼、他就要將自己再給祭司察看。
notes: UNV 為得潔淨 maps to LCC 爲了證明自己已經潔淨 — LCC expands the phrase but 潔淨 remains the core semantic anchor for H2893 and the lamed prefix 09001
LCC 了 (aspect particle after 察看) left unannotated per rule 5 — no Hebrew equivalent
LCC 那麼 (connector) has no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated
LCC 就要將自己 is structural Chinese phrasing with no direct SN correspondence, left unannotated

Lev/13.lcc_sn: 祭司<WH03548>要察看<WH07200><WTH8804>；若見<WAH02009>癬<WH04556>在皮上<WAH09002><WH05785>發散<WH06581><WTH8804>開了，那麼、祭司<WH03548>就要斷他爲不潔淨<WH02930><WTH8765>：那是<WAH01931>痲瘋屬之病<WH06883>。
Lev/13.lcc_original: 祭司要察看；若見癬在皮上發散開了，那麼、祭司就要斷他爲不潔淨：那是痲瘋屬之病。
notes: UNV {<WAH02009>} (הִנֵּה behold) is implicit in UNV, but LCC has explicit 見 (see/behold) — braces dropped, SN attached to 見
UNV {<WH03548>} (priest) is implicit in UNV, but LCC has explicit second 祭司 — braces dropped, SN attached normally
LCC 發散開了: SNs attach to 發散; 開了 is LCC's aspectual elaboration with no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated
UNV 大痲瘋 → LCC 痲瘋屬之病: different phrasing for same concept (צָרַעַת leprosy), SN attached to full LCC phrase

Lev/13.lcc_sn: 『一個人<WAH09002><WH0120>身上若<WAH03588>有了<WAH01961><WTH8799>痲瘋<WH06883>屬災病<WH05061>，他就要被帶<WH0935><WTH8717>到<WAH0413>祭司<WH03548>面前。
Lev/13.lcc_original: 『一個人身上若有了痲瘋屬災病，他就要被帶到祭司面前。
notes: UNV has {<WAH03588>} (כִּי) as implicit at sentence start; LCC explicitly translates it as 若 (if), so braces dropped and SN attached to 若.
UNV 大痲瘋 vs LCC 痲瘋 — same Hebrew root H6883 (צָרַעַת), LCC omits 大 but meaning is equivalent.
LCC 屬 (belonging to / of the type) is a Chinese connector with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated.
LCC 身上 (on the body) has no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated.
LCC uses passive 被帶 (be brought) vs UNV active 帶 (bring) — both translate H0935 (בּוֹא hophal), SN attached after 帶.

Lev/13.lcc_original: 祭司要察看；若見皮上有了白白腫腫的地方，又使毛變了白，而在腫的地方也有了生的赤肉，
notes: LCC 見 explicitly renders UNV's implicit {<WAH02009>} (הִנֵּה behold), so braces dropped and tag attached to 見
LCC 白白腫腫 is a Chinese reduplication; split as 白白<WH03836>腫腫<WH07613> corresponding to UNV 白<WH03836>癤<WH07613>
{<WAH01931>} (הוּא he/it) kept implicit — LCC 又 is a conjunction ('also'), not a pronoun rendering
LCC 生的赤肉 mapped as 生<WH02416>赤<WH04241>肉<WH01320>: 生(living/raw)=חַי, 赤(red)=מִחְיָה, 肉(flesh)=בָּשָׂר, following UNV pattern

Lev/13.lcc_sn: 這<WAH01931>就是肉<WH01320>皮上<WAH09002><WH05785>宿伏<WH03462><WTH8737>的痲瘋屬之病<WH06883>，祭司<WH03548>要斷他爲不潔淨<WH02930><WTH8765>；不用<WAH03808>將他關閉<WH05462><WTH8686>，因爲<WAH03588>他已是<WAH01931>不潔淨<WH02931>。
Lev/13.lcc_original: 這就是肉皮上宿伏的痲瘋屬之病，祭司要斷他爲不潔淨；不用將他關閉，因爲他已是不潔淨。
notes: UNV 舊 (old/chronic) → LCC 宿伏 (lingering/chronic): same semantic concept H3462, different lexical choice
UNV 大痲瘋 → LCC 痲瘋屬之病: LCC expands to 'leprosy-class disease' but still maps to single H6883
UNV 定他為不潔淨 → LCC 斷他爲不潔淨: H2930 (Piel: pronounce unclean) attached after 不潔淨 as semantic anchor, matching UNV placement
UNV 關鎖 → LCC 關閉: synonym pair, both map to H5462
這...是 split: first 這<WAH01931> for demonstrative use, second 是<WAH01931> for copula use, matching UNV's two H1931 occurrences

Lev/13.lcc_original: 痲瘋屬之病若在皮上到處發作，這種病若佈滿了患災病者全身的皮，儘據祭司眼光所看得到的、從頭到腳、無處不有，
notes: UNV implicit {<WH06883>} becomes explicit on LCC '這種病' (LCC explicitly restates the disease); braces dropped per rule 3
LCC second '若' (before 佈滿了) has no UNV/Hebrew counterpart — left unannotated as LCC restructuring
LCC '儘...所看得到的' expands UNV '察看'; only the core roots H4758+H5869 attached to '眼光' (sight+eyes combined)
H3605 split from H5785 in LCC: '全'<WAH03605> maps to כֹּל (all), '皮'<WH05785> maps to עוֹר (skin), unlike UNV which groups them together after 皮
LCC additions 者/身/所看得到的/儘 have no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated per rule 5

Lev/13.lcc_sn: 那麼、祭司<WH03548>就要察看<WH07200><WTH8804>；若見<WAH02009>{<WAH0853>}痲瘋屬之病<WH06883>佈滿了<WH03680><WTH8765>全身的<WAH03605>肉<WH01320>，那麼、他就要斷那<WAH0853>患災病<WH05061>的爲潔淨<WH02891><WTH8765>；身上旣全然<WAH03605>變<WH02015><WTH8804>白<WH03836>，他<WAH01931>就潔淨了<WH02889>。
Lev/13.lcc_original: 那麼、祭司就要察看；若見痲瘋屬之病佈滿了全身的肉，那麼、他就要斷那患災病的爲潔淨；身上旣全然變白，他就潔淨了。
notes: LCC 見 explicitly renders UNV implicit {<WAH02009>} (hinneh/behold), so braces dropped per rule 3
First {<WAH0853>} (object marker) has no explicit LCC equivalent — kept implicit after 見
LCC reorders clause: 痲瘋屬之病佈滿了全身的肉 vs UNV 全身的肉若長滿了大痲瘋 — SNs follow semantic equivalents in LCC word order
LCC 痲瘋屬之病 (leprosy-type disease) corresponds to UNV 大痲瘋 — single WH06883 attached
LCC 全然 maps to second WAH03605 (כֹּל/all); 身上 (on body) left unannotated as it is LCC's expansion with no separate SN
LCC 斷 (judge/determine) corresponds to UNV 定 — no separate SN for this verb, it is part of the pronouncing-clean construction

Lev/13.lcc_original: 但赤肉幾時現在身上，他幾時就不潔淨。
notes: UNV 紅 (red) maps to LCC 赤 (red/scarlet) — synonyms for raw/inflamed flesh
UNV 顯 (appear) maps to LCC 現 (appear) — synonymous verbs
UNV 在他的身上 includes 他的 (his) but LCC 在身上 omits the possessive; WAH09002 (bet prefix) attached to 身上 in LCC
The 幾時…就幾時… conditional pattern appears in both; H3117 tagged only on the first 幾時 per UNV source

Lev/13.lcc_original: 祭司要察看那赤肉，斷他爲不潔淨：赤肉本不潔淨；那就是痲瘋屬之病。
notes: UNV 一看 → LCC 要察看: 要 is a Chinese modal auxiliary (shall/should) with no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated; SN attached to 察看 (the lexical verb)
UNV 紅 → LCC 赤: both mean 'red', straightforward synonym swap
First 本是<WAH01931>: LCC has 本 but drops 是; H1931 (הוּא pronoun) has no explicit LCC equivalent, kept as implicit {<WAH01931>} after 本
Second 是<WAH01931>: LCC 那就是 contains explicit 是, so attached normally
UNV 大痲瘋 → LCC 痲瘋屬之病: LCC expands to 'leprosy-type disease'; H6883 (צָרַעַת) covers the whole phrase

Lev/13.lcc_original: 或是，赤肉若再變白，他就要來見祭司；
notes: UNV 若 carries both H0176 (אוֹ, or) and H3588 (כִּי, if/when); in LCC these split naturally: 或是 takes H0176, 若 takes H3588
UNV 復原 (H7725 shub, return/restore) and 又變 (H2015 haphak, turn/change) are restructured in LCC as 再變: 再 (again) captures the repetitive sense of H7725 shub, while 變 (change) maps to H2015 haphak
Morphology codes WTH8799 attached to 再 (with H7725) and WTH8738 attached to 變 (with H2015)

Lev/13.lcc_original: 祭司要察看他；若見災病已經變白，那麼、祭司就要斷那患災病的爲潔淨；他就潔淨了。
notes: UNV {<WAH02009>} (hinneh) is implicit but LCC has explicit 見 (behold/see) — dropped braces and attached per rule 3
UNV 他乃<WAH01931>: 01931=hû (he pronoun), attached to 他 in LCC rather than to 就
LCC extra 他 after 察看 has no separate SN in UNV — left unannotated
UNV 定 maps to LCC 斷 (both meaning pronounce/declare clean)

Lev/13.lcc_original: 『人的肉身若在皮膚上長了瘡，已經好了；
notes: UNV 人若 — 人 is untagged in both; 若 takes H3588 (כִּי)
LCC 肉身 covers UNV 肉 (H1320 בָּשָׂר); LCC uses 肉身 vs UNV 肉 but same referent
LCC 皮膚 covers UNV 皮 (H5785 עוֹר); both mean skin, LCC uses disyllabic form
Two H9002 prefixes: first on 皮膚 (בְעֹרוֹ), second on 上 (בוֹ), matching UNV structure
LCC 已經好了 corresponds to UNV 治好了 (H7495 נִרְפָּא niphal H8738); LCC drops 治 but meaning is equivalent
LCC 了 after 長 is Chinese aspect particle, left unannotated as part of 長了 receiving the verb's SN

Lev/13.lcc_original: 而在長瘡的地方又腫的白白地，或是有白中帶紅的火斑，那麼、他就要給祭司看。
notes: UNV 又起了白癤 (arose + white + swelling) restructured in LCC as 又腫的白白地 (again swollen whitishly): H1961 (arose/became) and H7613 (swelling) both attached to 腫 since LCC merges the becoming and swelling into one verb; H3836 (white) attached to 白白地
LCC 有 (have) in 或是有白中帶紅 has no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated
LCC 那麼、他 (then, he) are discourse markers with no SN correspondence — left unannotated

Lev/13.lcc_original: 祭司要察看；若見有比皮窪深的現象，上頭的毛也變了白，那麼、祭司就要斷他爲不潔淨；那是痲瘋屬災病在瘡中發作。
notes: UNV {<WAH02009>} (hinneh/behold, implicit) → LCC 見 is explicit rendering, braces dropped
UNV {<WH03548>} (priest, implicit second reference) → LCC has explicit second 祭司, braces dropped
UNV 大痲瘋 → LCC 痲瘋 (LCC omits 大 but same Hebrew root צָרַעַת)
UNV 定 vs LCC 斷 — different Chinese word but same semantic function (pronounce/declare), SN attached to 不潔淨 covering the whole phrase
UNV 發 → LCC 發作 (compound verb in LCC), SN attached to compound
LCC 屬 (belonging-to, category marker) has no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated

Lev/13.lcc_original: 但祭司察看那病狀，若見那上頭沒有白毛，也沒有比皮窪深，只是暗淡而已，那麼、祭司就要將他關閉七天。
notes: UNV {<WAH02009>} (behold/see) is implicit, but LCC has explicit 見 → dropped braces and attached as <WAH02009>
UNV {<WH03548>} (second priest reference) is implicit, but LCC explicitly repeats 祭司 → dropped braces and attached as <WH03548>
LCC restructures: 祭司察看那病狀，若見... vs UNV 祭司若察看 — placed <WAH0518> after 若 and <WAH02009> after 見 to match LCC word order
LCC 比皮窪深 corresponds to UNV 窪於皮: 比 maps to 於<WAH04480> (comparative), 窪深 maps to 窪<WH08217>
LCC additions 但, 那病狀, 而已, 那麼 have no Hebrew equivalents and are left unannotated

Lev/13.lcc_original: 倘若在皮上發散開了，祭司就要斷他爲不潔淨；那就是災病。
notes: UNV 若 → LCC 倘若 (fuller synonym, same conditional meaning)
UNV 定 → LCC 斷 (both mean 'pronounce/determine'; verb concept carried by 02930 טָמֵא Piel = pronounce unclean)
UNV 是 → LCC 那就是 (那就 are Chinese discourse additions with no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated; 是 carries 01931)

Lev/13.lcc_original: 火斑若在原處止住，沒有發散，便是瘡的瘢痕，祭司就要斷他爲潔淨。
notes: UNV 痕跡 → LCC 瘢痕 (both mean 'scar/mark', same SN H6867)
UNV 定他為 → LCC 斷他爲 (both mean 'pronounce him', same SN H2891; note LCC uses traditional 爲 variant)

Lev/13.lcc_original: 『或是，人的肉身若在皮膚上起了火傷，火傷的生肉又成了火斑，或是白中帶紅，或是全白；
notes: LCC begins with 『或是，which corresponds to Hebrew verse-initial אוֹ (H0176), but UNV omits this word entirely — left unannotated since no SN exists in UNV source for it.
LCC 火傷 (first occurrence) is a single compound covering both H0784 (אֵשׁ fire) and H04348 (מִכְוַת burning), which UNV splits as 火<WH0784>毒<WH04348>.
LCC reverses UNV word order: 肉身...皮膚 vs UNV 皮...肉, following Hebrew order בָשָׂר...בְעוֹרוֹ (flesh...in-skin).
LCC 又 (in 又成了) is a Chinese discourse particle with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated.
LCC 生肉 (raw/living flesh) corresponds to UNV 瘀肉 — both translate H4241 מִחְיָה.

Lev/13.lcc_original: 祭司就要察看那病狀；若見火斑中的毛變了白，又有深於皮的現象，那就是痲瘋屬之病在火傷中發作，那麼、祭司就要斷他爲不潔淨：那是痲瘋屬災病。
notes: LCC adds '那病狀' (that condition) as explicit object of 察看; attached WAH0853 (object marker) there since it marks the object being examined
LCC '若見' (if sees) taken as explicit rendering of implicit WAH02009 (הִנֵּה/behold); braces dropped per rule 3
Second '祭司' is explicit in LCC but implicit {<WH03548>} in UNV; braces dropped per rule 3
LCC '痲瘋屬之病' and '痲瘋屬' both render UNV '大痲瘋' for WH06883 (צָרַעַת)
LCC '發作' corresponds to UNV '發出' for WH06524 (פָּרַח, to break out) — same semantic meaning, different Chinese verb choice

Lev/13.lcc_original: 但祭司察看那病狀，若見火斑中並沒有白毛，也沒有比皮窪深，只是暗淡而已，那麼、祭司就要將他關閉七天。
notes: UNV {<WAH02009>} (hinneh, implicit behold) → LCC 見 is explicit in 若見; braces dropped per rule 3
UNV {<WH03548>} (second implicit priest) → LCC has explicit 祭司 in 那麼、祭司; braces dropped per rule 3
LCC additions 那病狀, 並, 而已, 那麼 have no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated per rule 5
LCC reorders 比皮窪深 vs UNV 窪於皮 — SNs attached to corresponding LCC words in LCC word order

Lev/13.lcc_original: 第七天祭司要察看他；火斑若在皮上發散開了，祭司就要斷他爲不潔淨；那是痲瘋屬災病。
notes: UNV implicit {<WH03548>} (priest) becomes explicit in LCC's second 祭司 — braces dropped per Rule 3
UNV 大痲瘋<WH06883> vs LCC 痲瘋 — LCC omits 大 but 痲瘋 still corresponds to H6883 (צָרַעַת)
WAH01931 (הוא as copula) attached to 是 in LCC's 那是, matching UNV's placement on 是; 那 left unannotated as a Chinese demonstrative addition
UNV 定 vs LCC 斷 — both translate the judicial determination sense; WAH0853 (את object marker) placed after 他 in both

Lev/13.lcc_original: 火斑若在原處止住，沒有在皮上發散，只是暗淡而已，那便是火傷腫起來的，祭司要斷他爲潔淨：那不過是火傷之瘢痕。
notes: UNV 乃是(WAH01931)+發暗(WH03544) → LCC 只是(WAH01931)+暗淡(WH03544); 而已 is an untranslatable Chinese particle, left unannotated
UNV 起的火(WH04348)+毒(WH07613) → LCC 火傷(WH04348)+腫起來的(WH07613); LCC rephrases 'swelling from a burn' differently but semantic mapping is clear
UNV 定他為潔淨 → LCC 斷他爲潔淨; both mean 'pronounce him clean', SN attached after 潔淨

Lev/13.lcc_original: 『一個男人或女人、若有災病在頭上或是鬍鬚上，
notes: UNV 無論<WAH03588> has no direct equivalent in LCC; mapped H3588 (כִּי, 'if') to LCC 若 which carries the conditional sense
UNV {<WAH0176>} (implicit 'or') becomes explicit 或 in LCC, so braces dropped per Rule 3
一個 is a Chinese classifier with no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated per Rule 5
UNV has 男人鬍鬚上 with SNs only for beard (H2206); 男人 there is contextual Chinese, not a second H0376, so LCC 鬍鬚上 gets H9002+H2206 only

Lev/13.lcc_original: 祭司就要察看那災病；若見它的現象深於皮，那裏還有細黃毛，那麼、祭司就要斷他爲不潔淨；這是頭上或鬍鬚上的痲瘋屬癩疥。
notes: UNV {<WAH02009>} (hinneh/behold) is implicit, but LCC has explicit 見 (see) in 若見 which functionally corresponds — dropped braces and attached to 見
LCC restructures the ending: UNV '這是頭疥，是頭上或是鬍鬚上的大痲瘋' → LCC '這是頭上或鬍鬚上的痲瘋屬癩疥' (scall and leprosy swapped). SNs for 頭疥<WH05424> and 大痲瘋<WH06883> attached to their LCC equivalents 癩疥 and 痲瘋 respectively
Second <WAH01931> (הוּא, copula) mapped to LCC 屬 which serves the same copulative function linking 痲瘋 to 癩疥, paralleling UNV's second 是
UNV {<WH03548>} (implicit second priest) — LCC explicitly has 祭司 in the second clause, so braces dropped and SN attached directly

Lev/13.lcc_original: 祭司察看癩疥之災病，若見它的現象並不深於皮，那裏也沒有黑毛，那麼、祭司就要將那患癩疥災病的關閉七天。
notes: UNV has {<WAH02009>} (הִנֵּה behold) as implicit, but LCC explicitly renders it as 見; braces dropped per Rule 3.
UNV {<WH03548>} (second implicit priest) corresponds to LCC's explicit 祭司; braces dropped per Rule 3.
LCC reorders clause: UNV has 若 before 察看, LCC has 祭司察看...若見 — SNs placed according to LCC word order.
它的 (its) left unannotated — Chinese possessive with no separate Hebrew equivalent.
那麼 left unannotated — Chinese discourse connector with no Hebrew equivalent.
那患 left unannotated — Chinese modifier (那=that, 患=afflicted with) part of natural rendering.

Lev/13.lcc_original: 第七天祭司要察看那災病；若見癩疥並沒有發散，那裏也沒有黃毛，癩疥也沒有深於皮的現象；
notes: UNV {<WAH02009>} (הִנֵּה, behold) is implicit, but LCC explicitly renders it as 見 in 若見; per rule 3, braces dropped and SN attached to 見.
LCC rearranges final clause: UNV 頭疥的現象不深於皮 → LCC 癩疥也沒有深於皮的現象; 現象<WH04758> placed at end following LCC word order, 沒有 carries WAH0369 (אֵין).
LCC 那 (demonstrative before 災病) and 並 (intensifier before 沒有) have no Hebrew equivalents and are left unannotated.
LCC uses 癩疥 where UNV uses 頭疥 for the same Hebrew word נֶתֶק (H05424); SN transferred to the LCC equivalent.

Lev/13.lcc_original: 那人就要把鬚髮剃光，癩疥之處可不要剃；祭司要將那長癩疥的再關閉七天。
notes: UNV 頭疥 → LCC 癩疥: same concept (scall/nethek H5424), different Chinese term choice
UNV 關鎖 → LCC 關閉: synonym for 'shut up' (H5462), straightforward mapping
UNV 不可 → LCC 可不要: reordered negation phrase; placed H3808 after 可不 as semantic equivalent of 不可
{<WAH0853>} before 癩疥: LCC fronts the object (癩疥之處) before the verb; implicit object marker kept in braces as LCC has no explicit equivalent, placed before the noun it marks
LCC 剃光 corresponds to UNV 剃去鬚髮; H1548+8694 attached after 剃光 as the verb carrying the shaving action

Lev/13.lcc_original: 第七天祭司要察看那癩疥；若見癩疥在皮上並沒有發散，現象也不深於皮，那麼、祭司就要斷他爲潔淨；他只要把衣服洗淨，就潔淨了。
notes: UNV has implicit {<WH03548>} (priest) before 就要定, but LCC explicitly has 祭司 there, so braces dropped and SN attached directly to 祭司.
LCC reorders 衣服/洗: UNV '洗衣服' → LCC '把衣服洗淨'; SNs placed after their respective words in LCC word order.
{<WAH02009>} (הִנֵּה behold) kept implicit — LCC 若見 is conditional 'if one sees' rather than a direct rendering of the discourse particle.
LCC 了 (aspect particle) left unannotated — no Hebrew equivalent.
LCC uses 癩疥 where UNV uses 頭疥 — same referent (scall/נֶתֶק H5424), SN transferred.
LCC 並沒有 corresponds to UNV 沒有<WAH03808> — 並 is Chinese emphasis with no separate SN.

Lev/13.lcc_original: 但是他得潔淨以後，癩疥若在皮上發散開了，
notes: LCC uses 癩疥 vs UNV 頭疥 for H5424 (neteq/scall) — same referent, different Chinese rendering
LCC adds 但是 (fuller conjunction) vs UNV 但 — neither annotated as no direct SN applies

Lev/13.lcc_original: 祭司就要察看他；若見癩疥在皮上發散了，祭司不必找黃毛，他就是不潔淨的。
notes: UNV {<WAH02009>} (הִנֵּה behold) is implicit in UNV, but LCC '若見' has explicit 見 (see/behold) — dropped braces and attached to 見
UNV {<WH03548>} (priest) is implicit in UNV, but LCC has explicit second 祭司 — dropped braces and attached normally
LCC uses 癩疥 where UNV has 頭疥 for H5424 (scall) — same referent, different Chinese term
了 after 發散 left unannotated (Chinese aspect particle with no Hebrew equivalent)

Lev/13.lcc_original: 若在祭司看來、癩疥已經止住，那裏也生了黑毛；癩疥已經好，那人就潔淨了；祭司要斷他爲潔淨。
notes: UNV {<WH03548>} (kohen/priest) is implicit, but LCC has explicit 祭司 in the second clause, so braces dropped and SN attached directly.
UNV 長了 → LCC 生了: different verb choice but same semantic (sprout/grow), H6779 transferred.
UNV 痊癒 → LCC 好: LCC uses simpler word for 'healed', H7495 transferred.
UNV 定他為潔淨 → LCC 斷他爲潔淨: 斷 (judge/determine) replaces 定 (establish), H2891 covers the whole pronouncement phrase.
在祭司看來 absorbs both <WAH09002> (prefix beth) and <WH05869> (eye) — the construction 'in the view of' maps to Hebrew בְּעֵינֵי.

Lev/13.lcc_original: 『一個男人或女人若皮肉上有了火斑，白的火斑，
notes: UNV {<WAH0176>} (or) is implicit, but LCC has explicit 或 — dropped braces and attached as normal tag
一個 is a Chinese measure word with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated
LCC 有了 corresponds to UNV 起了 (both rendering H01961 qal imperfect) — same verbal sense of 'appearing/arising'
白的 in LCC corresponds to 白 in UNV — 的 is a Chinese structural particle, SN attached after 白的 as a unit

Lev/13.lcc_original: 祭司就要察看；若見火斑在皮肉上灰白，那就是水泡疹在皮上發作：那人是潔淨的。
notes: UNV has {<WAH02009>} (הִנֵּה, behold) as implicit, but LCC's 若見 explicitly renders it with 見 — dropped braces per rule 3
LCC 灰白 (grayish-white) merges UNV's 白<WH03836>中帶黑<WH03544> (white with dimness) — both SNs attached to the compound
LCC word order 皮肉 reverses UNV's 肉皮 — SNs assigned by semantic match: 皮=H5785(skin), 肉=H1320(flesh)
LCC uses 水泡疹 for UNV's 白癬, both translating H0933 (בֹּהַק, tetter/harmless eruption)

Lev/13.lcc_original: 『一個人的頭上若掉了頭髮，他雖禿頭，還是潔淨。
notes: UNV '他不過是<WAH01931>' — H1931 (הוּא, he) maps to LCC '他'; '不過是/雖' are translation glosses with no separate SN
UNV '頭禿' vs LCC '禿頭' — same morphemes in reversed order; SN attached after LCC's word order '禿頭<WH07142>'
UNV '的髮' and LCC '頭髮' both lack a dedicated SN — Hebrew מָרַט (H4803) covers the falling-out action, hair is contextually implied by H7218 (rosh/head)

Lev/13.lcc_original: 若是他頭的前面掉了頭髮，他不過是頂門禿，還是潔淨。
notes: LCC '前面' absorbs three SNs (WAH04480 מִן + WH06285 פֵּאָה + WH06440 פָּנִים) as LCC uses a single compound '前面' where UNV distributes the meaning across separate positions
UNV '若' maps to LCC '若是' — the 是 is a Chinese copula addition with no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated
頭髮 has no SN in UNV source (implied by verb מָרַט), so left unannotated in LCC as well

Lev/13.lcc_original: 但是頭禿處或是頂門禿處若有白中帶紅的災病，那就是痲瘋屬之病、在頭禿處或頂門禿處在發作。
notes: LCC '但是' has no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated
LCC '痲瘋屬之病' (leprosy-type disease) corresponds to UNV '大痲瘋' (H06883); entire phrase tagged
LCC uses '或' (without 是) in second occurrence vs UNV '或是'; SN H0176 attached to '或'
LCC '在發作' — '在' is a Chinese progressive marker with no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated; '發作' corresponds to UNV '發' (H06524 + WTH8802)
LCC '那就是' corresponds to UNV '這就是' (H01931) — same demonstrative function, different proximal/distal choice

Lev/13.lcc_sn: 那麼、祭司<WH03548>就要察看<WH07200><WTH8804>他<WAH0853>；若見<WAH02009>在頭禿處<WAH09002><WH07146>或<WAH0176>頂門禿處<WAH09002><WH01372>有了白<WH03836>中帶紅<WH0125>的災病<WH05061>腫起來<WH07613>，像皮<WH05785>肉<WH01320>上痲瘋屬之病<WH06883>的現象<WAH09003><WH04758>，
Lev/13.lcc_original: 那麼、祭司就要察看他；若見在頭禿處或頂門禿處有了白中帶紅的災病腫起來，像皮肉上痲瘋屬之病的現象，
notes: UNV {<WAH0853>} (את, object marker) was implicit; LCC has explicit 他 (him) as direct object of 察看, so braces dropped and SN attached to 他.
UNV {<WAH02009>} (הנה, behold) was implicit; LCC has 見 (see/perceive) in 若見 which serves as an explicit rendering, so braces dropped and SN attached to 見.

LCC renders 大痲瘋 as 痲瘋屬之病 (leprosy-type disease); entire compound treated as one unit for WH06883.

Lev/13.lcc_sn: 那麼、他<WH0376>就是<WAH01931>患痲瘋屬之病<WH06879><WTH8803>，他<WAH01931>不潔淨<WH02931>；祭司<WH03548>總要<WH02930><WTH8762>斷他爲不潔淨<WH02930><WTH8763>；他的災病<WH05061>是在頭上<WAH09002><WH07218>。
Lev/13.lcc_original: 那麼、他就是患痲瘋屬之病，他不潔淨；祭司總要斷他爲不潔淨；他的災病是在頭上。
notes: UNV 那人(WH0376) → LCC 他: LCC uses pronoun 他 instead of 那人 but same referent (the man)
UNV {<WAH01931>} was implicit (הוּא with no explicit Chinese in UNV), but LCC has explicit 他 in 他不潔淨, so braces dropped per rule 3
那麼 is a LCC discourse particle with no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated
