LCC 患痲瘋屬之病 corresponds to UNV 長大痲瘋 (WH06879 צָרוּעַ, Qal participle WTH8803)

Lev/13.lcc_original: 『身上有痲瘋屬災病的人、他的衣服要撕裂，頭髮要蓬散；他要摀着上脣喊叫說：「我不潔淨，不潔淨。」
notes: UNV 蓬頭<WH07218>散髮<WH06544> restructured in LCC as 頭髮<WH07218>蓬散<WH06544> — different word grouping but same semantic mapping (head+disheveled vs hair+disheveled)
LCC adds 人 after 的 and 我 before 不潔淨 — left unannotated (no Hebrew equivalent)
LCC 屬 is a grammatical connector (belonging to) with no separate Hebrew word — grouped with 災病 for H05061
LCC third 他要 (before 摀着) has no separate SN source — left unannotated
{<WAH05921>} (upon/על) kept implicit as LCC also has no explicit word for it between 摀着 and 上脣

Lev/13.lcc_original: 儘災病在他身上的日子，他總是不潔淨；他旣不潔淨，就要獨居；住所須要在營外。
notes: UNV {<WAH03605>} (כֹּל, all/every) is implicit, but LCC has explicit 儘 (throughout/all), so braces dropped per rule 3.
UNV {<WH04186>} (מוֹשָׁב, dwelling-place) is implicit, but LCC has explicit 住所 (dwelling place), so braces dropped per rule 3.
LCC 總是 (always) and 須要 (must) have no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated per rule 5.
LCC 旣 is the traditional form of UNV 既, mapped to <WAH01931> (הוּא).

Lev/13.lcc_original: 『染上痲瘋屬災病的衣服，無論是羊毛衣服、是麻布衣服，
notes: UNV '染了' → LCC '染上': different aspect particle but same verb concept; <WAH09002> attached after 染上
UNV '大痲瘋' → LCC '痲瘋': LCC drops 大 (great) but refers to same disease; <WH06883> attached to 痲瘋
LCC adds '屬' (belonging to/of the type of) between 痲瘋 and 災病 — no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated

Lev/13.lcc_original: 無論是【1】線條是幅塊【1】，是在麻布上、或羊毛上，是在皮子上或皮子作的任何物件上，
notes: UNV {<WAH0176>} (implicit 'or' between warp/woof) → LCC has explicit 是 in 無論是X是Y construction, so dropped braces per rule 3 and attached to second 是
UNV 經(warp)→LCC 線條, UNV 緯(woof)→LCC 幅塊: different Chinese words for the same weaving terms
【1】 footnote markers preserved in original positions; SN tags inserted between word and footnote marker
UNV 或 between 麻布 and 羊毛 has no SN in source; LCC 或 left unannotated accordingly

Lev/13.lcc_original: 這災病在衣服上或皮子上、在【1】線條上或幅塊上【1】、或任何皮子的物件上、若是發綠、或是發紅，那就是痲瘋屬狀態的災病，要給祭司看。
notes: LCC restructures sentence: 這災病 moved to front (UNV has it mid-sentence); H5061 attached at first 災病 occurrence
UNV implicit {<WAH0176>} between 衣服/皮子 → LCC has explicit 或 → braces dropped per Rule 3
UNV implicit {<WH0176>} between 皮子/經 → LCC uses 、在 (comma, no explicit 'or') → kept implicit
UNV implicit {<WAH0176>} between 經/緯 → LCC has explicit 或 → braces dropped per Rule 3
LCC 線條=UNV 經 (warp/שְׁתִי), LCC 幅塊=UNV 緯 (woof/עֵרֶב)
LCC 那就是 covers H1931 (הוּא demonstrative); 那/就 are LCC elaboration of UNV 是
LCC 屬狀態的 has no SN — LCC's own descriptive expansion of 大痲瘋的
【1】footnote markers preserved as-is in original positions

Lev/13.lcc_original: 祭司要察看那災病，把染上災病的物件關閉七天。
notes: UNV 就要 → LCC 要: 就 is a discourse filler omitted in LCC; SN attached to 察看 as the main verb
UNV 染了 → LCC 染上: aspectual particle difference (了→上), SN for 災病 attached after second 災病 as in UNV
UNV 關鎖 → LCC 關閉: synonym substitution, same SNs transferred

Lev/13.lcc_original: 第七天他要察看那災病；那災病若在衣服上、【1】線條上、或幅塊上【1】、或皮子上、發散了，無論這皮子作甚麼用的，那災病就是頑惡性的痲瘋屬病狀；那是不潔淨的。
notes: UNV 或<WAH03588> ('if/whether') maps to LCC 若 ('if') — same conditional sense, different Chinese word
UNV 經(warp)/緯(woof) map to LCC 線條(threads)/幅塊(fabric pieces) — different terminology for weaving components, confirmed by Hebrew H8359=שְׁתִי(warp) and H6154=עֵרֶב(woof)

LCC has explicit 或 before 幅塊上 and 皮子上, so the corresponding {<WAH0176>} implicit markers are dropped to normal <WAH0176> attached to 或; the first conjunction between 衣服上 and 線條上 has no explicit 或 in LCC, so {<WAH0176>} is kept implicit
UNV 蠶食的(moth-eaten/fretting) maps to LCC 頑惡性的(malignant) — both translate Hebrew H3992 מַמְאֶרֶת (fretting/corroding)
UNV 當作 maps to LCC 作 — same verb H6213 עָשָׂה, LCC uses shorter form
【1】 footnote markers preserved in original positions
UNV 都是<WAH01931> — הוא(it/that) maps to LCC 那 as demonstrative pronoun; 就 left unannotated as discourse particle

Lev/13.lcc_original: 那染上災病的衣服、或在羊毛上或麻布上的【2】線條或幅塊【2】、或是甚麼皮子的物件、他都要燒，因爲這是頑惡性的痲瘋屬病狀，總要將那東西放在火裏燒。
notes: LCC restructures UNV's 'warp, woof, wool, linen' order into 'on wool or linen, threads(warp) or fabric-pieces(woof)' — SNs reassigned to follow LCC's structure: 羊毛上←H6785, 麻布上←H6593, 線條←H8359, 幅塊←H6154
Three implicit {<WAH0176>} in UNV become explicit 或 in LCC (before 麻布, before 幅塊, already explicit before 羊毛) — braces dropped per rule 3
蠶食的(moth-eaten)→頑惡性的(malignant): different wording but same Hebrew root H3992 מָאֶרֶת
LCC adds 將那東西(that thing) and 總要 with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated
{<WAH09002>} before 災病 kept implicit as LCC has no explicit preposition there (染上 absorbs the meaning)

Lev/13.lcc_original: 『祭司察看；若見災病在衣服上、或【1】線條上或幅塊上【1】、或是任何皮子的物件上、並沒有發散，
notes: UNV {<WAH02009>} (הִנֵּה behold) is implicit but LCC has explicit 見, so braces dropped and attached as 見<WAH02009>
UNV 經(warp)/緯(woof) mapped to LCC 線條(threads)/幅塊(fabric pieces) — different translation choices for H08359/H06154
UNV order 皮子做的甚麼...物件上 rearranged in LCC as 任何皮子的物件上; SNs distributed to corresponding words
【1】 footnote markers preserved in their original positions; SN tags inserted at word boundaries around them
LCC 並 (connective before 沒有) has no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated

Lev/13.lcc_original: 那麼、祭司就要吩咐他們把染上災病的物件洗淨，再關閉七天。
notes: UNV 染了 → LCC 染上: same semantic role (染 + resultative complement), WAH09002 prefix attached to 染上
UNV 洗了 → LCC 洗淨: same verb with different resultative complement
UNV 關鎖 → LCC 關閉: synonym pair, both meaning 'shut up/close'
那麼、 is LCC-only discourse connector with no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated

Lev/13.lcc_sn: 洗了<WH03526><WTH8718>以後<WH0310>，祭司<WH03548>要察看<WH07200><WTH8804>{<WAH02009>}那<WAH0853>災病<WH05061>；若見那災病並沒有<WAH03808>變<WH02015><WTH8804>{<WAH0853>}態<WH05869>；災病<WH05061>雖沒有<WAH03808>發散<WH06581><WTH8804>，那物件還是<WAH01931>不潔淨<WH02931>：那是<WAH01931>有腐蝕性的災病<WH06356>；無論<WAH0176>是反面的掉毛<WAH09002><WH01372>、是正面的掉毛<WAH09002><WH07146>、你總要將那物件放在火<WAH09002><WH0784>裏燒<WH08313><WTH8799>。
Lev/13.lcc_original: 洗了以後，祭司要察看那災病；若見那災病並沒有變態；災病雖沒有發散，那物件還是不潔淨：那是有腐蝕性的災病；無論是反面的掉毛、是正面的掉毛、你總要將那物件放在火裏燒。
notes: LCC splits UNV's single 那物件 into two 那災病 mentions (object of 察看 and subject of 沒有變態); SNs (H853, H5061) placed on first occurrence only, second left unannotated
LCC uses 態 (form) where UNV uses 色 (color) for H5869 (עַיִן appearance) — semantically equivalent
LCC reverses order: 反面(H1372 גַּבַּחַת) before 正面(H7146 קָרַחַת), opposite of UNV; SNs assigned by semantic meaning not position
LCC adds 掉毛 (hair loss) and 有腐蝕性的 (corrosive) as descriptive expansions with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated
若見 is LCC's restructuring; 見 has no separate Hebrew source word and is left unannotated

Lev/13.lcc_original: 祭司察看；若見物件洗了以後、那災病暗淡了，那麼、他就要把那災病從衣服上或皮子上、從【1】線條上或幅塊上【1】、都撕去。
notes: UNV implicit {<WAH0853>} for את (object marker) mapped to LCC explicit '物件' (item) per rule 3 — LCC makes the washed object explicit where UNV leaves it implicit.

UNV lists 4 items each with implicit {或}{從}, but LCC restructures into 2 pairs: '從衣服上或皮子上、從線條上或幅塊上'. Distributed the 3 sets of {<WAH0176>}{<WAH04480>}: explicit 或/從 get tags directly; where LCC omits 從 (before 皮子上, 幅塊上) or 或 (between the two pairs), kept as implicit markers.
LCC '暗淡了' corresponds to UNV '發暗' (H3544 כֵּהָה, dim/faded) — semantic match despite different Chinese phrasing.
LCC '線條' = UNV '經' (H8359 warp); LCC '幅塊' = UNV '緯' (H6154 woof) — different Chinese terms for the same weaving concepts.

Lev/13.lcc_original: 若仍現在衣服上或【1】線條上或幅塊上【1】、或是任何皮子的物件上，那就是災病直發作；那染上災病的物件、你總要放在火裏燒。
notes: UNV has two implicit {<WAH0176>} between warp/woof/leather; LCC has explicit 或/或是 for all three, so braces dropped per Rule 3
LCC uses 線條 for UNV 經 (warp, H8359) and 幅塊 for UNV 緯 (woof, H6154)
LCC restructures UNV '必用火焚燒' into '你總要放在火裏燒'; fire SN attached to 火, burn SN+morphology to 燒
LCC '那就是' corresponds to UNV '這就是' for H1931 (הוּא); both serve as copula
H6524+WTH8802 (פָּרַח breaking out) attached to 發作 as the verb; 災病 is the subject and left unannotated since it is not separately tagged in UNV

Lev/13.lcc_original: 但是你所洗的衣服、或【2】線條或幅塊【2】或是任何皮子的物件，若災病離開了，還要再洗，然後潔淨。』
notes: 但是你 in LCC has no UNV SN counterpart — left unannotated
UNV 經(warp)<WH08359> maps to LCC 線條; UNV 緯(woof)<WH06154> maps to LCC 幅塊 — both are textile terms with different Chinese word choices
【2】markers are LCC's own notation, preserved in place without disruption
{<WAH04480>} (from/מִן) remains implicit — LCC 離開了 implies separation but has no separate preposition for 'from'
UNV 就潔淨了 maps to LCC 然後潔淨 — 然後 is unannotated (Chinese connective with no Hebrew equivalent)
還要 left unannotated; only 再 carries <WH08145> (שֵׁנִית/second time)

Lev/13.lcc_original: 這是痲瘋屬狀態的災病的法規，無論是羊毛衣服、或麻布衣服、是【2】線條或幅塊【2】或是任何皮子的物件，要斷爲潔淨或不潔淨的標準。
notes: LCC 痲瘋屬狀態 is a paraphrase of UNV 大痲瘋 (H6883 tsara'at); entire phrase tagged as one unit.
LCC uses 線條 for UNV 經 (H8359 warp) and 幅塊 for UNV 緯 (H6154 woof) — non-standard translations but positionally clear.
Second {<WAH0176>} attached to 是 before 線條: 是 serves the disjunctive structural role of Hebrew אוֹ (or) even though it literally means 'is/be'; this is a borderline call.
LCC 的標準 at end has no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated.
LCC second 衣服 (after 麻布) has no separate SN — UNV likewise has no SN on its second 衣服上.

Lev/14.lcc_original: 永恆主告訴摩西說：
notes: 耶和華→永恆主: standard LCC rendering of YHWH
曉諭→告訴: both mean 'spoke/told', straightforward semantic match
{<WAH0413>} kept implicit — LCC has no explicit preposition for אֵל before 摩西

Lev/14.lcc_sn: 『患痲瘋屬之病<SN><WH06879><WTH8794></SN>的得潔淨<SN><WH02893></SN>的日子<SN><WAH09002><WH03117></SN>、其法規<SN><WH08451></SN>乃是<SN><WAH01961><WTH8799></SN>這樣<SN><WAH02063></SN>：人要帶他<SN><WH0935><WTH8717></SN>去見<SN><WAH0413></SN>祭司<SN><WH03548></SN>。
Lev/14.lcc_original: 『患痲瘋屬之病的得潔淨的日子、其法規乃是這樣：人要帶他去見祭司。
notes: LCC '患痲瘋屬之病' expands UNV '長大痲瘋' — SNs placed after 病 (the semantic core) before structural 的
LCC adds '人' (subject marker) with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated
LCC '法規' corresponds to UNV '例' (both render H8451 תּוֹרָה/torah)

Lev/14.lcc_original: 祭司要出營外，那祭司要察看；若見那痲瘋屬災病在患這病者身上已經好了，
notes: UNV 到<WAH0413> has no explicit counterpart in LCC (LCC says 出營外 without 到), so H0413 kept as implicit {<WAH0413>} after 出.
UNV {<WH03548>} (implicit second priest) becomes explicit in LCC 那祭司, so braces dropped per rule 3.
UNV {<WH05061>} (implicit נֶגַע plague) maps to LCC explicit 災病, so braces dropped per rule 3.
UNV {<WH06879>}{<WTH8803>} (implicit leper/Pual participle) maps to LCC explicit 患這病者 (one afflicted), so braces dropped and both tags attached.
LCC 屬 (belonging to) and 在...身上 (on the body of) are Chinese structural words with no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated.

Lev/14.lcc_sn: 那麼、祭司<WH03548>就要吩咐人<WH06680><WTH8765>爲那求斷爲潔淨的<WH02891><WTH8693>取<WH03947><WTH8804>兩隻<WH08147>活活而<WH02416>潔淨的<WH02889>鳥<WH06833>、和香柏<WH0730>木<WH06086>、朱紅色綫<WH08144><WH08438>跟脣形薄荷<WH0231>。
Lev/14.lcc_original: 那麼、祭司就要吩咐人爲那求斷爲潔淨的取兩隻活活而潔淨的鳥、和香柏木、朱紅色綫跟脣形薄荷。
notes: UNV {<WH03548>} is implicit (no explicit word for 'priest'), but LCC has explicit '祭司' — dropped braces and attached as normal tag.
LCC '脣形薄荷' (labiates/mint-family plant) is a different Chinese term for hyssop than UNV '牛膝草', but both render H0231 (אֵזוֹב); attached SN to LCC's term.
LCC '活活而' is a reduplicated/emphatic form for 'living/alive', mapped to H2416 (חַי); UNV simply uses '活'.
LCC '取' corresponds to UNV '拿' (both meaning 'take'), mapped to H3947 (לָקַח).
LCC '求斷爲潔淨的' is a more elaborate rendering than UNV '求潔淨的' but maps to the same H2891 (טָהֵר, to be clean).

Lev/14.lcc_original: 祭司要吩咐人用瓦器盛活水；把其一隻鳥宰在活水上面。
notes: LCC adds 人 (someone) after 吩咐 — no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated
LCC adds 其 (one of) before 一隻 — no separate SN, left unannotated
LCC explicates 活水 before 上面 where UNV has only 上面 (over it); <WAH05921> (על) attached after 上面 to cover the full prepositional phrase 在活水上面

Lev/14.lcc_original: 至於那隻活鳥、祭司要取牠，又取香柏木、朱紅色綫跟脣形薄荷、將這些物品和那隻活鳥一同蘸於被宰在活水上的鳥的血中；
notes: UNV implicit {<WH03947>}{<WTH8799>} (take/לקח) → LCC has explicit 取, so braces dropped and SNs attached to 取
UNV implicit {<WH06833>}{<WH02416>} (living bird, second mention) → LCC explicitly says 活鳥 in '那隻活鳥一同蘸', so braces dropped
UNV 牛膝草 (hyssop) → LCC 脣形薄荷 (same plant H0231, different Chinese term)
UNV 和<WAH0853> → LCC 又<WAH0853>: conjunction role preserved, 又 serves as connector for the second object group
LCC adds '將這些物品和' and a second 取 as structural expansion with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated
{<WAH0853>} before 朱紅色綫 kept implicit: LCC has no explicit word for this את object marker (just punctuation 、)
LCC restructures from single-取 + 把 construction to double-取 pattern, lowering confidence

Lev/14.lcc_original: 又在那求斷爲痲瘋屬之病已得潔淨的人身上灑七次，就斷他爲潔淨；再把那隻活鳥放在田野裏。
notes: UNV '長大痲瘋' (great leprosy) → LCC '痲瘋屬之病' (disease of leprosy type): same Hebrew נֶגַע צָרַעַת, SNs attached after 病
UNV '求潔淨的' (seeking cleansing) → LCC '已得潔淨的' (already obtained cleansing): different rendering of Hithpael טָהֵר but same semantic role
UNV '定他為潔淨' → LCC '斷他爲潔淨': both render Piel טָהֵר (pronounce clean), SN attached after 潔淨
LCC '那隻' (demonstrative + classifier) has no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated
UNV '裡' / LCC '裏' both render פָּנִים (WH06440) in the idiom 'על פני השדה' (upon the face of the field)

Lev/14.lcc_original: 那求斷爲潔淨的人要把衣服洗淨，剃去一切毛髮，在水中洗澡，就潔淨了；然後可以進營，不過要在自己的帳棚外住七天。
notes: LCC uses 把-construction (要把衣服洗淨) vs UNV's 當洗衣服; placed {<WAH0853>} before 衣服 since 把 serves a similar accusative-marking function but is Chinese grammar, not a translation of את
UNV has {<WAH03605>} (implicit כֹּל 'all') but LCC explicitly says 一切, so braces dropped per rule 3: 一切<WAH03605>
LCC 不過 corresponds to UNV 只是 — neither carries SN, left unannotated
LCC 住 is shorter form of UNV 居住 — same verb, SN attached to 住

Lev/14.lcc_original: 第七天、他要把一切毛髮都剃去，把頭髮、鬍鬚和眉毛以及所有的毛都剃去；也要把衣服洗淨，在水中洗身，就潔淨了。
notes: LCC has explicit first 剃去 where UNV has implicit {shave} — dropped braces per rule 3, attached WH01548+WTH8762 to first 剃去
LCC's 頭髮 in the enumeration clause maps to WH07218 (ראש/head): LCC renders 'his head' as '頭髮' (head-hair) for natural Chinese, since one shaves hair not a head

LCC restructures clause order: general 'shave all hair' first then specific enumeration, vs UNV which lists specifics first then summarizes — SNs redistributed accordingly with 一切=WAH03605(first כל) and 毛髮=WH08181(first שׂער)
Chinese 把 (object marker) treated as explicit rendering of Hebrew את (WAH0853): three 把 instances absorb three את markers; comma-separated 鬍鬚 has no explicit marker so {WAH0853} kept implicit
LCC's third 把 (before 衣服) renders the implicit {WAH0853} from UNV explicitly — braces dropped per rule 3

Lev/14.lcc_sn: 『第八<WH08066>天<WAH09002><WH03117>他要取<WH03947><WTH8799>兩隻<WH08147>完全沒有殘疾<WH08549>的公羊羔<WH03532>、和一隻<WH0259>完全沒有殘疾<WH08549>一<WH01323>歲<WH08141>以內的母羊羔<WH03535>、也要把調<WH01101><WTH8803>油<WAH09002><WH08081>的細麵<WH05560>一伊法【1】的十分<WH06241>之三<WH07969>作爲素祭<WH04503>，並把油<WH08081>一<WH0259>羅革<WH03849>【2】一同取來。
Lev/14.lcc_original: 『第八天他要取兩隻完全沒有殘疾的公羊羔、和一隻完全沒有殘疾一歲以內的母羊羔、也要把調油的細麵一伊法【1】的十分之三作爲素祭，並把油一羅革【2】一同取來。
notes: LCC adds 完全 before 沒有殘疾 (both occurrences) — H8549 (תָּמִים tamim = complete/without blemish) attached after the full phrase 完全沒有殘疾 since LCC's 完全 is an explicit rendering of the same Hebrew word
LCC 以內 (within) has no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated
LCC 把 (grammatical object marker) has no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated
H1323 (בַּת bat = daughter, used idiomatically for age) attached to 一 in LCC following UNV's pattern, though in Hebrew it means 'daughter of [a year]'
LCC uses 【1】【2】 footnote markers after 伊法 and 羅革 — preserved in place, SN tags placed before the footnote markers where applicable (羅革<WH03849>【2】)

Lev/14.lcc_sn: 行潔淨<WH02891><WTH8764>禮的祭司<WH03548>要將<WAH0853>那求斷爲潔淨<WH02891><WTH8693>的人<WH0376>和這些物品<WAH0853>、安置<WH05975><WTH8689>在永恆主<WH03068>面前<WAH09001><WH06440>、會<WH04150>棚<WH0168>的出入處<WH06607>。
Lev/14.lcc_original: 行潔淨禮的祭司要將那求斷爲潔淨的人和這些物品、安置在永恆主面前、會棚的出入處。
notes: LCC uses 永恆主 for 耶和華 (LORD/YHWH) — standard LCC convention, H3068 attached to 永恆主
LCC uses 棚 (shed/booth) where UNV uses 幕 (curtain/tent) for H0168 (אֹהֶל, tent); split 會<H4150>棚<H0168> paralleling UNV's 會<H4150>幕<H0168>
LCC uses 出入處 (entrance/exit) for UNV's 門口 (doorway) — both translate H6607 (פֶּתַח, opening/entrance)
LCC 物品 replaces UNV 東西 — same semantic range, H0853 object marker attached
LCC word order differs: 永恆主面前 comes before 會棚的出入處, whereas UNV has 會幕門口 before 耶和華面前; SNs placed per LCC word order
LCC adds 斷爲 in 求斷爲潔淨 (declared clean) vs UNV 求潔淨; 斷爲 left unannotated as it has no separate Hebrew equivalent

Lev/14.lcc_original: 祭司要取一隻公綿羊羔，獻爲解罪責祭，又取那一羅革油，將這兩樣物品做搖獻物、搖在永恆主面前。
notes: 公羊羔(UNV)→公綿羊羔(LCC): same H3532 כֶּבֶשׂ, LCC adds 綿 for specificity
贖愆祭(UNV)→解罪責祭(LCC): same H817 אָשָׁם, different Chinese rendering
耶和華(UNV)→永恆主(LCC): same H3068 יְהוָה, LCC's standard rendering
搖祭(UNV)→搖獻物(LCC): same H8573 תְּנוּפָה
LCC adds 又取 and 將這兩樣物品 with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated
Both implicit {<WAH0853>} retained: LCC has no explicit word for either את object marker (before 一隻 and before 爲)

Lev/14.lcc_original: 他要在宰解罪祭牲和燔祭牲的地方、就是在聖的地方、宰那公綿羊羔；解罪責祭品要給祭司、像解罪祭品一樣：那是至聖的。
notes: LCC reorders: subordinate clause (where sin/burnt offerings are slaughtered) precedes the main clause (slaughter the lamb), opposite of UNV. Morphology codes reassigned accordingly: first 宰 in LCC gets H8799 (imperfect, subordinate), second 宰 gets H8804 (waw-consecutive perfect, main verb).
UNV's explicit 把<WAH0853> becomes implicit {<WAH0853>} in LCC since LCC lacks an object marker particle; 那 is a demonstrative ('that'), not an object marker, so it is left unannotated.
LCC adds 他 (he) and first 要 (shall) with no Hebrew equivalents — left unannotated.

Prefix SNs (WAH09001, WAH09002, WAH09003) kept with the noun rather than the separate Chinese preposition (在, 給, 像), following UNV's convention where 於 is untagged and WAH09002 attaches to the place noun.
LCC uses 解罪祭牲/解罪祭品 for UNV's 贖罪祭牲/贖罪祭 (sin offering) and 解罪責祭品 for UNV's 贖愆祭 (guilt offering).

Lev/14.lcc_original: 祭司要取些解罪責祭牲的血；抹在求斷爲潔淨之人的右耳垂上、和右手的大拇指上、跟右腳的大拇趾上。
notes: LCC 解罪責祭牲 = UNV 贖愆祭牲 (trespass offering, H0817)
LCC 求斷爲潔淨之人 = UNV 求潔淨人 (the one being cleansed); H2891+H8693 attached after 之人
{<WH03548>} kept implicit — LCC also omits the second 祭司, using semicolon to continue the subject
LCC 大拇趾 (toe character 趾) vs UNV 大拇指 (finger character 指) for foot — both map to H0931 (big toe)
LCC conjunctions 、和 and 、跟 replace UNV 和 and 並; WAH05921 attached to 和 and 跟 respectively

Lev/14.lcc_original: 祭司要從那一羅革【2】油之中取出一點兒來，倒在自己的左手掌裏；
notes: LCC 取出一點兒來 corresponds to UNV 取些; SN H3947+WTH8804 attached after core verb 取, leaving 出一點兒來 (complement/quantifier) unannotated
UNV 中 has no SN; LCC expands to 之中 — both unannotated
{<WH03548>} kept implicit: LCC 自己 does not explicitly name the priest, same as UNV
LCC 【2】 footnote marker preserved in place between 羅革 and the SN tags

Lev/14.lcc_original: 把右手的一個指頭、蘸在左手掌中的油裏，在永恆主面前用指頭將油彈七次。
notes: H3709 (kaph/palm) attached to LCC 手掌 which explicitly renders the palm meaning vs UNV 手
UNV implicit {<WAH04480>}{<WH08081>} (from the oil) becomes explicit in LCC 將油 — braces dropped and SNs attached to 油
將 is a Chinese grammatical particle (ba-construction marker for disposal) with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated
LCC 永恆主 replaces UNV 耶和華 as the rendering of YHWH (H3068)
中 in 手掌中的 is a Chinese locative with no separate Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated, grouped with 的

Lev/14.lcc_original: 手中剩下的油、祭司要抹在那求斷爲潔淨之人的右耳垂上、和右手的大拇指上、跟右腳的大拇趾上，就是抹在解罪責祭牲的血上。
notes: UNV has {<WH03548>} (כֹּהֵן/priest) as implicit, but LCC explicitly has 祭司 — braces dropped per Rule 3
LCC 解罪責祭牲 corresponds to UNV 贖愆祭牲 (H0817 אָשָׁם guilt offering) — different Chinese rendering, same referent
LCC uses 跟 where UNV uses 並 for the third conjunction; WAH05921 attached to 跟 as it carries the prepositional sense of עַל
LCC 大拇趾 (foot) vs UNV 大拇指 (used for both hand and foot) — same H0931 בֹּהֶן applied to both
WAH0834/WAH04480/WH03499 grouped after 剩下的 since LCC merges the relative clause 所…剩的 into 剩下的

Lev/14.lcc_original: 祭司要用手中剩下的油、抹在那求斷爲潔淨的人頭上；在永恆主面前爲他行除罪禮。
notes: LCC adds 用 (to use) with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated per rule 5
LCC 要 is a modal auxiliary separated from 抹 (unlike UNV 要抹 together) — SN attached to 抹 as the semantic verb
LCC 行除罪禮 (perform atonement rite) rephrases UNV 贖罪 (atone) — all SNs (<WH03722><WTH8765>) attached to the full phrase
LCC 那求斷爲潔淨的人 expands UNV 那求潔淨人 — same SNs attached to the full LCC phrase
{<WH03548>} kept implicit: LCC does not repeat 祭司 in the second clause

Lev/14.lcc_original: 祭司要獻解罪祭、爲那求斷爲潔淨的行除罪禮，免去他的不潔淨，然後宰燔祭牲。
notes: UNV 贖罪祭 → LCC 解罪祭: different term for sin offering (חַטָּאת H2403), straightforward semantic match
UNV 贖罪 → LCC 行除罪禮: LCC rephrases כִּפֶּר (H3722) as 'perform purification rites' rather than 'make atonement'
UNV 本不潔淨 (מִטֻּמְאָתוֹ) → LCC restructures as 免去他的不潔淨: מִן prefix (WAH04480) attached to 免去 (captures 'from/away' sense), טֻמְאָה (WH02932) attached to 不潔淨
Both אֵת (WAH0853) markers kept implicit as LCC has no explicit direct object markers in either position
UNV 求潔淨的人 → LCC 求斷爲潔淨的: same participant (הַמִּטַּהֵר H2891), LCC adds judicial nuance '斷爲'

Lev/14.lcc_original: 要獻上燔祭和素祭在祭壇上；爲他這樣行除罪禮，他就潔淨了。
notes: UNV 把<WAH0853> (first את object marker) has no equivalent in LCC (no 把), so kept as implicit {<WAH0853>} before 燔祭.

LCC 這樣行除罪禮 is a fuller expression for UNV 贖罪 (H3722 כָּפַר make atonement); all SNs attached after the complete phrase.
LCC 要 is a Chinese modal auxiliary (shall/should) with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated.
LCC 祭壇 vs UNV 壇: same referent (H4196 מִזְבֵּחַ), LCC just uses the fuller form 祭壇.
Both {<WH03548>} (כֹּהֵן priest) remain implicit as LCC also omits the explicit subject.

Lev/14.lcc_original: 『他若貧寒、手頭彀不着，就要取一隻公綿羊羔做解罪責祭、搖一搖，爲他行除罪禮；也要把調油的細麵一伊法的十分之一爲素祭，並把油一羅革【2】、一同取來；
notes: UNV {<WH03027>} (יָד/hand) is implicit, but LCC has explicit 手頭 — braces dropped per Rule 3
UNV 不能預備...夠數 restructured in LCC as 彀不着 (potential complement with infixed negation): 不→H0369, 着→H05381+WTH8688
UNV 贖愆祭 (guilt offering) = LCC 解罪責祭; UNV 贖罪 (atone) = LCC 行除罪禮 — different translation terms, same Hebrew roots
UNV 公羊羔 vs LCC 公綿羊羔 — LCC adds 綿 (sheep) specifier, same H03532 (kebes)

Lev/14.lcc_original: 也取兩隻斑鳩、或是兩隻雛鴿、就是他手頭所彀得着的：一隻作爲解罪祭，一隻作爲燔祭。
notes: H5381 (nasag='reach/afford') placed on 彀得着 rather than 取; UNV maps it to 取 but LCC's 彀得着 is the true semantic match for 'afford'. LCC's 取 is an added verb with no Hebrew counterpart.
H3027 (yad='hand') placed on 手頭; UNV renders as 力量 (ability) but LCC uses the more literal 手頭 (hand).
WAH0834 (asher='which/that') placed on 就是 which introduces the relative clause '就是...所...的', paralleling UNV's 照.
Second 作爲 (before 燔祭) has no H1961 tag, matching UNV where only the first 作 carries WAH01961+WTH8804.

Lev/14.lcc_original: 第八天他要把這些物品帶到永恆主面前、會棚的出入處、交給祭司。
notes: LCC omits the purpose clause '為潔淨' (for cleansing, H2893 with prefix H09001) — retained as implicit {<WAH09001>}{<WH02893>} after 天
LCC reverses the order: UNV has '會幕門口、耶和華面前' but LCC has '永恆主面前、會棚的出入處' — SNs placed at their semantic matches regardless of reordering
LCC adds '他' (he) and '物品' (items) with no Hebrew equivalents — left unannotated
耶和華 (YHWH, H3068) maps to LCC's 永恆主 (Eternal Lord); 會幕 (H4150+H0168) maps to 會棚; 門口 (H6607) maps to 出入處

Lev/14.lcc_original: 祭司要取那做解罪責祭的公綿羊羔、和那一羅革【2】油；將這些物品做搖獻物，搖在永恆主面前；
notes: UNV has implicit {<WH03947>}{<WTH8804>} (take) but LCC explicitly has 取, so braces dropped and SNs attached to 取.
UNV 把<WAH0853> (object marker via 把) mapped to LCC 那 (demonstrative serving as object introducer) for the first object clause.
LCC 將這些物品 (take these items) is unique LCC phrasing with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated.
{<WH03548>} (implicit priest as subject of second clause) retained with braces since LCC also leaves the subject implicit in the second clause.
{<WAH0853>} (final implicit object marker) retained with braces at clause end since LCC has no explicit equivalent.
LCC 解罪責祭 = UNV 贖愆祭 (guilt/trespass offering); LCC 公綿羊羔 = UNV 羊羔 (lamb) — same referent, different wording.
LCC 搖獻物 = UNV 搖祭 (wave offering, WH08573); LCC 永恆主 = UNV 耶和華 (LORD, WH03068) — systematic translation differences.

Lev/14.lcc_original: 也要宰那做解罪責祭的公綿羊羔。取些解罪責祭牲的血，抹在那求斷爲潔淨之人的右耳垂上、和右手的大拇指上、跟右腳的大拇趾上。
notes: LCC uses 解罪責祭 where UNV has 贖愆祭 (both = guilt offering H0817); same SN attached
LCC distinguishes 大拇指 (thumb/hand) from 大拇趾 (big toe/foot); UNV uses 大拇指 for both — H0931 attached to each respectively
{<WAH0853>} (direct object marker) kept implicit — LCC 那 is a demonstrative, not the את marker
{<WH03548>} (priest) kept implicit — LCC has no explicit word for it, placed before 取 at sentence boundary
LCC adds 做 (serving as) and 公綿 (male) — unannotated as they have no Hebrew equivalent
LCC uses 、 (enumeration comma) where UNV uses Chinese commas — preserved exactly

Lev/14.lcc_original: 祭司要把些油倒在自己的左手掌裏；
notes: UNV and LCC are nearly identical here; only orthographic difference is 裡→裏 (standard LCC variant). The implicit {<WH03548>} (priest) remains implicit in LCC as well — no explicit word to attach it to.

Lev/14.lcc_original: 用右手的一個指頭、把左手掌中的油、在永恆主面前彈七次。
notes: LCC reorders clause: 'right hand finger' comes before 'left palm oil', unlike UNV. SNs placed at LCC's word positions accordingly.
LCC 永恆主 = UNV 耶和華 (both translate YHWH/H3068), systematic LCC convention.
LCC 手掌 (palm) maps to H3709 (כַּף, palm/hollow of hand); UNV uses bare 手 for the same word.
{<WH03548>} (priest) remains implicit — no explicit subject in LCC either, placed at sentence start.
{<WAH05921>} (upon/עַל) remains implicit — placed after the clause break before 把, as LCC has no explicit preposition for it.

Lev/14.lcc_original: 將他手掌中的油、抹在那求斷爲潔淨之人的右耳垂上、和右手的大拇指上、跟右腳的大拇趾上，就是抹在解罪責祭牲的血那地方。
notes: UNV 些<WAH04480> (partitive מִן 'some of') has no explicit LCC equivalent; attached to 抹 since LCC 抹 covers the whole 'put some of' action (rule 6).
UNV {<WAH05921>} (implicit) in 就是{<WAH05921>}抹 → LCC has explicit 在 after 抹, so braces dropped per rule 3: 抹在<WAH05921>.
LCC uses 解罪責祭牲 for UNV 贖愆祭 (both = אָשָׁם guilt offering H0817); single SN attached to full LCC phrase.
LCC 大拇趾 (toe, foot) vs 大拇指 (finger, hand) — both receive <WH0931> (בֹּהֶן covers both thumb and big toe).
LCC 跟 replaces UNV 並 as conjunction; receives same <WAH05921> tag.

Lev/14.lcc_original: 祭司要將手中剩下的油、抹在那求斷爲潔淨的人頭上，在永恆主面前爲他行除罪禮。
notes: UNV 要抹<WH05414><WTH8799> — LCC splits into 要將...抹; SNs attached to 抹 (the main verb), 要將 left unannotated as Chinese auxiliary+disposal marker
UNV 所<WAH0834>剩的 → LCC 剩下的: WAH0834 (relative pronoun אֲשֶׁר) attached to 剩下的 since LCC lacks an explicit relative marker like 所
UNV 那求潔淨人<WH02891><WTH8693> → LCC 那求斷爲潔淨的人: SNs placed after 潔淨的 (the cleansing adjective clause) rather than after 人, matching the Hebrew טָהֵר attachment
UNV 贖罪 → LCC 行除罪禮: LCC expands into a fuller phrase; all atonement SNs (<WAH09001><WH03722><WTH8763>) grouped on 行除罪禮 as a unit

Lev/14.lcc_original: 那人要獻上一隻斑鳩、或是一隻雛鴿、就是他手頭所彀得着的；
notes: LCC restructures the clause order: UNV has 照他的力量 (according to his ability) before 獻上, but LCC places the equivalent 就是他手頭所彀得着的 (what his hand can reach) at the end as a relative clause.
LCC explicitly translates 手頭 for H3027 (יָד/hand) and 彀得着 for H5381 (נָשַׂג/reach), which are implicit {braces} in UNV — braces dropped per Rule 3.
{<WAH0853>} (object marker אֵת) retained as implicit since LCC has no explicit word for it.
就是 maps to <WAH04480><WH0834> (מִן אֲשֶׁר = from what/which); slight semantic stretch as 就是 means 'that is' rather than 'from which', lowering confidence slightly.

Lev/14.lcc_sn: 他要獻上<WAH0853>手頭<WH03027>所<WAH0834>彀得着的<WH05381><WTH8686>；{<WAH0853>}一隻<WH0259>作爲解罪祭<WH02403>、{<WAH0853>}一隻<WH0259>作爲燔祭<WH05930>，連素祭<WH04503>一同獻上<WAH05921>：祭司<WH03548>要這樣爲<WAH05921>那求斷爲潔淨的<WH02891><WTH8693>人在永恆主<WH03068>面前<WAH09001><WH06440>行除罪禮<WH03722><WTH8765>。
Lev/14.lcc_original: 他要獻上手頭所彀得着的；一隻作爲解罪祭、一隻作爲燔祭，連素祭一同獻上：祭司要這樣爲那求斷爲潔淨的人在永恆主面前行除罪禮。
notes: UNV {<WH03027>} (hand) is implicit, but LCC has explicit '手頭' → braces dropped, SN attached to 手頭
UNV {<WH02891>}{<WTH8693>} (be clean) is implicit, but LCC explicitly renders as '潔淨的' → braces dropped and attached there; LCC's '求斷爲' is translator expansion left unannotated
<WAH0853> (את object marker) attached after 獻上 — LCC lacks UNV's '就是' but the marker conceptually governs the object '手頭所彀得着的'
LCC adds '要獻上' in first clause and '這樣' with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated
Two instances of <WAH05921> (על): first = 'upon/with' after 獻上, second = 'for/on behalf of' after 爲

Lev/14.lcc_sn: 關於身患<WAH09002>痲瘋<WH06883>屬災病<WH05061>的人<WAH0834><WAH0834>、在求斷爲潔淨<WAH09002><WH02893>的事上、他若手頭<WH03027>緊、彀不着<WAH03808><WH05381><WTH8686>豫備正常的祭物、其法規<WH08451>是這樣<WAH02063>。』
Lev/14.lcc_original: 關於身患痲瘋屬災病的人、在求斷爲潔淨的事上、他若手頭緊、彀不着豫備正常的祭物、其法規是這樣。』
notes: Both H0834 (אֲשֶׁר, relative pronoun) merged onto 的人 — Chinese lacks relative pronouns and LCC has no equivalent of UNV's 那; the 的 construction absorbs both relative clauses
H3027 (יָדוֹ, hand) is implicit in UNV {<WH03027>} but explicit in LCC 手頭 (idiomatic: financial situation), so braces dropped per rule 3
H3808+H5381+WTH8686 (לֹא־תַשִּׂיג, not reach/attain) mapped as unit to 彀不着 (cannot afford); LCC's 豫備正常的祭物 is free paraphrase with no direct Hebrew lexeme
H02063 (זֹאת, this) mapped to sentence-final 這樣 — LCC inverts sentence structure vs UNV's opening 這是

Lev/14.lcc_original: 永恆主告訴摩西亞倫說：
notes: 耶和華→永恆主: LCC's standard rendering of YHWH
曉諭→告訴: both mean 'spoke/told', straightforward semantic match
Both {<WAH0413>} (preposition 'to') remain implicit as LCC has no explicit preposition before 摩西 or 亞倫

Lev/14.lcc_sn: 『你們進了<WH0935><WTH8799>{<WAH0413>}我<WAH0589>所<WAH0834>賜<WH05414><WTH8802>給你們<WAH09001>爲業產<WAH09001><WH0272>的迦南<WH03667>地<WH0776>時候<WAH03588>，我若使<WH05414><WTH8804>痲瘋<WH06883>屬災病<WH05061>傳到你們所得爲業產<WH0272>之地<WH0776>的一間房屋<WAH09002><WH01004>，
Lev/14.lcc_original: 『你們進了我所賜給你們爲業產的迦南地時候，我若使痲瘋屬災病傳到你們所得爲業產之地的一間房屋，
notes: UNV {<WAH03588>} (כִּי, 'when') is implicit, but LCC has explicit 時候 — braces dropped per rule 3
LCC 所 maps to אֲשֶׁר (<WAH0834>), which in UNV attaches to 的; both are relative clause markers
LCC restructures second clause: '使痲瘋屬災病傳到...房屋' vs UNV '使...房屋中有大痲瘋的災病' — SNs repositioned to match LCC word order
{<WAH0413>} (אֶל) remains implicit — LCC 進了 implies direction but has no separate preposition
LCC 傳到 (spread to), 一間 (a/one), 屬 (type-of) have no Hebrew equivalents — left unannotated

Lev/14.lcc_original: 那麼、那房主就要去告訴祭司說：據我看，這房屋中似乎有災病。
notes: LCC adds 那麼、那 at the start and 這 before 房屋中 — these have no Hebrew equivalent and are left unannotated.
房<WH01004>主<WAH0834> split preserved identically since LCC uses the same 房主 compound.

Lev/14.lcc_original: 祭司還沒有進去察看災病以前，要吩咐人把那房屋騰空，免得房屋裏所有的都染着了不潔淨；然後祭司纔可以進去察看那房屋。
notes: LCC uses 房屋 where UNV uses 房子 — same meaning, SNs transferred directly
LCC 染着了不潔淨 vs UNV 成了不潔淨: H2930 (טמא) attached to 不潔淨 as the core meaning word; 染着了 is LCC's rendering with no separate Hebrew equivalent
LCC 纔可以 (only then can) has no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated, SNs attached to 進去
LCC adds demonstrative 那 before 房屋 twice — no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated
LCC omits 就 before 要吩咐 — no impact on SN placement; implicit {<WH03548>} retained since LCC also has no explicit subject before 要吩咐

Lev/14.lcc_original: 他要察看那災病；若見災病在房屋的牆上有了發綠、或發紅的凹斑紋，其現象又比牆窪深；
notes: UNV has {<WAH02009>} (hinneh/behold) as implicit, but LCC explicitly translates it as 若見 ('if seen'); dropped braces and attached to 見 per Rule 3.
LCC uses 房屋 where UNV has 房子 — both mean 'house', same H1004.
LCC reorders 窪於牆 (lower-than-wall) to 比牆窪深 (compared-to-wall sunken-deep); redistributed H4480 (min→比), H7023 (qir→牆), H8217 (shaphel→窪深) to match LCC word order.
LCC adds 深 alongside 窪 to express H8217 (shaphel); attached H8217 to the compound 窪深 as they jointly render one Hebrew word.
其 and 又 in LCC have no Hebrew counterparts — left unannotated per Rule 5.
了 is a Chinese aspect particle with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated per Rule 5.

Lev/14.lcc_original: 那麼、祭司就要從房屋裏出來、到房門外，把房屋關閉七天。
notes: UNV has {<WAH04480>} (implicit 'from') and {<WH01004>} (implicit 'house') but LCC explicitly says 從房屋裏 ('from inside the house'), so braces dropped per rule 3.
LCC 出來 corresponds to UNV 出 (both meaning 'go out'); 來 is a Chinese directional complement with no separate SN.
裏 ('inside') is a Chinese locative particle with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated per rule 5.
LCC uses 關閉 ('close') where UNV uses 封鎖 ('seal/shut up') — same Hebrew root H5462 (סָגַר).

Lev/14.lcc_original: 第七天祭司要再去察看；若見災病在房屋的牆上發散了，
notes: UNV has {<WAH02009>} (hinneh/behold) as implicit, but LCC has explicit 見 in 若見, so braces dropped and SN attached to 見
LCC uses 房屋 where UNV uses 房子 — same semantic meaning (house), SN transferred normally
了 is a Chinese aspect particle with no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated

Lev/14.lcc_original: 那麼、祭司就要吩咐人把那有災病的石頭挖出來，扔在城外不潔淨的地方；
notes: UNV {<WH03548>} is implicit (no surface word for 'priest'), but LCC has explicit '祭司' → dropped braces and attached as normal tag per Rule 3.
LCC uses '地方' where UNV has '之處' for H4725 (מָקוֹם place) — same semantic, straightforward mapping.
LCC adds '那麼、' as a discourse connector with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated per Rule 5.

Lev/14.lcc_original: 也要叫人刮房屋裏面四圍，把所刮掉的灰泥倒在城外不潔淨的地方；
notes: LCC 房屋 covers UNV 房 — both translate בַּיִת (H01004); attached SN to the full LCC word 房屋
LCC 裏面 corresponds to UNV 內 (inside); the implicit {<WAH04480>} (מִן) and {<WH01004>} (repeated בַּיִת) kept implicit as 裏面 conveys spatial 'inside' rather than the Hebrew prepositional construction
LCC 把 is a direct object marker paralleling Hebrew את (H0853), so the second {<WAH0853>} in UNV is de-braced and attached to 把; the first {<WAH0853>} before 房 has no LCC equivalent, kept implicit
LCC 地方 corresponds to UNV 之處 — both translate מָקוֹם (H04725)

Lev/14.lcc_original: 再拿別的石頭放進去代替挖出來的石頭，然後拿別的灰泥墁那房屋。
notes: H935 (bo, 'bring in') reassigned from UNV's 代替 to LCC's 放進去 which directly means 'put in/bring in'
H8478 (tachath, 'instead of') reassigned from UNV's 那挖出來 to LCC's 代替 which semantically means 'in place of'
H413 (el, 'to/into') was implicit {<WAH0413>} in UNV but LCC's 放進去 ('put into') explicitly conveys the directional meaning, so braces dropped per Rule 3
UNV's second 另(H312) corresponds to LCC's second 別的(H312) — both mean 'other' for the plaster clause

Lev/14.lcc_original: 『他挖了石頭、刮了房屋、墁了牆以後，災病若在房屋裏再度發作，
notes: LCC '牆' (wall) has no corresponding SN in UNV (UNV just says 墁了 without specifying what was plastered) — left unannotated
UNV has {<WH07725>}{<WTH8799>} as implicit (שׁוּב = return/again), but LCC explicitly says '再度' (again) — dropped braces per rule 3
LCC uses '發作' (break out/flare up) vs UNV '發現' (appear/break out) — both render H6524 פָּרַח, semantic match confirmed
Two implicit {<WAH0310>} retained as LCC has no explicit words for those intermediate 'after' markers; the single explicit '以後' takes H0310

Lev/14.lcc_sn: 那麼、祭司<WH03548>就要進去<WH0935><WTH8804>察看<WH07200><WTH8804>；若見<WAH02009>災病<WH05061>在房屋裏<WAH09002><WH01004>發散<WH06581><WTH8804>了；那就是<WAH01931>頑惡性的<WH03992><WTH8688>痲瘋屬病狀<WH06883>在房屋裏<WAH09002><WH01004>；那是<WAH01931>不潔淨<WH02931>的。
Lev/14.lcc_original: 那麼、祭司就要進去察看；若見災病在房屋裏發散了；那就是頑惡性的痲瘋屬病狀在房屋裏；那是不潔淨的。
notes: UNV {<WAH02009>} (hinneh/behold) is implicit, but LCC 若見 explicitly translates it with 見 — braces dropped per rule 3
LCC 頑惡性的 corresponds to UNV 蠶食的 (both H3992 מַמְאֶרֶת, malignant/fretting) — different translation choice, same Hebrew root
LCC 痲瘋屬病狀 corresponds to UNV 大痲瘋 (both H6883 צָרַעַת, leprosy)
那麼 and 了 are Chinese discourse/aspect particles with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated
Two occurrences of 在房屋裏<WAH09002><WH01004> mirror UNV's two occurrences of house reference (若在房子裡 and 房內)

Lev/14.lcc_original: 那麼、他就要把那房屋拆毀，把它的石頭、木頭和房屋裏所有的灰泥都拆掉，搬出城外不潔淨的地方。
notes: UNV's first {<WAH0853>} (implicit before 房子) becomes explicit in LCC via 把 → braces dropped per rule 3
UNV's implicit {<WH01004>} (second 'house') becomes explicit in LCC's second 房屋 (房屋裏) → braces dropped per rule 3
LCC's 拆掉 is an expansion with no separate Hebrew equivalent (H5422 already attached to 拆毀); left unannotated
LCC's 出 is part of compound verb 搬出 corresponding to H3318 Hiphil; SN tags attached to 搬 following UNV pattern
LCC additions 所有的, 它的, 那, 和 have no separate Hebrew SN equivalents; left unannotated
First {<WAH0413>} placed after 出 as implicit directional marker 'to' before 城外 phrase

Lev/14.lcc_original: 在關閉房屋的日期內、凡進去的人總會不潔淨到晚上。
notes: LCC reverses word order to 關閉房屋 (shut-house) vs UNV 房子封鎖 (house-shut); SNs placed on respective LCC words accordingly.
LCC 凡 (every/all) has no separate Hebrew equivalent here — H3605 (kol) modifies the time period (日期), not the person entering, so 凡 left unannotated.

Lev/15.lcc_original: 『女人呢，若有所洩漏，而她身上所洩漏的是經血，那麼、她就有月經汚穢七天；凡觸着她的就不潔淨到晚上。
notes: UNV 行經 compresses the entire clause כִּי תִהְיֶה זָבָה דָּם יִהְיֶה זוֹבָהּ בִּבְשָׂרָהּ into two characters with all SNs implicit. LCC expands this into two clauses: 若有所洩漏 (H3588+H1961+H2100) and 而她身上所洩漏的是經血 (H9002+H1320+H2101+H1961+H1818). All formerly implicit SNs become explicit in LCC, so braces are dropped.
H1961 appears three times: (1) 有 in 有所洩漏, (2) 是 in 所洩漏的是經血, (3) 有 in 她就有月經汚穢. Each maps to one of the three תִהְיֶה/יִהְיֶה occurrences in the Hebrew.
LCC 經血 (menstrual blood) corresponds to דָּם H1818; the 經 (menstrual) component is part of LCC's interpretive rendering, not a separate Hebrew word.
LCC 月經汚穢 maps to נִדָּה H5079; 月經 is LCC's expansion but the whole phrase maps to the single Hebrew concept.

Lev/15.lcc_original: 在月經汚穢中、凡她所躺的東西、都不潔淨；凡她所坐的東西、也都不潔淨。
notes: UNV 女人 has no SN and LCC omits it entirely — no action needed.
UNV second clause {<WAH03605>} is implicit but LCC has explicit 凡 — braces dropped per Rule 3.
LCC 月經 is a more specific rendering of UNV 污穢 (niddah/menstrual impurity) — SNs attached after 中 to cover the whole prepositional phrase.
LCC second clause 她 has no corresponding SN in UNV — left unannotated per Rule 5.

Lev/15.lcc_original: 凡觸着她的床的、要把衣服洗淨，在水中洗澡，但還是不潔淨到晚上。
notes: LCC reorders clauses: washing clothes/bathing comes before 'unclean until evening', whereas UNV has the opposite order. SNs follow LCC word positions.
LCC '觸着' corresponds to UNV '摸' (both = touch, H5060).
LCC '洗淨' (wash clean) maps to UNV '洗' (H3526); the 淨 is LCC's stylistic addition, SN attaches after the full word.
LCC '但還是' (but still) has no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated.
LCC '她的床' includes the possessive 的 not in UNV; 的 left unannotated, SN group attaches after 床.

Lev/15.lcc_original: 凡觸着她所坐的任何物件的、總要把衣服洗淨，在水中洗淨，但還是不潔淨到晚上。
notes: LCC restructures the sentence: UNV has 'unclean until evening + wash clothes + bathe' but LCC has 'wash clothes + bathe + but still unclean until evening'. SNs follow LCC word order.
LCC has two instances of 洗淨: first (clothes) maps to WH03526/כָּבַס (wash garments), second (in water) maps to WH07364/רָחַץ (bathe body).
{<WAH05921>} (עַל, upon) remains implicit — LCC has no explicit word for it, same as UNV.
總要, 把, 但還是 are Chinese grammatical words with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated.

Lev/15.lcc_original: 那物件若在那女人床上、或在那女人所坐的物件上，觸着它的、就不潔淨到晚上。
notes: LCC restructures verse: '那物件若在...' (subject-first) vs UNV '在...若有別的物件' (location-first); SNs repositioned accordingly
LCC's second '那女人' corresponds to UNV '她' — both tagged H01931
LCC '觸着' (touch) corresponds to UNV '摸了' — same Hebrew root H05060
UNV implicit {<WAH09002>} made explicit by LCC '它' — braces dropped per rule 3
LCC initial '那物件' left unannotated (UNV '有別的物件' carries no SN tags)
LCC uses '所...的' relative clause structure where UNV uses '的' alone; H0834 attached to '的' following UNV pattern

Lev/15.lcc_original: 男人若和那女人親密地同寢，染着她的月經汚穢，就不潔淨七天；凡他所躺的床都不潔淨。
notes: UNV 同房 with implicit+explicit H7901 (infinitive absolute construction) → LCC 同寢 is explicit, so both H7901 refs attached directly to 同寢 without braces
LCC adds 他 (him) which has no Hebrew counterpart — left unannotated
UNV 也為 → LCC 都 (both mean 'also/all will be') — 都 left unannotated as it's a Chinese discourse particle
LCC 月經汚穢 expands UNV 污穢 but H5079 (niddah) covers the full concept of menstrual impurity, so SN attached after the whole phrase
LCC word order 就不潔淨七天 differs from UNV 就要七天不潔淨 — SNs placed per LCC word positions

Lev/15.lcc_original: 『女人不在月經汚穢期內、若患着厲害的血漏許多日子，或是在月經汚穢期外還患着血漏；那麼、儘血漏的日子、她的不潔淨、就像月經汚穢的日子一樣。
notes: LCC restructures UNV 在經期以外 as 不在月經汚穢期內; placed WAH09002+WH03808 together on 不在 as both express the Hebrew בְּלֹא (not-in)
LCC 厲害 (severe) is an interpretive addition with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated
UNV implicit {WH05921} (עַל beyond) → LCC has explicit 外 in second clause, braces dropped
UNV implicit {WAH03605} (כֹּל all) and {WH03117} (יְמֵי days) → LCC explicit 儘 and 日子, braces dropped per Rule 3
UNV implicit {WAH01961}{WTH8799} (תִּהְיֶה shall be) → kept implicit as LCC has no explicit copula in the comparison clause
WAH09003 (כְּ as/like prefix) separated from WH03117 and placed on 就像 since LCC splits the comparison marker from 日子

Lev/15.lcc_original: 儘她血漏的日子、凡她所躺的床、她都要看爲月經汚穢的床一樣；凡她所坐的物件、都不潔淨，像月經汚穢之不潔淨一樣。
notes: LCC restructures heavily: UNV uses one predicate (都要看為不潔淨) for both bed and items, but LCC splits into two clauses — bed compared to menstrual bed, items declared unclean like menstrual uncleanness.
UNV implicit group {<WAH09003>}{<WH04904>}{<WH05079>} (like bed of niddah) becomes fully explicit in LCC (月經汚穢的床一樣) — braces dropped, SNs attached to corresponding LCC words.

UNV implicit group {<WAH09003>}{<WH02932>}{<WAH01961>}{<WTH8799>} partially explicit in LCC: 像→WAH09003, 不潔淨→WH02932 are explicit; WAH01961+WTH8799 (second יִהְיֶה) remain implicit as LCC has no explicit 'shall be' in second clause.
Three instances of implicit {<WAH03605>} (כָּל) in UNV all become explicit in LCC: 儘 (throughout-all), 凡 (first, every bed), 凡 (second, every item).
月經汚穢 as a unit translates נִדָּה (H5079) — 月經 alone means menstruation, 汚穢 adds the uncleanness nuance inherent in the Hebrew word.
{<WAH09001>} (לָּהּ, to her) has no LCC equivalent — kept as implicit after 看爲.

Lev/15.lcc_original: 凡觸着這些東西的就不潔淨；他要把衣服洗淨，在水中洗澡，但還是不潔淨到晚上。
notes: LCC uses 把-construction '把衣服洗淨' reordering object before verb vs UNV '洗衣服'; SNs attached to respective words (衣服←H0899, 洗淨←H3526)
LCC splits the two 'unclean' references with '；他...但還是不潔淨到晚上' — first H2930 (qal impf) on initial 不潔淨, second H2930 (qal perf) on final 不潔淨
LCC '在水中' renders Hebrew prefix בְּ (09002) differently from UNV '用水'; prefix marker placed on 水 with 中 left unannotated as Chinese structural particle

Lev/15.lcc_original: 女人若得潔淨、沒有漏症，她總要自己算七天，然後纔潔淨。
notes: LCC restructures the verse: UNV has '漏症若好了' (discharge if healed) while LCC splits into '若得潔淨、沒有漏症' (if becomes clean, having no discharge). Mapped 得潔淨 to the first <WH02891><WTH8804> (Qal perfect = healed/clean) and 漏症 to <WAH04480><WH02101> (discharge/flow).
{<WAH09001>} (lamed prefix) kept implicit — LCC's 自己 is a reflexive addition with no direct Hebrew equivalent, and the lamed has no explicit LCC word.
纔 (LCC archaic form of 才) left unannotated as it is a Chinese grammatical particle with no Hebrew source word; 潔淨 after it carries the second <WH02891><WTH8799> (Qal imperfect).

Lev/15.lcc_original: 第八天她要取兩隻斑鳩、或是兩隻雛鴿，帶到會棚的出入處，交給祭司。
notes: LCC adds 她 (she) as explicit subject — left unannotated (no Hebrew equivalent)
LCC 會棚 corresponds to UNV 會幕 (H4150+H0168): 棚 replaces 幕 but both render אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד
LCC 出入處 replaces UNV 門口 for H6607 (פֶּתַח); 的 is a structural particle, left unannotated
LCC 交給 replaces UNV 給 for H0413 (אֶל); 交 is LCC's addition fused into the giving verb, entire phrase tagged with <WAH0413>
LCC uses 、(enumeration comma) after 斑鳩 where UNV uses 或是 directly — punctuation preserved as-is

Lev/15.lcc_original: 祭司要獻一隻爲解罪祭，一隻爲燔祭；爲了那人不潔淨之漏症，祭司要在永恆主面前這樣爲她行除罪禮。
notes: LCC reorders: UNV '血漏...不潔' → LCC '不潔淨之漏症'; H2932(טֻמְאָה) attached to 不潔淨, H2101(זוֹב)+H4480(מִן) attached to 漏症
LCC 解罪祭 = UNV 贖罪祭 (both render חַטָּאת H2403)
LCC adds 這樣 (no Hebrew equivalent) — left unannotated
LCC 行除罪禮 = UNV 贖罪 (both render כפר H3722); morphology WTH8765 attached to this verb phrase
Both {<WAH0853>} (אֵת direct object markers) kept implicit as LCC has no explicit equivalent

Lev/15.lcc_sn: 『你們要這樣使<WAH0853>以色列<WH03478>人<WH01121>和<WAH04480>他們的不潔淨<WH02932>隔離<WH05144><WTH8689>，免得<WAH03808>他們使{<WAH0853>}我的帳幕<WH04908>、那<WAH0834>在<WAH09002>他們中間<WH08432>的帳幕、蒙不潔<WAH09002><WH02930><WTH08763>，而他們就因自己的不潔淨<WAH09002><WH02932>而死亡<WH04191><WTH8799>。』
Lev/15.lcc_original: 『你們要這樣使以色列人和他們的不潔淨隔離，免得他們使我的帳幕、那在他們中間的帳幕、蒙不潔，而他們就因自己的不潔淨而死亡。』
notes: UNV 玷污 (single verb for טמא Piel) → LCC uses periphrastic 蒙不潔 (receive-uncleanness); all three SNs (<WAH09002><WH02930><WTH08763>) attached to 蒙不潔
UNV implicit {<WAH0834>}{<WAH09002>}{<WH08432>} (אֲשֶׁר בְּתוֹכָם) have explicit LCC equivalents 那/在/中間 → braces dropped per Rule 3
LCC expands into apposition 我的帳幕、那在他們中間的帳幕 — WH04908 (מִשְׁכָּן) attached to first 帳幕 only; second is resumptive
LCC second 使 (causative auxiliary) and both 而 (connective particles) are Chinese grammatical devices with no Hebrew source — left unannotated
{<WAH0853>} (את direct object marker) kept implicit before 我的帳幕 as LCC has no explicit word for it

Lev/15.lcc_sn: 這是<WAH02063>關於患漏症<WH02100><WTH8802>者的法規，關於那<WAH0834>有精液<WH07902><WH02233>從身上<WAH04480>洩出<WH03318><WTH8799>、因而不潔淨的<WAH09001><WH02930><WTH8800>{<WAH09002>}，
Lev/15.lcc_original: 這是關於患漏症者的法規，關於那有精液從身上洩出、因而不潔淨的，
notes: LCC restructures into two 關於 clauses; 法規 (law/torah, H8451) is not in the provided UNV SN set so left unannotated
UNV implicit {WAH0834} (asher/who) maps to explicit 那 in LCC — braces dropped per rule 3
UNV implicit {WAH04480} (mimmennu/from him) maps to explicit 從身上 in LCC — braces dropped per rule 3
精液 in LCC covers both H7902 (shikbat/emission) and H2233 (zera/seed) — both SNs attached to single phrase per rule 6
{WAH09002} (bah/by it) has no explicit LCC equivalent — braces retained

Lev/15.lcc_original: 關於在汚穢期中有月經病的，關於男性或女性患漏症的，以及關於男人和不潔淨女人同寢的法規。
notes: LCC restructures into three 關於 clauses; UNV groups 男女 with 漏症 which matches LCC's second clause
LCC adds 在汚穢期中 (during the period of uncleanness) with no direct SN — left unannotated
LCC 同寢 corresponds to UNV 同房 (both = lie with); LCC 法規 corresponds to UNV 條例 (both = law/statute)
{<WAH0853>} (direct object marker) and {<WAH0834>} (relative pronoun) remain implicit as LCC has no explicit equivalents

Lev/16.lcc_original: 亞倫的兩個兒子走近永恆主面前、死了；死了之後，永恆主告訴摩西，
notes: UNV 近到 → LCC 走近: same semantic (approach/draw near), straightforward mapping to H7126 qal inf.cstr.
UNV 耶和華 → LCC 永恆主: standard LCC rendering of YHWH.
UNV 曉諭 → LCC 告訴: both mean 'told/spoke to', mapped to H1696.
{<WAH0413>} kept implicit — LCC 告訴摩西 has no explicit preposition for אֶל, same as UNV pattern.

Lev/16.lcc_original: 說：『要告訴你哥哥亞倫不可隨時進至聖所帷帳以內、到櫃上的除罪蓋前，免得死亡，因爲我要在雲中顯現於除罪蓋上。
notes: 說 is explicit in LCC but implicit {<WH0559>} in UNV → dropped braces per rule 3
至 is explicit in LCC for implicit {<WAH0413>} (entering holy place) → dropped braces per rule 3
LCC uses 除罪蓋 (atonement cover) vs UNV 施恩座 (mercy seat) for H3727 כַּפֹּרֶת — both appear twice
LCC uses 帷帳 vs UNV 幔子 for H6532 פָּרֹכֶת (veil/curtain)
LCC omits 他 before 死亡 — H4191 attached to 死亡 only
LCC uses 於 where UNV uses 在 for WAH05921 (על, upon) before the second 除罪蓋
LCC uses 在雲中 where UNV uses 從雲中 — both render Hebrew bet prefix (WAH09002); LCC is more literal

Lev/16.lcc_original: 亞倫進至聖所要帶着以下這些祭牲：一隻牛、是小公牛、爲解罪祭，一隻公綿羊爲燔祭。
notes: LCC 至 explicitly renders אֶל (H0413), which is implicit {<WAH0413>} in UNV — braces dropped
LCC 這些 explicitly renders זֹאת (H02063), which is implicit {<WH02063>} in UNV — braces dropped
First בְּ prefix (WAH09002 on זֹאת) remains implicit in LCC as the 'with' sense is absorbed into the verb structure 帶着; placed before 這些 near its root word
LCC splits the bull description differently: 牛(H01241=בָּקָר/cattle) as a general term, then 小(H01121=בֶּן/son→young)公牛(H06499=פַר/bull) as appositive specification
LCC 解罪祭 vs UNV 贖罪祭 — both render חַטָּאת (H02403); LCC emphasizes 'resolving sin' vs UNV 'redeeming sin', same referent

Lev/16.lcc_original: 他要穿上細麻布的聖內袍，也要把細麻布的褲子穿在身上，要用細麻布長腰帶束腰，也要將細麻布的禮冠戴上：這些都是聖的衣服。他要在水中洗身，然後穿戴上。』
notes: LCC uses 長腰帶 (long sash) vs UNV 帶子 (belt/girdle) for H73 אַבְנֵט — attached SNs to 長腰帶 as the semantic equivalent
LCC restructures 束腰 (gird-waist) vs UNV 腰束 (waist-gird) — placed H2296 after 束 (the verb), leaving 腰 unannotated as it has no separate Hebrew correspondent
LCC uses 禮冠 (ritual crown) vs UNV 冠冕 (turban) for H4701 מִצְנֶפֶת — same semantic role
LCC 在水中 (in water) restructures UNV 用水 (with water) — attached H4325 to 水, leaving 在...中 as Chinese grammar
H1961/H5921 implicit construction preserved: LCC 穿在身上 parallels UNV exactly, keeping {<WAH01961>}{<WTH8799>} implicit
{<WAH0853>} (direct object marker) kept implicit — LCC has no explicit word for it in 洗身

Lev/16.lcc_original: 『他要從以色列人的會衆取兩隻公山羊爲解罪祭，一隻公綿羊爲燔祭。
notes: UNV has {<WH01121>} (bēn/sons) as implicit, but LCC explicitly has 人 (people/sons of Israel), so braces dropped and SN attached to 人.
LCC uses 解罪祭 (解罪=resolve sin) where UNV has 贖罪祭 (贖罪=atone for sin); same Hebrew concept (ḥaṭṭāʾṯ, H2403), just different Chinese rendering.
LCC 他要 — 他 is a pronoun added by LCC with no corresponding SN in UNV, left unannotated.

Lev/16.lcc_original: 亞倫要把爲自己做解罪祭的公牛獻上，爲本身和本家行除罪禮。
notes: UNV has {<WAH09001>} (implicit ל prefix on לוֹ) with no explicit Chinese word; LCC explicitly translates it as 爲 in 爲自己做解罪祭的公牛, so braces dropped per rule 3 and attached to 爲
LCC 做 (to make/do) has no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated per rule 5
LCC 行除罪禮 (perform atonement rite) translates Hebrew כִּפֶּר as a phrase; all SNs (WH03722 + WTH8765) attached after the full phrase
LCC uses 本身 where UNV uses 自己 for בַּעֲדוֹ (on behalf of himself) — same semantic mapping, WH01157 attached to 本身

Lev/16.lcc_original: 他要使兩隻公山羊站在會棚的出入處、永恆主面前。
notes: UNV {<WH03947>}{<WTH8804>} (לָקַח 'take') has no explicit counterpart in LCC (LCC omits 'take', using only 使...站 'cause to stand'), so kept implicit after 要.
UNV 把<WAH0853> — 把 serves as direct object marker for את; LCC has no equivalent particle (uses causative 使 instead), so first את made implicit.
LCC 會棚 corresponds to UNV 會幕 (אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד); split as 會<H4150>棚<H0168> to preserve per-character SN alignment.
LCC 出入處 ('entrance/exit') corresponds to UNV 門口 (פֶּתַח H6607); semantic equivalent despite different wording.
LCC 永恆主 ('Eternal Lord') is LCC's standard rendering of 耶和華 (YHWH/H3068).

Lev/16.lcc_original: 然後爲那兩隻山羊拈鬮，拈一隻歸永恆主，一隻歸阿撒瀉勒【1】。
notes: LCC uses 山羊 (mountain goat) where UNV has 羊 (goat); both render H8163 (שׂעיר) so SN attaches to 山羊.
LCC rephrases 一鬮歸與... (one lot for...) as 拈一隻歸... (cast one [goat] for...). The word 鬮 (lot, H1486) has no explicit LCC equivalent in these clauses, so kept as implicit {<WH01486>} after 一<WH0259>.
LCC adds a second 拈 (cast) not present in UNV; left unannotated as it is a structural rephrasing.
然後 (then) is LCC-only connective with no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated.
LCC renders 耶和華 (YHWH) as 永恆主 (Eternal Lord); same SNs <WAH09001><WH03068> attached.
{<WH0175>} (Aaron) remains implicit as LCC also has no explicit subject here.

Lev/16.lcc_original: 亞倫要把那隻拈歸與永恆主的公山羊供獻爲解罪祭。
notes: UNV 拈鬮 (cast lots) compressed to just 拈 in LCC; attached both H5921 (upon) and H1486 (lot/גּוֹרָל) to 拈 since it implicitly carries the lot-casting meaning

永恆主 (Eternal Lord) is LCC's rendering of 耶和華 (Yahweh/LORD) — same H3068 with H9001 prefix

Lev/16.lcc_original: 至於那隻拈歸阿撒瀉勒的公山羊、他卻要使牠活活地站在永恆主面前，好【2】在牠身上【2】行除罪染，然後放牠到曠野去歸阿撒瀉勒。
notes: UNV 拈鬮 (two words: 05921 'upon' + 01486 'lot') collapsed to single 拈 in LCC; both SNs attached to 拈
LCC 公山羊 (he-goat) vs UNV 羊 (goat) — same referent, H08163 (sa'ir) means 'he-goat' so LCC is more literal
LCC 永恆主 replaces UNV 耶和華 for YHWH — standard LCC convention
UNV implicit {<WAH0853>} (object marker) has explicit 牠 in LCC after 放, so braces dropped per Rule 3
LCC 在牠身上 corresponds to UNV 用以 (WAH05921 = 'al/upon'); Hebrew 'upon it' rendered explicitly in LCC

LCC additions 他卻要, 然後 have no Hebrew equivalents — left unannotated

Lev/16.lcc_sn: 『亞倫<WH0175>要把<WAH0853>那爲自己做解罪祭<WH02403>的<WAH0834><WAH09001>公牛<WH06499>獻上<WH07126><WTH8689>，爲<WAH01157>本身和<WAH01157>本家<WH01004>行除罪禮<WH03722><WTH8765>；他要把<WAH0853>那爲自己做解罪祭<WH02403>的<WAH0834><WAH09001>公牛<WH06499>宰了<WH07819><WTH8804>。
Lev/16.lcc_original: 『亞倫要把那爲自己做解罪祭的公牛獻上，爲本身和本家行除罪禮；他要把那爲自己做解罪祭的公牛宰了。
notes: LCC splits UNV's compressed '牽來宰了' (bring+slaughter) into two separate clauses: '獻上' (offer up) and '宰了' (slaughter). WH07126/WTH8689 mapped to 獻上, WH07819/WTH8804 to 宰了.
UNV's implicit markers {WAH0853}{WH06499}{WH02403}{WAH0834}{WAH09001} all have explicit LCC counterparts in the second clause ('他要把那爲自己做解罪祭的公牛宰了'), so braces dropped per rule 3.

LCC's first-clause '爲自己' (describing the bull) has no separate SN in UNV — it is part of the relative clause structure. The two WAH01157 tags attach to the atonement clause '爲本身和本家' matching UNV's '為自己和本家'.
LCC adds '本身' (himself) alongside '本家' — '本身' left unannotated as it has no separate Hebrew equivalent; WAH01157 attaches to the preposition '爲' and '和' respectively.

Lev/16.lcc_original: 他要從永恆主面前的祭壇上拿個滿有炭火的香爐，又拿一捧搗細的芬芳香末，帶進帷帳內，
notes: LCC reverses 火炭 to 炭火 — SNs attached to individual characters: 炭<WH01513>火<WH0784>
LCC adds 他要 (subject+auxiliary) with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated
LCC 芬芳 maps to H05561 (סַמִּים, spices/sweet) and 香末 maps to H07004 (קְטֹרֶת, incense)
LCC restructures sentence: UNV '拿香爐，從...壇上盛滿火炭' → LCC '從...祭壇上拿個滿有炭火的香爐' — SNs follow LCC word order
Second WH04393 (מְלֹא) attached to 一 as in UNV, representing 'his hands full / a handful'

Lev/16.lcc_original: 在永恆主面前、將香放在火上，讓香的煙雲遮掩着法櫃上的除罪蓋，免得他死亡。
notes: UNV 施恩座<WH03727> → LCC 除罪蓋 (same Hebrew כַּפֹּרֶת, different Chinese rendering: 'mercy seat' vs 'sin-removal cover')
UNV 把<WAH0853> → LCC 將<WAH0853> (both are Chinese object-fronting markers corresponding to Hebrew את)

LCC 着 after 遮掩 is a Chinese aspect particle (not translating any Hebrew word), left unannotated; {<WAH0853>} kept implicit after it since את as direct object marker has no explicit LCC equivalent at that position
UNV 使 → LCC 讓 (both causative markers, no SN attached in UNV so none in LCC)

Lev/16.lcc_original: 他要取公牛的一點兒血，用指頭彈在除罪蓋的東面；他要用指頭把血彈在除罪蓋的前面彈七次。
notes: UNV has {<WAH09002>}{<WH0676>} (implicit finger) in the second clause, but LCC explicitly has 用指頭, so braces are dropped and SNs attached normally.

LCC restructures the second clause with 把 construction (把血彈在...的前面) plus a repeated 彈七次. The first 彈 carries <WH05137><WTH8686> as the main verb; the second 彈 (before 七次) is a Chinese stylistic repetition and left unannotated.
LCC adds 一點兒 (a little bit of) before 血 — this has no Hebrew equivalent and is left unannotated.
LCC 他 (he) appears twice as explicit subject — no SN in UNV source, left unannotated.

在 in second clause (彈在除罪蓋的前面) is part of the Chinese verb-complement construction, not a separate preposition like <WAH05921> in the first clause; left unannotated since the Hebrew preposition is לִפְנֵי covered by <WAH09001><WH06440> on 前面.

Lev/16.lcc_original: 『他要宰那爲人民做解罪祭的公山羊，把羊的血帶進帷帳內，用這血行禮，像他用公牛的血行禮一樣，彈血在除罪蓋上面，又彈在除罪蓋前面。
notes: LCC restructures significantly: 'do with blood as with bull's blood' (וְעָשָׂה אֶת־דָּמוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה) is moved BEFORE the sprinkling clause, whereas UNV/Hebrew places sprinkling first then the comparison
UNV implicit {<WH06213>}{<WTH8804>} (עשה 'do') → LCC explicit 行禮 ('perform rite') in both occurrences; braces dropped per rule 3
UNV implicit {<WH01818>} (דמו 'his blood') → LCC explicit 這血 ('this blood'); braces dropped
UNV implicit {<WH03727>} (second כפרת) → LCC explicit 除罪蓋; braces dropped
UNV 施恩座 vs LCC 除罪蓋: different renderings of כפרת (03727) — UNV = 'mercy seat', LCC = 'atonement cover'
LCC's second 彈 in '又彈在除罪蓋前面' left unannotated — Hebrew has one verb והזה with two prepositional phrases (על + ולפני); UNV also has only one annotated 彈
'用' in '用這血' and '用公牛的血' left unannotated — Chinese grammatical word introducing instrument, no direct Hebrew equivalent

Lev/16.lcc_original: 因以色列人的不潔淨、和過犯、跟一切的罪、他要爲至聖所除罪染；爲會棚也要這樣行，因爲那是在他們的不潔淨中間、和他們同住的。
notes: LCC 至聖所 vs UNV 聖所 — both map to H6944 (קֹדֶשׁ); LCC adds 至 (most) as translation choice, left unannotated
LCC 除罪染 vs UNV 贖罪 — both map to H3722 (כִּפֶּר, make atonement), different Chinese rendering of same concept
LCC 會棚 vs UNV 會幕 — same אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד compound, split as 會<H4150>棚<H9001+H0168> following UNV pattern
LCC rearranges the dwelling clause: 在他們的不潔淨中間、和他們同住的 vs UNV 在他們污穢之中; SNs redistributed to match LCC word order
First 他們的 (possessive, before 不潔淨) has no separate SN — absorbed in Hebrew suffix on טֻמְאֹתָם (H2932)
他要, 因爲那是在 — Chinese structural words with no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated

Lev/16.lcc_original: 他進至聖所行除罪禮、爲本身和本家以及以色列全體大衆行除罪禮時候，未出來以前，會棚裏都不可有人。
notes: LCC restructures the sentence: UNV places the tent-of-meeting prohibition first then the 'until' clause with beneficiaries; LCC front-loads the beneficiaries (爲本身和本家以及以色列全體大衆) and second atonement before the prohibition.
LCC uses 至聖所 (most holy place) vs UNV 聖所 (holy place) — same H6944 (קֹדֶשׁ) applies to both.
LCC uses 棚 vs UNV 幕 for 'tent' (H0168 אֹהֶל) — same SN applies.
LCC has two instances of 行除罪禮: first maps to the infinitive construct H3722+WTH8763, second to the perfect H3722+WTH8765, matching UNV's two 贖罪/贖了罪.
LCC 都 partially expresses כֹּל (H3605) as a totality intensifier, but kept {<WAH03605>} as implicit before 人<WH0120> since 都 is a grammatical adverb rather than a direct lexical translation.
未...以前 in LCC maps to UNV 直等到 (H5704 עַד, 'until'); placed WAH05704 after 以前 as it carries the 'until/before' sense.

Lev/16.lcc_original: 他要出來、到永恆主面前的祭壇那裏，爲壇除罪染，取公牛的一點兒血、和公山羊的血，抹在祭壇四角上的四圍。
notes: 永恆主 is LCC's standard rendering of 耶和華 (YHWH/H3068)
除罪染 is LCC's rendering of 贖罪 (כָּפַר H3722 make atonement); morphology WTH8765 (Piel) attached to this verb
一點兒 is LCC's addition to express the partitive sense of מִן (H4480); WAH04480 attached to 的 as the relational particle, with H1818 on 血
四圍 is LCC's equivalent of UNV 周圍 (סָבִיב H5439)
爲 in LCC corresponds to 在 (עַל H5921) in UNV — both serve as the prepositional marker before the altar in the atonement clause

Lev/16.lcc_original: 也要用指頭把血彈在祭壇上七次，使壇潔淨、免去以色列人的不潔淨，把壇分別爲聖。
notes: UNV '潔淨了壇，從壇上除掉…污穢，使壇成聖' is restructured in LCC as '使壇潔淨、免去…不潔淨，把壇分別爲聖' — SNs redistributed to match LCC's clause structure.
LCC '分別爲聖' corresponds to UNV '成聖' (WH06942/WTH8765); both render the Piel of qādash.
LCC '不潔淨' corresponds to UNV '污穢' (WH02932 = ṭumʾâ, uncleanness); semantic equivalence despite different Chinese wording.
LCC uses '祭壇' (sacrificial altar) where UNV has just '壇' (altar) — no SN difference, tag placed after 在 as prefix marker.

Lev/16.lcc_original: 『亞倫爲聖所跟會棚和祭壇、行完了除罪染，就要把那隻活的公山羊獻上：
notes: UNV 會幕 → LCC 會棚: split SNs per character (會<WH04150>棚<WH0168>) since WH04150=מועד(meeting) maps to 會 and WH0168=אהל(tent) maps to 棚
UNV 壇 → LCC 祭壇: both refer to the altar, WH04196 attached to the full word 祭壇
UNV 獻完了 → LCC 行完了: different Chinese verb (獻=offer vs 行=do) but both convey completing the action; WH03615=כלה(finish) applies to 行完了
UNV 贖罪祭 → LCC 除罪染: LCC text as provided appears unusual (染=dye?); preserved exactly as given, attached atonement SNs
UNV 奉上 → LCC 獻上: synonymous verbs for presenting/offering, WH07126=קרב attached to 獻上

Lev/16.lcc_original: 亞倫要把兩手按在那隻活的公山羊頭上，在羊身上承認以色列人的一切罪愆、一切過犯跟一切的罪，把這一切都歸在那公山羊頭上，交在一個隨時有準備的人手裏，去放到曠野。
notes: LCC 罪愆 maps to H5771 (עוונות/iniquities) and LCC 罪 maps to H2403 (חטאות/sins) by positional order, even though UNV uses 罪愆 for H2403 and 罪孽 for H5771 — the two translations use different Chinese terms for the same Hebrew words.

{<WH0175>} (Aaron) promoted to explicit since LCC has 亞倫; {<WH02416>} (living/חי) promoted to explicit since LCC has 活的; {<WAH05921>} (on/upon for confession) promoted to explicit since LCC has 在羊身上; {<WAH03605>} before transgressions promoted to explicit since LCC has 一切.
LCC restructures the ending: UNV 藉著所派之人的手送到曠野去 → LCC 交在...人手裏去放到曠野. H7971 (שׁלח/send) attached to 放到 as the primary send-away action; 交 left unannotated as Chinese restructuring.
手裏 receives <WAH09002><WH03027> (בְּיַד) — LCC uses 手裏 (in the hand) vs UNV 的手 (hand), same Hebrew source.
Missing SNs: 0853

Lev/16.lcc_sn: 那公山羊<WH08163>身上<WAH05921>要擔當<WH05375><WTH8804>{<WAH0853>}他們一切的<WAH03605>罪罰<WH05771>到<WAH0413>個隔絕<WH01509>之地<WH0776>；他就把<WAH0853>那公山羊<WH08163>放<WH07971><WTH8765>在曠野<WAH09002><WH04057>裏。
Lev/16.lcc_original: 那公山羊身上要擔當他們一切的罪罰到個隔絕之地；他就把那公山羊放在曠野裏。
notes: LCC reorders the two clauses: bearing sins comes first, then sending the goat away (UNV has the opposite order). SNs mapped to corresponding clause in LCC.
UNV {<WAH05921>} (עַל, upon) was implicit, but LCC has explicit 身上 (on its body) → braces dropped per Rule 3.
{<WAH0853>} (את before 'all their iniquities') remains implicit in LCC as there is no explicit object marker before 罪罰.
LCC uses 隔絕 (isolated/cut-off) where UNV uses 無人 (uninhabited) — both translate H01509 גְּזֵרָה; SN attached to 隔絕.
個 is a Chinese measure word with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated per Rule 5.
裏 (locative suffix 'inside') left unannotated; SN for wilderness attached to 曠野 before it.

Lev/16.lcc_original: 『亞倫要進會棚，把他進至聖所時所穿的細麻布衣服脫下，放在那裏。
notes: UNV 會幕 (tent of meeting) → LCC 會棚 (meeting booth/tabernacle): same two SNs H04150+H0168 split across 會+棚
UNV 聖所 → LCC 至聖所: 至 is LCC's interpretive intensifier (most holy); entire phrase maps to H06944
Both {<WAH0413>} (אֶל, to/into) remain implicit — LCC has no explicit preposition in either position, relying on 進 (enter) to convey direction

Lev/16.lcc_original: 他要在聖的地方在水中洗身，穿上衣服，出來，把自己的燔祭和人民的燔祭獻上，爲本身又爲人民行除罪禮。
notes: UNV 聖處 split as 聖<H6918>的地方<H4725> in LCC — 的 is unannotated grammatical particle
UNV 百姓 → LCC 人民: both translate H5971 (עָם, people)
UNV 贖罪 → LCC 行除罪禮: both translate H3722 (כפר, make atonement); LCC uses a longer phrase but covers the same semantic unit
UNV 為自己和百姓 → LCC 爲本身又爲人民: two בַּעַד (H1157) instances mapped to the two 爲 prepositions in LCC; 又 left unannotated as conjunction
Both implicit את markers ({<WAH0853>}) retained — LCC has no explicit direct object marker before 身 or 衣服

Lev/16.lcc_original: 解罪祭牲的脂肪、他要燻在祭壇上。
notes: UNV 贖罪祭 H2403 → LCC 解罪祭 (same concept, different translation choice for חַטָּאת)
UNV 脂油 H2459 → LCC 脂肪 (synonym for חֵלֶב)
UNV 焚燒 H6999 → LCC 燻 (LCC uses 燻 for קָטַר which emphasizes smoking/incense-burning aspect)
{<WAH0853>} kept implicit — LCC has no explicit direct object marker for את

Lev/16.lcc_original: 那放公羊歸阿撒瀉勒的人要把衣服洗淨，在水中洗身，然後進營。
notes: UNV 羊 → LCC 公羊 (more specific term for he-goat/שָׂעִיר); H08163 attached to 公羊
UNV 歸與阿撒瀉勒 → LCC 歸阿撒瀉勒 (與 omitted in LCC, no SN impact)
UNV 洗衣服 reordered in LCC to 把衣服洗淨; H03526 attached to 洗淨, H0899 to 衣服
在水中: WAH09002+H04325 attached to 水; 在...中 is Chinese prepositional frame with no separate SN
Two implicit markers {<WAH0853>} retained: one before 公羊 (no explicit object marker in LCC), one before 身 (same as UNV)

Lev/16.lcc_original: 那作爲解罪祭的公牛、和作爲解罪祭的公山羊、牠們的血旣被帶入、在聖所裏做除罪物，牠們的身體就要搬出營外；牠們的皮、跟肉和糞、都要用火去燒。
notes: LCC explicitly says 解罪祭 for both bull and goat; UNV second {<WH02403>} was implicit → braces dropped per Rule 3
身體 (body) in LCC has no Hebrew equivalent (UNV uses 這牛羊) → left unannotated
UNV 將<WAH0853> has no LCC equivalent → first את marker for skin/flesh/dung becomes implicit {<WAH0853>}
到<WAH0413> (אֶל) has no explicit LCC word; attached to 出 which covers the directional sense
LCC 做除罪物 corresponds to UNV 贖罪 (H3722 כפר Piel inf.)
牠們的<WAH0834> maps the relative pronoun אשר to LCC resumptive possessive 牠們的

Lev/16.lcc_original: 燒的人要把衣服洗淨，在水中洗身，然後進營。
notes: UNV 焚燒的 → LCC 燒的: same Hebrew root (שָׂרַף H8313), LCC omits 焚 but meaning is identical
UNV 要洗衣服 (verb-object) → LCC 要把衣服洗淨 (把-construction): H3526 (כָּבַס, wash garments) attached to 洗淨 as the verb carrying the action
UNV 用水 → LCC 在水中: H9002 prefix (בּ in/with) and H4325 (מַיִם water) placed after 水, before 中 which is a Chinese locative particle with no Hebrew equivalent

Lev/16.lcc_original: 『每逢七月初十日、你們總要刻苦自己，無論是本地人、是寄居在你們中間的外僑、一切的工都不可作；這要給你們做永遠的條例。
notes: UNV 己心 (soul/heart) → LCC 自己 (oneself): both render nephesh <WH05315>; implicit {<WAH0853>} retained as LCC also has no explicit direct-object marker
UNV 外人 → LCC 外僑: same Hebrew gēr <WH01616>, different Chinese rendering
UNV 甚麼 → LCC 一切: both render kol <WAH03605> (all/every)
UNV 定例 → LCC 條例: both render chuqqah <WH02708>
LCC 給你們 explicitly renders the lamed prefix (לכם) that UNV embeds implicitly in 你們; <WAH09001> placed after 給你們 as a unit

Lev/16.lcc_original: 因爲在這一日要給你們行除罪禮，使你們潔淨；你們要在永恆主面前得潔淨、脫離一切的罪。
notes: LCC adds 一 before 日 (not in UNV); left unannotated as it has no Hebrew equivalent
LCC 行除罪禮 (perform atonement rite) corresponds to UNV 贖罪 (atone) — same Hebrew root כָּפַר H3722
LCC 永恆主 (Eternal Lord) corresponds to UNV 耶和華 (Yahweh) — both render H3068
LCC 脫離 corresponds to UNV 脫盡 — both render the מִן (H4480) separation concept; grouped with 一切的 (H3605) as in UNV
LCC 罪 vs UNV 罪愆 — both render חַטָּאת H2403

Lev/16.lcc_sn: 這一日<WAH01931>你們<WAH09001>要守爲完全歇工的安息<WH07677>日<WH07676>；要刻苦<WH06031><WTH8765>{<WAH0853>}自己<WH05315>；這是永遠<WH05769>的條例<WH02708>。
Lev/16.lcc_original: 這一日你們要守爲完全歇工的安息日；要刻苦自己；這是永遠的條例。
notes: UNV 聖安息<H7677>日<H7676> maps to LCC 完全歇工的安息<H7677>日<H7676>: LCC expands שַׁבָּתוֹן as '完全歇工的安息' but the SN attaches after 安息 since '完全歇工的' is LCC's interpretive expansion of the same Hebrew word
UNV 己心<H5315> (one's heart/soul) → LCC 自己 (oneself): both render נֶפֶשׁ differently but the SN transfers directly
את (H0853) remains implicit {<WAH0853>} as LCC has no explicit object marker

Lev/16.lcc_original: 那被膏立承受聖職接替他父親爲祭司的、要穿上細麻布衣服、就是聖衣、來行除罪禮。
notes: LCC reorders: '承受聖職接替他父親' vs UNV '接續他父親承接聖職' — SNs placed per LCC word order
UNV implicit {<WAH0899>} (garments) becomes explicit 衣服<WH0899> in LCC since LCC has '衣服' explicitly (Rule 3)
H0899 (beged) appears twice: once for 衣服 (linen garments) and once for 衣 (holy garments), matching Hebrew 'bigdei bad bigdei haqqodesh'
'就是' (explanatory 'that is') and '來' (purpose marker) are Chinese discourse words with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated
UNV '祭司' becomes LCC '爲祭司' — H3548 attached to the full phrase

Lev/16.lcc_original: 他要爲至聖所除罪染，爲會棚和祭壇除罪染，也要爲祭司們和衆民大衆行除罪禮。
notes: UNV has {<WH03722>}{<WTH8765>} (implicit כפר/atonement) after 至聖所, but LCC explicitly renders it as 除罪染 — dropped braces per rule 3 and attached H3722+H8765 to 除罪染.
LCC uses 棚 (shed/tent) where UNV uses 幕 (curtain/tent) for אֹהֶל (H0168) — same Hebrew word, different Chinese rendering; SN attached to 棚.
Three את (H0853) markers remain implicit: LCC restructures with 爲 (for) instead of direct object construction, so no explicit word corresponds to את.
UNV has {<WAH03605>} (implicit כל/all) but LCC has 衆 which explicitly conveys 'all/many' — dropped braces per rule 3.
衆民大衆 segmented as 衆(H3605 כל)+民(H5971 עם)+大衆(H6951 קהל), matching Hebrew כָּל־עַם הַקָּהָל; UNV reverses order as 會眾(H6951)的百姓(H5971).

Lev/16.lcc_original: 爲以色列人行除罪禮、去掉他們一切的罪、一年一次；這要給你們做永遠的條例。』於是亞倫照永恆主所吩咐摩西的去行。
notes: LCC reorders the verse: atonement clause comes first, then the statute clause, opposite of UNV/Hebrew order. All SNs transferred despite reordering.
UNV 因<WAH05921> (because of/on account of) mapped to LCC 爲 (for) — both render Hebrew עַל with slightly different nuance but same preposition.
LCC adds 去掉 (remove) and 他們 (them) which have no direct Hebrew counterparts — left unannotated. 去掉 is LCC's interpretive expansion of the atonement concept.
行除罪禮 in LCC corresponds to UNV 贖罪 (כִּפֵּר H3722) — LCC expands to 'perform the sin-removal rite' but all SNs attach to this phrase.
LCC 永恆主 = UNV 耶和華 (H3068 יְהוָה) — standard LCC rendering of the divine name.
要...做 split by 給你們 in LCC; SNs <WAH01961><WTH8804> placed after 做 (the main verb corresponding to הָיָה).
UNV has {<WH01696>}{<WTH8762>} as implicit (no explicit Chinese word for דבר), but LCC explicitly translates it as 告訴 — braces dropped per rule 3.
UNV 對<WAH0413> (אֶל 'to') is absorbed into LCC 告訴 ('told'), so H0413 is attached to 告訴 along with H1696 and its morphology.

Lev/17.lcc_original: 『你要告訴亞倫和他兒子們、跟以色列衆人說：永恆主所吩咐你們的事、乃是這樣說：
notes: UNV attaches both WAH02088 (zeh=this) and WH01697 (davar=word/thing) together on 這樣; in LCC, split: 事<WH01697> and 這樣<WAH02088> since LCC explicitly renders 事 (thing/matter)
LCC adds 你們 (you plural) with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated per rules
Final 說 in LCC is explicit rendering of the implicit {<WAH09001>}{<WH0559>}{<WTH8800>} (lē'mōr), so braces dropped
跟 in LCC corresponds to 並<WAH0413> in UNV (both meaning 'and/with' introducing the Israelites)

Lev/17.lcc_original: 凡屬以色列家的人、宰公牛或是綿羔羊、或是山羊，不拘是宰於營內，或是宰於營外，

屬 in 凡屬 and 是 in 不拘是 are LCC grammatical additions with no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated
Both {<WAH0834>} implicit markers retained — LCC also lacks explicit relative pronouns at these positions

Lev/17.lcc_original: 而未曾帶到會棚出入處、永恆主帳幕前、獻與永恆主爲供物的，那使祭牲流血的罪就必歸到那人身上；他使祭牲流血，他必須從他族人中被剪除。

UNV {<WH0376>} (implicit ish/man) → LCC 他<WH0376>: dropped braces per rule 3 since LCC has explicit pronoun subject 他 for the second clause
LCC additions 那使祭牲 (causing the sacrifice to...) have no Hebrew equivalent and are left unannotated
LCC 族人 (kinsmen) corresponds to UNV 民 (people), both mapping to H5971 (am/people)
出入處<WH06607> for UNV 門口: LCC uses 出入處 (entrance/exit place) for H6607 (pethach/doorway)

Lev/17.lcc_original: 這是要叫以色列人把他們在田野上所宰獻的祭牲帶到會棚出入處、給祭司，獻與永恆主爲平安祭。

LCC 會棚 vs UNV 會幕, LCC 出入處 vs UNV 門口, LCC 祭牲 vs UNV 祭 — different Chinese renderings of same Hebrew words

Lev/17.lcc_original: 祭司要把血潑在會棚出入處永恆主的祭壇上，把脂肪燻爲怡神之香氣、獻與永恆主。
notes: 會棚 split as 會<WH04150>棚<WH0168> mirroring UNV's 會<WH04150>幕<WH0168> — 會=meeting(מועד), 棚=tent(אהל)

LCC 燻 (fumigate/smoke) covers UNV 焚燒 (burn), both rendering WH06999 (קטר hiphil); WTH8689 confirms hiphil stem

Lev/17.lcc_original: 他們不可再宰祭牲獻給野山羊神【1】，就是他們變節【2】所服事的；這要給他們做世世代代永遠的條例。
notes: UNV 獻<WH02076> (sacrifice verb) mapped to LCC 宰 (slaughter), which is closer to Hebrew זבח; LCC 獻 (offer) left unannotated as part of the Chinese expression 獻給

UNV 隨從<WH0310> (follow after) mapped to LCC 服事<WH0310> (serve) — LCC rephrases the idiomatic 'go whoring after' as 'apostatize to serve'

{<WAH0853>} kept implicit: LCC has no explicit object marker (把/將) for the direct object 祭牲
LCC 給他們<WAH09001> in second clause corresponds to Hebrew לָהֶם (to them); 給 explicitly renders the ל prefix

Lev/17.lcc_original: 『你要對他們說；凡屬以色列家的人、或是在你們中間寄居的外僑，獻上燔祭或宰獻祭牲，
notes: UNV 曉諭<H0559> maps to LCC 說; UNV 他們<H0413> split in LCC as 對<H0413>他們 since 對 explicitly renders the preposition אֵל
Hebrew אִישׁ אִישׁ (H0376×2): first on 凡, second on 的人, matching UNV pattern
H4480 (מִן from) in 家中 mapped to LCC 屬 (belong to) — closest semantic carrier for the partitive מִן
UNV 平安祭<H2077> → LCC 宰獻祭牲<H2077>: H2077 (זֶבַח) is generic sacrifice, LCC rendering is actually closer to Hebrew
{<WAH0834>} kept implicit — LCC also lacks explicit relative pronoun before 獻上
H4480 before H1616 (外僑) kept on 外僑 — LCC has no separate preposition for מִן-הַגֵּר

Lev/17.lcc_original: 而不帶到會棚出入處去獻與永恆主的，那人必須從他族人中被剪除。
notes: UNV 會幕 → LCC 會棚: same concept (tent of meeting), H4150+H0168 attached after 棚
UNV 門口 → LCC 出入處: both mean 'entrance/doorway', H6607 attached after 出入處
LCC 去 before 獻 is a Chinese directional complement with no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated; SNs attached after 獻
UNV 給耶和華 → LCC 與永恆主: 永恆主 is LCC's standard rendering of יהוה (Yahweh); 的 is a Chinese structural particle left unannotated
UNV 從民中 → LCC 從他族人中: split H4480 (מִן/from) to 從 and H5971 (עַם/people) to 族人 for more precise placement
{<WAH0853>} (את direct object marker) kept implicit — LCC has no explicit word for it
LCC 被剪除 uses passive 被 construction vs UNV active 剪除 — both map to H3772 (כָּרַת)

Lev/17.lcc_original: 『凡屬以色列家的人、或是你們中間寄居的外僑、喫任何血、我總要向那喫血的人板着臉，把他從他的族人中剪除掉。
notes: Hebrew אִישׁ אִישׁ (H376 x2) maps to LCC 凡...的人 — first H376 on 凡, second on 的人, matching UNV pattern
LCC 屬 (belonging to) has no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated
LCC 總要 (emphasis/certainty) has no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated
LCC 板着 corresponds to UNV 變 — both render Hebrew נתן (H5414) in the idiom 'set face against'
H834 (אשר, relative pronoun) is implicit in LCC — no explicit 若/who, kept as {<WAH0834>} before 喫
LCC 掉 is a Chinese resultative complement with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated

LCC 外僑 vs UNV 外人 — both render H1616 (גֵּר, sojourner)

Lev/17.lcc_original: 因爲肉之生命是在於血；是我給了你們讓它在祭壇上爲你們的生命行除罪禮的；因爲是血（血是生命）在除罪的。
notes: UNV 活物 (living creature) → LCC 肉 (flesh): both translate H1320 בָּשָׂר, different Chinese renderings of the same Hebrew word
UNV 贖罪 → LCC 行除罪禮 (perform atonement rite): same H3722 כָּפַר, LCC uses a more elaborate expression
LCC restructures final clause with parenthetical （血是生命）to express the Hebrew בַּנֶּפֶשׁ (H09002+H5315) concept; H1931 הוּא attached to 是 in the emphatic 是...的 construction
LCC 讓它 (let it) — the pronoun 它 refers to blood (Hebrew pronominal suffix on נְתַתִּיו); no separate SN in UNV source, so left unannotated

Lev/17.lcc_original: 故此我對以色列人說：你們中間一切的人都不可喫血；在你們中間寄居的外僑也不可喫血。

LCC reorders second clause: UNV '寄居在你們中間的外人' → LCC '在你們中間寄居的外僑'; SNs follow LCC word order
LCC uses 外僑 (sojourner) for H01616 where UNV has 外人; same semantic referent (Hebrew ger)

Lev/17.lcc_original: 凡以色列人、或是在你們中間寄居的外僑、打獵得了可喫的野味、無論是野獸是飛鳥，他總要插牠的血讓流出來，用塵土掩蓋上。
notes: LCC restructures the blood clause significantly: UNV 必放出...牠的血來 (must pour out its blood) → LCC 插牠的血讓流出來 (pierce its blood to let it flow out). Attached <WH08210><WTH8804> (שָׁפַךְ, pour out) to 流出 as the closest semantic match; 插 left unannotated as LCC's own addition.

Lev/17.lcc_original: 『因爲凡有血肉的的生命、其血就等【3】於其生命。所以我對以色列人說：凡有血肉的的血、你們都不可喫，因爲凡有血肉的的生命、就是牠的血；凡喫血的必須被剪除。

Lev/17.lcc_original: 凡喫自己死的屍體、或野獸撕裂的的人、無論是本地人、是寄居的、總要把衣服洗淨，在水中洗澡，但還是不潔淨，到晚上、然後纔潔淨。

Lev/18.lcc_sn: 不可<WAH03808>露現<WH01540><WTH8762>你父親<WH01>續娶的妻子<WH0802>的下體<WH06172>；那就是<WAH01931>你父親<WH01>的下體<WH06172>。

Lev/18.lcc_sn: 你的姐妹<WH0269>{<WH06172>}、不拘是異母同父<WH01>的{<WH01323>}、是<WAH0176>異父同母<WH0517>的{<WH01323>}、無論<WAH0176>在家<WH01004>裏生<WH04138>的、或是在外<WH02351>頭生<WH04138>的、你都不可<WAH03808>露現<WH01540><WTH8762>她的下體<WH06172>。

notes: LCC uses 露現 (expose/reveal) where UNV has 露 (uncover); both SNs H1540+H8762 attached to 露現 as a unit
LCC 家裏 and 外頭 have suffixes (裏/頭) that are Chinese locative particles with no Hebrew equivalent — SN placed on 家 and 外 respectively

Lev/18.lcc_sn: 你兒子<WH01121>的女兒<WH01323>、或是<WAH0176>你女兒<WH01323>的女兒<WH01323>、你都不可<WAH03808>露現<WH01540><WTH8762>她們的下體<WH06172>，因爲<WAH03588>她們<WH02007>的下體<WH06172>、就是你自己的下體<WH06172>。

notes: LCC restructures Hebrew's fronted construct (עֶרְוַת בַּת־בִּנְךָ) so the first H6172 attaches to 下體 after the verb 露現, rather than appearing before the kinship terms as in Hebrew/UNV.
