Lev/19.lcc_original: 第五年你們纔可以喫它的果子，好叫它給你們增加出產：我永恆主是你們的上帝。
Lev/19.unv_sn_reference: 第五<WH02549>年<WAH09002><WH08141>，你們要吃<WH0398><WTH8799>那<WAH0853>樹上的果子<WH06529>，好叫樹給你們<WAH09001>結<WAH09001><WH03254><WTH8687>果子更多<WH08393>。我是<WAH0589>耶和華<WH03068>─你們的　神<WH0430>。
notes: UNV 那<WAH0853> (direct object marker את) → LCC 它 (pronoun 'its'); not a perfect semantic match but 它 is the closest functional equivalent modifying 果子
UNV 耶和華<WH03068> → LCC 永恆主 (Eternal Lord), LCC's standard rendering of YHWH
UNV 神<WH0430> → LCC 上帝, systematic vocabulary difference
纔可以 (only then can) left unannotated — Chinese grammatical words with no Hebrew equivalent
Two <WAH09001> (lamed prefix) tags: one on 給你們 and one on 增加, matching UNV's distribution on 給你們 and 結

Lev/19.lcc_original: 『你們不可喫帶血的東西，不可觀兆頭，不可算命。
notes: LCC reverses the order of the last two clauses vs UNV: UNV has 用法術(H5172) then 觀兆(H6049), but LCC has 觀兆頭(H6049) then 算命(H5172). Mapped by semantic meaning: 觀兆頭='observe omens'→H6049 (anan), 算命='divination/fortune-telling'→H5172 (nachash).
UNV 也不可 simplified to 不可 in LCC — the third WAH03808 attaches to LCC's third 不可.
的物 (UNV) vs 的東西 (LCC) — both are generic classifiers with no SN, left unannotated.

Lev/19.lcc_original: 不可將你們頭的兩邊剃圓形，也不可把鬍鬚的兩邊割損。
notes: LCC 剃圓形 together translates תַקִּפוּ (H5362, to round/cut around); SNs placed after full phrase 圓形 rather than after 剃 alone
UNV implicit {<WAH0853>} (את accusative marker) maps to LCC 把 (bǎ construction) — dropped braces per rule 3 since LCC explicitly renders it
LCC 將 in first clause is a grammatical disposal marker with no Hebrew counterpart — left unannotated
LCC adds 你們 (your) which is part of רֹאשְׁכֶם but not separately tagged in UNV — left unannotated
UNV parenthetical （或譯：兩鬢） is a translation note, not part of the text — ignored

Lev/19.lcc_original: 不可爲死人將刻紋劃在你們的肉身上，也不可在你們身上割花紋：我是永恆主。
notes: UNV has {<WH08296>} (שֶׂרֶט, cutting/incision) as implicit, but LCC has explicit 刻紋 (carved pattern) — applied Rule 3: dropped braces and attached <WH08296> to 刻紋.
LCC adds 將, 在...上, 你們的 as grammatical elements with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated per Rule 5.
LCC renders יהוה as 永恆主 (Eternal Lord) vs UNV 耶和華 — same SN <WH03068> attached.
Second clause 身上<WAH09002> has only prefix marker with no base SN, matching UNV source tagging.

Lev/19.lcc_original: 『不可叫你的女兒受汚辱、使她爲妓女，恐怕這地一味向着淫亂，就滿了罪大惡極的事。
notes: LCC restructures '不可辱沒你的女兒' → '不可叫你的女兒受汚辱'; 叫 (cause) has no Hebrew equivalent and is left unannotated
UNV has two occurrences of 地/H0776 ('地上的人' and '地就滿了'); LCC merges into one ('這地...就滿了'), so second H0776 is marked implicit {<WH0776>} before 就
UNV '地上的人專向淫亂' (people of the land turn to whoredom) → LCC '這地一味向着淫亂' (this land turns to whoredom); LCC drops 的人 but meaning is equivalent, H0776 attached to 這地
{<WAH0853>} (את direct object marker) remains implicit in LCC since 叫 is a causative restructuring, not a direct object marker

Lev/19.lcc_sn: 我的安息日<WH07676>你們務要守<WH08104><WTH8799>{<WAH0853>}；我的聖所<WH04720>你們務要敬重<WH03372><WTH8799>：我是<WAH0589>永恆主<WH03068>。
Lev/19.lcc_original: 我的安息日你們務要守；我的聖所你們務要敬重：我是永恆主。
notes: LCC uses 敬重 (two characters) where UNV uses 敬 alone for H03372 (יָרֵא); both SNs attached after 敬重 as a unit.
LCC translates 耶和華 as 永恆主 — SN 03068 attached to 永恆主.
{<WAH0853>} (אֵת direct object marker) kept implicit as LCC has no explicit equivalent.

Lev/19.lcc_sn: 『你們不可<WAH0408>偏<WH06437><WTH8799>向<WAH0413>那些交鬼的<WH0178>和<WAH0413>行巫術的<WH03049>；不可<WAH0408>求問<WH01245><WTH8762>他們、以致因他們<WAH09002>而蒙不潔<WAH09001><WH02930><WTH8800>；我<WAH0589>永恆主<WH03068>是你們的上帝<WH0430>。
Lev/19.lcc_original: 『你們不可偏向那些交鬼的和行巫術的；不可求問他們、以致因他們而蒙不潔；我永恆主是你們的上帝。
Lev/19.unv_sn_reference: 「不可<WAH0408>偏<WH06437><WTH8799>向<WAH0413>那些交鬼的<WH0178>和<WAH0413>行巫術的<WH03049>；不可<WAH0408>求問<WH01245><WTH8762>他們，以致被他們<WAH09002>玷污了<WAH09001><WH02930><WTH8800>。我是<WAH0589>耶和華<WH03068>─你們的　神<WH0430>。
notes: UNV 我是<WAH0589> — H0589 (אֲנִי='I') attaches to LCC 我; the copula 是 in both versions is unannotated
UNV 耶和華<WH03068> → LCC 永恆主 (Lü's standard rendering of YHWH)
UNV 神<WH0430> → LCC 上帝 (systematic UNV/LCC difference)

UNV 被他們<WAH09002>玷污了<WAH09001><WH02930><WTH8800> → LCC 因他們<WAH09002>而蒙不潔<WAH09001><WH02930><WTH8800>: Hebrew בָהֶם (09002+them) and לְטָמְאָה (09001+H2930 to-be-defiled); LCC rephrases as 因…而蒙不潔 but semantic mapping is clear
LCC begins with 你們 which has no separate SN in UNV — left unannotated

Lev/19.lcc_original: 『在白頭髮的人面前你要站起來；要尊敬老人，要敬畏你的上帝：我是永恆主。
notes: LCC 白頭髮的 corresponds to UNV 白髮的 — both render שֵׂיבָה (H7872); SN placed after 的 to cover the full adjectival phrase
LCC 上帝 = UNV 神 (H0430 אֱלֹהִים), standard LCC rendering
LCC 永恆主 = UNV 耶和華 (H3068 יהוה), standard LCC rendering for the Tetragrammaton
{<WH06440>} (פָּנִים face/presence) kept implicit after 老人 — LCC has no explicit word for it, matching UNV treatment

Lev/19.lcc_sn: 『若有<WAH03588>外僑<WH01616>在你們的地<WAH09002><WH0776>寄居<WH01481><WTH8799>，和你<WAH0854>在一起，你們不可<WAH03808>欺負<WH03238><WTH8686>他<WAH0853>。
Lev/19.lcc_original: 『若有外僑在你們的地寄居，和你在一起，你們不可欺負他。
notes: LCC restructures word order: UNV '和你同居' (with-you sojourn) → LCC '寄居，和你在一起' (sojourn, with you together); SNs placed at their respective semantic correspondents despite reordering.
LCC uses 外僑 (foreign resident) for UNV 外人 (stranger) — same Hebrew גֵּר H1616.
LCC adds explicit 你們 before 不可; left unannotated as it has no separate SN.
LCC 在一起 is part of the 'with you' phrase but has no separate SN — only 和你 gets <WAH0854>.

Lev/19.lcc_sn: 和你們<WAH0854>在一起的<WH01481><WTH8802>寄居者<WH01616>、你們<WAH09001>要<WAH01961><WTH8799>看爲你們中間<WAH04480>的本地人<WAH09003><WH0249>一樣；要愛<WH0157><WTH8804>他<WH09001>像你自己<WAH03644>，因爲<WAH03588>你們在埃及<WH04714>地<WAH09002><WH0776>也做<WAH01961><WTH8804>過寄居者<WH01616>；我<WAH0589>永恆主<WH03068>是你們的上帝<WH0430>。
Lev/19.lcc_original: 和你們在一起的寄居者、你們要看爲你們中間的本地人一樣；要愛他像你自己，因爲你們在埃及地也做過寄居者；我永恆主是你們的上帝。
notes: UNV {<WAH04480>} (מִן, from) was implicit, but LCC has explicit 中間 (among) — dropped braces per rule 3 and attached to 中間
LCC 永恆主 is LCC's distinctive rendering of 耶和華/YHWH → mapped to H3068
LCC 上帝 maps to UNV 神/אלהים → H0430 (standard LCC-UNV divergence)
LCC 在一起的 carries H1481 (גּוּר sojourn verb) — LCC rephrases UNV 同居的 as 在一起的
Chinese aspect particle 過 (experiential aspect) left unannotated per rule 5
LCC 是 (copula) and 看爲/像 (comparison markers) left unannotated — no direct Hebrew equivalent

Lev/19.lcc_original: 『在審判案件上、在尺秤量器上、你們不可行不公道的事。
notes: UNV 不義(H5766) maps to LCC 不公道的事 — LCC expands into a fuller phrase; SN attached after the whole phrase
UNV 升、斗(H4884 meshurah) maps to LCC 量器 — LCC uses a general term '量器' (measuring vessel) instead of UNV's specific 升/斗 (dry measures)
Each measurement term in UNV carries its own <WAH09002> prefix (bet preposition); preserved on each LCC term even though LCC uses a single 在...上 construction

Lev/19.lcc_original: 要用公道的天平、公道的法碼，公道的升斗、公道的加倫；我永恆主是你們的上帝，曾把你們從埃及地領出來的。
notes: LCC uses 加倫 (gallon) where UNV has 秤 (hin) for WH01969 (הִין) — both are liquid measure translations, SN transferred to LCC's rendering
LCC 永恆主 = UNV 耶和華 (YHWH), standard LCC rendering
LCC 上帝 = UNV 神 (אֱלֹהִים), standard LCC rendering
WAH0589 (אֲנִי, I) attached to 我 only; 是 (am/to be) left unannotated as it is Chinese copula with no separate Hebrew word
{WAH09001} kept implicit — LCC 用 is functional Chinese, not a direct rendering of the Hebrew prefix

Lev/19.lcc_original: 你們要謹守我的一切律例、一切典章、而遵行它；我是永恆主。
notes: LCC explicitly has 它 (it/them) corresponding to Hebrew אֹתָם (H0853), which is implicit {<WAH0853>} in UNV after 遵行 — braces dropped per rule 3.
LCC has two explicit 一切 corresponding to the two כֹּל in Hebrew (כָּל־חֻקֹּתַי וְאֶת־כָּל־מִשְׁפָּטַי). The second כֹּל was implicit {<WAH03605>} in UNV but explicit in LCC — braces dropped.
Two את markers (before 律例 group and before 典章 group) remain implicit {<WAH0853>} as LCC has no explicit object markers for them.
永恆主 is LCC's standard rendering of 耶和華 (YHWH/H3068).

Lev/20.lcc_original: 永恆主告訴摩西說：
notes: UNV {<WH01696>}{<WTH8762>} are implicit (דבר, no explicit UNV word), but LCC 告訴 explicitly translates 'spoke/told', so braces dropped and SNs attached directly.
UNV 對<WAH0413> (אֵל, 'to') has no separate word in LCC; 告訴 ('told') subsumes the directional sense, so WAH0413 attached to 告訴 along with the verb SNs.

Lev/20.lcc_original: 『你要對以色列人說：凡以色列人、和在以色列中寄居的外僑、將自己的後裔獻給摩洛的、總必須被處死；這地的人要扔石頭把他砍死。
notes: UNV 曉諭<WAH0413> → LCC 對<WAH0413>: H0413 (אֵל, 'to/unto') maps to LCC's preposition 對 rather than being absorbed into the verb
UNV 兒女<WH02233> → LCC 後裔<WH02233>: LCC uses 後裔 (offspring/descendants) instead of 兒女 (children) but same Hebrew root זֶרַע (H2233)
UNV 總要<H4191+8800>治死<H4191+8714> → LCC 總必須<H4191+8800>被處死<H4191+8714>: Split the מוֹת יוּמָת construction — infinitive absolute (emphasis) on 總必須, hophal imperfect (main verb) on 被處死
UNV 外人<WH01616> → LCC 外僑<WH01616>: different Chinese word, same Hebrew גֵּר (sojourner/alien)
{<WAH0834>} kept implicit: אֲשֶׁר (relative pronoun 'who') has no explicit equivalent in LCC; the Chinese 的 is a structural particle, not a direct translation

Lev/20.lcc_original: 我也要向那人板着臉，把他從他的族人中剪除掉，因爲他把他的後裔獻給摩洛，使我的聖所蒙不潔，並且褻瀆我的聖名。
notes: LCC '板着臉' split: 板 receives <WH05414><WTH8799> (natan/set), 着 unannotated (aspect particle), 臉 receives <WH06440> (panim/face)
LCC '族人' maps to UNV '民' for <WH05971> (am/people) — same semantic referent, different word choice
LCC '使' explicitly expresses the purpose clause that is implicit in UNV {<WAH09001>}{<WAH04616>} (lema'an) — braces dropped per Rule 3
LCC '蒙不潔' (suffer defilement) replaces UNV '玷污' (defile) for <WH02930><WTH8763> — different voice but same root tame
LCC '掉' (resultative complement) and '並且' (conjunction) and '他的' (his, 2x) are unannotated — no Hebrew equivalents
{<WAH0853>} kept implicit twice: before 聖所 and before 聖名 — LCC has no explicit object marker words

Lev/20.lcc_original: 人把他的後裔獻給摩洛，這地的人若掩目不看，不把他處死，
notes: UNV 那人 → LCC 人: LCC omits demonstrative 那 but both WAH01931+WH0376 attached to 人
UNV {<WAH0853>}{<WH05869>} (eyes implicit) → LCC 目 is explicit, so braces dropped and tags attached to 目
H5956 (עָלַם hide/conceal) appears twice: first as Hiphil 8687 on 掩 (cover), second as 8686 on 不看 (not look), matching UNV 佯為…不見 split
UNV 兒女 → LCC 後裔: both render Hebrew זֶרַע (H2233); WAH04480 (מִן from) absorbed into LCC possessive 他的
UNV 治死 → LCC 處死: synonym for putting to death, H4191 attached

Lev/20.lcc_original: 我就要向那人和他的家板着臉，把他和一切隨從他變節【1】的、就是變節去服事摩洛的人、都從他的族人中剪除掉。
notes: UNV {<WH02181>}{<WTH8802>} is implicit (no explicit Chinese word), but LCC has explicit 變節 for the first occurrence → dropped braces per rule 3, attached as 變節<WH02181><WTH8802>
LCC 去服事摩洛 rephrases UNV 與摩洛; mapped WAH0310 (אחרי=after) to 去 as the directional element; 服事 (serve) has no Hebrew SN equivalent and is left unannotated
LCC 板着 corresponds to UNV 變 — both render the Hebrew idiom שׂים פּנים (set face against); WAH0853 (את object marker) placed after 板着 matching UNV pattern
掉 is a Chinese resultative complement with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated per rule 5
LCC uses 那 where UNV has 這 — both translate the same Hebrew demonstrative; WAH01931 attached to 那

Lev/20.lcc_original: 『人偏向交鬼的和行巫術的、變節【1】去隨從他們，我要向那人板着臉，把他從他的族人中剪除掉。
notes: UNV 行邪淫 (go whoring) → LCC 變節 (apostatize/turn traitor): significant paraphrase; both render Hebrew זָנָה (H2181) but with different metaphors. SNs H9001+H2181+morph 8800 attached to 變節.
UNV 隨他們 (follow them) → LCC 去隨從他們: 去 is a Chinese directional verb with no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated; H0310 (אַחַר, after) attached to 隨從他們.
UNV 變臉 → LCC 板着臉 (set/harden face): same Hebrew idiom נָתַן פָּנִים; H0853+H6440 attached to 板着臉 as a unit.
LCC 他的族人 vs UNV 民: LCC is more specific (his clansmen vs people); H5971 attached to 族人.
LCC 掉 (resultative complement) and 去 have no Hebrew equivalents — left unannotated.
Footnote marker 【1】 preserved in its original position after 變節 and its SN tags.

Lev/20.lcc_sn: 所以你們要潔淨自己爲聖<WH06942><WTH8694>，而成<WAH01961><WTH8804>聖別<WH06918>，因爲<WAH03588>我<WAH0589>永恆主<WH03068>是你們的上帝<WH0430>。
Lev/20.lcc_original: 所以你們要潔淨自己爲聖，而成聖別，因爲我永恆主是你們的上帝。
Lev/20.unv_sn_reference: 所以你們要自潔<WH06942><WTH8694>成<WAH01961><WTH8804>聖<WH06918>，因為<WAH03588>我是<WAH0589>耶和華<WH03068>─你們的　神<WH0430>。
notes: LCC expands H6942 Hithpael (自潔→潔淨自己爲聖): '爲聖' is part of the Hithpael elaboration, so H6942+TH8694 attached after the full phrase '潔淨自己爲聖' before the comma
LCC uses 永恆主 for YHWH (H3068) instead of 耶和華
LCC uses 上帝 for Elohim (H0430) instead of 神

Lev/20.lcc_sn: 你們要謹守<WH08104><WTH8804>{<WAH0853>}我的條例<WH02708>而遵行<WH06213><WTH8804>它<WAH0853>；我<WAH0589>永恆主<WH03068>是把你們分別爲聖的<WH06942><WTH8764>。
Lev/20.lcc_original: 你們要謹守我的條例而遵行它；我永恆主是把你們分別爲聖的。
notes: UNV has two implicit {<WAH0853>} (את direct object markers). The second one corresponds to LCC's explicit '它' (them), so braces dropped per Rule 3. The first את between 謹守 and the object remains implicit as LCC has no explicit word for it.
LCC '永恆主' = UNV '耶和華' (both render יְהוָה/H3068). LCC uses '永恆主' (Eternal Lord) as its standard rendering.
LCC '條例' = UNV '律例' (both render חֻקֹּתַי/H2708, 'my statutes').
LCC '分別爲聖' = UNV '成聖' (both render מְקַדִּשְׁכֶם/H6942, Piel participle).

Lev/20.lcc_sn: {<WAH03588>}凡<WH0376><WH0376>咒罵<WH07043><WTH8762>自己的{<WAH0853>}父親<WH01>或{<WAH0853>}母親<WH0517>的<WAH0834>、必須<WH04191><WTH8800>被處死<WH04191><WTH8714>；他咒罵了<WH07043><WTH8765>自己的父親<WH01>或母親<WH0517>，流他血<WH01818>的罪必歸到他自己身上<WAH09002>。
Lev/20.lcc_original: 凡咒罵自己的父親或母親的、必須被處死；他咒罵了自己的父親或母親，流他血的罪必歸到他自己身上。
notes: UNV 凡+WH0376x2 (אִישׁ אִישׁ 'every man') mapped to LCC 凡 — LCC omits the explicit 'man' but 凡 covers the semantic range
LCC adds 自己的 (reflexive possessive) before 父親/母親 with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated
LCC adds 或 ('or') between 父親/母親 — left unannotated; UNV has them juxtaposed
{<WAH0853>} (את direct object markers) kept implicit before 父親 and 母親 in first clause since 自己的 is possessive, not a translation of את
WH04191+WTH8800 (מוֹת infinitive absolute) → 必須; WH04191+WTH8714 (יוּמָת Hophal impf) → 被處死
UNV parenthetical 原文是血 becomes explicit 流他血的罪 in LCC — WH01818 attached to 血 within that phrase
Second clause 父親/母親 have no את markers in UNV source either, so none added in LCC

Lev/20.lcc_original: 『一個人和另一個人的妻子犯了姦淫──和他鄰舍的妻子犯了姦淫──姦夫和淫婦都必須被處死。
notes: UNV's 8 implicit markers at start represent the first clause (אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִנְאַף אֶת אֵשֶׁת אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר) which UNV omits but LCC translates explicitly as 一個人和另一個人的妻子犯了姦淫. Dropped braces for 6 of 8 implicit SNs that LCC renders explicitly.
Both אֲשֶׁר (WAH0834) remain implicit as LCC restructures without an explicit relative pronoun — placed after the subject they modify.
LCC adds 和 between 姦夫 and 淫婦 which has no corresponding SN in UNV (the Hebrew וְ on וְהַנֹּאָפֶת is not separately annotated), so left unannotated.
他 in 他鄰舍 is the possessive suffix absorbed into H7453 (רֵעֵהוּ), not separately annotated.
都必須 maps to מוֹת (infinitive absolute, H4191+H8800 emphasizing certainty); 被處死 maps to יוּמַת (Hophal imperfect, H4191+H8714 = be put to death).

Lev/20.lcc_sn: 人<WH0376>和<WAH0854>他的繼母<WH01><WH0802>同寢<WH07901><WTH8799>{<WAH0834>}、就是露現了<WH01540><WTH8765>他父親<WH01>的下體<WH06172>，他們二人<WH08147>都必須<WH04191><WTH8800>被處死<WH04191><WTH8714>；流他們血<WH01818>的罪必歸到他們自己身上<WAH09002>。
Lev/20.lcc_original: 人和他的繼母同寢、就是露現了他父親的下體，他們二人都必須被處死；流他們血的罪必歸到他們自己身上。
notes: H0376 (man): implicit in UNV but LCC has explicit 人 → braces dropped per Rule 3
H6172 (nakedness/ערוה): implicit in UNV but LCC has explicit 下體 → braces dropped per Rule 3

Lev/20.lcc_sn: 『人<WH0376>{<WAH0834>}拉了<WH03947><WTH8799>{<WAH0853>}他的姐妹<WH0269>、無論是異母同父<WH01>的{<WH01323>}、或是<WAH0176>異父同母<WH0517>的{<WH01323>}，男的看了<WH07200><WTH8804>{<WAH0853>}女的的下體<WH06172>，女的<WAH01931>也看了<WH07200><WTH8799>{<WAH0853>}男的的下體<WH06172>，這<WAH01931>是可恥的事<WH02617>；二人都必須在他們本國的子民<WH05971><WH01121>眼前<WAH09001><WH05869>被剪除<WH03772><WTH8738>：他露現了<WH01540><WTH8765>他姐妹<WH0269>的下體<WH06172>，他必須擔當<WH05375><WTH8799>他自己的罪罰<WH05771>。

Deut/1.lcc_original: 審判的時候、不可看人的外貌；聽訟無論是聽卑小的，還是聽尊大的、都要一樣；不可怕人的情面，因爲審判是屬於上帝的；你們認爲難辦的案件、可以呈到我這裏來，我就判斷。」

Deut/1.lcc_sn: 『我們從何烈<WAH04480><WH02722>往前行<WH05265><WTH8799>，走遍<WH03212><WTH8799>{<WAH0853>}{<WAH03605>}你們所<WAH0834>看見<WH07200><WTH8804>那<WAH01931>大<WH01419>而可怕<WH03372><WTH8737>的曠野<WH04057>，照<WAH09003><WAH0834>永恆主<WH03068>我們的上帝<WH0430>所吩咐<WH06680><WTH8765>我們<WAH0853>的、按到亞摩利人<WH0567>山地<WH02022>的路向<WH01870>而行<WH0935><WTH8799>；我們就到達了<WAH05704>加低斯巴尼亞<WH06947>。

路向 (LCC, 'direction/route') carries WH01870 (דֶּרֶךְ), which UNV renders as the directional 往; 到達了 carries WAH05704 (עַד, 'unto'), which UNV renders as 到了 — LCC expands the preposition into a fuller arrival phrase.

notes: UNV 耶和華 → LCC 永恆主: different Chinese terms for Yahweh (יְהוָה), same WH03068 applied to 永恆主.

LCC's 永恆主 (Eternal Lord) corresponds to UNV's 耶和華 (YHWH) — both receive <WH03068>.

LCC rephrases the final clause from UNV's 有我不…嗎 to 我不是…麼; WAH03808 (negation לֹא) attached to 不, and 是 left unannotated as a Chinese copula with no Hebrew equivalent.
LCC 難過 corresponds to UNV 愁悶 (WH07489 = רָעַע, be bad/displeasing); LCC 喫飯 is the same word as UNV 吃飯 in a different character variant.

1Sam/1.lcc_original: 哈拿心裏愁苦，就向永恆主祈禱，直痛哭飲泣。
notes: LCC reorders clauses relative to UNV: UNV places weeping (痛痛哭泣) before praying, LCC places praying before weeping — matching Hebrew syntax (וַתִּתְפַּלֵּל...בָּכֹה תִבְכֶּה) more closely; SNs assigned accordingly to their semantic targets in LCC word order.
{<WAH05921>} is implicit (no explicit Chinese) in UNV, but LCC explicitly renders עַל as 向; braces dropped and <WAH05921> attached directly to 向.
耶和華<WH03068> (YHWH) in UNV → 永恆主<WH03068> in LCC; Lü's characteristic rendering of the divine name as 永恆主.

Hebrew infinitive absolute בָּכֹה תִבְכֶּה is split across LCC's 直痛哭飲泣: <WH01058><WTH8800> (inf. absolute intensifier) attached to 痛哭, <WH01058><WTH8799> (finite imperfect) attached to 飲泣; moderate uncertainty here since LCC treats this as one continuous phrase.

1Sam/1.lcc_original: 她許個願說：『萬軍之永恆主阿，你若眞地看到使女的困苦，眷念到我，不忘了使女，而賜給使女一個男的後裔，那麼我就要使他儘他一生的日子獻與永恆主，剃刀總不上到他的頭。』
notes: UNV treats 許願 as a compound verb-noun pair; split across LCC's 許(H05087+WTH8799) and 個願(H05088) since 許=vow(verb) and 個願=a vow(noun) map naturally.

Hebrew infinitive absolute רָאֹה (H07200+WTH8800) mapped to LCC's adverbial 眞地 rather than a verb; the finite imperfect (H07200+WTH8799) maps to 看到. This preserves the emphatic 'surely see' function LCC renders as 眞地看到.
Hebrew verb זָכַרְתַּנִי includes first-person object suffix 'me'; LCC makes this explicit with 到我. Entire phrase 眷念到我 carries H02142+WTH8804.
LCC second 使女 in 賜給使女 receives WAH09001+H0519, representing the dative ל+אָמָה (to [the] maidservant) from Hebrew וְנָתַתָּה לַאֲמָתְךָ.

LCC 儘他一生的日子 reverses Hebrew/UNV order: Hebrew כָּל יְמֵי חַיָּיו = all(WAH03605) + days(WH03117) + his-life(WH02416), but LCC puts 一生(WH02416) before 日子(WH03117). SNs assigned per LCC's actual word order.
LCC 總不 takes WAH03808 on 總不 as a unit; 總 is LCC's emphatic intensifier with no separate Hebrew lexeme.
{WAH05921} kept implicit: LCC 上到 is a directional compound verb where 到 conveys direction-to-destination rather than clearly lexicalizing עַל (upon). UNV also leaves WAH05921 implicit.
LCC 永恆主 is LCC's rendering of יהוה (H03068) throughout; 獻與 absorbs the dative ל (WAH09001) into the verb phrase.

把 treated as explicit functional equivalent of accusative marker אֶת (WAH0853), braces dropped per Rule 3; 把 marks the direct object in the disposal construction analogously to אֶת.
WAH04480+WAH05921 (מֵעָלָֽיִךְ, 'from upon you') attached to 你 within the 把你的酒除去 phrase, following UNV's strategy of tagging these prefixes to the pronoun 你.

LCC's second clause restructures UNV's dynamic rendering 你不應該喝酒 into 把你的酒除去吧, which is actually closer to the Hebrew literal; the removal verb WH05493+WTH8685 maps cleanly to 除去 rather than UNV's 不應該.

2Chr/1.lcc_original: 所羅門向以色列衆人、向千夫長、百夫長、審判官、向全以色列衆首領、父系家屬的族長、講話。

2Chr/1.lcc_original: 所羅門往基遍的邱壇去，全體大衆也跟他一同去；因爲在那裏有上帝的會棚、永恆主僕人摩西在曠野所造的。

LCC adds 了 (aspect particle after 聚集), two instances of 他 (subject pronouns), 把這些車馬 (topicalizer before 安置), and 同在一處 (manner phrase) — all unannotated Chinese additions with no Hebrew equivalent

Neh/3.lcc_original: 接着是提哥亞人修造了另一段，就是從那凸出來的大譙樓前面、直到俄斐勒的墻。【7】俄斐勒呢、是當殿役的所住的地方【7】。
notes: 其次→接着: both render WH0310 (אַחַר = after/next); direct semantic equivalent.

對著<WAH04480><WAH05048> (מִנֶּגֶד) is split across LCC's 從…前面: UNV renders the compound preposition as a single 對著 (opposite/facing), while LCC expands it as 從 (from = מִן, WAH04480) + 前面 (in front of = נֶגֶד, WAH05048) bracketing the noun phrase; WAH04480 placed on 從, WAH05048 placed on 前面.
一段<WH08145><WH04060>→另<WH08145>一段<WH04060>: LCC adds 另 to make the 'another/second' sense of WH08145 (שֵׁנִי) explicit; 另 carries WH08145, 一段 carries WH04060 (מִדָּה = measure/portion).
樓<WH04026>→譙樓<WH04026>: LCC uses 譙樓 (battlemented tower) for מִגְדָּל; WH04026 attached to the full compound.
了 (aspect particle after 修造) left unannotated per rules.
就是 (explanatory connector) has no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated.
【7】…【7】 is a LCC footnote block with no UNV parallel; entire footnote content left unannotated.

Neh/3.lcc_original: 從馬門往上、祭司們各對着自己的房屋而修造。
notes: UNV 眾祭司 → LCC 祭司們: SN 03548 attaches to 祭司們 (collective plural expressed differently but same referent)
UNV 對 → LCC 對着: SNs 09001 (prefix ל) and 05048 (נֶגֶד) attach together to 對着
LCC connective 而 before 修造 is left unannotated — no Hebrew equivalent, purely a Chinese syntactic connector
05921 (עַל, upward) functions as a prefix on 從 alongside 04480 (מִן); 往上 in both versions is covered by this compound prefix, not tagged separately

Neh/3.lcc_original: 接着是音麥的兒子撒督對着他自己的房屋而修造。接着是看守東門的示迦尼的兒子示瑪雅修造的。
notes: LCC uses 接着 for UNV 其次 (both render WH0310 אַחֲרָיו, 'after him')
LCC adds pronoun 他 before 自己的房屋 — making the Hebrew possessive suffix on בֵּיתוֹ explicit; SN WH01004 attaches to 房屋 at end of full phrase
LCC inserts connective 而 before first 修造 — Chinese syntactic particle with no Hebrew correspondent; left unannotated, SN/morphology tags attach to 修造
LCC uses 看守 (compound) for UNV 守 — WH08104 (שָׁמַר) and its morphology WTH8802 both attach to 看守 as the complete verbal unit
LCC sentence-final 的 at end of second clause is a Chinese grammatical particle with no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated

Neh/3.lcc_sn: 接着<WH0310>是示利米雅<WH08018>的兒子<WH01121>哈拿尼雅<WH02608>和薩拉<WH06764>的第六<WH08345>兒子<WH01121>哈嫩<WH02586>修造<WH02388><WTH8689>了另<WH08145>一段<WH04060>。接着<WH0310>是比利迦<WH01296>的兒子<WH01121>米書蘭<WH04918>對着<WAH05048>他自己的廂房<WH05393>而修造<WH02388><WTH8689>。
Neh/3.lcc_original: 接着是示利米雅的兒子哈拿尼雅和薩拉的第六兒子哈嫩修造了另一段。接着是比利迦的兒子米書蘭對着他自己的廂房而修造。
notes: UNV 其次 → LCC 接着: both mean 'next/afterward'; WH0310 transferred to 接着 in both clauses
UNV 又修 → LCC 修造了: 又 is an adverb in UNV with no SN; 了 is an aspect particle with no Hebrew equivalent — both left unannotated; WH02388+WTH8689 attach to 修造
UNV 一段<WH08145><WH04060> → LCC 另一段: WH08145 (שֵׁנִי, second/another) attaches to 另; WH04060 (מִדָּה, measure/section) attaches to 一段
UNV 自己的房屋<WH05393> → LCC 他自己的廂房: WH05393 (נִשְׁקָה, chamber/storeroom) attaches to 廂房; LCC adds 他 (his) which has no separate SN in UNV, left unannotated
UNV 子<WH01121> (second occurrence) → LCC 兒子 (LCC uses full 兒子 where UNV uses abbreviated 子); SN transferred to 兒子

Neh/3.lcc_original: 接着是銀匠中有一個人瑪基雅修造到當殿役的和旅行商人的房屋，對着哈米弗甲門、直到城角樓。
notes: H06885+H01121 (銀/匠 in UNV) both attached after 銀匠 in LCC; LCC expands 'son of the goldsmiths' (H1121, בֶּן) into '中有一個人' which is left unannotated as it is a paraphrase rather than a distinct lexeme
尼提寧 (H05411, Nethinim) is rendered interpretively as 當殿役的 in LCC rather than transliterated; SN attached after 的
LCC 城角 drops the 的 found in UNV 城的角; <WH06438> attached after 角 accordingly
LCC uses 、 (enumeration comma) before 直到 rather than UNV's ，; original LCC punctuation preserved exactly

Neh/3.lcc_sn: 在城角<WH06438>樓<WH05944>和羊<WH06629>門<WAH09001><WH08179>之間<WAH0996>的一段是銀匠們<WH06884><WTH8802>和旅行商人們<WH07402><WTH8802>修造<WH02388><WTH8689>的。
Neh/3.lcc_original: 在城角樓和羊門之間的一段是銀匠們和旅行商人們修造的。
notes: LCC restructures the sentence into a passive-like topic-comment construction (location phrase first, then subject+predicate), so SN tags follow LCC word order rather than UNV order.
城角 (two characters) is treated as the single equivalent of UNV 角 (H06438 = corner); 城 is structural and unannotated.
LCC 旅行商人們 expands UNV 商人 but maps to the same H07402 (רָכַל, traveling merchant).
中間 → 之間: synonymous, WAH0996 attaches to 之間 as the direct semantic equivalent.

LCC 在 (opening preposition) is unannotated — it is a Chinese structural particle required by the topic-comment construction, not a distinct Hebrew lexeme; the prepositional force is already captured by the prefix on WAH0996.
LCC-only phrase 的一段是…的 has no Hebrew equivalent and is left unannotated.

Neh/4.lcc_original: 【1】參巴拉聽說是我們在修造城墻，就發怒，大大惱恨，直嗤笑着猶大人。
notes: LCC 是 is an explicit word for implicit UNV {<WAH03588>} (כִּי = 'that'); braces dropped per Rule 3, tag attached as 是<WAH03588>
{<WAH01961>}{<WAH09003>}{<WAH0834>} (וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר = 'and it came to pass when') remain implicit — LCC omits this temporal frame and begins directly with 參巴拉
LCC 在 (Chinese progressive aspect marker before 修造) has no independent Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated; the participle aspect is already captured by <WTH8802> on 修造
LCC 直 (continuative adverb, 'kept/continued') has no direct Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated
LCC 嗤笑着 — SN tags attached after 嗤笑 and before aspect particle 着 (着 is a Chinese grammatical particle per Rule 5, unannotated): 嗤笑<WH03932><WTH8686>着
Missing SNs: 09001

Neh/4.lcc_sn: {<WH0559>}{<WTH8799>}他在他的族弟兄<WH0251>和撒瑪利亞<WH08111>的軍兵<WH02428>面前<WAH09001><WH06440>說<WH0559><WTH8799>：『嘿！這些衰弱憔悴<WH0537>的猶大人<WH03064>要作<WH06213><WTH8802>甚麼<WAH04100>？他們要奮不顧身<WH05800><WTH8799><WAH09001>麼？要宰獻祭牲<WH02076><WTH8799>動工麼？要在一天<WAH09002><WH03117>之內就作完<WH03615><WTH8762>麼？他們<WAH01992>要從塵土<WH06083>廢堆<WAH04480><WH06194>中拿火燒過<WH08313><WTH8803>的石頭<WH068>把<WAH0853>它重新建造起來<WH02421><WTH8762>【2】麼？』
Neh/4.lcc_original: 他在他的族弟兄和撒瑪利亞的軍兵面前說：『嘿！這些衰弱憔悴的猶大人要作甚麼？他們要奮不顧身麼？要宰獻祭牲動工麼？要在一天之內就作完麼？他們要從塵土廢堆中拿火燒過的石頭把它重新建造起來【2】麼？』
notes: First {<WH0559>}{<WTH8799>} kept implicit — LCC has no separate introductory 'he spoke' verb before 在; the second 說<WH0559><WTH8799> accounts for the one explicit 'said'.
對<WAH09001><WH06440> → 面前<WAH09001><WH06440> — LCC expresses לִפְנֵי (H6440 + ל prefix) via the 在…面前 frame; tag placed after 面前 as the head noun of the prepositional phrase.

保護<WH05800><WTH8799>自己<WAH09001> → 奮不顧身<WH05800><WTH8799><WAH09001> — LCC renders H5800 (עָזַב 'forsake/leave') + reflexive dative pronoun (WAH09001 = לָהֶם) as the 4-character idiom 奮不顧身; both SNs grouped at end of idiom since no separate reflexive word exists.
{<WAH01992>} → 他們<WAH01992> — LCC provides explicit pronoun at this clause; braces dropped per Rule 3.
{<WAH0853>} → 把<WAH0853> — LCC uses 把 as the direct-object marker equivalent of אֵת; braces dropped per Rule 3, tag placed after 把.
LCC's 嘿！(exclamatory interjection) and 動工 ('start work', appended to the sacrifice question) have no UNV SN counterparts and are left unannotated.

Neh/4.lcc_sn: 亞捫人<WH05984>多比雅<WH02900>在參巴拉旁邊<WH0681>，他也說<WH0559><WTH8799>：『哼！這些人<WAH01992>所<WAH0834>修造<WH01129><WTH8802>的、就使<WAH0518>一隻狐狸<WH07776>上去<WH05927><WTH8799>，也<WAH01571>會把這些石<WH068>墻<WH02346>跐個破口<WH06555><WTH8804>的！』
Neh/4.lcc_original: 亞捫人多比雅在參巴拉旁邊，他也說：『哼！這些人所修造的、就使一隻狐狸上去，也會把這些石墻跐個破口的！』
notes: H0681 (אֵצֶל, beside) attached to 旁邊; LCC expands UNV's 站在旁邊 to 在參巴拉旁邊, explicitly naming Sanballat — SN placed on 旁邊 which is the semantic core.
LCC's 他也說: 他 and the narrative 也 are Chinese additions with no Hebrew counterpart; only 說 receives H0559/WTH8799.
哼！ is a LCC interjection (rhetorical exclamation) with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated.
石墻 split into 石<WH068>墻<WH02346>: H068 (אֶבֶן, stone) and H02346 (חוֹמָה, wall) are distinct Hebrew words.

LCC restructures the consequence clause as 也會把這些石墻跐個破口的 vs UNV's 也必跐倒; 也<WAH01571> maps to גַּם, and 跐個破口<WH06555><WTH8804> maps to UNV's 跐倒 (פָּרַץ, H06555) — LCC's expanded phrasing 會把這些 is Chinese addition left unannotated.

Neh/4.lcc_original: 我們的上帝阿，求你垂聽我們怎樣地被藐視；求你使他們的毀謗回到他們自己的頭上，使他們在被擄之地作爲被掠之物。
Neh/4.unv_sn_reference: 我們的　神<WH0430>啊，求你垂聽<WH08085><WTH8798>，因為<WAH03588>我們被<WAH01961>藐視<WH0939>。求你使他們的毀謗<WH02781>歸<WH07725><WTH8685>於<WAH0413>他們的頭<WH07218>上，使他們<WH05414><WTH8798>在擄到<WH07633>之地<WAH09002><WH0776>作為掠物<WAH09001><WH0961>。

Neh/4.lcc_original: 修造的人都腰間佩刀來修造；吹號角的人在我旁邊。

Esth/1.lcc_original: 當亞哈隨魯的日子──這是那位從印度到古實統治一百二十七省的亞哈隨魯──
notes: H1961 (וַיְהִי, narrative-opening verb) remains implicit {WAH01961}: LCC's temporal idiom 當…的日子 restructures the clause without an explicit 'came to pass' verb, so no single Chinese word maps cleanly to it.
當 absorbs ב prefix (H9002); 日子 = H3117 (yom); first 亞哈隨魯 = H325 — all three were implicit in UNV but LCC makes them explicit, so braces removed per Rule 3.
LCC's 這 = H1931 (הוּא 'this/he'); 是 is a Chinese copula bridging the verbless Hebrew clause — no SN assigned to 是.
LCC's 統治 = sole rendering of H4427 (הַמֹּלֵךְ). UNV split this verb across 作王 (tagged H4427) and 統管 (no SN, a Chinese stylistic addition); LCC uses 統治 for the entire concept.
Second 亞哈隨魯 (H325) placed at the end of LCC's dash-bounded parenthetical, matching the second Hebrew אֲחַשְׁוֵרוֹשׁ in the source text.

Esth/1.lcc_original: 當那些日子、亞哈隨魯王在書珊宮堡登了國位；
notes: WAH09002+WH03117+WAH01992 (בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם, 'in those days') were all implicit in UNV but explicit in LCC (當那些日子); braces dropped per Rule 3. Following UNV convention that ב-prefix tags attach to the noun rather than to a separate Chinese preposition word: WAH01992→那些 (הָהֵם), and WAH09002+WH03117 both→日子 (יָּמִים), with 當 left unannotated as a Chinese temporal particle.
宮堡 (LCC compound 'palace-fortress') covers Hebrew הַבִּירָה (WH01002); LCC fuses location into a two-character compound where UNV uses two separate words (書珊城 … 宮).

WAH0834 (relative pronoun אֲשֶׁר, 'which') has no explicit LCC equivalent; LCC restructures 'throne of his kingdom, which was in Shushan the citadel' into a plain locative phrase (在書珊宮堡), so WAH0834 is kept implicit as {<WAH0834>} placed after 宮堡.

登 (explicit in LCC, 'ascend/mount') corresponds to implicit שֶׁבֶת (WH03427) + כְּ-prefix (WAH09003) + infinitive-construct morphology (WTH8800) in UNV; braces dropped per Rule 3 and all three tags attached to 登.
了 (Chinese perfective aspect particle) has no Hebrew equivalent and is left unannotated per Rule 5.
國位 covers three Hebrew elements conflated by LCC: עַל (WAH05921, 'upon'), כִּסֵּא (WH03678, 'throne'), and מַלְכוּת (WH04438, 'kingdom'); Rule 6 applied for the multi-SN phrase.

Esth/1.lcc_original: 他執政第三年、曾爲他的衆官長和臣僕擺設了筵席；有波斯和瑪代的權貴各省最顯達的人和官長、在他面前；
notes: 在位 → 執政: UNV uses a nominal phrase 'on the throne'; LCC uses verb 執政 'ruled/governed'; WAH09001+WH04427+WTH8800 attached to 執政 as the head of the temporal clause
米底亞 → 瑪代: Different transliterations of Media (מָדַי WH04074); same referent, straightforward
貴冑 → 最顯達的人: WH06579 (פַּרְתְּמִים, nobles/distinguished) rendered as descriptive phrase in LCC; tag attached to 人 as the head noun
WAH09001+WAH03605 (לְכֹל, for all) attached to 衆 which directly corresponds to כֹּל; the prepositional sense is absorbed into 爲 earlier in LCC
了 after 擺設 is a Chinese perfective aspect particle with no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated per rule 5
UNV 就是各省的貴冑與首領 restructured in LCC as 各省最顯達的人和官長 without the copular 就是; SNs distributed to corresponding lexemes unchanged

Esth/1.lcc_original: 他把他光榮之國的豐富和他宏大威儀之華貴給他們看了許多日子，共有一百八十天。
notes: 光榮 maps to H03519 (כְּבוֹד), directly corresponding to UNV 榮耀

LCC '宏大威儀之華貴' restructures UNV '美好威嚴的尊貴'; aligned H08597→宏大, H03366→威儀, H01420→華貴 following UNV word order rather than Hebrew order (יְקַר H03366 precedes תִּפְאֶרֶת H08597 in MT); alternative alignment H03366→宏大, H08597→威儀 is plausible
<WAH0853> (accusative אֶת) is implicit in both UNV and LCC since 把 already marks the object; kept in braces both occurrences
LCC 日子 and 天 both receive H03117 (יוֹם) corresponding to UNV 日 in each clause
LCC 共有 is a translator addition with no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated

Esth/1.lcc_original: 這些日子滿了，王又爲所有在書珊宮堡的衆民、無論尊大卑小、在王宮花園的院子擺設了筵席七天。
notes: UNV {<WH04428>} was implicit (subject 'king' omitted in Chinese); LCC has explicit 王 → dropped braces, attached as 王<WH04428>
LCC 在 maps to UNV 住<WH04672><WTH8737> (Hebrew מָצָא H4672 = found/present; both express location in Shushan)
LCC 宮堡 maps to UNV 城<WH01002> (both = H1002 בִּירָה = palace-fortress/citadel)
UNV {<WH01055>} was implicit (H1055 = בִּיתָן = garden-pavilion); LCC has explicit 宮 in 王宮 → dropped braces, attached as 宮<WH01055>
LCC 尊大/卑小 for UNV 大/小 (H1419/H6996); {<WAH05704>} (H5704 = עַד 'unto') remains implicit between them — LCC encodes the range via 無論...卑小 construction with no single explicit word for 'unto'
LCC word order shifts 衆民 before the 尊大卑小 qualifier (vs UNV 大小人民 order); SNs follow LCC surface order
LCC 天 for UNV 日 at verse end — both = H3117 יוֹם (day)

Esth/1.lcc_original: 有白色綿織的幔子、藍紫色的帷子、用細麻繩子紫紅色繩子、在銀竿【1】上、和白玉石柱上繫起來；有金銀的牀榻擺在斑岩白玉石螺鈿黑玉石的鋪石處。
notes: UNV has three distinct color-fabric terms: 白色(WH02353)、綠色(WH03768)、藍色(WH08504). LCC restructures into two compound descriptions: 白色綿織 merges חוּר (white, WH02353) and כַּרְפַּס (cotton cloth, WH03768) — כַּרְפַּס means fine cloth not 'green', so LCC's 綿織 (woven cotton) is the better semantic target; 藍紫色 receives WH08504 (תְּכֵלֶת = blue-violet).

UNV 環(WH01550=גָּלִיל) → LCC 竿 (rod/pole). גָּלִיל means cylindrical bar or rod, making LCC's 竿 actually a more precise rendering than UNV's 環 (ring); SN transferred to 竿【1】 with footnote marker left in place.

WH08336 (שֵׁשׁ = white marble) in UNV tags the generic noun 玉石 at the end of the stone-type list. In LCC there is no separate generic 'stone' word; שֵׁשׁ is semantically closest to LCC's 白玉石 (white marble). Accordingly WH08336 is co-attached with WH01858 (דַּר) on 白玉石, since both Hebrew terms denote white/lustrous stone and LCC conflates them into one compound.
UNV tags both 白玉石 and 柱 with the same SN WH05982 (עַמּוּד = pillar) in the first clause — likely a FHL encoding of a Hebrew construct chain. Transferred as-is to LCC 白玉石柱.
LCC 繫起來 adds the resultative complement 起來; WH0270 (אָחַז = to fasten) and morphology code WTH8803 (passive participle) are attached to the full verb phrase 繫起來.
UNV 從(WAH05921) expresses the preposition עַל governing the silver rings; LCC rephrases as 在…上. WAH05921 attached to LCC's 在 as the functional equivalent preposition.
LCC 螺鈿 (mother-of-pearl/shell inlay) corresponds to UNV 黃 which carries no SN tag; left unannotated.

Esth/1.lcc_original: 賜飲是用金器皿；器皿和器皿也各不同；御酒很多，按照王的大手面而賜飲。
notes: LCC inverts word order: opens with 賜飲 (verb) before the instrumental phrase; WH08248+WTH8687 attached to the fronted 賜飲, matching Hebrew שָׁקָה. Final 而賜飲 is LCC stylistic resumption with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated.

LCC renders Hebrew כֵּלִים מִכֵּלִים ('vessel from vessel') as 器皿和器皿; mapped as 器皿<WH03627>和器皿<WAH04480><WH03627> following the UNV token split where WAH04480 (מִן prefix) + WH03627 attach to the second occurrence.

LCC 按照王的大手面 is an expansive paraphrase of UNV 足顯王的厚意 (= כְּיַד הַמֶּלֶךְ 'according to the hand of the king'); WAH09003 (כְּ prefix) and WH03027 (יָד hand) kept together on 大手面 per UNV prefix-attachment convention; 按照 (rendering the כְּ preposition meaning) left without a separate tag since it is subsumed by WAH09003.
UNV 足顯 has no SN (translational gloss); LCC 按照 similarly unannotated. LCC 很多 = UNV 甚多 = WH07227 (רַב); straightforward.

Esth/1.lcc_original: 喝酒都照定例，沒有勉強人的；因爲王對他宮中的一切臣宰曾立下規矩：人人都要隨己意而行。
notes: UNV {<WAH05921>} was implicit (no explicit Chinese rendering); LCC has 對 explicitly, so braces dropped per Rule 3 — 對<WAH05921> attaches the על preposition to the explicit word.

UNV 吩咐 (commanded) maps to LCC 曾立下規矩 (had established rules); H3245 (יָסַד = to found/establish) supports LCC's rendering; SNs attach after the verb 立下, with 規矩 as the implied object of the founding action.
Two occurrences of WH0376 (אִישׁ וָאִישׁ = each man) map together onto LCC's reduplicated 人人; both SN tags attach to that single word.
WAH09001 (ל infinitive prefix) attaches to 而行 as the infinitive/purpose marker; 而 corresponds to this prefix and 行 = WH06213+WTH8800.
LCC 都 (adverbial 'all/also') in both 都照定例 and 都要 has no direct Hebrew equivalent and is left unannotated per Rule 5.
LCC 照 is treated as the lexical rendering of prefix WAH09003 (כְּ = according to); since WAH09003 is a prefix particle bound to WH01881, both tags are grouped after 定例 as the head noun.

Esth/1.lcc_original: 王后瓦實提也在亞哈隨魯王御殿中爲婦女們擺設了筵席。

LCC reverses UNV's 設擺 to 擺設 and appends aspect particle 了 (no Hebrew equivalent); H6213 and TH8804 attach to 擺設, 了 left unannotated

Esth/1.lcc_original: 第七天亞哈隨魯王因酒而心裏高興，就吩咐伺候他面前的七個太監、米戶幔、比斯他、哈波拿、比革他、亞拔他、西達、甲迦，
notes: 天 (LCC) replaces 日 (UNV) for 'day'; WAH09002+WH03117 attached to 天.

Esth/1.lcc_original: 領王后瓦實提戴着王后的冠冕到王面前，使各族之民和大臣看她的美麗；因爲她容貌俊美。

H853 (object marker אֶת) from UNV's 請 consolidated onto 領: UNV's 請 has no counterpart in LCC, and 領 immediately precedes the direct object 王后瓦實提, the same role 請 played.

LCC's 俊美 annotated with H2896 as the equivalent of UNV's 甚美 (both render טוֹבַת).

Esth/1.lcc_original: 王后瓦實提卻不肯遵王由太監經手所傳的命令而來；因此王非常生氣，烈怒中燒。

{<WH02534>} is implicit in UNV (心 carries the locative WAH09002 only), but LCC has explicit 烈怒 for חֵמָה — dropped braces and attached as 烈怒<WH02534> per rule 3
UNV 心<WAH09002> (locative 'in his heart', בֹו) → LCC 中<WAH09002> (within/in); same locative preposition on a different Chinese word
LCC 由 (Chinese through/by preposition introducing the agent) left unannotated; its semantic role is distributed across surrounding tagged words (太監, 經手)
LCC 傳的 (conveyed) left unannotated; the Hebrew 'by the hand' (בְּיַד) is already tagged on 經手<WAH09002><WH03027>

Esth/1.lcc_original: 那時跟王接近的有甲示拿、示達、押瑪他、他施斯、米力、瑪西拿、米母干、波斯瑪代的七個大臣，都是常見王面、在國中坐首位的人──王問他們說：

Esth/3.lcc_original: 哈曼對亞哈隨魯王說：『有一族之民散居在王國內各省各族之民間，而又自己隔開：他們的法例跟各族的法例不同；王的法例他們也不遵行；所以由着他們、對於王最不妥當。
notes: 散居/隔開 split: UNV annotates 散(H6340)居(H6504) as two consecutive characters each with their own SN. LCC uses 散居 as a compound for general scattered-dwelling, then 隔開 as a separate clause. H6340 (פזר=scatter) is attached to 散居, H6504 (פרד=separate) to 隔開 — semantically more accurate in LCC.
LCC adds 各族 twice: first in 各省各族之民間 (second 各族 renders the peoples H5971 = בין העמים), second in 各族的法例 (renders כל-עם H4480+H3605+H5971). Both 各族 instances receive their respective SNs.

WAH09001 on 王 in the opening address: the ל prefix (to/for the king) is conveyed by LCC's 對...王 structure; SNs kept on 王 following UNV attachment convention.

Esth/3.lcc_original: 王若以爲好，就請寫下勅令殺滅他們；我就秤出一萬擔【3】銀子，由管事人經手、運入王的府庫。』
notes: 以為美(UNV)→以爲好(LCC): both render H2895 טוֹב; lexical variant only
H3789(כָּתַב, write) attached to 寫下; LCC adds 勅令(edict) as explicit object with no Hebrew counterpart in this verse—left unannotated
H3603(כִּכָּר, talent) attached to 擔; LCC substitutes Chinese weight unit 擔 for the transliteration 他連得; footnote marker【3】preserved immediately after the SN tag

Word-order reversal in steward phrase: UNV orders 交給(hand/H3027)→掌管(manage/H6213)→國帑(work/H4399); LCC compresses to 管事人(H6213+TH8802+H4399)→經手(WAH05921+H3027); SNs redistributed to the semantically matching words
{<WAH05921>}(עַל, upon) kept implicit before 王—LCC 王若以爲好 has no explicit word for this preposition, mirroring UNV's treatment

Esth/3.lcc_original: 於是王脫下了手上的打印戒指，給猶大人的敵人、亞甲族哈米大他的兒子哈曼。
notes: UNV 摘下→LCC 脫下: both render H5493 (סוּר, Hiphil 'remove/take off'); morphology code WTH8686 attached to 脫下.

UNV 從<WAH04480><WAH05921>自己手上<WH03027>: LCC omits the explicit preposition word 從, so the מִן+עַל prefixes (WAH04480, WAH05921) are bundled with 手上 since that is the only lexical anchor for the full phrase 'from upon his hand'.
LCC elaborates UNV 戒指 as 打印戒指 (signet ring); WH02885 (חֹתָם) attached after the full phrase 打印戒指 since 打印 is an explicating modifier with no independent Hebrew word.
{<WAH0853>} (direct object marker אֵת) remains implicit — LCC has no explicit equivalent; placed before 打印戒指 following UNV positional convention.
UNV 仇敵→LCC 敵人: near-synonym pair, both map to H6887 (צָרַר Qal ptcp 'adversary/enemy'); no confidence loss.
了 (Chinese perfective aspect particle) left unannotated per rule 5.

Esth/3.lcc_original: 對哈曼說：『這銀子仍賜給你，這人民也交給你，你看怎樣好，就怎麼待他們好啦。』
notes: LCC omits subject 王 (H04428); inserted as implicit {<WH04428>} before 對 since there is no explicit word to attach it to
LCC 人民 vs UNV 民 for H05971 (עָם 'people'); SN attached to full 人民 compound

LCC 你看怎樣好 paraphrases Hebrew בְּעֵינֶיךָ כַּטּוֹב ('as good in your eyes'); 看 receives H09002+H05869 (in/eyes), 好 receives H09003+H02896 (as/good); word order is reversed from Hebrew but semantic alignment is clear
LCC adds 好啦 as a Chinese aspect/emphasis particle with no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated

Esth/3.lcc_original: 詔書由跑文書的人經手送到王的各省，說要在一日之間、在十二月、就是亞達月【2】、十三日，將所有的猶大人、無論老少幼小或婦女、全都消滅屠殺滅盡，並且奪取他們的資財作爲掠物。

所有的 (all) is explicit in LCC but was implicit {WAH03605} in UNV — braces dropped per Rule 3
LCC restructures word order: the date clause (在一日之間…十三日) precedes the object (將所有的猶大人), whereas UNV places the object first then the date; SNs follow LCC's arrangement
LCC 跑文書的人 (running messengers) maps to UNV 驛卒 <WH07323><WTH8801>; 經手 (through hands) maps to 交給 <WAH09002><WH03027>; 送到 maps to 傳到 <WH07971><WTH8736><WAH0413>
全都 is a Chinese intensifier in LCC with no distinct Hebrew counterpart — left unannotated
LCC 幼小 maps to WH02945 (טַף = little children), and 少 maps to WH05288 (נַּעַר = youth), matching the Hebrew age-range idiom מִנַּעַר וְעַד-זָקֵן
The three destruction verbs (消滅/屠殺/滅盡) map in order to UNV's 全然剪除/殺戮/滅絕 (WH08045, WH02026, WH06) with their respective waw-conjunctive prefixes and morphology codes

LCC 上帝 (WH0430) vs UNV 神: LCC consistently uses 上帝 for אֱלֹהִים; same SN attached to 上帝.
LCC 壞事 (WH07451+WAH04480) vs UNV 惡事: both render מֵרָע; prefix WAH04480 (מֵ, from) and root WH07451 (evil) attached to 壞事 as one phrase.

{<WAH01961>} retained as implicit: the second הָיָה (and was) in the Hebrew second clause is absent in LCC; LCC's 又...又...又 structure uses connective particles rather than an explicit copulative verb.
WTH8802 (Qal participle morphology) kept attached immediately after 遠離 together with WH05493, matching UNV attachment order.

Job/1.lcc_original: 他生了七個兒子、三個女兒。
notes: Direct word-for-word alignment; only surface difference is LCC uses enumeration comma 、 where UNV uses ，. All six SN tags placed at identical lexical positions.

Job/1.lcc_original: 他的牲畜有羊七千隻、駱駝三千隻，牛五百對、母驢五百匹；他還有很多僕婢；這人在東方人之中至爲昌大。

LCC 牲畜 (livestock) is a more literal rendering of WH04735 מִקְנֶה than UNV 家產 (property); SN attaches to 牲畜.
LCC phrase 他還有 (he also had) parallels UNV 並有 — both are Chinese connective additions with no direct Hebrew counterpart, left unannotated.
Measure words 隻 and 匹 are Chinese classifiers with no Hebrew equivalent and are left unannotated.
{<WAH04480>}{<WAH03605>} remain implicit: LCC 在東方人之中 uses 之中 to express the comparative/locative without explicit words for מִן (from) or כָּל (all).

LCC 至爲<WAH01961>昌大<WH01419>: 至爲 carries WAH01961 (וַיְהִי = was/became) as the predicate linker; 昌大 (prosperous-great) carries WH01419 (גָּדוֹל = great). LCC expands 至大 to 昌大 but the SN correspondence is clear.

Job/1.lcc_original: 他的兒子們往往在自己的日子到各人的家，擺設筵席；又打發人去請他們的三個姐妹來、和他們一同喫喝。
notes: LCC restructures UNV's '按著日子各在自己家裡' → '往往在自己的日子到各人的家'; 往往 is LCC's habitual-aspect addition with no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated.
{<WH01980>}{<WTH8804>} is implicit in UNV (no overt Chinese character for the walking/going); LCC renders it explicitly as 到, so braces are dropped per Rule 3.
擺設 receives WH06213+WTH8804 (verb: made/held) immediately after it; 筵席 receives WH04960 (noun: feast) immediately after it — split placement within the same compound phrase.
Reordering of 日子/各人/家 between UNV and LCC introduces mild placement uncertainty; tags are anchored to their closest semantic equivalent in LCC word order.

Job/1.lcc_original: 宴飲的日子輪完了，約伯總打發人去叫他們來【1】，使他們潔淨自己爲聖；他往往在早晨時候清早起來，按着他們幾人的數目獻上燔祭；因爲約伯說：『萬一我兒子犯了罪，心裏謗讟【2】上帝呢。』每逢這個日子、約伯總是這樣行的。
notes: H1961+H3588 (וַיְהִי כִּי, 'and it came to pass when') retained as implicit {}: LCC expresses the temporal clause structurally without explicit equivalents for either Hebrew word.
UNV 他<WH0347> (pronoun for Job) realized as explicit 約伯<WH0347> in LCC's 因爲約伯說 clause — same H347 referent, different realization.
H3605 (כֹּל, 'all') in UNV's 眾人 maps to LCC's 幾人 — LCC renders as 'how many people' rather than 'all people'; the Hebrew referent is the same.
LCC 謗讟 is a more literal rendering of H1288 (בָּרַךְ as euphemism for 'curse/blaspheme') than UNV's 棄掉 ('cast away'); SN placed after 謗讟 before footnote marker 【2】.

H6942<WTH8762> (to purify/consecrate) attached to end of LCC's expanded phrase 使他們潔淨自己爲聖, which covers UNV's single word 自潔.
H3605+H3117 (כָּל יָמֵי, 'every day / continually') distributed across LCC's 每...日子 structure: 每<WAH03605> and 日子<WH03117>.
LCC additions 往往, 時候 (in the morning clause) have no Hebrew equivalents and are left unannotated.

Job/1.lcc_original: 這一天、神子們都來侍立在永恆主左右；撒但【3】也來在他們中間。
notes: H1961 (WAH01961) anchored to 這: LCC renders UNV 有一天 as 這一天 with no explicit 'came to pass' verb; 這 is the closest lexical anchor though it does not directly mean 'to be'
H3068 assigned to 永恆主, LCC's characteristic rendering of יהוה; 左右 ('left and right' = 'in the presence of') is LCC's interpretive expansion of the prepositional phrase and is left unannotated
Footnote marker 【3】 placed immediately after 撒但<WH07854>
都 left unannotated — LCC-added collective adverb with no direct Hebrew equivalent in this clause

Job/1.lcc_original: 永恆主問撒但說：『你從哪裏來？』撒但回答永恆主說：『我是漫遊地上、在那上面走來走去、回來的。』
notes: LCC's 永恆主 renders YHWH (H3068); its second occurrence (implicit {<WH03068>} in UNV, where UNV text omitted it) is explicit in LCC, so braces dropped per rule 3.
{<WAH0853>} (accusative particle אֵת) remains implicit — LCC has no explicit word for the accusative marker, though 永恆主 immediately follows as its object.

Hebrew has two motion verbs (שׁוּט H7751 = roam; הִתְהַלֵּךְ H1980 = walk about) but LCC renders three clauses: 漫遊 (→H7751), 走來走去 (→H1980), and 回來 (unannotated — a LCC narrative framing addition with no direct Hebrew anchor in this verse).

LCC's 在那上面 explicitly renders the implicit בָּהּ ({<WAH09002>} in UNV), so braces dropped per rule 3. Note LCC places 在那上面 before 走來走去, reversing the Hebrew word order (הִתְהַלֵּךְ בָּהּ), but tags follow LCC text order as required.

WAH04480 (מִן 'from') prefix on both motion verbs attaches to 漫遊 and 走來走去 respectively, as those are the verbal anchors; LCC absorbs the directional sense into the verbs rather than using an explicit 從.

Job/1.lcc_original: 永恆主問撒但說：『你有沒有用心察看過我僕人約伯，看出地上沒有人能比得上他那樣純全，又正直又敬畏上帝，又遠離壞事呢？』
notes: 永恆主 (LCC) ≡ 耶和華 (UNV) for <WH03068> (YHWH) — standard LCC term for the divine name
上帝 (LCC) ≡ 　神 (UNV) for <WH0430> (Elohim) — systematic LCC/UNV terminological difference
純全 (LCC) ≡ 完全 (UNV) for <WH08535> (תָּמִים, blameless/complete) — synonymous renderings
壞事 (LCC) ≡ 惡事 (UNV) for <WH07451> (רָע, evil/bad things) — synonymous renderings
{<WAH03588>} kept implicit: LCC uses bridging verb 看出 (discover/see that) rather than an explicit conjunction for כִּי, so the marker stays in braces since no single LCC word directly translates it
能比得上他那樣 represents כָּמֹהוּ <WAH03644> (like him); SN placed after 那樣 at the end of the full comparative phrase

LCC grammatical additions left unannotated: 有沒有 (A-not-A interrogative structure), 過 (perfective aspect particle on 察看), 看出 (LCC-added bridging verb for the object clause), 能 (modal), 呢 (final question particle)

Ps/1.lcc_original:
詩篇 第一卷

不依惡人的計謀而行，不站在罪人的道路，不坐在褻慢人的座位，這人有福阿！
notes: LCC restructures clause order: the three 不-clauses come first, with 這人有福阿！(= אַשְׁרֵי הָאִישׁ, 'blessed is the man') moved to end. No SN data was supplied for that portion, so it is left unannotated.

UNV 從<WH01980><WTH8804> collapses preposition + verb into one word. LCC splits into 依…而行: 依 carries the prepositional nuance ('in/according to') and is left unannotated because the ב prefix is already captured by WAH09002 on 計謀; WH01980+WTH8804 (הָלַךְ, walk) are assigned to 而行 where 行 is the explicit walk-verb.

LCC adds the locative particle 在 after 站 and 坐 (yielding 站在, 坐在). These are tagged as a unit with the verb's SN tags immediately after, consistent with treating the verb+particle as one semantic unit.
{<WAH0834>} (אֲשֶׁר, relative pronoun) kept implicit — LCC has no explicit relative pronoun; the subordinate-clause relationship is expressed through sentence structure alone.

Ps/1.lcc_original: 他所喜愛的、是永恆主的律法，他晝夜所思想的、也是主的律法。
notes: H03588 (כִּי) and H0518 (אִם) both remain implicit — LCC has no explicit particles for כִּי אִם; placed at verse start as {<WAH03588>}{<WAH0518>}

H0376 (man/אִישׁ) and H0835 (blessed/אַשְׁרֵי) from UNV v2 are not transferred — these SNs originate in Hebrew v1 but UNV restructured them into v2; LCC v2 has no equivalent words, so they are omitted here
LCC 永恆主 (Eternal Lord) maps to יְהוָה (H03068); Lü's distinctive rendering of the divine name
Second implicit {<WAH09002>}{<WH08451>} (UNV's elided law-clause) is made explicit in LCC as 主的律法 — braces dropped per rule 3 and both tags attached after 律法
LCC's two 他 pronouns (subject of each clause) have no explicit SN counterpart within verse 2's UNV data and are left unannotated
Missing SNs: 0376, 0835

Ps/1.lcc_original: 他好像一棵樹、移植於流水溝旁，按節候結果子，其葉子總不凋殘；凡他所作的、盡都順利。
notes: 好像 covers both WAH01961 (H1961 הָיָה, 'shall be') and WAH09003 (ב prefix, 'like/as') since LCC fuses the copula into 好像 rather than expressing 要 + 像 separately as UNV does.
LCC 移植 ('transplant') aligns to UNV 栽在 = H8362 (שׁתל, to transplant/plant); the passive morphology WTH8803 attaches to it.

流水溝 is treated as a single phrase covering both H6388 (פֶּלֶג, canal/stream) and H4325 (מַיִם, water); the preposition 於 is a Chinese structural addition with no direct Hebrew equivalent and is left unannotated; WAH05921 (עַל, by/upon) attaches to 旁 as in UNV.
{<WAH0834>} (אֲשֶׁר, H834) remains implicit — LCC also omits an explicit relative pronoun before 按節候.
LCC 其 (possessive 'its') makes the Hebrew suffix הוּ on עָלֵהוּ explicit, but since the suffix is subsumed under H5929 in UNV annotation, 其 is left unannotated and H5929 attaches to 葉子.

Ps/1.lcc_original: 惡人卻不是這樣：惡人乃像糠粃、給風吹散而飄蕩。
