UNV 所<WAH01931><WAH08033> (הוּא + שָׁם) is split in LCC: 它 explicitly renders the pronoun הוּא → <WAH01931>; 所 renders the locative-relative function of שָׁם 'there' → <WAH08033>.
LCC adds 由 in 由出 ('come out by way of') not present in UNV's bare 出; H2224 attached to 由出 as the whole verb unit since LCC uses it to render זָרַח.
H4725 (מָקֹמוֹ 'its place') maps cleanly to 之地 in both versions.

Eccl/1.lcc_original: 風往南颳，又向北轉；不住地旋轉，又循其旋轉道返回原處。
notes: First three clauses (風往南颳 / 又向北轉 / 不住地旋轉) are parallel 1:1 with UNV, straightforward alignment.
LCC uses ；(semicolon) instead of ，after 北轉; punctuation preserved as-is.
LCC's 循其旋轉道 merges UNV's 轉行<WAH05921>原道<WH05439>: 循 (along/upon) receives <WAH05921> (H5921 עַל), and 其旋轉道 (its revolving circuit) receives <WH05439> (H5439 סְבִיבֹת).
LCC's final clause follows Hebrew word order more closely (upon-circuits → returns) versus UNV's reversed order (returns → upon-circuits); tags placed accordingly.
LCC's 原處 ('original place') is an interpretive expansion with no direct Hebrew correspondent and is left unannotated.

Both {<WH07307>} remain implicit — LCC does not repeat 風 explicitly. First {<WH07307>} placed after 又 (before 循) matching the Hebrew position of הָרוּחַ between הוֹלֵךְ and וְעַל; second {<WH07307>} placed at verse end, matching the final הָרוּחַ after שָׁב.

Eccl/1.lcc_original: 谿河都往海裏流，海卻沒有滿溢；谿河流到哪一個地方，還再流到那裏。
notes: LCC 沒有 covers UNV 不 (WAH0369/H369 negation); 卻 left unannotated as aspect particle with no Hebrew equivalent
LCC 谿河流到哪一個地方 inverts UNV word order (從何處流 → 流到哪一個地方); WAH0413 assigned to 到 as the preposition, WH01980+WTH8802 assigned to preceding 流

LCC 還再流到那裏 condenses UNV 仍歸還何處 — implicit {WAH01992} (הֵם, they) preserved after 還再 since LCC has no explicit pronoun; WH07725+WTH8802 (שׁוּב, return) and WAH09001+WH03212+WTH8800 (ו+הָלַךְ, and go, infinitive absolute) all consolidated on 流到 as the unified return/go verb phrase
LCC 滿溢 expands UNV 滿 with an additional character (溢, overflow); WH04392 attached to 滿溢 as one unit

Eccl/1.lcc_original: 萬物都【1】都疲勞困乏；人也不能說得盡；眼看，看不飽，耳聽、聽不足。
notes: UNV 萬事 → LCC 萬物: WAH03605 (כֹּל = all) attaches to 萬, WH01697 (דָּבָר = thing/matter) attaches to 物; the semantic split across the compound is preserved
WH03023 (יָגֵעַ = weary/laborious) comes from the UNV parenthetical alternate translation 困乏; applied to 困乏 in LCC since LCC chose 疲勞困乏 as its primary rendering of this word
LCC 也 is a Chinese emphatic/additive particle with no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated
LCC 得 in 說得盡 is a Chinese resultative complement particle; left unannotated
LCC text has a doubled 都 (萬物都【1】都疲勞困乏); preserved exactly as provided, treating 【1】 as a footnote marker

Eccl/1.lcc_original: 必有的事、是曾經有的；必行的事、是曾經行過的：日光之下並無新事。
notes: LCC inverts subject/predicate relative to UNV and the Hebrew: Hebrew/UNV has 'what was [is] what will be' (מַה שֶׁהָיָה הוּא שֶׁיִּהְיֶה); LCC renders it 'what must be is what has already been', so H7945+H1961 (שֶׁיִּהְיֶה) attach to the subject phrase 必有的事/必行的事 rather than the predicate.
H1931 (הוּא copula pronoun 'it/that') attaches to 是 rather than being bundled with the verbal phrase as in UNV's 後必再有.

Morphology tags swap accordingly: WTH8735 (Niphal imperfect = future) goes with 必行的事 (the future verb phrase) and WTH8738 (Niphal perfect = past) goes with 曾經行過的 (the past verb phrase), reversed from their UNV positions.
Final clause 日光之下並無新事 is structurally identical to UNV; alignment is unambiguous.

Eccl/1.lcc_original: 哪裏有一件事人能指着說：『看哪，這是新的』？哪知在我們以前的世代早已有了。
notes: Rule 3 applied to 看哪: UNV has implicit {<WH07200>}{<WTH8798>} (rāʾâ = look/see), but LCC has explicit 看哪 — braces dropped and SNs attached directly after 看哪
哪裏有 (LCC) vs 豈有 (UNV) both map cleanly to H3426 (yēš = there is); tag placed after 有 in both cases
{<WAH0834>}{<WAH01961>} remain implicit after 在 in LCC just as in UNV — LCC likewise has no explicit lexical word for H834 (ʾăšer = which/that) or H1961 (hāyâ = to be) in this clause

Song/1.lcc_original: 萬歌之歌、卽是所羅門之歌。
notes: 萬歌之歌 maps to שִׁיר הַשִּׁירִים (H7892+H7892) in reversed order: 萬歌 (all songs) ← הַשִּׁירִים, final 歌 ← שִׁיר — LCC restructures the superlative genitive construct
卽是 renders אֲשֶׁר (H834) as a whole phrase; tag placed after 是 covering the full 卽是 unit
所羅門之歌: 所羅門 carries H09001+H8010 (לִשְׁלֹמֹה); final 之歌 has no Hebrew counterpart (LCC expansion for natural Chinese phrasing) — left unannotated per Rule 5

Song/1.lcc_original: 哦，願他用他的親嘴使我陶醉哦！因爲你的愛情比酒更好，
notes: LCC restructures the first clause from 'let him kiss me with kisses of his mouth' (Hebrew/UNV) into '願他用他的親嘴使我陶醉'. All five SNs from that clause (WH06310 mouth, WAH04480 מִן-prefix, WH05390 kisses, WH05401 kiss-verb, WTH8799 morphology) are consolidated onto 親嘴, which bridges both the nominal 'kisses of his mouth' and the verbal 'to kiss' concepts in a single pivot word.
UNV marks {<WAH04480>}{<WH05390>} as implicit; LCC 親嘴 explicitly renders 'kisses', so braces are dropped per Rule 3 and tags attached normally.
使我陶醉 ('make me intoxicated') is LCC's interpretive paraphrase of the kissing action with no direct Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated.
哦 exclamation particles are LCC additions with no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated.
Second clause maps cleanly and directly: 因爲→WAH03588 (כִּי), 愛情→WH01730 (דֹּד), 酒→WAH04480+WH03196 (מִ+יַיִן), 更好→WH02896 (טוֹב).

Song/1.lcc_original: 你的香膏之馨香很美好；你的名如同倒出來的香膏；因此童女們都愛你。
notes: LCC '香膏' corresponds to UNV '膏油' (both = H8081, ointment/oil) — different Chinese terms for the same Hebrew שֶׁמֶן

UNV treats 馨(H2896) and 香(H7381) as two separate annotated characters; LCC uses compound 馨香 for fragrance (→ H7381+WAH09001) while 美好 captures H2896 (טוֹב, good/pleasant); 很 has no Hebrew equivalent and is left unannotated
UNV '所以' → LCC '因此' (both = therefore); WAH05921+WAH03651 (עַל כֵּן) applied to 因此
UNV '眾童女' → LCC '童女們' (H5959, עֲלָמוֹת); plural marker 們 is a Chinese grammatical particle with no separate SN

Song/1.lcc_sn: 願你拉我<WH04900><WTH8798>跟着你<WH0310>哦；我們快跑<WH07323><WTH8799>吧！王<WH04428>帶我進了<WH0935><WTH8689>他的洞房<WH02315>。王阿，我們要因你<WAH09002>而快樂<WH08055><WTH8799>歡喜<WH01523><WTH8799>；我們要頌揚<WH02142><WTH8686>你的愛情<WH01730>，勝過頌揚美酒<WAH04480><WH03196>；稱讚你的愛<WH0157><WTH8804>勝過稱讚新酒<WH04339>。
Song/1.lcc_original: 願你拉我跟着你哦；我們快跑吧！王帶我進了他的洞房。王阿，我們要因你而快樂歡喜；我們要頌揚你的愛情，勝過頌揚美酒；稱讚你的愛勝過稱讚新酒。
Song/1.unv_sn_reference: 願你吸引我<WH04900><WTH8798>，我們就快跑<WH07323><WTH8799>跟隨你<WH0310>。王<WH04428>帶我進了<WH0935><WTH8689>內室<WH02315>，我們必因你<WAH09002>歡喜<WH01523><WTH8799>快樂<WH08055><WTH8799>。我們要稱讚<WH02142><WTH8686>你的愛情<WH01730>，勝似稱讚美酒<WAH04480><WH03196>。他們愛你<WH0157><WTH8804>是理所當然的<WH04339>。
notes: LCC follows Hebrew word order for the opening clause (拉我跟着你快跑), unlike UNV which reorders to 吸引我快跑跟隨你; WH04900 attached to 拉我 (verb+object unit = מָשְׁכֵנִי), WH0310 to 跟着你 (= אַחֲרֶיךָ), WH07323 to 快跑 (= נָּרוּצָה).
LCC reverses rejoicing word order vs UNV: 快樂歡喜 vs UNV 歡喜快樂. Matched to Hebrew roots individually: 快樂 (be glad) = שָׂמַח → WH08055, 歡喜 (rejoice) = גִּיל → WH01523.
Second 王阿 in LCC's rejoicing clause is LCC's vocative addition with no Hebrew parallel; left unannotated.

Final clause is a major restructuring: Hebrew מֵישָׁרִים אֲהֵבוּךָ ('uprightly they love you', WH04339+WH0157) is rendered by LCC as a second wine-comparison clause 稱讚你的愛勝過稱讚新酒 rather than as a direct statement. WH0157+WTH8804 attached to 愛 (the lexical anchor for אהב); WH04339 (מֵישָׁרִים = uprightness/rightly) attached to 新酒 as the closest end-anchor — this is forced since 新酒 has no Hebrew parallel (יַּיִן = wine generically; 新酒 is LCC's literary elaboration).

Song/1.lcc_sn: 耶路撒冷<WH03389>的女子<WH01323>阿，我<WAH0589>雖黝黑<WH07838>，卻很秀美<WH05000>，如同基達<WH06938>的帳棚<WAH09003><WH0168>，如同所羅門<WH08010>的幔子<WAH09003><WH03407>。
Song/1.lcc_original: 耶路撒冷的女子阿，我雖黝黑，卻很秀美，如同基達的帳棚，如同所羅門的幔子。
Song/1.unv_sn_reference: 耶路撒冷<WH03389>的眾女子啊<WH01323>，我<WAH0589>雖然黑<WH07838>，卻是秀美<WH05000>，如同基達<WH06938>的帳棚<WAH09003><WH0168>，好像所羅門<WH08010>的幔子<WAH09003><WH03407>。
notes: WH01323 (בָּנוֹת 'daughters') attaches to content word 女子; the exclamatory particle 阿 is left trailing after the tag rather than before it
UNV 雖然黑 → LCC 雖黝黑; WH07838 placed after 黝黑 which is LCC's fuller rendering of the darkness root
UNV uses 好像 for the second simile; LCC normalizes both to 如同 — alignment is still unambiguous
WAH09003 (כ prefix) is preserved with its head noun (帳棚, 幔子) even though 如同 in LCC already conveys the comparative sense

Song/1.lcc_sn: 你們不要<WAH0408>因我<WAH0589>黝黑<WH07840>，因日頭<WH08121>把我曬黑<WH07805><WTH8804>了、你們就盯着我<WH07200><WTH8799>。我的同母<WH0517>弟兄<WH01121>向我<WAH09002>發怒<WH02787><WTH8738>；他們叫<WH07760><WTH8804>我顧守着<WH05201><WTH8802>{<WAH0853>}葡萄園<WH03754>，我自己的<WAH07945><WAH09001>葡萄園<WH03754>我卻沒有<WAH03808>顧守着<WH05201><WTH8804>呢！
Song/1.lcc_original: 你們不要因我黝黑，因日頭把我曬黑了、你們就盯着我。我的同母弟兄向我發怒；他們叫我顧守着葡萄園，我自己的葡萄園我卻沒有顧守着呢！
notes: WAH0589 (אֲנִי) placement differs from UNV: UNV attaches it to 把我 in the scorching clause, but LCC restructures the verse into two explicit 'because' clauses (因我黝黑 / 因日頭把我曬黑了). WAH0589 is placed on 我 in 因我黝黑, which better matches the Hebrew שֶׁאֲנִי שְׁחַרְחֹרֶת (that I am swarthy).

WH07840 (שְׁחַרְחֹרֶת = swarthy/dark) maps to LCC 黝黑 in the first clause rather than the 黑 in 曬黑了, because LCC expresses the state of being dark (黝黑) and the causative action of scorching (曬黑) in separate clauses.
WH07805+WTH8804 (שָׁזַף = to scorch) annotates the compound resultative verb 曬黑 in 因日頭把我曬黑了; the 黑 component is not separately re-annotated with WH07840 since that SN is already consumed by 黝黑.
LCC 叫 (to tell/cause) corresponds to UNV 使 → both translate Hebrew שִׂים (WH07760, set/make).
LCC 顧守着 (twice) corresponds to UNV 看守 → both translate Hebrew נָטַר (WH05201). First occurrence (participle) takes WTH8802; second (qatal 1cs) takes WTH8804.
{<WAH0853>} (direct object marker אֵת) retained as implicit — Chinese syntax requires no explicit marker.
LCC's repeated 你們 (plural you) and the topicalized second 我 in 我卻沒有顧守着 are Chinese discourse elements with no dedicated Hebrew SN; left unannotated.

Song/1.lcc_original: 我心愛的阿，求你告訴我你在哪裏放羊，你中午在哪裏讓羊躺着休息；我何必在你同伴的羊羣旁像【1】流浪徘徊【1】的女郎呢？
notes: LCC drops the relative particle 所 from 所愛的, so WAH07945 WH0157 WTH8804 all attach after 愛的 as a unit, absorbing the relativizer.
LCC's 讓羊躺着休息 is a periphrastic rendering of H7257 (causative lie-down); all tags attach at clause end as one semantic unit.

LCC's 流浪徘徊的女郎 is a substantial interpretive departure from UNV's 蒙著臉的人 (veiled person); both render H5844 (עָטָה, to wrap/veil), but LCC follows a tradition that reads it as a wandering woman — WAH09003 WH05844 WTH8802 are all appended after 女郎 as the phrase-final position.
Footnote markers 【1】 within LCC are preserved exactly per rule 7.
Second 哪裏 receives WH0349 (no prefix, matching UNV's bare 何處<WH0349>); first 哪裏 receives WAH0349 (with prefix, matching UNV's 何處<WAH0349>).

Song/1.lcc_original: 你這女子中極美麗的阿，你若不知道，只管出去，跟着羊羣的腳蹤走，把你的山羊羔在牧人帳幕旁放放。
notes: LCC adds vocative particle 阿 after 極美麗的 — left unannotated as it has no Hebrew equivalent.

LCC restructures the 'go-out/follow-footsteps' clause: UNV has 跟隨...腳蹤...去 (follow...footsteps...go), while LCC has 出去...跟着...腳蹤...走. H3318 (יָצָא, go out) maps to 出去; 走 is unannotated as it functions as a connective gloss with no unaccounted Hebrew source.
{<WAH09001>} retained as implicit after 出去 — the ethical dative לָכְ is unexpressed in LCC just as in UNV.
H7462 appears twice: once as Qal participle on 牧人 (<WTH8802>), once as Qal imperative on 放放 (<WTH8798>). LCC uses the reduplicated form 放放 for the verb; tags attach to the full reduplication.
LCC uses 帳幕 (tent/tabernacle) where UNV has 帳棚; both map to H4908 (מִשְׁכָּן).

Isa/1.lcc_sn: 以下是亞摩斯<WH0531>的兒子<WH01121>以賽亞<WH03470>的異象<WH02377>，就是當猶大<WH03063>王<WH04428>烏西雅<WH05818>、約坦<WH03147>、亞哈斯<WH0271>、希西家<WH03169>執政的日子<WAH09002><WH03117>以賽亞所<WAH0834>看見<WH02372><WTH8804>、論到<WAH05921>猶大<WH03063>和耶路撒冷<WH03389>的。
Isa/1.lcc_original: 以下是亞摩斯的兒子以賽亞的異象，就是當猶大王烏西雅、約坦、亞哈斯、希西家執政的日子以賽亞所看見、論到猶大和耶路撒冷的。
notes: LCC restructures from UNV's verb-object clause (得<WH02372>默示<WH02377>) into a topic-comment noun phrase (異象<WH02377>…所看見<WH02372>), so the tags split across two positions: 異象 gets WH02377, 看見 gets WH02372+WTH8804.
所 in '所看見' is treated as an explicit Chinese relativizer for אֲשֶׁר ({<WAH0834>} in UNV); per Rule 3 the braces are dropped and the tag attaches after 所.

The second occurrence of 以賽亞 ('以賽亞所看見') is left unannotated: LCC restates the subject explicitly for the relative clause, whereas Hebrew uses only the implicit pronoun in חָזָה (he saw). WH03470 is already assigned to the first 以賽亞.
執政 (to govern/reign) is LCC's added verbal predicate making the temporal clause grammatical; UNV's equivalent 作 is likewise unannotated in the source, so no SN is assigned.
日子<WAH09002><WH03117> maps cleanly to UNV 時候<WAH09002><WH03117> — both render Hebrew בִּימֵי (in the days of).

Isa/1.lcc_original: 天哪，要聽！地阿，要側耳以聽！因爲永恆主說：『我將兒女養大，撫養起來，他們竟背叛了我。
notes: 永恆主 (Eternal Lord) tagged with WH03068 (Yahweh); LCC consistently renders the Tetragrammaton as 永恆主 rather than 耶和華

UNV 養育(WH01431/gadal)+養大(WH07311/rum) maps to LCC 養大+撫養起來 in arguably reversed order; aligned WH01431(gadal=cause to grow/be great) to 養大 and WH07311(rum=lift up/exalt, supported by 起來) to 撫養起來; this order inversion is the main source of reduced confidence
了 (Chinese perfective aspect particle) before 我 left unannotated; WAH09002 attached to 我 only
WTH8765 appears on both 說(WH01696) and 養大(WH01431) — correct, same morphology code for two separate verbs

Isa/1.lcc_original: 牛認識牛主，驢認識牠主人的槽；以色列卻不認識，我的人民總不細想。』
notes: UNV 主人<WH07069> (H7069 qanah=buyer/owner) → LCC 牛主; LCC disambiguates the referent by prepending 牛, tag placed after 牛主 as the full phrase.
UNV 主人<WH01167> (H1167 ba'al=master) → LCC 牠主人; LCC adds the pronoun 牠 (its) before 主人, tag placed after 主人.
Second 認識 (donkey clause) carries no SN in UNV because the Hebrew verb יָדַע is elided—only appears once governing both clauses. LCC's second 認識 is likewise left untagged.
UNV 卻不<WAH03808> (second negation) → LCC 總不; different adverb but semantically the same negation particle, WAH prefix preserved.
UNV 留意<WH0995><WTH8712> (H995 hithpolel hitbonen=reflect/consider) → LCC 細想; 細想 (carefully think) is a good functional equivalent; morphology tag <WTH8712> for hithpolel attached accordingly.

Isa/1.lcc_original: 嗐，犯罪的國，罪孽沉重的人民，作壞事的種，敗壞的兒女！他們離棄了永恆主，藐視以色列之聖者，跟他疏遠。
notes: 國民 (UNV, WH01471) → 國 (LCC): LCC abbreviates to 國 alone; SN attached to 國
擔著 (WH03515) + 罪孽 (WH05771) + 百姓 (WH05971): LCC reorders to 罪孽沉重的人民; tagged in LCC word order as 罪孽<WH05771>沉重<WH03515>的人民<WH05971>
行惡的 (WH07489+WTH8688) → 作壞事的: different phrasing for same Hebrew root רעע; morphology code follows its verb
耶和華 (WH03068) → 永恆主: standard LCC rendering of יהוה
了 (aspect particle after 離棄) has no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated per Rule 5
與他生疏 (WH02114+WTH8738) + 往後退步 (WH0268): LCC merges both Hebrew elements into 跟他疏遠; all three tags attached to 疏遠 as the covering phrase
{<WH0853>} kept implicit for both object-marker occurrences: LCC has no explicit accusative particle

Jer/1.lcc_original: 便雅憫地亞拿突城的祭司中、希勒家的兒子耶利米、的言行記在下面。
notes: LCC uses 言行 (words and deeds) where UNV uses 話 (words); both correspond to <WH01697> (דָּבָר). LCC's rendering is slightly broader but this is clearly the same referent.
LCC punctuation (、instead of ，) preserved exactly from source.
All nine SNs map cleanly to the same lexical positions in LCC — the two versions are structurally near-identical for this verse.

Jer/1.lcc_original: 當猶大王亞們的兒子約西亞的日子，他執政的十三年那時候，永恆主的話傳與耶利米。
notes: UNV {<WAH09002>}{<WH03117>} are both implicit (Hebrew בִּימֵי = ב+יְמֵי); LCC has explicit 當 (preposition 'in/when') and 日子 ('days'), so per Rule 3 braces are dropped: <WAH09002> attaches to 當 and <WH03117> to 日子.
LCC 永恆主 (Everlasting Lord) is LCC's systematic rendering of יְהוָה in place of UNV 耶和華; same referent, H03068 assigned confidently.
LCC 執政 ('govern/rule') maps to UNV 在位 (H04427 מָלַךְ 'reign'); 他 is a LCC-added explicit subject pronoun with no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated.
LCC 傳與 maps to UNV 臨到: 傳 takes <WAH01961> (H01961 הָיָה 'come') and 與 takes <WAH0413> (H0413 אֶל 'to') — LCC uses different verbs but same semantic mapping.

UNV {<WAH0834>} (H0834 אֲשֶׁר 'which/that', a relative clause connector) is kept implicit {<WAH0834>} in LCC; 那時候 ('at that time') is a LCC paraphrase of the clause structure rather than a direct translation of אֲשֶׁר.
耶利米 carries no SN in the UNV source; left unannotated in LCC.

Jer/1.lcc_original: 當猶大王約西亞的兒子約雅敬的日子，直到猶大王約西亞的兒子西底家十一年年底，直到五月間耶路撒冷人流亡的時候，永恆主的話都常常傳與耶利米。
Jer/1.unv_sn_reference: 從猶大<WH03063>王<WH04428>約西亞<WH02977>的兒子<WH01121>約雅敬<WH03079>在位的時候<WAH09002><WH03117>，直到<WAH05704>猶大<WH03063>王<WH04428>約西亞<WH02977>的兒子<WH01121>西底家<WAH09001><WH06667>在位的末年<WH08552><WTH8800>，就是{<WAH05704>}十一<WH06249><WH06240>年<WH08141>五<WH02549>月間<WAH09002><WH02320>耶路撒冷<WH03389>人被擄<WH01540><WTH8800>的時候，耶和華的話也常臨到<WAH01961>耶利米。
notes: UNV '在位的時候'+<WAH09002><WH03117> → LCC '的日子': 日子 corresponds to WH03117 (יוֹם = day/time); ב-prefix (WAH09002) attaches to it as a unit.
UNV order is '在位的末年'<WH08552><WTH8800> then '十一年'; LCC reverses to '十一年年底' — WH08552+WTH8800 placed on 年底 after 十一年<WH08141>.
Implicit {<WAH05704>} in UNV ('就是{<WAH05704>}') maps to the second explicit 直到 in LCC; Rule 3 applied — braces dropped, tag attached as normal.
UNV '被擄'<WH01540><WTH8800> → LCC '流亡': different gloss but same Hebrew root גָּלָה (WH01540); morphology WTH8800 follows.
UNV '耶和華' carries no explicit SN in the supplied UNV+SN text; LCC '永恆主' (YHWH rendering) is left unannotated accordingly.
<WAH01961> (וַיְהִי, 'and it came/was') attaches to LCC '傳與' as the main verb of the clause, corresponding to UNV '臨到'.
UNV opens with 耶利米說， (no SN) which LCC omits entirely — no alignment needed
永恆主 (Eternal Lord) = 耶和華 → H3068 (YHWH); LCC uses a paraphrastic rendering but the referent is identical
傳 (transmit/convey) aligns with 臨 (come upon) for H1961 (היה); LCC softens the directional nuance but the semantic slot is the same
與我 aligns with 到我 for WAH0413 (אֶל + suffix); SN placed after 我 to keep the comma in its original position before 說

Lam/1.lcc_sn: 怎麼啦<WAH0349>！先前滿有<WH07227>人民<WH05971>的城<WH05892>，現在竟自獨<WH0910>坐<WH03427><WTH8804>阿！先前在列國中<WAH09002><WH01471>爲大的<WH07227>，現在竟{<WAH01961>}如寡婦<WAH09003><WH0490>阿！先前在諸省中<WAH09002><WH04082>爲王后<WH08282>的，現在竟成了<WAH01961>作苦工的<WAH09001><WH04522>阿！
Lam/1.lcc_original: 怎麼啦！先前滿有人民的城，現在竟自獨坐阿！先前在列國中爲大的，現在竟如寡婦阿！先前在諸省中爲王后的，現在竟成了作苦工的阿！
Lam/1.unv_sn_reference: 先前滿有<WH07227>人民<WH05971>的城<WH05892>，現在何竟<WAH0349>獨<WH0910>坐<WH03427><WTH8804>！先前在列國中<WAH09002><WH01471>為大的<WH07227>，現在竟{<WAH01961>}如寡婦<WAH09003><WH0490>；先前在諸省中<WAH09002><WH04082>為王后<WH08282>的，現在成為<WAH01961>進貢的<WAH09001><WH04522>。
notes: WAH0349 (אֵיכָה): UNV positions '何竟' mid-sentence; LCC repositions to sentence-initial '怎麼啦！' — same lexeme, different syntactic slot; tagged after 怎麼啦.
{WAH01961} clause 2: LCC '現在竟如寡婦' has no explicit copula/verb; implicit braces retained.
WAH01961 clause 3: LCC uses explicit '成了' for היה — braces dropped, tag attached directly after 成了.
WAH09001+WH04522 (לְמַס = tribute/forced labor): LCC '作苦工的' is a paraphrase of UNV '進貢的'; both render מַס; tags attached after the full phrase.
LCC '自' in '竟自獨坐' is a Chinese reflexive/emphatic particle with no Hebrew correspondent — left unannotated.
Clause-final '阿！' is a Chinese exclamatory particle — no Hebrew equivalent, unannotated.

Lam/1.lcc_original: 她夜間痛哭，淚水滿腮；在她衆親愛者中間、沒一個安慰她的；她的朋友都以詭詐待她，成爲她的仇敵。
notes: LCC 痛哭 is a single compound verb where UNV splits it into 痛 (Qal inf.abs., WTH8800) + 哭 (Qal impf., WTH8799); both H01058 instances with their morphology codes are attached together to 痛哭 to represent the Hebrew emphatic בָּכֹה תִּבְכֶּה construction.
LCC 淚水 corresponds to UNV 淚 (H01832); the added 水 is an LCC explanatory expansion and left unannotated.
UNV 流滿<WAH05921> (= Hebrew עַל 'upon') rendered as LCC 滿<WAH05921>; the 流 in UNV has no LCC equivalent and disappears.

LCC 衆 corresponds to UNV 一切 (= Hebrew כָּל); both WAH04480 (מ prefix = 'from/among') and WAH03605 are placed on 衆. The preceding 在 is a translation artifact (unannotated) and 她 before 衆親愛者 is the possessive suffix embedded in H0157 (unannotated).
LCC ends first main clause with ；where UNV uses 。; LCC original punctuation preserved exactly throughout.

Lam/1.lcc_original: 猶大因遭遇苦難，又因多作苦工，就流亡外邦；她住在列國中，尋不着安居之地；追逼她的、都在她困苦時將她追上。
notes: 服勞苦 (UNV) → 作苦工 (LCC): different phrasings for עֲבֹדָה (H05656, labour/service); SN placed after LCC's 作苦工.
遷到外邦 (UNV) → 流亡外邦 (LCC): both render גָּלָה (H01540, to go into exile); morphology <WTH8804> follows.
安息 (UNV) → 安居之地 (LCC): both render מָנוֹחַ (H04494, resting-place); LCC is more expansive but the SN follows the whole phrase.

在…狹窄之地 (UNV) → 在她困苦時 (LCC): בֵּין הַמְּצָרִים rendered spatially in UNV but temporally ('time of distress') in LCC. <WAH0996> (בֵּין) placed after 在; <WH04712> (מֵצַר) after 困苦時. LCC's 她 is an addition with no Hebrew correspondent and is left unannotated.
LCC punctuation (commas, semicolons, 、) preserved exactly from source; only SN tags inserted.

Ezek/1.lcc_original: 第三十年四月初五日、我在迦巴魯河邊流亡人之中，天開了，我看見關於上帝的異象。
notes: <WAH01961> (וַיְהִי 'and it came to pass') has no explicit word in LCC — kept as braced implicit {<WAH01961>} at the head of the verse
UNV parenthetical 以西結（原文是我<WAH0589>）signals the Hebrew has אֲנִי (I); LCC drops the parenthetical and uses 我 directly — <WAH0589> attached to first 我
UNV 被擄的人 (captives/exiles) maps to LCC 流亡人 (wandering exiles); <WH01473> attached to 流亡人
LCC 之中 covers UNV 中 for H08432 תּוֹךְ (midst); <WAH09002><WH08432> attached to 之中
UNV 得見 (Hiphil perception verb) maps to LCC 看見; <WH07200><WTH8799> attached to 看見
UNV 神 → LCC 上帝 (systematic difference for H0430 אֱלֹהִים); <WH0430> attached to 上帝
LCC 關於 (concerning, linking 看見 to 上帝的異象) is a Chinese syntactic addition with no direct Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated
第 (Chinese ordinal marker before 三十) has no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated

Ezek/1.lcc_original: 當約雅斤王流亡了去的第五年、四月初五日、
notes: WAH01931 (הִיא, copular pronoun 'it/that'): UNV renders as 正是 (it is/that is); LCC restructures as temporal clause with 當 — no direct translation of הִיא — attached to 當 as the nearest structural anchor for this clause-marker

WH01546 (גָּלוּת, exile/captivity): UNV 被擄 → LCC 流亡; both SNs (WAH09001 prefix + WH01546) attach to 流亡 as the main exile word; 了、去、的 are Chinese grammatical particles with no Hebrew equivalent and left unannotated
Date formula (四月初五日) maps cleanly: WAH09001+WH02320 to 四月, WAH09002+WH02568 to 初五; 日 has no separate SN in UNV and is left bare in LCC

Ezek/1.lcc_original: 在迦勒底人之地迦巴魯河邊、永恆主的話特特地傳與布西的兒子祭司以西結；永恆主的手就在那裏按在他【1】身上。
notes: LCC uses 永恆主 instead of 耶和華 for יְהוָה (WH03068); tag placed after 永恆主 both times.
UNV translates יַד (WH03027) as 靈 (Spirit) with a footnote saying the Hebrew says 手; LCC directly uses 手, so tag attaches cleanly to 手.
LCC 按 (press/rest upon) corresponds to UNV 降 (fell/came upon) — both represent the Hebrew וַתְּהִי (WAH01961); tagged accordingly.
{<WAH05921>} kept implicit between 之地 and 迦巴魯 because LCC also lacks an explicit preposition particle there, matching UNV's implicit treatment.
那裏 in LCC is an explicit word for the implicit {<WAH08033>} שָׁם (there); braces dropped per Rule 3.
特特地傳與 split as 特特地<WAH01961>傳<WAH01961>與<WAH0413>, mirroring UNV's 特特<WAH01961>臨<WAH01961>到<WAH0413> (infinitive absolute + finite verb + preposition).

Dan/1.lcc_original: 猶大王約雅敬執掌國政之第三年、巴比倫王尼布甲尼撒來到耶路撒冷，將耶路撒冷圍困住。
notes: UNV 在位 (H04438 מַלְכוּת + 09001 בְּ prefix) → LCC 執掌國政之: LCC freely expands 'in the kingdom/reign of' into 'managing the affairs of state'; both SNs attached after 執掌國政之 as the phrase boundary.
UNV 城 (<WAH05921> עַל = against the city) → LCC uses 耶路撒冷 explicitly in the siege clause instead of pronoun/city; <WAH05921> attached after the second 耶路撒冷.
LCC adds 住 (resultative complement marking completion of the siege action) with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated per rule 5.

Hos/1.lcc_sn: 以下是永恆主<WH03068>的話<WH01697>，就是當烏西雅<WH05818>、約坦<WH03147>、亞哈斯<WH0271>、希西家<WH03169>做猶大<WH03063>王<WH04428>的日子<WAH09002><WH03117>，也是當約阿施<WH03101>的兒子<WH01121>耶羅波安<WH03379>做以色列<WH03478>王<WH04428>的日子{<WAH0834>}、傳<WAH01961>與<WAH0413>備利<WH0882>的兒子<WH01121>何西阿<WH01954>的。
Hos/1.lcc_original: 以下是永恆主的話，就是當烏西雅、約坦、亞哈斯、希西家做猶大王的日子，也是當約阿施的兒子耶羅波安做以色列王的日子、傳與備利的兒子何西阿的。
notes: LCC's opening phrase '以下是' is an editorial introduction with no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated.
'永恆主' is LCC's rendering of יְהוָה (YHWH); tagged <WH03068>.

The two occurrences of בִּימֵי (WAH09002+WH03117) are placed on the two '日子' nouns rather than on '當', since '日子' carries the semantic weight of the noun 'days' and '當' is LCC's Chinese temporal conjunction with no independent Hebrew lexeme.
The relative particle {<WAH0834>} is kept implicit (braces retained); LCC's nominalized sentence-final '的' absorbs the relative clause structurally with no single explicit word to attach the tag to.

LCC's '傳' (transmit/give) maps to Hebrew הָיָה <WAH01961> ('came/was'); '與' maps to Hebrew אֶל <WAH0413> ('to/unto'). LCC renders the arrival of the word more dynamically than UNV's '臨到' but the two-word split is preserved.
Missing SNs: 03117, 09002

Hos/1.lcc_original: 永恆主開始同何西阿講話，對何西阿說：『你去，娶淫婦爲妻，收取淫亂生的兒女；因爲這地大行淫亂、離棄了永恆主。』
notes: 耶和華 (WH03068) → 永恆主: LCC systematically uses 永恆主 for the Tetragrammaton; both occurrences annotated.
UNV 他<WH01954> (pronoun) → LCC 何西阿 (explicit name in second clause): WH01954 transferred to the full name.
{<WH03068>} kept implicit: LCC second clause '對何西阿說' also has no explicit subject, so the implicit brace form is retained.

Hebrew infinitive absolute construction (זָנֹה תִזְנֶה): UNV splits as 大<WH02181><WTH8800>行淫亂<WH02181><WTH8799>; LCC 大行淫亂 follows the same split to preserve distinct morphology codes (8800=inf.abs., 8799=qal impf.).
收取 receives no SN, following UNV where the parallel 也收 is also unannotated; H03947 (לֵקַח) is assigned only to 娶 in both versions.
離棄了: aspect particle 了 is a Chinese addition with no Hebrew counterpart and is left unannotated after 離棄<WH0310>.

Hos/1.lcc_original: 於是何西阿就去、娶了滴拉音的女兒歌篾；這婦人懷了孕，給他生個兒子。
notes: UNV 懷孕 → LCC 懷了孕 (aspect particle 了 inserted between verb and object); SN attached after 孕 as the semantic head
UNV 生了一個兒子 → LCC 生個兒子; 了 and 一 are absent in LCC — both are unannotated function words anyway; 兒子 carries <WH01121>
{<WAH0853>} kept implicit: LCC has no explicit direct-object marker corresponding to Hebrew את

Hos/1.lcc_original: 永恆主對何西阿說：『給他起名叫耶斯列【1】，因爲再過片時、我必向耶戶家追討在耶斯列殺人流血的罪，也必使以色列家的國滅絕。
notes: 耶和華 (UNV) → 永恆主 (LCC): both render יהוה (WH03068); Lü's characteristic rendering of the divine name
{<WAH05921>} was implicit in UNV (no explicit character for עַל), but LCC has explicit 向 ('against/toward'); braces dropped per Rule 3 and tag attached to 向
UNV 討<WH06485><WTH8804> → LCC 追討<WH06485><WTH8804>: LCC uses compound verb 追討 to render פקד; both morphology tags attach to the compound
LCC clause order is 向耶戶家追討 vs UNV 討{upon}耶戶家 — SNs placed at semantically correct positions despite reordering
{<WAH0853>} (direct object marker את) has no explicit LCC word; kept as implicit per Rule 4
Footnote marker 【1】 preserved in its original position after SN insertion on 耶斯列

Joel/1.lcc_sn: 永恆主<WH03068>的話<WH01697>、傳與<WAH0834><WAH01961><WAH0413>毘土珥<WH06602>的兒子<WH01121>約珥<WH03100>的、記在下面。
Joel/1.lcc_original: 永恆主的話、傳與毘土珥的兒子約珥的、記在下面。
notes: 永恆主 is LCC's rendering of יְהוָה (H3068), equivalent to UNV's 耶和華.

LCC's 傳與 compresses three Hebrew tokens into one compound verb: אֲשֶׁר (H0834, implicit in UNV), הָיָה (H1961), and אֶל (H0413). Per rule 3, H0834 braces are dropped because LCC has an explicit word (傳) for the relative clause sense.
LCC's 的 after 約珥 is a structural genitive particle with no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated.
LCC's 記在下面 is Lü's interpretive addition (not in the Hebrew); left unannotated.

Joel/1.lcc_sn: 老年人<WH02205>哪，要聽<WH08085><WTH8798>這話<WAH02063>，國中<WH0776>所有<WAH03605>的居民<WH03427><WTH8802>哪，要側耳以聽<WH0238><WTH8685>！在你們的日子<WAH09002><WH03117>、或<WH0518>你們列祖<WH01>的日子<WAH09002><WH03117>、曾有<WAH01961>過以下這樣的事<WAH02063>麼？
Joel/1.lcc_original: 老年人哪，要聽這話，國中所有的居民哪，要側耳以聽！在你們的日子、或你們列祖的日子、曾有過以下這樣的事麼？
Joel/1.unv_sn_reference: 老年人哪<WH02205>，當聽<WH08085><WTH8798>我的話{<WAH02063>}；國中<WH0776>的居民<WH03427><WTH8802>哪，都<WAH03605>要側耳而聽<WH0238><WTH8685>。在你們的日子<WAH09002><WH03117>，或<WH0518>你們列祖<WH01>的日子<WAH09002><WH03117>，曾有<WAH01961>這樣的事<WAH02063>嗎？
notes: UNV '我的話{<WAH02063>}' is implicit; LCC makes it explicit as '這話' — dropped braces and attached normally per rule 3
UNV '都<WAH03605>' appears after the verb clause; LCC repositions it as '所有<WAH03605>' within the noun phrase before '居民', which actually better reflects Hebrew כֹּל יֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ word order
LCC adds aspect particle '過' after '曾有' — no Hebrew equivalent, left unannotated
LCC adds '以下' before '這樣的事' — translator's clarifying addition with no Hebrew equivalent; SN WAH02063 attaches to '事' at end of phrase

Joel/1.lcc_sn: 要將這事向<WAH05921>你們的子孫<WAH09001><WH01121>傳說<WH05608><WTH8761>，讓你們的子孫<WH01121>傳與他們的子孫<WAH09001><WH01121>，而他們的子孫<WH01121>又傳與另<WH0312>一代<WAH09001><WH01755>。
Joel/1.lcc_original: 要將這事向你們的子孫傳說，讓你們的子孫傳與他們的子孫，而他們的子孫又傳與另一代。
notes: H5921 (עָלֶיהָ, 'about it') is implicit {<WAH05921>} in UNV because no Chinese word renders it; LCC has explicit 向, so braces dropped per Rule 3 and SN attached to 向

LCC collapses UNV's generational distinction (子 H1121 = sons, 孫 H1121 = grandsons) into the single compound 子孫 (descendants); both levels map to the same Hebrew H1121 so SN content is preserved, but the four H1121 tags must be distributed across three 子孫 occurrences following the clause structure: object of 1st clause gets WAH09001+H1121 (the ו-prefixed form), subject of 2nd gets H1121, object of 2nd gets WAH09001+H1121, subject of 3rd gets H1121
LCC's 一 in 另一代 has no Hebrew counterpart—Hebrew is simply דּוֹר אַחֵר (another generation) with no numeral—left unannotated per Rule 5
LCC's structural particles 讓 and 而 and adverb 又 are Chinese clause-chaining devices with no Hebrew equivalent and are left unannotated per Rule 5

Obad/1.lcc_original: 俄巴底亞所見的異象。我們從永恆主那裏聽到了信息，同時有使節奉差在列國中，說：『起來！我們起來作戰、攻擊以東吧！』【1】論以到東、主永恆主是這麼說的【1】：
notes: UNV places WH0136+WH03069 (Adonai+YHWH) on 耶和華 in the superscription title; LCC's title 俄巴底亞所見的異象 has no LORD reference, so these SNs are applied to 主永恆主 in the footnote clause corresponding to Hebrew כֹּה אָמַר אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה לֶאֱדוֹם

LCC 攻擊以東 rearranges UNV 與以東爭戰 (fight against Edom); WH05921 (עַל, against) applied to 以東 as the final word of the phrase expressing עָלֶיהָ (against her = Edom), with 作戰 carrying WAH09001+WH04421 for לַמִּלְחָמָה
以到東 in the LCC footnote appears to be a textual error for 以東; SNs WAH09001+WH0123 applied to it as-is per original text preservation rule
LCC 所見的 (relative clause marker for 'seen by'), introductory 說 before the quote, 同時, 有, 在, 中, and aspect particle 了 have no direct Hebrew equivalents and are left unannotated
LCC uses plural 我們 (we) in both the message body and the cohortative, correctly reflecting Hebrew שָׁמַעְנוּ and וְנָקוּמָה; UNV uses singular 我 — both pronouns left unannotated

Jonah/1.lcc_original: 永恆主的話傳與亞米太的兒子約拿、說：
notes: 耶和華 (H3068) → 永恆主: LCC's standard rendering of the Tetragrammaton as 永恆主 ('Eternal Lord') rather than the transliterated 耶和華.
臨<WAH01961>到<WAH0413> → 傳<WAH01961>與<WAH0413>: UNV splits the verbal idea across two tokens; LCC parallels this with 傳 ('transmitted/came') + 與 ('to/unto'). H1961 attaches to 傳, H413 attaches to 與.
LCC uses ideographic enumeration comma 、 where UNV uses ，; punctuation preserved exactly as-is in LCC original.

Jonah/1.lcc_original: 『你起來，往尼尼微那大城去，宣告警戒它的居民；因爲他們的壞行爲上到我面前了。』
notes: UNV '向<WAH05921>…呼喊<WH07121><WTH8798>' (call out against) → LCC '宣告警戒'; LCC has no separate preposition word for עַל, so <WAH05921> and <WH07121><WTH8798> are both attached to 宣告警戒 as the full verb phrase covers both the calling and its directional sense
UNV '惡<WH07451>' (רַע, evil/wickedness) → LCC '壞行爲' (bad deeds); H7451 attached to the full two-character phrase
UNV '達到<WH05927><WTH8804>' → LCC '上到<WH05927><WTH8804>'; H5927 (עָלָה, to ascend/go up) is actually a stronger semantic match for LCC's 上到 than UNV's 達到
